title: Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize our next-generation data architecture on Google Cloud Platform. You will be responsible for the "heavy lifting" of dataconstructing robust ETL pipelines, managing large-scale Spark clusters, and ensuring our BigQuery warehouse is performant and scalable.
Beyond core engineering, you will help bridge the gap between traditional data processing and emerging GenAI capabilities, exploring how Vertex AI can be integrated into our production pipelines.

Technical Stack & Responsibilities
Core Data Engineering
ETL/ELT Architecture: Design and implement complex data pipelines from disparate sources into our centralized data lake/warehouse.
Big Data Processing: Leverage Apache Spark (via Dataproc) and Python/Scala to handle petabyte-scale transformations.
Advanced SQL: Write and optimize complex queries for data modeling, ensuring high performance in BigQuery.
Stream & Batch: Develop real-time processing solutions using Pub/Sub and Dataflow (Apache Beam).
GCP Infrastructure
Orchestration: Manage workflow automation using Cloud Composer (Airflow).
Storage & Databases: Architect solutions across Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, and Spanner, choosing the right tool for the specific latency and consistency requirements.
Environment Management: Ensure security, logging, and monitoring are integrated into every pipeline.

Required qualifications to be successful in this role
Must to have :
Programming: Mastery of Python or Scala.
Spark Expertise: Proven experience tuning and debugging Spark jobs at scale.
GCP Professional: Deep hands-on experience with the full Google data suite (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub).
SQL Mastery: Ability to perform complex window functions, CTEs, and query optimization.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Fabric Data Engineer 
Experience: 510 Years

About the Role 
We are seeking a hands-on Fabric Data Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Fabric, Python and SQL to build and maintain scalable data solutions across analytics and reporting use cases.
Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop and maintain Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering solutions , including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines and Notebooks.
Build and maintain layered data architectures (Medallion) and production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines for batch and incremental processing.
Develop and optimize Python, PySpark and SQL solutions for data ingestion and transformation.
Integrate data from databases, APIs, OData, files and SaaS applications .
Implement data quality, validation, reconciliation, monitoring and error handling .
Develop reusable, parameterized and configuration-driven data processes.
Apply appropriate data modelling and data warehousing practices.
Follow established development, naming, documentation, testing and deployment standards .
Collaborate with data engineers, analytics teams and business stakeholders.
Mandatory Skills 
5–10 years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, BI or related fields.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering , including Lakehouse, Pipelines and Notebooks.
Strong Python/PySpark and SQL skills.
Strong understanding of ETL/ELT, data integration and data pipelines .
Experience with incremental loading, CDC, watermarking and historical data processing .
Experience with relational and analytical databases .
Practical knowledge of dimensional modelling, star schemas and SCD Type 1/Type 2 .
Experience integrating data through APIs, OData, databases, files and SaaS applications .
Experience with Git, CI/CD and DEV/TEST/PROD deployment processes .
Experience with data quality, reconciliation, monitoring, logging and error handling .
Understanding of SQL and Spark performance optimization .
Desirable Skills 
Exposure to SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and downstream reporting/data consumption use cases.
Previous experience integrating or migrating SAP BTP calculated views to Microsoft Fabric or similar modern data platforms .
Experience with Confluence for technical documentation and knowledge sharing.
Exposure to Salesforce as a data source .
Exposure to Microsoft Purview or other data governance, cataloguing, or metadata management solutions .

Job Title: Software Engineer 
Company: Digient Technologies Private Limited
Experience: 2 to 5 Years
Location: Chennai (Onsite)
Employment Type: Full-Time
About Us 
Digient Technologies is a dynamic and innovative B2B online iGaming company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge technology solutions for the rapidly evolving iGaming industry. We are committed to building scalable, high-performance applications that provide exceptional user experiences while driving innovation and business growth.
Job Summary 
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Full Stack Developer with 24 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining web applications. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in back-end technologies, database management, and front-end development while leveraging AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency and code quality.
The candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.
Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable web applications.
Develop robust and efficient back-end services using PHP, Laravel, and the Lumen framework.
Build responsive and user-friendly front-end applications using Next.js.
Create, optimize, and maintain MySQL and MongoDB databases.
Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services.
Write clean, efficient, and reusable code while adhering to best practices.
Perform code reviews, troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization.
Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and quality assurance teams.
Participate actively in sprint planning, daily stand-up meetings, and Agile development activities.
Utilize AI-assisted development tools, including Cursor IDE and Large Language Models (LLMs), to improve development productivity, code quality, documentation, and debugging.
Requirements 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
2 to 5 years of hands-on experience as a Full Stack Developer.
Strong proficiency in PHP, Laravel, and the Lumen framework.
Experience working with MySQL and MongoDB databases.
Good working knowledge of Next.js for front-end development.
Demonstrated proficiency in AI-assisted software development, including the effective use of Cursor IDE and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) processes.
Experience with Git and version control systems.
Familiarity with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
Experience working within Agile and Scrum environments.
Preferred Skills 
Full Stack Development
PHP Development
Laravel Framework
Lumen Framework
Next.js
MySQL
MongoDB
REST APIs
Git
Agile Methodology
Scrum
AI-Assisted Development
Cursor IDE
Large Language Models (LLMs)
If you are passionate about building innovative software solutions and enjoy working with cutting-edge technologies, we would love to hear from you.

Technical Project Manager / Delivery Manager

Seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager / Delivery Manager to lead delivery of a Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, enterprise search, data, and AI implementation. Coordinate architecture, engineering, AI, security, QA, governance, and UI workstreams.
Manage communications across client, prime-contractor, subcontractor, and technical teams.
Coordinate DEV, TEST, UAT, production releases, and acceptance activities.
Track staffing, labor hours, costs, deliverables, forecasts, and estimates to complete.
Coordinate environment access, tenant approvals, application consent, and technical decisions.
Lead delivery reviews, risk meetings, status reporting, and stakeholder updates.
Coordinate production stabilization, knowledge transfer, operational transition, and project closeout.

Working knowledge of Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Entra ID, document AI, enterprise search, generative AI, React, and DevSecOps

Project Management and Delivery Plan
Integrated schedule and milestone tracker
RAID, action, decision, and change logs
Staffing, utilization, cost, and forecast reports
Status, transition, release-readiness, and closeout reports

Government or regulated-environment delivery experience

Microsoft Azure Fundamentals or equivalent cloud certification

title: Project Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 

Roles & Responsibilities: 
Job Summary
The Project Manager is responsible for leading and managing the successful delivery of supply chain enterprise software implementation projects. This includes managing the project scope, timeline, budget, resources, and stakeholder expectations to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the customer's satisfaction. The Project Manager works closely with the customer, project team, and other stakeholders to plan, execute, monitor, and control all aspects of the project.
Responsibilities 
Develop and maintain the project plan, including scope, schedule, budget, and resource requirements
Manage the project team, including assigning tasks, monitoring progress, and providing guidance and support
Conduct regular project status meetings and provide updates to the customer and stakeholders
Identify and manage project risks and issues, and develop mitigation strategies
Manage project changes and ensure that the project scope remains aligned with the customer's requirements
Facilitate project meetings and workshops to gather requirements, design solutions, and resolve issues
Manage the project budget and ensure that expenses are tracked and controlled
Ensure that project deliverables meet the customer's quality standards and acceptance criteria
Manage the project closure process, including conducting lessons learned and archiving project documentation
Manage customer and stakeholder relationships, including communicating effectively, managing expectations, and resolving conflicts
Provide leadership and mentorship to the project team, and foster a positive and collaborative team environment
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (finance, operations, IT, procurement) to ensure end-to-end integration of supply chain solutions.
Monitor vendor and third-party performance, ensuring contractual obligations and SLAs are met.
Leverage analytics and reporting tools to provide insights into project performance
Deliberate and structured way of thinking resulting in effective cross-functional delivery.
Managing and tailoring communication across various stakeholders.
Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in business, information technology, or a related field
5+ years of experience in project management, with a focus on supply chain enterprise solutions
Strong understanding of supply chain processes and best practices
Proficient in project management methodologies and tools, such as Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with customers, stakeholders, and team members at all levels
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to think critically and creatively
Strong change management skills
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
PMP certification or equivalent is preferred
Industry 
Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
Employment Type 
Full-time

Immediate to 15 days joiner

Preferred candidate profile

description:
Roles & Responsibilities 
Build hands-on Gen AI prototypes, pilots and reusable components for AI roadmap.
Implement AI solutions for knowledge-base query, requirements generation, design support, trace/RCA, test strategy, test case generation, test execution support, deployment/MOP and stakeholder interaction analysis.
Develop RAG pipelines over requirements specifications and design documents, test plans, tickets, KB articles, deployment records, application and system logs and traces.
Build document-processing pipelines including parsing, metadata extraction, chunking, embedding generation, vector indexing and retrieval logic.
Create prompts, structured outputs and reusable skill files for requirements, acceptance criteria, design summaries, test cases, RCA summaries and stakeholder summaries.
Build n8n workflows for AI automation, including document ingestion, knowledge refresh, ticket summarisation, requirement extraction, trace processing, test generation, approvals and metrics capture.
Use Claude Code to support code understanding, code generation, refactoring, unit-test generation, documentation and engineering productivity within the OSP delivery context.
Implement evaluation mechanisms to track output quality, retrieval accuracy, hallucination risk, human review effort, time saved, adoption and AI output acceptance rate.
Work closely with SMEs, developers, testers, deployment teams and use-case owners to validate AI outputs and improve solution quality.
Document reusable assets, demos, workflows, lessons learned and implementation patterns in the AI KM repository and AI Engineering Playbook.
Qualifications & Skills 
Bachelors or Master’s degree in Engineering, with 1-4 years of experience developing Gen AI solutions
Strong hold on prompt engineering coupled with experience using LLMs including but not limited to Claude Sonnet, Claude Opus, Claude Haiku, GPT-4 and GPT-5. atleast 2
Hands-on RAG implementation experience including document ingestion, embeddings, vector search, metadata filtering, retrieval evaluation and source-grounded responses.
Experience with Claude Code for code generation, code explanation, refactoring, test generation, documentation and review support.
Experience building n8n workflows with API integrations, conditional logic, LLM calls, approval flows, logging, retries and error handling.
Experience with Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, REST APIs, JSON, Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel and vector databases.
Good understanding of software engineering lifecycle activities including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment and support.
Knowledge of Spec-driven Development will be beneficial.
Background in Telecom sector and network platforms will be a plus.

title: Plumbing Project Manager
description:
Virat MEP Services is looking for an experienced Plumbing Project Manager for high-rise residential and commercial projects.
The candidate will be responsible for project planning, subcontractor hiring, material procurement, site supervision, quality control, billing, testing, commissioning and handover.
Key Roles and Responsibilities 
Project planning and execution 
Review approved drawings, specifications, BOQs, project schedules and site conditions before starting work.
Prepare project schedules, work plans and activity-wise targets.
Monitor daily and weekly progress, identify delays and take corrective action to meet project deadlines.
Provide regular project updates to management and attend review meetings.
Plumbing systems 
Supervise the installation, testing and commissioning of:

Domestic water supply and distribution systems
Soil, waste, vent and sanitary drainage systems
Rainwater and stormwater drainage systems
Hot water and flushing water systems
Sumps, overhead tanks, pumps and associated piping
External water supply and drainage networks
Plumbing connections to sewage treatment plants (STPs)
Sanitary fixtures, fittings and related equipment
Ensure work is carried out according to approved drawings, project specifications and applicable standards.
Identify site clashes and technical issues and obtain the necessary clarifications and approvals.
Subcontractor and site management 
Identify, evaluate and hire suitable plumbing subcontractors based on project requirements.
Allocate work to site teams and subcontractors based on project priorities.
Monitor subcontractor productivity, workmanship and progress against targets.
Guide site engineers, supervisors, plumbers and technicians on installation methods and resolve day-to-day technical problems.
Work with civil, electrical, HVAC and other contractors to ensure smooth site execution.
Material planning and procurement 
Prepare material requirements based on approved drawings, BOQs and project schedules.
Obtain quotations, arrange material approvals and purchase materials for timely delivery.
Monitor material receipt, storage, issue and usage at site.
Maintain material records and reconcile quantities to minimise shortages, delays and wastage.
Quality, safety and documentation 
Inspect plumbing installations and ensure workmanship meets project requirements.
Arrange inspections with clients and consultants, and close punch points, defects and NCR observations.
Supervise pressure testing, leakage testing, flushing and other required tests.
Ensure site teams follow project health and safety requirements, including toolbox talks and safe working practices.
Maintain daily and weekly progress reports, inspection requests, test records and other project documents.
Support quantity verification, subcontractor bills, running account (RA) bills and variation records.
Manage final testing, client inspections, handover documents and project close-out.
Education and Experience 
Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical or a related engineering discipline. 
ITI in Plumbing or a related trade may also be considered for candidates with strong, relevant project management experience.
Practical experience in plumbing execution for high-rise residential or commercial projects.
Experience managing site teams, subcontractors, materials and project schedules.
Ability to read plumbing drawings, review BOQs and work with clients and consultants.
Knowledge of plumbing testing, commissioning and applicable project standards.
Desired Skills 
Plumbing project planning and site execution
High-rise construction experience
Subcontractor hiring and management
Material planning and procurement
Drawing and BOQ review
Client and consultant communication
Quality control and site safety
Quantity tracking and RA billing
Testing, commissioning and handover
MS Excel, email and progress reporting
Leadership and problem-solving

title: Project Manager
description:
The IT Project Manager will ensure project goals and outcomes align with the organization's strategic objectives by managing multiple large projects to meet operation and/or strategic goals. S/he works closely with the business stakeholders, solution engineers, operational support staff, and internal Program Manager within the Technology Project Management group, supporting them during the planning and execution phases of projects, once the solution has been defined and accepted. This PM is responsible for developing project plans, managing budgets and timelines, and leading multiple cross-functional teams. Must be reliable and responsive, with the ability to manage projects end-to-end including communication, issue resolution, and change management.

Essential Job Functions 
Lead high impact, enterprise critical initiatives while collaborating with multiple cross-functional technology & business teams in the creation and maintenance of project schedules for large complex projects, based on work activities and estimates provided by the solution engineers
Coordinate activities, drive progress, and track status against project plans, timelines and changing priorities from initiation through closeout
Communicate status of schedules, open issues, etc to internal team and leadership. Maintain online dashboards, status reports, and issues lists as required.
Provide regular, detailed status updates and present project initiatives to senior executives
Identify internal and external project risks, develop risk mitigation plans, and assist the project team in removing constraints
Manage project issue identification, tracking, resolution or escalation as required, and communication with key stakeholders
Identify and effectively manage remediation efforts resulting from shifting priorities, demands and timelines
Track project time reporting and budget forecasts vs. actuals

Specific Requirements (Technical Knowledge, Software, Etc.)
Working knowledge of Microsoft Suite including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Sharepoint and OneDrive 
Proven experience managing large, complex, and cross-functional projects
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Ability to manage multifaceted challenges and drive decisions while collaborating with diverse experts across the organization
Ability to work independently
Strong stakeholder communication and management skills
Possess excellent interpersonal, oral and written skills
Experience leading applications/system implementations
Strong understanding of and experience with SDLC concepts including Waterfall and Agile methodologies
6-12 years experience in IT project management

Additional Skills 
Change Management Experience
Previous use of JIRA/Confluence
Working knowledge of the IT systems or business functions in the telecommunications industry. 

Education 
College degree required, BS in related discipline preferred
PMP certification preferred

- Industrial client handling.
- Scrap material pricing and negotiation.
- Factory and machinery dismantling knowledge.
- Strong communication and business development skills.
- Vendor and contractor management.

title: Hiring For Project Manager
description:
EY ES Internal Transformation Services 
Assistant Director 
ITS (Internal Transformation Services) under EY’s Enablement Service, is a team of seasoned consulting professionals that operate globally on internal transformation programs which are critical to EY’s strategy and ambition. Our expertise is in the areas of Project Management, Strategy, Technology, Process Improvement, Organization Design, and Organizational Change Management. 

Job Description: 

We are seeking a highly experienced and knowledgeable Business Consultant to join our dynamic team. ITS professionals should be able to operate globally on internal programs that are critical to EY’s strategy and ambition. As a Business Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in providing strategic guidance and expert advice to our Executive Leadership in the areas of project management, change management, and design thinking. Your extensive experience in these fields will be invaluable as you collaborate with cross-functional teams, lead transformative projects, and drive organizational growth and innovation. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of project management methodologies, change management principles, and design thinking frameworks, along with exceptional leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Roles & Responsibilities: 

Collaborate with Executive Leadership to understand their business objectives, challenges, and opportunities. Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and guide teams toward successful outcomes
Manage & engage senior stakeholder relationships at CxO, Partner, Functional Head levels
Perform rapid assessment of landscape for stakeholders and provide insights to accelerate action towards refining their current state
Bring diverse and thought-provoking perspective to transformations, including market trends, new and innovative ideas to drive data driven decision making
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a strategic mindset and attention to detail
Drive and build upon a culture of continuous improvement by developing innovative idea
Conduct comprehensive analyses of organization’s processes and systems
Provide strategic recommendations and action plans to drive business performance and transformation
Develop roadmaps for implementing project management, Organizational change management, and design thinking initiatives.
Lead and manage complex projects from initiation to closure, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes
Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria in collaboration with clients and stakeholders
Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement mitigation strategies
Foster effective communication and collaboration among project teams and stakeholders
Develop and implement change management strategies to support organizational transformation initiatives
Conducting Change Impact Analysis and Change Readiness / Gap Assessment and give recommendations that are actionable on immediate and long-term basis
Build strong change network, drive change adoption, manage stakeholders with people centric approach, if needed work towards mindset shift and achieve cultural transformation
Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of change management efforts and make adjustments as necessary
Apply design thinking principles and methodologies to identify innovative solutions to complex business problems
Conduct user research, gather insights, and define user personas and journeys.
Advocate for design thinking principles and foster a culture of creativity and experimentation within client organizations
Contribute to the development and enhancement of consulting methodologies and frameworks
Mentor and coach junior consultants, providing guidance and support in their professional growth
What will make you eligible for this role? 
Master’s degree in business administration, management, or a related field
10+ Years of experience with at least 7+ years of management / business consulting experience

title: Project Manager
description:
Role Summary
We are looking for a Project Manager to lead delivery of our banking software product and its implementation at client banks. You will work with product and engineering to ship releases on time and at quality, and act as the single point of accountability to clients from requirements and fit-gap through UAT, go-live and stabilization. The role suits someone who knows how banks buy, deploy and run software, and who can protect the product while meeting client commitments.
Key Responsibilities
Product development delivery 
Manage product development with engineering, QA and design: release planning, iteration cadence, backlog prioritization with the product owner and release readiness.
Translate client and market needs into product requirements, separating what belongs in the core product from client-specific configuration or customization.
Maintain integrated plans for product releases and client implementations, covering dependencies, capacity and milestones.
Drive quality: test strategy, defect triage, performance and security testing, and release sign-off.
Protect product architecture and avoid one-off client forks that raise long-term maintenance cost.
Client engagement and requirements 
Be the primary delivery contact for client sponsors, business teams and IT; run kick-offs, workshops and steering committees.
Lead requirements and fit-gap sessions with client business and technology teams; document gaps, workarounds and change requests.
Set and manage client expectations on scope, timelines and dependencies; escalate early with options.
Coordinate client-side inputs: environments, integrations with core banking and other systems, data migration, security reviews and regulatory approvals.
Implementation and go-live 
Own the implementation plan: environment setup, configuration, integration, data migration, UAT, training, cutover, go-live and hypercare.
Manage client UAT, defect resolution and formal acceptance sign-offs.
Work with client infrastructure, information security, compliance and audit teams on requirements such as RBI guidelines, data localisation and VAPT.
Run go-live readiness reviews, cutover and rollback planning; own stabilisation and handover to support.
Feed implementation learnings into the product backlog and reusable implementation playbooks.
Commercials and scope control 
Own implementation budgets and effort tracking; 
Manage change requests with clear impact analysis; protect fixed-price and milestone commitments.
Support pre-sales with estimates, plans and solution scoping; track milestone billing with Finance.
Team leadership 
Lead cross-functional teams across product, development, QA, implementation consultants and support.
Coordinate partners and system integrators involved in client implementations.
Mentor team leads; build reusable templates and delivery playbooks.
Required Qualifications and Experience
1215 years in software product or banking technology delivery, including at least 5 years leading product development and client implementations for banks or financial institutions.
Delivered at least three end-to-end implementations of a banking product or platform at client sites, from fit-gap to go-live.
Working knowledge of banking domains.
Hands-on with Agile, Scrum or hybrid delivery, release management and tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
Experience with integration (APIs, messaging), data migration, environments and cutover planning.
Comfortable with senior client stakeholders; strong communication, negotiation and expectation management.
Commercial awareness across fixed-price, time-and-material and change-request models.
Preferred Qualifications
PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, SAFe or equivalent certification.
Prior experience at a banking software vendor, product company or consulting firm.
Exposure to cloud and SaaS deployments, DevSecOps and API-led integration.
Key Competencies
Product thinking: balancing client asks against a sustainable core product
Client-facing presence and expectation management
Scope and change control
Negotiation and commercial acumen
Calm ownership of go-live pressure
People leadership and mentoring

description:
Role Purpose
To lead the execution and governance of the joint NeGDCAG programme for institutionalisation of software controls across State Government financial management systems, ensuring that the five workstreams deliver the agreed outputs on schedule and to the quality expected by the Joint Standards Council.

Lead programme planning and execution, and manage the integrated schedule, milestones and inter-dependencies.
Coordinate across the five workstreams — IFMS controls, State implementation support, audit enablement, e-Procurement and works systems controls, and technical audit capability.
Act as the single point of coordination with the Office of the CAG, NeGD, Accountant General offices and State Governments.
Convene and service the Joint Standards Council and the Technical Working Group, including agenda, documentation and minutes.
Maintain the risk, issue and dependency register and drive mitigation with the concerned offices.
Review all deliverables for completeness and quality before submission for acceptance.
Prepare progress reports, governance dashboards and executive presentations for NeGD and CAG leadership.
Track expenditure against the sanctioned estimate and support preparation of Utilisation Certificates.
Plan and execute programme closure, handover and knowledge transfer.

Programme Management Plan and integrated project schedule
Programme Inception and Governance Record, with terms of reference for both governance forums
Monthly progress reports and governance dashboards
Rolling risk, issue and dependency register
Half-yearly programme report for the Joint Standards Council
Minutes and action-tracking records of all governance forums
Programme Closure and Knowledge Transfer Report

Work Experience

Degree bachelor’s in engineering

title: Devops Engineer
description:
AWS CNE Infrastructure Engineer (LTC E)
About the Role
Were modernising with cloud—building a secure, resilient, and scalable cloudnative platform that enables engineers across Lloyds Banking Group to build and run services safely and efficiently.

The AWS Cloud Native Environment (CNE) is the Group’s strategic cloud platform, providing standardised, AWSnative capabilities, private connectivity, and multiregion resilience to support critical business services.
As an AWS CNE Infrastructure Engineer (LTC E), you will act as a technical authority defining platform strategy, standards, and architectural direction. You will lead complex, enterprisescale initiatives and influence cloud adoption and engineering practices across the organisation.
Required Skillset: 
Strong hands-on expertise across AWS infrastructure and platform services including VPC, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, Route 53, Direct Connect/VPN, EC2, S3, IAM/KMS, EKS/Kubernetes and secure multi-account/hybrid cloud architectures.
Strong Infrastructure-as-Code, automation and DevOps engineering skills using Terraform/CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, Git and scripting (Python/Bash), with experience building reusable, secure and standardised cloud platform patterns
Strong operational engineering across AWS security, observability and resilience, including CloudWatch, Dynatrace/Splunk, logging/monitoring, incident troubleshooting, multi-region resilience, security controls and production support.
Key Responsibilities
Cloud Platform Engineering & Accountability
Own and govern the design and operation of AWSnative platform capabilities across networking, compute, storage, and foundational services.
Define, evolve, and govern standardised onboarding patterns for applications and integrations on AWS CNE.
Design resilient, multiregion platform architectures aligned to availability, recoverability, and regulatory expectations.
Drive and shape continuous improvement of platform reliability, scalability, and technical sustainability.
Networking & Secure Connectivity
Define and lead the design and implementation of enterprisegrade connectivity patterns including VPC, Transit Gateway, and PrivateLink.
Own and govern private DNS and service resolution architectures using Route53 and resolver patterns.
Ensure network designs align with Group security, segmentation, and firewall standards.
Act as a senior technical specialist for secure, private connectivity across AWS and hybrid environments.
Platform Automation & Engineering Excellence
Define and lead Infrastructure as Code design using Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
Drive and shape automation and standardisation through CI/CD integration and platform tooling.
Enable scalable, selfservice onboarding through approved templates, pipelines, and patterns.
Promote DevOps and platform engineering best practices across AWS CNE.
Security, Risk & Compliance by Design
Embed securitybydesign principles into all platform capabilities.
Enforce IAM leastprivilege access, encryption using KMS, and secure secrets management.
Define and lead platform contributions to audit readiness, risk remediation, and regulatory assurance.
Partner with security and risk teams to align with Group governance frameworks.
Operational Resilience & Observability
Own and govern the operational health of AWS CNE infrastructure and services.
Define and enhance observability using CloudWatch, Dynatrace, and Splunk.
Define and lead incident response, root cause analysis, and resilience improvements.
Drive and shape optimisation of cost, performance, and utilisation across the platform.
Container & Kubernetes Platform Enablement
Provide seniorlevel engineering support for Amazon EKS as a strategic platform capability.
Define secure, scalable deployment and access patterns for container platforms.
Contribute to cluster lifecycle management and access control models.
Partner with application teams to enable safe and consistent Kubernetes adoption.
Data & Integration Enablement
Enable secure data transfer and integration patterns using S3, DataSync, and eventdriven services.
Support integration with SaaS, PaaS, and enterprise platforms through standardised patterns.
Ensure endtoend integration flows are secure, resilient, and observable.
Collaboration, Standards & Influence
Act as a recognised technical authority within AWS CNE.
Influence platform strategy, design standards, and engineering decisions.
Participate in change, onboarding, and governance forums.
Coach and mentor engineers, raising engineering standards across the platform.
What We’re Looking For
Deep expertise in AWS cloud architecture and largescale platform engineering.
Strong leadership in architecture, design standards, and engineering strategy.
Proven experience leading complex cloud transformation initiatives.
Advanced knowledge of security, compliance, and regulated environments.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability across senior audiences.
Why Join Us
Engineer a strategic cloud platform enabling services used by millions of customers.
Operate at scale in a complex, regulated environment.
Influence cloud and platform engineering standards across the Group.
Collaborate with experienced engineers, architects, and security specialists.
Shape secure, resilient, and standardised cloud capabilities for the future

You will join the Continuous Improvement Team as a Cloud Engineer, focusing on the continuous improvement and optimization of existing solutions for our US-based client. The role requires ensuring the production environment operates smoothly, providing automated deployment solutions for new environments, and actively reducing infrastructure costs. You will collaborate closely with a team comprising a Team Lead, Cloud Engineers, and interact directly with development teams from the United States.

- Provision and manage scalable cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure platforms using Terraform.

Job Title: GCP DevOps Engineer
Experience: 5-12 Years
Locations: Pune, Hyderabad, Bangalore
Department: Engineering IT / Cloud Infrastructure
Role: DevOps Engineer

Job Description
We are looking for an experienced GCP DevOps Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), DevOps automation, CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). The candidate will be responsible for building, deploying, automating, and maintaining scalable, secure, and reliable cloud environments.

Design, implement, and manage cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployment.
Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
Manage GCP services such as Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Storage, Cloud Networking, and IAM.
Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational tasks using scripting.
Manage Docker containers and Kubernetes deployments, preferably on GKE.
Monitor cloud infrastructure, troubleshoot production issues, and optimize performance and costs.
Implement cloud security best practices, access controls, and compliance standards.
Collaborate with development, QA, security, and operations teams to improve deployment efficiency.
Support production releases, incident management, and root-cause analysis.

Mandatory Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .
Expertise in DevOps practices and CI/CD pipeline implementation .
Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) .
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes (GKE) .
Proficiency in scripting using Python, Shell, or Bash.
Good understanding of cloud networking, IAM, security, and monitoring.
Experience in troubleshooting and managing cloud infrastructure in production environments.

Good-to-Have Skills
Experience with Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or Cloud Build.
Knowledge of Ansible or configuration management tools.
Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Monitoring, or Cloud Logging.
Understanding of GitOps, SRE practices, and high-availability architecture.
Relevant GCP certifications.

Candidate Profile
8–12 years of overall IT experience with strong relevant GCP DevOps experience.
Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and automation skills.
Ability to manage cloud infrastructure and support production environments.
Willingness to work in Pune, Hyderabad, or Bangalore.

Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume, total experience, relevant GCP DevOps experience, current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and current location.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer 
Job Summary 
We are looking for a skilled DevOps / Cloud Automation Engineer with hands-on experience in CI/CD, infrastructure automation, containerization, Kubernetes, and AWS cloud services. The ideal candidate should have strong scripting and automation skills using Python and Ansible, along with experience managing GitHub-based development and deployment workflows.
Knowledge of IBM WebSphere Server and exposure to UiPath RPA will be an added advantage and may be required based on project needs.
Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
Manage source code repositories, branching strategies, pull requests, and release workflows using GitHub .
Automate infrastructure and application deployment using Ansible .
Develop Python scripts for automation, operational tasks, and integration requirements.
Build, manage, and troubleshoot Docker containers.
Deploy and manage containerized applications on Kubernetes and Amazon EKS .
Work with AWS services including: 
Amazon EC2
AWS Lambda
Amazon VPC
Amazon EKS
AWS IAM
AWS KMS
Implement and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable deployment processes.
Monitor application and infrastructure health and troubleshoot deployment/runtime issues.
Collaborate with development, QA, infrastructure, and application teams to improve deployment automation and operational efficiency.
Support application deployments and administration involving IBM WebSphere Server .
Contribute to automation initiatives using UiPath RPA , where required.
Follow DevOps best practices for security, version control, automation, and infrastructure management.
Participate in incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities.
Required Skills 
Strong hands-on experience with GitHub and GitHub Actions .
Good experience with Ansible for configuration management and automation.
Strong scripting/programming skills in Python .
Hands-on experience with Docker .
Good knowledge of Kubernetes , preferably including Amazon EKS.
Working knowledge of AWS , particularly:

EC2
Lambda
VPC
EKS
IAM
KMS
Knowledge of IBM WebSphere Server administration and deployment.
Good understanding of CI/CD concepts and DevOps practices.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills 
Experience with UiPath RPA and automation workflows.
Experience supporting enterprise Java/WebSphere-based applications.
Knowledge of AWS security and access-management practices.
Experience with cloud-native application deployment and container orchestration.
Exposure to monitoring, logging, and production support environments.
Education & Experience 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
Relevant experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Automation, or Application Deployment .
Candidates with strong hands-on experience across the required technology stack will be preferred.
Key Competencies 
Automation mindset
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
Collaboration and communication
Production support orientation
Ability to work in a fast-paced enterprise environment
Continuous learning and adoption of DevOps/cloud best practices

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities: 

What You Will Own 
End-to-end technical ownership of one client environment
Day-to-day health, reliability, and operational excellence of the environment
Deployments, infrastructure changes, and production support
Monitoring, alerting, and incident response
Infrastructure automation and continuous improvement
Client technical communication and requirement understanding
Coordination, guidance, and technical review of 12 engineers
Documentation, reporting, and operational knowledge management
Identification of opportunities for reliability, security, performance, and cost improvement

Cloud Infrastructure Operations 
Own and operate workloads running on managed Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE, including deployments, scaling, rolling updates, troubleshooting and cluster maintenance.
Implement, test and maintain backup, restore and recovery workflows for object storage and managed databases.
Operate and troubleshoot core cloud services including compute, storage, databases, networking, IAM/RBAC and load-balancing services across AWS, Azure and/or GCP:
Compute: EC2 / Azure VM / Compute Engine
Storage: S3 / Azure Blob Storage / Google Cloud Storage
Databases: RDS / Azure SQL or Azure Database / Cloud SQL
Networking: VPC / Virtual Network / VPC Network
Security: IAM / Azure AD & RBAC / GCP IAM
Load Balancers and Networking Services

CI/CD & Automation 
Maintain CI pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar for build, test, and artifact management.
Manage application delivery pipelines using CD tools such as Spinnaker, ArgoCD, Flux, or similar, implementing deployment strategies like Blue-Green or Canary deployments.
Troubleshoot failed builds, deployments, and releases and identify opportunities to improve deployment reliability and speed.
Automate repetitive operational activities and reduce manual intervention and operational toil.
Write and maintain automation scripts (Bash/Python) to streamline deployment workflows and reduce manual effort.

Security & Compliance 
Implement and maintain infrastructure security practices including vulnerability management, IAM/RBAC, least privilege, secrets management, and OS hardening for Linux workloads.

Monitoring, Logging & Performance 
Configure dashboards, alerts, and log pipelines using observability platforms such as Coralogix, Grafana, New Relic, Datadog, or cloud-native monitoring tools.
Troubleshoot performance and availability issues across infrastructure, containers, networking, and applications.
Proactively identify reliability and performance issues before they become client-impacting incidents. Own incident response for assigned environments, contribute to RCA, and implement preventive actions.

Linux & System Administration 
Manage Linux-based workloads across compute nodes and Kubernetes clusters, including patching, tuning, troubleshooting, and log analysis.
Perform OS-level maintenance, troubleshooting, incident response, and recovery while maintaining production availability and security.

Client & Stakeholder Management 
Act as the primary technical DevOps contact for the assigned client.
Understand client requirements and translate them into technical actions.
Communicate infrastructure health, incidents, risks, and planned changes clearly.
Handle routine technical discussions independently.
Set appropriate expectations and escalate risks when required.
Maintain professional and responsive communication during production incidents.
Build trust through predictable execution and transparent communication.

Team Coordination & Mentoring 
Coordinate, guide, and review the work of 1–2 engineers supporting the client environment.
Review technical work and ensure adherence to engineering standards.
Help team members troubleshoot complex issues.
Share knowledge and improve team documentation.
Proactively escalate capability, delivery, or performance risks.

Required Skills & Experience 
3–4 years of hands-on DevOps / Cloud Operations experience.
Strong hands-on production experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with working knowledge of core services across cloud environments.
Practical experience with Kubernetes deployments in production (preferably EKS).
Good understanding of GitHub (SCM) and building CI workflows in GitHub Actions.
Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform, CloudFormation, Bash and/or Python.
Experience administering Linux environments (Ubuntu / Amazon Linux).
Working knowledge of monitoring/logging tools – Cora Logix or similar (New Relic, Grafana, CloudWatch).

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities 

Own infrastructure as code in Terraform for the full landing zone: IAM, VPC and subnets, firewall rules, Cloud NAT, global HTTPS load balancing (ALB and NLB), Cloud Armor, private regional GKE clusters and node pools, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Persistent Disk, Cloud SQL, Memorystore, Cloud KMS, Secret Manager, Artifact Registry, and Cloud DNS, with environments reproducible from an empty project.
Accept the handover from our migration partner, validate every deliverable against the scope, and close the gaps they excluded: application process monitoring and alerting, runbooks, and day-two operations.
Complete the migration: ECS workloads to GKE, S3 data to Cloud Storage via Storage Transfer Service, remaining VMs, and the DNS cutover to the new load balancer.
Operate GKE well: namespaces, Kubernetes service accounts and RBAC, workload identity, cluster and node-pool autoscaling, ingress, upgrades without downtime, and GPU node pools with vLLM for open-weight models.
Run the data services: MongoDB Atlas from the GCP Marketplace, Confluent Cloud Kafka, Debezium on GKE, Memorystore Redis, and Cloud SQL, including backups, restore tests, and disaster recovery.
Build CI/CD with Cloud Build and GitHub Actions and Argo CD, with images and packages in Artifact Registry, signed images, SBOMs, and vulnerability scanning in the pipeline.
Run the observability stack: OpenTelemetry collectors, Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus and Grafana, VPC Flow Logs, and per-tenant cost and token telemetry.
Drive cost engineering: spot and preemptible node pools, autoscaling to zero, committed-use discounts, right-sizing the n2d and highmem pools, and a FinOps dashboard the founders check weekly.
Implement and maintain the enterprise security baseline: organization policies (public access prevention, no external IPs, no service-account keys or uploads, uniform bucket-level access, restricted serial port access, trusted images only, no default network), least-privilege IAM, CMEK with Cloud KMS, Secret Manager, VPC Service Controls, Private Service Connect, SSO, CIS benchmarks, and SOC 2 evidence.
Produce deployment blueprints for AKS and EKS and validate them with a real customer deployment.
Define SLOs, run incident response, and write the postmortems.

Preferred candidate profile 

5 to 8 years in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, with production depth on Google Cloud.
Kubernetes beyond the basics: private GKE, networking and ingress, autoscaling, workload identity, upgrades without downtime.
Terraform as your primary language for infrastructure, plus Python or Bash for everything else.
Cloud networking you can draw from memory: VPCs and subnets, NAT, firewall rules, load balancer tiers, private DNS, and how a WAF sits in front of all of it.
Operating at least one of Kafka, MongoDB, or Redis in production, and a habit of testing backups by restoring them.
Observability as a practice, not a product install.
Exposure to compliance work: SOC 2, ISO 27001, or customer security reviews.
Experience taking over infrastructure built by someone else and making it yours.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
About the Role 

We are looking for a hands-on, self-driven digital marketing professional to own our online presence end to end. The role covers social media, lead generation, content creation, website upkeep and in-house design work, along with general marketing support as the business needs it. It suits someone who enjoys variety and can work independently.

Key Responsibilities 

Digital Marketing & Lead Generation 
Plan, run and optimise paid campaigns on Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Ads to generate quality leads.
Manage lead capture forms and landing pages, and track leads through to the sales team.
Monitor campaign performance (CPL, CTR, conversions) and share weekly and monthly reports with recommendations.
Support SEO activities: on-page optimisation, keyword research and Google Business Profile management.

Social Media Management 
Manage the companys social media handles (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and others).
Prepare and execute a monthly content calendar.
Grow followers and engagement through organic strategies, trends and community interaction.
Respond to comments, messages and enquiries promptly.

Content Creation 
Create engaging posts, reels, short videos, carousels and stories.
Write captions, ad copy, blog posts, website content and email or WhatsApp campaign content.
Coordinate photo and video shoots when required.

Website Management 
Update and maintain the company website (WordPress or similar CMS): add new pages, update content and images, and remodel sections as needed.
Make sure the website is mobile-friendly, fast and aligned with the brand.
Coordinate with external developers or agencies for technical changes.

Design & Presentations 
Design creatives using Canva (and Photoshop/Illustrator if known): social posts, brochures, flyers, banners and ads.
Prepare professional presentation decks for management, clients and investors (PowerPoint / Google Slides / Canva).
Maintain brand consistency across all communication.
Other Responsibilities 
Support offline marketing activities, events and promotions as required.
Track competitor activity and industry trends.
Handle miscellaneous marketing and administrative tasks assigned by management.

Required Skills & Qualifications 
3 to 5 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, social media and content creation.
Proven hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads for lead generation.
Strong command of Canva. Basic video editing skills (CapCut, InShot, Premiere Pro or similar).
Working knowledge of WordPress or website CMS.
Proficiency in MS PowerPoint, Excel and Google Workspace.
Excellent written and spoken English. Knowledge of [regional language] is a plus.
Familiarity with Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite and basic SEO tools.
Creative mindset with an eye for design and detail.
Ability to multitask, meet deadlines and work independently.

Good to Have 
Experience in marketing.
Knowledge of Photoshop or Illustrator.
Experience with WhatsApp Business, email marketing tools or a CRM.

What We Offer 
Opportunity to own and shape the brands entire digital presence.
Direct exposure to management and decision-making.
A growth-oriented work environment.
Add any benefits: Health Insurance, Hybrid Work

title: Digital Marketing & Advertising Specialist
description:
We are building a new family entertainment and children's activity brand, offering indoor play, birthday parties, memberships, events, and family experiences.
We are hiring a smart, hands-on Digital Marketing Specialist who can own digital campaigns end to end from planning and paid advertising to lead generation, bookings, retention, tracking, and reporting.
This is a high-ownership role. You will work directly with the Stakeholders and operations team, community partners, and an in-house creative team.

Role & responsibilities 

Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns for brand awareness, grand opening, birthday parties, memberships, events, camps, day passes, and repeat visits.
Manage and optimize paid campaigns on Meta Ads, Google Ads, Instagram, Facebook, Google Search, Display, YouTube, and other relevant channels.
Generate qualified leads and improve party bookings, memberships, event registrations, and customer acquisition.
Set up and manage campaign tracking using Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, UTM links, and conversion events.
Build retargeting campaigns for website visitors, leads, booking drop-offs, social-media audiences, past customers, and lapsed members.
Work with the creative team to develop ad creatives, videos, Reels, campaign copy, landing-page copy, email campaigns, and social-media content.
Manage content calendars and maintain active, accurate social-media and Google Business profiles.
Run email and SMS campaigns for lead nurturing, booking reminders, promotions, memberships, reviews, referrals, and win-back campaigns.
Improve website and booking-page conversion through testing of offers, landing pages, forms, calls to action, and customer journeys.
Support local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, online reviews, and local digital presence for a U.S. location.
Track performance and share weekly/monthly reports with insights on leads, bookings, ad spend, cost per lead, conversion rate, customer acquisition cost, and ROAS.
Recommend new campaign ideas, offers, audience segments, channels, and growth opportunities based on data.

Preferred candidate profile 

3-6 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, paid media, growth marketing, or lead generation.
Strong practical experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads is mandatory.
Experience in lead generation, local business marketing, consumer services, retail, hospitality, events, fitness, healthcare, entertainment, or similar industries.
Experience with conversion tracking: Meta Pixel, GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM tracking, retargeting, and reporting dashboards.
Good understanding of Google Search Ads, Meta Ads, remarketing, local SEO, Google Business Profile, landing-page optimization, and conversion funnels.
Experience with email marketing, SMS marketing, CRM workflows, automation, lead nurturing, and customer retention campaigns.
Ability to write clear, persuasive marketing copy in natural English.
Comfortable analyzing campaign data and making practical recommendations to improve leads, bookings, conversions, and ROI.
Experience working with designers, video editors, content creators, web teams, and sales/operations teams.
Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple campaigns independently.
Comfortable working from the Hyderabad office and joining occasional meetings during U.S. business-hour overlap.

Good to Have 

Experience launching a new business, local brand, venue, retail outlet, restaurant, entertainment center, fitness studio, clinic, or consumer-service business.
Experience working with U.S.-based clients or U.S. local-business marketing.
Experience with booking systems, memberships, ticketing, CRM, loyalty, or event-management platforms.
Familiarity with tools such as HubSpot, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, GoHighLevel, Brevo, Zapier, Looker Studio, Canva, Buffer, Later, or Hootsuite.
Experience in childrens brands, family entertainment, hospitality, events, or community-focused businesses.

Application Requirements 

Please share your updated resume along with:

Examples of paid campaigns, dashboards, landing pages, email/SMS flows, or digital-marketing work.
A brief note on one campaign you personally managedobjective, channels used, results, and improvements made.
Current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and Hyderabad location/commute details.

We are looking for a passionate, analytical, and eager-to-learn Digital Marketing & SEO Fresher to join our growing marketing team. This position is ideal for recent graduates looking to build a concrete career in performance-driven digital marketing.

Basic understanding of search engine algorithms and ranking factors.
Familiarity with Content Management Systems (CMS) like WordPress .
Working knowledge of tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, and basic SEO tools.
Soft Skills: 
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Detail-oriented with an analytical mindset to interpret basic data trends.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
About the Role 
We are looking for a General Manager Brand Marketing to lead the end-to-end marketing 
charter. 

This leader will own Brand Marketing, Digital Marketing, Performance Marketing, SEO, 
Influencer Marketing, and Social Media Marketing, driving both long-term brand equity and 
short-term business growth. 
The ideal candidate is an experienced marketing leader who combines strategic thinking with 
execution excellence, has a deep understanding of consumer behavior, and has successfully 
scaled digital-first brands through impactful campaigns and performance-led growth. 
This is a highly visible leadership role where you will shape how millions of Indians discover, 
engage with, and experience dining out. 
Key Responsibilities 
1. Brand & Digital Marketing 
Define and drive overall brand positioning and marketing strategy. 
Develop integrated marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels to build 
awareness, trust, and consideration. 
Lead creative development in partnership with agencies and internal teams. 
Build compelling consumer narratives and differentiated brand communication. 
Ensure consistency across all customer touchpoints. 
2. Performance Marketing 
Own the end-to-end performance marketing strategy across paid channels including 
Meta, Google, Affiliates, and other acquisition platforms. 
Drive measurable user acquisition, retention, and revenue growth. 
Optimize marketing investments to improve CAC, ROAS, LTV, and conversion metrics. 
Continuously experiment with new channels, audiences, and campaign strategies. 
3. SEO & Organic Growth 
Define and execute the SEO roadmap to maximize organic traffic and discovery. 
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Content teams to optimize restaurant, cuisine, 
and city pages. 
Improve keyword rankings and search visibility across key consumer journeys. 
Build scalable organic growth levers to drive sustainable user acquisition. 
4. Influencer & Social Media Marketing 

Lead influencer marketing strategy across macro, micro, regional, and creator 
communities. 
Build engaging, culturally relevant campaigns across social media platforms. 
Develop scalable brand IPs and campaigns that create conversations around dining-out 
culture. 
Drive user-generated content and community engagement initiatives. 
5. Marketing Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration 
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing marketing organization across Brand, 
Performance, Social Media, SEO, and Influencer Marketing. 
Partner closely with Product, Growth, Business, Partnerships, Analytics, and CRM teams 
to deliver business outcomes. 
Own annual marketing planning (AOP), budget allocation, forecasting, and performance 
reporting. 
Manage agency relationships and ensure best-in-class campaign execution. 
Preferred Experience 
812 years of experience in marketing leadership roles. 
Experience across Consumer Internet, FMCG, Lifestyle, Consumer Tech, Marketplace, 
or F&B businesses. 
Strong expertise in both Brand Marketing and Performance Marketing. 
Demonstrated success in scaling user acquisition and engagement through digital 
channels. 
Hands-on experience leading SEO, Social Media, and Influencer Marketing initiatives. 
Deep understanding of consumer journeys, digital storytelling, and marketing analytics. 
Experience managing high-performing teams and external agency partners. 
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. 

Lead the entire marketing function for one of India's fastest-growing dining platforms. 
Own a high-impact leadership role with end-to-end responsibility across brand, growth, 
digital, and performance marketing. 
Shape one of India's most exciting consumer brands and influence how millions of users 
discover and experience dining out. 
Work alongside high-performing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial 
environment. 
Drive measurable business impact through strategic marketing, innovation, and 
consumer-centric storytelling.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
ROLE PURPOSE 
The Digital Marketing Manager is responsible for leading the digital media agenda for Muthoot FinCorp ONE, with a dual mandate of strengthening brand consideration and driving customer acquisition.
The role owns digital media strategy, planning, execution and optimisation across paid channels and is responsible for ensuring that media investments deliver against clearly defined marketing and business objectives.
The incumbent will manage digital media agencies and partners, recommend deployment of approved budgets across channels and campaigns, and continuously improve media effectiveness based on performance.
A key requirement of the role is to connect digital media activity with downstream business outcomes. The role will therefore maintain visibility across the customer funnel from impressions and reach through traffic, leads, applications, conversions and disbursals, working with relevant internal teams to understand and improve performance.
The immediate scope is Muthoot FinCorp ONE, with the potential for the role to progressively support the broader Muthoot FinCorp digital media mandate.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES 
1. Digital Media Strategy
Translate brand and business objectives into integrated digital media strategies.
Define the appropriate combination of channels, audiences, formats and campaign objectives.
Develop media strategies across Google, Meta, programmatic, online video and other relevant paid digital channels.
Balance investments between brand-building and customer-acquisition objectives.
Identify emerging digital media opportunities and recommend their application to Muthoot FinCorp ONE.
Outcome: A clearly defined digital media strategy that delivers both brand impact and customer acquisition.

2. Digital Brand Building
Develop paid media strategies for key brand and product campaigns.
Build audience strategies designed to deliver effective reach and frequency amongst priority customer segments.
Partner with Brand and Content teams to ensure creative ideas are effectively translated into digital media.
Drive amplification of key campaigns across relevant digital platforms.
Track indicators such as reach, frequency, engagement, video consumption, branded search and consideration.
Outcome: Sustained improvement in Muthoot FinCorp ONE's visibility and consideration amongst priority customer audiences.

3. Customer Acquisition
Plan and manage acquisition campaigns across search, social, display, video, affiliates and other relevant digital channels.
Drive traffic, leads, journey initiations and applications for priority Muthoot FinCorp ONE propositions.
Continuously optimise campaigns across audiences, creatives, placements, platforms and bidding strategies.
Balance acquisition volumes with lead quality, conversion and cost efficiency.
Build effective prospecting and conversion campaign structures.
Outcome: Scalable and cost-efficient acquisition of customers with demonstrable contribution to business volumes.

4. Full-Funnel Media Effectiveness 
Define appropriate KPIs across each stage of the funnel. 
Track media-generated customers through downstream business outcomes.
Work with Business, Product and Analytics teams to understand lead quality and conversion.
Identify significant funnel drop-offs and determine whether interventions are required across media, audience, communication or customer journeys.
Use downstream conversion information to improve future media decisions.
Build a clear understanding of digital media's contribution to customer acquisition and disbursals.
Outcome: Media decisions increasingly optimised against business outcomes rather than platform-level metrics alone.

5. Media Planning & Investment Management 
Develop annual, quarterly and campaign-level digital media plans.
Recommend allocation of approved budgets across platforms, campaigns and objectives.
Recommend reallocation of spends based on campaign performance and changing business priorities.
Monitor utilisation and ensure adherence to approved budgets.
Maintain appropriate governance over campaign spends, approvals and reporting.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of media investment.
Outcome: Disciplined allocation of digital media investment with demonstrable improvements in effectiveness and efficiency.

6. Agency & Partner Management 
Develop clear agency briefs linked to marketing and business objectives.
Evaluate media recommendations, audience strategies and campaign plans.
Challenge agency recommendations where required and independently assess opportunities for improvement.
Ensure campaigns are launched accurately, on time and within approved budgets.
Establish structured agency performance reviews.
Hold partners accountable for campaign delivery, optimisation, reporting and agreed outcomes.
Outcome: High-quality agency output with strong accountability for performance and execution.

7. Measurement, Analytics & Optimisation 
Establish campaign dashboards and regular performance reviews.
Monitor metrics including reach, frequency, CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL/CPA, conversion rates and downstream business conversion.
Analyse performance across channels, campaigns, audiences, creatives and propositions.
Conduct structured experiments across media strategies, audiences, formats and creative executions.
Translate campaign data into clear recommendations and actions.
Build learnings from completed campaigns into future media planning.
Outcome: Continuous improvement in digital media performance supported by robust measurement and experimentation.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS 
Experience
58 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, media planning or performance marketing.
Demonstrated experience managing paid digital campaigns across major digital platforms.
Experience spanning both brand-led digital media and performance/customer-acquisition marketing.
Experience managing digital media agencies and evaluating media recommendations independently.
Strong understanding of digital media planning, audience strategy, campaign optimisation and measurement.
Experience working with customer acquisition funnels and downstream conversion metrics.
Exposure to BFSI, fintech, consumer internet, telecom, e-commerce or other high-volume consumer businesses preferred.
Education
MBA/PGDM or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Business or a related discipline preferred.

KNOWLEDGE & CAPABILITIES 
Digital media strategy and planning
Paid search and paid social
Programmatic and online video
Audience planning and segmentation
Brand and performance media
Media economics and budget allocation
Customer acquisition
Campaign measurement and optimisation
Digital funnel analysis
Agency management
Experimentation and performance improvement
Data interpretation and commercial decision-making
Familiarity with attribution and digital analytics platforms is desirable. Deep technical ownership of marketing technology implementation is not a requirement for the role.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a results-driven Senior Digital Marketing Executive to lead digital marketing initiatives for our real estate projects, drive qualified lead generation, optimize marketing investments, and contribute to overall sales growth.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute digital marketing strategies aligned with project sales targets, launches, and business objectives.
- Plan, manage, and optimize Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid campaigns to maximize qualified leads and marketing ROI.
- Own campaign budgets, lead generation targets, cost per lead (CPL), and performance optimization.
- Drive integrated digital campaigns across social media, SEO, websites, landing pages, and real estate portals.
- Analyze campaign performance, lead quality, customer acquisition costs, and conversion trends to identify growth opportunities.
- Work closely with sales and CRM teams to improve lead management, site visits, and booking conversions.
- Lead digital campaign planning, creative strategy, content direction, and brand positioning for real estate projects.
- Monitor competitor strategies, market trends, and customer behaviour to improve campaign effectiveness.
- Manage external agencies, creative teams, and portal partners to ensure timely execution and quality deliverables.
- Prepare and present performance reports, budget utilization, insights, and action plans to management.

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
- 45 years of hands-on digital marketing experience, preferably in real estate.
- Strong expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, performance marketing, and lead generation.
- Knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, SEO, CRM integration, and property portals.
- Strong analytical, strategic planning, budget management, and stakeholder coordination skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Qualified lead generation and achievement of monthly targets.
- Cost per lead, cost per site visit, and marketing ROI.
- Campaign efficiency and advertising budget utilization.
- Contribution to site visits and booking conversions.
- Campaign execution, reporting accuracy, and overall digital growth.

Application: Interested candidates may share their updated resume along with details of real estate campaigns managed, advertising budgets handled, and results achieved.

Role & responsibilities 

We are looking for enthusiastic and creative Digital Marketing Executives to join Nexus Infosys. The role involves managing digital content, video editing, graphic designing, website management, SEO and online advertising.

1. Video Editing, Graphic Designing & Content Creation 
Edit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and promotional videos.
Create attractive social media posts, banners, posters and marketing creatives.
Develop engaging content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
Create product videos, product demonstrations and promotional content.
Assist with product photography and video shoots.
Create marketing content for leading IT brands and our BenQ Experience Centre.
2. Website Management & E-commerce 
Manage and maintain the company's WordPress and WooCommerce website.
Upload new products and update product descriptions, images and pricing.
Manage website pages, banners, categories and product listings.
Assist with website updates, improvements and user experience optimisation.
Ensure product information and website content are regularly updated.
3. SEO & Google Ads 
Assist in managing Google Ads campaigns, including Search and Performance Max.
Perform keyword research and competitor analysis.
Work on on-page SEO, meta titles, meta descriptions and blog publishing.
Monitor website performance using Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
Assist with Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking.
Analyse digital marketing performance and prepare reports.

Preferred candidate profile 

Freshers and candidates with 01 year of experience are welcome.
Basic knowledge of Canva, Photoshop or other graphic designing tools.
Knowledge of video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Filmora or CapCut.
Basic understanding of WordPress and WooCommerce.
Interest in SEO, Google Ads and digital marketing.
Good communication, writing and creative skills.
Knowledge of social media platforms and current digital trends.
Willingness to learn, take initiative and handle multiple responsibilities.

Perks and benefits 

Opportunity to work with leading technology brands.
Hands-on experience in e-commerce and digital marketing.
Practical exposure to Google Ads, SEO and website management.
Creative freedom and opportunities to develop new ideas.
Learning, skill development and career growth opportunities.
Friendly and collaborative working environment.

Set up and maintain conversion tracking with GA4, Google Tag Manager and Meta Pixel / Conversions API.
Support SEO and Google Business Profile: on-page basics, local listings, reviews and posts.
Build landing-page and lead-form flows; coordinate with sales on lead follow-up and feedback.
Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports (spend, leads, CPL, CTR, conversion rate, ROAS) with clear next actions.
Track competitor ads and platform updates; propose new campaign ideas and tests.

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS 
Minimum 1 year of hands-on digital marketing experience with proof of live campaigns managed.
Practical expertise in ALL of the following: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Canva and Social Media Marketing.
Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, SEO basics and Google Business Profile.
Strong understanding of funnels, targeting, retargeting, A/B testing and lead-generation campaigns.
Data-driven: able to read dashboards, calculate CPL and ROAS, and explain results clearly.
Good written English for ad copy and captions; Marathi or Hindi is a plus.

PREFERRED 
Google Ads and/or Meta Blueprint certification.
Experience in Cybersecurity ,IT services, telecom, ISP, B2B or local-service lead generation.
Basic video editing (CapCut, InShot, Premiere) and reels creation.
Exposure to WhatsApp Business, email marketing or CRM tools (Zoho, HubSpot).
Comfort using AI tools for content, creatives and campaign productivity.

WHAT YOU GET 
Real budgets and full ownership of your campaigns.
Exposure to multiple B2B and B2C service lines.
Fast learning curve and performance-driven growth.
Stable direct-client payroll role at a Chinchwad office.

EDUCATION 
Any graduate. Digital marketing certifications preferred. Skills and results matter more than degrees.

Campaign portfolio or results: screenshots, monthly ad spend handled, leads and CPL achieved

Current CTC, expected CTC and notice period
Current location

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Job Title: Digital Marketing Executive

We are looking for a skilled and result-oriented Digital Marketing Executive to manage digital advertising campaigns across multiple platforms, with a primary focus on Facebook and Instagram Ads.

Key Responsibilities: 
Campaign Creation & Management: Plan, create, launch and manage advertising campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, Google, YouTube, LinkedIn and X (Twitter).
Meta Ads Management: Set up campaigns, ad sets, audience targeting, budgets, placements, lead generation forms and retargeting campaigns.
Ad Copywriting: Write compelling primary texts, headlines, descriptions and CTAs tailored to different platforms, audiences and campaign objectives.
Content Writing: Develop engaging social media captions, promotional content, creative concepts, video hooks and advertising scripts.
Audience & Competitor Research: Identify target audiences, research competitors and develop relevant campaign strategies.
Campaign Optimization: Monitor daily spending, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, leads, CPL and conversions. Identify performance gaps and take corrective action.
Performance Reporting: Prepare campaign reports and recommend strategies to improve lead quality, conversions and return on ad spend.
