2 - 3 years of practical experience in digital marketing or performance marketing preferred.
Strong hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, especially Facebook and Instagram campaign creation.
Working knowledge of Google Ads, YouTube Ads, LinkedIn Ads and X (Twitter) Ads.
Excellent advertising copywriting and content-writing skills.
Understanding of campaign budgets, bidding strategies, audience targeting and performance metrics.
Ability to analyze campaign performance and make data-driven decisions.
Familiarity with conversion tracking, remarketing and campaign reporting.
Good communication, time management and problem-solving skills.
Graduate in any discipline preferred.
Important: Candidates must be comfortable creating campaigns independently and writing platform-specific ad copies. Practical experience and execution skills will be given preference over theoretical knowledge.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER

Company: Media Masters / Wings to Grow

Experience: 59 Years Preferred

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Hyderabad, India

About the Role
We are looking for a responsible and result-oriented Digital Marketing Manager to handle the agencys complete digital marketing operations, including team management, client communication, brand management, social media, Meta Ads, and AI tools.
The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth operations, timely delivery, quality work, and client satisfaction across all brands.
Key Responsibilities

1. Team Management 
Manage executives, designers, video editors, content creators, and interns.
Assign tasks, monitor performance, and ensure timely completion of work.
Conduct team meetings, resolve issues, and maintain accountability.

2. Brand & Client Management 
Handle multiple brands and their complete digital marketing activities.
Communicate with clients, understand requirements, collect approvals, and manage feedback.
Maintain client relationships and ensure satisfaction.
Plan monthly content calendars, campaigns, and deliverables.

3. Social Media Management 
Manage Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest, and other platforms.
Supervise posts, reels, captions, stories, and promotional content.
Monitor engagement, reach, growth, and overall profile performance.
Coordinate with the creative team to maintain quality and consistency.

4. Meta Ads Management 
Plan, execute, monitor, and optimise Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns.
Manage budgets, audiences, creatives, leads, CPL, and campaign performance.
Prepare reports and implement strategies to improve results.

5. AI Tools & Content Strategy 
Use ChatGPT, Gemini, Canva AI, and other tools for content, research, campaigns, and reporting.
Develop creative concepts, festival campaigns, influencer collaborations, and marketing strategies.
Introduce AI tools and efficient workflows to improve team productivity.

6. Daily Operations & Reporting 
Manage workflows, deadlines, approvals, and pending tasks across all brands.
Coordinate between clients and internal teams.
Prepare performance reports and track team productivity.
Identify problems, implement solutions, and ensure smooth daily operations.

Required Skills
35 years of digital marketing experience, preferably with team management experience.
Strong knowledge of social media marketing, Meta Ads, and analytics.
Excellent communication, leadership, and client-handling skills.
Experience managing multiple brands and teams simultaneously.
Knowledge of AI tools, content strategy, and digital marketing trends.
Strong organisational, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Timely delivery and quality of work.
Client satisfaction and retention.
Team productivity and accountability.
Social media growth and campaign performance.
Efficient management of advertising budgets.
Improved workflows, reporting, and use of AI tools.

Candidate Expectations
The candidate must take complete ownership of the agency’s daily operations, manage the team independently, handle clients professionally, monitor campaigns, and ensure that every brand receives proper attention.

The goal is to ensure that all clients, brands, team members, campaigns, and deliverables are managed efficiently, with minimum supervision from management.

title: Digital Marketing Lead
description:
Digital Marketing Lead for B2B Europe and USA Markets. 

Position: Digital Marketing Lead 
Department: Marketing & Business Development
Experience: 6 to 8 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: On-site

Industry: SASA Products / iGaming / E-Commerce / Technology / Digital Services

Job Overview 
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Aggressive Digital Marketing Lead who can develop and execute organic digital marketing strategies to generate high-quality B2B leads for Europe and USA business segments.
The ideal candidate must have strong expertise in SEO, organic traffic generation, content marketing, social media marketing, brand positioning, and conversion optimization.
The candidate will be responsible for building sustainable organic traffic channels, increasing brand visibility, attracting potential business partners and customers, and converting website visitors into qualified leads.
We are looking for someone who can independently plan, execute, manage, and scale digital marketing activities rather than simply coordinate with external agencies.

Important Expectations 
We are looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing Lead who understands that marketing success is measured by business growth and qualified leads, not simply website traffic, followers, or impressions.
The candidate must be capable of building organic marketing channels from the ground up, generating consistent for B2B leads, and developing a long-term digital growth strategy.

Key Responsibilities 

1. Organic Lead Generation B2B 
Develop and implement organic lead-generation strategies for B2B for Europe and USA markets.
Generate qualified business leads through Google search, organic social media, content marketing, and other digital channels.
Identify potential business partners, operators, affiliates, distributors, and end customers.
Build organic acquisition funnels to convert website visitors into inquiries, registrations, and qualified leads.
Explore new organic marketing channels to increase customer acquisition.

2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) 
Develop and execute comprehensive on-page and off-page SEO strategies.
Improve Google rankings for targeted commercial and industry-specific keywords.
Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and SEO audits.
Implement technical SEO, website optimization, backlink strategies, and internal linking.
Build and manage high-quality backlinks through guest posting, PR, and relevant industry publications.
Increase organic website traffic and improve search visibility.

3. Content Marketing 
Develop content strategies for B2B leads for Europe and USA audiences.
Plan and manage blogs, articles, landing pages, newsletters, case studies, and industry-related content.
Create SEO-focused content that attracts relevant audiences and generates inquiries.
Develop content calendars and ensure consistent publishing.
Coordinate with content writers, designers, and developers.

4. Social Media & Community Marketing 
Manage organic marketing activities across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, X, and relevant communities.
Build brand awareness and engagement through consistent organic content.
Develop LinkedIn strategies for B2B networking and business lead generation.
Identify relevant online communities, forums, groups, and industry platforms.
Establish relationships with industry influencers, content creators, and relevant communities.

5. Website Traffic & Conversion Optimization 
Analyze website traffic, visitor behavior, and conversion performance.
Optimize landing pages, CTAs, contact forms, and lead-generation funnels.
Improve website engagement, lead quality, and conversion rates.
Work with developers to implement SEO and website performance improvements.

6. Analytics & Performance Reporting 
Manage Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, and SEO tools.
Track organic traffic, keyword rankings, backlinks, lead sources, and conversion rates.
Prepare weekly and monthly marketing performance reports.
Identify growth opportunities through data analysis.
Continuously improve strategies based on measurable results.

7. Team Leadership 
Lead and manage SEO, content, social media, and digital marketing resources.
Develop marketing plans, assign responsibilities, and monitor execution.
Manage external SEO agencies, freelancers, and content partners where required.
Work closely with sales and business development teams to improve lead quality.

Required Skills & Qualifications 
68 years of hands-on digital marketing experience.
Proven experience generating organic leads for B2B for Europe and USA markets.
Strong expertise in SEO and organic traffic growth.
Good understanding of Google search algorithms and SEO best practices.
Experience with keyword research, competitor analysis, and backlink building.
Excellent content marketing and social media marketing knowledge.
Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills.
Ability to independently execute marketing strategies and deliver measurable results.

Preferred Experience 
Understanding of B2B lead generation and customer acquisition.
Experience with international SEO and multi-country organic traffic strategies.
Knowledge of affiliate marketing, industry directories, forums, and partnership acquisition.
Experience growing websites from low organic traffic to consistent lead-generating platforms.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
The candidate will be evaluated based on measurable business outcomes:
1. Growth in organic website traffic.
2. Number of qualified B2B leads generated organically.
3. Number of B2C registrations and potential customer acquisitions from organic channels.
4. Improvement in Google keyword rankings.
5. Growth in domain authority and quality backlinks.
6. Organic lead-to-conversion ratio.
7. Growth in organic social media engagement and reach.
8. Cost efficiency of organic customer acquisition.

title: Manager Digital Marketing, SEO & social media
description:
Role & responsibilities 

1. Social Media Management & Brand Building
Independently manage social media accounts for both Dronitech and Robo.
Develop and execute social media strategies across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and X (Twitter).
Prepare monthly content calendars, campaign schedules, and platform-specific posting strategies.
Create and publish engaging posts, reels, stories, videos, carousels, and promotional content.
Develop creative content showcasing company products, drone technologies, robotics solutions, projects, and achievements.
Handle regular posting, scheduling, audience engagement, comments, messages, and community management.
Increase organic followers, audience engagement, brand awareness, and relevant business enquiries.
Manage company leadership's professional social media presence, particularly LinkedIn.
Monitor competitor activity, industry trends, and emerging social media opportunities.
Maintain consistent branding, communication style, and visual identity across both brands.
2. SEO & Website Management
Develop and implement on-page, off-page, and technical SEO strategies.
Improve website visibility, organic traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation.
Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and website SEO audits.
Optimize website pages, blogs, landing pages, and product descriptions.
Manage Google Search Console, Google Analytics (GA4), and relevant SEO tools.
Apply modern SEO practices, including AI search visibility, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).
3. Digital Advertising & Lead Generation
Plan, execute, and optimize Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads campaigns.
Generate qualified B2B leads for Robotics, Drone, AI, and Enterprise technology solutions.
Monitor advertising budgets, cost per lead, conversions, and campaign ROI.
Develop targeted digital campaigns for product launches, exhibitions, and business development activities.
Coordinate with the sales team for lead tracking and conversion reporting.
4. Content Creation & Creative Marketing
Create professional marketing content, social media creatives, presentations, brochures, and promotional materials.
Develop engaging technical and non-technical content for products, projects, and business achievements.
Coordinate photography, product demonstrations, video shoots, and editing of promotional reels.
Create content using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, or similar tools.
Support promotional campaigns, product launches, exhibitions, and corporate events.
5. Marketing Strategy & Reporting
Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports covering SEO, social media, leads, engagement, and advertising campaigns.
Track follower growth, reach, impressions, engagement rates, website traffic, and lead conversions.
Develop marketing strategies in coordination with the Company Directors.
Attend client meetings, exhibitions, product demonstrations, and networking events whenever required.
Support branding, marketing presentations, and business development initiatives.

Preferred candidate profile 

3 to 4 years of relevant experience in Digital Marketing, SEO, Social Media Marketing, or Performance Marketing.
Proven track record of independently handling business social media accounts.
Strong knowledge of LinkedIn marketing, B2B lead generation, and social media growth strategies.
Hands-on experience with SEO, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads.
Ability to create high-quality social media content, reels, creatives, and campaigns.
Good written English, communication, presentation, and content-writing skills.
Proficiency in Canva, Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and digital marketing tools.
Knowledge of WordPress, Adobe Creative Suite, and video editing software will be advantageous.
Experience marketing technology, robotics, drones, IT, or industrial products is preferred.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple brands, and meet deadlines.

Perks and benefits 

Fixed Salary: 30,000 35,000 per month, based on experience and skills.
Performance Incentive: Up to 10,000 per month, based on achievement of agreed marketing and business goals, with eligibility starting after successful completion of 4 months.
Working Schedule
Office Location: Andheri, Mumbai
Monday to Friday: Work from Office
1st, 3rd & 5th Saturday: Half-day Work from Home
2nd & 4th Saturday: Holiday
Sunday: Weekly Off
Candidates must be based in Mumbai or willing to relocate before joining.

China Gate Group, established in 1993, is one of the leading restaurant groups in India, with a diverse portfolio of dining concepts. We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Digital Marketing Manager to strengthen our digital presence, enhance brand visibility, drive customer engagement and increase footfall and revenue across our restaurant brands.

Digital Marketing Strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies aligned with business objectives across multiple restaurant brands.

Proven expertise in performance marketing, social media strategy, SEO and campaign analytics.
Experience handling multiple brands, outlets or business locations.
Strong understanding of customer acquisition, local marketing and conversion optimisation.
Experience managing agencies, influencers, creative teams and marketing budgets.
Excellent communication, analytical, planning and leadership skills.
Ability to demonstrate measurable results through previous campaigns and performance reports.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with proven experience in restaurant chains, premium dining, hospitality or food and beverage brands will be preferred.
Should be strategic, creative, analytical and commercially focused.
Must be capable of independently managing digital marketing activities and delivering measurable business outcomes.

description:
Position: Digital Marketing Specialist(Expert in Google Ads)
Location: Pimple Saudagar, Pune
Experience: 2 to 4yrs
About the Role 
We are looking for a Google Ads Expert with 1.5 + years of hands-on experience in managing, optimizing, and scaling campaigns, primarily for lead generation.
Around 70% of this role will involve practical Google Ads execution, optimization, troubleshooting, and performance analysis.
Key Requirements: 
* Google Ads Must Have
* Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, Display & YouTube Ads.
* Strong keyword research, search intent & negative keyword management
* Campaign and ad-group structuring
* Ad copy creation and testing
* Bid & budget optimization
* Search Terms & Impression Share analysis
* Understanding of CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA & ROAS
* Campaign scaling and performance troubleshooting
* Lead quality and conversion optimization
Tracking & Analytics: 
* Practical knowledge of **GA4 & Google Tag Manager**
* Google Ads conversion tracking
* Website/form lead tracking
* UTM tracking
* Excel / Google Sheets
* Campaign performance reporting
What You'll Do: 
* Plan, launch and manage Google Ads campaigns
* Monitor and optimize campaigns regularly
* Identify and fix performance issues
* Reduce irrelevant traffic and improve lead quality
* Optimize keywords, bids, budgets and targeting
* Analyse campaign data and provide actionable insights
* Scale successful campaigns while maintaining efficiency
* Coordinate with creative, website and sales teams
Preferred: 
* Google Ads Certification
* B2B & high-ticket lead generation experience
* Multiple client account experience
* Basic Meta Ads knowledge
* CRM integration & lead tracking experience
* Looker Studio knowledge
Practical Expertise Expected: 
You should be able to independently handle situations such as:
* High CPL / CPA
* Low-quality leads
* High clicks but low conversions
* Sudden performance drops
* Low Impression Share
* Tracking/conversion discrepancies
* Performance drops after budget increases
We are looking for someone who can analyse the problem, identify the cause and implement the right solution not just someone with theoretical knowledge.
Why Join Us? 
* Work on multiple real-world Google Ads campaigns
* Exposure to diverse industries
* Hands-on performance marketing experience
* Freedom to experiment, optimize and scale
* Learning and growth opportunities

Benefits:
Leave encashment
Paid sick time
Paid time off
Work Location: In person

title: Assistant Manager - Digital Marketing
description:
Company: AGILiAD Technologies
Position: Assistant Manager - Digital Marketing
Location: Pune (Bund Garden Next to Ruby Hall)
Work Mode: In Office
Website: www.agiliad.com

We are seeking an Assistant Marketing Manager with a strong digital-first mindset , supported by an engineering background (B.Tech) and an MBA in Marketing . The role requires hands-on ownership of digital marketing strategy and execution , while ensuring consistent brand messaging and alignment across all touchpoints.
This position is ideal for a marketer who understands technology-driven and B2B businesses , is data-oriented, and can translate complex offerings into clear, impactful digital campaigns.

Key Responsibilities 
Digital Marketing (Primary Focus) 
Own and execute digital marketing initiatives across website, social media, email marketing, SEO, and paid campaigns
Plan and manage always-on and campaign-based digital programs to drive brand visibility, engagement, and lead generation
Manage social media strategy, content calendars, and execution, with a strong focus on LinkedIn and relevant platforms
Track, analyze, and optimize campaign performance using Google Analytics, platform insights, and dashboards
Support website management, landing pages, SEO optimization, and ongoing digital content updates

Branding & Marketing Communications 
Ensure consistent brand messaging across all digital and offline channels
Support brand campaigns, corporate announcements, and internal communications
Coordinate development of marketing collateral including presentations, case studies, brochures, and digital creatives
Work closely with design, content, and agency partners to maintain brand quality and standards

Content & Thought Leadership 
Drive digital content distribution for blogs, articles, newsletters, and leadership communications
Support thought leadership, employer branding, and corporate storytelling initiatives
Review and refine content to ensure clarity, relevance, and alignment with brand voice

Campaign & Project Management 
Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns with digital as the primary channel
Manage timelines, vendors, agencies, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely execution.
Support digital marketing for events, webinars, virtual campaigns, and hybrid events

Marketing Analytics & Operations 
Own digital dashboards, performance reports, and campaign trackers

Required Skills & Qualifications 
4+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience
Strong understanding of B2B digital marketing and brand management
Experience with SEO, social media marketing, email marketing, and basic paid campaigns
Working knowledge of Google Analytics, CMS platforms, email marketing tools, and social media schedulers
Data-driven mindset with strong analytical and reporting skills
Excellent communication, coordination, and project management abilities

Good to Have 
Digital marketing certifications (Google, HubSpot, LinkedIn, Meta, or equivalent)
Exposure to lead generation, ABM, or marketing automation tools

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Position & Role: Digital Marketing Manager 
Department: Marketing 

1. Job Overview 
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Digital Marketing Manager to develop, execute, and manage the company's digital marketing strategies. The candidate will be responsible for strengthening brand visibility, generating quality leads, managing digital campaigns, and driving business growth through various online marketing channels.

2. Key Responsibilities 

Digital Marketing Strategy
- Develop and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies.
- Plan and manage monthly marketing campaigns.
- Improve brand awareness and online presence.
- Identify new digital marketing opportunities.

Social Media Management
- Manage company social media accounts (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, etc.).
- Plan and maintain monthly content calendars.
- Oversee posts, reels, creatives, and promotional campaigns.
- Increase followers, engagement, and brand visibility.

Performance Marketing & Paid Advertising
- Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns.
- Manage Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram).
- Monitor advertising budgets and campaign performance.
- Improve cost per lead (CPL), conversion rates, and ROI.

SEO & Website Management
- Develop and implement SEO strategies.
- Improve website ranking and organic traffic.
- Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.
- Monitor website performance using Google Analytics and Search Console.

Lead Generation & Business Growth
- Generate quality leads through digital channels.
- Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition.
- Coordinate with the Sales team for lead quality and conversion tracking.
- Identify target audiences and new market opportunities.

Content & Campaign Management
- Plan marketing content, blogs, email campaigns, and promotional materials.
- Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, and content writers.
- Ensure consistent brand communication across platforms.
- Manage marketing campaigns from planning to execution.

Analytics & Reporting
- Track campaign performance and marketing KPIs.
- Prepare weekly and monthly marketing reports.
- Analyse website traffic, leads, conversions, and engagement.
- Identify improvement areas and implement corrective strategies.

Team Management
- Lead and manage the digital marketing team.
- Assign tasks and monitor team performance.
- Coordinate with internal departments.
- Ensure timely execution of marketing activities.

3. Required Skills & Expertise 

- Strong knowledge of Digital Marketing and Online Branding.
- Expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads.
- Knowledge of SEO, SEM and Social Media Marketing.
- Experience in Lead Generation and Performance Marketing.
- Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
- Knowledge of Content Strategy and Marketing Funnels.
- Understanding of CRM and Marketing Automation.
- Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.
- Excellent communication and team management skills.
- Strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.

4. Preferred Tools & Platforms 

- Google Ads
- Meta Ads Manager
- Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
- Google Search Console
- Google Tag Manager
- Canva / Adobe Creative Suite
- WordPress or other CMS platforms
- Mailchimp or similar email marketing tools
- CRM and marketing automation platforms

5. Qualifications & Experience 

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
- 3 to 5 years of relevant digital marketing experience.
- Previous experience managing digital marketing campaigns and teams.
- Proven track record of generating leads and improving campaign performance.
- Experience in the IT, SaaS, or technology industry will be an advantage.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

The candidate will be evaluated on:
- Quality lead generation.
- Website traffic and organic growth.
- Social media reach and engagement.
- Paid campaign ROI and cost per lead.
- Lead-to-customer conversion rate.
- Brand visibility and online presence.
- Marketing campaign performance.
- Team productivity and timely execution.

7. Ideal Candidate Profile 

We are looking for someone who is strategic, creative, analytical, and capable of independently managing the company's complete digital marketing operations while driving measurable business growth.

title: Head Digital Marketing
description:
Digital Marketing Head to drives online brand visibility, generates high-intent property leads, and manages digital ad performance to support residential, commercial, or plotted development sales . 

Job Overview 
Role Title: Digital Marketing Head / Head of Marketing (Real Estate) 
Core Objective: Turn digital traffic and ad spend into qualified site visits, walk-ins, and closed property sales while optimizing Cost Per Lead (CPL). 
Experience Required: Typically 10+ years of digital/performance marketing experience (with leadership tenure). 

Key Responsibilities1. Performance Marketing & Lead Generation 

Design and scale paid acquisition campaigns on Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google Ads, YouTube, and LinkedIn . 
Own and track critical real estate metrics: CPL (Cost Per Lead), CPA/CPB (Cost Per Acquisition/Booking), ROAS, and lead-to-site-visit conversion rates . 
Coordinate closely with Pre-Sales and Sales teams to ensure fast lead allocation, CRM tracking, and quality feedback loops. 
2. SEO, Website & Portal Management 
Manage corporate and project-specific landing pages, ensuring high conversion rates and fast load times. 
Drive on-page and off-page SEO strategies to capture high-intent organic search traffic for local property queries. 
Oversee active real estate listings and reputation management on major portals like 99acres, Housing.com, and Magicbricks . 
3. Brand & Content Strategy 
Oversee digital content creation, including 3D walkthrough videos, project teaser reels, WhatsApp/SMS campaigns, and digital brochures.
Maintain consistent brand positioning across digital touchpoints for residential or commercial portfolios.
Manage Google Business Profiles, online reviews, and community engagement. 
4. Budget, Analytics & Agency Management 
Allocate and monitor monthly digital advertising and portal budgets.
Use Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Meta Ads Manager, and CRM dashboards to build weekly/monthly ROI reports for senior management.
Lead and manage external digital agencies, creative designers, and tech vendors. 
Required Qualifications & Skills 
Education: MBA or Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or Digital Marketing.
Technical Skills: 
Hands-on mastery of Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and GA4.
Familiarity with real estate CRMs (Salesforce, Sell.Do, or custom property CRMs).
Strong grasp of funnel optimization, attribution modeling, and landing-page design. [1, 2, 3]
Soft Skills: Stakeholder management, cross-functional leadership with sales, and data-driven commercial acumen. [1]

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description Digital Marketing Manager
Organization: Asia-Pacific Institute of Management (AIM)
Location: Jasola, New Delhi
Department: Marketing & Admissions
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience Required: 4–7 Years (preferably in Education/EdTech)
About the Organization
Asia-Pacific Institute of Management (AIM) is a leading management institution in New Delhi with a legacy of 30 years in management education. With a renewed focus on digital transformation, global collaborations, AI-integrated learning, and industry-oriented education, AIM is strengthening its digital presence and student acquisition strategy.
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager who can take complete ownership of our digital marketing ecosystem, oversee campaigns across multiple platforms, manage agency relationships, and ensure seamless integration between marketing campaigns, LeadSquared CRM, and admissions operations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Digital Marketing & Campaign Management
Oversee and manage digital marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize performance marketing campaigns focused on lead generation, applications, and student admissions.
Manage campaign budgets, allocation, performance, and return on advertising spend.
Monitor key performance indicators, including CPL, CPA, conversion rates, cost per admission, and overall marketing ROI.
Develop remarketing, retargeting, and audience segmentation strategies.
Ensure effective campaign tracking through Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking tools.
Coordinate with external digital marketing agencies, review their performance, and ensure timely execution of deliverables.
2. LeadSquared CRM & Lead Management
Oversee the end-to-end integration of digital marketing campaigns with LeadSquared CRM .
Ensure accurate lead capture, source attribution, tracking, and distribution across all marketing channels.
Monitor lead allocation, lead scoring, lead stages, and automated workflows.
Work closely with the admissions and counselling teams to track lead quality, follow-ups, application conversions, and admissions.
Develop and optimize CRM automation workflows, including WhatsApp, SMS, email marketing, and lead nurturing campaigns.
Identify and resolve lead leakage, duplicate entries, attribution discrepancies, and integration issues.
Build and maintain LeadSquared dashboards and reports for marketing and admissions performance.
Analyze the complete admissions funnel from lead generation to final enrolment.
3. Website, Landing Pages & SEO
Coordinate the development, optimization, and maintenance of the institute's website and campaign-specific landing pages.
Ensure landing pages are optimized for conversion rates, mobile responsiveness, user experience, and lead capture.
Oversee SEO initiatives, including on-page, technical, and off-page optimization.
Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, and search performance through Google Search Console and GA4.
Implement A/B testing to improve landing page conversion rates.
Ensure proper integration of website forms, WhatsApp chatbots, and other lead generation tools with LeadSquared.
4. Agency & Vendor Management
Act as the primary point of contact for all external digital marketing, SEO, social media, creative, and technology agencies.
Establish clear deliverables, timelines, performance benchmarks, and reporting requirements.
Review campaign strategies, creatives, targeting, keywords, and media plans before implementation.
Conduct regular performance review meetings with agencies.
Ensure accountability for campaign outcomes, lead quality, budget utilization, and agreed deliverables.
Identify opportunities to improve marketing efficiency and reduce customer acquisition costs.
5. Marketing Analytics & Reporting
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports covering all digital marketing channels.
Develop consolidated dashboards combining advertising platform data, website analytics, and LeadSquared CRM data.
Monitor campaign-wise and program-wise lead generation, applications, admissions, and acquisition costs.
Track lead-to-application and application-to-admission conversion rates.
Identify underperforming campaigns and recommend corrective actions.
Present actionable insights and recommendations directly to senior management.
6. Marketing Automation & Admissions Funnel Optimization
Develop automated lead nurturing journeys through LeadSquared, WhatsApp Business API, email, and SMS.
Create audience segmentation strategies based on program interest, lead source, engagement, and admissions stage.
Work with admissions teams to improve lead response times, follow-up effectiveness, and conversion rates.
Implement re-engagement campaigns for inactive and previously generated leads.
Ensure compliance with applicable data privacy regulations, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection framework.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
4–7 years of relevant experience in digital marketing and performance marketing.
Strong working knowledge of LeadSquared CRM is highly preferred , including workflows, automation, lead distribution, integrations, and reporting.
Hands-on understanding of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
Proficiency in Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and conversion tracking.
Strong understanding of lead generation funnels, attribution models, remarketing, and conversion optimization.
Experience managing external marketing agencies and multiple campaigns simultaneously.
Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and marketing performance dashboards.
Strong analytical, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in the higher education, admissions, or EdTech industry will be an added advantage.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be evaluated based on:
Lead Generation: Volume, quality, and cost per lead across digital channels.
Conversion Performance: Lead-to-application and application-to-admission conversion rates.
Campaign ROI: Marketing spend efficiency and cost per enrolled student.
CRM Efficiency: Lead capture accuracy, source attribution, automation effectiveness, and reduction in lead leakage.
Agency Performance: Timely delivery, campaign optimization, and achievement of agreed targets.
Digital Growth: Website traffic, organic visibility, landing page conversions, and overall digital engagement.
Reporting & Accountability: Accuracy, timeliness, and usefulness of marketing performance reports.
Ideal Candidate
We are looking for a performance-driven, analytical, and execution-oriented professional who understands both digital marketing and the admissions conversion funnel.
The ideal candidate should be capable of independently overseeing multiple digital marketing agencies, critically evaluating campaign performance, managing the LeadSquared CRM ecosystem, and working closely with the admissions team to translate marketing expenditure into measurable student enrolments.
This is an ownership-driven role requiring strong technical understanding, strategic thinking, and hands-on operational capabilities.

We are looking for a creative, analytical and result-oriented Digital Marketing Professional to strengthen our online presence, improve brand visibility and generate quality business leads.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
About Us 
Earth Sky Buildcon is a construction and design company based in Faridabad, building farmhouses, bungalows and independent floors for clients across India. We are growing fast, and quality leads are the engine of that growth.
About the Role 
We are looking for a performance-driven digital marketer who will run our paid ads and bring in a steady flow of qualified leads. You will own the full funnel, from ad creative and targeting to lead quality and cost per lead, and you will be judged on results, not just clicks.
Key Responsibilities 
Plan, launch and manage paid campaigns on Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Ads (Search, YouTube, Display) to generate leads for construction and design services.
Own the lead targets: number of leads, cost per lead (CPL) and lead quality.
Run campaigns for different cities and regions across India, with location-wise targeting and budgets.
Write ad copy and brief designers and video editors for creatives (reels, carousels, project walkthroughs).
Build and improve landing pages and lead forms to raise conversion rates.
Test audiences, creatives, offers and budgets regularly (A/B testing) and scale what works.
Set up and maintain tracking: Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking and UTM tags.
Coordinate with the sales team so every lead is followed up quickly, and track how many leads convert into meetings and signed projects.
Share a weekly and monthly performance report with the Managing Director covering spend, leads, CPL, conversions and next actions.
Support social media and content: Instagram, YouTube, Google Business Profile and reviews.
Requirements 
Graduate in any stream; a digital marketing course or certification is a plus.
2-4 years of hands-on experience running Meta and Google Ads for lead generation; real estate, construction, interior or home services experience is preferred.
Proven record of generating leads at a controlled cost (you should be able to share past campaign results).
Strong command of Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads and Google Analytics.
Understanding of the funnel: targeting, creative, landing page, lead form, follow-up.
Basic Excel/Sheets skills for reporting, and basic knowledge of CRM or WhatsApp lead follow-up tools.
Good communication in Hindi and English.
Data-driven, creative and comfortable with accountability for numbers.
Good to Have 
Basic design or video editing skills (Canva, CapCut).
Experience with WhatsApp marketing, SEO or a website builder (Shopify/Wix/WordPress).
Working Days & Hours 
Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM.
Benefits 
Direct work with the Managing Director and real ownership of the lead engine
Clear growth path to Marketing Manager / Head of Growth
Company-provided ad budget and tools

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Role & responsibilities :

1. Performance Marketing Google, Meta & LinkedIn Ads 
Plan, launch, manage, and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), and LinkedIn Ads.
Manage search, display, video, remarketing, lead generation, and conversion-focused campaigns.
Conduct audience research, keyword targeting, competitor analysis, and budget allocation.
Develop and test ad copies, creatives, headlines, landing pages, and calls to action.
Monitor campaign performance, including CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rates, and lead quality.
Implement and troubleshoot conversion tracking using Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, Meta Pixel, and relevant tracking tools.
Optimise campaigns to improve return on ad spend, lead quality, customer acquisition, and overall marketing efficiency.
Prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
2. Marketplace Management Amazon & Flipkart 
Manage and optimise product listings, titles, descriptions, bullet points, keywords, images, and other listing assets.
Plan and execute Amazon Ads and Flipkart Ads campaigns.
Conduct marketplace keyword research, competitor analysis, and product performance analysis.
Monitor product visibility, impressions, clicks, conversion rates, sales, advertising costs, and profitability.
Optimise product listings and advertising campaigns to improve organic rankings and sales.
Coordinate pricing, promotional offers, deals, inventory visibility, and catalogue updates.
Track marketplace performance and identify opportunities to scale revenue.
3. Udemy & Online Course Marketing 
Manage and optimise course listings on Udemy, including titles, descriptions, keywords, and promotional content.
Conduct course keyword research and competitor analysis to improve discoverability.
Support course launches, promotional campaigns, and enrolment growth initiatives.
Monitor course performance, traffic, enrolments, ratings, and revenue.
Identify opportunities to improve course visibility, learner acquisition, and conversion rates.
4. Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) 
Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
Implement on-page SEO, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, and content optimisation.
Identify and resolve technical SEO issues related to crawlability, indexability, site structure, and page performance.
Develop and execute off-page SEO and ethical link-building strategies.
Optimise website pages, product listings, landing pages, and blog content for organic visibility.
Monitor rankings, organic traffic, clicks, impressions, and conversions using Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.
Collaborate with content and development teams to implement SEO recommendations.
Stay updated with search engine algorithm changes and evolving SEO practices.
5. Analytics, Tracking & Reporting 
Track performance across paid media, marketplaces, organic search, and online learning platforms.
Build and maintain performance dashboards and campaign reports.
Analyse customer acquisition costs, conversion funnels, sales trends, and channel-level profitability.
Identify underperforming campaigns and implement data-driven optimisation strategies.
Maintain accurate tracking and reporting to support marketing decisions.

Preferred candidate profile : 

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
5-8 years of relevant digital marketing experience.
Experience in e-commerce, education, publishing, or online learning businesses.
Familiarity with marketplace seller dashboards, product catalogue management, and advertising consoles.
Experience with landing page optimisation, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimization.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
1. JOB PURPOSE 
To manage, develop, and drive sales growth across online marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, and other Healthcare & Industrial B2B platforms. The role involves managing product listings, optimizing catalogs, identifying new marketplace opportunities, and executing performance-driven initiatives to improve product visibility, customer reach, and overall marketplace revenue.
The role also requires a proactive approach towards identifying growth opportunities, analysing marketplace performance, and implementing strategies to strengthen the company's online presence.
2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES (JOB DESCRIPTION) 
Marketplace Management: Manage and maintain product listings across Amazon, Flipkart, and other relevant Healthcare & Industrial B2B marketplaces.
Listing & Catalog Optimization: Optimize product titles, descriptions, keywords, images, specifications, and other listing attributes to improve product visibility, search rankings, and conversions.
Marketplace Onboarding: Research, identify, evaluate, and onboard new Healthcare and Industrial marketplaces to expand the company's digital sales channels.
Sales & Performance Monitoring: Monitor marketplace sales, traffic, conversion rates, product rankings, and other key performance indicators to identify growth opportunities.
Catalog & Inventory Coordination: Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely catalog updates, accurate product information, pricing, stock availability, and inventory synchronization.
Campaign & Promotional Execution: Plan and execute marketplace promotions, discount campaigns, festive offers, deal events, and other sales-driven initiatives.
Marketplace Advertising: Assist in planning, executing, and monitoring marketplace advertising campaigns, including Amazon Ads and other platform-specific promotional tools.
Competitor Analysis: Track competitor pricing, product positioning, listings, promotional strategies, and marketplace trends to identify opportunities for improvement.
Organic Growth: Implement strategies to improve organic product visibility, keyword rankings, search discoverability, and marketplace performance.
Performance Reporting: Prepare and share weekly and monthly marketplace performance reports, highlighting sales trends, campaign results, key insights, and areas of improvement.
Growth Initiatives: Proactively identify new opportunities, suggest improvement strategies, and implement initiatives to increase marketplace sales and customer acquisition.
Cross-functional Coordination: Work closely with the sales, product, operations, and marketing teams to ensure smooth marketplace operations and timely execution of business requirements.
3. KEY EXPECTATIONS 
Take ownership of marketplace operations and assigned sales targets.
Demonstrate a proactive approach towards identifying new marketplace and business growth opportunities.
Ensure accuracy and consistency of product listings and catalog information.
Stay updated with marketplace policies, algorithms, trends, and promotional opportunities.
Focus on improving product visibility, conversion rates, and overall marketplace revenue.
Demonstrate strong analytical, coordination, and execution skills.

description:
Job Description: Performance Marketing Manager 
Job Title: Performance Marketing Manager(Paid Ads & SEO ) 
Department: Digital Marketing
Experience: 3-6 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a results-driven Performance Marketing Manager with strong expertise in paid advertising and Search Engine Optimization (SEO). The candidate will be responsible for driving website traffic, generating qualified leads, improving organic search rankings, and maximizing ROI through data-driven digital marketing strategies.

Key Responsibilities: 
1. Performance Marketing & Paid Advertising
Plan, execute, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant platforms.
Develop strategies for lead generation, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.
Manage advertising budgets, bidding strategies, and campaign performance.
Monitor KPIs, including CPL, CPA, CAC, CTR, conversion rate, and ROAS.
Conduct audience research, keyword research, competitor analysis, and A/B testing.
Optimize ad creatives, landing pages, and conversion funnels to improve campaign performance.
2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) 
Develop and implement SEO strategies to improve organic traffic, keyword rankings, and website visibility.
Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis to identify organic growth opportunities.
Execute on-page SEO, including meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, and content optimization.
Stay updated with Google algorithm updates and SEO best practices.
Collaborate with content writers, developers, and designers to implement SEO recommendations.
3. Analytics & Reporting 
Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports covering paid and organic channels.
Analyze campaign and website data to identify trends, issues, and growth opportunities.
Measure marketing performance against business objectives and recommend improvements.
Track lead quality, conversion rates, and overall marketing ROI.
4. Required Skills & Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
3-6 years of experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, and SEO.
Strong understanding of on-page SEO, off-page SEO, technical SEO, and keyword research.
Proficiency in Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deliver measurable results.
5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
Cost per Lead (CPL), Cost per Acquisition (CPA), and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) and marketing ROI.
Qualified leads and lead-to-customer conversion rate.
Organic website traffic growth.
Target keyword ranking improvements.
Organic click-through rate and search impressions.
Number of organic leads and conversions.
Website technical health and on-page SEO improvements.
Paid and organic contribution to overall business growth.
6. Preferred Qualifications 
Experience in B2B lead generation or e-commerce marketing.
Knowledge of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and landing page optimization.
Experience with CRM tools, marketing automation, and reporting dashboards.
Understanding of content marketing and integrated digital marketing strategies.

Experience in B2B lead generation or e-commerce marketing.

Experience with CRM tools, marketing automation, and reporting dashboards. 
Understanding of content marketing and integrated digital marketing strategies.

title: Digital Marketing Lead
description:
Job Description: Digital Marketing Lead

Department: Marketing
Reports to: Head of Sales & Marketing
Employment type: Full-time

Role Summary 
The Digital Marketing Lead owns end-to-end digital marketing strategy and execution across multiple brands and client accounts. This role combines strategic planning with hands-on delivery across paid media, email, SEO, content, CRM, and web, driving lead generation, conversions, and measurable business growth.
Key Responsibilities 
Strategy and Planning 
- Develop and own digital marketing strategies aligned with business and client goals, including positioning, ICP definition, and channel mix.
- Plan integrated campaigns for product launches, programs, events, and webinars.
- Set KPIs, budgets, and timelines, and report on performance to stakeholders.
Paid Advertising 
- Plan, launch, and optimise paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, and LinkedIn.
- Manage ad budgets, audience targeting, creative testing, and conversion tracking.
- Continuously improve ROAS, CPL, and conversion rates.
Email Marketing and Automation 
- Build and manage email campaigns, newsletters, and automated nurture sequences.
- Segment audiences and personalise messaging to improve engagement.
- Monitor deliverability, open rates, click-through rates, and conversions.
CRM and Marketing Systems 
- Set up and manage CRM systems (Zoho CRM, HubSpot) including pipelines, lead scoring, and workflows.
- Integrate forms, chat, and booking tools (Zoho SalesIQ, Tally, appointment schedulers) with the CRM.
- Ensure clean data, accurate lead attribution, and smooth handover between marketing and sales.
SEO and Content 
- Lead on-page, technical, and local SEO, including keyword research and site audits.
- Plan and produce blog series, landing pages, website copy, and LinkedIn content.
- Manage thought leadership assets such as newsletters and long-form articles.
Website and Landing Pages 
- Build and maintain websites and landing pages on WordPress, WooCommerce, and modern site builders.
- Optimise pages for conversion, speed, and user experience.
- Coordinate site fixes, integrations (LMS, e-commerce, payments), and new feature rollouts.
Social Media 
- Plan and manage organic social presence, primarily LinkedIn and Meta platforms.
- Grow audience and engagement through consistent, on-brand content.
Analytics and Reporting 
- Track performance using Google Analytics, Search Console, ad platform dashboards, and CRM reports.
- Deliver regular performance reports with insights and recommendations.
- Run A/B tests and use data to guide decisions.
Leadership and Collaboration 
- Manage multiple client and brand accounts at once, prioritising effectively.
- Coordinate with designers, developers, freelancers, and internal teams.
- Act as the main point of contact for marketing across stakeholders.

Required Skills and Qualifications 
- Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
- 4+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience across multiple channels.
- Proven results managing paid campaigns and budgets.
- Strong working knowledge of CRM and marketing automation platforms.
- Solid understanding of SEO, content strategy, and conversion optimisation.
- Experience with WordPress and WooCommerce.
- Excellent written communication and copywriting skills.
- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into action.

Tools and Platforms 
Zoho Suite (CRM, Campaigns, SalesIQ, Meeting), HubSpot, Brevo, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, WordPress, WooCommerce, Tally, Canva, and AI tools for content and workflow efficiency.

Key Performance Indicators 
- Qualified leads generated and cost per lead
- Conversion rates across landing pages, email, and ads
- Return on ad spend (ROAS)
- Organic traffic and keyword ranking growth
- Email engagement and nurture conversion rates
- CRM data quality and pipeline contribution
- On-time campaign delivery across accounts

Preferred Attributes 
- Self-starter comfortable owning the full marketing stack.
- Experience in agency or multi-client environments.
- Industry exposure to education, accounting and finance, e-commerce, or community platforms.
- Up to date with AI-driven marketing tools and trends.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Desired Candidate Profile 

Experience with social media marketing platforms such as Facebook Ads Manager and Instagram Ads.

Strong understanding of SEO best practices for real estate websites.

2-5 years of experience in digital marketing or a related field.
1. Digital Marketing Strategy
Develop and implement digital marketing strategies aligned with business goals.
Plan monthly marketing campaigns, budgets, and promotional activities.
Identify target audiences and optimize marketing channels for maximum ROI.
Monitor competitors, market trends, and customer behavior.
2. Performance Marketing & Lead Generation
Plan, launch, and optimize paid advertising campaigns on Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram).
Generate high-quality leads for real estate projects and property sales.
Manage campaign budgets, cost per lead (CPL), conversion rates, and return on ad spend (ROAS).
Conduct A/B testing of creatives, ad copies, landing pages, and audience segments.
Track lead quality and coordinate with the sales team to improve conversions.
3. Social Media Management
Develop social media strategies for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
Plan and manage content calendars, campaigns, reels, property videos, and promotional creatives.
Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, and content creators.
Monitor engagement, reach, follower growth, and overall social media performance.
4. SEO & Website Management
Oversee on-page and off-page SEO activities.
Improve website visibility, organic traffic, and search engine rankings.
Manage landing pages, website content, and conversion optimization.
Use Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and other tools to track performance.
5. Analytics & Reporting
Monitor and analyze campaign performance using relevant marketing tools.
Prepare weekly and monthly marketing performance reports.
Track KPIs such as leads, CPL, conversion rates, website traffic, and campaign ROI.
Provide actionable insights to improve marketing effectiveness.
6. Team & Vendor Management
Coordinate with designers, video editors, agencies, and other marketing partners.
Manage marketing timelines, deliverables, and campaign execution.
Collaborate with sales and business development teams to meet lead and revenue targets.
Ensure consistent brand communication across all marketing channels.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
35 years of experience in digital marketing or performance marketing.
Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.
Knowledge of SEO, social media marketing, email marketing, and website analytics.
Strong understanding of lead generation, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization.
Proficiency in Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and reporting dashboards.
Strong analytical, communication, leadership, and project management skills.
Preferred Experience
Experience in real estate marketing, property sales, or lead generation.
Knowledge of CRM platforms and lead management systems.
Experience managing substantial advertising budgets.
Understanding of real estate buyer journeys and property marketing campaigns.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Number of qualified leads generated.
Cost per lead (CPL) and cost per qualified lead.
Lead-to-site-visit and lead-to-sale conversion rates.
Advertising campaign ROI and budget efficiency.
Website traffic and organic search growth.
Social media reach, engagement, and brand awareness.
Timely execution of marketing campaigns.

title: Data Engineer- ETL
description:
Role & responsibilities 

Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources.
Develop Python scripts for data ingestion, transformation, automation, and data processing.
Use PySpark to process large datasets, perform distributed transformations, joins, aggregations, and data cleansing.
Develop and maintain Databricks notebooks, jobs, and data processing workflows.
Write complex SQL queries using joins, CTEs, subqueries, window functions, and aggregations.
Build and optimize data pipelines to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
Implement incremental data loading, deduplication, and change data capture (CDC) where required.
Optimize Spark jobs, partitioning, caching, joins, and shuffle operations to improve performance.
Optimize SQL queries and data processing logic to reduce execution time and resource consumption.
Work with data formats such as CSV, JSON, and Parquet, and manage Delta Lake tables.
Implement data quality checks, validation rules, and reconciliation processes.
Schedule and monitor ETL workflows using Databricks Workflows or orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow.

Strong knowledge of ETL/ELT concepts, data integration, data extraction, transformation, and loading processes.
Proficiency in Python programming, including functions, data structures, exception handling, and file processing.
Hands-on experience with PySpark DataFrames, transformations, actions, joins, aggregations, and window functions.
Experience with Databricks notebooks, jobs, clusters or compute, and Delta Lake.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, subqueries, window functions, aggregations, and query optimization.
Understanding of Apache Spark architecture, lazy evaluation, partitioning, caching, shuffling, and performance tuning.
Knowledge of data formats such as CSV, JSON, Avro, and Parquet, along with Delta Lake tables.

Experience designing and developing enterprise-grade ETL/ELT data pipelines.

description:
Overview
We are seeking an experienced Quantexa Data Engineer to join our Contextual Monitoring Program within Financial Crime Risk Technology. This role will focus on the design, implementation and optimisation of Quantexa-based contextual monitoring solutions that support Financial Crime, Risk and Compliance outcomes. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions leveraging Quantexa, Spark and cloud-native technologies.
Key Responsibilities
Design, build and support Quantexa solutions for Contextual Monitoring and Financial Crime use cases.
Develop and maintain data ingestion, transformation and enrichment pipelines supporting entity resolution, network generation, and scoring.
Configure, optimise and support Quantexa processing pipelines using Spark and Scala.
Integrate multiple internal and external data sources into Quantexa and associated analytics platforms.
Build scalable and resilient data processing solutions capable of handling large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
Implement data quality controls, reconciliation processes and monitoring capabilities.
Support solution deployment across AWS and Kubernetes-based environments.
Contribute to CI/CD automation, operational support and platform optimisation.
Participate in Agile delivery processes and contribute to engineering best practices.
Mandatory Skills & Experience
Hands-on experience implementing Quantexa solutions in enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of data ingestion, data preparation, entity resolution, network generation, scoring and data model configuration.
Experience delivering Quantexa-based Financial Crime or Risk solutions.
Advanced Apache Spark experience.
Strong Scala development experience with Java or Python exposure.
Strong SQL and data modelling skills.
Experience handling large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.
AWS experience including S3, EKS, OpenSearch/ElasticSearch, IAM and RDS.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Preferred Skills
Financial Crime, AML, or Compliance domain knowledge.
Airflow, Argo Workflows or Control-M experience.
Experience with DBT.
Presto or Trino experience.
Ideal Candidate Profile
5+ years of Data Engineering experience.
2+ years of hands-on Quantexa implementation experience.
Strong Spark and Scala expertise.
Experience implementing Financial Crime, AML or Compliance solutions.
Experience deploying and supporting applications on AWS.

Ability to manage multiple artwork revisions and deadlines.

Candidates with experience in flexible packaging, printing, lamination, packaging artwork, pre-press, or related industries will be preferred.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer Lactonova 
Company: Lactonova
Industry: D2C | Health, Wellness & Nutrition
Department: Marketing & Creative
Job Title: Graphic Designer
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 2–5 Years (Preferred)
Work Mode: As per company requirements
Reporting To: Marketing Head / Digital Marketing Manager
1. About Lactonova 
Lactonova is a Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) brand operating in the health, wellness and nutrition category. Our objective is to build a recognizable, trustworthy and consumer-centric brand through strong product positioning, compelling storytelling, educational content and performance-driven marketing.
We are looking for a creative and commercially aware Graphic Designer who can translate marketing strategies, product benefits and brand positioning into impactful visual communication.
The ideal candidate should understand that design is not just about aesthetics. Every creative should serve a purpose, whether it is building brand awareness, educating consumers, communicating product benefits, generating engagement or driving sales.
2. Role Overview 
The Graphic Designer will be responsible for designing and executing visual assets across Lactonova's marketing ecosystem.
The candidate will work closely with the Marketing Head, Social Media Manager, Performance Marketing Team, Content Team and other stakeholders to develop creative assets for:
Social media platforms.
Meta and Google advertising campaigns.
Website and landing pages.
Product marketing and promotional campaigns.
E-commerce product listings.
Brand communication and storytelling.
Email and WhatsApp marketing.
Packaging and offline marketing materials.
The candidate must be capable of independently conceptualizing, designing, revising and delivering high-quality creative assets while maintaining brand consistency.
3. Key Responsibilities 
A. Social Media Graphic Designing 
Create visually appealing, engaging and platform-optimized creatives for Lactonova's social media channels.
Responsibilities: 
Design Instagram and Facebook posts.
Create Instagram carousel posts for educational and product-related content.
Design promotional and offer-based creatives.
Create product-focused graphics highlighting features, ingredients and benefits.
Design educational infographics related to health, wellness and nutrition.
Develop visual concepts for social media campaigns.
Create quote graphics, testimonial creatives and customer review posts.
Design festival, seasonal and occasion-based creatives.
Develop consistent visual templates for recurring content categories.
Adapt designs for Instagram Stories, Facebook Stories and other social media formats.
Expected Deliverables: 
Static social media posts.
Carousel designs.
Stories and promotional graphics.
Educational infographics.
Product benefit creatives.
Customer testimonial designs.
Campaign-specific visual assets.
B. Performance Marketing & Advertising Creatives 
This is one of the most important responsibilities of the role. The candidate must understand how to design creatives that support customer acquisition, conversion and revenue generation.
Responsibilities: 
Design high-converting Meta Ads creatives for Facebook and Instagram.
Create multiple creative variations for A/B testing.
Design product-focused advertising creatives.
Create problem-solution-based advertising graphics.
Develop offer-based creatives for promotional campaigns.
Design creatives highlighting product USPs and differentiators.
Create retargeting creatives for website visitors, product viewers and abandoned cart audiences.
Design creatives for prospecting, consideration and conversion campaigns.
Create comparison-based creatives where claims are factually substantiated.
Collaborate with the Performance Marketing Team to understand campaign objectives and creative performance.
Creative Formats: 
1:1 square ads.
4:5 portrait ads.
9:16 vertical ads.
16:9 landscape ads.
Static image advertisements.
GIF and simple motion graphics.
Product-led and lifestyle-led advertisements.
UGC-style advertising overlays and layouts.
Important: The designer should understand that different advertising angles require different visual treatments. A testimonial creative, product-benefit creative, offer creative and educational creative should not look identical.
C. Product Marketing & E-commerce Designing 
Create product-centric visual assets that communicate product value and improve the online shopping experience.
Responsibilities: 
Design product listing images.
Create product feature and benefit graphics.
Design product ingredient infographics.
Create product usage and consumption instruction graphics.
Design product comparison graphics.
Create product lifestyle visuals and promotional banners.
Design website homepage banners and category banners.
Create product page visual assets.
Design promotional banners for discount campaigns.
Create product bundles, combo offers and subscription-related graphics.
Expected Deliverables: 
Product listing images.
Product feature infographics.
Product benefit graphics.
Product detail page assets.
Website banners.
Offer and discount banners.
Product comparison graphics.
E-commerce promotional creatives.
D. Brand Identity & Visual Communication 
Maintain and strengthen Lactonova's overall brand identity across all communication channels.
Responsibilities: 
Maintain consistency in brand colours, typography and design language.
Follow established brand guidelines.
Develop reusable creative templates.
Ensure consistent visual communication across social media, advertisements and website.
Maintain a professional and premium brand appearance.
Develop creative concepts aligned with Lactonova's positioning.
Ensure proper use of logos, brand assets, typography and imagery.
Contribute ideas for improving the brand's visual identity.
Develop visual styles for new product launches and campaigns.
Maintain an organized brand asset library.
E. Website & Landing Page Designing 
Support the digital marketing team by creating visual assets for Lactonova's website and landing pages.
Responsibilities: 
Design homepage banners.
Create landing page hero section graphics.
Design product benefit sections.
Create promotional banners.
Design website pop-up creatives.
Develop visual elements for product detail pages.
Create campaign-specific landing page graphics.
Optimize images for web usage without compromising visual quality.
Maintain consistent visual presentation across desktop and mobile layouts.
Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are implemented correctly.
Preferred: Basic understanding of website UI/UX principles, responsive design and e-commerce conversion optimization.
F. Email, WhatsApp & CRM Marketing Creatives 
Design visual assets for customer communication and retention campaigns.
Responsibilities: 
Design email marketing banners.
Create promotional email graphics.
Design WhatsApp promotional creatives.
Create product education graphics for customer retention.
Design abandoned cart campaign graphics.
Develop festive and seasonal communication creatives.
Create customer engagement and loyalty campaign visuals.
G. Packaging & Offline Marketing Designing 
Support the brand's offline communication and packaging requirements.
Responsibilities: 
Design product packaging and labels.
Create packaging variations for different SKUs.
Design product inserts and thank-you cards.
Create brochures and product catalogues.
Design standees, posters and promotional materials.
Create event and exhibition branding materials.
Prepare print-ready files with correct dimensions, bleed and colour profiles.
Coordinate with printing vendors whenever required.
Preferred: Knowledge of CMYK, die lines, packaging layouts, print specifications and production-ready artwork.
H.PMT Brief by Sumyadeep Ji 
PMT Responsibilities: 
4. Required Technical Skills 
The candidate should have proficiency in the following tools:

Tool 

Expected Proficiency 

Adobe Photoshop

Advanced

Adobe Illustrator

Advanced

Canva

Intermediate to Advanced

Adobe InDesign

Basic to Intermediate

Figma

Basic to Intermediate
Additional advantages:
AI-assisted design tools.
Generative AI image tools.
AI-based background removal and image enhancement.
Product mockup creation.
Image optimization for websites.
Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS is an advantage, not mandatory.
5. Creative & Marketing Skills 
We are looking for someone who understands both design fundamentals and marketing psychology.
The candidate should demonstrate:
Strong visual storytelling skills.
Understanding of colour psychology.
Typography and layout expertise.
Knowledge of visual hierarchy.
Understanding of consumer behaviour.
Ability to communicate product benefits visually.
Understanding of advertising creative formats.
Ability to create different design variations for different audiences.
Understanding of branding and brand positioning.
Ability to convert written content into visually engaging designs.
Attention to detail and consistency.
Ability to work with creative briefs and marketing objectives.
6. Understanding of the Health, Wellness & Nutrition Industry 
Experience in the following categories will be an advantage:
Nutraceuticals.
Dietary supplements.
Health and wellness.
Ayurveda and herbal products.
Functional nutrition.
Beauty and personal care.
FMCG.
D2C brands.
E-commerce brands.
The candidate should be comfortable designing educational content around ingredients, product features, nutritional information and consumer benefits.
Important Compliance Requirement: 
Since Lactonova operates in the health and wellness category, the designer must ensure that:
No unverified medical claims are introduced into creatives.
Product benefits are communicated using approved content.
Before-and-after visuals are used only when legally and scientifically appropriate.
Ingredient information is accurately represented.
Health-related claims are not exaggerated.
All product communication follows the company's approved compliance guidelines.
The designer is responsible for visual execution, while product and regulatory claims must be approved by the relevant internal stakeholders.
7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
The Graphic Designer will be evaluated on creativity, quality, consistency, turnaround time and contribution to marketing objectives.

KPI 

Measurement / Expectation 

Creative Delivery

Timely delivery against the approved content calendar

Design Quality

Consistent, professional and brand-aligned output

Creative Accuracy

Minimal errors in text, dimensions, product details and branding

Ad Creative Variations

Multiple meaningful variations for campaign testing

Revision Management

Ability to incorporate feedback efficiently

Brand Consistency

Adherence to established visual guidelines

Campaign Support

Timely delivery of campaign and launch creatives

Asset Organization

Proper naming, categorization and storage of files

Creative Innovation

Regular introduction of new visual concepts

Cross-team Collaboration

Effective coordination with marketing and content teams
Suggested initial performance benchmarks: 
3–5 quality static social media designs per working day, depending on complexity.
2–4 creative variations for selected advertising concepts.
1–2 carousel designs per day, depending on slide count and complexity.
Timely execution of approved website, packaging and campaign requirements.
95% adherence to mutually agreed delivery timelines.
These are planning benchmarks, not rigid daily quotas. Workload should be adjusted based on complexity, campaign priorities and other assigned projects.
8. Qualifications & Experience 
Education: 
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts or a related field.
Relevant professional experience and a strong portfolio may be considered in place of formal qualifications.
Experience: 
2–5 years of professional graphic design experience preferred.
Experience working with D2C, e-commerce, FMCG or wellness brands is highly desirable.
Experience creating performance marketing creatives is strongly preferred.
9. Required Personal Attributes 
The ideal candidate should be:
Creative and visually driven.
Proactive and self-motivated.
Detail-oriented.
Open to constructive feedback.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced marketing environment.
Capable of handling multiple assignments.
Curious about consumer psychology and design trends.
Accountable for deadlines.
Interested in understanding the business objective behind every creative.
10. Working Relationship & Reporting Structure 
The Graphic Designer will work closely with:
Marketing Head / Digital Marketing Manager 
Receives campaign briefs.
Understands marketing objectives.
Gets creative concepts and designs approved.
Prioritizes campaign requirements.
Social Media Manager 
Coordinates daily social media requirements.
Works on the content calendar.
Creates post, carousel and story designs.
Performance Marketing Team 
Creates advertising creatives.
Develops creative variations.
Supports A/B testing.
Incorporates insights from campaign performance.
Content Team 
Converts scripts and content ideas into visual communication.
Works on educational and promotional creatives.
11. What We Expect from the Candidate 
We are not looking for someone who simply knows Photoshop, Illustrator or Canva.
We are looking for a designer who:
Understands why a creative is being made.
Can distinguish between a branding creative and a performance marketing creative.
Can communicate product USPs effectively.
Can design for different stages of the customer journey.
Understands how to capture attention in a crowded digital environment.
Can translate marketing strategies into compelling visual assets.
Can independently manage design assignments.
Takes ownership of creative quality and delivery.
The ultimate objective is to build a strong and recognizable visual identity for Lactonova while supporting the company's marketing, customer acquisition and revenue growth objectives. 
13. Application Requirements 
Interested candidates should submit:
Updated resume.
Portfolio showcasing previous graphic design work.
Examples of social media creatives.
Examples of performance marketing advertisements.
Examples of product or e-commerce designs.
Details of brands or industries previously handled.
List of design software and tools they are proficient in.
Current salary and expected salary.
Notice period and availability.
Portfolio is mandatory. 
Applications without a relevant design portfolio may not be considered.
