title: Graphic Designer
description:
Job Summary :- 
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer with a strong understanding of luxury aesthetics and jewellery branding. The candidate will be responsible for creating visually appealing designs for digital and print marketing, social media, campaigns, product launches, catalogues, advertisements, and promotional materials.

The ideal candidate should have a strong design portfolio, excellent knowledge of industry-standard design software, and the ability to translate jewellery collections and brand concepts into premium visual communication.
Key Responsibilities 
Creative & Graphic Design :- 
Create high-quality visual content for jewellery collections, campaigns, promotions, and brand communication.
Design social media creatives for Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms.
Develop creatives for festive campaigns, wedding collections, seasonal launches, offers, and special occasions.
Design digital advertisements, banners, website creatives, emailers, WhatsApp marketing creatives, and promotional materials.
Create brochures, catalogues, lookbooks, flyers, invitations, packaging, tags, and other print collateral.
Develop creative concepts and layouts while maintaining the brand's luxury identity.
Jewellery Product Presentation 
Create premium visuals to showcase jewellery products and collections.
Work with product photographs and enhance images through retouching, colour correction, background removal, and compositing.
Prepare jewellery images for websites, e-commerce platforms, social media, catalogues, and advertisements.
Ensure accurate representation of jewellery colours, stones, metals, textures, and finishes.
Create collection-wise presentation materials and visual stories.
Campaign & Brand Support 
Collaborate with the marketing and merchandising teams to develop campaign concepts and creatives.
Support new jewellery collection launches with a complete set of marketing creatives.
Develop visual concepts for brand campaigns, promotional offers, events, exhibitions, and showroom activities.
Adapt creative designs into multiple sizes and formats for different platforms.
Ensure all communication reflects a premium, elegant, and aspirational jewellery brand image.
Digital & Social Media 
Design engaging social media posts, stories, reels covers, carousels, and promotional creatives.
Follow current design, social media, fashion, and jewellery trends.
Create visually compelling content that supports customer engagement and brand awareness.
Coordination & Execution 
Coordinate with photographers, videographers, marketing teams, vendors, printers, and external agencies when required.
Manage multiple design projects and meet deadlines.
Take creative briefs from internal teams and convert them into effective visual concepts.
Prepare final artwork according to digital and print specifications.
Ensure accuracy of product details, pricing, offers, spelling, logos, and other information before final release.
Requirements 
Bachelor's degree/diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field preferred.
3+ years of professional graphic design experience , preferably in jewellery, fashion, luxury, lifestyle, or retail.
Strong portfolio demonstrating creative and commercial design work.
Excellent knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign , and other relevant design tools.
Knowledge of Canva, Figma, After Effects, Premiere Pro, or other motion/video tools will be an advantage.
Strong understanding of typography, colour theory, composition, layouts, and visual hierarchy.
Experience with jewellery/product image retouching is highly preferred.
Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple projects.
Preferred Jewellery Industry Skills 
Jewellery product photo editing and retouching
Gold and diamond jewellery presentation
Luxury brand aesthetics
Jewellery catalogue design
Wedding and festive campaign creatives
Jewellery collection launch creatives
Social media creatives
Jewellery promotional campaigns
Product image manipulation and enhancement
Print and digital marketing collateral
Key Skills 
Graphic Design
Jewellery Image Retouching
Branding & Visual Communication
Social Media Design
Catalogue & Brochure Design
Adobe Photoshop
Adobe Illustrator
Adobe InDesign
Basic Motion Graphics / Video Editing
Colour Correction
Attention to Detail

Interested candidates can send resume on archana.laxmeshwar@whp.co.in or connect on 022-62249100

Additional Perks : 
Location : Vile Parle West
Office Time : 10.00 a.m. to 7.00 p.m.
Providend Fund
Paid Leaves
Maternity Benefits

title: Graphic Designer
description:
We are looking for a highly creative and detail-oriented Marketing Creative Designer with 4+ years of experience to support branding, marketing, and communication initiatives across all our group companies, including Mentco Manufacturing and Verity Global Solutions.
The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in modern design tools, a deep understanding of branding, and the ability to create high-quality creatives for digital and offline platforms. This role requires someone who can translate business objectives into impactful visual communication.
Additionally, since the role involves creating creatives for global markets, the candidate must possess strong communication skills and an understanding of international audience preferences, tone, and visual expectations.
With the increasing adoption of AI in marketing, the candidate should also be comfortable leveraging AI-powered creative tools for ideation, image generation, design enhancement, content adaptation, and rapid creative development. Strong understanding of prompt writing / prompt engineering for marketing creatives will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities 

Visual Design & Assets Creation: Conceptualize and design high-quality B2B visual assets including corporate pitch decks, whitepapers, infographics, social media graphics, eBooks, event collaterals, and display ads.
Brand Identity Maintenance: Maintain and evolve brand identity standards for both Mentco and Verity Global Solutions, ensuring consistency across all marketing touchpoints.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with content writers, digital marketers, and leadership to bring marketing campaigns to life.
Data Visualization: Translate complex data, metrics, and business processes into clear, aesthetically pleasing charts, diagrams, and visual graphics.
Digital & Web Creatives: Create visual elements for landing pages, websites, email headers, and digital ad campaigns designed for customer acquisition and conversion.

Requirements & Qualifications 

Experience: Minimum 4+ years of professional graphic design experience, preferably within a B2B agency, tech corporate setup, or professional services firm.
Portfolio: A robust design portfolio showcasing B2B collateral, branding projects, digital campaign creatives, and data visualization/presentation design.

Software Proficiency: 

Master-level expertise in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
High proficiency in PowerPoint / Google Slides / Figma for executive pitch deck design.

Key Skills: 

Strong understanding of typography, grid systems, layout design, color theory, and visual hierarchy.
Solid understanding of design principles catered to B2B target audiences (clean, professional, modern, data-driven).
Ability to manage multiple projects, tight deadlines, and brand guidelines across different entities.

description:
About the Role 
We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and trend-aware Graphic Designer & Video Editor who can create impactful visual communication across digital and offline platforms. The candidate will be responsible for designing marketing creatives, social media content, branding materials, and editing engaging videos that align with the company’s brand identity and business objectives.
The ideal candidate should have strong design aesthetics, storytelling ability, understanding of current digital trends, and hands-on expertise in graphic design and video editing tools.

Key ResponsibilitiesGraphic Design Responsibilities Design creative assets for social media, websites, advertisements, brochures, presentations, emailers, banners, and branding materials.

Create visually engaging marketing collaterals aligned with brand guidelines.

Develop campaign creatives for digital marketing platforms including Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Design product catalogs, event creatives, standees, posters, and print materials.

Work closely with the marketing team to conceptualize campaign ideas and visual strategies.

Ensure consistency in typography, color palette, layouts, and overall brand communication.

Create motion graphics and animated creatives when required.

Video Editing Responsibilities Edit promotional videos, reels, advertisements, corporate videos, testimonials, and social media content.

Add transitions, subtitles, sound effects, music, motion graphics, and animations to enhance video quality.

Create short-form and long-form content optimized for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and websites.

Coordinate with the content and marketing teams for scripting and storyboard execution.

Manage raw footage, audio synchronization, color correction, and final rendering.

Ensure videos are optimized for platform-specific formats and dimensions.

Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or certification in Graphic Design, Multimedia, Animation, Visual Communication, or related field.

2–5 years of experience in graphic designing and video editing.

Strong portfolio showcasing creative design and editing work.

Proficiency in:

Adobe Photoshop

Adobe Illustrator

Adobe Premiere Pro

Adobe After Effects

CorelDRAW (preferred)

Figma (preferred)

Good understanding of typography, layout design, branding, and visual hierarchy.

Knowledge of social media trends and digital marketing creatives.

Basic understanding of photography/videography is an added advantage.

Ability to manage multiple projects within deadlines.

Creativity and a passion for design
Willingness to learn and grow in a dynamic team environment
Time management and ability to handle multiple tasks
Collaborative mindset with a positive attitude
Adaptability and openness to feedback

title: AI Graphic Designer/Video Editor - Generative AI - Remote - Agency
description:
Company: Tattvam Media Private Limited
Location: Pune
Work Mode: Remote / Work From Home
Experience: 1-7 Years
Employment Type: Full Time
Industry: Digital Marketing / Advertising / Creative Agency

About the Role 
We are looking for creative, talented and AI-enabled Graphic Designers / Video Editors to join our growing creative team.
The ideal candidate should have strong visual design or video editing skills, a good creative sense and hands-on experience with modern AI-powered image and video generation tools.

You will work on creative campaigns, social media content, corporate brand communication, product visuals, promotional videos and digital marketing assets for leading B2B brands across manufacturing, renewable energy and infrastructure sectors.

We are open to candidates specialising in Graphic Design, Video Editing or both. Candidates with capabilities across both disciplines and practical AI production experience will be preferred. 

Role & Responsibilities 
1. Graphic Design & Visual Communication 
Design high-quality social media creatives, carousels, banners, advertisements and promotional materials.
Create creative concepts and visual communication aligned with client branding and campaign objectives.
Develop corporate presentations, brochures, infographics and marketing collaterals.
Create premium product visuals, industrial graphics and corporate brand creatives.
Work on creative campaigns for manufacturing, renewable energy, solar, wind, infrastructure and technology brands.
Understand design briefs and translate them into compelling visual concepts.
Maintain consistency in typography, colours, layouts and brand guidelines.
Deliver creative assets in different formats and dimensions for various digital platforms.
2. Video Editing & Motion Graphics 
Edit short-form videos, reels, corporate videos, promotional films and brand videos.
Create engaging video content for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube.
Develop motion graphics, animations, transitions and visual effects.
Work on product videos, industrial films, corporate storytelling and campaign videos.
Add appropriate sound effects, background music, subtitles and other finishing elements.
Convert creative concepts and scripts into engaging video content.
Ensure professional video quality, storytelling, pacing and platform-specific formatting.
3. AI Image & Video Generation 
Use AI-powered image generation tools to create original visuals, concepts, product imagery and advertising creatives.
Use AI video generation tools to create cinematic scenes, product demonstrations, animations and marketing videos.
Experiment with image-to-video, text-to-video and generative editing workflows.
Use AI tools to improve creative production speed, visual quality and efficiency.
Combine AI-generated assets with traditional design and video editing workflows.
Develop creative concepts that may not be possible or practical through conventional production methods.
Maintain visual consistency, realistic outputs and brand accuracy while using AI tools.
4. Creative Research & Innovation 
Stay updated with the latest design trends, creative formats and AI generation technologies.
Research creative references, competitor campaigns and industry-specific visual communication.
Experiment with new AI tools and workflows to improve production capabilities.
Suggest innovative creative ideas for B2B brands and marketing campaigns.
Develop original concepts rather than relying entirely on templates or stock assets.
5. Team Collaboration & Execution 
Coordinate with social media managers, account managers, content writers and marketing teams.
Understand creative briefs and clarify requirements before execution.
Manage multiple creative assignments and meet deadlines.
Incorporate feedback and revisions while maintaining quality.
Ensure all final deliverables meet client branding and quality standards.

Required Skills & Tools
Graphic Design: 
Adobe Photoshop
Adobe Illustrator
Adobe InDesign
Figma
Canva
Video Editing & Motion Graphics: 
Adobe Premiere Pro
Adobe After Effects
DaVinci Resolve
Final Cut Pro
CapCut
AI Image Generation: 
Midjourney
ChatGPT Image Generation
Google Gemini / Nano Banana
Adobe Firefly
FLUX
Stable Diffusion
Leonardo AI
AI Video Generation: 
Google Veo
Seedance
Kling AI
Runway
Sora
Pika
Luma Dream Machine
Hailuo AI
Candidates are not expected to know every tool. Practical experience with relevant tools and the ability to learn new AI workflows is more important.

Preferred Candidate Profile
1-7 years of professional experience in Graphic Design, Video Editing, Motion Graphics or Creative Production.
Strong portfolio demonstrating original creative work.
Good understanding of design principles, composition, typography, colours and visual storytelling.
Hands-on experience with professional design or video editing software.
Practical experience using AI image or video generation tools.
Ability to convert creative briefs into high-quality visual output.
Understanding of social media creative requirements and digital advertising formats.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments.
Good communication skills and attention to detail.
Candidates with B2B, corporate, manufacturing, renewable energy or advertising agency experience will be preferred.

What We Are Looking For
We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to use design software or edit videos.
We want creative professionals who can think conceptually, experiment with AI, develop original ideas and produce high-quality visual content.
You should be comfortable combining traditional creative skills with modern AI-powered production workflows.

Candidates specialising in either Graphic Design or Video Editing are welcome. Candidates proficient in both will have an added advantage. 

Why Join Tattvam Media?
Work with established B2B and enterprise brands.
Create campaigns for manufacturing, renewable energy and infrastructure companies.
Work on corporate films, product visuals, digital campaigns and creative brand communication.
Experiment with modern AI image and video generation technologies.
Collaborate with marketing, strategy and creative teams.
Work remotely with opportunities to grow your creative and technical capabilities.

If you are passionate about design, video production and AI-powered creativity, we would like to hear from you. 

Please share your portfolio or showreel along with your application

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Print & Offline Design 
Design brochures, project flyers, property fact sheets, standees, banners, hoardings, and other real estate marketing collaterals.
Create newspaper advertisements, site branding, event creatives, and sales presentation materials.
Ensure print-ready artwork meets the required specifications, dimensions, and quality standards.
2. Digital & Social Media Design 
Create static creatives for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Google Ads, and other digital platforms.
Design campaign creatives, social media posts, carousels, digital banners, emailers, and website assets.
Develop visually appealing creatives for real estate projects, property launches, offers, and promotional campaigns.
Maintain brand consistency across all digital touchpoints.
3. Motion Graphics & Animation 
Create basic motion graphics, animated social media posts, promotional videos, and short-form visual content.
Add motion elements to marketing campaigns, property promotions, and digital advertisements.
Work with video editors and marketing teams to deliver engaging visual content.
4. Brand & Creative Execution 
Translate briefs into high-quality designs aligned with campaign objectives and brand guidelines.
Collaborate with marketing, sales, and business teams to understand project requirements and target audiences.
Manage multiple design projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
Incorporate feedback and maintain consistency in visual quality across deliverables.
Skills & Qualifications
23 years of professional experience in graphic design.
Experience in real estate, advertising, digital marketing, or a creative agency is preferred.
Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe InDesign .
Working knowledge of Adobe After Effects and/or Premiere Pro for motion graphics and animation.
Strong understanding of typography, colour theory, composition, layouts, and visual hierarchy.
Experience in preparing print-ready files and designing for digital platforms.
Ability to interpret creative briefs and deliver designs with minimal supervision.
Strong attention to detail, time management, and communication skills.
A strong portfolio showcasing both print and digital work, with motion graphics samples.
What We’re Looking For
Someone who can balance creativity with business objectives.
A designer who understands how visual communication supports real estate marketing and sales.
Someone who can work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and take ownership of deliverables.
A proactive creative thinker who brings fresh ideas and stays updated with design and digital content trends.

title: Video Editor & Graphic Designer
description:
01 About the Company 
Yuvwaa Speed, operated by Futuristic Mobility Private Limited, operates in the electric mobility space, supporting mobility solutions for delivery partners and related operations. The company focuses on enabling efficient and accessible mobility through electric vehicles and supporting operational services.

COMPANY WEBSITE 
https://share.google/fbeqfVhTQC3smcRBX 

02 About the Role 
We are looking for a creative, enthusiastic and detail-oriented Video Editor & Graphic Designer to join our Marketing team.
The candidate will be responsible for producing engaging visual content for digital platforms, including video editing, graphic design, motion graphics, photography, videography and on-ground content shoots.
The ideal candidate should combine creative thinking with strong practical and technical skills and be capable of independently executing creative assignments while maintaining brand consistency and meeting deadlines.

03 Key Responsibilities 
1 Plan, coordinate and execute video shoots at company hubs and corporate locations.
2 Edit short-form videos, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, promotional videos and other digital content.
3 Design social media creatives, graphics, carousels, banners and marketing materials.
4 Create motion graphics, animations, transitions and visual effects.
5 Handle photography and videography during marketing activities and on-ground shoots.
6 Ensure all creative assets align with the company's branding guidelines and communication objectives.
7 Collaborate with the Marketing team to understand campaign requirements and deliver creatives within deadlines.
8 Maintain organized records of raw footage, edited videos, design files and other creative assets.
9 Stay updated with social media trends, editing techniques and emerging creative formats.
10 Review and improve creative output based on feedback, engagement metrics and campaign objectives.

04 Educational Qualifications 
Graduate in any discipline.
Candidates with a degree, diploma or certification in Graphic Design, Animation, Multimedia, Film Making, Visual Communication or a related field will be preferred.

05 Required Technical Skills 
Proficiency in video editing using Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or equivalent tools.
Working knowledge of graphic design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or Canva.
Basic understanding of motion graphics, animation and visual effects.
Knowledge of photography, videography, framing, lighting and audio recording.
Understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other social media formats.
Strong visual storytelling, creativity and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
Openness to feedback and willingness to learn new creative tools.

06 Good-to-Have Skills 
Advanced proficiency in DaVinci Resolve.
Adobe After Effects and motion graphics expertise.
Experience in social media content production or digital marketing.
Experience with professional cameras, lighting equipment and audio recording.
Familiarity with AI-assisted creative and editing tools.
A portfolio demonstrating original creative work.

07 Experience 
02 years of relevant experience.
Freshers with strong practical skills and a good portfolio are encouraged to apply.
Candidates with internship, freelance, academic or personal project experience may also be considered.

08 Languages Required 

English 

Hindi 

Marathi (Optional) 

09 Work Requirements 
The position is based in Pune, Maharashtra.
The role may require travel to company hubs, including Pisoli, Hinjewadi and corporate locations for video shoots and content production.
Flexibility may be required depending on shoot schedules and campaign deadlines.
The candidate must be comfortable working both independently and collaboratively with the Marketing team.

10 Selection Process 

1 

HR Screening: Initial discussion to assess communication, experience, software knowledge and role suitability.

2 

Portfolio Evaluation: Assessment of previously completed video editing, graphic design and creative projects.

3 

Technical Interview: Evaluation of practical knowledge, editing techniques, design fundamentals and creative thinking.

4 

Practical Assignment: Assessment of video editing, graphic design and creative execution capabilities.

5 

Final Interview: Discussion with the Marketing Strategist and/or CMO to evaluate creative thinking, ownership and suitability.

6 

Final HR Discussion: Compensation alignment, availability, documentation and offer discussion.

11 Application Requirements 
Interested candidates should submit:
Updated resume.
Portfolio containing relevant video editing samples.
Graphic design and social media creative samples.
Motion graphics or animation samples, if available.
Candidates must be able to explain their individual contribution to the projects submitted.

Important: Portfolio submission is mandatory. Freshers may submit academic projects, internship assignments, freelance work or personal creative projects.

12 Candidate Expectations 
We are looking for someone who:
Can independently handle video editing and graphic design assignments.
Demonstrates strong creativity and visual storytelling.
Understands current digital content trends and social media formats.
Can convert marketing ideas into engaging visual content.
Takes ownership of assigned tasks and delivers work within timelines.
Is adaptable, proactive and willing to learn new tools and techniques.

Produce the full opening material set for every new store, based on the HappiTea India Store Opening Kit: hoarding, opening banner, flyers, vouchers, social countdown posts and grand opening visuals.

- A creative environment where your ideas and designs will shape brand storytelling.
- Exposure to projects spanning luxury interiors, public art, and global collaborations.
- Growth opportunities in creative strategy, brand building, and multimedia design.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Job Description : Graphic Designer 
Experience : 3 to 4 yrs 
Location : Noida 
Working Days : Monday -Friday 

About Us:
GTF Technologies is a creative, fast-growing digital agency transforming the real-estate marketing space
for 17+ years. We blend smart strategy, bold ideas, and cutting-edge tech to help brands stand out and
scale. Join us and be part of a team where innovation, passion, and growth come alive every day.

Job Overview:
At GTF Technologies, we merge creativity, technology, and strategy to deliver impactful digital solutions
for brands across diverse industries. We are currently seeking a passionate Graphic Designer with a
strong background in branding and a sharp eye for digital innovation. In this role, you will collaborate
with our creative and marketing teams to bring ideas to life through visually compelling designs that
elevate our clients brands.

Skills & Requirements:
Experience: Minimum 2 years of professional experience in graphic design with a strong
emphasis on branding. A portfolio showcasing brand identities and digital projects is required.
Design Expertise: Solid experience in logo design, brand identity kits, brochures, packaging, and
print/digital marketing materials.
Technical Proficiency: Skilled in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and AI-powered tools
like MidJourney and Adobe Firefly.
Creativity & Detail Orientation: Strong conceptual thinking and artistic abilities with a sharp eye
for design details.
Adaptability & Teamwork: Able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced,
evolving environment.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to present and articulate
design ideas effectively.

Key Responsibilities:
Branding & Identity Design: Create brand identities, including logos, brand guidelines,
brochures, packaging, and marketing collateral that reflect unique brand narratives.
Digital & Social Media Design: Design engaging visuals for digital campaigns, websites, and
social media platforms while ensuring consistency across all digital touchpoints.
AI-Powered Design Innovation: Utilize tools like MidJourney and Adobe Firefly to streamline
design workflows and produce cutting-edge artwork.
Collaborative Execution: Work closely with marketing, content, and strategy teams to align
visuals with brand positioning and campaign goals.
Trend Awareness: Stay on top of current design trends, branding best practices, and AI
advancements to keep our creative output modern and impactful.
Project Management: Manage multiple design projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery
and uncompromised quality.

Why Join Us?
Work with a dynamic and creative team on exciting projects for global clients.
Opportunity to explore and implement the latest AI design technologies.
Continuous learning, skill enhancement, and professional growth.
Supportive, collaborative, and innovation-driven work culture.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION GRAPHIC DESIGNER 

Position - Graphic Designer
Experience - 4- 5 Years
Budget- Up to 4.8 LPA
Qualification - Any Graduate
Gender - Both Male and Female Candidates
Industry - Any Industry

ROLE PURPOSE 

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer with 4 to 5 years of experience to develop engaging visual content for the company's branding, marketing, and communication requirements. The
candidate should have strong design skills, an eye for layout and typography, and hands-on experience with industry-standard graphic design and video-editing software. The role will involve creating high-quality graphics and visual assets, editing videos, and supporting creative requirements across digital and other marketing channels.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Graphic Design &Creative Development 
Create visually appealing designs for digital campaigns, social media, websites, product promotions, and other marketing requirements.
Design marketing collaterals, banners, brochures, product creatives, and other communication materials as required.
Develop creative concepts and layouts in line with brand guidelines and campaign objectives.
Prepare and adapt artwork in the required sizes and formats for different platforms.
Ensure consistency in branding, colours, typography, and overall visual presentation.
Image Editing & Product Creatives 
Edit, retouch, and enhance product images and other visual assets.
Create and modify illustrations, layouts, and graphic elements as per project requirements.
Use AI image-generation tools to support creative development and produce visual concepts where appropriate.
Video Editing & Motion Graphics 
Edit promotional, product, and social media videos using Adobe Premiere Pro.
Create visual effects, transitions, and basic motion graphics using Adobe After Effects.
Ensure videos are properly formatted and optimized for the intended digital platforms.
Coordination & Delivery 
Coordinate with the marketing and concerned teams to understand design briefs and delivery timelines.
Manage multiple design tasks and complete assigned work within agreed deadlines.
Review designs and make revisions based on feedback while maintaining quality and accuracy.
Organize and maintain editable files, artwork, and final creative assets for future use.

SOFTWARE SKILLS 

CorelDRAW Version 14 or above (as specified).
Adobe Photoshop.
Adobe Illustrator.
Adobe Premiere Pro.
Adobe After Effects.
AI Image Creation tools.

DESIRED CANDIDATE PROFILE 

Qualification: Any Graduate.
Experience: 4- 5 years of relevant experience in graphic designing and creative development.
Strong command of CorelDRAW, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and After Effects.
Working knowledge of AI image-creation tools and their use in creative workflows.
Good understanding of design principles, colour combinations, typography, layouts, and visualcommunication.
Ability to understand creative briefs, manage deadlines, and incorporate feedback.
Candidates from any industry may apply. 
Both male and female candidates can apply. 

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS) 

Quality and creativity of designs.
Timely completion and delivery of assigned projects.
Accuracy and consistency with brand guidelines.
Video-editing and creative-output quality.
Turnaround time for design revisions.

CORE COMPETENCIES 

Graphic Designing | Creative Concept Development | CorelDraw | Adobe Photoshop | Adobe Illustrator | Adobe Premiere Pro | Adobe After Effects | Image Editing | Video Editing | AI Image Creation | Layout & Typography | Brand Consistency | Time Management | Attention to Detail | Team Coordination

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Key Responsibilities 

Design creative and engaging social media posts, carousels, stories, reels covers, and advertisements.

Create graphics for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other digital platforms.

Design event creatives including invitations, banners, backdrops, standees, stage graphics, certificates, badges, brochures, and event collaterals.

Develop visual concepts for business events, conferences, award shows, and corporate campaigns.

Maintain consistency with brand guidelines, colors, typography, and visual identity.

Work closely with the content, marketing, and event teams to understand creative requirements.

Adapt designs into different sizes and formats for various platforms.

Create supporting visuals such as illustrations, infographics, collages, photo compositions, and promotional creatives.

Make revisions based on feedback while maintaining design quality.

Manage multiple design projects and deliverables simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

Stay updated with current design trends, social media trends, and creative styles.

Required Skills: 

Strong knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign, Adobe Illustrator.

Understanding of layout, typography, colour theory, and visual hierarchy.

Good understanding of social media design and digital marketing creatives.

Ability to create designs from a brief and develop original creative concepts.

Good attention to detail.

Ability to work under tight deadlines.

Good communication and teamwork skills.

What Were Looking For 

Demonstrates a strong understanding of visual design principles, aesthetics, and branding.

Possesses the ability to develop original and innovative design concepts beyond standard templates.

Understands social media design trends and can create visually engaging content that aligns with brand objectives.

Can effectively manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

Has the ability to work across both digital and print design requirements.

Takes ownership of assigned projects and demonstrates accountability for delivering high-quality work within timelines.

Is receptive to feedback and committed to continuous learning, improvement, and professional development.

Qualification: 

Bachelors degree/diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field is preferred.

A strong portfolio is mandatory.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Position : Graphic Designer 
Location: Gurgaon 
Experience: 2+ Years
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job OverviewWe are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to own and develop visual assets across digital and physical brand touchpoints. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in print, packaging, branding, and marketing creatives , along with a good understanding of modern AI-assisted design workflows. you will be responsible for translating brand requirements into visually compelling designs while maintaining consistency across all consumer-facing communication.

Key Responsibilities 
Print & Packaging
Design packaging, menu inserts, stationery, brochures, promotional materials, and other print collaterals.
Develop high-quality artwork while ensuring accuracy in dimensions, typography, colors, and layouts.
Prepare print-ready files and coordinate with vendors for final production.
Ensure quality and consistency of physical brand assets.
Branding & Marketing
Create visual assets aligned with the brand identity and style guidelines.
Develop creatives for marketing campaigns, promotions, launches, and offline activations.
Design OOH creatives, billboards, in-store branding, displays, and other large-format assets.
Maintain consistency in typography, colors, imagery, and overall visual language.
Digital Design
Create static social media creatives, emailers, website banners, promotional graphics, and other digital assets.
Adapt campaign creatives across different formats and platforms.
Collaborate with marketing and content teams to translate campaign concepts into strong visual communication.
AI-Assisted Design
Use AI-powered design tools to improve speed, efficiency, and creative output.
Leverage tools such as Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Canva Magic Studio , and other relevant AI tools.
Explore AI for image generation, background expansion, retouching, generative fill, asset variations, and creative experimentation.
Brand & Design Management
Act as a custodian of the brand's visual identity and design guidelines.
Ensure consistency across all physical and digital touchpoints.
Manage multiple design requirements simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines.
Work closely with marketing, content, operations, and external vendors.
Requirements 
2+ years of professional experience in Graphic Design .
Strong portfolio demonstrating print, packaging, branding, and digital design .
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign .
Strong understanding of layout, typography, composition, and visual hierarchy.
Good knowledge of print production processes, including CMYK, bleed, color accuracy, paper types, and pre-press requirements .
Experience creating packaging artwork and print-ready files.
Strong understanding of brand consistency and visual identity.
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted creative tools such as Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Canva Magic Studio , or similar platforms.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and deliver high-quality work within tight timelines.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Good communication and vendor coordination skills.
Preferred Background 
Candidates from FMCG, Food & Beverage, D2C, Retail, Lifestyle, Beauty, Wellness, or consumer brands with strong packaging and print portfolios would be preferred.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Key Responsibilities 
Design creative layouts, advertisements, brochures, signage, logos, packaging, and other branding materials for print and digital platforms.
Develop engaging creatives for social media, Meta and Google Ads, website banners, blogs, SEO visuals, and e-commerce marketplace infographics.
Maintain brand consistency across all designs, ensuring uniformity in typography, colors, layouts, and visual identity.
Prepare print-ready artwork with accurate bleed, margins, crop marks, resolution, and color settings, ensuring compliance with printing requirements.
Conduct pre-press checks and coordinate with printing and production teams to ensure quality output, appropriate materials, and suitable finishing techniques.
Interpret creative briefs, translate concepts into effective visual designs, and refine artwork based on feedback and project requirements.
Manage multiple design projects simultaneously while maintaining quality, meeting deadlines, and staying updated with the latest design trends, digital advertising formats, and printing technologies.

Required Skills & Qualifications 
23 years of professional graphic design experience, preferably in the printing, advertising, packaging, or branding industry.
Strong working knowledge of CorelDRAW and Adobe Illustrator ; good proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, with Adobe InDesign considered an added advantage.
Strong understanding of offset, digital, and large-format printing processes, including print-ready artwork preparation, pre-press checks, and production requirements.
Knowledge of packaging design, dielines, product labels, signage, and other branding materials is preferred.
Familiarity with Meta and Google Ads creative formats, website graphics, e-commerce creatives, and marketplace listing images.
Good understanding of typography, color theory, composition, visual hierarchy, and brand consistency.
Strong attention to detail, creativity, time management, and the ability to manage multiple projects independently while collaborating with internal teams.
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communication, or a related field. Candidates with relevant practical experience will also be considered.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the Role: 

We are looking for a creative and proactive Graphic Designer & Social Media Content Creator to join our institute. The ideal candidate should be able to create engaging visual content, edit videos/reels, and manage regular social media content for our institute.

Key Responsibilities: 
1. Design creative and engaging social media posts, carousels, stories, banners, and promotional creatives.
2. Create and edit Instagram Reels, short-form videos, promotional videos, and educational content.
3. Develop fresh and engaging content ideas based on courses, student activities, admissions, events, and institute updates.
4. Handle the regular posting and scheduling of content across social media platforms.
5. Maintain a consistent visual identity and branding across all social media channels.
6. Edit raw footage into engaging and professional videos suitable for Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and other platforms.
7. Create promotional creatives for new courses, offers, admissions, events, workshops, and campaigns.
8. Work with the marketing/team to plan a monthly/weekly content calendar.
9. Stay updated with current social media trends, Reels formats, editing styles, and creative trends.
10. Take basic photos/videos of institute activities and convert them into social media content when required.

Required Skills: 
1. Strong knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator or similar graphic design tools.
2. Good video editing skills using Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar software.
3. Good understanding of Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and social media content formats.
4. Ability to create Reels and short-form videos that are engaging and trend-focused.
5. Good sense of design, typography, colors, composition, and branding.
6. Creative thinking and ability to generate new content ideas independently.
7. Good communication skills and ability to understand marketing requirements.

Preferred: 
1. Experience working with education/training institutes, coaching institutes, or similar businesses.
2. Basic knowledge of social media marketing and content strategy.
3. Knowledge of AI tools for content creation, image generation, video generation, and editing will be an advantage.
4. Basic photography/videography skills will be a plus.

What We Expect: 
We are looking for someone who can take ownership of our social media creative work from coming up with ideas to designing the creative, editing the video, and publishing the final content.The candidate should be able to consistently produce high-quality, creative, and engaging content rather than only working on designs provided by the team.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Job Description: Graphic Designer Ayurvedic Cosmetics & Beauty Products 
Job Title: Graphic Designer Product & Packaging Design
Experience: 35 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Department: Creative / Design / Marketing
Industry: Ayurvedic Cosmetics, Skincare & Beauty Products
Job Overview 
We are looking for a highly creative and experienced Graphic Designer specializing in Ayurvedic cosmetics, skincare, and beauty product design . The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience designing cosmetic product packaging, labels, jars, bottles, cartons, product mockups, and digital marketing creatives.
The candidate will be responsible for developing visually appealing and brand-consistent designs for Ayurvedic skincare, haircare, and personal care products. The role requires a strong understanding of cosmetic branding, packaging aesthetics, typography, color combinations, product presentation, and e-commerce design requirements.
Candidates with experience in beauty, skincare, herbal, Ayurvedic, or personal care brands will be preferred.
Key Responsibilities 
1. Cosmetic Product & Packaging Design 

Design packaging for Ayurvedic cosmetics, skincare, haircare, and personal care products.
Create product labels, bottles, jars, tubes, cartons, boxes, and outer packaging designs.
Develop premium packaging concepts for products such as face creams, face washes, serums, sunscreens, shampoos, hair oils, and herbal formulations.
Prepare print-ready packaging artwork with accurate dimensions, bleed, dielines, color specifications, and production requirements.
Ensure product packaging aligns with brand identity, target audience, and market positioning.
Create product mockups and realistic 3D-style product visuals for presentations and marketing campaigns.
Adapt packaging designs across different product sizes, variants, and product ranges.
2. Branding & Visual Identity 

Develop creative concepts for Ayurvedic beauty and skincare brands.
Maintain consistency in brand colors, typography, logo placement, product naming, and visual elements.
Create premium, natural, herbal, and wellness-inspired design concepts.
Design product range collections that maintain a cohesive brand identity.
Research competitor packaging, beauty industry trends, and consumer preferences to develop differentiated designs.
3. E-commerce Product Design 

Create high-quality product images and listing creatives for Shopify websites and other e-commerce platforms.
Design product feature graphics, ingredient highlights, benefit-based visuals, product comparison charts, and promotional banners.
Create product infographics highlighting ingredients such as Kumkumadi, turmeric, aloe vera, neem, saffron, and other herbal ingredients when relevant to the product.
Develop product listing images optimized for clarity, consistency, and conversion.
Prepare product launch creatives, offer banners, festive campaigns, and promotional graphics.
4. Digital Marketing & Social Media Creatives 

Design engaging creatives for Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, and other social media platforms.
Create advertising creatives for Meta Ads and Google Display Ads.
Develop campaign visuals for new product launches, seasonal promotions, influencer collaborations, and brand awareness campaigns.
Collaborate with the digital marketing team to develop creatives aligned with campaign objectives.
Create multiple creative variations for A/B testing and performance marketing campaigns.
5. Product Photography & Image Editing 

Edit and enhance cosmetic product photographs for websites, packaging, and marketing campaigns.
Improve product presentation through lighting correction, retouching, background removal, and image compositing.
Create product compositions using natural ingredients, botanical elements, textures, and lifestyle backgrounds.
Ensure accurate product colors, packaging details, and visual consistency across all platforms.
6. Team Collaboration & Production 

Coordinate with marketing, SEO, content, product development, and packaging vendors.
Prepare final artwork files for printing and verify technical specifications before production.
Manage multiple design projects while meeting deadlines.
Incorporate feedback from internal teams and stakeholders.
Maintain organized design files, editable source files, and brand asset libraries.
Required Skills & Qualifications 

35 years of professional graphic design experience, preferably in cosmetics, skincare, beauty, personal care, herbal, or Ayurvedic product brands.
Strong portfolio demonstrating cosmetic packaging, product labels, branding, and e-commerce product creatives.
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.
Experience with packaging layouts, dielines, print-ready files, and color specifications.
Strong understanding of typography, color theory, composition, branding, and visual hierarchy.
Experience creating product mockups and premium product presentation visuals.
Knowledge of printing processes, packaging materials, and artwork production requirements.
Ability to translate product concepts and brand guidelines into attractive, market-ready designs.
Excellent attention to detail, creative thinking, and time management skills.
Preferred Skills 

Previous experience working with Ayurvedic skincare, herbal cosmetics, organic beauty, or wellness brands.
Experience designing packaging for face creams, serums, face washes, hair oils, shampoos, and other beauty products.
Familiarity with cosmetic product photography and commercial image retouching.
Working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Figma, Blender, or other 3D packaging visualization tools.
Understanding of Shopify product image requirements and e-commerce presentation.
Basic awareness of cosmetic labeling requirements, ingredient declarations, and applicable packaging regulations in India.
Experience using AI-powered design tools to support creative ideation and visual development.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

Quality, creativity, and originality of product packaging designs.
Accuracy of labels, dimensions, dielines, and print-ready artwork.
Consistency across product variants and the overall brand identity.
Timely delivery of packaging, product images, and marketing creatives.
Number of design revisions required due to avoidable errors.
Effectiveness of product visuals in supporting marketing and e-commerce objectives.
Ability to manage multiple product design projects efficiently.
Application Requirements 
Interested candidates should submit:

Updated resume highlighting relevant experience.
Portfolio showcasing cosmetic packaging, labels, jars, bottles, cartons, and product mockups.
Samples of e-commerce product listing images and social media creatives.
Details of previous experience with Ayurvedic, herbal, skincare, or beauty brands.
Important: Candidates with direct experience in cosmetic product packaging and branding will be given preference over candidates whose experience is limited to general social media graphic design.
Application Subject: Graphic Designer Ayurvedic Cosmetics & Product Packaging

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to own product strategy, roadmap, discovery, delivery, and adoption across digital products. The role involves translating user, faculty, and business needs into scalable product solutions while driving measurable outcomes through data-driven decisions, cross-functional collaboration, and AI-enabled innovation.
Location: Hyderabad
Experience: 8+ years
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
1. Product Strategy and Discovery
Understand user needs, faculty workflows, and business requirements.
Define product vision, strategy, roadmap, MVPs, and phased releases.
Conduct user research, market analysis, and product data reviews.
Prioritize opportunities based on user value, business impact, evidence, effort, and risk.
2. Product Delivery and Outcomes
Own product requirements, user journeys, backlogs, acceptance criteria, and release priorities.
Collaborate with Engineering and Design teams while maintaining clear ownership of product direction.
Coordinate launch readiness with QA, content/academic teams, Marketing, Operations, and Support.
Track product adoption, engagement, retention, user outcomes, and business impact after launch.
Manage multiple products or product areas according to business priorities.
3. AI-Enabled Product Management
Identify valuable AI use cases across learning, content, search, recommendations, and operations.
Define data requirements, evaluation frameworks, human validation, and success metrics for AI features.
Understand LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI capabilities, limitations, costs, privacy, and safety considerations.
Use approved AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, and documentation, ensuring human verification.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Operations, and Support teams.
Communicate product priorities, decisions, risks, and progress to stakeholders and leadership.
Ensure product decisions are evidence-led and aligned with business objectives.
Continuously incorporate user feedback and product analytics into product improvements.

Required Skills and Experience
8+ years of experience, including strong ownership of digital product management.
Proven experience in product discovery, roadmap planning, prioritization, requirements definition, product launches, and adoption.
Strong user research, product analytics, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple products or product areas based on business priorities.
Understanding of mobile applications, web platforms, APIs, and modern product-engineering practices.
Practical understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, and responsible AI implementation.
Ability to use AI tools productively while protecting confidential information, credentials, and user data.
Commitment to human review, testing, security validation, and traceability for AI-assisted outputs.

Good-to-Have Experience
Experience in medical education, EdTech, healthcare, or content-platform products.
Familiarity with learning journeys, video-based learning, MCQs, assessments, or educational platforms.
Experience with semantic search, recommendation systems, knowledge platforms, or AI-powered products.
Key Success Metrics
Evidence-based roadmap decisions aligned with business priorities.
Predictable product launches and measurable adoption.
Continuous improvement in user feedback and engagement.
AI capabilities delivering validated value with appropriate governance.
Consistent delivery of measurable business and user outcomes.
Ideal Candidate
A strategic and data-driven product leader who combines strong product ownership with user empathy, analytical thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and an understanding of AI-enabled products to deliver measurable business impact.

title: Product Manager
description:
SUMMARY 
We are seeking a dynamic and technically competent Product Manager Industrial Automation to drive the growth of our automation product portfolio. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise along with commercial acumen in industrial automation products including PLC, HMI, Servo Systems, Motion Control, and Industrial IoT solutions.

EDUCATION 
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
MBA (Marketing/Operations) will be an added advantage.

EXPERIENCE 
Product Management & Business Development
Develop and execute product strategies aligned with business objectives.
Drive business growth through new customer acquisition and expansion of existing accounts.
Prepare annual business plans, product roadmaps, and revenue forecasts.
Identify emerging market trends, customer needs, and competitive opportunities.
Technical Sales & Solution Consulting
Conduct technical discussions with OEMs, machine builders, system integrators, and industrial customers.
Recommend appropriate automation solutions based on application requirements.
Deliver product demonstrations, technical presentations, and proof-of-concept sessions.
Prepare techno-commercial proposals and participate in contract negotiations.
Customer Engagement
Build long-term relationships with key customers and strategic partners.
Provide technical guidance during pre-sales and post-sales activities.
Conduct product training programs for customers, channel partners, and internal sales teams.
Ensure exceptional customer satisfaction through proactive engagement.
Product & Market Development
Monitor industry developments and competitor activities.
Gather customer feedback and recommend product enhancements.
Coordinate with engineering, marketing, and service teams for successful product launches.
Support marketing initiatives including seminars, exhibitions, webinars, and technical events.
Reporting & Performance Management
Maintain accurate sales pipelines and CRM records.
Prepare monthly business reports, sales forecasts, and management presentations.
Track key performance metrics and recommend improvement strategies.
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
PLC
HMI
Servo Drives & Motion Control
Industrial IoT Gateways
Industrial Communication Protocols
Automation Control Systems
Excellent communication and presentation abilities
Strong techno-commercial negotiation skills
Customer relationship management
Strategic thinking and analytical problem-solving
CRM software proficiency
Project coordination and stakeholder management
Ability to work independently and collaboratively
EXPERIENCE 
37 years of experience in Product Management, Technical Sales, or Business Development within the Industrial Automation industry. Experience handling products such as PLC, HMI, Servo Systems, Motion Control, or Industrial IoT solutions. Experience working with OEMs, machine builders, system integrators, and industrial customers is highly desirable.
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS) 
Achievement of Monthly, Quarterly, and Annual Sales Targets New Customer Acquisition Product Revenue Growth Customer Retention & Satisfaction Lead-to-Order Conversion Ratio Forecast Accuracy Market Share Growth Successful Product Launches CRM Data Accuracy and Reporting Compliance
PREFERRED INDUSTRY BACKGROUND 
Industrial Automation Factory Automation Motion Control PLC & HMI Solutions Servo Drives Robotics Machine Builders CNC Automation Industrial IoT Process Automation

title: Product Manager
description:
Job Description: Product Manager (Laboratory Glassware)
Company: Borosil Scientific Limited
Industry: Scientific & Laboratory Equipment Manufacturing (Laboratory Glassware & Consumables)
Website: https://www.borosilscientific.com/
Department/Business: Laboratory Glassware
Experience Required: 6-10 years
Gender: Males Only

Travel Requirements: Customer, channel partner and manufacturing site visits as required

About the Company 

Borosil Scientific Limited is one of India's leading manufacturers and suppliers of laboratory glassware, scientific instruments, laboratory consumables and pharmaceutical packaging solutions. With over six decades of expertise, the company serves pharmaceutical companies, research laboratories, educational institutions and industrial customers across India and international markets. Borosil Scientific is recognised for its commitment to quality, precision, innovation and scientific excellence.

Role Purpose 

Lead the strategy, growth and profitability of the laboratory glassware portfolio. Translate customer needs and market opportunities into product plans, support sales and channel teams, and coordinate with manufacturing, quality, supply chain and marketing to strengthen product availability, competitiveness and customer adoption.
Portfolio Scope

Volumetric glassware, laboratory bottles and caps, general laboratory glassware, microbiology glassware, quartz and sintered ware, and associated accessories within the assigned portfolio.

Key Responsibilities 

1. Product Strategy and Business Performance
Develop annual category plans covering revenue, volume, gross margin, product mix and priority customer segments.
Analyse product and SKU performance by customer segment, geography and channel to identify growth opportunities and corrective actions.
Build product roadmaps and business cases for new products, range extensions and portfolio rationalisation.
Work with sales leadership to develop forecasts, review business performance and implement agreed growth plans.

2. Market Intelligence and Customer Engagement

title: Product Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced Product Manager with a strong background in the Healthcare/Hospital/Diagnostics domain to drive product strategy, market adoption, and sales enablement initiatives. The role will be responsible for managing the product lifecycle while ensuring that sales teams, channel partners, and key stakeholders are thoroughly trained and equipped to position the product effectively in the market.
The ideal candidate should possess a blend of product management expertise, healthcare industry knowledge, and the ability to deliver impactful sales training programs.
Define and execute product strategy and roadmap in alignment with business objectives.
Gather and translate customer, clinician, hospital, and market requirements into product enhancements.
Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer feedback assessments.
Collaborate with technology, operations, sales, and marketing teams for successful product launches.
Monitor product performance, adoption, and customer satisfaction metrics.
Develop and deliver product training programs for sales teams, account managers, and channel partners.
Create product presentations, training manuals, playbooks, FAQs, and competitive positioning documents.
Conduct onboarding and periodic refresher training sessions.
Enable sales teams to confidently communicate product value propositions and handle customer objections.
Support sales teams during client presentations, demonstrations, and strategic pitches.
Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for product-related discussions.
Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, and Technology teams.
Gather insights from customers, hospitals, laboratories, clinicians, and healthcare administrators to improve product offerings.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Management, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Business Administration, or MBA preferred.
4-9 years of experience in Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, or Product Training.
Prior experience from IVF/Diagnostics/Pharmaceutical Industry
Strong communication and storytelling skills
Excellent presentation and facilitation abilities
Customer-centric mindset
Strategic thinking and problem-solving
Ability to influence cross-functional teams
Data-driven decision making
Product Lifecycle Management
Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy
Sales Enablement

Interested candidates can share your cv to sneha.shetty@indiraivf.in

title: Product Manager
description:
Job Description 

Position - Product Manager 
Shift timing - 1 to 10 PM 
5 days work from office. 

As a Product Manager, youre key to helping us continue to enhance our product offering. You would be joining a high performing Product and Design team where you will partner directly with Product Managers, UX Designers and others across the company to ensure were building the right functionality to meet our customers needs. This position will provide a great opportunity to work on the flagship Payroll platform that serves as the foundation piece of the PrismHR technology. 

Responsibilities: 
Define the product strategy and roadmap 
Drive the product- and business-planning processes for cross-functional teams 
Partner with stakeholders & User Experience Designers (UX) to discover, define, and translate customer needs into a prioritized product backlog (Epic > User Stories > Acceptance Criteria) 
Responsible for driving the creation, and completion, of User Stories to a “Ready for Development” status 
Assess current competitor offerings and seek opportunities for differentiation 
Analyze product requirements and develop appropriate programs to ensure they’re met 
Develop, implement, and maintain production timelines across multiple departments 
Appraise new product ideas and strategize appropriate go-to-market plans 
Responsible for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and close coordination with Engineering and Quality Assurance (QA) teams to ensure acceptance criteria are met. 
Act as a primary point of contact to triage any escalated issues that were routed through Support and/or Professional Services 
Partner with the Technical Documentation team and Support to clearly communicate and define product changes. 
Partner with PM & UX on the management of User Influencer Groups (and other customer feedback mechanisms) to maintain a high level of engagement with the platform’s most active customers & users 
Help ensure Product Management is successful at building and maintaining a centrally located, 12-month roadmap, and product backlog 
Establish a close partnership and working relationship with QA to assess the status of testing product fixes and enhancements. 
Act as a liaison and bridge between product teams, support, and professional services to help identify product issues and opportunities for enhancements. 
Stay up to date on Payroll related trends and changing requirements 
Qualifications: 
7+ years of Business / Product Analyst experience or equivalent 
Previous experience collaborating with others to refine project, process, and or application needs from high level requirements 
Excellent communication and organization skills; ability to connect across various domains, skills, and disciplines 
Great balance of software business and technical savvy/aptitude with the ability to quickly understand customer problems 
Understand and have previous experience with HR platforms and core functionality would be a plus 
Ability to become a true product expert with the flexibility to respond to various business & team needs 
Experience working in an Agile environment and a great understanding of its most common practices / processes / tactics. 
Ability to contribute and supervise various Agile Scrum rituals such as standups, grooming sessions, and Sprint Demos. 
Demonstrate a high level of grit and initiative to get stuff done 

Additional Qualifications: 
Passion for the Software product craft and a curiosity for continuous learning and improvement bonus points if you love all things Payroll and related HR functionality 
Experience using PrismHR or another Human Capital Management (HCM) platform and/or related HR Technology 
Software Business Analyst / Product Owner certificate course 
Agile Framework certifications and/or professional development training 
Knowledge of and/or experience with Pragmatic Institute’s (or equivalent) Product Management framework

title: Product Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities 
Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmaps aligned with business objectives.
Partner with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Operations, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality product experiences.
Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery through launch, measurement, and continuous improvement.
Exercise sound product judgment by evaluating short-term and long-term opportunities, making thoughtful recommendations, and balancing customer needs, business objectives, technical considerations, and strategic priorities to guide product direction and investment decisions.
Gather and prioritize customer, stakeholder, and business requirements.
Develop product hypotheses and validate them through research, experimentation, and data analysis.
Use customer insights, product analytics, and key performance metrics to inform prioritization and product decisions.
Translate complex business problems into clear product requirements and actionable roadmaps.
Coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver initiatives on time and with measurable outcomes.
Drive adoption of modern technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities, automation, and data-driven decision making where appropriate.
Qualifications 
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
5+ years of product management experience owning digital products from strategy through execution.
Demonstrated experience developing product roadmaps and delivering customer-focused software products.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data to drive product decisions.
Experience working closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and cross-functional business partners.
Ability to influence stakeholders and build alignment across multiple teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-making capabilities.
Comfortable working in fast-paced, evolving, and ambiguous environments.
Preferred Experience 
Customer-facing digital products
Enterprise software or operational platforms
Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning applications
Automation and workflow optimization
Data products and analytics
Mobile applications
Experimentation, A/B testing, or optimization
Pricing, commerce, marketplace, or operational products
Success in this Role 
Customer obsession and a strong product mindset.
Ownership and accountability for product outcomes.
Strategic thinking balanced with execution excellence.
Data-driven decision making.
Strong collaboration and influence across cross-functional teams.
Adaptability and ability to quickly learn new business domains.

title: Product Manager
description:
Job description: 

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Product Manager to support the product team in planning, developing, and delivering innovative digital products. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills with an interest in product management and technology. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

1. Gather, analyze, and document business and product requirements. 
2. Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and functional specifications. 
3. Assist in product roadmap planning, feature prioritization, and product strategy. 
4. Collaborate with Engineering, QA, UI/UX, Business, and Project teams to ensure timely product delivery. 
5. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to understand business needs and provide product updates. 
6. Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer research to identify product opportunities. 
7. Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, product reviews, and backlog management. 
8. Perform product validation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and quality checks before product releases. 
9. Track product development milestones, timelines, and project progress. 
10. Monitor product performance, analyze user feedback, and recommend product enhancements. 

Required Skill-set: 

- Product Management fundamentals 
- Product Requirement Documentation (PRD) & User Stories 
- Business Analysis & Requirement Gathering 
- Stakeholder Management 
- Strong Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills 
- Excellent Verbal & Written Communication 
- Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) 
- Basic understanding of UI/UX principles 
- Knowledge of SDLC and Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC)
