title: Product Manager
description:
KEMIN CBR | JOB DESCRIPTION 
KEMIN CBR 
JOB DESCRIPTION 
PRODUCT MANAGER KEMIN CBR 
Job Title Product Manager Kemin CBR Function Marketing Sub-function Retail Marketing Reports to General Manager Kemin CBR Location Chennai (Includes travel)

ROLE SUMMARY
Responsible for developing and executing product and marketing strategies for the Kemin CBR ruminant and veterinary retail portfolio, with accountability for portfolio growth, market development, brand positioning, gross margin, and marketing effectiveness.
Manage the marketing mix across product, price, place, and promotion, translating scientific evidence, market intelligence, and customer insights into differentiated and commercially relevant product propositions.
¢ Lead product lifecycle management, new-product launches, scientific communication, sales enablement, farmer education, veterinary and veterinary doctor engagement, and marketing-cost optimization to support sustainable retail-business growth.
¢ Collaborate closely with Sales, Technical Services, R&D, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Finance, Quality, and Supply Chain to deliver portfolio priorities and achieve approved sales and profitability objectives.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Product Strategy and Portfolio Management
¢ Develop and execute annual product and marketing plans for the assigned ruminant and veterinary retail portfolio.
¢ Define target customer segments, product positioning, value propositions, pricing recommendations, and promotional strategies.
¢ Establish and monitor portfolio sales, gross-margin, market-development, and marketing-expenditure objectives.
¢ Identify portfolio gaps and new-product opportunities through market research, competitor analysis, customer feedback, and field insights.
¢ Manage product lifecycle activities, including new-product introductions, brand repositioning, portfolio improvements, performance reviews, and rationalization recommendations.
¢ Translate veterinary and scientific knowledge into clear, commercially relevant product benefits for farmers, veterinarians, distributors, retailers, and other channel partners.
2. Market Research and Retail Business Development
¢ Conduct market research to understand farmer needs, purchasing behaviour, retailer feedback, competitor offerings, and opportunities in ruminant health and nutrition.
¢ Assess market trends, competitive pricing, product differentiation, and gaps in retail availability.
¢ Support Sales in developing territory-specific marketing plans and identifying opportunities for geographic and channel expansion.
¢ Conduct joint field visits with Sales and Technical Services to engage distributors, retailers, veterinarians, and farmers.
¢ Gather, analyze, and consolidate customer and channel insights to guide product development, communication, and promotional priorities.
¢ Build professional networks and strengthen relationships with veterinary professionals and relevant industry and channel stakeholders.
3. New-Product Development and Launch Execution
¢ Prepare new-product proposals for R&D, supported by defined market needs, competitive analysis, scientific rationale, and commercial potential.
¢ Coordinate with R&D, Technical Services, Sales, Quality, Supply Chain, and other relevant functions to support product development and launch readiness.
¢ Contribute veterinary and customer insights to formulation discussions, product differentiation, and the development of science-backed claims.
¢ Develop integrated launch plans covering positioning, pricing, promotional materials, sales training, sampling, channel activation, and field execution.
¢ Coordinate product evaluations and field trials with technical teams, and translate findings into approved marketing and training materials.
¢ Monitor post-launch performance, consolidate customer feedback, and recommend corrective actions or product improvements.
4. Scientific Communication and Brand Promotion
¢ Develop scientific articles, technical bulletins, product presentations, sales manuals, training modules, flyers, and customer-education materials.
¢ Translate research findings and technical information into clear, audience-appropriate product messages.
¢ Ensure product communications and claims are scientifically substantiated and reviewed through the appropriate internal approval process.
¢ Plan and execute marketing campaigns, product-awareness programs, and brand-building initiatives aligned with portfolio objectives.
¢ Develop point-of-sale materials, retailer branding, and farmer-facing communication tools.
¢ Coordinate with approved vendors to ensure the quality, timely delivery, and cost efficiency of promotional materials.
5. Sales Training and Technical Support
¢ Train sales teams and channel partners on product knowledge, positioning, differentiation, responsible use, and customer-objection handling.
¢ Develop structured training modules and conduct post-training assessments to evaluate learning effectiveness, in coordination with sales training faculties.
¢ Provide scientific and technical support for customer presentations, field meetings, product demonstrations, and sales campaigns.
¢ Coordinate with Technical Services and R&D to address complex product queries and customer feedback.
¢ Strengthen sales effectiveness by providing timely promotional inputs and practical field-communication tools.
¢ Ensure consistent product messaging across sales teams, channel partners, and customer-facing materials.
6. Farmer Education and Veterinary Engagement
¢ Coordinate farmer-education programs on livestock nutrition, preventive animal healthcare, and productivity topics relevant to the portfolio.
¢ Work with veterinary and technical teams to develop practical educational content and field-engagement activities.
¢ Support farmer meetings, veterinary interactions, and product demonstrations in coordination with Sales and Technical Services.
¢ Collect and analyze field data and customer feedback to evaluate engagement activities and identify improvement opportunities.
¢ Apply veterinary knowledge to understand customer needs and support responsible product education and communication.
7. Commercial Performance and Cost Optimization
¢ Track product-level sales, gross margin, marketing expenditure, and campaign performance against approved plans.
¢ Prepare periodic portfolio-performance reports and recommend actions to improve growth, profitability, and execution effectiveness.
¢ Optimize expenditure on sampling, promotional materials, vendor services, and marketing activities without compromising execution quality.
¢ Work with Purchasing to evaluate competitive sourcing opportunities that support approved product and cost objectives.
¢ Collaborate with Manufacturing and Finance to evaluate standard costs and support agreed cost-improvement targets.
¢ Assess the commercial effectiveness of launches, campaigns, and field activities to improve resource allocation and return on marketing investment.
8. Cross-functional Coordination and Process Improvement
¢ Coordinate with Sales, R&D, Technical Services, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Finance, Quality, and Supply Chain to execute portfolio priorities.
¢ Establish effective processes for customer feedback, technical-query escalation, and response tracking.
¢ Improve workflows for product launches, training delivery, promotional-material development, and marketing execution.
¢ Maintain accurate product documentation, training records, market intelligence, project updates, and approved marketing materials.
¢ Support team coordination, knowledge sharing, and timely delivery of agreed initiatives.
¢ Escalate material portfolio risks, project delays, budget deviations, and investment requirements to the General Manager in a timely manner.
QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
¢ Must have: Bachelors degree in Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry, Animal Nutrition, or a related scientific discipline.
¢ Preferred: A postgraduate qualification in Veterinary Pharmacology and Toxicology, Animal Nutrition, or a related veterinary discipline is preferred. A management qualification is an added advantage.
¢ Approximately 57 years of relevant experience across animal health, veterinary practice, research, technical services, sales, or marketing.
¢ At least 3 years of experience in product management, animal-health marketing, veterinary affairs, or a closely related commercial role.
¢ Demonstrated experience in product launches, market research, scientific communication, sales training, and cross-functional coordination.
¢ Experience in ruminant health, livestock nutrition, farmer engagement, or retail-channel marketing is preferred.
¢ Candidates with companion-animal product-management experience may be considered where they demonstrate relevant livestock exposure and transferable commercial and technical capabilities.
CORE COMPETENCIES
Commercial and Product Management Product strategy and lifecycle management; market research and competitor analysis; opportunity identification; brand positioning; launch planning; sales and gross-margin analysis; marketing-budget management; cost optimization; retail-channel and customer engagement. Scientific and Technical Veterinary scientific knowledge and evidence interpretation; scientific and technical writing; product training and knowledge transfer; technical sales support; customer-query coordination; translation of research findings into product communication; field-data analysis and reporting. Behavioral and Execution Cross-functional collaboration; team coordination; influencing; presentation and interpersonal communication; vendor negotiation and relationship management; planning and project management; customer orientation; problem-solving; accountability; decisiveness; continuous improvement.
TRAVEL REQUIREMENT
¢ Approximately 1520 days of domestic travel per month, as required by the business. Travel may include field visits, customer meetings, channel engagement, training programs, and product-launch activities.
OTHER CONSIDERATIONS
This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the roles responsibilities and expectations. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties. Responsibilities may change in response to evolving business priorities, portfolio requirements, and organizational needs.

title: Product Manager
description:
Hi,

We are looking for Product Development Manager Weigh in Motion (WIM) 

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
Experience: 8-12 years (preferably in WIM, ATMS, tolling systems, or ITS projects)
Qualification : B.E./B.Tech

Job Summary 
We are looking for an experienced Product Development Manager to lead the development, installation, testing, commissioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Weigh in Motion (WIM) systems. The candidate will be responsible for product development, hardware and software integration, project execution, technical support, and coordination with clients and service teams to ensure reliable system performance and successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities 

Product Development: Lead the development, enhancement, testing, and improvement of Weigh in Motion systems, including Slow Speed and Medium Speed Weighing Machines.
System Integration: Oversee the integration of hardware, software, sensors, controllers, and communication interfaces used in WIM systems.
Technical Expertise: Manage and troubleshoot, loop detectors, load cells, control boxes, and control panel wiring.
Installation & Commissioning: Supervise installation, testing, commissioning, maintenance, and servicing of WIM systems, including coordination of civil works wherever required.
Software & Hardware Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to WIM software, hardware, sensors, control panels, and system communication.
Project Management: Manage end-to-end project execution, including planning, resource allocation, site coordination, implementation, testing, handover, and documentation.
Client Coordination: Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams to ensure project requirements and delivery timelines are met.
AMC & Service Management: Oversee Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) activities, preventive maintenance, breakdown support, and service team performance across project sites.
Team Leadership: Lead and guide product development, technical support, installation, and maintenance teams to improve productivity and system reliability.
Quality & Compliance: Ensure compliance with applicable technical specifications, project requirements, quality standards, and contractual obligations.
Technical Documentation: Maintain product specifications, testing reports, service records, installation documentation, and project handover reports.
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve product performance, accuracy, reliability, maintainability, and cost-effectiveness.

Required Skills & Competencies 

In-depth knowledge of Weigh in Motion systems and weighing technologies.
Experience with load cells, indicators, loop detectors, control panels, sensors, and electronic measurement systems.
Strong troubleshooting skills in hardware, software, and system integration.
Experience in installation, testing, commissioning, maintenance, and AMC management.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and client-handling skills.
Willingness to travel to project sites across India when required.

Interested candidates can share their updated CV on hr@qualix.co.in

title: Product Manager
description:
About Leverage Edu 
Leverage Edu is an AI-powered talent mobility platform helping students achieve their global education and career aspirations. Through technology, innovation, and data-driven solutions, we are transforming the study abroad journey for students across the globe.

About the Role: 
We are looking for a highly driven Product Manager to own end-to-end product development across both customer-facing and internal business platforms. As an Individual Contributor (IC), you will build new products, scale existing ones, and continuously improve user experiences while driving measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities: 

Own the complete product lifecycle, from ideation and roadmap planning to launch, adoption, and continuous optimization.
Lead products through every growth stage (0 to 1, 1 to 10, and 10 to 100) by building new solutions and enhancing existing capabilities.
Own both customer-facing and internal business products, improving user experience and operational efficiency.
Define product vision, prioritize initiatives, and maintain a roadmap aligned with customer needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility.
Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Leadership to deliver high-quality product initiatives.
Use analytics, customer insights, experimentation, and market research to validate ideas and prioritize features.
Identify opportunities to automate workflows and leverage AI to improve customer experience and business productivity.
Track key product metrics and user feedback to improve adoption, engagement, and customer satisfaction.

What You Bring: 

Strong product thinking: the ability to identify customer and business problems, prioritize effectively, and turn ideas into impactful solutions.
Proven experience building and scaling products across different growth stages with measurable business outcomes.
Analytical mindset: comfortable using data, experimentation, and customer insights to make decisions.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across Engineering, Design, Business, and Leadership.
Ownership mindset: a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and drives initiatives to completion.

What We Offer: 

High ownership of products that directly influence customer experience and business growth.
Close work with founders and senior leadership on strategic, high-impact initiatives.
Opportunity to build products used by thousands of students and internal stakeholders across multiple geographies.
Fast-paced, innovation-led environment with accelerated career growth.
Competitive compensation and performance-driven growth.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Company: Conceptia Technologies Ltd.
Division: Conceptia Marine
Designation: Business Analyst
Experience: 35 Years
Skills: Business Analysis, MIS Reporting and Project Coordination
Tools: Power BI
Location: Bengaluru
Qualification: Any Graduate
CTC: 5.00 6.00 LPA
Working Days: Monday to Friday

1. Job Purpose 
We are looking for a result-oriented and analytical Business Analyst to join our Conceptia Marine Division. The candidate will be responsible for business data analysis, management reporting, dashboard development, project coordination and project performance monitoring.
The role involves working closely with internal departments, project managers and other stakeholders to monitor project progress, track deliverables, analyse performance and provide timely information to management for effective decision-making.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities 
A. Business Data Analysis & Reporting 
Collect, consolidate and analyse business and operational data from various sources.
Identify trends, patterns, gaps and opportunities for business improvement.
Analyse business performance against defined targets and KPIs.
Prepare periodic MIS reports, management reports and performance dashboards.
Develop and maintain interactive dashboards using Power BI or similar tools.
Automate routine reporting processes wherever possible.
B. Project Coordination & Monitoring 
Coordinate with project managers, engineering teams and other stakeholders to monitor project progress.
Track project schedules, milestones, deliverables and completion status.
Follow up with respective project teams to obtain periodic project updates.
Maintain project trackers and prepare project status reports for management review.
Identify project delays, bottlenecks and deviations from planned schedules and escalate them to the concerned stakeholders.
Coordinate project review meetings, prepare meeting agendas and document minutes of meetings and action points.
Follow up on pending action items to ensure timely closure.
Assist in monitoring resource utilisation, project progress and overall project performance.
Ensure timely communication and coordination between relevant departments for smooth project execution.
C. Business Performance Monitoring 
Monitor business performance, project progress and operational efficiency.
Analyse deviations from planned targets and highlight areas requiring management attention.
Assist in developing performance indicators and reporting frameworks.
Provide data-driven insights to support business planning and decision-making.
D. Data Management & Stakeholder Coordination 
Gather business and reporting requirements from internal stakeholders.
Coordinate with various departments to collect and validate relevant data.
Ensure accuracy, consistency and integrity of business reports and project records.
Maintain proper documentation of reports, dashboards, project trackers and analysis.
E. Process Improvement 
Identify opportunities to improve reporting, project monitoring and business analysis processes.
Recommend improvements based on data findings.
Support management in business planning, forecasting and operational decision-making.

3. Required Skills & Competencies 
Hands-on experience in Microsoft Power BI or similar business intelligence tools.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, Lookups and advanced formulas.
Understanding of data analysis, data visualisation and MIS reporting.
Good project coordination, monitoring and follow-up skills.
Ability to prepare project trackers, status reports and management dashboards.
Strong organisational, analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to coordinate with multiple teams and stakeholders.
Good attention to detail and ability to manage multiple assignments.
Knowledge of MS Project or other project management tools will be an added advantage.
Knowledge of SQL and database concepts will be an added advantage.

4. Educational Qualification & Experience 
Any Bachelor's Degree.
35 years of relevant experience in Business Analysis, Project Coordination, MIS Reporting, Data Analysis or Business Intelligence.
Practical experience in developing dashboards, analysing business data and coordinating projects is desirable.

5. Preferred Candidate Profile 
Candidates from Business Analysis, Business Intelligence, MIS, Data Analytics or Project Coordination backgrounds.
Experience in preparing management dashboards and project performance reports.
Ability to independently manage project trackers, coordinate with stakeholders and follow up on deliverables.
Experience in engineering, manufacturing, marine or project-based organisations will be an added advantage.

Important: This position is primarily focused on Business Analysis, MIS Reporting and Project Coordination. Candidates primarily working as Software Developers, Software Engineers, Full Stack Developers, Application Developers or Programmers are not required.

6. Compensation & Benefits 
Annual CTC: 5.00 6.00 LPA, depending on experience and suitability.
Five-day working week (Monday to Friday).
Opportunity to work with the Conceptia Marine Division and contribute to business analysis, project monitoring and management decision-making.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Role Overview: 
We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Business Analyst to support business decision-making through data analysis, reporting, process evaluation, and actionable insights. The individual will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, identify operational gaps, analyse performance metrics, and recommend improvements that drive business efficiency and growth.
The ideal candidate should have strong analytical capabilities, proficiency in data visualization and reporting tools, and the ability to translate complex data into meaningful business insights.
Key Responsibilities: 
1. Business Analysis & Insights
Analyse business performance, operational metrics, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Gather, interpret, and validate business data to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Develop reports and dashboards to track business performance and key metrics.
Translate data findings into actionable insights and recommendations for management.
2. Data Analysis & Reporting
Extract, clean, manipulate, and analyse large datasets from multiple sources.
Build and maintain dashboards and automated reports for business stakeholders.
Monitor key business metrics and prepare periodic performance reports.
Conduct variance analysis, trend analysis, and root cause analysis to identify performance gaps.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reports.
3. Process Improvement
Evaluate existing business processes and identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks.
Recommend data-backed solutions to improve operational efficiency and productivity.
Support implementation of process improvements and track their effectiveness.
Document business processes, workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
4. Stakeholder Management
Work closely with teams across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Technology to understand business requirements.
Gather requirements, define business problems, and translate them into analytical solutions.
Prepare presentations and reports to communicate findings to stakeholders.
Coordinate with relevant teams to track business initiatives and ensure timely execution.
Required Skills & Qualifications: 
Minimum 2 years of experience in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, MIS, or Business Intelligence roles.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel , including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, advanced formulas, and data handling.
Working knowledge of SQL for querying and analysing databases.
Hands-on experience with Power BI or Tableau for dashboard creation and data visualization.
Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.
Understanding of business KPIs, performance metrics, and data-driven decision-making.
Ability to interpret data and present actionable business insights.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
Tools & Technologies: 
Data Analysis: Advanced Microsoft Excel, SQL
Data Visualization: Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio
Reporting: Google Sheets, Microsoft PowerPoint
Database & Business Intelligence: MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server
Project Management: Jira, Asana, or similar tools
Preferred Qualifications: 
Experience working in EdTech, Education, SaaS, or other fast-paced business environments.
Exposure to CRM platforms and business reporting systems.
Understanding of sales funnels, revenue metrics, customer acquisition, and operational performance.
Familiarity with automation and AI-powered analytical tools.

Ideal Candidate: 
A highly analytical and business-oriented professional who can work with data, identify patterns, solve business problems, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. The candidate should be comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and capable of independently managing analytical assignments from data extraction to final presentation.

title: Business Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
Business Analyst Implementations 
Job category: Business Analysis

Job Description
DevOn is looking for a highly driven, client-facing Business Analyst Implementations who can independently own and drive the end-to-end implementation for an account with minimal supervision. In this role, you will combine strong functional and technical skills, working with a team of software professionals and directly with client stakeholders to enhance overall business operations.
We are seeking a Business Analyst Implementations professional who has 4-6 years of experience in Healthcare IT and/or Business Analysis that includes Elicitation, Analysis, testing, debugging, documenting and/or maintaining applications or using applications in a business setting. The ideal candidate is self-organized and resourceful, and applies strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to work through ambiguity without close oversight.
This role will require you to collaborate with, and confidently represent DevOn in front of, the clients subject matter experts, sprint team, and other internal and external teams/stakeholders maintaining a professional, positive, and solutions-oriented demeanor throughout.
Key Responsibilities
Client & stakeholder engagement

Serve as the primary client-facing point of contact for external and internal stakeholders, understanding their needs and independently formulating the solution around the ask.
Independently own and drive the end-to-end implementation for the assigned account from requirements through go-live with minimal to no supervision.
Perform live demos on system functionality and the recommended implementation/solution approach to customer partners and internal teams.
Deliver presentations on topics including measurement, analysis, improvement, and KPIs.
Understand customer workflow problems and provide recommended best practices; represent the problem to internal stakeholders to provide potential technical solution recommendations.
Requirements & functional analysis

Leverage prior healthcare experience and creativity, applying strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills to resolve a wide range of issues.
Work under an Agile framework, writing user stories, mock-ups and acceptance criteria, and contributing to refining/grooming user stories and test scenarios.
Collaborate with the Product teams to review customer requirements.
Define configuration, integration, reporting, and automation requirements for clients.
Create, analyze, and validate details on back-end/source system capabilities and perform gap analysis.
Technical & system analysis

Write SQL/DB queries to perform data analysis, with a deep understanding of APIs, Microservices, and SSO integrations.
Apply deeper understanding and prior implementation experience with healthcare integrations such as EDI, FHIR, HL7, and other cross-system integrations.
Develop and maintain system flow diagrams depicting As is and future state considerations.
Develop and maintain data flow diagrams for system data integrations.
Cross-functional team collaboration

Participate in system design, development, testing, and deployment, collaborating daily with Developers, QA, Architecture, and UI/Design teams to drive a workable solution design, ensure tickets satisfy Definition of Done (DOD), and bring iteration commitments to resolution within the estimated timeframe.
Assist QA in deriving test scenarios and reviewing test cases.
Report on common sources of technical issues or questions and give recommendations.
Skills & Qualifications

Bachelors degree, or advanced degrees and certifications in either software development or healthcare.
Minimum of 3 years hands-on experience implementing software applications for customers in the US healthcare space.
Hands-on working experience on clinical platforms in the US healthcare domain, such as Case Management, Utilization Management, and Medication Therapy Management.
Highly self-organized and independent; able to take full ownership of and drive the entire implementation for an account with minimal to no supervision.
Strong problem-solving ability, applying critical thinking to work through ambiguous or complex situations.
Strong client-facing skills with the ability to build trust and confidently manage relationships with client stakeholders.
Excellent communication and analytical skills.
Ability to work individually and as part of a team in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
Professional, positive, and collaborative demeanor in all client and internal interactions.
Solid understanding of Web services (SOAP, REST, XML etc.) and SQL.

description:
Role & responsibilities 

Business Analyst MIS & Business Performance
Swargaseema Sandal Wood Farms Pvt. Ltd. | Hyderabad
The Role
We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our team and help us understand
business performance through data and analysis.
The role involves working with data across different functions, including
Marketing, Pre-Sales, Sales and Post-Sales, to understand the customer journey,
track business performance and evaluate the effectiveness of various business
activities and spends.
The candidate should be able to connect information from different departments,
identify trends and patterns, and understand how various activities impact
business outcomes such as revenue, costs, profitability and overall performance.
We are looking for someone with 2–3 years of experience in MIS, Data Analysis or
Business Analysis, who is comfortable working with numbers and has the
business acumen to look beyond the data and understand what it means for the
business.
What You Will Do
• Collect, organise and analyse data across Marketing, Pre-Sales, Sales and
Post-Sales functions.
• Track and analyse the customer journey, from initial enquiry and lead
generation to sales conversion and post-sales activities.
• Connect data across departments to understand relationships between
marketing spends, lead generation, conversions, sales and revenue.
• Monitor key business metrics and prepare regular reports to track
performance.
• Analyse marketing and operational spends against business outcomes to
understand effectiveness and identify areas for improvement.
• Identify trends, gaps, inefficiencies and opportunities through regular data
analysis.
• Assist in preparing budgets, forecasts and actual performance reports.
• Analyse business performance from a cost, revenue and profitability
perspective.

• Prepare monthly MIS and management reports with clear observations and
findings.
• Coordinate with different teams to understand business activities, validate
information and improve data reporting.
• Support management with business analysis and data requirements as
needed.
Who You Are
• 2–3 years of experience in MIS, Data Analysis, Business Analysis or a
similar role.
• Graduate in any discipline. A background in Commerce, Business or
Finance is an added advantage.
• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookup
functions and pivot tables.
• Comfortable handling, organising and analysing data from multiple
sources.
• Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail.
• Good business understanding and the ability to connect numbers with
actual business performance.
• Basic understanding of financial concepts such as revenue, costs,
margins, profitability and return on investment.
• Able to look beyond reporting numbers and understand what is driving
business performance.
• Good communication skills in English and Telugu, both written and verbal.
• Able to present findings and explain numbers in a simple and clear manner.
Good to Have
• Working knowledge of Power BI or similar data visualisation tools.
• Basic understanding of SQL.
• Experience analysing sales, marketing, customer or operational data.
• Experience preparing MIS reports and management dashboards.

title: Business Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Business Functional Analyst who sits at the intersection of Core Banking and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, you will lead the discovery and design of AI driven banking solutions. You will be responsible for translating complex business needs into technical specifications for data scientists and ML engineers, ensuring that every AI model builtfrom LLMs to Agentic workflows—solves a concrete banking problem while adhering to strict compliance and operational standards.

Core Responsibilities
Requirements Engineering for AI
Translate Ambiguity: Elicit requirements for AI/ML applications and translate them into actionable User Stories with rigorous Acceptance Criteria.
AI Life Cycle Management: Define functional requirements across the ML lifecycle, from data ingestion and labeling to model monitoring (MLOps).
RAG & Agentic Design: Work with stakeholders to define the knowledge base and retrieval logic for RAG based systems and the decision making boundaries for AI Agents in banking workflows.
Banking & Domain Alignment
Domain Expertise: Apply deep Core Banking knowledge to ensure AI solutions align with retail/commercial banking processes (e.g., credit scoring, KYC, fraud detection, or customer service).
Compliance & Risk: Ensure user stories include non functional requirements for AI transparency, bias mitigation, and regulatory reporting.

Role Overview 
We are seeking an AWM Domain Analyst to support the transition of multiple application & data projects by establishing functional understanding of existing applications, business processes, and data flows. Domain Understanding: Understand AWM business processes, key entities such as accounts, portfolios, holdings, transactions, and valuations, and their relationships across systems.

Ability to understand existing SQL scripts, transformation logic, and legacy system documentation.
Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and knowledge transfer skills.

Project functional overview and knowledge transfer documents.
Source-to-target data mapping specifications.
Business rules catalogue and data dictionary.
End-to-end data lineage and dependency documentation.
Data validation requirements and transition readiness tracker.

Change Management & Training: Assist in project rollouts by delivering user manuals, change management materials, and end-user training to drive post-implementation adoption.

JOB DESCRIPTION 
We have various roles in Cognizant Consulting Insurance (P&C) ranging from Business Analyst, Consultants, Senior Consultants and Product Owner. Depending upon your experience and expertise, we will triage them accordingly for best fitment.
Consulting & Business Analysis Skills 
Ability to gather, analyze and document business and system requirements.
o Experience in creating requirements artifacts like BRD, FSD, use cases and user stories.
o Experience in leading or complementing team in domain consulting assignments.
o Extensive experience in Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
o Ability to collaborate with business users to assess the complexity and elicit effort estimation.
o Demonstrated Business Analysis skills working on Insurance domain projects.
o Strong experience in stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, requirements traceability, and solution validation.
o Experience in business process analysis, process optimization, and consulting engagements.
o Design thinking and ability to work in fast-paced and ambiguous situations.
o Strong Communication & Presentation Skills with a flair for writing documents and the ability to present to various audiences.
Insurance Domain Knowledge 
Strong experience in Property & Casualty (P&C) Insurance domain.
o Mandatory experience in UK/London Market Insurance .
o Good understanding of Commercial Lines, Specialty Insurance, Underwriting, Policy Administration, Claims Management, and Broking processes.
o Experience working across Personal, Commercial, or Specialty Insurance lines.
o Knowledge of insurance lifecycle including quotations, policy issuance, endorsements, renewals, claims, and settlements.
o Experience working with Insurance organizations (P&C or Life) and business stakeholders.
o Exposure to digital initiatives undertaken by insurers in improving customer experience, customer insights, channel performance, defining digital KPIs, and transforming insurance operations.
o Familiarity with London Market ecosystem, Lloyds market processes, and insurance transformation initiatives is desirable.
o Demonstration of Thought Leadership in a particular area of the insurance domain.
o Ability to contribute and lead creation of domain-led consulting offerings.
Soft Skills 
Ability to work in fast-paced and ambiguous situations.
o Strong Communication & Presentation Skills with a flair for writing documents and the ability to present to various audiences.
o Displays a high level of personal maturity and ability to perform in an unstructured, ambiguous environment.
o Ability to advance and shoulder greater responsibilities.
o Ability and willingness to proactively accept and drive change.
o Ability to lead, motivate, and influence to accomplish objectives.
o Leadership experience in client-facing situations.
o Displayed leadership or initiative in work or personal settings.
o Ability to groom team members for higher responsibilities.
Qualification 
Masters in Business Administration or equivalent.
• Preferable tertiary qualification in IT and Insurance.
• Insurance industry certification such as ACII, CPCU, AINS, The Institutes, CII, etc. will be an added advantage.
• Exposure to InsurTech, Data Science, and Digital Insurance platforms preferred.
• Knowledge of UK Insurance regulations and London Market practices will be an added advantage.
Experience 
9 to 13 years of working experience in Insurance Domain along with IT experience.
• Strong hands-on experience in Property & Casualty Insurance .
• Mandatory exposure to UK/London Market Insurance projects and business processes.
• Experience in business analysis, digital transformation, consulting, or process improvement initiatives.
Key Skills 
Business Analysis
• Requirements Gathering & Documentation
• BRD, FSD, Use Cases & User Stories
• Property & Casualty (P&C) Insurance
• UK/London Market Insurance
• Commercial Lines Insurance
• Specialty Insurance
• Underwriting & Claims Management
• Policy Administration
• Stakeholder Management
• Agile & Waterfall Methodologies
• Process Mapping & Gap Analysis
• Good communication skills (written and verbal) & Facilitating skills
• Good interpersonal skills
• Knowledge & apply a framework to present a solution
• Capability to understand the big picture
• Innovativeness & Thinking Out of the Box
• Success in selling process and displayed service orientation
• Responsibilities held – Team Size, Financials, etc.
• Relevant Skill Acquired applicable to the new role
• IT Literacy, Analytics & Problem Solving

title: Business Analyst
description:
About the Role 
We are looking for a Business Analyst who can understand customer requirements, map business processes, and convert business needs into clear software specifications. You will work with customers, product teams, developers, and testers to deliver practical ERP and AI-powered solutions.
Key Responsibilities 
Conduct customer discussions and requirement-gathering sessions.
Study existing workflows, identify gaps, and propose process improvements.
Prepare Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Requirements Documents (FRD), user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Create process flowcharts, wireframes, and screen specifications.
Analyze ERP processes across sales, purchase, inventory, production, finance, HR, and payroll.
Identify opportunities for AI agents and automation, including required data, actions, and human approvals.
Document third-party integration requirements and coordinate with technical teams.
Support functional testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), product demonstrations, and user documentation.
Required Skills 
Strong business analysis, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate business needs into clear functional requirements.
Understanding of ERP systems and end-to-end business workflows.
Experience preparing user stories, process diagrams, and acceptance criteria.
Good communication and stakeholder coordination skills..
Basic understanding of databases, APIs, and software integrations.
Preferred Experience 
Manufacturing ERP, particularly production planning, BOM, material planning, quality, subcontracting, and job work.
SaaS products, CRM, HRMS, payroll, or finance applications.
AI agents, workflow automation, and AI-enabled business applications.
Working with development and QA teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Job Title: Business Analyst 
Work Location: WFO/Remote 
Experience Level: 6 years 

About the Role 
6+ years in a requirements-facing role 

Role summary 

Turns client requirement sheets into PSK definitions a developer can build from without guessing. The requirement material is incomplete in known and specific ways the data fields behind each PSK and the exact rules for calculated status are largely unstated so the role is as much about closing gaps with the client as recording what is already written. One of the two positions moves onto a parallel workstream finalising requirements for a further 36 PSKs.

Responsibilities 
•Confirm the definition of each in-scope PSK with the nominated client business owner against its requirement sheet.
•Specify, for each PSK: grid columns, calculated fields, additional data areas, chart content, and the rule by which red / yellow / green status is set.
•Identify which data fields already exist in the application data store and which are new, working with the developers against the live schema.
•Run grouped working sessions with client business owners to close open requirement items, organised by functional family rather than one session per PSK.
•Produce a completed requirement definition per PSK in a form that can be estimated and built.
•Track open items daily and flag any that threaten a milestone to the Project Manager.

Essential skills and experience 
•4+ years eliciting and documenting requirements for web applications, with direct client contact.
•Able to write a specification precise enough to code from — stated thresholds, stated comparisons, no ambiguity in a status rule.
•Comfortable reading a relational schema and writing basic SQL to verify what data already exists.
•Experience working with incomplete requirements and driving them to closure, rather than reporting that they are incomplete.
•Confident running a working session with senior client stakeholders in English.

Desirable 
•Automotive product development or programme governance exposure.
•Experience specifying dashboards, scorecards or KPI reporting.
•Familiarity with ExtJS grid and chart behaviour, to specify what the platform can do.

Intrested candidates please share your CV to mjfernandes@v2soft.com

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have):- Experience with BI tools like Power BI, Tableau, or similar.- Knowledge of data visualization best practices.- Understanding of statistical methods and data modeling.

title: Business Analyst - FP&A
description:
# Senior Business Analyst / Lead FP&A 

*Experience:* 5+ years
*Department:* Finance / FP&A
*Employment Type:* Full-time
*Reporting To:* Head of FP&A / Finance Director / CFO

## Role Overview 

We are looking for an experienced *Senior Business Analyst / Lead – FP&A* to drive financial planning, forecasting, management reporting, business performance analysis, and strategic decision support.

The role will partner closely with senior business and finance stakeholders to translate financial and operational data into actionable insights, identify business drivers and risks, and support key strategic and commercial decisions.

## Key Responsibilities 

### FP&A and Financial Planning 

* Lead the annual budgeting, long-range planning, and periodic forecasting processes.
* Develop and maintain robust financial models for revenue, cost, profitability, cash flow, and scenario planning.
* Drive monthly and quarterly forecasting cycles in collaboration with business stakeholders.
* Analyze business performance against budget, forecast, and prior-year results.
* Identify key drivers of financial performance and provide recommendations to management.

### Business Performance & Analytics 

* Lead monthly management reporting and performance reviews.
* Develop dashboards and executive-level presentations covering financial and operational KPIs.
* Provide insights on revenue growth, margins, operating expenses, productivity, and profitability.
* Perform detailed variance analysis and explain key movements to senior management.
* Conduct scenario, sensitivity, and what-if analysis to support strategic decisions.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas for performance improvement.

### Business Partnering 

* Act as a finance business partner to senior stakeholders across functions such as Sales, Operations, Marketing, HR, and Procurement.
* Challenge assumptions and provide commercially relevant financial insights.
* Support business cases, investment decisions, pricing analysis, cost optimization, and strategic initiatives.
* Translate complex financial information into clear recommendations for non-finance stakeholders.

### Reporting & Process Improvement 

* Own and improve recurring management reporting and FP&A processes.
* Drive automation and standardization of financial reporting and analytical processes.
* Leverage tools such as *Advanced Excel, Power BI, SQL, ERP systems, and other analytics platforms* to improve reporting efficiency.
* Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accuracy across financial reports and models.
* Identify opportunities to improve forecasting accuracy and FP&A processes.

### Leadership & Stakeholder Management 

* Lead cross-functional analytical projects and initiatives.
* Mentor junior analysts and support the development of FP&A capabilities within the team.
* Work effectively with senior leadership and present financial insights to management.
* Manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality analysis within tight deadlines.

## Required Qualifications 

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
* *5+ years of relevant experience* in FP&A, financial planning, business analysis, commercial finance, management reporting, or corporate finance.
* Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modelling.
* Proven experience working with senior business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience managing complex datasets and converting analysis into actionable business insights.

## Preferred Qualifications 

* *CA / CMA / CFA / MBA (Finance)* or equivalent qualification.
* Experience with *Power BI, SQL, SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, Hyperion, or other ERP/FP&A tools*.
* Experience in FP&A transformation, reporting automation, or financial planning systems.
* Exposure to strategic planning, M&A, business cases, pricing, or cost optimization.
* Prior experience leading a team or mentoring finance/business analysts.

## Key Competencies 

* Strategic thinking and commercial acumen
* Financial planning and forecasting
* Financial modelling
* Business partnering
* Data-driven decision making
* Management reporting
* Variance and profitability analysis
* Executive communication
* Stakeholder management
* Process improvement and automation
* Leadership and mentoring

## Key Success Measures 

* Accuracy and timeliness of budgets and forecasts
* Quality and relevance of management reporting
* Improved forecasting and planning processes
* Effectiveness of business insights provided to leadership
* Successful delivery of automation and process improvements
* Stakeholder engagement and business partnering effectiveness

title: Business Analyst
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to manage end-to-end operational data, reconciliation, validation, and reporting activities. The role involves analyzing large datasets, identifying discrepancies, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring timely resolution of data-related issues. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, proficiency in MS Excel, and the ability to drive data accuracy and process efficiency.

Role & responsibilities: 

Data Management & Validation: Collect, consolidate, and validate operational data, including financial adjustments, penalties, deductions, and other relevant inputs to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
Reconciliation & Analysis: Perform data reconciliation across multiple sources, identify discrepancies, investigate mismatches, and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for resolution.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with central teams and operations stakeholders to ensure accurate data flow, timely information sharing, and smooth execution of business processes.
Issue Resolution: Analyze data-related issues, identify root causes, and coordinate with relevant teams to minimize operational impact.
Reporting & MIS: Prepare and maintain MIS reports, reconciliation trackers, dashboards, and exception reports to monitor data accuracy, pending issues, and process performance.
Case Management & Follow-up: Maintain a tracker of critical discrepancies and unresolved cases, ensuring consistent follow-up until closure within defined timelines.
Stakeholder Coordination: Share finalized data and relevant case details with concerned teams, including recovery and field support teams, for further action.
Process Improvement: Identify recurring errors, process gaps, and inefficiencies, and recommend improvements to enhance data quality, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency.
Documentation & Compliance: Maintain accurate records, supporting documents, and audit trails for reconciliations, adjustments, and issue resolutions.

Preferred candidate profile 

Strong proficiency in MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, data cleaning, and reconciliation.
Experience in handling large datasets and preparing structured reports.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong attention to detail, ownership, and ability to manage multiple priorities within deadlines.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial/accounting systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday, or similar ERP tools).

title: Healthcare AI Data Scientist (Chart Processing)
description:
About the role 
We are looking for a Python developer or data scientist who enjoys working with AI and wants to build a career in US healthcare. You will take over and improve our medical chart processing system. It reads patient charts (PDFs), extracts the text, and uses LLMs to find diagnoses and their ICD-10 codes for coders to review. 
You do not need deep healthcare experience; we will teach you the coding rules. You do need solid Python and real curiosity about AI.

Key responsibilities 
Maintain and improve the Python code that processes medical charts: PDF text extraction and OCR, splitting charts by visit, and extracting diagnoses. 
Write, test, and improve LLM prompts (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude) that return structured JSON. 
Measure accuracy against coder-reviewed samples and fix the errors you find. 
Validate extracted codes against ICD-10 and other standard code sets. 
Store and query data in MongoDB; write data checks and simple reports. 
Deploy and debug on Azure (Functions, Blob Storage, queues) using Docker and Git. 
Document the system and work closely with coders and engineers in a small team. 

Must-have skills 
Good Python: pandas, files and JSON, writing and debugging scripts, Git. 
Basic ML / NLP and GenAI knowledge: you have called an LLM API or built an NLP or ML project. College projects count. 
Basic database skills: SQL or MongoDB. 
Basic healthcare awareness: what ICD-10 codes are and comfort with medical terms, or a clear willingness to learn them fast. 
Good written English.

Nice to have 
Exposure to US healthcare data: ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, claims, or HL7/FHIR. 
RAG, embeddings, LangChain, or similar frameworks. 
OCR and PDF tools (Tesseract, PyMuPDF). 
Cloud (Azure preferred), Docker, FastAPI. 
Medical coding coursework or certification (CPC). 
Some overlap with US time zones.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Job Description 
As a Data Scientist, he will be responsible for translating management and business requirements into advanced analytics solutions. He will play a crucial role in the development of data pipelines, business intelligence tools, and the delivery of meaningful insights through trend analysis and business analytics.

Key Responsibilities : 
Data Analysis and Modeling: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand management and business requirements.
Develop and implement statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and other advanced analytics techniques to derive actionable insights.

Data Pipeline Development: Design and build efficient data pipelines to support the collection, processing, and analysis of large datasets.
Ensure the availability, reliability, and scalability of data pipelines to meet business needs.

Business Intelligence (BI) Tool Development: Work closely with IT teams to develop and maintain BI tools that provide intuitive access to data for business users.
Create dashboards and reports that visualize key performance indicators and support data-driven decision-making.

Trend Analysis and Reporting: Conduct trend analysis to identify patterns, correlations, and anomalies in large datasets.
Generate and present regular reports on business analytics, highlighting key insights and recommendations.
Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their analytical needs and translate them into actionable plans.
Communicate complex analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

Key skilled required :-
Proven experience as a Data Scientist with a focus on business analytics and trend analysis.
Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or R.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Zoho Analytics, Tableau, Power BI).
Knowledge of statistical modeling, machine learning, and data mining techniques.
Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Primary Responsibilities: 
Lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable AI/ML solutions, leveraging Python, SQL, pandas, numpy, and modern ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, ScikitLearn).
Lead the predictive maintenance practice for critical medical imaging equipment (MRI and CT Scanners).
Experience with streaming data, IOT architectures and tools, Edge devices and Systems integration
Oversee endtoend ML workflowsfrom data preparation, feature engineering, EDA, and model development to evaluation, deployment, and continuous monitoring.
Guide model selection, optimization, and tuning, ensuring solutions balance performance, explainability, cost, and Responsible AI principles.
Build and maintain productiongrade ML pipelines with orchestration and experimenttracking tools such as MLflow, Feature Stores, ONNX, and vector databases.
Lead drift analysis, observability, and model health monitoring to ensure ongoing accuracy, reliability, and robustness in production environments.
Design and support scalable, multicloud ML infrastructure (Azure/GCP primary, AWS optional), incorporating best practices for compute, storage, networking, and distributed data processing.
Collaborate with data engineering teams to integrate realtime and batch pipelines built on Synapse/BigQuery, Dataflow/Databricks, and Kafka/EventHub/PubSub.
Work closely with engineering, product, data science, and UX to translate business requirements into actionable technical solutions and architecture patterns.
Review and guide the creation of architecture diagrams, C4 models, ADRs, and technical specifications as part of engineering governance.
Mentor and coach data scientists and ML engineers on best practices in model development, experimentation, coding standards, optimization, and cloudnative ML deployment.
Ensure ML systems meet high standards of scalability, security, reliability, automation, observability, and operational excellence.
Collaborate with frontend teams where needed to ensure ML components integrate seamlessly with product workflows and user-facing experiences.
Stay current with emerging AI/ML tools, frameworks, and research; evaluate applicability to current and future projects.
Communicate technical concepts, design trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders, including leadership.
Document methodologies, experiments, findings, and implementation details to ensure maintainability and knowledge sharing across teams.
Comply with company policies, employment terms, and organizational directives related to work arrangements and project assignments.

Required Qualifications: 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field
5-7 years of experience in Data Science, AI/ML, or a similar role, with 2+ years in leadership roles
Experience with the full life cycle of AI/ML projects, including EDA, model development, tuning, and drift analysis
Experience in Predictive Maintenance (using AI), IOT (Internet of Things), Sensors, Smart Manufacturing, Uptime of MRI and CT Scan machines, PHM (Prognostics and Health management), Digital Twins
Experience with Time series models including foundational models, Signal processing, Anomaly detection, Remaining Useful life (RUL) of equipment
Hands-on experience in delivering production-grade AI/ML projects
Solid programming skills in Python, with experience in pandas, numpy, and SQL
Proficiency in frameworks such as Scikit Learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch
Solid understanding ofmathematical and statistical concepts
Knowledge of Big Data technologies (PySpark, Hadoop) and data streaming tools (Kafka, etc.) is a plus.
Proven excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
Solid communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in a team environment
Preferred Qualification: 
Familiarity with IOT and medical equipment predictive maintenance

title: Fraud Data Scientist
description:
Job Requirements:
Data Scientist / Senior Data Scientist - Fraud Risk
Experience Range - 2 to 8 Years
Location - Bangalore / Hyderabad / Gurgaon (Hybrid)

Role Overview
We are looking for a Data Scientist with 2 to 8 years of experience to own end-to-end Machine Learning model development for payment fraud prevention. You will design, build, and deploy high-throughput fraud decisioning models and feature pipelines across card transactions, merchant activity, and account takeover scenarios.

Key Responsibilities
- ML Development: Build payment fraud models using XGBoost, LightGBM, and Isolation Forests.
- Feature Pipelines: Build velocity, temporal, and device features using Python and SQL.
- Decision Strategy: Optimize precision-recall trade-offs to balance fraud loss and friction.
- Model Lifecycle: Track production performance (PSI, drift) and manage retraining pipelines.
- Cross-Functional: Translate emerging threat vectors into actionable rules and model signals.
Technical Requirements
- Experience: 2 to 8 years of hands-on data science experience.

Core Tech Stack: 
- FRAUD Domain Knowledge: Understanding of FRAUD banking/payments, credit/debit card fraud patterns, transaction monitoring, account takeover (ATO), and velocity-based risk scoring etc. 
- Python: Strong proficiency with pandas, numpy, scikit-learn.
- SQL: Good Hands on capabilities (complex joins, window functions, query optimization on large datasets).
- Machine Learning: Hands-on experience in building ML models. 

About Company: Straive: 
Straive is a market leading Content and Data Technology company providing data services, subject matter expertise, & technology solutions to multiple domains.
Data Analytics & Al Solutions, Data Al Powered Operations and Education & Learning form the core pillars of the company's long-term vision. The company is a specialized solutions provider to business information providers in finance, insurance, legal, real estate, life sciences and logistics. Straive continues to be the leading content services provider to research and education publishers.

Data Analytics & Al Services : Our Data Solutions business has become critical to our client's success. We use technology and Al with human experts-in loop to create data assets that our clients use to power their data products and their end customers' workflows. As our clients expect us to become their future-fit Analytics and Al partner, they look to us for help in building data analytics and Al enterprise capabilities for them.

With a client-base scoping 30 countries worldwide, Straive's multi-geographical resource pool is strategically located in eight countries - India, Philippines, USA, Nicaragua, Vietnam, United Kingdom, and the company headquarters in Singapore.

Website: https://www.straive.com/ Linkedin

title: Data Scientist
description:
Job Summary 
Drive strategic business value by leading the end-to-end development and deployment of Machine Learning solutions. The primary focus is to build robust, data-driven decisioning systems that help clients optimize revenue, maximize asset returns, and automate complex lifecycle strategies.
Roles and Responsibilities 
End-to-End Modeling: Build, train, and deploy machine learning models, including survival and hazard-based models, to estimate sale probabilities and recommend item-level pricing and disposition actions.
Data & Feature Engineering: Assess data readiness, perform feature engineering, and develop meaningful features using demand signals, seasonality, costs, historical trends, and other relevant business variables. Design effective approaches to address data gaps and quality issues.
Model Validation & MLOps: Test models in shadow mode, evaluate real-world performance against established benchmarks, and collaborate with Data Engineering teams to develop scalable MLOps pipelines, including feature stores, CI/CD, model monitoring, and deployment.
Business & Client Partnership: Work closely with clients and business stakeholders to understand complex business requirements and translate business rules into scalable machine learning solutions and modeling roadmaps.
Leadership & Delivery: Act as a technical point of contact for client engagements, drive agile delivery, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and mentor a small team of Data Scientists.
Required Skills 
Python, SQL, PySpark, Machine Learning, Survival Analysis, Hazard Modeling, MLOps, Snowflake, dbt, Tableau, and Team Leadership.
Strong understanding of statistical modeling, feature engineering, model validation, experimentation, and production ML deployment.
Experience with Pricing, Inventory, Revenue Optimization, or Lifecycle Management is preferred.
Knowledge of constrained optimization, decisioning systems, cloud-native ML tooling, model monitoring, feature stores, and CI/CD is an added advantage.

title: Urgent Requirement: Data Scientist
description:
Role & responsibilities 

Role Overview 
We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Senior Data Scientist to lead our applied AI and analytics initiatives. This role is designed for a strategic thinker who excels at bridging the gap between complex business challenges and advanced technical execution. You will be responsible for client management, team leadership, and the end-to-end development of AI-driven architectures that deliver measurable operational and financial impact.
Key Responsibilities 
Business-to-Analytics Translation 
Act as the critical link between business stakeholders and the technical team, translating ambiguous business problems into structured analytics frameworks.
Define clear objectives, data requirements, mathematical methodologies, and success metrics for every AI initiative.
Design scalable architectures that align with overarching business goals, ensuring solutions are robust and adaptable to various operational constraints.
Consulting & Client Management 
Serve as the primary technical advisor and consultant for key enterprise customers, managing expectations and fostering long-term strategic relationships.
Lead discovery workshops and requirement-gathering sessions to understand customer pain points deeply.
Communicate complex statistical concepts and AI outcomes clearly to non-technical business stakeholders and executive leadership.
Hands-On AI Development & Execution 
Maintain a hands-on approach to designing, writing, and deploying advanced machine learning models and AI solutions.
Apply advanced modeling techniques for predictive analytics, forecasting, and optimization, relying on generalized, robust methodologies rather than rigid, single-algorithm approaches.
Oversee data pipelines, model validation frameworks, and the seamless transition of prototypes into production environments.
Team Leadership & Mentorship 
Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of data scientists and data engineers.
Establish best practices for code reviews, model governance, agile analytics delivery, and cross-functional collaboration.
Cultivate a culture of continuous learning, ensuring the team stays current with emerging AI trends and modern data architectures.
Qualifications & Competencies 
Experience Requirements: 
10 to 14 years of professional experience in data science, advanced analytics, or AI engineering.
Proven track record of directly managing technical teams and guiding them through complex project lifecycles.
Extensive background in client-facing, B2B, or internal consulting roles.
Technical Proficiency: 
Programming & Data: Advanced, hands-on proficiency in Python, SQL, and enterprise data processing.
AI/ML Expertise: Deep, applied understanding of machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI frameworks applied to real-world business optimization.
Deployment: Solid experience with cloud infrastructure and MLOps practices for deploying, monitoring, and maintaining scalable models.
Core Soft Skills: 
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, capable of distilling complex technical findings into compelling, single-slide executive narratives.
Strong consultative mindset with the ability to influence decision-making and steer client strategy.
High degree of adaptability, critical thinking, and problem-solving acumen when dealing with lumpy, intermittent, or missing data.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Key Responsibilities: 
Agent Development & Architecture:
Build agentic workflows using LangChain/LangGraph and similar frameworks.
Develop autonomous agents for data validation, reporting, document processing, and domain workflows.
Deploy scalable, resilient agent pipelines with monitoring and evaluation.
GenAI Application Engineering:
Develop GenAI applications using models like GPT, Gemini, and LLaMA.
Implement RAG, vector search, prompt orchestration, and model evaluation.
Partner with data scientists to productionize POCs.
Data & Platform Engineering:
Build distributed data pipelines (Python, PySpark).
Develop APIs, SDKs, and integration layers for AI-powered applications.
Optimize systems for performance and scalability across cloud/hybrid environments.
MLOps / LLMOps:
Contribute to CI/CD workflows for AI modelsdeployment, testing, monitoring.
Implement of governance, guardrails, and reusable GenAI frameworks.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement:
Work with analytics, product, and engineering teams to define and deliver AI solutions.
Participate in architecture reviews and iterative development cycles.
Support knowledge sharing and internal GenAI capability building.

Key Skills & Requirements: 
5-8 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, data science, or software engineering, with at least 4 years focused on GenAI.
Strong programming expertise in Python, distributed computing using PySpark, and API development.
Hands on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Transformers, OpenAI/Vertex/Bedrock SDKs).
Experience developing AI agents, retrieval pipelines, tool calling structures, or autonomous task orchestration.
Solid understanding of GenAI concepts: prompting, embeddings, RAG, evaluation metrics, hallucination identification, model selection, fine tuning, context engineering.
Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), containerization (Docker), and CI/CD pipelines for ML/AI.
Strong problem solving, system design thinking, and ability to translate business needs into scalable AI solutions.
Excellent verbal, written communication, and presentation skills.

Good to Have: 
Experience in workflow automation and building reusable AI components.
Background in analytics, statistical models, or enterprise data products.
Experience with MLOps / LLMOps tooling

title: Data Scientist
description:
Job Description & Summary:
Data Scientist
Level: Senior Associate
Location: Noida,Bangalore
Skill: • Python, GenAI ,Machine learning, data science,statistics
Job Position Title: Data Scientist
Responsibilities: 
• Develop and implement advanced statistical models and machine learning algorithms including time series forecasting, Bayesian modeling, and neural networks to solve complex business problems and drive data-driven
decision making.
Design, build, and deploy scalable machine learning models on cloud
platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) using MLOps practices including
Dockerization, CI/CD pipelines, and REST APIs to ensure efficient model lifecycle management.
Process, cleanse, and validate large volumes of structured and
unstructured data using programming languages such as Python, R, and SQL, ensuring data integrity and quality for analytical purposes.
Architect and maintain robust data pipelines and processing workflows on big data platforms including Hadoop and Elasticsearch, enabling seamless data flow for machine learning operations.
Customize and deploy foundation models and Large Language Models (LLMs) for specific business use cases, implementing prompt engineering techniques and managing LLM orchestration frameworks.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate complex business requirements into actionable data science solutions, effectively communicating technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Leverage deep learning frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Keras to build sophisticated neural network models that address advanced analytical challenges and predictive modeling requirements.
Maintain version control systems and collaborative development
environments to ensure codebase integrity, facilitate team collaboration, and implement best practices for reproducible data science workflows.
Mandatory skill sets: • • Proficient in programming languages like R, Python, and database query languages like SQL,Databricks is desirable. Familiarity with Scala, Java, or C++ is an added advantage.
• Proficient in Statistical modelling and Machine techniques such as time series forecasting, Reliability models, Markov Models, Stochastic models, Bayesian Modelling, Classification Models, Cluster Analysis, Neural Network, etc.
• Good exposure to deep learning and associated frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Keras). 
•Ability to perform preprocessing of structured and unstructured data:
Processing, cleansing, and validating the integrity of data to be used for
analysis. 
• Strong working experience with cloud platforms: build, train, and
deploy ML Models on Azure/AWS/GCP. 
• Good working knowledge in distributed computing environments / big data platforms (Hadoop, Elasticsearch, etc.) as well as common database systems and value stores(SQL, Hive, HBase, etc.). 
• Hand-on experience in the MLOps (Dockerization, REST APIs and the CI/CD/CT processes).

title: Data Analyst
description:
We are hiring a Data Analyst on behalf of our client. This role involves collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to uncover insights that drive smarter business decisions. Its a great opportunity for someone curious about numbers who enjoys turning raw data into clear stories and actionable recommendations.

Role & responsibilities 
Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources
Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and business insights
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract and analyze data
Build and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools
Create charts and visualizations to present findings clearly to stakeholders
Track key business metrics (KPIs) and share regular performance reports
Support business teams by answering data-related questions and ad-hoc requests
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and quality across reports
Collaborate with product, marketing, finance, and operations teams
Document data processes, definitions, and reporting standards

Preferred candidate profile 
Bachelors/Masters degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or related field
0 to 2 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or related role (internships count)
Strong knowledge of SQL for querying and analyzing data
Proficiency in MS Excel (formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP)
Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or Looker)
Basic knowledge of Python or R for data analysis
Good understanding of statistics and data interpretation
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Good communication skills, able to explain insights to non-technical teams
