title: Data Analyst
description:
Position summary
Renaissance Academy of Wisdom Private Limited is seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and technically proficient Data Analyst SE to support data-driven decision-making across its education technology platforms, digital learning operations, recruitment systems, and business functions.
The role involves collecting, cleaning, validating, analysing, and interpreting data from multiple sources to produce accurate reports, interactive dashboards, performance metrics, and actionable business insights.
The successful candidate will work with management, technology, academic and training operations, recruitment, and other relevant teams to translate business requirements into measurable analytical outcomes. The candidate will also contribute to reporting automation, data quality improvement, performance monitoring, and the development of reliable business intelligence processes.
Position details
Job title
Data Analyst SE
Organisation
Renaissance Academy of Wisdom Private Limited
Department
Data Analytics, Business Intelligence and Operations
Reporting to
Analytics Manager, Business Operations Manager, or designated reporting manager
Employment type
Full-time, subject to approved employment terms
Location
As specified in the approved vacancy
Experience
Suggested range: 14 years, adjustable to the role's intended seniority
Education
Bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant discipline
Technical focus
SQL, Excel, Python, Power BI/Tableau, data quality and reporting
The title suffix “SE” is retained as provided. Its internal expansion, experience band, location, reporting line, and compensation should follow the company's approved HR structure.
3. Roles and responsibilities
A. Data collection and integration
The candidate will be responsible for collecting and consolidating data from relevant internal systems and authorised external sources.
Responsibilities include:
Extracting information from databases, spreadsheets, learning management systems, recruitment platforms, assessment systems, and business applications.
Understanding database structures, table relationships, fields, identifiers, and reporting requirements.
Writing SQL queries to retrieve, filter, join, and aggregate information.
Combining datasets from different systems while maintaining consistent identifiers and business definitions.
Preparing analytical datasets for management reporting, operational analysis, and dashboard development.
Documenting data sources, extraction logic, assumptions, and transformation steps.
Coordinating with technical teams when data is unavailable, incomplete, inconsistent, or incorrectly structured.
B. Data cleaning, validation, and quality assurance
Data accuracy is essential because management decisions and operational reports depend on reliable information.
The candidate will:
Identify missing values, duplicate records, inconsistent formats, and invalid entries.
Standardise dates, categories, identifiers, names, and other fields as appropriate.
Validate records against defined business rules and reference datasets.
Reconcile data between source systems and final reports.
Investigate differences in totals, record counts, status fields, and calculated metrics.
Develop repeatable validation checks for recurring reports.
Maintain records of identified issues, corrective actions, and outstanding discrepancies.
Escalate source-system problems to the appropriate technical or operational team.
C. SQL and database analysis
The candidate should be comfortable working with relational databases and writing queries for business analysis.
Key responsibilities include:
Writing SQL queries using SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, HAVING, and aggregate functions.
Using subqueries and common table expressions where appropriate.
Analysing relationships across multiple tables.
Creating summaries, breakdowns, and time-based comparisons.
Investigating unusual results and identifying potential causes.
Validating analytical calculations against source records.
Improving query readability and efficiency.
Supporting recurring extracts and reporting datasets.
Maintaining appropriate access controls and following database security procedures.
D. Dashboard and business intelligence development
The Data Analyst SE will help convert raw information into understandable reports and interactive dashboards.
Responsibilities include:
Developing dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
Creating KPI cards, trend charts, comparison views, filters, and drill-down reports.
Defining clear metric calculations and maintaining consistent reporting standards.
Designing dashboards for management, training, recruitment, technology, and operational users.
Creating reports that highlight exceptions, performance gaps, and changes over time.
Testing dashboards for calculation accuracy, usability, and data consistency.
Updating reports as business requirements change.
Documenting dashboard logic, refresh schedules, and data dependencies.
E. Python-based data analysis and automation
Python can be used to improve analytical efficiency and handle repetitive or complex data-processing tasks.
The candidate may be expected to:
Use Python for data extraction, cleaning, transformation, and exploratory analysis.
Work with Pandas and NumPy for tabular data manipulation and numerical calculations.
Use Matplotlib or other suitable libraries for analytical visualisation.
Automate recurring data preparation and reporting tasks.
Develop scripts to validate datasets and identify anomalies.
Compare outputs from automated processes against known results.
Document scripts, assumptions, and dependencies.
Collaborate with developers to integrate approved analytical workflows into existing systems.
Advanced machine learning is not necessarily a core requirement for this position unless specified by the project.
F. Education and learning analytics
Given the organisation's education and professional learning focus, the candidate may analyse learner and course performance data.
Responsibilities include:
Measuring course enrolments, active learners, completion rates, and assessment outcomes.
Analysing learner engagement and identifying patterns associated with course discontinuation.
Monitoring performance across courses, cohorts, programmes, and training periods.
Evaluating assessment participation, completion, scores, and pass rates.
Identifying bottlenecks in learning journeys and course delivery.
Preparing reports to help academic and training teams improve learning experiences.
Supporting comparisons between course offerings and learning outcomes.
Developing dashboards that allow authorised teams to monitor educational KPIs.
Any learner-level analysis should follow applicable privacy requirements and the organisation's data access policies.
G. Recruitment and HR analytics
Where recruitment or HR systems are within the assigned scope, the candidate may analyse operational and recruitment data.
Responsibilities include:
Monitoring candidate registrations, applications, screening stages, interviews, and hiring outcomes.
Measuring recruitment funnel conversion rates and time spent at each stage.
Analysing interview scheduling, completion, and assessment status.
Identifying delays and recurring bottlenecks in recruitment workflows.
Preparing reports on hiring activity, candidate progress, and operational performance.
Supporting HR reporting on attendance, leave, and other authorised workforce metrics where relevant.
Reconciling information across recruitment and HR systems.
Presenting trends that can support process improvements.
H. Business and operational analytics
The role may also support wider organisational reporting.
Responsibilities include:
Preparing recurring business performance reports.
Tracking operational KPIs and comparing actual results against targets.
Analysing platform adoption, user activity, and workflow completion.
Supporting management with trend analysis and business performance summaries.
Identifying manual reporting activities that could be automated.
Evaluating process changes using before-and-after performance comparisons.
Investigating unexpected movements in business metrics.
Producing evidence-based recommendations for operational improvements.
I. Requirements gathering and stakeholder management
Meet with relevant teams to understand their analytical needs.
Convert business questions into data requirements, calculations, and deliverables.
Confirm KPI definitions and reporting expectations before development begins.
Explain findings in clear language to non-technical stakeholders.
Present assumptions, limitations, and relevant caveats alongside results.
Manage feedback and implement approved changes to reports.
Maintain documentation of requirements, deliverables, and revisions.
Communicate risks and dependencies that may affect reporting timelines.
J. Data governance, privacy, and security
Use authorised data sources and approved access methods.
Protect confidential business, employee, candidate, and learner information.
Follow the organisation's applicable data retention, privacy, and security policies.
Limit access to sensitive data to authorised purposes.
Avoid exposing personal information in unnecessary reports or dashboard views.
Maintain appropriate audit trails and analytical documentation.
Escalate suspected data quality or security issues through approved channels.
4. Technical skills and proficiency expectations
Technical area
Expected capability
SQL
Joins, aggregations, subqueries, CTEs, data validation
Microsoft Excel
PivotTables, lookup functions, conditional formulas, reconciliation
Power BI / Tableau
Interactive dashboards, KPI reporting, filters, visualisation
Python
Pandas, NumPy, data manipulation and automation
Statistics
Descriptive statistics, distributions, trend analysis, correlation basics
Database concepts
Relational models, keys, schemas, table relationships
Data quality
Deduplication, validation, reconciliation, anomaly identification
Reporting
Metric definitions, documentation, recurring report preparation
Communication
Business presentations, analytical summaries, stakeholder collaboration
Automation
Reusable scripts and repeatable reporting workflows
Core requirements: SQL, Excel, analytical reasoning, data quality, and reporting.
Additional advantages: Python automation, advanced Power BI, cloud data platforms, API-based data extraction, and experience with education or recruitment analytics.
5. Educational qualifications
Suitable qualifications may include:
B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
BCA or MCA.
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, or Analytics.
BBA or MBA with a strong analytical, quantitative, or business intelligence background.
Other relevant qualifications supported by demonstrated technical proficiency.
Candidates should have a sound understanding of data interpretation, quantitative reasoning, structured problem-solving, and analytical reporting.
Relevant internships, practical projects, certifications, or professional experience may strengthen a candidate's profile.
6. Experience requirements
For candidates with 1–2 years of experience
Candidates should be able to:
Write SQL queries for common analytical requirements.
Clean and validate data using Excel or Python.
Prepare recurring reports and basic dashboards.
Understand KPI definitions and data relationships.
Identify discrepancies and explain their findings.
Work with guidance from senior team members.
For candidates with 3–4 years of experience
Candidates should additionally demonstrate the ability to:
Independently manage analytical assignments.
Design complex SQL queries and reusable reporting processes.
Build and maintain dashboards for multiple stakeholders.
Automate recurring reporting tasks.
Investigate data inconsistencies and conduct root-cause analysis.
Translate business requirements into measurable analytical solutions.
Review data quality and reporting logic before delivery.
Recommend process improvements based on analytical findings.
These experience bands are proposed guidelines and should be adjusted to the actual seniority intended by “SE.”
7. Key performance indicators
Performance should be assessed against measurable and role-appropriate objectives.
KPI
What it measures
Report accuracy
Reliability of analytical outputs and calculations
On-time delivery
Completion of assigned reports within agreed deadlines
Data quality
Detection and resolution of data inconsistencies
Dashboard reliability
Consistency and usability of dashboards
Automation efficiency
Reduction in avoidable manual reporting effort
Issue resolution
Effectiveness in investigating discrepancies
Stakeholder satisfaction
Usefulness and clarity of reports and analysis
Documentation quality
Completeness of query, metric, and process documentation
Process improvement
Measurable improvements resulting from analytical work
Targets should be agreed with the reporting manager based on the assigned responsibilities and available data.
8. Illustrative work scenarios
Scenario 1 — Learning platform analytics
Business question: Why are some courses experiencing low completion rates?
Expected approach: Extract enrolment and progress data, validate completion records, compare course and cohort performance, identify where learners stop progressing, and prepare a dashboard for the learning team.
Expected output: A validated completion report, engagement dashboard, and evidence-based observations for further investigation.
Scenario 2 — Recruitment workflow analytics
Business question: Which recruitment stages are creating delays?
Expected approach: Analyse candidate stage histories, interview dates, status changes, and turnaround times. Validate that completed and active records are classified correctly.
Expected output: A recruitment funnel dashboard showing stage-wise conversion, elapsed time, and areas requiring operational review.
Scenario 3 — Reporting automation
Business question: How can repetitive management reports be produced more efficiently?
Expected approach: Document the existing workflow, identify repeatable calculations, develop a suitable SQL or Python process, and validate automated results against the current report.
Expected output: A documented, repeatable reporting process with appropriate validation and reduced manual effort.
These are illustrative examples of work aligned with the organisation's business context, not statements that every system or project will form part of the role.
9. Soft skills and professional competencies
The ideal candidate should demonstrate:
Strong analytical and logical reasoning.
Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Structured problem-solving and investigative thinking.
Clear written and verbal communication.
Ability to explain technical results in business terms.
Effective time management and task prioritisation.
Accountability for deliverables and reporting quality.
Collaboration across technical and non-technical teams.
Adaptability to changing business requirements.
Professional conduct and respect for confidentiality.
10. Suggested selection process
The following is a recommended recruitment framework for this role.
Resume screening
Review educational qualifications, relevant experience, SQL, Excel, dashboard development, and analytical projects.
Technical assessment
Test SQL queries, data cleaning, Excel formulas, data interpretation, and basic statistics.
Practical analytics exercise
Ask candidates to analyse a sample dataset and prepare a concise report or dashboard.
Technical interview
Assess analytical reasoning, query logic, validation methods, Python skills, and problem-solving.
Managerial or business round
Evaluate communication, stakeholder handling, prioritisation, and understanding of business metrics.
HR discussion
Confirm role expectations, availability, compensation, location, and applicable employment checks.
11. Career development opportunities
Subject to performance, business needs, and available opportunities, this role can provide experience relevant to future positions such as:
Senior Data Analyst
Business Intelligence Analyst
Power BI Developer
Business Analyst
Analytics Consultant
Data Analytics Lead
Data Engineer, with additional engineering expertise
The role can also develop expertise in learning analytics, SaaS product analytics, recruitment analytics, and operational intelligence.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Position summary 
Doosri gaadi service private limited is seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and technically proficient Data Analyst SE to support data-driven decision-making across its education technology platforms, digital learning operations, recruitment systems, and business functions. 
The role involves collecting, cleaning, validating, analysing, and interpreting data from multiple sources to produce accurate reports, interactive dashboards, performance metrics, and actionable business insights. 
The successful candidate will work with management, technology, academic and training operations, recruitment, and other relevant teams to translate business requirements into measurable analytical outcomes. The candidate will also contribute to reporting automation, data quality improvement, performance monitoring, and the development of reliable business intelligence processes. 
Position details 
Job title 
Data Analyst SE 
Organisation 
Doosri gaadi service private limited 
Department 
Data Analytics, Business Intelligence and Operations 
Reporting to 
Analytics Manager, Business Operations Manager, or designated reporting manager 
Employment type 
Full-time, subject to approved employment terms 
Location 
As specified in the approved vacancy 
Experience 
Suggested range: 14 years, adjustable to the role's intended seniority 
Education 
Bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant discipline 
Technical focus 
SQL, Excel, Python, Power BI/Tableau, data quality and reporting 
The title suffix SE is retained as provided. Its internal expansion, experience band, location, reporting line, and compensation should follow the company's approved HR structure. 
3. Roles and responsibilities 
A. Data collection and integration 
The candidate will be responsible for collecting and consolidating data from relevant internal systems and authorised external sources. 
Responsibilities include: 
Extracting information from databases, spreadsheets, learning management systems, recruitment platforms, assessment systems, and business applications. 
Understanding database structures, table relationships, fields, identifiers, and reporting requirements. 
Writing SQL queries to retrieve, filter, join, and aggregate information. 
Combining datasets from different systems while maintaining consistent identifiers and business definitions. 
Preparing analytical datasets for management reporting, operational analysis, and dashboard development. 
Documenting data sources, extraction logic, assumptions, and transformation steps. 
Coordinating with technical teams when data is unavailable, incomplete, inconsistent, or incorrectly structured. 
B. Data cleaning, validation, and quality assurance 
Data accuracy is essential because management decisions and operational reports depend on reliable information. 
The candidate will: 
Identify missing values, duplicate records, inconsistent formats, and invalid entries. 
Standardise dates, categories, identifiers, names, and other fields as appropriate. 
Validate records against defined business rules and reference datasets. 
Reconcile data between source systems and final reports. 
Investigate differences in totals, record counts, status fields, and calculated metrics. 
Develop repeatable validation checks for recurring reports. 
Maintain records of identified issues, corrective actions, and outstanding discrepancies. 
Escalate source-system problems to the appropriate technical or operational team. 
C. SQL and database analysis 
The candidate should be comfortable working with relational databases and writing queries for business analysis. 
Key responsibilities include: 
Writing SQL queries using SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, HAVING, and aggregate functions. 
Using subqueries and common table expressions where appropriate. 
Analysing relationships across multiple tables. 
Creating summaries, breakdowns, and time-based comparisons. 
Investigating unusual results and identifying potential causes. 
Validating analytical calculations against source records. 
Improving query readability and efficiency. 
Supporting recurring extracts and reporting datasets. 
Maintaining appropriate access controls and following database security procedures. 
D. Dashboard and business intelligence development 
The Data Analyst SE will help convert raw information into understandable reports and interactive dashboards. 
Responsibilities include: 
Developing dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. 
Creating KPI cards, trend charts, comparison views, filters, and drill-down reports. 
Defining clear metric calculations and maintaining consistent reporting standards. 
Designing dashboards for management, training, recruitment, technology, and operational users. 
Creating reports that highlight exceptions, performance gaps, and changes over time. 
Testing dashboards for calculation accuracy, usability, and data consistency. 
Updating reports as business requirements change. 
Documenting dashboard logic, refresh schedules, and data dependencies. 
E. Python-based data analysis and automation 
Python can be used to improve analytical efficiency and handle repetitive or complex data-processing tasks. 
The candidate may be expected to: 
Use Python for data extraction, cleaning, transformation, and exploratory analysis. 
Work with Pandas and NumPy for tabular data manipulation and numerical calculations. 
Use Matplotlib or other suitable libraries for analytical visualisation. 
Automate recurring data preparation and reporting tasks. 
Develop scripts to validate datasets and identify anomalies. 
Compare outputs from automated processes against known results. 
Document scripts, assumptions, and dependencies. 
Collaborate with developers to integrate approved analytical workflows into existing systems. 
Advanced machine learning is not necessarily a core requirement for this position unless specified by the project. 
F. Education and learning analytics 
Given the organisation's education and professional learning focus, the candidate may analyse learner and course performance data. 
Responsibilities include: 
Measuring course enrolments, active learners, completion rates, and assessment outcomes. 
Analysing learner engagement and identifying patterns associated with course discontinuation. 
Monitoring performance across courses, cohorts, programmes, and training periods. 
Evaluating assessment participation, completion, scores, and pass rates. 
Identifying bottlenecks in learning journeys and course delivery. 
Preparing reports to help academic and training teams improve learning experiences. 
Supporting comparisons between course offerings and learning outcomes. 
Developing dashboards that allow authorised teams to monitor educational KPIs. 
Any learner-level analysis should follow applicable privacy requirements and the organisation's data access policies. 
G. Recruitment and HR analytics 
Where recruitment or HR systems are within the assigned scope, the candidate may analyse operational and recruitment data. 
Responsibilities include: 
Monitoring candidate registrations, applications, screening stages, interviews, and hiring outcomes. 
Measuring recruitment funnel conversion rates and time spent at each stage. 
Analysing interview scheduling, completion, and assessment status. 
Identifying delays and recurring bottlenecks in recruitment workflows. 
Preparing reports on hiring activity, candidate progress, and operational performance. 
Supporting HR reporting on attendance, leave, and other authorised workforce metrics where relevant. 
Reconciling information across recruitment and HR systems. 
Presenting trends that can support process improvements. 
H. Business and operational analytics 
The role may also support wider organisational reporting. 
Responsibilities include: 
Preparing recurring business performance reports. 
Tracking operational KPIs and comparing actual results against targets. 
Analysing platform adoption, user activity, and workflow completion. 
Supporting management with trend analysis and business performance summaries. 
Identifying manual reporting activities that could be automated. 
Evaluating process changes using before-and-after performance comparisons. 
Investigating unexpected movements in business metrics. 
Producing evidence-based recommendations for operational improvements. 
I. Requirements gathering and stakeholder management 
Meet with relevant teams to understand their analytical needs. 
Convert business questions into data requirements, calculations, and deliverables. 
Confirm KPI definitions and reporting expectations before development begins. 
Explain findings in clear language to non-technical stakeholders. 
Present assumptions, limitations, and relevant caveats alongside results. 
Manage feedback and implement approved changes to reports. 
Maintain documentation of requirements, deliverables, and revisions. 
Communicate risks and dependencies that may affect reporting timelines. 
J. Data governance, privacy, and security 
Use authorised data sources and approved access methods. 
Protect confidential business, employee, candidate, and learner information. 
Follow the organisation's applicable data retention, privacy, and security policies. 
Limit access to sensitive data to authorised purposes. 
Avoid exposing personal information in unnecessary reports or dashboard views. 
Maintain appropriate audit trails and analytical documentation. 
Escalate suspected data quality or security issues through approved channels. 
4. Technical skills and proficiency expectations 
Technical area 
Expected capability 
SQL 
Joins, aggregations, subqueries, CTEs, data validation 
Microsoft Excel 
PivotTables, lookup functions, conditional formulas, reconciliation 
Power BI / Tableau 
Interactive dashboards, KPI reporting, filters, visualisation 
Python 
Pandas, NumPy, data manipulation and automation 
Statistics 
Descriptive statistics, distributions, trend analysis, correlation basics 
Database concepts 
Relational models, keys, schemas, table relationships 
Data quality 
Deduplication, validation, reconciliation, anomaly identification 
Reporting 
Metric definitions, documentation, recurring report preparation 
Communication 
Business presentations, analytical summaries, stakeholder collaboration 
Automation 
Reusable scripts and repeatable reporting workflows 
Core requirements: SQL, Excel, analytical reasoning, data quality, and reporting. 
Additional advantages: Python automation, advanced Power BI, cloud data platforms, API-based data extraction, and experience with education or recruitment analytics. 
5. Educational qualifications 
Suitable qualifications may include: 
B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
BCA or MCA. 
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, or Analytics. 
BBA or MBA with a strong analytical, quantitative, or business intelligence background. 
Other relevant qualifications supported by demonstrated technical proficiency. 
Candidates should have a sound understanding of data interpretation, quantitative reasoning, structured problem-solving, and analytical reporting. 
Relevant internships, practical projects, certifications, or professional experience may strengthen a candidate's profile. 
6. Experience requirements 
For candidates with 12 years of experience 
Candidates should be able to: 
Write SQL queries for common analytical requirements. 
Clean and validate data using Excel or Python. 
Prepare recurring reports and basic dashboards. 
Understand KPI definitions and data relationships. 
Identify discrepancies and explain their findings. 
Work with guidance from senior team members. 
For candidates with 34 years of experience 
Candidates should additionally demonstrate the ability to: 
Independently manage analytical assignments. 
Design complex SQL queries and reusable reporting processes. 
Build and maintain dashboards for multiple stakeholders. 
Automate recurring reporting tasks. 
Investigate data inconsistencies and conduct root-cause analysis. 
Translate business requirements into measurable analytical solutions. 
Review data quality and reporting logic before delivery. 
Recommend process improvements based on analytical findings. 
These experience bands are proposed guidelines and should be adjusted to the actual seniority intended by SE.” 
7. Key performance indicators 
Performance should be assessed against measurable and role-appropriate objectives. 
KPI 
What it measures 
Report accuracy 
Reliability of analytical outputs and calculations 
On-time delivery 
Completion of assigned reports within agreed deadlines 
Data quality 
Detection and resolution of data inconsistencies 
Dashboard reliability 
Consistency and usability of dashboards 
Automation efficiency 
Reduction in avoidable manual reporting effort 
Issue resolution 
Effectiveness in investigating discrepancies 
Stakeholder satisfaction 
Usefulness and clarity of reports and analysis 
Documentation quality 
Completeness of query, metric, and process documentation 
Process improvement 
Measurable improvements resulting from analytical work 
Targets should be agreed with the reporting manager based on the assigned responsibilities and available data. 
8. Illustrative work scenarios 
Scenario 1 — Learning platform analytics 
Business question: Why are some courses experiencing low completion rates? 
Expected approach: Extract enrolment and progress data, validate completion records, compare course and cohort performance, identify where learners stop progressing, and prepare a dashboard for the learning team. 
Expected output: A validated completion report, engagement dashboard, and evidence-based observations for further investigation. 
Scenario 2 — Recruitment workflow analytics

We're a fast-growing startup with a young, talented team of alumni from IITs and other premier institutes, building technology that runs complex real-world operations at scale.
Among the platforms we have built is BuildNow, the Telangana Government's Next-Gen Unified Building & Layout Approval System and one of India's most successful digital governance platforms.

About the Role 

As a Data Analyst at Floww, you will play a key role in transforming complex datasets into actionable insights, enabling business teams to make data-driven decisions. You will work closely with business and engineering teams to clean, transform, and analyze data, build reports and dashboards, and deliver actionable insights.

What You'll Do 

Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports in line with business requirements.
Validate datasets for accuracy, consistency, and completeness through systematic data quality checks.
Gather and understand analytics requirements and translate business questions into structured data queries and reports.
Ensure timely, accurate, and high-quality data deliveries.
Detect, debug, and extract data records for root cause analysis and corrective resolution.
Organize and structure data to create models that simplify analysis and visualization.
Monitor metrics for production workloads, and optimize them for performance & cost.
Handle confidential data responsibly and adhere to data governance standards.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, deliver data solutions, and update datasets as needed when changes occur.
Be ready to assist with additional tasks or projects based on team requirements.

What We're Looking For 

Systematic and organised You work in a systematic and organised way, while keeping the broader business context in view.
Logical and structured thinking — You break complex problems into clear, manageable parts and arrive at practical answers.
Adaptable & quick to learn — You pick up new tools and techniques quickly and adjust to changing requirements and priorities.
Clear communication — You ask the right questions upfront and maintain clear, well-structured documentation.
Attention to detail & ownership — You validate data before sharing and ensure tasks are completed end to end.

Skills & Qualifications 

Advanced expertise in SQL (BigQuery) and analytical querying.
Hands-on experience with Looker Studio, Power BI or equivalent BI tools.
Strong Google Sheets skills for quick, ad-hoc analyses.
Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail .
Strong communication skills and proven ability to work with stakeholders.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to support a Single-Family Office in Mumbai. Graduate/Postgraduate—MCom or relevant specialization preferred.

title: Hiring Data Analyst
description:
Hiring Data Analyst ! 

Company: Mechademy
Location: Gurugram 
Work Mode: Hybrid
Experience: 1-3 years

We need an immediate joiner or a candidate with a maximum 30-day notice period. 

About Mechademy Mechademy builds an enterprise AI platform for real-time monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance of industrial equipment. We are a venture-funded, Series A startup experiencing 8090% YoY growth, with 15+ enterprise clients across oil & gas, power generation, and LNG. 

The Opportunity We are looking for a sharp Data Analyst who thrives on open-ended problem-solving. Instead of answering pre-packaged questions or staring at standing dashboards, you will be handed raw data and complex industrial datasets (sensor streams across speed, pressure, temperature, flow, and vibration) to figure out what is actually happening. Your findings will directly inform engineers making decisions on assets worth hundreds of millions of dollars. 

What You'll Own 
Investigation & Root Cause (40%): Pull and structure raw sensor data across time windows, formulate testable hypotheses, and work alongside domain engineers to trace anomalies from raw signals to defensible recommendations. 
Performance & Efficiency (25%): Analyze relationships between operating variables, build before/after intervention studies, and derive performance metrics to quantify asset degradation or improvement. 
Reporting & Communication (15%): Produce clear visualizations, structured analytical reports, and summaries that stand up to leadership scrutiny. 
Product Analytics (10%): Analyze internal user interactions and platform usage metrics to help improve the Mechademy product itself. 
Knowledge & Reuse (10%): Document analytical patterns and help build a shared knowledge base of equipment behavior and reusable frameworks. 

Who You Are (Must-Haves) 
Structured Problem-Solving: Ability to break down vague, large-scale problems into solvable components and stitch them back into coherent answers. 
Defensible Reasoning: Your conclusions logically follow from your analysis, and you can clearly walk senior stakeholders through your work. 
Python Proficiency: Daily comfort with Python (pandas, numpy, and basic scipy for statistical checks) as a core analytical tool. 
Time-Series Experience: Comfort working with sequential data indexed over time, spotting trends, seasonality, and drift. 
Hypothesis-Driven Mindset: A natural reflex to form testable explanations when encountering anomalies rather than random searching. 
Comfort with Ambiguity: Ability to take a vague prompt and turn it into a rigorous, structured investigation. 

Strong Signals 
Exposure to real equipment, IoT, SCADA, or industrial sensor streams. 
Curiosity about product and user behavior analytics. 
Engineering, science, or quantitative academic background. 

What We Offer 
Direct access to irreplaceable operational sensor data from enterprise clients. 
Close collaboration with domain engineers and AI-powered investigation tooling. 
A fast learning curve, high impact, and clear growth path early in your career. 
Competitive compensation and hybrid flexibility (23 days on-site in Gurugram). 

To Apply please send your resume to sunanda.lawania@mechademy.com with your Current CTC, Expected CTC & NP

title: Project Manager
description:
Aryan Group is looking for an experienced and technically sound Civil Engineer / Project Manager to independently oversee civil construction activities across the company's residential, villa, clubhouse and infrastructure development projects. The candidate must have substantial experience working with an established real estate developer and possess strong knowledge of construction execution, technical drawings, BOQ preparation, estimation, billing, quality control and project management.

Key Responsibilities 

Construction & Site Execution: Supervise day-to-day civil construction activities and ensure execution as per approved architectural, structural and MEP drawings.
Site & Labour Management: Manage site resources, labour, contractors and subcontractors to ensure efficient utilisation and timely completion of work.
Drawing Interpretation & Coordination: Read, interpret and coordinate architectural, structural, electrical, plumbing and external development drawings.
BOQ & Quantity Estimation: Prepare detailed BOQs, quantity estimates, measurement sheets and material requirement statements based on approved drawings.
External Development & Infrastructure: Prepare and coordinate drawings and execution of drainage systems, stormwater management, internal roads, underground service networks and other external infrastructure.
Cost & Material Control: Monitor construction costs, material consumption, labour productivity and wastage to maintain project budgets.
Quality Control: Inspect concrete work, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, flooring, tiling and finishing activities to ensure adherence to approved specifications and quality standards.
Swimming Pool Construction: Supervise complete swimming pool execution, including civil works, waterproofing, tiling, filtration systems, piping and associated installations.
Clubhouse Construction: Oversee clubhouse construction, including structural works, masonry, flooring, finishing and service installations.
Plumbing & Water Management: Ensure proper execution of plumbing, water supply, sewerage, drainage and rainwater harvesting systems.
Electrical & MEP Coordination: Verify electrical conduits, cable routes, underground electrical piping, sleeves and other service installations as per approved drawings.
Contractor Billing & Measurements: Verify contractor bills, site measurements, material consumption and completed work quantities before processing.
Project Coordination: Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, MEP consultants, contractors and project managers to resolve technical issues and ensure smooth execution.
Site Safety & Compliance: Ensure adherence to site safety protocols, construction standards and applicable statutory regulations.
Site Documentation & Reporting: Maintain daily progress reports, site records, inspection checklists, measurement books and material registers.
Technical Problem-Solving: Identify drawing discrepancies, site constraints and service clashes, and coordinate timely corrective actions.
Project Timeline Management: Ensure timely execution and completion of residential projects, villas, clubhouses, swimming pools and external infrastructure works.

We seek a technically strong and result-oriented civil engineering professional who can independently take ownership of construction execution, manage site operations and ensure that every aspect of development meets the company's standards of quality, cost efficiency and timely delivery.

The ideal candidate should possess strong practical knowledge of construction, be capable of interpreting complex drawings, identifying technical issues, preparing accurate BOQs and controlling project expenses. The candidate must not merely supervise construction but actively contribute to improving execution quality, optimising resources and delivering exceptional real estate developments for Aryan Group

Preferred candidate profile 

Minimum 812 years of professional experience in civil construction, preferably with an established real estate developer.
B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering or Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
Strong experience in residential real estate construction, villas, high-end developments and infrastructure projects.
In-depth knowledge of architectural, structural, electrical, plumbing and MEP drawings.
Hands-on expertise in BOQ preparation, quantity estimation, rate analysis, measurement sheets and contractor billing.
Practical experience in swimming pool construction, clubhouse development, waterproofing, drainage and external infrastructure.
Strong understanding of construction materials, specifications, quality control and cost optimisation.
Knowledge of AutoCAD and construction planning and project management tools.
Ability to independently manage site teams, contractors, subcontractors and multiple construction activities.
Strong technical, analytical, coordination and problem-solving abilities.
Must be proactive, disciplined, accountable and capable of independently handling site responsibilities.

title: Real Estate Digital Marketing Executive
description:
* Job Title: Digital Marketing Executive Real Estate 
*Department: Marketing & Digital Marketing 
*Industry: Real Estate 
*Employment Type: Full-Time 
*Experience: 2-4 Years (Real Estate Experience Preferred)

Job Overview 

We are looking for a creative, skilled and result-oriented Digital Marketing Executive to independently manage our company's complete digital marketing activities.

The candidate will be responsible for creating professional marketing designs, managing social media platforms, running paid advertising campaigns, generating quality property leads and developing digital marketing strategies.

The ideal candidate should be capable of handling everything independently, from creative planning and content creation to campaign execution, performance tracking and lead generation.

Key Responsibilities 

1. Graphic Design & Creative Development
* Create professional social media posts, banners, brochures, flyers and property advertisements.
* Design high-converting creatives for Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Create property marketing creatives, project brochures and promotional materials.
* Develop creative concepts for residential projects, apartments, villas, plots and commercial properties.
* Use AI tools to generate property visuals and marketing creatives.
* Maintain consistent brand identity across all marketing materials.

2. Meta Ads & Paid Advertising 
* Plan, create and manage Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.
* Run Lead Generation, Traffic, Engagement and Conversion campaigns.
* Develop effective ad copies, headlines and creative strategies.
* Manage campaign budgets and optimize Cost Per Lead (CPL).
* Analyze audience targeting, campaign performance and lead quality.
* Conduct A/B testing of creatives, audiences and ad copies.
* Generate quality property enquiries and site visit leads.

3. Social Media Management 
* Manage Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube accounts.
* Plan and execute monthly social media content calendars.
* Create engaging property posts, reels, stories and promotional videos.
* Write captions, hashtags and social media content.
* Manage regular posting and audience engagement.
* Follow real estate trends and develop creative marketing ideas.

4. Video Editing & Reel Creation 
* Edit property promotional videos, walkthroughs and short-form reels.
* Create engaging video advertisements for Meta and Instagram.
* Add transitions, subtitles, music, voiceovers and motion graphics.
* Develop promotional videos for property launches and campaigns.

5. Lead Tracking & Performance Analysis 
* Monitor incoming leads from Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Track CPL, campaign spend, CTR, conversions and lead quality.
* Prepare weekly and monthly marketing performance reports.
* Coordinate with the sales and CRM teams for lead feedback.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance.

6. AI & Marketing Tools 
* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and image-generation platforms for marketing.
* Create AI-powered property visuals, marketing concepts and content.
* Use Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator or similar design tools.
* Use CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar video editing software.
* Explore automation tools to improve marketing productivity.

Required Skills & Qualifications 

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related field (preferred).
* 24 years of experience in digital marketing.
* Strong knowledge of Facebook and Instagram Ads.
* Good graphic design and video editing skills.
* Knowledge of social media management and content creation.
* Basic understanding of SEO, WordPress and website management.
* Knowledge of Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager.
* Good copywriting and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.

Preferred Tools & Software 

* Meta Ads Manager
* Canva 
* Adobe Photoshop
* CapCut
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
* Google Tag Manager (GTM)
* Google Search Console

Preferred Candidate Profile 

* Experience in real estate marketing is highly preferred.
* Understanding of property marketing, residential projects and lead generation.
* Creative thinking with a performance-driven mindset.
* Ability to handle complete digital marketing operations independently.
* Strong focus on generating quality leads rather than just increasing engagement.
* Ability to work with deadlines and take ownership of marketing activities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

Performance will be evaluated based on:

1. Quality and consistency of marketing creatives.
2. Social media growth and engagement.
3. Lead generation and Cost Per Lead (CPL).
4. Campaign performance and advertising ROI.
5. Quality of video and promotional content.
6. Website updates and SEO improvements.
7. Monthly marketing targets and reporting.

*Important :* The candidate will be expected to independently manage the company's complete digital marketing and creative activities, with a strong focus on real estate brand building and lead generation.*

Job Summary 
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Digital Marketing Manager to lead and oversee our digital marketing operations, including content strategy, social media, performance marketing, media buying, affiliate marketing, and search arbitrage. Oversee content creation, scriptwriting, social media strategies, and digital campaigns.
Plan and manage paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google, and other platforms.
Handle media buying, campaign budgeting, audience targeting, and optimization.

Hands-on experience in Meta Ads, Google Ads, and Media Buying.

Experience with budget allocation, ROI analysis, and revenue growth strategies.
Knowledge of SEO, content marketing, and social media strategy.
Strong leadership, team management, and decision-making skills.
Proficiency in Google Analytics, Google Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, and reporting tools.

Preferred Candidate 
A strategic thinker with strong analytical abilities, leadership skills, and a proven track record of managing digital marketing campaigns and driving measurable business results.

description:
Job Description DevOps Engineer
Job Title: DevOps Engineer
Department: Information Technology
Experience: 4+ Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer with a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience to join our IT team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for implementing automation, managing CI/CD pipelines, maintaining cloud infrastructure, and ensuring seamless software deployment. The role requires close collaboration with development, QA, and IT operations teams to improve system reliability, security, and performance.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and implement automation tools and frameworks for continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD).
Collaborate with development teams to build, manage, and optimize CI/CD pipelines.
Monitor and maintain infrastructure to ensure high availability, scalability, and performance.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Implement security best practices to safeguard infrastructure, applications, and data.
Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment processes.
Provide technical support and guidance to development and IT teams.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiency.
Stay updated with emerging DevOps technologies, tools, and industry best practices.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in a DevOps role. 
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Ruby, or Shell Scripting .
Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef .
Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .
Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions.
Good understanding of Linux-based environments and system administration.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform.
Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools.
Relevant DevOps or cloud certifications will be an added advantage.
Key Skills
DevOps | AWS | Azure | GCP | CI/CD | Jenkins | Python | Shell Scripting | Linux | Ansible | Puppet | Chef | Docker | Kubernetes | Terraform | Infrastructure Automation | Cloud Computing

title: Strategy Associate Digital Marketing & Partnerships
description:
Strategy Associate Digital Marketing & Partnerships
Department: CEOs Office
Location: Kolkata, West Bengal
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: Minimum 5 years
Compensation: Up to 10 LPA
Qualification: MBA in Digital Marketing

Role Overview 
India Autism Center (IAC) is building an integrated ecosystem of clinical services, vocational development, research, training, and residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum and their families.
We are looking for a Strategy Associate with strengths in digital analytics, business analysis, stakeholder engagement, and process improvement to strengthen strategic performance monitoring across IAC, with a specialist focus on communications, partnerships, fundraising, admissions, talent acquisition, HR, and community outreach.
You will play a key role in evaluating departmental performance, monitoring strategic priorities, analysing operational workflows, and identifying opportunities to improve effectiveness and accountability. The role requires translating data into insights, evaluating processes beyond individual campaigns or activities, and monitoring the implementation of agreed improvements.

Key Responsibilities 
1. Strategic Performance Monitoring 
Monitor departmental plans, deliverables, and organisation-wide strategic priorities against agreed objectives, quality standards, budgets, resource requirements, and timelines.
Review progress across communications, partnerships, fundraising, admissions, talent acquisition, HR, and community outreach.
Monitor relevant performance indicators, including admissions pipelines, conversion rates, stakeholder engagement, partnership progression, fundraising pipelines, recruitment timelines, and process efficiency.
Identify deviations from targets, analyse underlying causes, and track agreed corrective actions.
Maintain performance trackers and action registers to support visibility and accountability.

2. Strategic Evaluation & Review 
Conduct structured, evidence-based evaluations of departmental performance, projects, processes, and strategic initiatives.
Assess performance against agreed targets, deliverables, budgets, resource requirements, quality parameters, and timelines.
Review end-to-end workflows of communications, admissions, stakeholder engagement, partnership development, fundraising, recruitment, and relevant HR processes.
Analyse conversion trends, delays, bottlenecks, handover gaps, duplication, and other factors affecting effectiveness.
Coordinate internal reviews and audits where required, document observations, and track corrective actions through closure.

3. Policies, Systems & Process Implementation 
Identify organisational and departmental process gaps and support the development of appropriate systems, structures, policies, SOPs, workflows, performance indicators, and reporting mechanisms.
Map and evaluate processes across admissions, communications, partnerships, fundraising, recruitment, HR, and community outreach.
Monitor the implementation, adoption, and effectiveness of established systems and processes.
Review the effectiveness of CRM platforms, websites, social media, admissions and recruitment systems, dashboards, and workflow tools where relevant.
Recommend improvements to strengthen information flow, process efficiency, coordination, and accountability.

4. Risk Monitoring & Management 
Monitor risks relating to admissions pipelines, partnership dependencies, fundraising opportunities, recruitment capacity, stakeholder engagement, process implementation, and delivery timelines.
Maintain relevant risk registers and monitor agreed mitigation plans with accountable teams.
Identify emerging risks, recurring bottlenecks, and dependencies that could affect organisational priorities and escalate them to leadership.

5. Leadership Reporting & Performance Analysis 
Consolidate departmental data into accurate dashboards, management reports, analytical summaries, and review presentations.
Analyse trends in admissions, engagement, website, social media, partnerships, fundraising, recruitment, and operational performance.
Evaluate performance against agreed indicators and identify recurring gaps or systemic challenges.
Translate data into evidence-based insights and recommendations to support leadership decisions.
Support periodic departmental and organisation-wide strategic reviews.

6. Cross-functional Coordination & Accountability 
Work with department heads and teams to review progress, understand implementation challenges, and identify dependencies across functions.
Monitor ownership and completion of agreed actions, deliverables, and improvement plans.
Identify gaps in coordination, handovers, information flow, and process accountability.
Facilitate follow-up on review findings and escalate persistent deviations or unresolved issues through the established reporting structure.

Key Outcomes 
Improved visibility into departmental performance and progress against organisation-wide strategic priorities.
Reliable monitoring of admissions, partnerships, fundraising, recruitment, communications, and people-operation indicators.
Early identification of process inefficiencies, performance gaps, and strategic risks.
Stronger implementation and adoption of organisational systems and workflows.
Better cross-functional accountability and timely completion of agreed actions.
Evidence-based reporting and recommendations that support institutional effectiveness and organisational growth.

Must-have Requirements 
5 years of relevant experience in business analysis, project management, digital analytics, operations, stakeholder engagement, partnerships, business development, or people operations.
MBA in Digital Marketing.
Experience analysing performance indicators, reviewing workflows, identifying process gaps, and preparing management reports.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate across departments and monitor implementation of agreed actions.
Strong analytical, organisational, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
Proficiency in spreadsheets, dashboards, and reporting tools.
Ability to translate data into practical recommendations and follow through on agreed actions.
Experience beyond routine campaign execution, content creation, or marketing activities.

Preferred Skills 
Familiarity with CRM platforms, admissions management systems, recruitment systems, and workflow management tools.
Experience analysing conversion funnels, stakeholder engagement, partnership pipelines, or recruitment metrics.
Exposure to fundraising, HR operations, institutional partnerships, or business development.
Experience developing dashboards, performance reports, or management presentations.
Experience in healthcare, education, non-profit, social-impact, or other multi-stakeholder organisations.

About India Autism Center 
India Autism Center is a not-for-profit organisation building a comprehensive ecosystem of support, training, research, and lifelong residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum and their families. IAC works towards greater independence, dignity, belonging, and quality of life for individuals and families across India.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Industry - Steel Manufacturing 
Designation - Data Engineer 
Location - Kolkata, west Bengal 
Salary - Upto 10 lpa 

Role Overview 

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with 45 years of hands-on experience in building scalable data pipelines, managing large datasets, and designing efficient data architectures.

Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines for batch and real-time processing.
Build and optimize ETL/ELT workflows to integrate data from multiple sources.
Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, database schemas, and data models.
Work with analytical databases and data warehouses to support business intelligence and reporting.
Implement data ingestion pipelines using APIs, databases, event streams, and files.
Ensure data quality, consistency, reliability, and governance.
Optimize pipeline performance, query execution, storage, and infrastructure costs.
Collaborate with backend engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.
Implement monitoring, logging, error handling, and automated recovery for data pipelines.
Maintain technical documentation and follow engineering best practices.

Required Skills 
Experience: 45 years in data engineering or a similar role.
Programming: Strong proficiency in Python.
Databases: Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with MySQL or PostgreSQL.
Data Processing: Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and data transformation workflows.
Analytical Databases: Hands-on experience with ClickHouse.
Cloud: Practical experience with AWS services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Athena, or EMR.
Big Data: Working knowledge of Apache Spark or PySpark.
Streaming: Understanding of Apache Kafka or other event-streaming technologies.
Orchestration: Experience with Apache Airflow or similar workflow orchestration tools.
DevOps: Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD, and monitoring tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, partitioning, indexing, and query optimization.

Preferred Qualifications 
Experience handling high-volume transactional and analytical datasets.
Experience with CDC (Change Data Capture) and incremental data loading.
Familiarity with lakehouse architecture and data formats such as Parquet.
Experience building near-real-time analytics and reporting platforms.
Knowledge of data security, access control, and data governance.

What We Expect 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to independently own data pipelines from design to production.
Focus on reliability, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional engineering teams.
A proactive approach to identifying and resolving data quality and performance issues.

Success Metrics 
Reliability and freshness of data pipelines.
Reduction in data processing time and infrastructure costs.
Accuracy and consistency of analytical datasets.
Performance and scalability of data infrastructure.
Timely delivery of business-critical data requirements.

The candidate must have a strong understanding of news-based content creation, graphic designing, and video editing for digital platforms.
Key Responsibilities
Design news graphics, banners, headlines, thumbnails, social media posts, and promotional materials.
Edit news videos, short clips, reels, interviews, and other digital media content.
Create engaging and visually appealing news-based content for social media platforms.
Work on breaking news creatives, news updates, and promotional videos.
Ensure accuracy, visual consistency, and timely delivery of content.
Enhance videos with transitions, effects, colour correction, sound, and other editing techniques.
Coordinate with the content and editorial teams to meet daily requirements.
Create and edit content using both mobile devices and PC/laptop.

Minimum 4 years of professional experience in Graphic Designing and Video Editing.

Strong understanding of news presentation, headlines, breaking news formats, and digital media content.
Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and After Effects.
Must be comfortable working on both mobile devices and PC/laptop.
Practical knowledge of mobile-based editing applications and professional desktop editing software.
Ability to work under tight deadlines and handle urgent news-related creative requirements.
Strong creative skills, attention to detail, and time management.
Added Advantage
Knowledge of Motion Graphics and Animation.
Experience with advanced video effects and visual storytelling.
Compensation & Work Schedule
Salary: Up to 22,000 per month, depending on experience and skills.
Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
Working Days: 6 days a week.
Weekly Off: 1 rotational day off.
Salary Date: 1st of every month.
Application Requirement: Candidates must share their updated resume along with a portfolio containing relevant news graphics, video edits, reels, and previous media work samples.

Designation: Graphic Designer

Work Location: Port Blair

Languages: Hindi, English 
Work Mode: Work from Office

Job Description  

The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating high-quality visual content for social media, digital campaigns, government initiatives, events, and departmental communication. The role will work closely with the Social Media Manager and content team to develop creative designs aligned with client requirements and branding guidelines. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities  

Creative Design: Create social media posts, banners, posters, infographics, announcements, and campaign creatives. 

Digital Content: Design creatives for Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, LinkedIn, websites, and other digital platforms. 

Campaign Creatives: Develop visual concepts for government campaigns, awareness programs, events, festivals, and special occasions. 

Department Requirements: Create department-specific creatives based on approved content briefs and communication requirements.

Asset Management: Maintain an organized repository of design files, templates, photographs, icons, and other creative assets.

3+ years of professional experience in graphic design, preferably in digital/social media. 

Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and/or equivalent design tools. 

Good understanding of social media design formats and specifications. 

Strong knowledge of typography, layout, colour theory, and visual communication. 

Ability to work on multiple projects and tight deadlines. 

Strong creativity and attention to detail.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Job Summary 
We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to join our Data Breach Response team. You will be responsible for analysing complex, often unstructured datasets resulting from cyber security incidents. Your primary goal is to identify impacted individuals, extract sensitive information (PII/PHI), and ensure data integrity for regulatory notification purposes.

Key Responsibilities 
Data Mining & Extraction: Perform manual and automated extraction of sensitive data from compromised file systems, emails, and databases.
Data Normalization & Cleanup: Clean, de-duplicate, and format massive sets of messy data to create a "Single Version of Truth" for legal review.
Quality Assurance: Conduct rigorous QA checks on datasets to ensure 100% accuracy before notification lists are generated.
Reporting: Translate complex data findings into actionable reports for legal counsel and stakeholders.
Process Optimization: Develop and maintain workflows (using Excel/SQL) to speed up the identification of PII/PHI.

Required Technical Skills 
Advanced Excel: Mastery of Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Index/Match, Power Query, and complex nested formulas.
SQL: Ability to write complex queries to extract, filter, and join data from relational databases.
Data Handling: Proven experience in Manual Extraction and Data Cleanups from unstructured sources (e.g., OCR outputs).
Field Expertise: Minimum of 3 years specifically within the Data Breach sector. 

Preferred Skills (The "Plus" List) 
VBA/Macros: Ability to automate repetitive Excel tasks to improve turnaround time.
Python: Experience using Pandas/NumPy for large-scale data manipulation and cleaning.
RegEx: Knowledge of Regular Expressions for pattern matching (e.g., finding SSNs or Credit Card numbers).

Professional Competencies 
High Attention to Detail: You must have a "detective" mindset to spot errors in thousands of rows of data.
Time Management: Ability to work under tight regulatory deadlines (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA).
Confidentiality: A deep understanding of data privacy ethics and the sensitivity of the information being handled.

Education 
Bachelors degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.

title: Senior Data Analyst / Data Science Engineer (Python & Statistical Mode
description:
Role: Senior Data Analyst / Data Science Engineer (Python & Statistical Modelling) 
Location: Gurugram 
Role Overview 
Core mission: Own and productionize statistical models in Pythonprimarily regression and forecasting—by translating legacy Excel models into robust, tested, and scalable Python pipelines. 
We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst / Data Science Engineer with 7+ years of handson experience in Python-based analytics , statistical modelling (regression, forecasting, GLM) , and strong data wrangling . You will convert complex Excel models into Python , validate parity, enhance them with software engineering best practices, and deploy them as reusable components/pipelines. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable discussing model assumptions with business stakeholders and implementing productionready code with tests and documentation.
Responsibilities 
Migrate existing Excel-based analytical/financial/statistical models into Python with feature parity, improved performance, and robust error handling.
Design, build, and validate regression and related statistical models (e.g., Linear/Multiple Regression, Logistic, Elastic Net, Timeseries/ARIMA/Prophet, Panel data as applicable).
Data wrangling & EDA: Clean, join, transform large datasets; exploratory analysis; feature engineering; handling outliers and missing data.
Model governance: Document assumptions, diagnostics (VIF, residuals, multicollinearity, heteroskedasticity), backtesting, and performance metrics (RMSE/MAE/AUC as relevant).
Productionization: Package models into versioned Python modules/notebooks/pipelines; write unit tests , data validation checks , and automation scripts (e.g., cron/Airflow).
Stakeholder engagement: Translate business questions into modelling problems; communicate insights, tradeoffs, and explain model outcomes to nontechnical audiences.
Collaboration: Partner with data engineering to access data; with BI teams to publish results (dashboards, APIs); with product/ops to integrate into decision flows.
Optimization: Refactor legacy logic, improve runtime, and reduce manual effort through automation and reproducible analysis.
Documentation & handover: Clear readme, change logs, model cards, and SOPs for ongoing maintenance.
Musthave qualifications 
7–10 years in analytics/data science with demonstrable Python proficiency (pandas, numpy, statsmodels , scikitlearn).
Strong command of regression techniques (linear, logistic, regularization, model diagnostics, crossvalidation).
Proven experience converting Excel models into Python (e.g., complex formulas, lookups, macros/VBA logic translated to Pythonic pipelines).
SQL proficiency for data extraction and joins; solid EDA and data quality practices.
Clear, structured communication; stakeholder management and requirement grooming.
Version control ( Git ), notebook hygiene, and documentation habits.
Nice to have 
Timeseries modelling (ARIMA/SARIMA/Prophet), survival analysis, or Bayesian methods.
Workflow orchestration (Airflow/Prefect), CI/CD for analytics, basic Docker .
Experience with Excel/VBA for model understanding; OpenPyXL/xlwings helpful.
Cloud exposure (AWS/GCP/Azure) for data/compute; basic API integration.
Visualization: matplotlib/seaborn/plotly; BI tools (Power BI/Tableau).
Domain exposure to financial modelling, pricing, marketing analytics, risk, or operations (as applicable).

Please share your updated resume to priyanka.m@tekskills.in

title: Devops Engineer
description:
DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer 

Responsibilities 

1. Plan, deploy, operate, and optimize AWS cloud infrastructure, including VPC, IAM, EC2, RDS, S3, ELB, and other core services.

2. Handle the daily operations and troubleshooting of production service clusters.

3. Build and maintain observability capabilities, including monitoring, alerting, and logging; participate in production releases, capacity planning, and cloud cost management.

4. Ensure the security of services and workloads running on the cloud platform.

5. Collaborate with engineering and security teams to continuously improve delivery efficiency and platform reliability.

6. Create and maintain operations documentation, standard operating procedures, and emergency response plans; continuously advance operations automation and standardization.

Requirements 

1. 2-3 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or public cloud operations.

2. Proficiency in common Linux administration tasks, with foundational troubleshooting skills in processes, disks, permissions, logs, and system performance.

3. Hands-on experience with AWS core services such as EC2, IAM, VPC, load balancing, and CloudWatch, including production environment setup and incident resolution.

4. Basic proficiency in at least one language such as Shell or Python.

5. Strong sense of ownership, communication, and collaboration; highly self-motivated and capable of proactively driving issues to resolution.

title: Data Engineer - AI
description:
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat 

About the Opportunity

We are looking for bright, technically strong and enthusiastic Computer Science / Computer Engineering graduates from IIT's who are passionate about Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML) and building innovative technology solutions.

This is an opportunity to work with a technology-driven organisation developing intelligent solutions for real-world challenges, including applications in the healthcare domain.

We are looking for individuals with strong programming abilities, sound mathematical and algorithmic fundamentals, curiosity and a willingness to learn and build.

Key Responsibilities

Develop, test and implement software solutions involving Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
Work on algorithms, data structures, mathematical models and problem-solving applications.
Explore and implement AI/ML models for practical, real-world use cases.
Use AI-assisted coding tools and development agents to improve engineering productivity.
Review, test, debug and validate AI-generated code rather than relying on automated outputs without verification.
Collaborate with experienced engineers and product teams to translate requirements into reliable software solutions.
Understand complex business and user workflows and contribute to building dependable technology products.
Continuously explore emerging AI/ML technologies, tools and development methodologies.

Candidate Profile

B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, AI/ML or related disciplines from IITs with 0-3 years of experience 
Strong programming skills in Python, C++, Java or other relevant languages.
Excellent understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, Mathematics and logical problem-solving.
Genuine interest in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning and related technologies.
Familiarity with AI development tools, LLMs and AI-assisted coding platforms will be an advantage.
Academic projects, internships, research work, GitHub contributions or competitive programming achievements demonstrating technical ability will be valued.
High initiative, independent thinking, learning agility and the ability to work on challenging technical problems.

What We Look For

We value demonstrated technical ability, problem-solving skills, curiosity and the ability to build working solutions. Strong academic credentials are welcome, but practical ability and individual contribution are equally important.

Application Process

Interested candidates are requested to share:

Updated CV.
GitHub profile and links to their strongest technical projects.
Details of AI/ML projects, research work, internships or relevant technical achievements.
Competitive programming achievements, Olympiad results or other notable academic accomplishments, if any.
Current location and willingness to work from Ahmedabad

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary: 

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Azure Databricks Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Databricks and cloud-based data platforms. In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines, support the implementation of enterprise-grade data and analytics solutions, and leverage Databricks best practices to deliver reliable, high-quality data products. You will work closely with data engineers, architects, business stakeholders, and analytics teams to enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. 
Key Responsibilities: 
Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines using Azure Databricks (Apache Spark).  
Build and support large-scale, cloud-native data processing solutions on Azure.  
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure data availability, reliability, and quality.  
Implement and support Databricks Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and MLflow solutions.  
Follow and promote best practices for CI/CD, version control, testing, and deployment in a Databricks environment.  
Work closely with project teams to deliver solutions aligned with business requirements and timelines. 
Required Qualifications: 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.  
7+ years of experience in data engineering.  
Hands-on expertise with Azure Databricks, including Spark SQL, Delta Lake, job orchestration, and performance tuning.  
Proficient in Python, SQL, and Apache Spark; knowledge of Scala is a plus.  
Experience working with Azure cloud services, including Databricks deployments.  
Strong understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT, data warehousing, and modern data lake architectures. 
Advanced SQL skills for data analysis. Expertise on problem-solving skills with a focus on finding innovative solutions to complex data challenges. Ability to proactively identify and address potential issues and bottlenecks. 
Fluent in multiple coding languages, such as Python or Java and able to learn new ones quickly   
Technical skills in metadata capturing and management using Collibra to document, organize, and ensure the quality of metadata assets 
Strong Knowledge of cloud-based data, compute, and storage services, including AWS S3, EC2, RDS, EBS, Lambda, Airflow (MWAA), Containerization Services (ECS, EKS) and so on. 

Preferred Qualifications: 
Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional). 
Experience with Unity Catalog, MLflow, and building data products on the Lakehouse. 
Experience with Azure services such as Azure Data Factory (ADF) and Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS).
