Role & responsibilities 

Job Description: Data Analyst Single Family Office (Mumbai) 
Experience Required : Prior experience in managing wealth management software is mandatory
Role Overview 
We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to support a Single-Family Office in Mumbai. The role involves managing, onboarding, and maintaining high-quality investment and accounting data across multiple asset classes and platforms. Candidates with hands-on experience in wealth management software (especially Asset Vantage and MProfit) will be preferred.
Key Responsibilities 
Data Onboarding & Maintenance 
Assist the family office in onboarding investment and accounting data across all investment vehicles (initial setup and ongoing updates).
Ensure accurate mapping and classification of all transactions across equities, mutual funds, bonds, PMS, AIFs, private equity, and global assets.
Data Feeds & Cleansing 
Understand and work with various types of data feeds received from custodians, brokers, PMS/AIF managers, and banks (India & overseas including US).
Identify appropriate data sources, cleanse and standardize data to meet platform requirements.
Investment & Accounting Understanding
Develop strong working knowledge of investment management and investment accounting concepts.
Learn and understand different investment structures and transactional flows across domestic and offshore jurisdictions.
Review & Coordination 
Coordinate periodic data sanity checks and review sessions with the team to ensure database accuracy.
Collaborate with wealth managers, AMCs, custodians, and internal teams to resolve data-related issues.
Issue Tracking & System Improvements
Identify system issues, bugs, and mismatches in data; document them and track resolution with the technology partner.
Reporting & Presentation 
Prepare dashboards, visual reports, and presentations summarizing portfolio insights and data trends for management review.
Build automated reports and reusable templates.
Technical Skills 
Strong Excel skills including VBA macros, advanced formulas, pivot tables, and data automation.
Ability to prepare high-quality presentations and explain data insights clearly.
Process implementation & management capability.
Highly proactive and detail-focused approach.
Ability to understand and explain complex investment and system-related concepts.
Problem-solving mindset with the ability to identify issues and execute effective solutions.
Capability to streamline processes and strong willingness to learn and grow.
Experience 
2–5 years of relevant experience in wealth management data operations.
Mandatory: Experience with wealth management software.
Preferred: Hands-on experience with Asset Vantage or MProfit.
Qualifications 
Graduate/Postgraduate—MCom or relevant specialization preferred.
Familiarity with investment accounting, performance reporting, and portfolio analytics.
Location - Mumbai

Department : Risk
Location : India
Work Experience : 1-3 years of relevant experience; exceptional fresh graduates are welcome

3. Prior experience in NBFC, fintech, digital lending or risk management is preferred.
4. Good English communication skills, strong data analysis capability and proactive problem-solving mindset.
5. Familiarity with RBI regulations or local Indian financial service ecosystem is a plus.

Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan (PMU base), with regular travel to circle locations
Experience: 8–12 years overall, with 6+ years managing multi-site delivery programs
Employment type: Full-time contractual for one year

Role Summary: 
The Project Manager will plan, execute and close a large multi-location program, leading a cross-functional team to deliver on time, within budget and to the agreed quality and service levels.

Key Responsibilities: 
Own the integrated project plan, milestones, budget and delivery schedule.
Assign clear tasks, owners and deadlines, and track completion through regular follow-up.
Lead, motivate and hold accountable a multi-disciplinary team and external vendors.
Manage client and stakeholder relationships, reviews and escalations.
Identify and resolve risks, issues and change requests proactively.
Report progress through status reports and dashboards, and ensure formal closure and sign-off.

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering
MBA/PGDM in operations or project management (preferred).
PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent certification (preferred).
Training or capacity-building programs, IT or platform rollouts,service-desk operations, andfamiliarity with the power distribution sector.
Power Sector field experience(Prefered)

Skills 
Project planning, scheduling and critical-path management
Budget, resource and vendor management
Risk, issue and change control
Good hands on knowledge of Project Management tools (MS-Project,Project Libre etc).
Tracking and reporting tools (MS Project, Excel, Jira or similar)
SLA and service-desk management.
Stakeholder communication, including with senior government or utility officials.
Fluency in English and Hindi, written and spoken; knowledge of Marwari(Prefered)

Competencies 
Excellent communication skills – Oral as well as written.
People leadership: builds, motivates and manages teams across functions.
Tech savy – Able to pick up new technologies and implement them.
Task orientation: sets clear targets, tracks closely and drives follow-through
Ownership and accountability for results
Structured problem solving and calm escalation handling
Negotiation and influencing without direct authority.

title: Assistant Manager - Branding & Digital Marketing - Jaipur
description:
Position: Assistant Manager Branding & Digital Communication 

Mandatory Background: B2B Marketing / B2B Branding / Industrial or Manufacturing-sector marketing exposure
B2B Marketing Strategy Develop and execute integrated B2B marketing plans aligned with business growth, customer acquisition, market expansion and brand-positioning objectives. 
Brand Strategy & Management Build, maintain and strengthen the corporate and business-unit brands, ensuring consistent positioning, identity, messaging, visual standards and brand guidelines across all platforms. 
Corporate Communication – External – Manage external communication including corporate announcements, press releases, company profiles, leadership communication, brochures, presentations, media content and stakeholder communication. 
Internal Communication – Design and execute structured internal communication for employees across offices, plants and business locations, including newsletters, leadership messages, organisational announcements, events and employee campaigns. 
Digital Marketing Strategy – Plan and execute the organisation's digital marketing roadmap across websites, search, social media, email marketing, online campaigns and digital platforms. 
Social Media Management – Manage corporate social-media presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and other relevant channels , with a strong focus on professional/B2B positioning and audience engagement. 
Content Strategy & Content Calendar – Develop monthly, quarterly and annual content calendars covering corporate, product, industry, employee, leadership, CSR, sustainability and business-related communication. 
Content Creation & Copywriting – Create high-quality content for social-media posts, websites, brochures, presentations, advertisements, newsletters, articles, corporate profiles, campaigns and leadership communication. 
Creative Designing & Visual Communication – Conceptualise and develop professional creatives including social-media posts, banners, brochures, infographics, posters, presentations, event collateral and digital communication materials. 
B2B Lead Generation Support – Work closely with Sales and Business Development teams to design marketing campaigns, digital assets, presentations, product communication and lead-generation initiatives supporting customer acquisition. 
Product & Technical Marketing – Translate technical/product information into compelling B2B marketing communication, product literature, brochures, application notes, case studies and customer-facing content. 
Website Management & SEO – Manage and continuously improve corporate/business websites, including content, SEO, landing pages, product information, news, careers and brand messaging to enhance visibility and organic reach. 
Performance Marketing & Analytics – Track digital and social-media performance using defined KPIs such as impressions, engagement, website traffic, leads, conversions and campaign ROI; prepare periodic management dashboards. 
Employer Branding – Partner with HR to strengthen employer branding through employee stories, workplace initiatives, career communication, leadership positioning, recruitment campaigns and organisational achievements. 
Leadership & Executive Branding – Support positioning of senior leadership through thought-leadership articles, LinkedIn content, industry perspectives, speeches, interviews, presentations and external communication. 
CSR, ESG & Sustainability Communication – Develop communication around CSR initiatives, community-development programmes, sustainability, HSE and responsible-business practices for both internal and external audiences. 
Corporate Events & Exhibitions – Support branding and communication for exhibitions, trade fairs, conferences, annual meetings, customer events, product launches, employee events and corporate programmes. 
Agency & Vendor Management – Coordinate with digital agencies, graphic designers, printers, photographers, videographers, media agencies and other vendors while managing quality, timelines and budgets. 
Brand Governance Across Businesses – Ensure uniform brand standards across the Group's different companies, plants, offices, products and communication channels, while appropriately differentiating individual business brands. 
Marketing MIS, Budget & ROI – Prepare annual marketing plans and budgets, maintain activity trackers, monitor vendor expenditure, evaluate campaign effectiveness and present periodic marketing/branding performance reports to management. 

Key profile requirement
Prior experience in B2B Marketing, Branding and Digital Marketing is mandatory. Candidates with only B2C, retail, lifestyle, influencer or consumer-social-media experience will not be considered. 

Preference will be given to candidates having exposure to Manufacturing, Minerals, Chemicals, Industrial Products, B2B Services, Engineering or allied sectors.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Summary: 
As a Snowflake Architect you will design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance Snowflake architectures across multiple projects and teams. Your typical day will involve collaborating with Integration Architects and Data Architects to ensure cohesive integration between systems and data models, while also engaging in discussions to refine and enhance the overall data architecture. You will be involved in various stages of the data platform lifecycle, ensuring that all components work harmoniously to support the organization's data needs and objectives. From CoE perspective, you will collaborate closely on presales, support delivery teams, and lead the design and execution of POVs and POCs.

Roles & Responsibilities: 
Project Role : Snowflake Architect
Project Role Description : Lead design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performance Snowflake architectures across multiple projects and teams. Contributes to CoE initiatives by creating guidelines, frameworks, and reference architectures to ensure consistency and scalability across projects.
- Lead Snowflake solutions across data ingestion, storage, transformation, and access.
- Lead capability growth initiatives by mentoring team members, driving POCs, and contributing to knowledge repositories.
- Provide pre-sales support, including proposal creation, estimations, solutioning, and client presentations.
- Define data modeling standards, physical schema designs, and best practices for structured and semi-structured data.
- Familiar with Snowflake s advanced features, including Snowpark, Iceberg tables, dynamic tables, snowpipe streaming, SPCS, authentication & authorization methods, alerts, performance tuning, row level security, masking, tagging, etc.
- Stay abreast of evolving Snowflake and GenAI capabilities recommend and pilot new tools and frameworks.
--Good to have skills on DBT and Fivetran.

Professional & Technical Skills: 
- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Snowflake Data Warehouse, SnowPro Core Certification(must)
Good to have skills : dbt, Fivetran, GenAI Features in Snowflake
- Deep Expertise in Data Engineering.
- Strong communication skills.
Additional Information:
- The candidate should have a minimum of 15 years of experience in Snowflake Data Warehouse.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role

At Group Mukkadan | Caspian , we are looking for a passionate and result-oriented Digital Marketing & Social Media Manager to build, lead, and scale our digital presence across the Groups diverse business verticals.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic thinker and hands-on digital marketing professional who can develop impactful marketing strategies, strengthen brand visibility, generate quality leads, and translate digital opportunities into measurable business growth.
The selected candidate will be responsible for building our digital marketing function from the ground up, managing end-to-end digital initiatives, and developing an in-house team to support the Groups long-term growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities
1. Digital Marketing Strategy & Brand Building
Develop and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies aligned with the Groups business objectives.
Build and strengthen brand identity and online visibility across multiple business verticals.
Plan and execute integrated digital campaigns to improve brand awareness, engagement, and business growth.
Ensure consistent brand communication across all digital platforms.
2. SEO, SEM & Performance Marketing
Lead Search Engine Optimisation (SEO), Search Engine Marketing (SEM), and paid advertising initiatives.
Manage Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other relevant digital advertising platforms.
Optimise campaigns for lead generation, conversion rates, cost per lead, and return on advertising spend (ROAS).
Monitor campaign performance and implement data-driven improvements.
3. Social Media Management & Content Strategy
Develop and execute social media strategies for platforms such as LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube.
Plan monthly content calendars, campaign themes, brand storytelling, and audience engagement initiatives.
Oversee the creation of graphics, videos, reels, promotional creatives, and other digital content.
Monitor social media performance, audience trends, and competitor activities.
Maintain a consistent and professional brand presence across all social media channels.
4. Website Optimisation & Lead Generation
Manage and optimise company websites and landing pages for user experience, search visibility, and conversions.
Develop digital lead-generation campaigns tailored to individual business verticals.
Track website traffic, visitor behaviour, lead quality, and conversion performance using analytics tools.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders to improve lead follow-up and campaign effectiveness.
5. AI-Driven Search Optimisation
Implement Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), and AI-driven search visibility strategies.
Optimise digital content for AI-powered search platforms and emerging discovery channels.
Stay updated on digital marketing trends, automation tools, AI applications, and evolving search algorithms.
6. Team Building & Leadership
Build, manage, and lead an in-house digital marketing team.
Establish workflows, campaign calendars, performance benchmarks, and accountability mechanisms.
Coordinate with designers, content creators, agencies, vendors, and internal business teams.
Take ownership of end-to-end execution while providing strategic direction and mentoring team members.
7. Analytics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) across digital marketing channels.
Prepare periodic reports on website traffic, engagement, lead generation, campaign performance, and marketing ROI.
Use data and insights to identify growth opportunities and improve campaign effectiveness.
Manage digital marketing budgets efficiently and ensure optimal utilisation of resources.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
5 - 10 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, SEO, and social media management.
Demonstrated experience in planning and executing end-to-end digital marketing campaigns.
Strong knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, SEO, SEM, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and Google Search Console.
Experience in content strategy, social media management, website optimisation, and lead-generation campaigns.
Working knowledge of AEO, GEO, AI-powered search optimisation, and marketing automation tools.
Strong analytical, communication, project management, and team leadership skills.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver measurable results.
A hands-on approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Preferred: 
Experience building a digital marketing function or in-house team from scratch, managing multiple brands or business verticals, and working in B2B, infrastructure, logistics, real estate, or diversified business groups.

What We Offer
An opportunity to build and lead the Groups digital marketing function from the ground up.
Direct involvement in brand strategy and business growth initiatives across multiple verticals.
Scope to build an in-house team and implement innovative digital marketing practices.
A challenging, ownership-driven role with opportunities for professional growth.

Work Requirements
Work Mode: Completely onsite; remote and hybrid work options are not available.
Working Schedule: 6 days a week.
Location: Kochi, Kerala.

Who Should Apply?
We are looking for someone who enjoys building things, takes ownership, thinks strategically, and executes hands-on. If you are passionate about digital growth, brand building, emerging AI-driven marketing trends, and leading a team to deliver measurable business outcomes, we would love to hear from you.

Join Group Mukkadan | Caspian and help build our next phase of digital growth.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING specialist 
Full-Time | In-Office | Vyttila, Kochi 

we are Vyttila-based business operating in the air-conditioning, refrigeration, and appliance parts segment. The business caters to customer requirements for AC-related products and spare parts and serves both retail and wholesale customers.
Position Overview 
We are looking for a creative and result-oriented Digital Marketing Manager to manage and strengthen companies digital presence. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in digital marketing, social media management, content creation, and video editing, with a strong understanding of current digital trends.
Job Details 
Position: Digital Marketing specialist 
Experience: 1-2 years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: In-Office
Location: Vyttila, Kochi
Salary: Performance-based / As per experience and performance
Key Responsibilities 

Plan and execute digital marketing strategies to increase brand visibility and customer engagement.
Manage the companies social media platforms and maintain a consistent content calendar.
Create engaging posts, reels, promotional creatives, and other digital content.
Shoot and edit short-form videos for social media and promotional campaigns.
Monitor social media trends and identify opportunities to improve online reach and engagement.
Plan and support paid digital campaigns across relevant platforms.
Track basic campaign and social media performance and prepare regular reports.
Coordinate digital content and campaigns in line with the companies products and business goals.
Required Skills & Competencies 

1-2 years of practical experience in Digital Marketing, Social Media Marketing, or a related role.
Strong knowledge of social media platforms and content marketing.
Good video editing skills with knowledge of CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar software.
Ability to create attractive and engaging visual and video content.
Basic understanding of Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, and digital campaign performance.
Creative thinking with a good eye for content, design, and current social media trends.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and deliver results.
Educational Qualification 
Bachelors degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. Relevant digital marketing certifications or practical experience will be an added advantage.
Ideal Candidate 
A proactive and creative professional who can take ownership of the companies digital marketing activities, create quality content, and contribute to growing companies online presence and customer reach.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Role & responsibilities 

Key Responsibilities
Act as a liaison between business and technology teams, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation.
Gather and analyse business requirements through client meetings, stakeholder discussions, and requirement-gathering sessions.
Engage with clients to understand business needs, processes, challenges, and expectations and translate them into clear and structured requirements.
Document current-state (as-is) and future-state (to-be) processes, business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, and process flows.
Prepare and maintain BRDs, SRS/FRDs, user stories, process documentation, and other requirement artefacts.
Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, iteration planning, story writing, and other Agile delivery activities.
Clarify requirements and resolve questions for development, QA, design, and other delivery teams.
Work closely with Project Managers, Developers, Designers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to ensure requirements are correctly understood and implemented.
Collaborate with the Design/UX team by reviewing designs and providing business and user-experience feedback to ensure the solution meets business and user expectations.
Facilitate client and internal meetings, document Minutes of Meetings, decisions, and action items, and ensure timely follow-ups.
Maintain requirement traceability and version control throughout the project lifecycle.
Identify requirement gaps, inconsistencies, dependencies, risks, and potential issues early and communicate them to relevant stakeholders.
Coordinate project activities and support tracking of requirements, deliverables, milestones, and dependencies.
Manage and document change requests and communicate their impact to stakeholders.
Support UAT and validate delivered functionality from a business and end-user perspective.
Contribute to proposal preparation, requirement analysis, presales activities, when required.
Contribute to process improvement initiatives by analysing workflows and recommending improvements.
Collaborate with sales, operations, and project teams to support business growth and successful project delivery.
Stay updated with industry trends, business analysis practices, Agile methodologies, tools, and emerging technologies.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
The Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for analysing business data, identifying actionable insights, developing analytical solutions, and supporting data-driven decision-making across the organisation.
The role will work closely with business and functional stakeholders to understand requirements, develop dashboards and analytical models, automate reporting processes, and provide meaningful insights to support business performance and strategic initiatives.

Role & responsibilities: 
1. Business Analysis & Insights
Analyse business data to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and areas requiring attention.
Translate business objectives and requirements into meaningful analytical solutions.
Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis to support business decisions.
Develop actionable insights and recommendations based on data analysis.
Perform business and performance analysis across relevant functions, products, processes, and customer segments.
2. Reporting & Business Intelligence
Develop and maintain management reports, dashboards, and performance tracking mechanisms.
Automate recurring reporting processes and improve reporting efficiency.
Define, track, and monitor business KPIs and performance metrics.
Ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of analytical outputs.
Develop intuitive and user-friendly dashboards for business and management stakeholders.
3. Data Analysis & Modelling
Work with large and diverse datasets from multiple sources.
Perform data extraction, cleansing, transformation, validation, and analysis.
Develop analytical models and datasets to support business requirements.
Identify data-quality issues and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
Establish and maintain appropriate data definitions, business rules, and analytical methodologies.
4. Business Requirements & Stakeholder Management
Engage with business and functional stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
Work collaboratively with technology, data, and business teams to deliver analytical projects.
Present analytical findings and insights to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
Manage multiple analytical requirements and deliverables within agreed timelines.
Act as a bridge between business users and technical/data teams where required.
5. Process Automation & Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to automate manual, repetitive, and time-consuming processes.
Develop data-driven solutions to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
Leverage Python, SQL, Power BI, Excel, and other relevant technologies for reporting and process automation.
Evaluate and implement appropriate analytical and automation tools.
Continuously improve existing reports, dashboards, processes, and analytical frameworks.
6. Advanced Analytics
Perform exploratory and advanced data analysis to address business problems.
Develop analytical models for forecasting, segmentation, classification, propensity analysis, and other business use cases as required.
Support business planning, scenario analysis, and performance forecasting.
Conduct ad-hoc analysis and deep dives to support strategic and operational requirements.
7. Management & Strategic Support
Prepare analytical inputs for management reviews, business presentations, and strategic initiatives.
Convert complex data and analysis into concise, business-friendly insights.
Support cross-functional and strategic projects through data-backed analysis.
Track and report progress against key business initiatives and objectives.

Key Deliverables 
Business performance dashboards and management reports
Automated MIS and reporting solutions
Business and performance analytics
Analytical models and data-driven insights
Data-driven process improvement and automation
Ad-hoc and advanced analytics
Management and strategic presentation inputs
Standardised KPIs, business definitions, and analytical frameworks
Data quality and reporting improvements

Preferred candidate profile: 
Technical Skills Mandatory 
Strong Python programming and data analysis skills, with hands-on experience using libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, and other relevant analytical libraries.
Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, manipulation, and analysis.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Power Query, Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, and data modelling.
Strong working knowledge of Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, data modelling, dashboard development, and visualisation.
Strong understanding of data preparation, data manipulation, and analytical techniques.
Ability to work with large and complex datasets from multiple sources.
Ability to develop automated and repeatable analytical and reporting solutions.

Technical Skills Preferred
Exposure to statistical modelling, machine learning, or predictive analytics.
Knowledge of databases, data warehouses, and ETL processes.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and enterprise BI environments.
Experience in automating analytical and reporting workflows.
Familiarity with Git/version control and software development practices for analytical solutions.

Business & Behavioural Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into data-driven solutions.
Strong business acumen and ability to understand business processes and performance drivers.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to present complex analysis in a simple, clear, and actionable manner.
Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Strong ownership and accountability.
Proactive approach towards automation, process improvement, and innovation.
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

Qualification & Experience 
Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
MBA / PGDM in Business Analytics, Finance, Operations, or a related field would be an advantage.
5 to 8 years of relevant experience in Business Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, MIS, or a similar role. 
Hands-on experience in Python, SQL, Power BI, and Advanced Excel is required. 
Experience in developing business dashboards, analytical models, automated reporting solutions, and management reports.
Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and translating business requirements into analytical solutions.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Job Title: Senior Project Manager 
Experience Required: 8-12 Years
Location: Mohali, Punjab (On-site)
Employment Type: Full-time

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Senior Project Manager who has proven expertise in end-to-end product/project management, client handling, technical delivery, and cross-functional leadership .

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in managing software products and complex IT projects , working directly with international clients, understanding technical requirements, and leading engineering teams toward successful product delivery.

The candidate should be capable of acting as a bridge between clients, business stakeholders, product teams, engineering, QA, design, and leadership , while ensuring that projects/products are delivered with the right balance of scope, quality, timelines, budget, and business value .
Experience in AI/ML, Generative AI, Automation, SaaS, FinTech, or other technology-driven products will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities 

Product & Project Leadership 
Own the end-to-end lifecycle of software products and projects , from discovery and requirement gathering through development, deployment, and continuous improvement.
Take ownership of product/project roadmap, priorities, milestones, releases, dependencies, and delivery plans .
Work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Engineering, QA, UI/UX, DevOps, and other teams to ensure seamless execution.
Translate business objectives and client requirements into clear technical and functional deliverables .
Ensure that product features and project deliverables are aligned with business goals and customer expectations.
Manage multiple projects/products simultaneously while maintaining visibility on priorities, timelines, resources, and risks.
Drive projects from requirements planning development testing deployment production support .

Client Management & Stakeholder Handling 
Act as a senior point of contact for clients , building strong and long-term professional relationships.
Lead client discussions related to requirements, project planning, delivery status, priorities, risks, dependencies, and escalations.
Conduct regular client meetings, product demos, sprint reviews, steering committee meetings, and project status reviews .
Understand client business objectives and proactively identify opportunities for product enhancement, process improvement, automation, and technology adoption .
Manage client expectations effectively and handle difficult conversations with professionalism and confidence.
Present project/product progress, challenges, risks, KPIs, and plans to senior client stakeholders.
Identify potential issues before they become escalations and ensure timely resolution.

Technical Leadership 
Possess strong technical understanding of software architecture, SDLC, APIs, databases, cloud technologies, integrations, application development, QA, and deployment processes .
Work closely with technical leads and architects to understand technical feasibility, dependencies, risks, and implementation approaches.
Review and challenge technical approaches where required while collaborating with Engineering/Architecture teams.
Understand system integrations, third-party dependencies, technical constraints, security considerations, and scalability requirements.
Participate in technical discussions and effectively communicate complex technical concepts to business and non-technical stakeholders .
Ensure that technical decisions support product objectives, scalability, maintainability, security, and long-term business requirements.

Product Management & Roadmap 
Collaborate with clients, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to define and prioritize product features and enhancements .
Support creation and management of product roadmaps, release plans, backlogs, and feature priorities .
Evaluate requirements based on business value, technical complexity, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
Drive product releases and ensure all stakeholders are aligned on scope and priorities.
Monitor product performance, customer feedback, adoption, and improvement opportunities.
Work with teams to continuously improve product quality, usability, performance, and customer experience.

Delivery & Agile Management 
Lead Agile/Scrum practices including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, Backlog Refinement, and Release Planning .
Track project health through scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, risks, and dependencies .
Establish project KPIs and maintain dashboards for leadership and client visibility.
Manage project risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
Proactively identify delivery bottlenecks and drive corrective actions.
Ensure effective resource allocation, capacity planning, estimation, and forecasting.
Manage scope changes through appropriate impact analysis and stakeholder approvals.
Ensure adherence to organizational delivery processes, quality standards, and governance frameworks.

Leadership & Team Management 
Lead and mentor cross-functional teams comprising Developers, Technical Leads, QA Engineers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, UI/UX Designers, DevOps, and AI/ML professionals .
Establish accountability and ensure team members have clear goals, priorities, and deliverables.
Resolve conflicts, remove blockers, and create an environment focused on collaboration and delivery excellence.
Support performance discussions, team development, knowledge sharing, and succession planning.
Work closely with senior leadership on strategic projects, delivery challenges, client escalations, and business priorities.

Required Skills & Experience 

10-15 years of experience in the IT/software industry with significant experience in Project Management, Product Management, or Delivery Management .
Proven experience managing software products and complex technology projects from conception to production.
Strong experience in client-facing roles , preferably working with international clients.
Excellent understanding of SDLC, Agile/Scrum methodologies, software development, testing, deployment, and production environments .
Strong technical understanding of modern software development ecosystems, with exposure to the MERN stack, React.js, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, and related web technologies .
Ability to understand technical architecture, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and application development concepts .
Proven experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, releases, feature prioritization, and product enhancements .
Strong experience in stakeholder management across technical, business, product, and leadership teams.

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in AWS and Azure cloud platforms to design, implement, and manage scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure. Set up and manage monitoring, logging, and alerting systems
Automate infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools
Optimize cloud costs, performance, and reliability

Collaborate with development, QA, and architecture teams

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, container orchestration
Solid understanding of networking, security, and cloud architecture
Experience managing production-scale environments
Strong troubleshooting and automation mindset

Nice to Have 
Experience with AI/ML infrastructure or data pipelines
Knowledge of serverless architectures
Experience with performance optimization and cost governance
Certifications in AWS/Azure DevOps or Cloud Architecture

description:
Job Description: Digital Marketing Manager
Experience: 10-18 years (IT Industry)
Location : Mohali (WFO)

About the Role 

Signity Software Solutions is seeking an experienced and innovative Digital Marketing Manager to lead, strategise, and optimise our digital marketing initiatives across all channels. The ideal candidate will have a strong grasp of current marketing tools and strategies and will be capable of leading integrated campaigns from concept to execution.

Key Responsibilities : 

Strategy Development 
Develop and execute integrated digital marketing strategies (SEO, SEM, email, social
media, display).
Drive brand visibility and qualified lead generation to support business growth.

Campaign Management 
Measure and report performance of all digital campaigns against KPIs and ROI.
Optimize campaigns using insights from analytics and conversion data.

Content Management 
Coordinate with teams to create high-converting landing pages and digital content.
Oversee content distribution to align with lead generation goals.

Data & Revenue Analysis 
Analyze user journeys across touchpoints to improve conversion funnels.
Track marketing-attributed revenue and optimize lead acquisition costs.

SEO and SEM 
Develop SEO strategies to increase organic traffic and search rankings.
Manage paid campaigns on Google and Bing for high-quality lead generation.

Social Media Management 
Grow brand presence and engagement across social platforms.
Oversee day-to-day content and performance of social channels.

Email Marketing 
Plan and execute lead-nurturing email campaigns to boost engagement.
Monitor open, click-through, and conversion rates to improve performance.

Lead Generation & Revenue Growth 
Design and run demand generation campaigns targeting qualified leads.
Collaborate with sales to align marketing with pipeline and revenue goals.

Budget Management 
Allocate and manage budgets to ensure cost-effective campaign performance.
Track and report spending, ROI, and overall budget efficiency.

Key Requirements : 
Experience: 10-18 years with at least 8 years in a IT industry and managing a team of at least 10 people.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field.
Strong leadership and communication skills to manage teams and collaborate across departments.
Hands-on experience in performance marketing, lead generation, and analytics.
Strong understanding of digital marketing concepts, strategies, and best practices.
Hands-on experience with SEO, PPC, email marketing, and social media.
Proficiency in web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics) and marketing software(e.g., HubSpot, Marketo).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Up-to-date with the latest trends and tools in digital marketing.

What We Offer 
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A dynamic and collaborative work environment.
Opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions.
Career growth opportunities in a fast-paced and innovative organization.

title: Salesforce Business Analyst
description:
Salesforce Business Analyst (Mid-Level) 4-7 Years 

Role Overview 

The Salesforce Business Analyst manages all requirements for assigned modules or projects. They serve as the main link between business 
stakeholders and Salesforce delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities 
Lead requirement discovery and analysis sessions with business stakeholders 
Examine business processes and convert them into Salesforce functional requirements 
Create and maintain Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs), user stories, and acceptance 
criteria. 
Ensure alignment between documented requirements and Salesforce solution design 
Assist with sprint planning, backlog refinement, and clarifying scope. 
Examine integration needs, data mappings, and functional changes. 
Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT) from a functional view and help with business sign-off. 
Spot functional risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement. 

Required Skills & Experience 

1. 4 to 7 years of Business Analyst experience with Salesforce implementations. 
2. Strong understanding of the Salesforce data model, standard objects, automation, and security model. 
3. Experience in Agile or Scrum environments. 
4. Strong skills in managing stakeholders and communicating effectively. 
5. Proficient with Jira, Confluence, and documentation tools. 
6. Salesforce BA/Admin certification is preferred. 
7. BA / Agile Certifications valued

Success Measures 
Stable requirements with little change.

title: Deputy Project Manager - Underground Metro
description:
Role & responsibilities 

Lead day-to-day execution of the complete underground metro EPC package and translate the Project Director's strategic objectives into measurable construction, engineering and commercial deliverables.
Lead the multidisciplinary project team, establish clear accountability across construction and functional leads, develop second-line leadership, resolve cross-functional conflicts and deputize for the Project Director whenever required , ensuring continuity of decision-making and overall project governance. Large-project directors are expected to lead multidisciplinary teams and provide strategic direction and decision-making
Direct execution of underground works encompassing TBM tunnelling, shafts, cross-passages, cut-and-cover structures, underground stations and associated civil works , ensuring constructability and integration across work fronts.
Provide senior management oversight of TBM launch, tunnelling operations, segment logistics, muck disposal, ground conditioning, interventions and breakthrough activities, with strong focus on productivity and geological risk management.
Drive construction of underground stations including diaphragm walls, piling, excavation, temporary/permanent supports, waterproofing, base slabs, concourse/platform structures, architectural works and associated interfaces.
Own the integrated execution strategy and closely monitor baseline schedule, critical path, milestones, look-ahead plans, productivity and recovery programmes , initiating corrective action wherever slippages threaten contractual milestones.
Coordinate with design/engineering teams to ensure timely issuance and closure of drawings, design submissions, shop drawings, method statements, RFIs and constructability reviews while preventing engineering delays at site.
Support the Project Director in managing project financial performance through budgetary control, cost-to-complete forecasting, productivity improvement, resource optimization, subcontract cost control and prevention of cost leakage . Financial oversight is a core Project Director responsibility in major construction projects.
Ensure rigorous contractual administration covering notices, variations, additional works, EOT/claims, contractual correspondence, records and substantiation, while protecting the EPC contractor's contractual and commercial interests.
Act as a senior interface with the Metro Authority/Client, General Consultant/Engineer/PMC and other key stakeholders , driving decisions, approvals and resolution of critical execution issues. Client and stakeholder relationship management is consistently identified as a core Project Director responsibility.
Oversee performance of major civil, tunnelling, specialist and finishing subcontractors covering mobilization, productivity, contractual performance, resource adequacy, billing interfaces and recovery of underperforming packages.
Ensure timely procurement of long-lead and critical materials/equipment such as TBM consumables/spares, precast segments, reinforcement, concrete inputs, waterproofing systems, temporary works equipment and specialist construction systems in alignment with the project schedule.
Review manpower, plant, machinery, TBM resources and specialist capabilities across work fronts and dynamically redeploy resources to maximize utilization, productivity and schedule performance.
Champion a zero-harm safety culture , particularly for high-risk underground activities such as tunnelling, deep excavation, heavy lifting, confined-space working, temporary works and movement of heavy equipment. Senior project leadership is expected to drive safety and environmental compliance. 
Ensure compliance with approved specifications, drawings, ITPs and quality plans while driving right-first-time construction, NCR closure, defect prevention, waterproofing integrity and systematic handover documentation.
Maintain executive oversight of project risks including geotechnical uncertainty, settlement, utilities, adjacent structures, groundwater, TBM performance, interface delays, access constraints, stakeholder issues and schedule/commercial exposure , with defined mitigation and contingency measures.
Establish robust coordination between Civil, TBM, Design, Architecture, Track, MEP, E&M, Systems and other interfacing contractors , ensuring civil/interface requirements are incorporated before construction and handover.
Drive resolution of utility diversions, road/traffic diversions, access constraints and interfaces with statutory/local authorities and affected stakeholders to maintain uninterrupted construction fronts.
Institutionalize strong project governance through periodic reviews of physical progress, earned/value performance as applicable, schedule variance, cost forecast, cash flow, billing, procurement, design status, risks, claims and key management interventions , escalating critical deviations with recovery actions.
Ensure progressive completion and handover of civil/structural areas, interface clearances, as-built documentation, snag rectification and readiness for architectural, MEP, track and systems installation through to project completion.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About the Role 
Vected Technologies is seeking a Data Engineer to join its growing technology team in Indore. The role focuses on developing reliable and scalable data pipelines, integrating data from multiple sources, optimizing data workflows, and working with modern cloud data platforms.
Key Responsibilities 
• Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration workflows.
• Build and optimize data pipelines using Python, SQL, and SQL Server.
• Work with Databricks and Snowflake for data processing, transformation, storage, and analytics workloads.
• Implement data validation, quality checks, monitoring, and error-handling mechanisms.
• Contribute to data architecture, data modeling, and performance optimization initiatives.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Use Azure DevOps and Microsoft Fabric as part of modern data engineering workflows.
• Troubleshoot pipeline and data issues and continuously improve reliability, scalability, and performance.

Required Qualifications & Skills 
• 1+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering or a closely related role.
• Strong hands-on experience with ETL development and data integration.
• Proficiency in Python and SQL, with practical experience in SQL Server. • Hands-on experience with Databricks and Snowflake.
• Working knowledge of Azure DevOps and Microsoft Fabric. 
• Good understanding of data architecture, data modeling, and pipeline optimization.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. 

Preferred Attributes 
• Experience with cloud-based data platforms and enterprise data environments.
• Strong ownership mindset with attention to data quality and production reliability.
• Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Passion for building scalable, maintainable, and high-performance data solutions.

title: Graphic Designer

We are looking for a creative and skilled Graphic Designer with a strong understanding of visual communication, design principles, and industry trends. The ideal candidate should be able to create visually appealing and impactful designs that effectively communicate brand messages and engage the target audience.

Key Responsibilities 
Create engaging creatives for social media, digital campaigns, advertisements, websites, and marketing collaterals.
Design graphics, banners, infographics, brochures, presentations, and promotional materials.
Understand the impact of colours, typography, layouts, and visual elements on audience perception and engagement.

Ability to create platform-specific designs aligned with marketing objectives.
Creative thinking, attention to detail, and a strong sense of aesthetics.
A strong portfolio showcasing diverse creative work.
What We Expect 
A designer who goes beyond aesthetics, understands why a design works, stays ahead of industry trends, and knows how to create visuals that are not just attractive but meaningful, engaging, and impactful.

title: Azure Devops Engineer
description:
Role: Senior Cloud Engineer / Azure DevOps Engineer
Role Overview 
We are looking for an experienced Cloud Engineer with 9+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Azure, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), particularly Terraform. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, automating, and supporting secure, scalable, and highly available cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
The role requires strong technical expertise in Azure cloud services, CI/CD automation, Terraform, Kubernetes, and cloud security, along with the ability to work with architects, developers, and operations teams.
Key Responsibilities 
1. Azure Cloud Engineering 
Design and implement Azure infrastructure across development, testing, pre-production, and production environments.
Manage Azure Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, and Private Endpoints.
Implement and manage Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure App Services, Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Container Registry.
Configure Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and cloud alerting.
Implement high availability, disaster recovery, backup, and cloud cost optimisation.
2. Terraform & Infrastructure as Code 
Develop reusable, modular Terraform code for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
Design and maintain Terraform modules, variables, state management, and environment-specific configurations.
Implement remote Terraform state using Azure Storage with appropriate state locking and access controls.
Manage Terraform plan, apply, destroy, and import operations.
Establish infrastructure deployment standards, code reviews, and automated validation.
Experience with Terraform Cloud or Enterprise is desirable.
3. Azure DevOps & CI/CD 
Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
Develop YAML-based build and release pipelines.
Automate infrastructure deployment using Terraform through Azure DevOps pipelines.
Implement approval gates, environment-based deployments, and release strategies.
Integrate security scanning, code quality checks, and automated testing.
Manage Azure Repos, Boards, Artifacts, and pipeline permissions.
4. Kubernetes & Containerisation 
Deploy and manage containerised applications on AKS.
Configure Kubernetes namespaces, deployments, services, ingress, secrets, and autoscaling.
Work with Docker, Helm, and Kubernetes configuration.
Troubleshoot container, networking, and application deployment issues.
Implement monitoring and logging for containerised workloads.
5. Security & Governance 
Implement Azure RBAC, Managed Identities, Key Vault, and least-privilege access.
Configure secure authentication using Microsoft Entra ID.
Implement network security, private connectivity, and secrets management.
Follow Azure security, compliance, and enterprise cloud governance standards.
6. Production Support & Technical Leadership 
Provide L3 support for Azure infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and Terraform deployments.
Troubleshoot production incidents and perform root-cause analysis.
Support cloud migration and modernisation initiatives.
Create technical documentation, operational runbooks, and architecture diagrams.
Mentor junior and mid-level cloud engineers.

title: Digital Marketing & B2B Growth Specialist
description:
ThoughtMakes is an emerging industrial technology company building iTraceX an Industrial Execution & Intelligence Platform , enabling manufacturing enterprises to digitally connect production, materials, quality, traceability and industrial operations.
With an established presence in India and a newly incorporated entity in Dubai, we are expanding our digital footprint and enterprise market reach across India and the UAE.
Role Overview 
We are looking for a highly driven, creative and AI-savvy Digital Marketing & B2B Growth Specialist to independently build and execute our digital marketing initiatives.
The role focuses on strengthening our digital brand, building market visibility, generating qualified B2B leads and leveraging the latest AI technologies to accelerate marketing effectiveness.
Key Responsibilities: 
Digital Strategy & Brand Building 
Develop and execute digital marketing strategies for India and UAE markets.
Strengthen ThoughtMakes and iTraceX visibility across LinkedIn, Google and relevant digital channels.
Build compelling industrial technology messaging, case studies, product content and thought-leadership campaigns.
AI-Powered Marketing & Content 
Leverage ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva AI and other AI tools for content creation, research, design and campaign execution.
Create engaging LinkedIn content, technical blogs, product explainers, videos and marketing collateral.
Develop AI-assisted marketing workflows to improve content quality, speed and consistency.
SEO, AI Search & Website Growth 
Drive SEO, website optimization and organic traffic growth.
Improve discoverability across search engines and AI-powered search platforms through SEO, AEO and GEO practices.
Develop targeted landing pages for MES, Industry 4.0, industrial execution and manufacturing digital transformation.
B2B Lead Generation & Growth 
Plan and execute LinkedIn and Google Ads campaigns.
Implement account-based marketing targeting manufacturing enterprises and industrial decision-makers.
Generate and nurture qualified B2B leads in India and the UAE.
Collaborate with leadership and business development teams to support sales pipeline growth.
Marketing Automation & Analytics 
Implement AI-powered marketing automation using tools such as Zoho CRM, HubSpot, n8n, Make or Zapier.
Monitor campaign performance, website traffic, lead quality and conversions.
Build marketing dashboards and provide actionable growth insights.
Required Skills 
36 years of hands-on digital marketing experience, preferably in B2B technology, SaaS, enterprise software or IT services.
Strong experience in LinkedIn marketing, SEO, Google Ads, content marketing and lead generation.
Practical experience using generative AI tools for marketing.
Excellent written and verbal English communication.
Strong analytical, creative and campaign execution capabilities.
Ability to independently manage digital marketing initiatives in a fast-paced startup environment.
Preferred Skills 
Experience in international B2B marketing, especially UAE/GCC markets.
Exposure to AI search optimization (AEO/GEO), account-based marketing and marketing automation.
Familiarity with industrial software, MES, ERP, Industry 4.0 or industrial automation.
Experience with CRM, marketing analytics and AI workflow automation tools.
Why Join ThoughtMakes? 
Build the digital marketing function for a growing industrial technology platform.
Drive market visibility and enterprise growth across India and the UAE.
Work directly with leadership and product teams.
Experiment with emerging AI-powered marketing technologies.
Enjoy high ownership, autonomy and performance-driven career growth.
We are looking for a hands-on digital growth builder, not just a social media manager. 

Interested candidates can reach out to the below contact person,

N. Sowmiya
HR Manager
7397748008

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
About Mallow Technologies 

Mallow Technologies is a product engineering company that builds digital products for businesses across the globe. We partner with clients to design, build, and scale software end to end.

In 16+ years, our team of 250+ has delivered 125+ projects for 95+ clients across the USA, UK, Canada, Europe and India, most on long-term, repeat engagements. Were ISO 27001 certified, an AWS Advanced Tier Partner and a Salesforce Consulting Partner.

About the Role 

We’re looking for a Senior Product Owner who can be trusted with a client from the very first conversation.

Our Product Owners step in once the problem is identified and the high-level direction is set. You step in before that: working with client leadership to uncover what’s really going on, frame the right problem and set the direction. Then you own the product all the way through to a working release in users’ hands.

Alongside your own products, you’ll guide our Product Owners: reviewing their calls, raising their bar, and stepping in when a client needs a senior voice. This role is for someone who has done this under real delivery pressure. You’ll be the person others turn to when things get ambiguous.

Key Responsibilities 

Lead discovery with client stakeholders: understand the business context, uncover the real problem, and agree on success measures before anything is built.
Set product direction and own the roadmap, turning business goals into a clear, sequenced plan that stays honest as things change.
Own a larger client account or several products end to end, from solution definition to a live product users actually adopt.
Make and defend hard prioritization calls, including telling a client “not now” when a request won’t serve their goals, without damaging the relationship.
Be the senior point of contact for client leadership: run steering conversations, handle escalations, and raise risks early with options, not just problems.
Shape solutions with engineering and design, weighing trade-offs to find what’s right for users, viable for the business and feasible to build.
Define how success is measured: set the metrics, read delivery and usage data critically, and use them for go/no-go calls on releases and scale-up.
Guide and review the work of our Product Owners, from backlog quality and decisions to client communication, and help them grow into senior roles.
Support new engagements by shaping the first-phase scope, team mix and ramp-up plan alongside delivery and sales.
Raise the bar on product practice across Mallow, including how we use AI tools for scoping, solutioning and rapid prototyping.

What We’re Looking For 

5+ years of total experience, with at least 4 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager on software delivery projects.
A track record of owning products from discovery through go-live and beyond, ideally for external clients in a services or consulting setting.
Direct experience with senior client stakeholders, including international clients, and with hard conversations on scope, timelines and priorities.
Strong product judgement: comfortable with ambiguity and trade-offs, questions data instead of taking it at face value, and decides without perfect information.
Experience guiding or mentoring Product Owners, Business Analysts or other product team members.
Clear, concise communication, written and spoken, for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Deep working knowledge of Agile/Scrum, backlog management and release planning, with the judgement to adapt process to each engagement model.
Hands-on with AI tools for scoping, solutioning and rapid prototyping, and able to show others how to use them well.

Nice to Have 

Pre-sales or solutioning experience, shaping scope and first-phase plans for new clients.
Experience with products that include AI or GenAI features.
A product owner certification such as CSPO or PSPO.

What You Can Expect 

Senior ownership from day one: lead client accounts from the first conversation to a live product.
A real say in how engagements are shaped, from first-phase scoping to delivery governance.
A close-knit team of designers, engineers, QA and Product Owners who care about building things well.
A diverse mix of domains and clients across the USA, UK, Canada, Europe and India.
A clear path into product and delivery leadership as our product practice grows.

title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
description:
Role & responsibilities 

We are looking for a creative, result-oriented Digital Marketing Coordinator to manage and execute digital marketing activities for our hypermarket and mall operations. The candidate will be responsible for strengthening brand visibility, managing social media platforms, promoting retail offers and mall events, driving customer engagement, and generating footfall through innovative digital campaigns.
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in social media management, digital advertising, content creation, influencer marketing, campaign execution, and performance analytics, preferably in the retail, hypermarket, shopping mall, or hospitality industry.
Key Responsibilities 
1. Digital Marketing & Social Media Management 
Develop and execute digital media plans aligned with business and marketing objectives.
Manage and grow social media accounts across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
Create engaging content to promote the hypermarket, mall, retail outlets, brands, offers, and customer experiences.
Ensure consistent growth in followers, reach, engagement, and overall brand visibility.
Monitor social media trends, competitor activities, and emerging digital marketing tools.
2. Retail Promotions & Mall Marketing 
Plan and execute digital campaigns for seasonal sales, festive offers, product launches, promotional activities, and special shopping days.
Promote mall events, entertainment activities, food festivals, exhibitions, family events, and customer engagement programmes.
Coordinate with retail tenants, hypermarket departments, food court operators, and internal teams to communicate promotions effectively.
Develop digital strategies to increase customer footfall, store visits, sales, and customer retention.
Support loyalty programmes, customer offers, and other promotional initiatives.
3. Content Creation & Creative Coordination 
Plan content calendars for social media and other digital channels.
Coordinate with graphic designers, photographers, videographers, and creative agencies to develop compelling marketing materials.
Prepare briefs for promotional videos, reels, posters, advertisements, and event coverage.
Ensure all content follows brand guidelines and maintains consistent communication across platforms.
4. Paid Advertising & Campaign Management 
Plan, execute, and monitor paid campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube, and other relevant digital platforms.
Optimise campaigns to improve reach, engagement, website traffic, customer enquiries, and conversions.
Monitor advertising budgets and evaluate campaign performance against defined objectives.
Explore local digital marketing opportunities to attract customers from nearby residential and commercial areas.
5. Influencer & Community Marketing 
Identify, coordinate, and manage local influencers, content creators, affiliates, and promotional partners.
Plan and execute influencer campaigns for mall events, retail offers, new store openings, and hypermarket promotions.
Build relationships with local communities and relevant digital partners to strengthen brand awareness.
6. Customer Engagement & Online Reputation 
Monitor and respond to customer comments, messages, queries, reviews, and complaints across digital platforms.
Coordinate with the relevant departments to resolve customer concerns promptly.
Maintain a positive online reputation and encourage customer engagement and feedback.
7. Analytics & Performance Reporting 
Track social media growth, engagement rates, campaign reach, impressions, website traffic, and conversions.
Prepare regular digital marketing performance reports and campaign summaries.
Analyse customer behaviour and campaign effectiveness to recommend improvements.
Monitor marketing expenditure and report campaign results to management.
8. Coordination & Execution 
Work closely with mall operations, hypermarket teams, leasing, tenant relations, sales, and management to align marketing campaigns with business priorities.
Coordinate digital promotions for new store openings, tenant offers, and mall-wide activities.
Ensure timely execution of marketing calendars, campaigns, and 

Preferred candidate profile 

Bachelors degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
2–5 years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in retail, hypermarkets, shopping malls, FMCG, or hospitality.
Hands-on knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Meta Business Suite, and Google Ads.
Experience in social media content planning, paid advertising, influencer marketing, and campaign analytics.
Familiarity with Canva and basic video editing tools is an advantage.
Strong communication, coordination, organisational, and creative skills.
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines in a fast-paced retail environment.
Knowledge of local market trends and customer behaviour is preferred.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
Growth in social media followers, reach, and engagement.
Effectiveness of paid campaigns and return on advertising spend.
Increase in customer footfall generated through digital promotions.
Successful execution of mall events and hypermarket campaigns.
Timely delivery of content and marketing calendars.
Improvement in online ratings, customer engagement, and brand visibility.
Campaign performance reporting and adherence to marketing budgets.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Job Title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive
Department: Digital Marketing
Experience: 3+ Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location: Trivandrum, Kerala 

Job Summary 
We are looking for a creative and performance-driven Senior Digital Marketing Executive with strong expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media management, content creation, and content writing. The candidate will be responsible for planning and executing digital marketing campaigns, improving brand visibility, generating quality leads, and optimizing campaign performance.

Key Responsibilities 
Plan, execute, and optimize Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns to generate leads and achieve business targets.
Manage social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
Develop engaging content for social media posts, reels, videos, advertisements, and marketing campaigns.
Write compelling captions, ad copies, blogs, website content, and promotional content.
Create and implement digital marketing strategies to improve brand awareness, engagement, and lead generation.
Monitor campaign performance, analyze KPIs, and prepare regular performance reports.
Optimize campaigns based on CPL, CTR, conversions, and overall ROI.
Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, and other teams to develop creative marketing materials.
Conduct audience research, competitor analysis, and keyword research.
Stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends, tools, and platform updates.
Required Skills 
Hands-on experience in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.
Strong knowledge of social media management and content planning.
Excellent content writing, copywriting, and creative communication skills.
Understanding of SEO, keyword research, audience targeting, and conversion optimization.
Ability to analyze campaign data and make performance-driven decisions.
Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and reporting tools is an advantage.
Strong communication, creativity, and time-management skills.
Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in digital marketing.
Proven experience managing paid advertising campaigns and social media platforms.
A portfolio or examples of previous campaigns, content, and performance results will be an advantage.

Plan, launch, manage, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
Develop and implement social media strategies across platforms including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant channels.
Plan and manage social media content calendars, campaigns, promotions, videos, reels, graphics, and other digital content.
Oversee the creation of engaging and conversion-focused ad creatives, social media content, landing pages, and marketing materials.
Work closely with the sales and business development teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and customer acquisition.

title: State Project Manager
description:
Position: State Project Manager (SPM) Kerala 

Organization: CSC e-Governance Services India Limited
CSC e-Governance Services India Limited is a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) under the Ministry of Electronics & IT. It serves as a key implementation agency for the Digital India programme, delivering Government-to-Citizen (G2C) services, digital literacy, and financial inclusion through a network of over 5.8 lakh CSC centres across the country.
Website : https://cscspv.in/index.html

Location: Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala
Experience: 57 years

Role Overview 
The State Project Manager (SPM) will be responsible for the end-to-end implementation, management, monitoring, and scaling of the CSC Scheme across Kerala. The role will act as a key link between CSC SPV Head Office and field-level operations , ensuring effective coordination with District Managers (DMs), Village Level Entrepreneurs (VLEs), government departments, and other stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities 
1. Project Implementation 
Lead the rollout, operationalization, and effective functioning of CSC services across Gram Panchayats in Kerala.
Drive state-level initiatives and ensure timely implementation of CSC projects and programs.
Monitor field operations and ensure adherence to defined processes and service standards.
2. Stakeholder Coordination 
Act as the primary point of coordination between CSC SPV, State IT Departments including KSITM, district administration, and other government stakeholders .
Maintain effective coordination with District Managers, VLEs, and other field-level teams.
Facilitate timely resolution of operational and administrative issues.
3. Monitoring & Performance Management 
Monitor key performance indicators including transaction volumes, active VLEs, service delivery, revenue/business performance, and operational timelines.
Analyse state-level performance data and identify areas requiring corrective action.
Prepare regular MIS and performance reports for senior management.
4. Capacity Building 
Plan and facilitate training programs, workshops, and awareness initiatives for DMs and VLEs.
Ensure VLEs are adequately equipped with knowledge of CSC services, processes, and technology.
Drive adoption of new services and initiatives at the field level.
5. Grievance & Helpdesk Management 
Ensure timely resolution of grievances raised by VLEs and citizens relating to technical issues, service delivery, or operational challenges.
Coordinate with relevant internal teams for resolution of escalated issues.
Monitor recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
6. Business Development 
Drive adoption and growth of B2C and other CSC services across Kerala.
Identify opportunities to improve transaction volumes, service uptake, and revenue generation.
Work closely with DMs and VLEs to strengthen the financial sustainability of CSC centres.
7. Reporting & Governance 
Provide regular updates to CSC SPV Head Office on state-level operations, performance, challenges, and action plans.
Ensure compliance with CSC SPV guidelines, government directives, and operational processes.
Support implementation of new government schemes, digital services, and strategic initiatives.

Candidate Profile 
Educational Qualification 
Graduate degree in any discipline.
Postgraduate qualification in Management, IT, Public Administration, or a related field will be an advantage.

Experience 
Minimum 5- 7 years of experience in managing large-scale IT, e-Governance, digital transformation, government, or field operations projects .
Experience in managing geographically distributed teams and working with government stakeholders will be preferred.

Key Skills 
Strong project and operations management skills.
Excellent stakeholder management and coordination abilities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good understanding of e-Governance and digital service delivery.
Proficiency in MS Office, MIS, dashboards, and online monitoring tools.
Strong people management and leadership capabilities.

Language Proficiency 
Excellent command of Malayalam and English , both written and verbal.
Ability to communicate effectively with government officials, field teams, DMs, and VLEs.

Operational Requirements 
Travel: Willingness to travel extensively across districts, Gram Panchayats, and CSC centres throughout Kerala.
Flexibility: Ability to work in a dynamic environment and adapt to changing government policies, project priorities, and operational requirements.
