title: Junior DevOps Engineer | 0-2 Yrs
description:
Experience Required: 0 - 2 years
CTC: 4-6 LPA
Work From Office:Trivandrum
Freshers:
Candidates from Computer Science, IT, or related courses, 2026 UG/PG & 2027 PG, who can join full-time and are available for immediate engagement.
Relevant hands-on skills, internships, certifications, projects or practical exposure in DevOps or related.

We are looking for a motivated and proactive Junior DevOps Engineer to support and enhance our cloud-native infrastructure and DevOps practices. This role involves working with modern cloud platforms, containerized environments, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring systems to ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability of applications.
The ideal candidate should be hands-on, eager to learn, collaborative, and passionate about automation, cloud technologies, and system reliability.

Key Responsibilities: 
Assist in building, deploying, and maintaining cloud infrastructure and containerized applications.
Work with AWS services (Fargate, ECS, DynamoDB, SNS, etc.) for managing distributed systems.
Monitor system performance using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and Splunk, and respond to alerts.
Support CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and ArgoCD.
Troubleshoot issues across infrastructure, networking, containers, and applications.
Assist in configuring and managing Kubernetes clusters, including deployments, services, and ingress.
Work on networking components such as load balancers, API gateways, reverse proxies, and service communication.
Participate in incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and postmortems.
Automate repetitive tasks using scripts and tools to improve efficiency.
Maintain documentation for infrastructure, deployments, and troubleshooting processes.
Collaborate with development and operations teams to improve system reliability and deployment workflows.
Participate in on-call or shift rotations to ensure system availability.
Preferred Skills: 

Cloud Platforms and Services
Basic to intermediate knowledge of AWS services such as ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, SNS.
Basic to intermediate knowledge of GCP services such as GKE, GAR, CloudSQL, Cloud Run.
Understanding of cloud-native architectures and distributed systems.
Familiarity with infrastructure provisioning concepts (Terraform/CloudFormation is a plus).
Monitoring and Logging Tools
Knowledge of CloudWatch Logs, Loki, Splunk for log analysis.
Familiarity with Prometheus and Grafana for metrics monitoring and dashboarding.
Understanding of alerting systems (Alertmanager) and incident response workflows.
Ability to analyze logs and metrics to identify system issues.
Networking and Security
Strong understanding of load balancers (e.g., ALB, NLB) for distributing traffic and troubleshooting connectivity issues.
Knowledge in API Gateways like AWS API Gateway or NGINX for managing API traffic.
Knowledge of reverse proxies and ingress controllers (e.g., NGINX Ingress, Traefik) for managing internal/external traffic.
Understanding service-to-service communications, including DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and gRPC protocols.
Experience or hands-on knowledge with firewalls, security groups, and IAM roles for secure communications.
Troubleshooting skills for VM-related issues in platforms like AWS EC2 or equivalent.
DevOps Toolchains
Proficiency with Docker for managing container images and runtime debugging.
Strong understanding of Kubernetes concepts of managing deployments, ingress setups, and pod-related issues and related troubleshooting commands and mechanisms.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipeline building tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD for building, deploying, and managing automated pipelines.
Understanding of Ingress controllers (e.g., NGINX, Traefik) and SSL termination for secure routing.
Troubleshooting and Incident Management
Strong problem-solving skills to identify root causes using logs, metrics, and system-level debugging.
Ability to document detailed troubleshooting steps and solutions for recurring issues.
Collaboration and Communication
Ability working with cross-functional teams (DevOps, development, and operations) to resolve incidents.
Skills in effective and proactive communication to escalate issues and provide updates during shift handovers.
Proficiency with tools like Slack, JIRA, Confluence, or Google Workspace for collaboration and issue tracking.

title: Digital Marketing Trainer
description:
Job Title: Digital Marketing Trainer 
Department: Training / Academics 
Employment Type: Full-Time 
Experience: 1 - 2 Years 
Industry: EdTech / Training 
Location: Trivandrum 

Job Summary 
We are looking for an experienced and passionate Digital Marketing Trainer to deliver practical, industry-oriented training in digital marketing. The candidate should have strong hands-on experience with digital marketing tools, campaign management, analytics, and current industry trends.

Key Responsibilities 
Conduct theory and practical training sessions on Digital Marketing.
Train students on SEO, SEM, Social Media Marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Content Marketing, Email Marketing, and Web Analytics .
Provide hands-on training through live projects, campaigns, assignments, and case studies .
Teach students how to plan, execute, monitor, and optimize digital marketing campaigns.
Train students in Google Analytics / GA4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Business Suite/Ads Manager , and other relevant tools.
Explain keyword research, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, technical SEO, competitor analysis, and SEO reporting .
Guide students in creating and managing social media campaigns across relevant platforms.
Monitor student performance through assessments, practical exercises, and projects.
Develop and update training materials, presentations, assignments, and project modules .
Mentor students on industry practices, career opportunities, and interview preparation.
Stay updated with the latest Google algorithm updates, advertising trends, AI tools, and digital marketing strategies .

Required Skills 
Strong knowledge of:
SEO & SEM 
Google Ads 
Meta Ads / Social Media Marketing 
Google Analytics 4 (GA4) 
Google Search Console 
Keyword Research & SEO Tools 
Content Marketing 
Email Marketing 
WordPress & Basic Website Management 
Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) 
Lead Generation & Performance Marketing 
Hands-on experience in running and optimizing digital campaigns.
Good analytical and reporting skills.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and practical manner.

Qualification 
Bachelor's/Master's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Communications , or a related field.
Relevant industry certifications such as Google Ads, Google Analytics, Meta, HubSpot , etc., will be an added advantage.

Preferred Profile 
1 - 2 years of hands-on experience in Digital Marketing.
Prior experience as a Digital Marketing Trainer / Faculty / Mentor is preferred.
Candidates with agency, EdTech, or performance marketing experience are preferred.
Should be comfortable conducting practical, project-based training .

KPIs 
Student satisfaction and training quality.
Student project completion and performance.
Practical campaign/project implementation.
Course completion and assessment results.
Student placement/readiness support.

title: Service Delivery Manager (Data, Analytics & AI)
description:
Job Title: Service Delivery Manager Analytics Services 
Location : Technopark, Thiruvananthapuram (Onsite)

Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on Service Delivery Manager to own end-to-end delivery of analytics and data projects. This role combines technical understanding, team leadership, and strong execution discipline to ensure predictable, high-quality outcomes. You will act as the onsite anchor between leadership and engineering teams, driving accountability, delivery cadence, and customer commitments. 

Key Responsibilities 

1) Delivery & Execution 
Own delivery of analytics/data projects (BI, data engineering, reporting, dashboards)
Ensure on-time, high-quality delivery across multiple parallel workstreams
Track commitments vs actuals and proactively manage risks and delays
Establish and enforce delivery processes (Agile/Scrum or hybrid) 

2) Team Management (Onsite) 
Manage and mentor a team of analysts, engineers, and junior developers 
Drive daily execution discipline (standups, task tracking, follow-ups
Identify performance gaps and take corrective actions 
Ensure team availability, responsiveness, and productivity 

3) Technical Oversight : Provide hands-on guidance on: 
Data modeling and transformations 
SQL, ETL/ELT pipelines 
BI tools (Power BI / Tableau / SAC or similar) 
Review solution design and ensure scalability, performance, and maintainability 
Act as a bridge between business requirements and technical implementation 

4) Stakeholder Management 
Interface with internal leadership and external customers
Translate business requirements into actionable delivery plans
Provide regular status updates, highlight risks, and manage expectations

5) Process & Quality 
Define and monitor KPIs (delivery timelines, defect rates, SLA adherence) 
Ensure documentation, version control, and best practices 
Drive continuous improvement in delivery efficiency 

6) Required Skills & Experience 
10-15 years of experience in analytics / data / BI delivery 
Proven experience managing 1015 member teams
Strong hands-on skills in: 
SQL and data analysis 
At least one BI platform (Power BI / Tableau / SAC) 
Data engineering concepts (ETL, pipelines, warehousing) 
Experience with cloud platforms (SAP BTP preferred) 
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery models 

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Preferred Qualifications 
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science or related discipline
Exposure to enterprise clients and global delivery models 
Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability 
Experience in SAP Analytics (good to have) 

Key Traits We Are Looking For 
Execution-focused drives tasks to closure, not just coordination
Hands-on leader can dive into technical details when needed 
Assertive communicator ensures clarity and accountability 
Onsite presence actively engages with team on the ground 

Success Metrics 
On-time delivery of projects and milestones 
Reduction in missed commitments and escalations 
Improved team productivity and responsiveness 
Customer satisfaction and repeat business

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Role & responsibilities Lead requirement elicitation through workshops, interviews, on-site observation and document analysis
Model as-is and to-be processes in BPMN 2.0
Prepare BRD, FRS/SRS, user-story maps, epics and stories with Gherkin acceptance criteria, and maintain the RTM
Define master data, data dictionaries and legacy-to-new migration mapping
Take part in API and data-model reviews; prepare wireframes in Figma/Balsamiq
Plan and run UAT, triage defects, analyse change-request impact, and prepare release notes and user manuals
Ensure compliance with DPDP Act 2023, GIGW 3.0 and WCAG 2.2
Must-Have Skills
8+ years as a Business Analyst on ERP or e-governance projects
Strong ERP functional knowledge: GL, receipts and payments, AP/AR, budgeting, payroll, inventory, procurement
Understanding of government accounting and audit requirements (double-entry, Treasury rules, CAG audit trails)
Proficiency in Jira and Confluence, plus BPMN tools (Camunda Modeler, Lucidchart, draw.io)
SQL for data analysis and validation
Ability to read OpenAPI specs and understand REST and event-driven flows
Working proficiency with AI tools (Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT or similar)
Good-to-Have
CBAP / PMI-PBA certification
Malayalam language proficiency (strongly preferred)
Temple administration, hospitality or booking-domain experience
Camunda / workflow-engine configuration
Experience training non-technical government staff

Selection Process (In-Person Only)
Interviews are conducted in person only at Thiruvananthapuram. There will be no virtual rounds. 
1.Written case study : BPMN, user stories and acceptance criteria for a given process
2.Technical interview : ERP finance processes, traceability and stakeholder handling
3.Artefact walkthrough : walkthrough of an FRS or story map you personally authored
Candidates must bring their own laptop for the assessment.
Working Conditions
Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM 5:30 PM, at the client's office in Thiruvananthapuram
Selected candidates must join within 7 days of selection and complete a 7-day induction
Must sign a confidentiality/NDA undertaking

Preferred candidate profile

title: Lead ETL Developer
description:
Job Description: 

Strong hands-on expertise in SQL Server (T-SQL) and relational database design, with solid
experience in data migration and conversion projects.
Design and build ETL/ELT pipelines to convert data between source and target systems,
following the mapping and transformation logic defined by the Architect.
Good working knowledge of data mapping, source-to-target transformation logic, and
reconciliation techniques for large datasets.
Collaborate with application engineers, business analysts, and QA teams to implement
conversion scope and cutover plans.
Hands-on experience writing and optimizing SQL Server stored procedures, indexes, and
queries for high-volume batch processing.
Proficiency with ETL tooling such as SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent, along with
scripting (PowerShell/Python) for data validation and automation.
Good understanding of data quality, de-duplication, cleansing, and validation techniques.
Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Azure SQL, Azure Synapse, or AWS RDS/Redshift)
and hybrid on-prem-to-cloud migration patterns.
Awareness of data security and compliance considerations during migration, including
encryption at rest/in transit and access controls.
Ability to execute rollback, dry-run, and phased/parallel-run cutover activities under the
guidance of the Architect.
Ability to maintain data lineage, mapping documentation, and audit trails for validation and
sign-off purposes.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with experience resolving issues in large batch
conversion jobs.
Proficiency in writing unit/integration tests and validation scripts for data reconciliation (row
counts, checksums, referential integrity).
Experience with version-controlled database change management (Flyway, Liquibase, or
equivalent) and CI/CD for database deployments.
To adhere to ISMS Policies and Procedures

title: Seo Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Job Title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist

Job Summary
We are looking for a results-driven SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to strengthen our online presence, increase website traffic, generate qualified leads, and improve search engine rankings. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SEO, content marketing, paid advertising, social media marketing, and web analytics, with a strong understanding of the latest digital marketing trends and search engine algorithms.

Key Responsibilities 
Search Engine Optimization (SEO) 
Develop and execute comprehensive on-page and off-page SEO strategies.
Perform keyword research and competitor analysis.
Optimize website content, metadata, internal linking, and technical SEO elements.
Monitor website performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
Build high-quality backlinks through ethical link-building techniques.
Conduct regular SEO audits and implement recommendations.
Stay updated with Google algorithm updates and industry best practices.
Content Marketing 
Plan and manage SEO-focused content strategies.
Optimize blogs, landing pages, and service pages for search engines.
Ensure content aligns with user intent and business objectives.
Digital Marketing 
Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
Manage Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, and other paid campaigns.
Optimize campaign performance to improve ROI and reduce acquisition costs.
Execute email marketing and remarketing campaigns.
Social Media Marketing 
Create and manage content calendars.
Grow brand awareness through organic and paid social media campaigns.
Monitor engagement and analyze campaign performance.
Analytics & Reporting 
Track website performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools.
Prepare monthly reports on traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance.
Provide actionable insights to improve the effectiveness of digital marketing.
Website & Conversion Optimization 
Collaborate with developers to improve website speed, mobile responsiveness, and technical SEO.
Optimize landing pages for higher conversion rates.
Conduct A/B testing and recommend UX improvements.

Required Skills 
Strong knowledge of On-Page, Off-Page, and Technical SEO.
Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Search Console.
Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads.
Knowledge of keyword research tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or Ubersuggest.
Understanding of HTML, CSS, and website structure is an advantage.
Experience with WordPress or other CMS platforms.
Knowledge of backlink analysis and outreach strategies.
Familiarity with local SEO and international SEO.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
Google Ads Certification or Google Analytics Certification is preferred.
Digital marketing certifications are an added advantage.

Experience 
3-6 years of experience in SEO and Digital Marketing.
Experience working with IT services, SaaS, software products, or digital agencies will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
Growth in organic website traffic.
Improvement in keyword rankings.
Increase in qualified leads generated.
Growth in website conversion rate.
Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
Cost per Lead (CPL).
Organic backlinks acquired.
Improvement in domain authority and website health score.
Social media engagement and follower growth.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
What You'll Do 
Create visually engaging designs for branding, digital platforms, marketing campaigns, and communication materials .
Develop creative concepts and visual directions based on project briefs, client requirements, and brand objectives.
Design brand identities, logos, brand collaterals, presentations, brochures, and other print and digital assets .
Create digital creatives for websites, social media, advertising campaigns, and other marketing touchpoints.
Translate ideas and concepts into clear, impactful, and visually consistent designs.
Work with typography, colour, composition, grids, and visual hierarchy to create effective design solutions.
Understand client requirements and collaborate with internal teams to develop relevant creative outputs.
Present design concepts and creative directions to clients, founders, and internal teams.
Incorporate feedback and manage design iterations while maintaining quality and consistency.
Ensure brand consistency across different platforms, formats, and communication materials.
Prepare final artwork and production-ready files for digital and print applications.
Organise design files, assets, and deliverables for efficient collaboration and handover.
Stay updated with emerging design trends, tools, and creative techniques.
Take ownership of assigned projects and ensure timely delivery without compromising design quality.

What We're Looking For 
1 to 3 years of experience in graphic design or a similar creative role.
A strong portfolio demonstrating branding, visual design, creative thinking, and design execution .
Strong command of Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator .
Working knowledge of Adobe InDesign and familiarity with Figma.
Strong understanding of typography, colour theory, composition, grids, and visual hierarchy .
Ability to develop original concepts rather than relying solely on templates or existing references.
Understanding of brand identity, brand guidelines, and visual consistency.
Ability to translate creative briefs and business requirements into effective visual solutions.
Strong attention to detail and a good sense of aesthetics.
Ability to explain creative decisions and present design concepts confidently.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Comfortable receiving feedback, refining concepts, and managing multiple design iterations.
Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise tasks, and meet deadlines.
A proactive approach to problem-solving, experimentation, and continuous learning.

Good to Have 
Experience in brand identity development and branding projects .
Familiarity with motion graphics, animation, or video editing.
Experience creating presentations, pitch decks, brochures, and marketing collaterals.
Understanding of digital marketing creatives and advertising formats.
Familiarity with Figma, Canva, and AI-assisted design tools.
Experience preparing artwork for print production and understanding print specifications.
Experience working in a creative agency or design studio.
Experience presenting concepts and communicating directly with clients.
Basic understanding of UI design and digital brand applications.
Ability to work across different visual styles, industries, and project requirements.

What You'll Get 
Opportunity to work on real client projects across branding, digital design, marketing, and creative communication.
Directly work with the founders and gain exposure to creative direction, client interactions, and project decisions.
Opportunity to take ownership of projects and see your designs move from initial concepts to final execution.
Exposure to diverse industries, brands, and creative challenges.
Opportunity to collaborate with UI/UX designers, marketers, and other creative professionals.
Mentorship and guidance from experienced designers and the creative team.
A collaborative, creative, and people-first work environment.
Opportunity to experiment with new ideas, design approaches, and creative tools.
Build a strong professional portfolio through meaningful, real-world projects.
Opportunity for long-term growth within the team.

How to Apply 
Interested candidates can share their resume and portfolio with us.
Email: px@demasters.in
Contact: 9075130122

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Job Title: Graphic Designer
Experience
1-2 Years 
Employment Type
Full-Time 
Job Description
We are looking for a talented and creative Graphic Designer with 1-2 years of professional experience to create visually compelling designs across digital and print media. The ideal candidate should have a strong eye for aesthetics, branding, typography, and layout, along with the ability to transform ideas into impactful visual communication.
Experience in designing for social media, marketing campaigns, events, exhibitions, museums, and experiential spaces will be an added advantage.
Key Responsibilities
Design creative assets for social media, websites, digital marketing campaigns, emailers, presentations, and advertisements.
Develop brand identities, logos, visual guidelines, and marketing collateral.
Create brochures, catalogs, flyers, banners, standees, posters, packaging, and other print materials.
Design branding elements for events, exhibitions, museums, experience centres, environmental graphics, and experiential spaces .
Collaborate with marketing, content, video, and project teams to deliver high-quality creative solutions.
Produce visually engaging presentations, pitch decks, and client proposals.
Ensure brand consistency across all creative materials and communication channels.
Prepare artwork for print production and coordinate with vendors when required.
Stay updated with the latest design trends, tools, typography, and visual storytelling techniques.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality standards.
Requirements
12 years of professional experience in Graphic Design.
Strong portfolio showcasing branding, digital, print, and marketing design work.
Good understanding of typography, color theory, layout, composition, and visual hierarchy.
Ability to interpret creative briefs and translate ideas into compelling designs.
Strong attention to detail and creative problem-solving skills.
Required Skills
Graphic Design
Branding & Visual Identity
Social Media Creative Design
Print Design
Marketing Collateral Design
Typography & Layout Design
Presentation Design
Basic Illustration
Photo Editing & Retouching
Creative Thinking
Time Management
Team Collaboration
Technical Skills
Adobe Photoshop
Adobe Illustrator
Adobe InDesign
Adobe Acrobat
Canva
Figma (Preferred)
CorelDRAW (Preferred)
Basic Adobe After Effects or Premiere Pro knowledge (Preferred)
Microsoft PowerPoint
Preferred Experience
Social Media Campaign Design
Corporate Branding
Event & Exhibition Branding
Museum Graphics & Wayfinding
Environmental Graphics
Packaging Design
Large Format Print Design
UI Assets & Web Graphics
Marketing & Advertising Agency Experience
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, or a related field.
Relevant certifications in Adobe Creative Suite or design tools are an added advantage.
Soft Skills
Creative mindset with strong visual storytelling abilities
Good communication and presentation skills
Attention to detail and commitment to quality
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Strong organizational and time-management skills
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
Positive attitude and willingness to learn
Why Join Us?
If you're passionate about creating impactful visual experiences, building memorable brands, and delivering high-quality creative work across digital and print platforms, we'd love to hear from you.
Job Type
Full-Time 
Experience
Graphic Design: 1–2 years (Required) 
Adobe Creative Suite: 1–2 years (Preferred) 
Branding & Marketing Design: 1–2 years (Preferred)

title: Lead Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
The Team Leader Business Intelligence & Analytics will lead a team of 5–6 Business Analysts 
and Senior Analysts delivering business analysis, reporting, dashboards and advanced 
analytics for Retail and Consumer Packaged Goods operations. The role combines people 
leadership, delivery governance, stakeholder management and hands-on technical oversight. 
The incumbent will translate commercial priorities into a structured analytics roadmap, ensure 
consistent KPI definitions and data quality, and deliver actionable insights across sales, 
merchandising, pricing, promotions, customer, inventory and supply-chain functions. 
Key Responsibilities 
Lead, coach and develop a team of 5–6 Business Analysts and Senior Analysts, setting clear 
goals, allocating work and reviewing delivery quality. 
Own the analytics delivery portfolio, including demand intake, prioritisation, resource planning, 
timelines, risks, dependencies and stakeholder communication. 
Partner with business leaders to translate strategic and operational questions into analytical 
workstreams, KPIs, dashboards and measurable recommendations. 
Provide hands-on technical direction and conduct solution, code, query, data-model and 
dashboard reviews. 
Drive analytics across Retail and CPG areas including sales, assortment, pricing, promotions, 
customer behaviour, loyalty, store or channel performance, inventory, demand forecasting and 
supply chain. 
Define and govern KPI frameworks, metric definitions, reusable datasets and reporting standards 
across functions. 

Oversee the design and delivery of scalable Power BI dashboards, executive scorecards and self- 
service analytics solutions. 

Guide the development and optimisation of SQL queries, Python solutions, Databricks pipelines 
and Alteryx workflows. 
Ensure accuracy, reconciliation, lineage, access control, documentation and timely refresh of 
business-critical data products. 
Present insights, business cases and recommendations to senior management using clear and 
compelling data storytelling. 
Establish delivery standards, review mechanisms, reusable templates and best practices for 
analysis, visualisation and documentation. 
Monitor team capacity, service levels and delivery metrics; remove blockers and escalate risks 
when required. 
Build team capability through mentoring, knowledge sharing, training plans and succession 
development. 
Collaborate with data engineering, IT, finance, sales, marketing, merchandising and supply-chain 
teams to improve data availability and adoption. 

Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, improve platform performance and reduce 
compute or processing costs. 
Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement and data-driven 
decision-making. 
Qualifications and Experience 
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, 
Engineering, Business Analytics, Economics or a related field. 
8+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, business analysis, data analytics or 
decision support. 
Proven experience leading, mentoring and managing a team of Business Analysts and Senior 
Analysts. 
Demonstrated ownership of multiple analytics projects, stakeholder expectations and delivery 
priorities. 
Strong experience working with large, multi-source datasets, enterprise reporting environments 
and data-quality controls. 
Significant Retail and CPG experience is required, with an understanding of commercial, 
customer, merchandising, pricing, promotion, inventory and supply-chain metrics. 
Technical Skills 
SQL: Advanced querying, joins, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, data validation and 
performance optimisation. 
Python: Strong working knowledge of pandas, data preparation, automation, reusable analysis 
and analytical scripting. 
Power BI: Data modelling, DAX, Power Query, semantic models, row-level security, deployment, 
refresh management and performance tuning. 
Databricks: Databricks SQL, notebooks, Spark SQL, PySpark, Delta Lake, workflows, job 
monitoring, data pipelines and compute optimisation. 
Alteryx: Workflow design, data blending, transformation, macros, scheduling, automation and 
production support. 
Retail and CPG analytics: Sales, pricing, promotions, assortment, customer segmentation, 
loyalty, store or channel performance, inventory, forecasting and supply-chain analysis. 
Data practices: ETL concepts, dimensional modelling, KPI governance, data quality, lineage, 
security, documentation and release controls. 
Delivery practices: Agile ways of working, backlog management, estimation, prioritisation, risk 
management and stakeholder reporting. 
Core Competencies 
People leadership, coaching and performance enablement. 
Strong business acumen with deep Retail and CPG domain understanding. 
Strategic thinking combined with hands-on analytical and technical judgment. 
Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation and executive communication skills. 
Ability to prioritise competing demands and deliver through a team in a fast-paced environment. 
Strong problem-solving, decision-making and escalation management. 
Commitment to data accuracy, governance, confidentiality and ethical use. 
Ownership, collaboration and a continuous-improvement mindset.Role & responsibilities 

Preferred candidate profile

title: DBT Analytics Engineer
description:
JOB SUMMARY
We are looking for a DBT Analytics Engineer with 57 years of relevant experience in data modeling, dbt, and Snowflake. The candidate should have strong expertise in Kimball dimensional modeling and experience transforming complex legacy data into reliable, business-friendly analytical models.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Design and develop dimensional data models using Kimball methodology.
• Build and maintain scalable dbt models in Snowflake.
• Transform complex, unnormalized legacy data into a reliable single source of truth.
• Implement data quality tests, documentation, and data lineage.
• Optimize SQL queries and analytical models for performance.
• Collaborate with reporting analysts and stakeholders to translate business requirements into data models.
• Communicate modeling decisions, code changes, and downstream impacts clearly.
REQUIRED SKILLS
Experience: 57 years in data warehousing, analytics engineering, or data modeling.
• Data Modeling: Strong expertise in Kimball methodology, star and snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, and SCD Types 1 and 2.
• dbt: Hands-on experience with dbt Core and/or dbt Cloud, including models, tests, incremental models, documentation, and Jinja.
• Certification: Active dbt Analytics Engineering Certification from dbt Labs is mandatory.
• Snowflake & SQL: Strong Snowflake experience, advanced SQL, query optimization, and performance tuning.
• Legacy Data: Experience handling complex business logic, unnormalized datasets, and cross-system data integration.
• Communication: Strong technical communication and problem-solving skills.
PREFERRED SKILLS
Experience with ERP, financial, accounting, payroll, or HCM data.
• Familiarity with SAP, Oracle, Deltek, or CMiC.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Job Description - 

We are seeking an AI Site Reliability Engineer to join a forward-thinking engineering team that builds intelligent observability, monitoring, deployment automation, and production support solutions using AI-augmented development practices. This role includes hands-on production support for Pega Infinity applications, where you will apply engineering rigor to improve platform stability, accelerate incident response, and strengthen operational resilience. You will build software solutions for operational challenges, leveraging Gen AI to automate triage, streamline root cause analysis, and drive systems toward five 9s (99.999%) availability while ensuring capacity planning, redundancy, and the highest standards of reliability, security, and scalability. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will actively contribute to architecture, code, AI-driven tooling, and the continuous improvement of Pega production operations. Ideal for engineers who are curious, adaptable, and excited about working at the intersection of software engineering, AI, and mission-critical platform support.
High Availability & Resilience

Design and implement architectures that achieve and sustain 99.999% uptime across critical systems and Pega Infinity application environments
Define, measure, and track SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets
Build AI-powered self-healing systems with automated failover, redundancy, and graceful degradation
Perform AI-assisted capacity planning, demand forecasting, and load testing
Conduct chaos engineering practices enhanced with AI-driven failure prediction
Production Support for Pega Infinity Applications

Provide engineering-led production support for Pega Infinity applications, ensuring platform stability, incident resolution, and operational continuity
Monitor application health, queues, integrations, and batch processes to proactively identify and resolve issues before business impact occurs
Lead incident triage, troubleshooting, and service restoration for Pega production issues, partnering across infrastructure, middleware, database, and development teams as needed
Use Gen AI to accelerate incident investigation, summarize signal patterns, and recommend next-best actions for recurring operational problems
Drive permanent fixes through post-incident analysis, defect prevention, runbook improvements, and automation of repetitive support tasks
Observability & Monitoring

Design, build, and maintain AI-enhanced observability platforms covering metrics, logs, traces, and intelligent alerting
Implement AI-powered anomaly detection, predictive alerting, and proactive system health management for shared services and Pega application workloads
Leverage Gen AI to auto-generate and refine dashboards, alert rules, and runbooks
Build real-time availability dashboards with AI-driven trend analysis tracking 99.999% targets
Root Cause Analysis

Build AI-accelerated root cause analysis with thorough postmortems and actionable remediation
Build AI-powered diagnostic tools that automatically correlate logs, metrics, traces, and Pega operational signals
Use Gen AI to analyze incident patterns, predict recurring failures, and recommend preventive actions
Build AI agents that automate initial triage and preliminary RCA for common incident types
Continuously reduce MTTD and MTTR through AI-assisted workflows
Deployment Automation

Design and maintain AI-enhanced CI/CD pipelines with AI-driven deployment risk scoring
Implement progressive delivery with canary releases, blue-green deployments, and automated rollbacks triggered by AI anomaly detection
Leverage Gen AI to generate deployment scripts, IaC templates, and pipeline configurations
Support production releases, hotfixes, and change implementations for Pega Infinity applications with strong operational controls and risk awareness
Eliminate manual toil by building AI agents for repetitive operational tasks
AI-Driven Development
Use GenAI tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) for coding, debugging, documentation, and operations
Developer ownership is non-negotiable. All code, whether human or AI-generated, must be reviewed, tested, and understood before merging
Design and develop AI agents for incident response, log analysis, capacity management, and operational automation
Define agent goals, tool use, memory, and orchestration logic for multi-step SRE workflows
Apply spec-driven development and continuously evaluate emerging Gen AI tools
Testing & Quality

Leverage Gen AI to generate tests, identify coverage gaps, and create edge-case scenarios
Drive AI-powered security scanning, performance testing, and reliability validation early in development
Modernization & Collaboration

Modernize existing monitoring, alerting, deployment, and support processes using AI-assisted workflows
Identify technical debt and propose AI-accelerated remediation strategies with measurable outcomes
Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and production readiness activities
Develop and maintain prompt engineering guidelines and custom instructions for consistent AI-assisted development
Share learnings, patterns, and tooling insights with the broader team

8+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on SRE, DevOps, platform engineering, or enterprise application production support 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent 
Hands-on technically with ability to architect, review code, and contribute to critical decisions 
Proven experience operating systems at 99.99% or higher availability 
Hands-on experience supporting and troubleshooting enterprise production applications, including incident triage, root cause analysis, and service restoration 
Hands-on experience with Pega Infinity applications in production support, platform operations, or engineering roles 
Strong hands-on knowledge of Pega operational constructs and troubleshooting, including queues, agents, node types, DDS, Kafka, integrations/APIs, and database troubleshooting 
Hands-on experience with GenAI coding tools and demonstrated ability to apply them effectively 
Proficiency in .NET, with scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell 
Experience building AI agents for operational automation 
Strong prompt engineering skills with ability to contribute to team-level AI practices 
Deep understanding of HA patterns including active-active, multi-region failover, and distributed consensus 
Hands-on experience with observability platforms (Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, or similar) 
Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or similar) 
Proven track record leading RCA efforts and driving reliability improvements 
Proven experience diagnosing production issues end-to-end, identifying root cause, and partnering with development teams on corrective and preventative improvements 
Strong CS fundamentals including system design, networking, concurrency, and algorithms 

Experience with Oracle, Mongo, SQL DBs 
Experience with cloud platforms (PCF, GCP, AWS, or Azure) 
Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) 
Knowledge of chaos engineering and ML-powered anomaly detection 
Experience with legacy system modernization 
Pega Infinity platform knowledge, including application support, deployment, and troubleshooting concepts 
Experience with Pega platform components and integrations, such as queues, agents, node classification/types, DDS, Kafka, and API-based integrations 
Experience troubleshooting database performance, query issues, and data-related failures in enterprise application environments 
Experience supporting workflow-driven enterprise applications in regulated or high-availability environments

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
We are seeking highly skilled Cloud Data Platform Engineers (45 resources) with deep hands-on expertise across Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Unity Catalog to strengthen our cloud data operations. These roles demand technical execution , not coordination—requiring strong engineering capabilities in infrastructure automation, FinOps, CI/CD, platform governance, environment management, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices .
The ideal candidates will have proven experience managing enterprise-scale data platforms , ensuring secure, reliable, cost-efficient, and well-governed cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities 
1. Cloud Platform Operations 
Manage and optimize Azure workloads— ADLS, VNets, Key Vault, ADF, Synapse, Fabric, Databricks .
Configure and maintain Databricks clusters, jobs, DLT pipelines, Delta Lake storage , and Unity Catalog policies.
It was pleasure speaking to you as discussed invite has been shared with you for Monday 11 AM and sent in a sperate email and below is JD.

Job Description: Cloud Data Platform Engineer / SRE (Azure | Databricks | Fabric | Unity Catalog) 
Role Overview 

Operationalize Fabric Lakehouses, Pipelines, Warehouses, and Semantic Models for production workloads.
Ensure robust platform governance across environments (DEV–QA–UAT–PROD).
2. InfrastructureasCode & CI/CD 
Build and maintain Terraform/Bicep templates for environment provisioning and configuration.
Develop end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for Databricks, Fabric, and Azure components (ADO/GitHub).
Automate deployment of notebooks, workflows, access policies, networking components, and Fabric artifacts.
Enforce version control, release governance, and quality gates.
3. FinOps, Cost Management & Capacity Planning 
Implement FinOps dashboards, alerts, budgets , and spend governance practices.
Perform Databricks and Fabric cost optimization —cluster sizing, autoscaling, idle management, job tuning.
Conduct capacity planning for compute, storage, Fabric engines, and Databricks workloads.
Develop cost-saving recommendations and automated consumption monitoring.
4. Environment Management, Security & Governance 
Provision and manage Azure data environments with consistent policies and naming standards.
Configure RBAC, ACLs, Unity Catalog grants, service principals, network security, Managed Identities .
Implement governance standards for data access, lineage, audit logging, compliance, and risk mitigation .
Ensure secure connectivity using Private Endpoints, VNET integration, and enterprise IAM controls.
5. Monitoring, Observability & Platform Reliability (SRE) 
Implement monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Databricks Metrics , Fabric Admin APIs.
Build runbooks, dashboards, and automated remediation workflows for platform reliability.
Conduct performance tuning of data workloads, Fabric pipelines, Databricks jobs, and storage layers.
Lead incident management, rootcause analysis, and environment stabilization efforts.

Required Skills & Experience 
6–12 years in cloud data engineering, SRE, or platform engineering roles.
Strong hands-on expertise with:
Azure Data Services (ADLS, ADF, Synapse, Key Vault, VNets)
Azure Databricks (clusters, jobs, Delta Lake, DLT, Unity Catalog)
Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Pipelines, Warehouse, Dataflows)
Unity Catalog governance (catalogs, schemas, access policies, lineage)
Strong scripting and automation experience: Python, PowerShell, Bash, SQL, PySpark .
Experience with Terraform/Bicep for IaC.
Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
Proven FinOps experience with cost governance and optimization across cloud workloads.
Experience in SRE practices—SLIs, SLOs, operational readiness, automated recovery.

Preferred Qualifications 
Certifications in Azure Data Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer, Databricks Data Engineer, FinOps Practitioner .
Experience in highly regulated environments (BFSI, Healthcare, Retail).
Understanding of zero-trust security models.

Suitable Job Titles 
Cloud Data Platform Engineer
Databricks Platform Engineer
Azure/Fabric DevOps Engineer
Cloud DataOps / SRE Engineer
Platform Reliability Engineer (Data Platforms)

title: VMS Product Manager / VMS Product Owner
description:
Description: This role aligns with industry titles such as Vendor Management Systems (VMS) Program Manager, MSP Program Manager, VMS product Manager or Beeline VMS Administrator

The Role 
We are the HR Product Owner team. We decide what gets built in Oracle and ServiceNow, in what order, and why. The HR community brings us their problems and their ideas, and we make sure they get into the system, get prioritised, and get tested before they reach anyone. Our colleagues never need to go to the technology teams directly. That is our job.
Each of us owns a domain end to end: onboarding and offboarding journeys, leave and absence, talent management, benefits and vendor management. This role adds the one domain we are missing.
As Program Manager and PO for Contingent Workforce, you will own the contingent worker journey as a product, from the moment someone is sourced, through onboarding, extensions and role changes, to the day they leave and their access is closed cleanly. Hire to retire, with one owner.
Today that journey runs across a vendor management system, Oracle Fusion, ServiceNow and our identity platforms, with different teams owning different pieces and nobody holding the whole thread. A working prototype already exists: a single conversational front door where a hiring manager gives the information once and the systems do the rest, with no tickets raised at all. Your job is to take that from a promising prototype to a permanent service, and to extend it across the full lifecycle.
This is not a role about keeping a system running. You will bring a process architect mindset to simplify genuine complexity, working with shared services, global HR systems and emerging technologies such as robotic process automation and artificial intelligence, so that the contingent worker experience becomes something we design rather than something that happens.

What You'll Own 
Own the contingent worker journey end to end as a product, with a clear roadmap, prioritised increments and measurable outcomes.
Act as business owner of our vendor management system (Beeline), covering configuration, supplier onboarding, rate card structures, worker classification and reporting.
Manage the relationship with the vendor management system provider and with staffing suppliers, holding both to agreed service levels.
Map the journey across Talent Acquisition, Procurement, Finance, IT, Security, and the country teams, then redesign it rather than simply document it.
Identify where policy rather than technology is the real blocker, and build the case to change it.
Maintain the role-based profile model so that access and equipment are provisioned automatically for standard roles, and manually only for genuine exceptions.
Translate what you learn into what gets built in Oracle and ServiceNow, and see it through to testing and adoption.
Work alongside the Global Process Owner for Hire-to-Onboard, and with the teams building provisioning for permanent employees, so we converge on one pattern rather than several.
Bring security, compliance and audit in early, not at the point of go-live.
Define and track what good looks like: time from source to day one, day one readiness, tickets raised per worker, and satisfaction of both the worker and the hiring manager.

About You 
Five to eight years of experience in contingent workforce programmes, managed service provider models, or HR operations with direct contingent workforce responsibility.
Hands-on ownership of a vendor management system such as Beeline or SAP Fieldglass, including configuration, supplier management and reporting. Experience as an end user alone is not enough for this role.
A process architect mindset: you can map a cross-functional journey, find where the time and the friction actually sit, and simplify it.
Comfort with data. You build the measurement case yourself rather than waiting for a report.
Proven success working in a matrix environment, influencing across functions without direct authority.
Curiosity and openness to innovation, including robotic process automation, artificial intelligence and agent-based workflows.
Clear written communication. Much of this role is making a complex journey understandable to people who own only one part of it.
Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion, ServiceNow and identity platforms such as Microsoft Entra is an advantage.
Understanding of contingent worker classification and compliance requirements across multiple countries is an advantage.

What You'll Get 
You will own a journey that thousands of people at Pearson experience, and you will own it properly: the system, the process, the suppliers and the roadmap. Few roles at this level give you that much of a canvas.
You will also arrive at the right moment. The problem is already evidenced, a prototype already works, and there is executive attention on the outcome. What is missing is a single owner to turn it into something permanent and scale it.
As the world's leading learning company, Pearson is transforming how people learn, work and grow. You will be based in India and working globally, with hybrid and flexible working, and with a team of product owners around you who are solving the same kind of problem in their own domains.
Ready to make an Impact? 
Apply now and help shape whats next.

title: Expansion Program Manager
description:
About the Team 
You will be part of the Expansion team at Curefit. Curefit operates the fastest-growing fitness chain brands in India cult.fit, Gold's, and Fitness First, with a 600+ centre footprint pan-India. The plan is to set up another 150+ centres per year across various offerings. The Expansion Program Manager will be responsible for centre expansion across top cities.

Key Responsibilities 
End-to-end program management and ownership of the transformation process from site identification to centre launch. 
Collaborate with multiple stakeholders Real Estate, Legal, Biz Finance, Projects, City Teams, Talent Acquisition, Sales/Growth, and Audits to program manage launch operations.
Interface effectively with Franchise partners to ensure timely execution, payments, launch readiness, and presales.
Own and manage capital expenditure across projects, equipment, and other line items.
Improve the overall launch process and Franchise partner satisfaction with new launches.
Identify, communicate, and problem-solve potential risks to ensure centres launch on time with a great member experience.

Desired Qualifications & Skills 
2- 4 years of experience in Project/Programme Management; startup experience preferred.
Bachelor's degree from a recognized Tier 1/Tier 2 university (Engineering, Law, Commerce, or Management)
Previous experience in a franchise or client-based business preferred.
Background in real estate, construction, or retail expansion is a plus
Sharp program management skills building and executing SOPs, securing stakeholder buy-in, and driving execution with high influence.
Excellent problem-solving abilities ability to hustle, think on your feet, and take decisive action in new situations
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Process-oriented mindset to identify and solve problems and establish best practices

title: Program Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 

Do you have a passion for scaling businesses and managing programs? Do you want to unearth insights, launch and scale new selection? Do you have proven analytical capabilities, exceptional communication, project management skills, and the ability to multi-task and thrive in a fast-paced environment? 

Are you customer obsessed, flexible, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, hungry and passionate about e-commerce, experienced, and entrepreneurial leader with a strong work ethic? Want to work in one of the fastest growing and most innovative businesses at Amazon? Interested in working in a high impact role? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you. 

If yes, you should consider Amazon Private Brands. 

We are looking for a smart, enthusiastic, hard-working, and creative candidate to join our team as a Program Manager. This position offers an exciting opportunity to manage one or more programs end to end, develop reporting standards and business intelligence support for one of Amazon's key exciting businesses - Amazon Private Brands. 

Traits of success: 
Thrive in ambiguous work environments 
Be a smart, hard-working and creative person who loves products, loves solving difficult problems and "getting it done." 
Be comfortable collaborating and influencing internal and external stakeholders 
Be responsible for building and executing on new initiatives and roadmaps each year. 

Key job responsibilities 
Key job responsibilities 
Creating a data-driven long-term category growth roadmap for Amazon Private Brands 

Develop & Launch new selection backed by strong customer / retail insights 

Working with Cross Functional Team to drive category growth agenda 

Owner for data reporting & Automation 

Strong business judgment with a track record of strong ownership values and relationship management skills. 

Driving deep insights and driving continuous improvement using the analysis. 

Detailed understanding of a business requirement or the ability to quickly get to the root cause of a particular business issue, and draft solutions to meet requirements or resolve the root problems. 

Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to drive key business decisions. 

Ensure data accuracy by validating data for new and existing tools. Learn and understand a broad range of Amazons data resources and know how, when, and which to use and which not to use. 

Work closely with category, marketing and sales stakeholders to understand and automate processes 

Respond with urgency to high priority requests from senior business leaders. 

Identify, develop, manage, and execute analyses to uncover areas of opportunity and present written business recommendations that will help shape the direction of the business. 

Provide customer and vendor data and insights for better impact decisions 

Create and publish category scorecards & campaign performance reports 

Automate data templates and reports & build a SQL repository for adhoc requests and reports 

We are seeking creative, goal-oriented and highly entrepreneurial people to join our exciting and fast-paced team. 

Basic qualifications
2+ years of program or project management experience
3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
Bachelor's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
Knowledge of SQL
Preferred qualifications
Experience in MS Access and SQL
Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
Preferred candidate profile 

Perks and benefits

title: Program Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 

The Executive / Senior Executive Program Management will be responsible for supporting end-to-end program execution from order receipt to delivery. The role requires close coordination with customers, engineering, procurement, production, quality, stores, logistics, and finance teams to ensure that program milestones are achieved as per agreed timelines and business commitments.
Key Responsibilities: 
Project / Program Planning, execution, monitoring, and closure of Defence and Aerospace programs.
Coordinate with internal departments such as design, engineering, procurement, production, quality, stores, and logistics to track program progress.
Prepare and maintain project plan, action trackers, delivery plans, dashboards, and program status reports.
Follow up on material availability, manufacturing progress, inspection readiness, customer approvals, and dispatch milestones.
Act as a communication bridge between customers and internal stakeholders for program updates, open points, risks, and escalations.
Monitor scope, schedule, cost, quality, and delivery commitments for assigned programs.
Identify potential risks, delays, bottlenecks, and dependencies, and support mitigation planning with the concerned teams.
Ensure proper documentation for customer communication, purchase orders, change requests, delivery commitments, inspection records, and closure reports.
Support customer reviews, internal program reviews, production meetings, and management reporting.
Ensure compliance with applicable customer requirements, quality standards, security expectations, and organizational processes.
Required Skills and Competencies: 
Strong program coordination and project planning and tracking skills.
Good understanding of manufacturing, fabrication, machining, assembly, inspection, and supply chain processes or complete PDLC of defense / aerospace product.
Strong communication, follow-up, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and project tracking tools.
Ability to work with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities under project timelines.
Good understanding of quality systems, aerospace / defense documentation, and customer inspection process.
Analytical mindset with ability to identify risks, delays, and corrective actions.
Required Qualification and Experience: 
Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering / Electronics & Communication Engineering / Mechanical or equivalent in related discipline.
10-12 years of experience in program management, project coordination in Defence, Aerospace or similar industries.
Exposure to project management tools like MPP, OpenProj or similar tools will be an added advantage.
Knowledge about AS9100D, ESS, EMI/EMC,JS5555 and other quality standards related to defence qualification standards.
Experienced dealing with or qualifications agencies like DGQA, RDAQA. DGAQA, CEMILAC etc.
Experience of working with DRDO labs like RCI, CHESS and any other defense Lab.
Desired Attributes: 
Ownership mindset with strong accountability for assigned deliverables.
Willingness to travel frequently to customer place
Proactive follow-up approach and ability to escalate issues at the right time.
Customer-focused attitude with professional communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing and project execution environment.
Attention to detail in documentation, schedules, commitments, and reporting.
Willingness to learn Defense and Aerospace program requirements, standards, and processes.

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Who We Are:

Gameberry Labs, a thriving mobile games studio established in 2017 and headquartered in Bangalore, has aimed for an extraordinary vision to become the premier game development company on a global scale. As a bootstrapped and profitable startup, Gameberry Labs has taken the mobile gaming scene by storm. Since our inception in 2017, our games 'Ludo STAR' and 'Parchisi STAR' have captivated players around the globe, resulting in an impressive 250M+ downloads.

Our Belief:

Our profound belief in the transformative ability of mobile games lies in their power to reshape modern connections, entertainment, and learning experiences. We see them as personal buddies that boost our brains, melt away stress, and keep spirits high - anytime, anywhere.

Our Mission:

We want to make millions of people happy with games that they would love to grow old with. We are driven by a passion for creating exceptional gaming experiences that people will cherish for years to come. With our fearless team of dreamers and innovators, we are constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the world of mobile gaming.

Highlight Reel:

We’ve smashed through 300M+ game downloads — and counting!
Our games have pulled in a whopping $275M+ in lifetime revenue.
Over 15M+ players jump into our worlds every single month
Both Parchisi STAR and Ludo STAR have each crossed the 120M+ download mark — absolute legends in their own right.
Crowned Bootstrap Champ at the ET Startups Awards 2023
Dropped our latest hit “Sorry World” in Oct 2025 — hit #1 on the US Play Store in just 2 weeks!
Oh, and yes — we’ve handled 1M+ players online at once without breaking a sweat.

Cool Tidbits:
Our games attract a monthly player base equivalent to the population of Australia, with over 20M players engaging each month!
Players spend an astronomical 297.6 Mars Round Trips worth of time on our games daily!!!

Responsibilities
-Build new game testing playbook for mobile puzzle games
-Perform early testing of concepts to drive decision making around our pipeline of new games
-Plan, execute, and scale paid UA campaigns across Meta Ads, Google App Campaigns, Unity Ads, Applovin, TikTok Ads, and other top-performing networks.
Own the execution and optimization of campaigns with a sharp focus on ROAS, not just installs.
Work closely with the design team to drive the creative testing (videos, playables, static) and identify winning concepts.
-Build processes to increase the efficiency of creative markketing teams
-Use AI tools to increase efficiency of the entire process
Own the campaign analytics & reporting. Analyze deep funnel metrics (Conversion rate, ARPU, LTV, retention) to double down on profitable cohorts.
Collaborate with product, analytics, and design teams to align marketing strategies with game monetization and player engagement.

Requirements
5-8 years of hands-on Paid UA experience in conceptualizing & executing campaigns across channels.
Previous experience in Paid App marketing in mobilegaming industry
Proven expertise in Meta Ads and Google Ads; experience with Unity Ads, AppLovin, and TikTok Ads is highly valued.
Strong knowledge of MMPs (Singular, Adjust, AppsFlyer) and attribution best practices.
Analytical mindset with fluency in Excel, CAC/LTV analysis.
Experience running campaigns on both iOS (SKAN) and Android, navigating IDFA restrictions with confidence.
Performance-first approach to creative testing—knowing what works and why

Your Adventure at Gameberry Labs:

At Gameberry Labs, we're all about riding the wave of new trends, tech, and building the best possible player experience that shapes the gaming universe. We strive to be at the forefront of casual game entertainment. When you join us, you're stepping into a place where your ideas count and your impact matters.
We offer an autonomous studio setup that fosters fast decision-making, empowering you to make a significant impact and accelerate your professional growth.

Why Choose Us:
Freedom to be you.
Get in on a seriously competitive salary.
Hungry? Enjoy free daily lunches.
We've got your back with company-paid health insurance.
Team fun? It's our thing!
Opportunity knocks with limitless growth potential.
We're making a global splash.
Your playground: a studio that owns the P&L of its creations.
Inspiring, down-to-earth teams are our secret sauce.
Dive into challenges, learning, and growth at warp speed.
We want to take India to the list of "Top 10 Gaming Studios" in the World.
Ready to embark on this thrilling quest? Join us and let's create gaming history, one pixel at a time.

title: Seo Executive
description:
Role Summary :
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive with strong core SEO skills to grow organic visibility, traffic and qualified leads. While SEO will be the primary focus, the role also contributes across the wider digital marketing mix, including content, social media, paid campaigns, email marketing and analytics.
Key Responsibilities Search Engine Optimization (Primary approx. 70%)
• Keyword & competitor research: Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis and search-intent mapping to build and maintain the SEO roadmap. 
• On-page SEO: Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal linking, images and schema markup. 
• Technical SEO: Run regular site audits and resolve issues relating to crawlability, indexation, site speed, Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, redirects, canonicals, sitemaps and robots.txt. 
• Off-page SEO: Plan and execute ethical link-building through guest posts, digital PR, outreach and partnerships; monitor and manage the backlink profile. 
• SEO content: Brief writers, optimize blogs and landing pages, and refresh existing content to improve rankings. 
• Local SEO: Manage Google Business Profile and local citations where relevant. • Emerging search: Optimize content for featured snippets and AI-driven search experiences (AI Overviews, answer engines).
• Reporting: Track rankings, organic traffic, conversions and visibility; prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with insights and recommendations. Other Digital Marketing (Supporting – approx. 30%) 
• Support Google Ads and paid social (LinkedIn, Meta) campaigns, including setup, keyword/audience selection and performance monitoring. 
• Plan and schedule social media content and track engagement. 
• Assist with email marketing campaigns, newsletters and basic marketing automation. 
• Coordinate website updates and landing pages in the CMS (e.g. WordPress) and recommend CRO improvements.
• Set up and maintain tracking with GA4 and Google Tag Manager; build dashboards in Looker Studio. 
• Work with design, content, sales and web teams to align campaigns with business goals. Quality & Documentation 
• Follow search engine guidelines and use only ethical, white-hat SEO practices; avoid spammy or manipulative tactics. 
• Maintain keyword trackers, audit checklists, content calendars and SEO documentation.
• Stay updated on search engine algorithm changes and industry trends, and adapt strategy accordingly. 
• Communicate priorities clearly, meet deadlines and proactively flag risks or opportunities. 
Required Skills & Qualifications 
• 1–3 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in a B2B, IT services or agency environment.
• Strong command of on-page, off-page and technical SEO fundamentals and current search engine guidelines. 
• Proficiency with SEO tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush/Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and Moz. 
• Working knowledge of at least two additional digital marketing areas, such as paid media (Google Ads/paid social), social media, content marketing, email marketing or CRO. 
• Familiarity with WordPress or similar CMS; basic understanding of HTML/CSS. 
• Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for tracking and reporting. 
• Ability to analyze data, interpret trends and translate them into clear actions. 
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

title: Senior Power BI & Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer
description:
Position Summary 

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Business Intelligence & Analytics Engineer to develop enterprise analytics solutions and own our Microsoft Fabric and Power BI environment.
This role goes beyond dashboard development. The successful candidate will work directly with business stakeholders to understand business processes, elicit and challenge requirements, translate those needs into data and analytical solutions, and deliver reliable Power BI dashboards and semantic models.
The role will work extensively with data from JD Edwards (JDE), Microsoft Dynamics 365, and other enterprise applications, supporting Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and other business functions.
This is a build-and-operate role, combining new solution development with day-to-day production support, monitoring, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Analysis & Analytics 
Partner directly with business stakeholders to understand processes, KPIs, reporting needs, and analytical requirements.
Translate business questions into clear data, reporting, and dashboard requirements, challenging or refining requirements where necessary.
Analyze and reconcile ERP, CRM, and other enterprise data to ensure reporting accuracy and business relevance.
Power BI & Data Modeling 
Design, develop, and support business-focused Power BI dashboards, reports, and semantic models.
Build scalable data models using dimensional modeling and star-schema principles.
Develop and troubleshoot DAX measures, Power Query transformations, and SQL queries.
Optimize reports and data models for performance, accuracy, scalability, and usability.
Microsoft Fabric & Data Engineering 
Manage and enhance the Microsoft Fabric environment, including Lakehouse/Warehouse, Dataflows, Pipelines, workspaces, security, and semantic models.
Maintain and evolve Bronze/Silver/Gold data layers and reliable integration with enterprise source systems.
Implement appropriate data-quality, monitoring, deployment, documentation, and governance practices.
Production Support & Continuous Improvement 
Provide day-to-day production support and proactively monitor pipelines, refreshes, data quality, platform performance, and report availability.
Troubleshoot issues across source data, Fabric pipelines, SQL, semantic models, DAX, and Power BI.
Perform root-cause analysis on recurring issues and implement permanent fixes, automation, or monitoring improvements to prevent recurrence.
Own solutions through requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, support, and ongoing improvement.
Required Qualifications & Skills 
5+ years of hands-on experience delivering Power BI, BI, analytics, or related data solutions.
Strong hands-on Power BI and DAX skills, including measures, filter context, time intelligence, and troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse/Warehouse, Dataflows, Pipelines, and semantic models.
Strong understanding of semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, relationships, and star-schema design.
Strong SQL skills for querying, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.
Experience developing analytics using data from ERP, CRM, or other enterprise transactional systems.
Proven ability to independently engage business stakeholders, elicit requirements, and translate business needs into analytical solutions.
Experience supporting production BI/data environments, including monitoring, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and performance optimization.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
Ability to work independently and take ownership in a lean, global IT environment.
