title: Data Analytics Engineer
description:
Job Purpose: 

The Data Analyst is responsible for transforming workforce, program, and market data into accurate, actionable, and client-ready analytics products. This role supports internal stakeholders and external clients by preparing, cleansing, modeling, analyzing, and visualizing data related to requisitions, submittals, placements, rates, suppliers, service level agreements, program performance, and other workforce metrics.
The Data Analyst works extensively within the Microsoft data and reporting environment, including SQL Server, Power BI, Excel, and related technologies. This position is responsible for sourcing and validating data, developing semantic models, building and maintaining dashboards and scorecards, administering Power BI environments, and ensuring reporting outputs are accurate, reliable, and aligned with business and client requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 
This position is required to ensure compliance of Company operations to all applicable laws, regulations and standards, good business practices, and company documented procedures (including but not limited to quality regulations, government occupational health and environmental regulations, and statutes).

Data Preparation, Modeling, and Analysis 
Extracts, cleanses, transforms, integrates, and validates data from SQL Server, VMS platforms, HR systems, recruiting systems, finance systems, and other internal or external sources.
Writes and optimizes SQL queries and stored procedures to source, join, transform, and prepare data for reporting and analysis.
Profiles raw and curated datasets to identify incomplete, inaccurate, inconsistent, duplicate, or anomalous data.
Develops and maintains analysis-ready datasets and data models that support recurring reporting, ad hoc analysis, benchmarking, and client deliverables.
Analyzes workforce and program data to identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities.
Performs analysis related to cost savings, quality, supplier performance, market rates, service levels, program health, workforce activity, and other business needs.
Applies consistent definitions, business rules, and calculation logic across reporting and analytical outputs.
Documents assumptions, data sources, transformations, dependencies, and reporting logic to support transparency and repeatability.
Power BI and Analytics Product Development 
Designs, builds, maintains, and enhances Power BI dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical products for internal stakeholders and external clients.
Develops and optimizes Power BI semantic models, including relationships, hierarchies, DAX measures, Power Query/M transformations, and incremental refresh processes.
Designs dashboards and reports using strong data visualization principles to ensure outputs are clear, intuitive, accurate, and client-ready.
Translates business and client questions into meaningful visualizations, KPIs, and analytical views.
Maintains consistency in metric definitions, report structures, visual standards, and user experience across Power BI products.
Manages Power BI datasets, dataflows, workspaces, gateways, scheduled refreshes, row-level security, user access, and related administrative functions.
Troubleshoots report, refresh, gateway, data model, and performance issues and coordinates resolution with appropriate technical teams.
Reviews dashboards and reports for data accuracy, visual integrity, usability, and alignment with business requirements before release.
Maintains and enhances existing analytics products based on user feedback, changing business needs, and new data requirements.
Workforce, MSP, and Market Analytics 
Develops analysis and reporting related to Managed Service Program performance, including requisitions, submittals, placements, fill activity, supplier performance, rates, savings, service levels, and other workforce metrics.
Develops and maintains client and program scorecards, KPI reporting, benchmarking, and performance analysis.
Analyzes VMS data from platforms such as SAP Fieldglass, Beeline, VNDLY, and similar systems.
Supports labor market and compensation benchmarking by analyzing wage, rate, supply, demand, geography, skill, and related market data.
Combines internal workforce data with external market information to support rate analysis, benchmarking, supplier discussions, and client recommendations.
Identifies trends or variances in client and program performance and communicates findings to appropriate stakeholders.
Supports development of analytical content for client business reviews, sales presentations, renewals, and account growth opportunities.
Data Quality, Validation, and Governance 
Owns data validation and quality assurance for assigned dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical deliverables.
Reconciles reporting outputs to source systems and investigates discrepancies before information is released to clients or business stakeholders.
Develops and follows standard quality control procedures for recurring reports and analytics products.
Partners with IT, Operations, and other technical teams to resolve data integrity, system, and reporting issues.
Monitors data refreshes, reporting dependencies, and recurring processes to ensure successful and timely completion.
Identifies data quality risks, reporting inconsistencies, or process weaknesses and recommends corrective actions.
Maintains data definitions, report documentation, process documentation, and other supporting materials.
Supports appropriate data access, confidentiality, and security requirements, including row-level security and user permissions.
Reporting Automation and Technical Support 
Develops and maintains standardized, repeatable reporting processes that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
Automates recurring data preparation, validation, reporting, and analytical tasks using Power BI, SQL, Excel, Power Query, and other approved tools.
Builds and maintains the connection layer between SQL Server and Power BI, including gateway configuration, scheduled refreshes, and query performance optimization.
Works with technical teams to define data collection requirements, troubleshoot source-system issues, and implement reporting solutions.
Supports implementation of new data sources, reporting tools, Power BI capabilities, and related technology enhancements.
Evaluates opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, scalability, maintainability, and user experience.
Cross-trains colleagues and provides documentation to promote continuity and shared knowledge across the analytics function.
Business Partnership and Insights 
Partners with Operations, Account Management, Sales, Marketing, Technology, Finance, and other stakeholders to understand reporting and analytical needs.
Translates business requirements into reporting specifications, data models, KPIs, dashboards, and analytical solutions.
Provides data-driven insights and recommendations to management and clients regarding program performance, risks, opportunities, and service improvements.
Communicates analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences using effective data storytelling.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: 

Strong knowledge of data analysis, reporting, data profiling, data validation, and data visualization practices.
Advanced Power BI development skills, including DAX, Power Query/M, semantic model design, relationships, incremental refresh, and performance optimization.
Experience administering Power BI environments, including workspaces, datasets, gateways, refresh scheduling, row-level security, and user access.
Strong SQL Server skills, including writing complex queries, joins, stored procedures, and troubleshooting query performance.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, Power Query, and other analytical capabilities.
Strong dashboard and data visualization design skills with an emphasis on clarity, usability, accuracy, and professional presentation.
Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to identify data inconsistencies, investigate root causes, and resolve or escalate data quality issues.
Ability to interpret workforce and program data and translate findings into meaningful business insights.
Knowledge of Managed Service Program processes and contingent workforce data, including requisitions, submittals, placements, suppliers, rates, and service levels.
Familiarity with VMS platforms such as SAP Fieldglass, Beeline, VNDLY, or similar systems.
Familiarity with labor market, compensation, and workforce benchmarking data and tools.
Strong written, verbal, presentation, and data storytelling skills.
Ability to communicate technical and analytical information clearly to non-technical stakeholders and clients.
Strong organizational, planning, prioritization, and time-management skills.
Ability to independently manage multiple projects, deadlines, and recurring deliverables.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and presentation quality.
Ability to establish effective working relationships across departments and organizational levels.
Ability to work proactively, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of assigned work.

Qualifications: 

Minimum 
Associates or bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum of three years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or a related analytical role.

title: AI Cloud Engineer
description:
Role Summary 
This role is responsible for designing, building, and delivering enterprise-scale AI solutions and cloud-native applications that support large user populations. The individual will lead the development of innovative AI-powered products, scalable architectures, and automation capabilities while partnering with technical and business stakeholders to solve complex problems. Success in this role requires deep technical expertise, strong communication skills, and a passion for innovation.

Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and implement enterprise-scale AI applications and intelligent automation solutions.
Lead the development of cloud-native applications, APIs, and AI-powered services using modern engineering practices.
Drive the integration and implementation of AI/LLM technologies within business applications and workflows.
Architect scalable, resilient, and secure solutions capable of supporting large-scale user adoption.
Lead technical design discussions, code reviews, and engineering best practice initiatives.
Optimize application performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Build and enhance deployment pipelines, automation frameworks, and DevOps capabilities.
Investigate and resolve complex technical challenges across application, infrastructure, and AI solution layers.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to define solution strategies and deliver business outcomes.
Mentor team members and contribute to technical capability development across engineering teams.
Establish and maintain architectural standards, development guidelines, and technical documentation.

description:
AWS infrastructure and automation: Provision and manage AWS infrastructure using reusable Terraform modules, including EKS, VPCs, subnets, routing, security groups, IAM, S3, PostgreSQL RDS, and Cognito. Replace manual configurations with repeatable, version-controlled automation.
Kubernetes platform engineering: Configure, upgrade, and troubleshoot EKS clusters and platform services, including VPC CNI, CoreDNS, Metrics Server, Istio, AWS Load Balancer Controller, cert-manager, and OpenTelemetry. Standardize Helm deployments and build-node configuration.
CI/CD and artifact management: Develop automated deployment, validation, promotion, and rollback workflows using Jenkins, GitLab, Helm, JFrog, and ECR. Establish governed artifact sourcing and automate authentication renewal where applicable.

Observability and reliability: Implement OpenTelemetry pipelines and Datadog monitoring, dashboards, and actionable alerts. Define service-level indicators and objectives, troubleshoot incidents, and drive root-cause analysis and preventive improvements.
Governance and environment promotion: Coordinate architecture and security reviews, remediate findings, and manage readiness checklists covering infrastructure, access, secrets, certificates, integrations, and operational requirements.
Operational readiness: Develop deployment, recovery, troubleshooting, and incident-response runbooks. Establish support ownership, escalation paths, and vendor engagement procedures, and maintain architecture and operational documentation.

Demonstrated senior-level experience in SRE, cloud platform engineering, or DevOps supporting enterprise applications.
Strong hands-on expertise with AWS, Amazon EKS, Kubernetes administration, cluster upgrades, and distributed-system troubleshooting.
Proficiency with Terraform, Helm, Git-based workflows, and scripting for infrastructure and deployment automation.
Experience with Jenkins, GitLab, JFrog Artifactory, Amazon ECR, and CI/CD pipelines.
Strong understanding of VPC networking, CIDR allocation, routing, DNS, IAM, security groups, load balancing, TLS, and certificate management.
Practical experience with Istio, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, monitoring, alerting, and production support.
Strong communication, documentation, cross-functional coordination, and independent delivery skills.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Job Description: Staffing Delivery Manager

Role: Staffing Delivery Manager
Experience: 1015+ Years
Industry: Recruitment / Staffing 
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Staffing Delivery Manager to lead recruitment teams, manage end-to-end staffing delivery, and ensure the achievement of hiring targets across multiple client accounts. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in team management, recruitment operations, client coordination, delivery planning, and performance monitoring.
The candidate will be responsible for driving team productivity, improving recruitment turnaround time, managing escalations, and ensuring consistent delivery of quality profiles and successful closures within agreed timelines.
Key Responsibilities
Team Management & Leadership 
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of recruiters, team leads, and delivery professionals.
Allocate recruitment requirements based on team capacity, recruiter expertise, and client priorities.
Monitor daily productivity, individual performance, and overall team delivery.
Conduct regular team reviews, provide feedback, and drive continuous performance improvement.
Build a collaborative, target-oriented, and quality-focused recruitment team.
Recruitment Delivery & Operations 
Manage end-to-end recruitment delivery across multiple client accounts and hiring requirements.
Drive sourcing, screening, submissions, interview coordination, offer management, and candidate closures.
Ensure hiring targets, delivery commitments, and client SLAs are achieved.
Track recruitment pipelines, aging requirements, interview conversions, offers, and joining ratios.
Identify delivery bottlenecks and implement effective action plans to improve closures.
Ensure recruiters maintain accurate recruitment trackers and ATS updates.
Client & Stakeholder Management 
Coordinate with clients and internal stakeholders to understand hiring needs, priorities, and delivery expectations.
Review open requirements, hiring progress, feedback, and critical positions.
Manage delivery escalations and ensure timely resolution of recruitment challenges.
Maintain effective communication with account managers, client stakeholders, and internal leadership.
Performance Monitoring & Reporting 
Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment delivery reports.
Monitor key metrics such as submissions, interviews, selections, offers, and joinings.
Analyze team performance and implement strategies to improve productivity and conversion ratios.
Provide regular updates to senior management on delivery status, risks, and hiring progress.
Required Skills & Qualifications
1015+ years of experience in recruitment, staffing, or talent acquisition.
Minimum 4–6 years of experience in recruitment team management and delivery leadership.
Proven experience managing recruitment teams and achieving hiring targets.
Strong understanding of end-to-end IT recruitment and staffing processes.
Experience handling multiple client accounts and high-volume or niche hiring requirements.
Excellent team leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Strong knowledge of recruitment metrics, ATS tools, sourcing strategies, and reporting.
Ability to manage escalations, prioritize critical requirements, and deliver under pressure.
Preferred Experience
Experience managing multiple recruitment teams or team leads.
Exposure to permanent, contract, and bulk hiring.
Experience in a staffing company or recruitment services organization.
Demonstrated success in improving team productivity, recruitment conversions, and closure rates.

description:
Performance Marketing Specialist Meta & Google Ads
Company: AM Growth Partners LLP
Location: Hyderabad | Work From Office
Experience: 2–4 Years
Salary: 3.5–5 LPA
Employment: Full-Time, Permanent

Role & Responsibilities 
AM Growth Partners is a growing strategy and marketing consulting firm specialising in brand development, lead generation, admissions growth, and business expansion for educational institutions.
We are looking for a hands-on, analytical and results-driven Performance Marketing Specialist to independently manage paid advertising campaigns for multiple clients.
This is an execution-focused role with opportunities to contribute to campaign strategy and long-term growth.
Key Responsibilities: 
Independently plan, launch, manage and optimise Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads campaigns.
Develop effective lead generation strategies for schools, educational institutions and other service-based businesses.
Manage campaign budgets, audience targeting, keyword research, bidding strategies and remarketing.
Monitor and optimise CPL, CPC, CTR, conversion rates and cost per qualified lead.
Set up and manage Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM) and conversion tracking.
Coordinate with graphic designers, content creators and video editors to develop high-performing advertising creatives.
Integrate campaigns with CRM systems and monitor lead quality throughout the admissions or sales funnel.
Conduct A/B testing of creatives, audiences, landing pages and campaign structures.
Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable recommendations.
Research competitors, identify opportunities and continuously improve campaign performance.
Collaborate with the internal strategy and admissions teams to improve overall lead-to-conversion performance.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Must-Have Skills: 
2–4 years of hands-on performance marketing experience.
Strong practical experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
Proven experience managing lead generation campaigns with measurable results.
Good understanding of Google Search campaigns, Meta lead forms, remarketing and conversion optimisation.
Working knowledge of GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel and conversion tracking.
Ability to independently manage multiple client advertising accounts.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and reporting skills.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to take ownership of campaigns and work with minimal supervision.
Preferred Qualifications: 
Experience working with digital marketing agencies, educational institutions, EdTech or other lead-generation businesses.
Experience managing monthly advertising budgets of 1 lakh or more.
Familiarity with CRM systems, lead attribution and landing page optimisation.
Google Ads or Meta Blueprint certifications are an advantage.
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
Important: We are looking for someone with actual campaign management experience, not just social media posting, boosting posts or theoretical digital marketing knowledge.
Perks & Benefits
Opportunity to work directly with the leadership team of a growing consulting firm.
Exposure to multiple brands, clients and performance marketing strategies.
Ownership of campaigns from planning through execution and optimisation.
Opportunities to contribute to business growth and marketing strategy.
Scope for career progression as the company expands.
Collaborative environment that values initiative, accountability and measurable results.

How to Apply 
Email: info@amgrowthp.com 
Website: www.amgrowthp.com 
Candidates are encouraged to share their resumes along with brief details of campaigns they have personally managed, advertising budgets handled and measurable campaign results.

Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads.

description:
Job Title: Marketing Manager 
Company: Autocracy Machinery Pvt Ltd 
Location: Hyderabad 
Experience Required: 10-12 Years 
Industry: Engineering & Manufacturing 
Employment Type: Full time 

We are a fast-growing organization committed to delivering reliable, high-performance, and customized solutions for our customers. We focus on innovation, operational excellence, and customer success.

Role Purpose:: 
The Marketing Manager will lead the planning and execution of Autocracy Machinerys marketing function, with a focus on brand building, industry expansion, content development, digital presence, and market engagement. 

The role will be responsible for managing the marketing team, strengthening the companys communication across products and industries, identifying new market opportunities, and developing marketing initiatives that support business growth and market expansion. 

The position will work closely with the CEO, Business Development, Sales, Product, Technical, and other functional teams to translate business priorities into effective marketing strategies and measurable outcomes.

Professional Experience:: 
Minimum 10+ years of experience in marketing, preferably in B2B, industrial, engineering, manufacturing, infrastructure, or technology-driven businesses. 
Proven experience in managing marketing teams and driving marketing initiatives from strategy to execution. 
Experience in brand building, content development, digital marketing, campaign management, and market development. 
Experience working across multiple products, industries, customer segments, or markets. 
Experience collaborating closely with Sales and Business Development teams to support business growth will be preferred. 

Technical Skills:: 
Marketing strategy and planning 
Brand management and positioning 
Content strategy and communication
B2B and industrial marketing 
Digital marketing and social media 
Market research and competitive analysis 
Product and application marketing 
Campaign planning and execution 
Lead generation and demand generation
Marketing analytics and performance measurement
Event and exhibition management 
Team management and stakeholder coordination 

Tools:: 
Google Analytics / Google Search Console 
Google Workspace / Microsoft Office 
Social media and digital marketing platforms 
CRM and marketing automation platforms 
Canva / Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent 
SEO and keyword research tools 
AI-powered content and marketing tools

1. Marketing Strategy & Execution:: 
Ability to translate organizational growth objectives into structured marketing plans, campaign priorities, and execution schedules. Capability to allocate resources effectively, monitor deliverables, and ensure timely completion of marketing initiatives.
Effectiveness in reviewing marketing outcomes and introducing corrective actions to improve results.

2. Lead Generation & Demand Generation:: 
Ability to design and manage campaigns that generate relevant business enquiries and qualified leads across multiple platforms.
Understanding of target audience selection, lead qualification, campaign optimisation, and cost-effective lead acquisition.
Capability to evaluate lead quality, lead-to-opportunity progression, and contribution to the sales pipeline rather than relying solely on impressions, clicks, or engagement.

3. Brand Building & Market Positioning:: 
Ability to establish consistent brand positioning across industrial markets, customer segments, and communication channels.
Capability to communicate the company's engineering strengths, product capabilities, and customer value propositions effectively.
Experience in strengthening brand credibility among business customers, institutional buyers, and industry stakeholders.

4. Industry Expansion & Market Intelligence:: 
Ability to identify emerging industries, customer segments, applications, and market opportunities relevant to the company's product portfolio.
Competence in competitor benchmarking, industry research, customer trend analysis, and market opportunity assessment.
Capability to convert research findings into actionable marketing and business development initiatives.

5. Content Strategy & Product Communication:: 
Ability to develop and oversee technically accurate, commercially relevant content for machinery, engineering products, and application-specific solutions.
Effectiveness in managing brochures, product presentations, case studies, videos, website content, and campaign assets.
Ability to simplify complex technical information into clear customer benefits and compelling product value propositions.

6. Digital Marketing & Campaign Performance:: 
Ability to manage integrated digital campaigns across relevant search, social media, website, and other marketing channels.
Competence in analysing lead generation, lead quality, campaign costs, website enquiries, and conversion performance.
Ability to improve campaign effectiveness through data analysis, audience refinement, and continuous optimisation.

7. Sales & Business Development Enablement:: 
Ability to align marketing plans with sales priorities, target accounts, product requirements, and business development opportunities.

title: SEO Specialist / SEO Executive
description:
SEO Specialist / SEO Executive 

Company: InfoGrowth Private Limited
Location: Madhapur, Hyderabad
Experience: 1-4 Years
Work Mode: Work from Office (WFO)
Shift: Night Shift (US Timings)
Working Days: 5 Days a Week
Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred

Job Summary 
We are looking for a skilled SEO Specialist with hands-on experience in on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and technical SEO. The candidate will be responsible for improving website visibility, increasing organic traffic, optimizing search engine rankings, and implementing effective SEO strategies across company websites.

Key Responsibilities 
1. On-Page SEO 
Conduct keyword research and identify relevant target keywords.
Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, images, and internal links.
Optimize website content and landing pages for search engines and users.
Perform competitor analysis and identify opportunities for organic growth.
2. Off-Page SEO 
Develop and execute backlink-building and link-acquisition strategies.
Conduct link outreach and identify relevant websites for quality backlinks.
Monitor backlink profiles and identify harmful or low-quality links.
Improve domain authority and website credibility through ethical SEO practices.
3. Technical SEO 
Conduct website SEO audits and identify technical issues.
Monitor crawling, indexing, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, and redirects.
Identify page-speed and Core Web Vitals improvement opportunities.
Work with developers to resolve technical SEO issues.
Identify duplicate content, broken links, and website structure issues.
4. SEO Analytics & Reporting 
Monitor website performance using Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, impressions, clicks, and conversions.
Prepare regular SEO performance reports.
Recommend data-driven improvements to increase organic visibility.

Required Skills 
Strong practical knowledge of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO.
Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.
Familiarity with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, or similar SEO tools.
Understanding of keyword research, backlink analysis, and competitor research.
Knowledge of WordPress and website content management.
Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.

Eligibility 
1-4 years of relevant SEO experience.
Willingness to work from the office in Madhapur, Hyderabad.
Comfortable working night shifts aligned with US business hours.
Available to work five days a week.
Immediate joiners preferred.

Preferred: Candidates who can demonstrate measurable improvements in organic traffic, keyword rankings, and website performance.

About the Role 
Infoz IT is looking for a results-driven Senior SEO Specialist to lead organic search strategy and execution. The ideal 
candidate will own SEO performance end-to-end from technical audits and on-page optimization to content strategy and 
off-page link building and will be comfortable mentoring junior team members while working closely with content, 
design, and development teams. 
Key Responsibilities 
Own and execute the end-to-end SEO strategy technical, on-page, and off-page to improve organic visibility 
and rankings. 
Conduct in-depth keyword research and competitor analysis to identify growth opportunities. 
Perform technical SEO audits (site speed, crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, schema markup) and coordinate 
fixes with the development team. 
Plan and oversee on-page optimization: meta tags, headers, internal linking, and content structure. 
¢ Build and manage a white-hat link-building strategy, including outreach and guest posting. 
¢ Collaborate with the content team to develop SEO-driven content calendars and briefs. 
¢ Track, analyze, and report on SEO performance using Google Analytics, Search Console, and SEO tools 
(Ahrefs/SEMrush/Moz). 
¢ Stay current with search engine algorithm updates and industry best practices, adjusting strategy accordingly. 
¢ Mentor and guide junior SEO executives, reviewing their work for quality and consistency. 
¢ Present SEO performance, insights, and recommendations to leadership on a regular cadence. 
Required Skills & Experience 
¢ 35 years of hands-on SEO experience, with at least 12 years in a senior or lead capacity. 
¢ Proven track record of improving organic search rankings and traffic for a website or portfolio of sites. 
¢ Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager. 
¢ Proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, or Moz. 
¢ Solid understanding of technical SEO (site architecture, crawl budget, Core Web Vitals, schema/structured data). 
¢ Working knowledge of HTML/CSS and how CMS platforms (WordPress or similar) affect SEO. 
¢ Experience with content optimization and basic understanding of content marketing principles. 
¢ Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable strategy. 
¢ Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to stakeholders and cross-functional teams. 
Good to Have 

¢ Experience in EdTech, IT services, or B2B industries. 
¢ Familiarity with local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization. 
¢ Basic understanding of paid search (Google Ads) to support integrated campaigns. 
¢ Google Analytics / SEO certifications. 
What We Offer 
¢ Opportunity to independently drive the SEO function for a growing organization. 
¢ Collaborative, fast-paced work environment with cross-functional exposure. 
¢ Compensation based on experience and interview performance no fixed band. 
Point of Contact: Bhaskar S Infoz IT, Secunderabad

Function: Marketing and Branding 
Designation: SEO Executive 
Open Position: 01 
Location: Hyderabad 

About Keus 
Keus is at the forefront of integrating elegant design with state-of-the-art technology in smart home automation and architectural lighting. Our mission is to transcend ordinary living, offering a luxurious smart home experience that is seamless and beyond compare.Our philosophy is centered around a design-first approach, where impeccable aesthetics meet unparalleled functionality. At Keus, a cadre of leading Industrial Designers, Electronics and Electrical Engineers, and Software Architects merge their expertise to redefine industry standards and craft bespoke smart home products and solutions that lead the way in innovation.

We pride ourselves on being the benchmark of sophistication and holistic smart home experiences in India, relentlessly innovating not only to meet but redefine global standards. Keus is on an ambitious path of expansion, with 2024 marking our entry into the thriving markets of Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune, and Delhi. Our strategy involves directly engaging with Architects, Interior Designers, and leveraging Digital Marketing to enhance our customer reach.

Discover more about our vision and offerings: 
Visit our website: www.keus.in
Watch us on YouTube: KeusSmartHome
Follow us on Instagram: @keussmarthome

Join us in shaping the future of luxurious Smart living. 

Position Overview: 
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented SEO Content Writer to develop high-quality, search-optimized content that drives organic traffic, strengthens brand authority, and generates qualified leads. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of SEO best practices, content strategy, keyword research, and digital marketing, along with the ability to create engaging content aligned with KEUSs premium brand voice .

Key Responsibilities: 

1. SEO Content Strategy & Research 
Research industry trends, customer intent, and target keywords to develop SEO-driven content strategies.
Conduct keyword research using tools such as Google Keyword Planner, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms.
Stay updated with Google algorithm changes, SEO trends, and content marketing best practices.

2. Content Creation & Optimisation 
Write and optimise blogs, landing pages, product pages, category pages, and website copy.
Develop compelling content around smart home automation, luxury lighting, interior design, and related technology topics.
Create SEO-friendly meta titles, meta descriptions, headers, and image alt text.
Update and optimise existing website content to improve search rankings and user engagement.
Create long-form content, pillar pages, and topic clusters where required.

3. Performance Monitoring & Optimisation 
Monitor content performance using Google Analytics and Google Search Console.
Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, engagement, and other relevant content performance metrics.
Identify opportunities to improve existing content and recommend optimisation strategies.

4. Cross-functional Collaboration 
Collaborate with designers, digital marketers, and product teams to ensure content aligns with campaign and business objectives.
Support content requirements for email campaigns, social media, case studies, and marketing collateral as required.
Ensure all content maintains KEUSs premium tone of voice and adheres to brand guidelines.

Key measures of success: 
Growth in organic website traffic.
Improvement in keyword rankings and search visibility.
Increase in qualified leads generated through organic content.
Improvement in content engagement metrics such as CTR, time on page, and bounce rate.
Consistent publishing of high-quality, SEO-optimized content.
Growth in indexed pages and featured snippet visibility.

Key Competencies: 
Strong SEO content writing and editing skills.
Strong understanding of on-page SEO and search intent.
Proficiency in keyword research and SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.
Excellent command of English, grammar, and proofreading.
Strong research and analytical skills.
Ability to simplify technical concepts into engaging, reader-friendly content.
Strong understanding of content strategy and digital marketing.
Attention to detail and adherence to brand tone and guidelines.
Strong collaboration, time management, and organizational skills.
Adaptability to evolving SEO trends and Google algorithm updates.

Qualifications: 
Bachelor’s degree in English, Journalism, Marketing, Communications, or a related field .
2–5 years of experience in SEO content writing or digital content marketing.
Hands-on experience with SEO, keyword research, and content optimization .
Experience with SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics .
Familiarity with WordPress or other CMS platforms .
Experience in B2B and B2C content marketing is preferred.
Experience in luxury brands, home automation, lighting, architecture, interior design, or consumer technology is an added advantage.

Keus Culture: 
Join a team that is passionate about innovation and excellence. At Keus, we value creativity, collaboration, ownership and a commitment to leading the smart home revolution.

What Keus Offers: 
Opportunity to work with an innovative premium technology and lifestyle brand .
Exposure to cutting-edge smart home automation and luxury lighting solutions .
Opportunity to create content that influences high-value customer decisions .
A collaborative and creative work environment .
Professional growth through impactful digital marketing initiatives .

Keus is an Equal Opportunity Employer; We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment
for all employees.

You’ll work on visually communicating AI, Pega, automation, enterprise software, and digital transformation concepts while creating content that directly supports business development and enterprise sales.

title: Lead visual graphic designer
description:
Hiring JD: Lead Visual Graphic Designer

About Premier Energies 
Established in 1995, Premier Energies is one of Indias largest integrated solar cell and module manufacturers with state-of-the-art facilities spread across 45 acres in Telangana. The Company also provides engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) and operating and maintenance (O&M) services for solar projects. It is a strong performer on ESG parameters and provides its employees with a great work environment, having been certified a 'GREAT PLACE TO WORK' for five consecutive years. The company recorded a consolidated group revenue and PAT of Rs. 6652 Crores and 937 Crores respectively in FY 2025. In September 2024, the Company successfully got listed on BSE & NSE.
Role Purpose
Premier Energies is seeking a highly skilled Lead Visual Graphic Designer with strong expertise in static visual design, video creation, motion graphics, and 3D layouts. The role is handson and executionfocused, responsible for delivering highquality visual assets across digital, print, video, and 3D platforms while maintaining brand consistency and creative excellence.
Key Responsibilities 
Static Visual Design 
Create high-impact visual assets across multiple communication channels, including:
Social media campaigns and content
Corporate websites and digital marketing assets
Brochures, flyers, posters, banners, and advertisements
Corporate presentations and investor communication materials
Infographics, reports, and technical communication collateral
Product launch and marketing materials
Video & Motion Graphics 
Design and produce: 
Corporate videos
Promotional and brand films
Product explainer videos
Motion graphics and shortform video content
Develop storyboards, visual directions, animations, and final video outputs.
Optimize video formats for different digital platforms.
3D Design & Layouts 
Design 3D visuals, layouts, and renders for: 
Product visualization
Conceptual demos
Exhibition booths and display layouts
Industrial or architectural representations
Ensure visual accuracy, proportion, and aesthetic quality in 3D assets.
AI-Powered Creative Development 
Leverage emerging AI technologies to enhance creative development and content production.
Utilizing AI-powered creative tools for concept generation, image creation, video enhancement, and rapid prototyping
Integrating AI-assisted workflows into design and content production processes
Exploring innovative applications of AI for visual storytelling and campaign development
Maintaining quality control and brand consistency across AI-generated content
Ensuring ethical and responsible use of AI-generated creative assets
Brand Communication & Campaign Creative 
• Develop campaign concepts, key visuals, and creative toolkits for integrated marketing initiatives
• Support corporate branding, employer branding, sustainability communication, and product marketing programs
• Translate business objectives into compelling visual narratives
• Collaborate with marketing, corporate communications, product, and business teams to deliver effective brand communication
• Ensure consistency of visual identity and messaging across all customer touchpoints
Brand Governance & Design Excellence 
Ensure adherence to corporate brand guidelines across all assets
Maintain consistency, creativity, and visual excellence in all communications
Review and refine designs based on stakeholder feedback while preserving creative intent
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in design, motion graphics, AI tools, and visual communication
Ideal Candidate Profile
610+ years of professional experience in visual/graphic design.
Strong portfolio demonstrates static design, video/motion graphics, and 3D work.
Prior experience with a leading creative, advertising, branding, or digital agency is strongly preferred
Experience working on integrated brand campaigns, corporate communications, product marketing, and digital content creation.
Exposure to B2B, industrial, manufacturing, energy, infrastructure, or technology sectors will be an added advantage
Education 
Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, Visual Communication, Multimedia, Animation, or related field.
Technical Skills
Graphic Design:
Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign
Video & Motion:
Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro (or equivalent)
3D Tools (any one or more):
Blender, Cinema 4D, 3Ds Max, SketchUp
Other: Strong understanding of typography, color theory, layout, and visual storytelling
AI Creative Tools
Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Microsoft Designer, ChatGPT for creative ideation and production support
Base Location: Hyderabad Corporate Office
Reporting Structure
The Lead Visual Graphic designer will report to the Head – Marketing and work in close collaboration with Brand teams.

Passion towards Photography and Videography.

Design, develop, and maintain s calable fullstack applications using Java (2+ years), Spring Boot, React.js, and RESTful APIs.

Develop backend services using Spring Boot, Microservices, and REST API s for high performance and scalability.

Integrate user-facing element s with s erver-side logic for a seamless user experience.

Conduct code reviews to maintain code quality and adherence to coding standards.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end test s to ensure reliability.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups.
5) DevOps & Deployment : 
Deploy applications using CI/CD pipeline s (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar).
Utilize Docker and Kubernete s for containerization and orchestration.
Manage cloud-based deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
6) Performance & Security : 
Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and database querie s (SQL / NoSQL).
Implement security best practices (OAuth, JWT, encryption) to protect data & applications.
Monitor and troubleshoot production issues, ensuring minimal downtime.
7) Maintenance & Documentation : 
Maintain and enhance existing application s with new features and improvements.
Create and update technical documentation for software architecture, APIs, and workflows.
Monitor & timely raise requirements for seamless uptime of servers hosting the assigned applications, databases, API & others.

[B] Key Skills & Experience : - 
1) Programming Languages : 
Java (2+ years), Python, JavaScript/TypeScript
2) Frontend Technologies : 
React.js, Redux, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap/Material-UI
3) Backend Technologies : 
Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA
RESTful APIs, Microservices, Maven/Gradle
4) Databases : 
SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis)
5) Cloud & DevOps : 
AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS), Docker, Kubernetes
CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
6) Operating Systems & Tools : 
Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS), Git/SVN, Postman, Swagger
7) Nice-to-Have : 
Knowledge of GraphQL, WebSockets, or Kafka.
Familiarity with testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, Jest, Cypress).
Exposure to monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack).

[C] Soft Skills : 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Working knowledge of AI models & agents will be an added advantage.

Interested candidates kindly share resume at rashmika.manjrekar@sbigeneral.in

Hexagram FinTech, a products company in the Investment Management space is looking for young and energetic Functional Specialists to supplement the current product team. title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Analytics Engineer 

Full-time 
CommVersion runs managed live-chat and AI-assisted conversation products for 
websites across hundreds of client accounts. Every chat, greeting, lead and page view 
lands in our warehouse, and the data team turns that into the client dashboards, 
executive reporting and revenue models the business runs on. 
We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to own models in our dbt codebase end to end from raw loaded tables through to the marts behind our Metabase and Power 
BI dashboards. This is a hands-on build role, not a reporting-request queue. You will 
write SQL and Python that runs in production every hour. 
This suits someone roughly 2 years in who already writes real dbt models and solid 
SQL, and wants to go deeper on data modelling, orchestration and warehouse 
performance with a small, senior team around them. 
Our Stack: 
You will work in all of this. We are not asking you to already know all of it we are asking you to 
be strong in SQL, dbt and Python, and to pick up the rest fast. 

What You'll Do: 

Build and own dbt models across our staging, intermediate, fact/dim and reporting layers including incremental models with merge strategies, SCD-style history tables and change-log driven refresh logic. 
Model the domain properly clients, agents, products, chats, leads, traffic and revenue with dimensional thinking, sane grain and keys that survive contact with real data. 
Write dbt tests and data-quality checks (generic, singular and custom) so that a bad 
upstream load fails loudly instead of quietly reaching a client dashboard. 
Build ingestion with dlt new sources, incremental/persistent vs non-persistent load 
patterns, schema evolution, and migrating our remaining legacy connectors over. 
Write Python where the tooling stops pull from third-party APIs that dlt doesn't cover, 
handle pagination, rate limits and retries, land the data in Redshift, and call our existing AI services for enrichment. 
Orchestrate in Airflow 3 author and maintain DAGs, wire dependencies between load, 
transform and report stages, and keep run times and retries under control. 
Build dashboards in Metabase and Power BI on top of your own models, and work directly with commercial and operations stakeholders on what they actually need. 
Care about performance distribution and sort keys, join strategy, incremental 
windows, and why the daily run got 40 minutes slower this week. 
Work like an engineer branches, PRs, code review, pre-commit checks and documented models. Nothing reaches production straight from a SQL client. 
What We are Looking for: 
Three tiers, and we mean them literally. The first is the bar. The second makes you a stronger candidate, 
but you will not be rejected for missing it. The third we teach you here please don't screen yourself out over it. 

Must have 

2+ year in an analytics engineering, data engineering or BI engineering role (internships 
and academic projects don't count towards this). 
Strong SQL window functions, CTEs, multi-table joins, aggregation at the right grain, 
and the ability to read someone else's 200-line query and explain what it does. 
Working Python requests/pandas, clean functions, error handling and logging. Enough 
to own a script that runs unattended every morning. 
Data modelling fundamentals: facts vs dimensions, grain, and keys that hold up once 
the data gets messy. 
A branch-and-pull-request workflow your work reaches production through code 
review, not a SQL client. 
Clear written and spoken English you will talk directly to non-technical stakeholders. 
Strongly preferred 
These make you a stronger candidate. None of them is a rejection on its own. 
Hands-on production dbt ref/source, materializations, incremental models, tests, macros, and Jinja. 
Any orchestrator: Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Mage. 
Any EL tooling: dlt, Fivetran, Airbyte, Meltano. 
Dashboards built in any BI tool (Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Superset) with real stakeholders on the other side. 
Redshift, or another columnar MPP warehouse Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks. 
GA4 / BigQuery export, Google Ads or other marketing data sources. 
Working with LLM or ML service outputs as a data source scoring, classification, NER. 
We'll teach you here 
Nobody arrives knowing these. They are learned by owning a pipeline in production which is exactly 
what this role gives you. 
Slowly changing dimensions and history modelling keeping last quarter's numbers correct when today's rates change. 
Idempotency, backfills and late-arriving data why a job that runs twice must not double your revenue. 
Redshift performance: distribution and sort keys, VACUUM/ANALYZE, the SUPER type. 
dlt, Airflow 3, dbt-checkpoint, sqlfluff and CI for dbt. 
Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions and our CI/CD pipeline. 
AWS: S3, IAM, ECS/EC2, Secrets Manager. 
Our domain what a chat, a greeting conversion, a lead and a client product actually 
mean. That takes everyone a few weeks. 
Why This role 
Small data team, real ownership your models are the ones the business reports on, 
and you'll see them used the week you ship them. 
A genuinely modern stack, kept current: dbt, Airflow 3, dlt, CI on every PR, and an active 
migration off legacy tooling that you'll help drive. 
Exposure across the full path ingestion, modelling, orchestration, AI-enriched data and 
BI rather than one narrow slice of it. 
Senior engineers who review your code properly and expect you to grow fast. 
A proper deployment path CI/CD with Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD and GitHub Actions. 
You'll work alongside it and pick it up here; we don't expect you to arrive knowing it. 
To apply, send your CV along with a short note on one dbt model or data pipeline you built, 
what made it hard, and what you would do differently now. Links to GitHub, a dbt project or a 
dashboard you're proud of are welcome and count for more than a longer CV.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Site Reliability Engineering ( L2 production support)

Comm skill must be excellent and have good exp in Monitoring Tools(Splunk ,Grafana and Dynatrace),Must be strong in exp in SQL,Unix . 

Java Good to have 

Recruiter level screening questions
How much experience do you have in App prod support as L2
In your last job were you doing App prod support
How many yrs of exp you have with SQL and how would you rate your self
How many yrs of exp you have with Unix and how would you rate your self
Do you have experience with any of the observability tools, if yes which ones and what kind of work did you do on them
Do you have experience with Splunk, Garfana if yes did create dashboards on these tools.
Do you have experience in the SRE space, if yes how many years
Have you ever been part of incident management triaging calls.

JD 

Role Type 

Full-time, on-prem / hybrid aligned to business requirements

Coverage 

24x7x365 production support model, including shift and weekend support as required

Primary Focus 

L2 production support, SRE, observability, automation, resiliency, DR readiness, capacity planning, reporting and production stability

Business Domain 

Investment Management / Financial Services

This role is responsible for L2 production support and Site Reliability Engineering for business-critical applications. The engineer will support production stability, restore services during incidents, improve observability, strengthen monitoring and alerting, automate repetitive work, support resiliency and disaster recovery capability, and provide data-driven operational reporting.
The successful candidate should bring a strong production support background with an engineering mindset focused on reducing toil, improving MTTD/MTTR, increasing automation coverage, improving dashboard visibility, and preventing recurring incidents through root cause analysis and permanent fixes.
Key Responsibilities 
L2 Production Support and Incident Management 
Provide Level 2 production support for critical applications across a 24x7x365 operating model with the flexibility to work on shifts, especially night shifts operating from the MSAS India offices of Mumbai or Bengaluru .
Triage, investigate and resolve production incidents impacting users, batch flows, data, infrastructure, databases, APIs or application services.
Assess severity, priority, business impact, customer impact, regulatory/reputational risk and restoration approach.
Coordinate service restoration with development, infrastructure, database, network, cloud, batch operations and vendor teams.
Provide clear incident updates covering impact, current status, recovery progress, risks, next steps and escalation needs.
Maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, dependency maps, operational playbooks and knowledge articles.
Participate in incident reviews, problem reviews, RCA discussions, audit/compliance activities and continuous service improvement forums.
Observability, Dashboarding and Monitoring 
Design, build and maintain Grafana dashboards for infrastructure health, application availability, API performance, batch status, capacity utilization, dependency health and service-level indicators.
Develop Splunk dashboards, SPL searches, alerts and analytics views for log monitoring, error analysis, transaction trends, abnormal behaviour detection and root cause investigation.
Define actionable monitoring thresholds, alert rules and runbook-linked notifications that support faster detection and recovery.
Improve observability across application, infrastructure, middleware, database, network, batch and cloud layers.
Contribute to SLIs, SLOs, availability tracking, batch health metrics, alert quality metrics and service reliability reporting.
BigPanda and PagerDuty Setup 
Configure BigPanda event ingestion, normalization, deduplication, correlation, enrichment, routing and service ownership alignment.
Improve BigPanda alert quality by reducing noise, duplicate alerts, non-actionable events and poor correlation patterns.
Configure PagerDuty services, escalation policies, on-call schedules, routing rules, incident priorities and response workflows.
Align alert routing with support ownership, severity model, runbooks and 24x7 support operating procedures.
Drive improvements in alert hygiene, incident response discipline, on-call effectiveness and stakeholder notification flows.
Automation, Power Platform and Toil Reduction 
Develop Python automation for health checks, batch validation, log parsing, ticket enrichment, reporting, operational checks and repetitive manual support activities.
Identify auto-remediation opportunities and build safe automation patterns to reduce manual intervention where appropriate.
Use Power Automate to build workflows for notifications, approvals, SharePoint/Teams updates, scheduled checks, exception handling and operational governance.
Use Power BI to create operational dashboards for incident trends, alert hygiene, SLA/SLO performance, capacity utilization, automation coverage, toil reduction and management reporting.
Quantify and reduce operational toil by simplifying workflows, removing manual handoffs, improving runbooks and automating repeatable activities.
Resiliency, DR Capability and Capacity Planning 
Support resiliency reviews, dependency mapping, failure-mode analysis, production readiness reviews and operational risk identification.
Participate in disaster recovery, business continuity, data center resilience and failover/failback testing activities.
Validate application behavior during infrastructure unavailability, degraded conditions, data center flips and recovery scenarios.
Improve DR runbooks, recovery procedures, escalation paths, dependency documentation and validation checklists.
Perform capacity and performance trend analysis across CPU, memory, storage, databases, batch, APIs and transaction volumes to forecast demand and prevent saturation.
Analytics, Reporting and Continuous Improvement 
Analyze operational data to identify recurring incidents, weak signals, capacity risks, alert noise, service instability and improvement opportunities.
Prepare operational reports and dashboards for engineering, production management and senior stakeholder reviews.
Track reliability metrics such as availability, MTTR, MTTD, incident volume, alert quality, automation coverage, toil reduction and SLO compliance.
Partner with development and infrastructure teams on RCA, preventive actions, permanent fixes and long-term reliability improvements.
Promote SRE best practices with a strong focus on measurable outcomes, automation, observability and operational excellence.
Technical Skills 

Area 

Required Skills 

Preferred / Good to Have 

Support and ITSM 

L2 support, incident management, problem management, ITIL, ServiceNow, JIRA, Confluence, runbooks, RCA

Major incident management, production readiness, audit/compliance familiarity

Observability 

Grafana, Splunk, Prometheus, Loki, AppDynamics, Apica, Nagios, monitoring standards, alert design

ELK, Datadog, Dynatrace, AIOps, anomaly detection, predictive monitoring

Alerting and On-call 

BigPanda setup, PagerDuty setup, event correlation, alert routing, escalation policies, on-call schedules

Alert governance, noise reduction, service ownership modelling, auto-remediation integration

Automation and Data 

Python, Shell scripting, SQL, REST APIs, Power Automate, Power BI, Excel, operational analytics

Power Apps, UiPath/Pega, advanced Power BI modelling, automation scorecards

Platforms 

Linux, Windows, Unix/Linux, SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, Sybase, Snowflake, Autosys, ESP, Comet, MQ, cloud fundamentals

Azure/AWS operations, Kubernetes, Docker, Ansible, CI/CD concepts, GitHub, Jenkins
Ideal Candidate Profile 
Hands-on production support engineer with strong SRE orientation and ownership mindset.
Comfortable diagnosing issues across application, batch, database, infrastructure, middleware, network and cloud layers.
Strong dashboarding and analytics capability with practical experience in Grafana, Splunk and Power BI.
Able to communicate clearly with business users, senior stakeholders, developers and infrastructure teams during high-pressure incidents.
Focused on measurable outcomes including availability, reliability, automation coverage, toil reduction, alert quality, MTTR, MTTD, SLO compliance, resiliency, DR readiness and capacity planning.
Strong documentation discipline and commitment to continuous improvement.
Success Metrics 
Improved service availability and production stability.
Reduced MTTR and MTTD through better observability, alerting and automation.
Reduced alert noise and improved alert actionability.
Increased automation coverage and reduced manual operational toil.
Improved Grafana, Splunk and Power BI dashboard adoption.
Improved accuracy of capacity forecasts and operational reporting.
Successful DR and resiliency test outcomes with improved recovery documentation.
Better RCA quality, preventive actions and closure of recurring incident themes.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
In this role, you'll be the first point of contact for production issues. You'll monitor system health, investigate alerts, and work with Engineering, DevOps, Product, and Customer Support teams to fix 
problems fast. From resolving customer support tickets to setting up alerts and dashboards, your work will directly impact the stability and reliability of our services. 

If you're hands-on with monitoring tools, understand cloud basics, can dig into logs, and are eager to take ownership of production support, we'd love to connect with you. 

What You'll Do: 
Monitor system health and performance using tools like Grafana, New Relic, Datadog, Sumo Logic, Dynatrace, etc. 
Create and maintain dashboards, alerts, and log queries to improve visibility and issue detection. 
Respond to and resolve support tickets by working closely with customer support and engineering teams. 
Use Jira to track issues, bugs, and tasks; keep them updated with clear status and progress. 
Document processes, known issues, and solutions in Confluence and maintain operational 
playbooks. 
Troubleshoot and analyze production issues using logs and monitoring data. 
Support root cause analysis and contribute to post-incident reviews. 
Assist in automating routine tasks and improving support workflows. 
Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Apply basic SQL and programming knowledge for debugging and data checks. 
Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, product, and customer support teams to ensure fast resolution and continuous improvement. 

What Were Looking For: 
B.Tech / MCA in Computer Science, IT, or a related field 
2 - 6 years of experience in a technical support, product support, or site operations role. 
Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools like Grafana, New Relic, Datadog,Sumo Logic, Dynatrace, etc. 
Experience in creating dashboards, setting up alerts, and analyzing logs. 
Working knowledge of Jira (issue tracking) and Confluence (documentation) 
Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP. 
Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive mindset. 
Familiarity with SQL for basic querying and troubleshooting. 
Basic programming or scripting experience (e.g., Python, Bash). Good communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams (engineering, DevOps, product, and support)Role & responsibilities.

description:
looking for a data-driven and growth-oriented Senior Manager Performance Marketing & Growth to lead customer acquisition, revenue growth, and marketing efficiency across digital channels. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in scaling D2C brands through performance marketing, analytics, conversion optimization, and full-funnel growth strategies.

Key Responsibilities
1. Performance Marketing Strategy
Develop and execute customer acquisition strategies across paid digital channels.
Own and manage performance marketing budgets to achieve revenue and
profitability targets.
Drive growth through Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube, and other paid media
platforms.
Optimize campaigns based on ROAS, CAC, MER, and LTV metrics.
Identify new growth opportunities and scalable acquisition channels.
2. Paid Media Management
Lead end-to-end campaign planning, execution, and optimization.
Manage:
Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
Google Search Ads
Google Shopping Ads
Performance Max Campaigns
YouTube Ads
Display & Remarketing Campaigns
Continuously improve campaign performance through audience segmentation and
creative testing.
3. Growth & Customer Acquisition
Drive new customer acquisition while maintaining target CAC.
Develop full-funnel growth strategies to improve conversion rates.
Collaborate with CRM and retention teams to maximize customer lifetime value.
Scale acquisition channels while maintaining profitability.
4. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
Analyze user journeys and conversion funnels.
Identify drop-off points and implement optimization strategies.
Conduct A/B testing for landing pages, creatives, and offers.
Improve website conversion rates and overall shopping experience.
5. Analytics & Data-Driven Decision Making
Monitor and analyze:
Revenue
ROAS
CAC
MER
CTR
CPC
Conversion Rate
Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
Build dashboards and reports to track campaign performance.
Provide actionable insights to leadership.
6. Creative Strategy & Testing
Partner with creative and content teams to develop high-performing ad creatives.
Lead creative testing frameworks and experimentation.
Identify winning messaging, formats, and audience segments.
7. Marketplace & Omnichannel Growth
Support growth initiatives across website and marketplace channels.
Collaborate with merchandising, marketing, and product teams to align growth
strategies.
Drive revenue through integrated digital marketing initiatives.
8. Team Management & Leadership
Lead and mentor performance marketing team members.
Coordinate with agencies, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Establish performance goals and drive accountability within the team.
Qualification
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or related field.
26 years of experience in Performance Marketing and Growth.
Strong experience in D2C, Fashion, Retail, or E-commerce brands.
Proven track record of scaling revenue through paid marketing channels.
Strong analytical and leadership skills.

title: Senior Manager- Performance Marketing
description:
Job description 
Role Summary 
We are looking for a hands-on performance marketing leader to own paid customer acquisition for Dr Batra's across Google and Meta.
The ideal candidate is equal parts operator and analyst someone who builds and optimises campaigns daily, reads data down to the ailment, city and keyword level, uses AI to move faster. This is an execution-first role, not a purely strategic one.

Key Responsibilities 
Campaign strategy & execution 
Own end-to-end planning, build, and daily optimisation of paid campaigns across Google (Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Display, YouTube) and Meta (Facebook & Instagram Advantage+ and manual).
Manage keyword, audience, placement, and match-type strategy; build and maintain negative-keyword hygiene and audience exclusions to protect spend.
Performance, efficiency & growth 
Own and continuously improve the core metrics: CPL, cost per qualified lead, lead-to-consultation rate, CPA / cost per acquisition with lead quality weighted as heavily as lead volume.
Manage monthly budget pacing across channels and ailments; forecast month-end spend, flag over/under-pacing, and reallocate to protect efficiency and hit targets.
Tracking, analytics & attribution 
Own conversion tracking integrity end to end: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads conversions, Meta Pixel, offline/CRM conversion imports, Enhanced Conversions, and Meta CAPI (server-side) so that offline consultations and patient value flow back into the platforms.

Skills & Qualifications 
Must have 
6–8 years of hands-on performance marketing experience with direct, in-platform ownership of Google Ads and Meta Ads (not just oversight of an agency).
Proven track record of hitting CPL / CPA targets and scaling spend efficiently — ideally in a lead-generation, healthcare services business.
Strong command of Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Display, YouTube, and Meta Advantage+ / social advertising.
Practical knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, offline conversion imports, Enhanced Conversions and Meta CAPI , and of attribution models.
Genuinely analytical — comfortable in spreadsheets and dashboards, able to turn ailment/city/keyword-level data into decisions.
Good to have 
Experience with multi-location / clinic or franchise businesses / local campaigns.
Exposure to programmatic channels as a secondary growth lever.
Education & certifications 
Graduate in any discipline (Marketing / Business / Analytics or an MBA is a plus, not a requirement — demonstrated performance and hands-on skill matter more than the degree).

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description 

We are looking for someone who understands ROI, ROAS, lead generation, conversion optimization, and scaling advertising campaigns , not just running ads.

Key Responsibilities 
Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, and other platforms .
Experience with CRM platforms, preferably GoHighLevel (GHL). 
Manage advertising budgets and maximize ROAS and ROI.
Develop performance marketing strategies for multiple clients across different industries.
Lead and mentor a team of PPC specialists and digital marketers.
Implement advanced conversion tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and Conversion API.
Conduct A/B testing, audience segmentation, remarketing, and landing page optimization.
Develop lead generation and customer acquisition strategies for Canadian and US markets.
Monitor campaign performance, CPL, CPA, CAC, CTR, and conversion rates.
Ability to build sales funnels, landing pages, and automated lead-nurturing workflows.
Experience integrating CRM with advertising platforms and tracking leads through to sales.
Prepare performance dashboards and present actionable insights to management and clients.
Work closely with creative, content, sales, and web development teams.
Manage multiple client accounts while ensuring deadlines, profitability, and performance targets are achieved.

Required Skills & Qualifications 
Minimum 7 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing.
Minimum 3 years of experience managing teams or leading paid media operations preferred.
Strong expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads is mandatory.
Proven experience managing significant monthly advertising budgets.
Strong knowledge of Google Analytics 4, GTM, Looker Studio, and conversion tracking.
Experience with CRM systems, marketing automation, and lead attribution.
Ability to independently develop and execute performance marketing strategies.
Strong analytical, leadership, communication, and client management skills.
Experience working in a digital marketing agency with multiple clients is highly preferred.
Experience managing campaigns for North American clients is a strong advantage.

What We Are Looking For 

We want a strategic leader who can take ownership of client results , identify growth opportunities, improve campaign profitability, and build a high-performing advertising team.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing both strategy and execution, solving performance challenges, and scaling successful campaigns.

title: Senior Data Analyst - Social
description:
This role sits within the Social Performance & Intelligence team and supports a diverse portfolio of national and international clients across industries including hospitality, automotive, telecoms, entertainment and retail.
The team's mission is to help brands maximize the value of their social media ecosystems by turning data into actionable strategic recommendations. Working across Organic Social as a primary focus, and Earned Social when relevant, the role contributes to the measurement and optimization of brand presence, content performance, creative effectiveness and audience engagement.
The consultant will collaborate closely with Social Media Strategists, Community Managers, Content teams and, when relevant, Media agencies and Paid Social teams to deliver a unified view of social performance across the full POE ecosystem.

Team Profile 
The role is part of the Social Performance & Intelligence practice and collaborates with multiple teams across the Publicis ecosystem, including Social Strategy, Community Management, Content Production, Influence, Data & Analytics and Media teams.
Depending on client needs, the consultant may work on a range of accounts such as Accor, Renault, Orange, Disney and other key clients.
The role acts as a central point of expertise for social media measurement, guaranteeing data accuracy and ensuring that performance insights are translated into actionable recommendations for content, engagement, influence and media activation under the supervision of the Performance Team.

Mission 
The role supports client teams in extracting, monitoring and analyzing social media performance at three complementary levels:
Overall Social Performance 
Measure brand performance against business objectives, benchmarks and competitors
Monitor audience growth, engagement, visibility and social effectiveness
Identify strategic opportunities and emerging trends
Organic & Earned Social Performance 
Evaluate the effectiveness of editorial strategies and community engagement
Analyze content performance across platforms and audiences
Support influencer and earned media measurement when relevant
Provide recommendations to improve reach, engagement and conversation quality
Integrated POE Performance 
Aggregate Organic, Earned and Paid indicators when relevant
Collaborate with media agencies and paid specialists to identify synergies across channels
Contribute to integrated social performance frameworks and reporting approaches
Creative Performance 
Assess content effectiveness by format, theme, platform and creative territory
Generate actionable creative insights to improve future activations
Identify best-performing content patterns and emerging platform behaviors
Key Responsibilities 
Support Social Performance & Intelligence activities across multiple clients:
Monitor and analyze organic social media performance across client portfolios
Ensure data accuracy, reliability on the long run (historical data, benchmarks)
Produce recurring performance reports and executive-ready presentations
Design and maintain dashboards within platforms such as Sprinklr, Emplifi or equivalent social listening and analytics tools
Deliver strategic analyses and performance deep-dives to support client decision-making
Analyze creative, editorial and content performance to optimize social media strategies
Contribute to social media audits, competitive analyses and measurement frameworks
Support influencer and earned media measurement initiatives when relevant
Work with media partners and paid specialists to build integrated views of social performance
Identify opportunities to improve measurement methodologies, KPIs and reporting automation
Promote best practices and knowledge sharing across social teams

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Summary: The Business Intelligence Specialist provides responsive, detail-oriented support for reporting and analytics users. This role handles day-to-day requests and first-level troubleshooting across business intelligence tools, helps maintain reliable reporting, and completes well-defined data and reporting enhancements. The Specialist partners with business users, analysts, and IT to understand needs, resolve issues, communicate progress, and deliver accurate, practical solutions.

Role & Responsibilities: 

Manage access requests: Coordinate and complete access requests for reporting, analytics, and related applications; follow established approval, documentation, and security procedures.
Troubleshoot reporting issues: Investigate and resolve first-level issues in Power BI and SSRS, including report errors, refresh failures, permissions, filters, subscriptions, and unexpected results; escalate complex issues with clear findings and supporting detail.
Respond to user requests: Monitor and respond to requests through the ticketing process, acknowledge receipt, provide status updates, document interactions, and schedule follow-ups when needed.
Write ad-hoc SQL queries: Create and modify SQL queries to answer operational questions, validate data, support troubleshooting, and produce custom extracts while applying sound data-handling practices.
Build minor enhancements: Complete small, well-defined changes in Sigma and other business intelligence tools, such as simple datasets, metrics, visualizations, filters, and report updates.
Validate data and reporting quality: Participate in QA testing; review reports for accuracy, functionality, consistency, and usability; analyze data from multiple sources and partner with Power BI experts to resolve data integrity issues.
Translate business needs: Evaluate internal customer needs and work with users at both a business and technical level to recommend appropriate solutions and act as a dependable technical point of contact.
Manage work and priorities: Develop work plans and timelines, manage workflows and open requests, coordinate with other teams, and balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Improve service delivery: Support workstream planning and help develop turnaround-time metrics and other measures that improve visibility, responsiveness, and service quality.
Use AI thoughtfully: Apply proficiency with AI tools to improve research, troubleshooting, documentation, query development, testing, and workflow efficiency while protecting confidential information and validating outputs.

Education Qualification 
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, as well as the ability to respond appropriately to requests via acknowledgements, updates and resolutions.
Strong attention to detail, focus, follow-through, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to monitor and respond quickly and effectively to requests.
Experience managing projects, requests, or workflows and coordinating work across teams.
Business Intelligence tool experience preferred.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
E ity to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.E

We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to support Mastercard's Lower Environment Platforms. Manage and support lower environments, ensuring stability, availability, and performance.

Knowledge of middleware technologies such as MQ, Tomcat, or JBoss.

Understanding of DevOps, Agile, and SRE practices.
Banking, Financial Services, or Payments domain experience.
