title: Product Owner
description:
Job Title: Product Owner (PO) 
About the Role 
We are looking for an experienced Product Owner with 56 years of experience driving product initiatives, preferably in the US logistics, moving and packing, freight, or related domains.
The ideal candidate will have experience working with US clients, managing product backlogs, translating business requirements into actionable user stories, and driving cross-functional teams to deliver against an established product roadmap.
You will be responsible for driving Product Delivery Pods (PODs), ensuring alignment on priorities, managing dependencies, and enabling timely, high-quality delivery. The role requires strong stakeholder management skills and flexibility to support US client calls during evening hours as needed.
Key Responsibilities 
Product Ownership & Backlog Management 
Own and prioritize the product backlog in alignment with the defined roadmap and business priorities.
Translate requirements into clear user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
Lead backlog refinement and collaborate with engineering and QA teams to ensure requirements are delivery-ready.
Manage scope changes, clarify requirements, and facilitate timely product decisions.
POD Execution & Delivery 
Drive Product Delivery Pods (PODs) against the established roadmap, priorities, and delivery commitments.
Coordinate with engineering, design, QA, and delivery teams to track progress and ensure timely execution.
Identify and resolve delivery blockers, risks, and dependencies proactively.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives, as required.
Support UAT, release readiness, and validation of delivered features against acceptance criteria.
Client & Stakeholder Management 
Work directly with US-based clients to understand requirements, align priorities, and communicate delivery progress.
Facilitate stakeholder discussions, requirement reviews, and sprint demos while documenting key decisions and action items.
Manage evolving stakeholder expectations and maintain alignment across client and internal teams.
Be comfortable supporting US client engagements during evening hours, with stakeholder calls typically scheduled between 7:00 PM and 11:00 PM IST , as required.
Qualifications 
Must Have 
5–6 years of relevant experience in Product Ownership or similar product delivery roles.
Experience working on US client projects, with direct stakeholder interaction.
Domain experience in US logistics, moving and packing, freight, or a related industry.
Strong expertise in product backlog management, user story writing, acceptance criteria, and prioritization.
Proven experience driving Agile delivery with cross-functional teams against an established roadmap.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Flexibility to support US time-zone collaboration as required by project needs.
Good to Have 
Familiarity with logistics and moving workflows, such as estimates, bookings, scheduling, dispatch, tracking, billing, and customer communications.
Experience working with distributed teams across India and the US.
Exposure to enterprise platforms, API integrations, or AI-enabled product initiatives.
Experience supporting UAT, release management, and post-release improvements.

title: Product Owner/AI Engineer
description:
Role Summary 

We are looking for an AI Product Owner to partner with our onsite AI Architecture team and drive initiatives across AI-enabled SDLC, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
The candidate will translate AI strategy and business/engineering opportunities into use cases, product roadmaps, prioritized backlogs, user stories, and measurable outcomes. This role requires someone who understands both product management and modern AI concepts, rather than a traditional Scrum-only Product Owner.

Key Responsibilities 

Own roadmap and backlog for AI-SDLC and Agentic AI initiatives.
Identify AI opportunities across requirements, design, coding, testing, CI/CD, documentation, modernization, and production support.
Define and prioritize GenAI and Agentic AI use cases.
Translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and KPIs.
Work closely with onsite AI architects, business stakeholders, and offshore engineering teams.
Drive initiatives from idea POC MVP production/adoption.
Track business value, productivity improvements, adoption, and ROI.
Incorporate Responsible AI, security, governance, and human-in-the-loop requirements.

Required Skills 

812+ years of experience in Product Management/Product Ownership/Technology.
Strong understanding of SDLC and software engineering processes.
Working knowledge of GenAI, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents/Agentic AI, and AI evaluation.
Strong Agile/backlog management experience.
Experience working with technical/architecture teams.
Strong communication and stakeholder management.
Experience in an onsite-offshore delivery model.

Ideal Candidate 
A technically strong Product Owner who can discuss AI opportunities with business stakeholders and translate them into actionable requirements for architects and engineering teams.

title: Program Manager
description:
Job Description: 

This is a full-time role as a Program Manager located in Pune. The Program Manager will be responsible for overseeing multiple projects and ensuring their successful completion. The Program Manager will also be responsible for creating project plans, assigning tasks, coordinating resources, managing budgets, and communicating progress to stakeholders. 

Requirement: 

1. Key result areas in delivering Program Quality, Cost and Delivery targets including program profitability and risk management. 
2. Budgeting, Scheduling, Business case, business strategy, stake holder management, Negotiation, Etc 
3. Define scope of work for Project for clear understanding of Customer requirements. Project, Program planning, monitoring and tracking 
4. Strategic Engagement with Customer and get alignment on the deliverables in terms of Cost, Quality and Timelines. 
5. Monitoring ECRN and PCRN and its associated cost impact. Study the risk, making mitigation plan, making a decision matrix. 
6. Conducting Weekly Project reviews. Ensuring Gate deliverable sign off and escalating to Management in case of non-adherence. 
7. Ensure Gate Adherence and Financial Health of the project is met as per the target derived from the Business case. 
8. Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks, and issues, communicating across leadership in MIS and Steering committee meetings. 
9. Inventory management during the Project execution till 3 months post SOP. 
10. Managed project documentation in line with APQP, Customer requirements and IATF quality standards

title: Delivery Manager
description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Delivery Manager to lead our Data Engineering delivery portfolio. You will own end-to-end delivery of large-scale data programs for global clients, covering data platform modernization, cloud migration, pipelines, and analytics enablement. Overall 15+ yrs of experience -You will manage client relationships, delivery teams, financial performance, and quality outcomes. You will also help us grow the practice by bringing AI/ML and GenAI capabilities into engagements.
Key Responsibilities
Delivery Management 
Own delivery of multiple data engineering projects and programs across onshore/offshore models, ensuring on-time, on-budget, high-quality outcomes.
Drive project governance: planning, risk and issue management, dependency tracking, change control, and escalation handling.
Ensure adherence to SLAs, KPIs, and delivery best practices (Agile, DevOps, DataOps).
Conduct regular delivery reviews, steering committee meetings, and status reporting with clients and internal leadership.
Client & Stakeholder Management 
Act as the primary delivery point of contact for senior client stakeholders (CIO, CDO, Heads of Data/Engineering).
Build long-term client relationships, drive satisfaction (CSAT/NPS), and identify opportunities for account growth.
Support pre-sales activities: solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, SOWs, and client presentations.
Technical Leadership & Solution Oversight 
Provide technical direction on data architecture, ETL/ELT pipelines, data lakes/lakehouses, data warehousing, and real-time streaming solutions.
Guide teams on cloud data platform adoption (Azure, AWS, GCP) and modern data stack tools.
Champion data quality, governance, security, and compliance standards.
Identify opportunities to embed AI/ML, GenAI, and intelligent automation into data solutions.
People & Practice Management 
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of architects, leads, and data engineers (typically 40-100+ members).
Manage resource planning, utilization, hiring, onboarding, and attrition.
Build a culture of upskilling and certification in cloud, data, and AI technologies.
Contribute to practice growth through accelerators, reusable frameworks, and thought leadership.
Financial & Operational Management 
Own project P&L, including revenue, margins, forecasting, billing, and cost optimization.
Improve delivery efficiency using automation, productivity levers, and pyramid management.
Ensure compliance with company processes, contractual obligations, and audit requirements.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelors or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
12-16 years of IT experience, with a strong background in data engineering/data warehousing and proven delivery management experience in an IT services or consulting environment.
Track record of managing large, multi-million-dollar data programs with distributed teams.
Hands-on understanding of: 
Cloud data platforms: Azure (Synapse, ADF, Databricks, Fabric), AWS (Redshift, Glue, EMR, S3), or GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow)
Big data & processing: Spark, Kafka, Hadoop ecosystem, Snowflake, Databricks
ETL/ELT & orchestration: Informatica, Talend, dbt, Airflow, or similar
Data modeling, warehousing, lakehouse architecture, and data migration 
SQL, Python/Scala (for technical guidance and review)
Strong experience with Agile/Scrum, SAFe, and DevOps/DataOps practices.
Excellent command of project financials: estimation, budgeting, forecasting, and margin management.
Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with experience handling US/EU clients.
PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, or equivalent certification is preferred.
Good to Have (AI/ML Exposure)
Experience delivering or overseeing AI/ML or GenAI projects (e.g., ML pipelines, MLOps, feature stores, RAG-based solutions, LLM integrations).
Familiarity with tools such as Azure ML, SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow, or Databricks ML.
Understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, and AI governance.
Ability to position and sell AI-enabled data solutions to clients.
Cloud or data certifications (Azure Data Engineer, AWS Data Analytics, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.).
Key Competencies
Strategic and outcome-driven delivery mindset
Strong leadership and people management
Client-centric approach with an ownership attitude
Problem-solving and crisis management
Business acumen and commercial awareness
Ability to balance technical depth with program-level oversight
What We Offer
Opportunity to lead high-impact data and AI programs for global clients
Competitive compensation and performance-linked incentives
Continuous learning, certifications, and career growth into Practice Head / Delivery Head roles
Collaborative, innovation-driven work culture

title: Program Manager
description:
Programme Manager - Loss Prevention
Company : Xpressbees 
Location: Pune, India 
Department: Supply Chain | Operations Excellence | Central Operations
Experience: 2+ Years 

About XpressBees 
XpressBees is a leading logistics and supply chain solutions provider in India, offering end-to-end logistics services across e-commerce, B2B, and cross-border operations. We leverage technology, analytics, and operational excellence to deliver reliable and scalable logistics solutions. 

Role Overview 
We are looking for a data-driven and execution-focused Programme Manager - Loss Reduction to drive loss prevention and operational efficiency across our logistics network. The role will focus on identifying operational leakages, reducing shipment losses and damages, improving process compliance, and implementing scalable control mechanisms across hubs, warehouses, linehaul, and last-mile operations. The ideal candidate should combine strong analytical capabilities with programme management and supply chain expertise to deliver measurable improvements in operational performance and cost efficiency. 

Key Responsibilities 
Loss Reduction: Identify, track, and reduce shipment losses, damages, shortages, pilferage, and other operational 
leakages across the logistics network. 

Programme Management: Own end-to-end loss reduction initiatives, from problem identification and planning to 
implementation, monitoring, and closure. 

Data Analytics: Analyse operational data, loss trends, and performance metrics to identify root causes and high-risk 
areas. 

Dashboard & KPI Management: Develop and monitor dashboards, MIS reports, and performance scorecards to track 
losses, ageing, recoveries, and process compliance. 

Process Improvement: Design and implement SOPs, preventive controls, and process improvements to minimise 
recurring losses and operational inefficiencies. 

Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Operations, Finance, Security, Technology, Linehaul, and Customer 
Experience teams to drive corrective actions. 

Cost Optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce operational costs, improve resource utilisation, and minimise 
financial exposure. 

Risk & Compliance: Monitor process adherence, conduct operational reviews, and establish accountability for recurring 
issues. 

Technology & Automation: Partner with technology teams to automate tracking, strengthen system controls, and 
improve shipment visibility. 

Management Reporting: Present programme progress, key findings, business impact, and corrective action plans to 
senior stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications & Skills 
- B.tech/ MBA (Top Ranked College) 
- 2+ years of experience in e-commerce, logistics, supply chain, operations excellence, analytics, or programme management. 
- Strong understanding of warehouse operations, fulfilment processes, inventory management, or last-mile logistics. 
- Proficiency in Advanced Excel; working knowledge of SQL, Power BI, or other BI tools is preferred. 
-Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root cause analysis and data interpretation. 
-Experience managing cross-functional projects and driving process improvement initiatives. 
-Strong stakeholder management, communication, planning, and execution skills.

title: Scrum Master
description:
About The Role 

The Scrum Master (SM) ensures the way of working enables delivery within Avayas CI/CD Feature Team model. This role owns flow health, process discipline, and continuous improvement protecting the team’s ability to deliver continuously through WIP discipline, impediment removal, and ensuring Jira reflects execution reality, not planning aspiration. Avaya keeps the customer at the core. The SM protects flow so the team can deliver customer-valuable increments continuously. This role facilitates, coaches, and removes impediments. It partners closely with the Product Owner (PO), Delivery and Execution Lead (DEL), Technical Lead (TL), and PLM (Analyst). It does not own backlog content/acceptance, delivery-commitment outcomes, product prioritization, technical decisions, or release Go/No-Go.

Key responsibilities 

Facilitate Agile ceremonies (Daily Flow/standup, Planning, Refinement, Review, Retrospective, Demo) that produce decisions and momentum
Enforce WIP limits and working agreements to protect flow and prevent overcommitment
Remove team-level and systemic impediments; escalate what the team cannot resolve alone
Keep Jira (and Zephyr-related progress signals) accurate and trustworthy — daily, no exceptions
Use flow metrics (cycle time, throughput, blocked time) to drive continuous improvement
Partner with PO on readiness and sprint-commitment alignment; TL on technical/pipeline impediments; DEL on cross-team/systemic escalation; PLM on requirement clarity impacting flow
Coach the team on sustainable pace, psychological safety, and customer-aware delivery conversations - without taking product ownership
Use AI (Tier 2 — Practitioner) to accelerate sprint-health, flow, and retrospective prep; remain accountable for facilitation judgment and data integrity

Required qualifications 

Strong background in Agile ways of working; familiarity with Scrum, SAFe, ICAgile, Scrum Alliance, and/or related certifications / continuing education
Work-item tracking experience — Jira preferred, or comparable tools (Rally, Azure DevOps/ADO)
Proficiency in Google Workspace preferred, or equivalent Microsoft Office fluency
Proven ceremony facilitation and coaching craft (Powerful Questions, Active Listening, constructive collaboration)
Flow and metrics literacy; demonstrated continuous-improvement follow-through
Strong stakeholder communication and conflict navigation under delivery pressure
Comfort using AI tools to support facilitation and metrics prep, with human accountability for decisions and board accuracy

What success looks like 

Predictable flow with consistent throughput and minimal blocked work
Trustworthy, current Jira/Zephyr data
Continuous improvement that is visible and actionable
Sprint objectives supported through strong process facilitation — without the SM becoming a task manager, delivery owner, or people manager

The primary focus of this role will be Meta Ads and Google Ads, with responsibility for campaign execution, optimization, tracking, lead quality, and conversion performance.

• Drive qualified leads, customer acquisition, and conversions. 
• Monitor campaign performance and optimize for better lead quality and ROI. 
• Track and improve CPL, CPA, CAC, CTR , Conversion Rate, and ROAS . 
• Conduct A/B testing across creatives, ad copies, audiences, locations, and campaigns. 
• Work with design and content teams to develop high-performing ad creatives. 
• Track conversions using GA4, Meta Pixel, GTM, UTMs, and other tracking tools.

title: Senior Creative Designer
description:
About the role 
We're looking for a hands-on creative lead to own design across our multi-brand portfolio in wellness, finance, trading and real estate. You'll take work from brief to final production - concept, art direction and finished craft - across brand identity, packaging, e-commerce, digital ads and print. You'll use generative AI tools to explore more directions, faster, while keeping art direction and final quality firmly human.

Key responsibilities 
Lead creative for multiple brands, owning concept, art direction and final quality on every deliverable.
Build and maintain brand identities and visual systems - logos, guidelines, stationery, brochures and roll-up systems.
Design Amazon A+ content, marketplace listings, product imagery and retouching.
Create web pages, website banners, icon sets and 3D illustrations.
Produce PPC and display ads in all standard sizes, consistent across formats and campaigns.
Design packaging and label systems - dielines, print prep and special finishes (e.g. foil).
Develop repeatable social content systems and launch, sale and seasonal campaign creative for D2C and marketplace channels.
Deliver print and POS collateral: roll-ups, tent cards, large format and stationery; coordinate with printers and vendors.
Plan campaign assets with motion and short video in mind; edit simple video pieces where needed.
Run reviews with stakeholders, scope briefs and manage multiple projects to deadline.

Requirements 
5+ years in graphic / creative design, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead role.
A strong portfolio covering brand identity, packaging and integrated campaigns - ideally for wellness, beverage, finance or real-estate brands.
Proven experience with Amazon A+ / e-commerce creative and performance (PPC) ad formats.
Solid print production knowledge: dielines, colour, prepress and finishes.
Confident art direction and typography; able to set and protect a visual standard across brands.
Clear communicator who can take a loose brief, ask the right questions and present work with rationale.
Degree or diploma in design, VFX, fine arts or related field - or equivalent professional experience.

EXPERTISE 
Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, CorelDRAW, Adobe Firefly

WORKING KNOWLEDGE 
CorelDRAW, Premiere Pro, Figma, Google Ads, Claude / ChatGPT

AI-assisted workflow 
You'll use tools such as Firefly, Photoshop generative features and Ideogram to explore lighting, colour and layout options at volume, and LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT to break down briefs and draft copy. Every final is selected and hand-finished by you - we want more directions per round without losing craft or consistency.

Nice to have 
UI/UX or Figma experience for web pages and landing pages.
Product mock-ups, 3D visualisation or basic motion / VFX skills.
Digital marketing understanding (Google Ads, marketplace performance).
Experience coordinating designers or freelancers.

We are 20+ year-old brand, with a strong foot hold in event management & entertainment across the country. A small but dynamic team focusing on delivery & customer satisfaction is the essence of
the company. We need like- minded people who can keep up with our pace, work ethic & match our vision to go beyond! With clientele being majorly global MNC’s across IT, manufacturing, automotive & media, Livewire is a growing brand.

Job Purpose: 
Creating digital graphics and artwork for the company, ensuring high-quality visual content that aligns with brand guidelines and client requirements.

Key Accountabilities: 
• Design 2D graphics for print media, digital presentations, mockups, and event-related
collateral. 
• Create emailers, website layouts for campaigns, and loyalty programs.
• Develop print designs for logos, posters, newsletters, direct mailers, brochures, character
designs, and mascots.
• Produce event-related collateral such as backdrops, side wings, standees, and ID

• Design brand identities including logos, visiting cards, and letterheads.
• Conduct quality control checks of large-format print files (Flex, Vinyl) for size, color, logos, and
other design/print-related issues.
• Archive creatives regularly in a stringent and organized manner.
• Collaborate with the Client Servicing team to understand the consumer experience, marketing
strategy, and operational capabilities.
• Adhere to brand guidelines, ensuring color accuracy, updated logos, and consistency in all
design elements.
• Implement quality control measures, including creating color palettes and small files for
accuracy checks.
• Visualize, brainstorm, and ideate to transform ideas into effective designs/artwork.
• Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends and ensure that all creatives reflect current
styles.
• Prepare digital presentations, mockups, and stills for client pitches and internal reviews.
• Ensure stringent archiving of all creatives and maintain organized digital files for easy access
and retrieval.

• Willingness to upgrade as per trends and self-study.
• Market research skills and curiosity to learn.
• Patience, resilience, and self-motivation.
• Strong attention to detail and a keen understanding of typography and composition.
• Ability to communicate and work effectively in a team environment.

• Knowledge of After Effects and video editing skills will be an added advantage.
• Ability to stay updated with the latest design trends globally.
• ***Strong sense of typography and composition.
• Understanding of file preparation using all programs in the Adobe suite.

Leadership Skills :
• Effective time management and ability to work well under pressure.
• Ability to motivate oneself and manage tasks efficiently.
• Open to learning and personal development.

PERSONALITY TRAITS 
Communication Skills: 
• Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with the Client Servicing and Operations teams.
• Ability to communicate complex information or ideas clearly to diverse audiences.
• Experience in communicating and working within a team environment.

Personal Characteristics: 
• Curious and willing to learn.
• Self-motivated with a positive attitude.
• Strong sense of patience and resilience.
• Ability to conduct market research and keep a watch on industry trends.
• Open to self-study and continuous improvement.
• Eager to stay up-to-date with the latest design trends globally.

title: Data Analyst - Business Intelligence & Analytics
description:
Job Description 

Data Analyst - Business Intelligence & Analytics 
For Operations, Business Analytics, CRM, Campaign Analytics, Dashboarding and Automation Support 

Job Title 
Data Analyst - Business Intelligence & Analytics 

Location 
Head Office, Chennai 

Experience 
2 to 5 years in Data Analytics, MIS, Business Intelligence or Reporting 

Role Purpose 
We are looking for a highly analytical and business-oriented Data Analyst to support business intelligence, reporting automation, campaign analytics, CRM transformation, customer-level tracking and performance management initiatives. The role will work closely with Operations, Business, Marketing, Product, Technology and Analytics teams to convert data into actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making. 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on exposure to SQL, Power BI and Advanced Excel, with working knowledge of Python preferred. The person should be able to understand business problems, extract and validate data, build dashboards, automate recurring reports, and communicate insights in a simple business-consumable manner. 

Experience Requirement 
2 to 5 years of experience in Data Analytics, MIS, Business Intelligence, Reporting or Data Analysis. 
Hands-on experience with SQL and Power BI is essential. 
Experience in financial services, insurance, lending, CRM analytics or campaign analytics will be an added advantage. 

Candidate Profile Summary 
The role is best suited for a person who is not limited to routine MIS preparation, but can think analytically, question data quality, understand business context, and convert raw data into decisions. The candidate should be comfortable working with large datasets, senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, while also being hands-on enough to build dashboards, automate reports and prepare actionable business insights. 
Nice-to-Have Capabilities 
Experience with CRM data, lead management systems or Work Queue Management platforms. 
Power BI DAX and data modeling exposure. 
Google BigQuery or cloud data platform exposure. 
Ability to prepare concise business notes and presentation-ready insights. 
Exposure to GenAI or AI productivity tools for documentation, analysis and reporting support.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
looking for an experienced Machine Learning Engineer with 7+ years of experience to join our growing AI practice. This role is at the intersection of agentic automation, enterprise LLM integration, manufacturing AI, and responsible AI governance. You will design and deploy multi-agent orchestration systems, RAG pipelines, computer vision solutions, and business process automation that create measurable impact across manufacturing and enterprise client environments. The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience with LLMs and generative AI, strong Python and ML framework proficiency, and a track record of shipping production-grade AI systems at scale.

Design and deploy multi-agent orchestration platforms for manufacturing automation and business process automation using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, and LangChain. 
Build enterprise LLM integrations including RAG pipelines, domain-specific knowledge bases, and fine-tuning workflows tailored to client-specific domains and data.

Automate internal business workflows across Finance, HR, Compliance, and Operations by designing and integrating AI-driven automation solutions. 
Establish and maintain AI governance frameworks covering model evaluation, prompt management, risk assessment, and responsible AI practices at enterprise scale. 
Collaborate with data engineers, platform architects, and business stakeholders to define AI system requirements and translate them into production-ready ML solutions. 
Integrate vector databases, embedding models, and MLOps tooling to support scalable model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Conduct model evaluation, red-teaming, and performance benchmarking; iterate on prompts, architectures, and fine-tuning strategies to meet quality thresholds.
Stay current with advances in LLMs, agentic AI, and Industry 4.0 technologies; contribute to internal knowledge sharing and technical community. 

Location: Chennai
Exp; 7 + yrs
Working mode : Hybrid 
Notice period : Immediate

This role is ideal for a mid-to-senior level analytics professional who enjoys solving complex business problems through statistical analysis, machine learning, AI, and data visualization. The successful candidate will partner with business stakeholders, data engineers, and leadership teams to transform data into actionable insights, predictive models, and intelligent decision-support solutions.

You will design, develop, validate, and maintain advanced analytics solutions while contributing to the organizations analytics modernization strategy. This role requires a strong combination of business acumen, analytical thinking, statistical knowledge, and hands-on technical capability.

Key Responsibilities
Partner with business stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify analytical opportunities, and translate requirements into scalable solutions.
Design and develop advanced analytics models for forecasting, optimization, segmentation, classification, and predictive decision-making.
Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, drivers, anomalies, and actionable business insights.
Build, validate, deploy, and monitor machine learning and statistical models for enterprise business use cases.
Develop analytical solutions using Python, R, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, notebooks, and related technologies. 
Create dashboards, scorecards, and self-service analytical experiences using Microsoft Power BI and Fabric.
Collaborate with data engineers to define data requirements and ensure reliable, governed, analytics-ready datasets.
Support AI and Generative AI initiatives by assessing business use cases and implementing appropriate analytical approaches.
Build reusable analytics assets, feature engineering components, notebooks, templates, and frameworks.
Document analytical methodologies, assumptions, model logic, validation results, limitations, and business recommendations.
Present analytical insights and recommendations clearly to business and executive stakeholders.
Apply data governance, privacy, security, and responsible AI standards throughout the analytics lifecycle.
Mentor junior team members, participate in peer reviews, and promote analytical best practices.
Evaluate emerging analytics, machine learning, and AI technologies that can improve business outcomes

Education
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
6 to 10+ Years of Experience
Advanced analytics, statistical analysis, or data science solution delivery. 
SQL Server, T-SQL, data analysis, and relational data modeling.
Python or R programming for analytics and model development .

Microsoft Fabric and analytics workloads.

Medallion Data Architecture and Lakehouse concepts.

Advanced Analytics & Data Science

Feature engineering and model evaluation

Generative AI applications and prompt engineering

Responsible AI practices

Experience building enterprise-scale analytics solutions and reusable analytical products.
Experience with workforce, hiring, recruitment, financial, or operational analytics.

Strong consulting, communication, problem-solving, and data storytelling skills.

description:
Job Description 
Title: Cloud Engineer L3 (Projects) 
Required Experience: 8 to 15 years 
We are seeking a Cloud Engineer - L3 with 8 to 15 years of hands-on experience in designing, implementing, and managing cloud infrastructure and DevOps automation solutions.
The ideal candidate should have experience with:
Designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or similar automation tools.
Automating application deployments for microservices and containerized applications across multi cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP, In-house DC) environments.
Developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and AWS CloudFormation.
Strong hands-on experience in independently designing, developing, and maintaining Terraform code from scratch, including reusable modules, remote state management, variables, outputs, and infrastructure provisioning following Infrastructure as Code (IaC) best practices.
Implementing configuration management using Ansible, Ansible Tower/Automation Controller, Puppet, or Chef.
Hands-on experience in developing Ansible playbooks, roles, inventories, and automation workflows from scratch to automate infrastructure provisioning, application deployment, and configuration management.
Managing cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP, with experience in multi-cloud environments preferred.
Working with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm for container orchestration and application deployment.
Writing automation scripts using Python, Bash, or PowerShell to streamline operational processes.
Implementing monitoring and observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or CloudWatch.
Working with messaging platforms such as Apache Kafka for real-time data streaming.
Implementing secure infrastructure using HashiCorp Vault, IAM, and security best practices.
Collaborating with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment and infrastructure issues.
Performing root cause analysis, performance tuning, and continuous optimization of cloud infrastructure and DevOps processes.
Preferred Qualifications 
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
8+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Application(SAAS) hosting, Cloud Application Support.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.
Self-motivated with a passion for automation, continuous improvement, and adopting modern DevOps practices.

title: AI Cloud Engineer
description:
Cloud AI Engineer — Agentic AI & Generative AI (Azure) 
We are looking for a senior engineer with 15+ years of overall software/ML engineering experience, including at least 4 years building Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions on Microsoft Azure, to design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic and GenAI systems across the full AI stack.
Responsibilities 
Architect and build GenAI solutions using Microsoft Foundry and Azure OpenAI, selecting models via the Foundry model catalog (OpenAI, Llama, Mistral, MAI)
Design and own Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using Azure OpenAI Embeddings, Azure AI Search, and Foundry IQ
Lead development of production AI agents using the Microsoft Agent Framework on Foundry Agent Service, with tool-calling via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and multi-agent coordination via the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol
Define and enforce Azure AI Content Safety guardrails and lead Foundry evaluations before production release
Own MLOps automation with Azure ML / MLflow and drive fine-tuning of models on proprietary data
Mentor engineers and guide architecture decisions for agentic AI adoption across teams
Required Skills 
10-15 years overall software/ML engineering experience, including at least 3 years hands-on with Agentic AI and Generative AI specifically
Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft Foundry and/or Azure OpenAI in a production environment
Strong grasp of embeddings, vector search, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture
Practical experience with the Microsoft Agent Framework, MCP tool-calling, and A2A multi-agent patterns
Strong Python/.NET and Azure fundamentals (Blob Storage, Entra ID, Container Apps)
Interview process: AI CBIE test, L1 & L2 (final round will be face to face)

Manage budgets, project schedules, and program reporting.
Act as the primary escalation point for operational and client-related issues.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Recruitment Manager Job Description
1. End-to-End Recruitment Management: Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for permanent, contract, and contract-to-hire (C2H) positions across various IT technologies.
2. Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and manage the Talent Acquisition team, including Team Leaders, Senior Recruiters, and Junior Recruiters, to achieve recruitment targets.
3. Client & Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, hiring managers, and internal stakeholders to understand hiring requirements and deliver recruitment solutions.
4. Business Development Support: Support business development activities, participate in client meetings, identify new hiring opportunities, and assist in acquiring new client accounts.
5. Recruitment Strategy: Develop effective sourcing strategies using job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, vendor networks, and other recruitment channels.
6. Performance & KPI Management: Monitor recruiter performance through daily, weekly, and monthly trackers, focusing on submissions, interviews, selections, offers, and onboardings.
7. Vendor Management: Manage recruitment vendors, negotiate commercial terms, maintain vendor relationships, and ensure timely profile submissions against client requirements.
8. Target & Delivery Management: Drive monthly and quarterly hiring targets, ensure timely closures, maintain pipeline quality, and meet client-specific SLAs.
9. Escalation & Issue Management: Handle client escalations, candidate dropouts, offer declines, interview delays, and other recruitment-related challenges while ensuring smooth delivery.
10. Reporting & Process Improvement: Prepare MIS reports, recruitment dashboards, productivity reports, and margin analysis. Implement process improvements and leverage AI recruitment tools to improve hiring efficiency.
Additional skills to highlight: Leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation, business development, strategic workforce planning, data-driven decision-making, and AI-enabled recruitment.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 

The Role 
Anoud is hiring a Delivery Manager to own end-to-end delivery of our Insurance product implementations for 
onshore/global clients, working out of our Chennai offshore team. This is an application implementation delivery 
role the person will lead product configuration, rollout, and go-live delivery for insurance clients, not infrastructure 
or platform operations. Strong stakeholder management is core to this role, as the person will be the primary bridge 
between onshore business/client stakeholders and the offshore implementation team. 
Key Responsibilities 
1. Insurance Product Implementation & Delivery Management 
Own end-to-end delivery of Insurance product implementations – configuration, testing, UAT, and go-live 
Ensure delivery consistently meets agreed SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, and client expectations 
Establish clear ownership, accountability, and governance across implementation and engineering teams 
Monitor delivery performance, identify implementation risks, and initiate corrective actions 
Drive delivery maturity through standardization, automation, process improvement, and implementation best 
practices 
Ensure business-critical product rollouts have appropriate coverage, documented procedures, and escalation 
mechanisms 
Maintain a strong focus on delivery quality, client satisfaction, and product reliability 
Provide regular management reporting covering implementation health, risks, issues, and improvement initiatives 
2. Stakeholder Management (Core Strength Required) 
Act as the primary offshore point of contact for onshore/global client stakeholders and leadership 
Lead client and internal governance calls, presenting delivery status, risks, and outcomes with clarity and 
confidence 
Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with client stakeholders across business and technology 
Own escalations end-to-end – fast resolution, transparent and proactive communication 
Manage expectations across multiple stakeholder groups (client, onshore leadership, offshore delivery team) 
simultaneously 
3. Team & People Management 
Manage and grow team leads and implementation/delivery managers 
Own capacity planning and resource allocation across implementation projects 
Build a culture of ownership and accountability; support career growth and succession planning 
4. AI-Enabled Delivery 
Actively use AI tools in day-to-day delivery work – reporting, status updates, documentation, risk analysis, and 
productivity tasks 
Champion the adoption of AI-assisted workflows within the delivery team to improve speed and qualityAnoud Technologies | We Ensure. You Insure. 
Page 2 
Evaluate and recommend AI tools that can streamline implementation and delivery processes 
5. Reporting 
Own weekly/monthly delivery reporting: SLA adherence, delivery timelines, quality, risk status, and client 
feedback 
Required Experience 
12–16 years in IT Delivery Management, Implementation Management, or Insurance Technology Delivery 
6–8 years specifically managing offshore delivery/implementation teams reporting into onshore/global 
stakeholders 
Mandatory: Experience delivering Insurance product implementations (policy admin, claims, underwriting, or 
related insurance platforms) 
Proven, demonstrable strength in stakeholder management – client-facing experience is essential, not just 
internal team coordination 
Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of delivery workflow (reporting, documentation, analysis) 
Demonstrated ownership of delivery governance and KPI reporting 
Required Skills 
Insurance Product Implementation • Application Delivery Management • Stakeholder & Client Management • 
SLA/OLA Management • Delivery Governance • Team Leadership • Capacity Planning • Risk & Escalation 
Management • Process Improvement • AI-Assisted Delivery Practices 
Preferred Certifications 
PMP – Preferred for strong project, delivery, planning, risk, budget, and stakeholder management capabilities 
ITIL 4 Foundation / Managing Professional – Preferred for service management, incident, problem, change, 
and governance experience 
PRINCE2 Practitioner – Preferred for structured project governance and delivery controls 
Agile / Scrum – Desirable for Agile, DevOps, and product-oriented delivery environments

description:
Position Overview 

We are seeking a highly driven and experienced Scrum Master with strong Delivery Management capabilities to join our Project. The role requires an individual who can effectively manage complex delivery environments, drive execution across multiple teams, collaborate with business and technology stakeholders, and deliver outcomes at pace.
This is a critical role within a high-visibility program, requiring a confident leader who can take ownership, solve problems proactively, and ensure successful delivery of strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities 

Lead Agile delivery across multiple Scrum teams and vendors within Our Project.
Drive program execution, sprint planning, backlog management, and delivery governance.
Ensure timely and high-quality delivery of project milestones and business commitments.
Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and impediments and drive their resolution.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Engineering Teams, Architects, and Business Stakeholders.
Monitor delivery performance metrics and establish continuous improvement practices.
Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on priorities, deliverables, and timelines.
Provide leadership and coaching to teams on Agile frameworks, Scrum best practices, and delivery excellence.
Drive stakeholder communications and executive reporting across project workstreams.
Take ownership of strategic initiatives and ensure successful execution from inception to completion.
Leverage AI tools and productivity accelerators to improve team efficiency, delivery speed, decision-making, and operational effectiveness.

Required Skills & Experience 

Delivery & Project Management 

Strong Delivery Management and Project Management experience in Agile environments.
Proven ability to manage multiple teams simultaneously.
Experience working in complex, multi-vendor delivery ecosystems.
Strong planning, tracking, governance, and execution capabilities.

Agile & Scrum Expertise 

Hands-on Scrum Master experience driving Agile transformations and delivery excellence.
Deep understanding of Scrum, Agile principles, Kanban, and scaled Agile practices.

title: Data Scrum Master
description:
Experience - 5 to 8 yrs 
Role Summary: 
The Scrum Master & Quality Lead will partner with our Data Product Owner (DPO) and guide a cross-functional team of software developers, data engineers, and operations specialists. This team owns the end-to-end data lifecycle—from vehicle collection and ingestion to processing, annotation, and release—powering our Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Parking features (Perception, Parking Functions, and Crowd-Sourced Maps). In this dual-purpose role, you will act as a servant-leader to optimize team workflows and Agile practices, while leveraging your strong test management background to establish robust validation methodologies for our data pipelines and final data products. Because high-quality data is safety-critical for ADAS, you will champion a culture where data integrity is treated with the same rigor as software code. 
Key Responsibilities 
1. Agile Coaching & Delivery Facilitation 
Facilitate standard Agile ceremonies, including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives. 
Guide the team in Agile best practices, adapting frameworks (Scrum/Kanban) to suit a unique blend of software engineering and operational data tasks. 
Track and communicate key delivery metrics (e.g., sprint burndown, velocity, and cycle time for data processing). 
Actively identify and remove technical or operational impediments that hinder team progress. 
2. Partnership with the Data Product Owner (DPO) 
Collaborate closely with the DPO to ensure the data product backlog is refined, prioritized, and aligned with downstream ADAS feature development. 
Assist in breaking down complex data pipeline requirements into clear, manageable epics and user stories. 
Manage cross-team dependencies, safeguarding the team from scope creep and external distractions. 
3. Data Quality & Validation Governance 
Champion the Definition of Done (DoD) by ensuring it explicitly includes data validation gates, schema checks, and data contract adherence before any story is closed. 
Establish and monitor validation workflows for the annotation process, ensuring metrics like Inter-Annotator Agreement (IAA) and groundtruth accuracy meet strict ADAS thresholds. 
Define statistical sampling and validation frameworks for incoming, often noisy, crowd-sourced parking map data. 
4. Test Strategy & Pipeline Methodology 
Drive a "Shift-Left" data testing culture by facilitating the integration of automated data testing (e.g., anomaly detection, automated schema checks) early in the ingestion and processing pipelines. 
Coordinate with data engineers to apply robust testing methodologies (Unit, Integration, and End-to-End) to both the pipeline code and the data payloads themselves. 
Lead defect triage sessions specifically focused on data anomalies, differentiating between software pipeline defects and fundamental data quality issues (e.g., sensor calibration). 
5. Release Readiness & Traceability 
Act as the testing liaison for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with downstream ADAS feature developers, ensuring released datasets physically function in their simulation and training environments. 
Ensure full traceability from initial driving campaign requirements through to the final validated data release, supporting automotive safety and compliance audits. 
Qualifications & Skills 
Proven experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or Agile Delivery Lead in a fast-paced technology environment. 
Deep background in Test Management, Quality Assurance, or SDET leadership, with a strong grasp of modern testing frameworks and methodologies. 
Deep understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and when to pragmatically apply them. 
Excellent facilitation, conflict resolution, and communication skills. 
Proficiency with Agile lifecycle and test management tools Domain Expertise (ADAS & Automotive) 
Previous experience supporting data engineering, machine learning operations (MLOps), or data pipeline teams. 
Understanding of the unique challenges in data lifecycles compared to traditional software development (e.g., managing physical data collection logistics or human-in-the-loop annotation). Familiarity with the automotive industry, ADAS, autonomous driving environments, or sensor data (Cameras, Radar, LiDAR, UltrasONIC

title: Performance Marketing Lead
description:
Roles & responsibilities: 

You will own paid media results for a portfolio of D2C brands across India and the US. Not just campaign setup, but the numbers: cost per purchase, ROAS and new customer growth.

Run Meta, Google (Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Shopping), Pinterest and Reddit ads end to end for 3 to 5 brands
Build account structures that scale, with prospecting, retargeting, catalog and testing working together
Plan monthly budgets with clients and move spend quickly when costs rise during sales and festive peaks
Run a weekly creative testing system and brief our design and video team on what to make next
Track the full funnel from ad click to Shopify checkout, and fix landing page or conversion issues with our web team
Keep pixel, Conversions API, GA4 and UTM tracking accurate on every account
Send weekly reports built on platform data, with clear decisions and next steps
Test new ad formats, platform features and AI tools as they launch, and bring the ones that work to every account

How we work: You own your accounts like a founder would. Clients hear about changes from you before they see them. Updates are proactive, trackers are always current, and every number you share can be traced back to its source.

Preferred candidate profile: 

4 to 7 years in performance marketing, with at least 3 years on D2C or ecommerce brands
Hands on experience managing 10 lakh or more in monthly ad spend, across one account or a portfolio
Strong on Meta Ads and Google Ads, with working experience on Pinterest or Reddit ads, or a proven ability to pick up a new platform within weeks
Up to date with how ad platforms are changing: Advantage+, Performance Max, AI creative tools, privacy and signal loss
A track record of improving cost per purchase or new customer growth, with numbers you can walk us through
Comfortable with GA4, Shopify analytics and spreadsheets, and able to explain performance to founders in plain language
Experience running festive or sale periods such as Diwali, BFCM or end of season sales
Bonus: US accounts, or regulated categories like health and food

title: Digital Marketing Manager - Performance and Campaign Management
description:
Digital Marketing - Campaign Management 

Experience: 5- 12 Year 
Qualification: Any Degree / MBA in Marketing (Preferred) 
Department: Digital Marketing 
Contact Person: Uma - 9500129825 (Call & WhatsApp)
Email I'd: umamageswari.m@gsquarehousing.com

Job Purpose:- 
To plan, execute, optimize, and manage end-to-end digital marketing campaigns across platforms, with a strong focus on Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and other performance channels. This role is responsible for campaign strategy, budget management, lead generation performance, optimization, reporting, compliance, and team leadership, ensuring high-quality leads, optimal cost efficiency, and strong ROI for real estate projects. The role also ensures seamless coordination with Sales, Branding, MIS, Website, and CRM teams for end-to-end campaign success. 

Key Responsibilities:- 
1. Leadership & Team Management 
Lead, mentor, and manage the digital campaign team, including campaign executives and specialists.
Allocate campaigns, budgets, and workloads based on project priorities and launch requirements.
Train the team on campaign setup, optimization techniques, audience targeting, analytics, and platform best practices.
Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and drive continuous skill development.
2. Meta Campaign Management 
Handle end-to-end Meta campaign execution, including:
Audience research (Investors, NRIs, regional buyers, behavioral segments, lookalikes).
Ad set creation, bidding strategies, and placements.
Creative coordination (static, carousel, video, reels, stories).
Monitor campaigns frequently and optimize based on CPL, CTR, CPC, frequency, relevance score, and conversions.
Resolve Meta-specific issues such as ad rejections, learning-limited status, policy violations, and CPL spikes.
3. Campaign Strategy, Planning & Execution 
Design full-funnel campaign strategies for:
Lead generation.
Awareness.
Retargeting.
Conversion optimization.
Plan and execute campaigns across:
Meta (Facebook & Instagram Ads).
Google Ads.
YouTube Ads.
Display networks.
Third-party platforms and real estate portals.
Ensure accurate campaign setup, including budgets, targeting, creatives, placements, tracking links, and integrations.
4. Optimization & Performance Management 
Continuously optimize campaigns to improve:
Lead volume.
Lead quality.
Cost per Lead (CPL).
Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
Engagement and reach.
Conduct A/B testing for creatives, audiences, placements, and bidding strategies.
Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities to scale high-performing campaigns.
5. Budgeting & Cost Control 
Allocate budgets project-wise based on performance, pipeline requirements, and urgency.
Monitor daily spends to prevent overspending or underutilization.
Maintain cost sheets, burn-rate reports, and spend forecasts.
Ensure optimal utilization of approved budgets with minimal variance.
6. Reporting & Analytics 
Prepare and share daily, weekly, and monthly reports covering:
Leads generated.
CPL.
Spend.
CTR, CPC, and conversions.
Campaign-wise and ad-set-wise performance.
Provide actionable insights to management for decision-making.
Ensure accurate lead flow tracking into CRM/Salesforce.
7. Cross-Functional Coordination 
Coordinate closely with:
Sales Team: Lead quality and conversion feedback.
Branding & Creative Team: Ad creatives and formats.
MIS Team: Performance reporting.
Website & Tech Teams: Tracking, landing pages, and APIs.
Align digital campaigns with project launches, BTL activities, events, and exhibitions.
8. Compliance & Quality Assurance 
Ensure campaigns adhere to brand guidelines and platform advertising policies.
Ensure proper implementation of:
UTM tracking.
Pixels.
APIs.
CRM integrations.
Maintain ad account health and prevent policy violations or account restrictions.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
Lead volume achieved versus target.
Cost per Lead (CPL) versus benchmarks.
Lead quality and conversion feedback from Sales.
Campaign optimization effectiveness.
Budget utilization efficiency.
Accuracy and timeliness of campaign reports.
Team productivity and performance.

Skills & Competencies Required 
Strong expertise in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
Advanced knowledge of performance marketing for real estate.
Campaign optimization and analytics expertise.
Leadership and team management skills.
Strong understanding of audience targeting and segmentation.
Knowledge of tracking tools, CRM integrations, and attribution models.
Analytical, data-driven decision-making ability.
Excellent communication and cross-functional coordination skills.

Regards 
Uma HR

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
Role & responsibilities 
The below are the roles and responsibilities;

Plan, execute, and optimize B2B paid marketing campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, and other performance marketing channels.
Develop lead generation strategies to drive Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs), and pipeline growth.
Conduct keyword research, audience segmentation, competitor analysis, and market research to identify growth opportunities.
Manage and optimize campaign performance based on KPIs such as CPL, CPA, CTR, Conversion Rate, Lead Quality, and ROI.
Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to align campaigns with target buyer personas and business objectives.
Build, manage, and optimize landing pages, lead funnels, and conversion paths to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
Perform A/B testing on ad creatives, audiences, messaging, and landing pages to maximize campaign effectiveness.
Utilize AI-powered marketing tools and automation platforms to improve campaign efficiency and performance.
Monitor advertising budgets and ensure cost-effective lead acquisition.
Prepare regular performance reports and provide actionable insights for continuous improvement.
Support B2C lead generation campaigns when required and contribute to customer acquisition initiatives across multiple markets.

Preferred candidate profile 

Minimum 8 years of experience managing B2B PPC and Performance Marketing campaigns.
Proven success in B2B Lead Generation, Demand Generation, and Pipeline Growth campaigns.
Strong expertise in Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid advertising platforms.
Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM and marketing automation platforms.
Strong understanding of conversion tracking, attribution models, funnel optimization, and lead nurturing.
Experience using AI tools and automation platforms for campaign management and optimization.
Ability to analyse campaign data and translate insights into actionable marketing strategies.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and reporting skills.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and budgets simultaneously.

Education 

Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.

Google Ads, LinkedIn Marketing, HubSpot, Meta Blueprint, or relevant digital marketing certifications will be an added advantage.

JOB DESCRIPTION PERFORMANCE MARKETING MANAGER
Paid Direct – Google & Meta Ads 
Location: Chennai – Work from Office | Experience: 3–4 Years | Employment: Full-time
About the Role
CreditMantri is India’s credit health and loan marketplace, helping consumers check credit scores, improve credit profiles, and explore loans and credit cards. The Performance Marketing Manager will manage Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns end to end, driving quality registrations, logins, and conversions while reducing acquisition costs across CreditMantri’s products.
Key Responsibilities
1. Google Ads 
Plan and optimise Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Display, YouTube, and App campaigns.
Manage account structure, keyword research, negative keywords, ad copy, and landing-page testing.
Implement bidding strategies, including tCPA, tROAS, and Maximise Conversions.
2. Meta Ads 
Manage Facebook and Instagram acquisition, retargeting, app-install, and conversion campaigns.
Build custom and lookalike audiences using CRM and app data.
Test static, carousel, Reels, and video creatives; monitor creative fatigue and refresh assets.
3. Tracking, Analytics & Budget Management 
Manage tracking using GTM, GA4, Google Ads, Meta Pixel, CAPI, and MMPs such as AppsFlyer or Branch.
Track backend conversions, logins, and approved applications.
Manage monthly budgets against CPL, CAC, and ROAS targets; optimise spending through A/B testing.
4. Reporting & Collaboration 
Maintain performance dashboards and weekly reports covering spend, CPL, CAC, conversions, and funnel performance.
Collaborate with Product, Analytics, CRM, Content, and Design teams to improve lead quality and conversions.
Monitor competitors, platform updates, and Google/Meta financial-services advertising policies, including applicable RBI and DPDP requirements.
Must-Have Skills & Experience
3–4 years of hands-on Google Ads and Meta Ads campaign management, with ownership of monthly budgets of 15 lakh or more.
Proven ability to scale campaigns while reducing CPL/CAC.
Strong knowledge of GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, CAPI, attribution, and conversion tracking.
Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, pivot tables, lookups, funnel analysis, and cohort analysis.
Experience with A/B testing, creative optimisation, and data-driven decision-making.
Good written and spoken English; Tamil or Hindi is an advantage.
Good to Have
Experience in fintech, lending, credit cards, or insurance.
App campaign and MMP experience with AppsFlyer, Branch, or Adjust.
Exposure to Microsoft Ads, affiliate marketing, programmatic advertising, or Looker Studio.
Basic SQL knowledge and Google Ads/Meta Blueprint certifications.

title: Graphic designer / Creative Hospitality,Hotels,Travel,Lifestyle,FMCG)
description:
Job Description : Graphic Designer 
Company: Mango Hill Hotels 
Department : Marketing (Brand Marketing) 
Experience : 4+ years 
Location : Chennai - Mylapore

About Mango Hill Hotels 

Mango Hill Hotels is a growing hospitality group with a portfolio of properties and brands serving leisure,business and event guests. We are building a dedicated in-house marketing team to strengthen our 
brand, deepen guest relationships and drive business growth across the portfolio. 

Role Overview 
Mango Hill Hotels is looking for a skilled, detail-minded Graphic Designer / Creative Executive to give the brand and its properties a consistent, premium look across digital, print and on-property touchpoints. 
The role designs campaign, social and collateral creatives, builds reusable templates, and prepares creative kits for property launches. 

Key Responsibilities 

Campaign & Social Creatives : Design creatives for brand campaigns, offers, festivals and social media, including posts, carousels, stories and reel covers, in line with the brand guidelines. 
Collaterals & Presentations : Design brochures, fact sheets, rate cards, event and wedding collaterals, sales and management presentations, and on-property materials such as signage, in- 
room collaterals and table tents. 
Digital Creatives : Prepare ad creatives, website banners, landing page visuals and email templates with Digital Marketing, in the sizes and formats each platform needs. 
Brand Consistency & Templates : Apply the brand identity correctly across brands and properties. Build and maintain a library of ready-to-edit templates so property teams and the 
marketing team can produce on-brand material quickly. 
Property Launch Kits : Prepare the creative kit for each new property, covering launch visuals,teasers, social assets, collaterals and signage artwork. 
Motion & Video Support: Create simple animations, reel edits and short video cuts, and brief external videographers when needed. 
Vendor Coordination : Brief and review work from photographers, printers, freelancers and creative agencies, and check print proofs for quality before release. 
Asset Library : Organise final files, photos and videos with clear naming so assets are easy to find and reuse. 
Turnaround & Collaboration : Manage multiple requests, prioritise with the Assistant Manager, 
and deliver on time while taking feedback constructively. 

Qualifications & Experience 
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts or a related 
field. 

4+ years of experience in graphic design, preferably for hospitality, hotels, travel, lifestyle or other consumer brands, or at a creative agency. 

Strong skills in Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma and Canva. 
Working knowledge of video and motion tools such as Premiere Pro, After Effects or Cap Cut is a strong plus. 

A good eye for typography, layout, colour and visual hierarchy, and an understanding of print production and digital formats. 

A portfolio that shows brand, social and collateral work. 
Good communication, time management and the ability to work with feedback across teams.

title: SEO Specialist (AI/ Deep Tech)
description:
Role: SEO Specialist (Frontier AI Research) 
Experience: 2-4 Years 
Salary: 5 -8 LPA 
Employment Type: Full-time 
Location: Chennai 
Work Mode: Work from Office 

Role Overview: 
We are looking for an SEO Specialist who can take ownership of BluBridge's organic search strategy and drive measurable growth in search visibility, qualified organic traffic, technical authority, and inbound opportunities.
This role sits at the intersection of SEO, technology, and organic growth. You will work closely with content, engineering, research, and business teams to build BluBridges organic search presence around advanced AI products and deep-tech initiatives. You will contribute to search visibility, technical authority, content strategy, qualified organic traffic, and long-term growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities: 
Develop and execute SEO strategies aligned with BluBridges business objectives, focusing on long-term organic growth, visibility, and qualified traffic.
Manage technical, on-page, off-page, and content SEO to strengthen website performance, search rankings, and overall organic presence.
Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, SEO audits, and search intent analysis to identify valuable search opportunities and content gaps.
Build SEO roadmaps and growth plans with clear priorities, quick wins, technical improvements, and long-term organic opportunities.
Develop topic clusters and content strategies around AI, ML, LLMs, AI infrastructure, model development, and deep-tech engineering.
Identify high-value search opportunities targeting enterprises, developers, researchers, AI practitioners, and other relevant technical audiences.
Plan and optimize technical content including blogs, research articles, solution pages, landing pages, case studies, and thought-leadership content.
Optimize website structure and technical SEO elements including metadata, internal linking, schema, URLs, crawlability, indexability, and Core Web Vitals.
Develop off-page and authority-building strategies including quality backlink opportunities, technical publications, and relevant industry platforms.
Track, analyze, and improve SEO performance using rankings, organic traffic, CTR, conversions, backlinks, and tools such as GSC, GA4, Ahrefs, and SEMrush.

What We Are Looking For: 
Professional experience in SEO, Technical SEO, Content SEO, or Organic Search Growth.
Strong understanding of search intent, topical authority, technical SEO, and user behavior.
Ability to understand AI/ML and deep-tech topics and translate them into search-optimized content.
Strong combination of strategic thinking, analytical skills, and hands-on SEO execution.
Ability to independently identify growth opportunities and drive measurable organic results.

Added Advantage 
Experience working with technology, AI, SaaS, startups, or B2B/knowledge-led brands.
Proficiency with tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Screaming Frog.
Experience driving measurable growth in organic visibility, qualified traffic, and search authority.

Benefits: 
Competitive salary package.
Health insurance coverage.
Personal accident and life insurance coverage.
Generous parental leave policy.
Accommodation / transportation allowance.
Complimentary lunch and dinner.

title: Seo Specialist
description:
Our client is a leading HRMS solution provider headquartered in Chennai with over 450 plus clients, 300,000 plus users, 70 plus happy employees with 30% sales growth year on year.
We are recruiting an SEO, GEO & AI Search Optimization Specialist to join our dynamic marketing team in Chennai with 3 to 6 years of experience in driving digital growth for B2B, SaaS, or enterprise technology brands.

Role & responsibilities 

You will be responsible for owning our comprehensive visibility strategy across both traditional search engines like Google and emerging AI-driven answer platforms including Gemini, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Perplexity. Rather than relying on low-value AI mass content, you will partner with our product and content teams to develop high-intent landing pages, structured data schemas, and credible brand citations while tracking your impact through a measurable AI visibility scorecard.
* Own end-to-end traditional and technical Google SEO, including keyword strategy, on-page optimization, schema markup, backlink profiles, and performance tracking via Google Search Console and Analytics.
* Build and execute GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) strategies to ensure our brand and products are discovered, cited, and recommended by AI assistants.
* Partner with content and product teams to create high-intent landing pages, comparison guides, and authoritative resources rather than mass-producing low-value AI pages.
* Strengthen digital brand authority and third-party citations across industry publications, review platforms, and high-quality web sources.
* Establish a monthly AI search visibility scorecard to track query performance, competitor share-of-voice, and citations across Google, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Copilot.
* Participate in a practical candidate assessment involving a live website audit, competitor gap analysis, and a 90-day integrated SEO and AI search visibility roadmap.

Preferred candidate profile 

Must be graduates with excellent written and spoken English proficiency, bringing 3 to 6 years of strong digital marketing experience with a proven track record of improving Google rankings and organic traffic. Candidates must have an excellent understanding of traditional technical, on-page, and off-page SEO alongside emerging Generative AI search, GEO, and AEO concepts. Essential required skills include hands-on proficiency with Google Search Console, Analytics, SEO tools like Semrush or Ahrefs, and AI research assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity, with background in SaaS, HR Tech, ERP, or B2B enterprise technology marketing considered a major advantage. 

Remuneration ranges from 4,00,000 to 8,00,000 CTC per annum, commensurate with experience and expertise.
For any queries or to submit your resume, please contact Vasudevan at 9840882093, email: svv@skillmin.in, website: www.skillmin.in.

Job Title: Sr. Data Analyst or MIS Lead 

Job Family - Data Analytics

Job Title : Sr. Data Analyst or MIS Lead (IC Role)
Location : Gurgaon
Education : Any Graduate
Experience Range : 8-10 Years
Work Schedule : 5-day work week | EMEA Shift: 12:30 PM-10:00 PM | Two-way transport

Role Overview: The role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining backend data pipelines and analytical datasets that support largescale business operations. The position focuses on advanced SQL development, ETL processes, and data modelling , along with analytical insights and dashboard creation using Googles data ecosystem.

The role works closely with stakeholders, handling structured data at scale and enabling datadriven decisionmaking through reliable, wellgoverned datasets and dashboards.

It is a core backend data engineering and analytics role .

Important: Excellent communication skills required, The candidate should have a strong understanding of advanced SQL and at least one other programming language, such as Python or VBA, along with some experience agentic AI or Gen AI.

Key Roles & Responsibilities 

Data Engineering & ETL 
Design, develop, and maintain robust SQLbased data pipelines supporting ETL workflows.
Work extensively on advanced SQL (Google SQL / BigQuerystyle SQL) for data extraction, transformation, and aggregation.
Develop and optimize PLX scripts for backend data processing and automation.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and performance across large datasets.
Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline failures, performance issues, and data inconsistencies.

Data Analysis & Analytics Enablement 
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights relevant to business and operational needs.
Translate analytical requirements into optimized datasets and data models .
Partner with crossfunctional teams to understand data requirements and deliver scalable solutions.

Dashboarding & Visualization 
Build and maintain PLX dashboards and analytical views for stakeholders.
Develop dashboards using Looker Studio (preferred) for insights and performance monitoring.
Ensure dashboards are accurate, scalable, and aligned to defined metrics and business logic.

Governance & Best Practices 
Follow data engineering best practices including version control, documentation, and reusable SQL patterns.
Ensure compliance with data access controls, security standards, and internal governance policies.
Participate in reviews, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives for data pipelines.

Education 
Any Graduate (Engineering / Computer Science / Mathematics / Statistics preferred)

Experience 

Must Have 
8-10 years of handson experience in backend data engineering or analytics roles 
Strong experience working with advanced SQL in largescale data environments
Proven experience with ETL processes and data pipeline development 
Experience working in structured, processdriven environments supporting enterprise clients

Technical Skills 

Must Have 
Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning) 
Strong understanding of ETL concepts, data modeling, and data transformations 
Handson experience with PLX scripts and PLX dashboards 
Strong analytical and problemsolving skills

Good to Have 
Experience with Google Workspace tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides)
Google Apps Script for automation
Looker Studio for dashboarding and analytics
Programming/scripting experience in Python, JavaScript, or VBA 

Note : Looking for immediate joiners only, Interested candidates can directly share their CV's at Sandeep.sharma72@wipro.com

Industry: IT Services & Consulting

Work Mode: Work from Office
Job Location: Gurugram
Experience: 614 Years
Salary: 3046 LPA
Open Positions: 7
Joining: Immediate to 30 Days Preferred
Job Summary 
We are hiring experienced Big Data Engineers with strong expertise in Apache Spark, Python, Databricks, and cloud-based data engineering platforms.
The ideal candidates should have extensive hands-on experience in designing, developing, and optimizing large-scale distributed data processing systems. Strong expertise in PySpark, distributed computing, ETL pipelines, and cloud data platforms is essential.
Candidates must have mandatory hands-on experience with Databricks on Azure or AWS .
We have multiple openings at L3 and L4 engineering levels, offering opportunities for both experienced individual contributors and senior engineers with technical leadership capabilities.
Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and implement scalable Big Data solutions using Apache Spark and Python.
Build, maintain, and optimize distributed data processing pipelines.
Develop batch and real-time data processing solutions.
Work with Azure Databricks or AWS Databricks for large-scale data engineering workloads.
Perform Spark job optimization, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
Build streaming data pipelines using Kafka, Spark Streaming, or similar technologies.
Develop ETL workflows and integrate data from multiple sources, including RDBMS, ERP systems, and files.
Work with SQL and NoSQL databases for large-scale data processing.
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to design and implement data solutions.
Follow Agile development methodologies and engineering best practices.
Senior-level candidates should be capable of leading technical teams and driving solution design.
Mandatory Technical Skills 
Apache Spark / PySpark
Python Programming
Azure Databricks or AWS Databricks
Azure or AWS Cloud Data Services
Distributed Computing
ETL Development and Data Pipelines
SQL – Queries, Joins, Stored Procedures, and Relational Schemas
Spark Performance Tuning
Additional Technical Skills 
Hadoop v2, MapReduce, HDFS, and Sqoop
Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ
Apache Storm and Spark Streaming
Hive and Impala
NoSQL databases – HBase, Cassandra, and MongoDB
SQL Server and Oracle
Delta Lake and Spark SQL
Candidate Requirements 
6–14 years of overall IT experience.
Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in Big Data and data engineering.
Strong understanding of distributed computing principles.
Expert-level knowledge of Apache Spark.
Hands-on programming experience with Python.
Mandatory practical experience with Databricks on Azure or AWS.
Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale Big Data solutions.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to work independently and collaborate with engineering teams.
Senior candidates should have experience leading technical teams.
Compensation 
L3: 30–35 LPA | 6–9 Years
L4: 40–46 LPA | 8–14 Years

Final compensation will depend on experience, technical expertise, and interview performance.
Joining Preference
Immediate joiners to candidates with a maximum 30-day notice period.
Interview Details
Face-to-Face Interview Drive
Date: 14 November 2026
Location: Gurugram

How to Apply 
Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at:
adithyaa@riosintelli.com

Current CTC
Expected CTC
Total Experience
Relevant Big Data Experience
Databricks Experience (Azure/AWS)
Current Location
Notice Period / Expected Joining Date
Availability for F2F drive on 14th November, Saturday 2026 - Yes/No
What are your preferred work locations, name at least 3 cities

3+ years’ experience working with RedHat OpenShift Infrastructure design, deployment and operational support.
