title: Product Analyst - EDMCS
description:
Product Analyst - EDMCS 
Company: American Express (via Quintes) Location: Gurugram (Work From Office)
About American Express 
American Express is a global financial services company best known for its charge cards, credit cards, travel, and digital payment solutions, serving consumers and businesses worldwide.
About the Role 
This role sits within American Express's Oracle ERP Fusion migration program, where the Product Analyst will focus on Enterprise Data Management Cloud Service (EDMCS) - analyzing existing EBS-based business processes and translating them into functional specifications for Oracle Fusion. You'll work closely with product leads, finance process teams, and technical teams in an Agile environment to configure and support EDMCS, while helping drive change management, training, and testing across the business.
What You Will Do 
Analyze current business processes on EBS (DRM) and identify areas for improvement to migrate to Oracle Fusion ERP, specifically EDMCS.
Gather and document detailed business requirements and functional specifications.
Collaborate with the product lead, finance process teams, and technical teams to configure and design solutions that meet business needs.
Apply industry best practices in financial systems design and configuration for scalable and auditable solutions.
Configure and support the EDMCS module.
Participate in developing user stories, sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups.
Support change management, training, and testing activities across user groups.
What We're Looking For 
Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field.
3+ years of experience as a Business/Finance or Product Analyst in an Oracle ERP context.
Oracle EPM Cloud experience - particularly EDMCS, FCCS, or PBCS - is preferred; hands-on Oracle DRM experience is also preferred.
Understanding of Reference Data Management applications and business processes.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
Exposure to Agile development methodology.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
Preferred (nice-to-have): SAFe Agilist or similar Agile certification; Oracle Fusion EDMCS certification; understanding of Oracle Fusion ERP financial processes and configuration; experience with quarterly Oracle Cloud releases and new feature adoption.

title: Expansion Program Manager
description:
About the Team 
You will be part of the Expansion team at Curefit. Curefit operates the fastest-growing fitness chain brands in India cult.fit, Gold's, and Fitness First, with a 600+ centre footprint pan-India. The plan is to set up another 150+ centres per year across various offerings. The Expansion Program Manager will be responsible for centre expansion across top cities.

Key Responsibilities 
End-to-end program management and ownership of the transformation process from site identification to centre launch. 
Collaborate with multiple stakeholders Real Estate, Legal, Biz Finance, Projects, City Teams, Talent Acquisition, Sales/Growth, and Audits to program manage launch operations.
Interface effectively with Franchise partners to ensure timely execution, payments, launch readiness, and presales.
Own and manage capital expenditure across projects, equipment, and other line items.
Improve the overall launch process and Franchise partner satisfaction with new launches.
Identify, communicate, and problem-solve potential risks to ensure centres launch on time with a great member experience.

Desired Qualifications & Skills 
2- 3 years of experience in Project/Programme Management; startup experience preferred.
Bachelor's degree from a recognized Tier 1/Tier 2 university (Engineering, Law, Commerce, or Management)
Previous experience in a franchise or client-based business preferred.
Background in real estate, construction, or retail expansion is a plus
Sharp program management skills building and executing SOPs, securing stakeholder buy-in, and driving execution with high influence.
Excellent problem-solving abilities ability to hustle, think on your feet, and take decisive action in new situations
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Process-oriented mindset to identify and solve problems and establish best practices

title: Implementation & Delivery Manager - SaaS
description:
Role Summary: 
We are hiring an Implementation & Delivery Manager to own two key outcomes. The first is getting new clients live quickly: you will take ownership of every deal closed by our sales team and ensure the client is onboarded and live on Navio OS in the shortest possible time.

The second is delivering for existing clients: when a live client raises a change request or a new requirement, you will understand it, assess its feasibility with the tech team and drive it through to delivery. You will be the primary link between clients, sales, support and developers. This is a hands-on, technical, client-facing role. You will not write code, but you will work closely with developers every day.

Key Responsibilities: 
A. New Client Implementation: 
1. Take a structured handover from sales covering scope, commitments and client expectations.
2. Lead client kick-off, understand business workflows and build a clear go-live plan.
3. Work with the tech team on platform setup, data migration and integrations.
4. Drive testing, UAT and user training to get the client live in the shortest possible time.

B. Existing Client Requirements: 
1. Capture change requests and new requirements from live clients.
2. Assess feasibility, effort and timelines with developers and recommend the best approach.
3. Agree scope, timelines and any commercial impact with the client and founder before work begins.
4. Convert approved requests into user stories and acceptance criteria, and track them through development, QA and release.

C. Delivery Ownership: 
1. Plan timelines and coordinate development, QA, UAT and production releases.
2. Track commitments, remove blockers and share regular progress updates with clients and internal teams.
3. Escalate risks and scope changes early.
4. Work with the support team to triage and resolve client issues quickly.
5. Maintain documentation, decisions, change requests and delivery status.
6. Convert client feedback into product improvement recommendations and prioritise them with the founder.
7. Use AI tools to improve documentation, analysis and testing.

Must Have: 
1. 3+ years of experience delivering or implementing B2B software for business customers.
2. Proven experience managing client relationships and converting requirements into developer-ready work.
3. Experience coordinating development, testing, UAT and releases through to go-live.
4. Working technical knowledge: reading API documentation, testing APIs (e.g. Postman), writing basic SQL queries, and understanding the SDLC, Agile/Scrum and dev/staging/production environments.
5. Strong ownership, clear communication, prioritisation and follow-up across multiple stakeholders.

Good to Have: 
Experience in SaaS, legal technology, contract management, compliance or workflow software will be an advantage, as will exposure to enterprise integrations. A technical background such as a B.Tech, BCA, MCA or similar degree is also preferred.

Work Mode & Location: 
In-Office Barakhamba Road, Connaught Place, New Delhi - 110001. Candidates should currently be based in Delhi NCR or be willing to relocate.

What You Earn: 
Compensation based on experience, relevant skills and delivery track record.

Growth & Upside: 
Work directly with the founder, own customer outcomes and grow into product or delivery leadership.

How to Apply: 
1. Visit https://nuvena.co/careers/ and open the Implementation & Delivery Manager role.
2. Click Apply Now, sign in with your email (we send you a one-time code), and add your mobile number, current city and latest CV.
3. Take the online test within 3 days: about 70 minutes, in one sitting, on a laptop.
4. Record a short video interview.
5. We review your application and reach out to you.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Head of Fixed-Price Delivery to lead our
project delivery organization, improve project profitability, and establish a culture of
accountability, engineering excellence, and predictable execution.
The role will initially oversee approximately 1020 concurrent fixed-price projects and
25–50 delivery professionals, including project managers, technical leads, developers, QA
engineers, and other specialists.
The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering experience with proven
expertise in managing project budgets, controlling scope, leading multidisciplinary teams,
and delivering profitable client engagements.
This is a business-critical leadership position with direct reporting to the CEO and the
authority to improve delivery processes, team structures, and performance.
Key Responsibilities
1. Project Profitability and Financial Management
• Take ownership of financial performance across the fixed-price delivery portfolio.
• Establish project-level budgeting, effort tracking, cost forecasting, and profitability
reporting.
• Monitor actual costs against approved budgets and estimated costs to complete.
• Identify potential overruns early and implement corrective actions.
• Improve delivery margins through better planning, productivity, resource utilization,
and execution discipline.
• Work with Finance to establish accurate, consistent project margin reporting.
2. Project Planning and Execution

• Ensure projects begin with clear requirements, deliverables, acceptance criteria,
milestones, and resource plans.
• Validate delivery plans and identify unrealistic schedules, dependencies, and technical
risks.
• Establish standardized project governance and weekly delivery reviews.
• Improve schedule predictability, milestone completion, and resource allocation.
• Personally intervene in critical or underperforming projects and lead recovery efforts.
3. Scope and Change Management
• Establish disciplined requirements management and scope control.
• Ensure all changes are documented and assessed for their impact on effort, cost, and
timelines.
• Work with Sales and Account Management to obtain commercial approval for
additional scope.
• Prevent unapproved work from creating unnecessary delivery costs.
• Ensure project teams understand and adhere to contractual scope and acceptance
criteria.
4. Engineering Quality and Delivery Efficiency
• Work closely with technical leads to review architecture, engineering estimates, and
implementation approaches.
• Identify technical decisions that may create rework, complexity, or delivery delays.
• Improve development practices, code review discipline, testing, and quality
assurance.
• Reduce avoidable defects, repeated rework, and inefficient engineering practices.
• Encourage practical adoption of AI-assisted development and automation where they
demonstrably improve productivity and quality.
5. People Leadership and Accountability
• Lead project managers, technical leads, and delivery teams.
• Establish clear ownership, performance expectations, and accountability across
projects.
• Review the capabilities of existing delivery leaders and identify coaching, training, or
organizational changes required.
• Build a strong culture of ownership, transparency, and problem-solving.
• Make resource allocation and performance management decisions to improve delivery
outcomes.
6. Client Communication and Satisfaction
• Ensure proactive communication on project progress, risks, and changes.
• Intervene in escalations and manage difficult delivery situations constructively.
• Improve client confidence through transparent reporting and predictable execution.
• Protect delivery quality and client relationships while improving project profitability.
Required Experience and Qualifications

• Significant experience in software engineering and technical project delivery,
preferably 12+ years.
• At least 5 years in a leadership role managing multiple software delivery projects.
• Demonstrated experience managing fixed-price software development projects with
direct financial accountability.
• Strong understanding of project budgeting, gross margins, resource costs, cost-to-
complete forecasting, and scope management.
• Experience leading project managers and technical leads across multiple
engagements.
• Sound technical understanding of custom web applications, SaaS platforms, APIs,
databases, mobile applications, and modern software architectures.
• Familiarity with AI, GenAI, automation, or data engineering project delivery.
• Experience working directly with international clients.
• Strong analytical, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
Highly Preferred
• Experience in an outsourced software product development, digital engineering, or IT
services company.
• Proven record of improving fixed-price project margins or recovering troubled
projects.
• Experience establishing delivery governance and financial controls where processes
were previously immature.
• Ability to challenge engineering assumptions without unnecessarily micromanaging
technical teams.
• Experience managing distributed engineering teams and working across multiple
technology stacks.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 

Objective

To lead and manage field quality assurance and inspection activities across client sites, ensuring compliance with project specifications, international standards, and regulatory requirements while driving consistency, efficiency, and client satisfaction in on-site delivery.

Responsibilities

• Oversee field QA/QC operations, including inspection, testing, and certification of civil, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, and welding works.

• Plan and allocate inspectors, technicians, and coordinators for project sites to ensure timely and effective service delivery.

• Ensure compliance with quality standards (ISO, ASME, AWS, API, IEC, ASTM, etc.) and client-specific requirements.

• Act as the key interface between site teams, clients, contractors, and internal delivery teams.

• Monitor and report field quality KPIs, NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports), and corrective action status.

• Conduct site audits, risk assessments, and quality reviews to ensure adherence to TIC protocols and HSE standards.

title: SEO Specialist (Google and AI Search)
description:
Job Description 

Ortu Software is looking for an experienced SEO Specialist who understands both traditional SEO and the rapidly evolving world of AI-powered search.

You'll be responsible for developing and executing SEO strategies that improve organic visibility, attract qualified traffic, and drive business growth. We're looking for someone who stays ahead of industry trends, thinks strategically, and understands how websites can succeed in both search engines and AI-powered search experiences.

Required Skills & Experience 

2 to 5 years of hands-on SEO experience.
Strong technical SEO knowledge.
Deep understanding of search intent, topical authority, internal linking, and content architecture.
Experience implementing structured data and Schema markup.
Proven experience developing and implementing SEO strategies that improve a website's visibility across Google Search, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI-powered search experiences. 
Strong proficiency with Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and Screaming Frog.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities 

Develop and execute end-to-end SEO strategies.
Perform technical SEO audits and implement recommendations.
Conduct keyword, competitor, and search intent research.
Optimize website architecture, internal linking, and content structure.
Implement and validate structured data (Schema).
Improve crawlability, indexability, and Core Web Vitals.
Develop topical authority and content strategies.
Monitor SEO performance and identify growth opportunities.
Collaborate with developers, designers, and content writers to implement SEO best practices.
Stay current with Google's algorithm updates and emerging AI search trends.

Collaborate with Product Owners to maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog and clear sprint goals.
Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, product, compliance, and operations.

Proven ability to manage budgets, timelines, dependencies, and stakeholders on large, complex programs.
Excellent facilitation, communication, and conflict-resolution skills.
Experience working with cross-functional teams in a regulated environment.

Knowledge of payment regulations and standards 
Experience with SAFe or scaled Agile environments.
Familiarity with delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, and MS Project.
Background in fintech, banking, or financial services.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Role Overview 
The Performance Marketing & CRM Associate Manager will be responsible for planning and executing digital marketing campaigns that generate qualified leads, managing CRM workflows, ensuring timely lead allocation and follow-ups with the sales team, and continuously improving lead-to-conversion performance. The role also owns marketing budget planning, campaign optimisation, and reporting. 

Key Responsibilities 
Performance Marketing 
Plan, execute, and optimise paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms. 
Drive high-quality lead generation while maintaining target Cost per Lead (CPL), Sales Qualified Leads and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). 
Conduct A/B testing on creatives, landing pages, audiences, and campaign strategies. 
Work closely with creative and content teams to improve campaign performance. 
Identify new acquisition channels and growth opportunities. 

CRM & Marketing Automation 
Manage CRM platforms to ensure accurate lead capture, tracking, and nurturing. 
Design automated lead nurturing journeys through email, WhatsApp, SMS, and other CRM channels. 
Maintain lead hygiene, segmentation, and database quality. 
Build lifecycle marketing campaigns to improve conversion and customer engagement. 

Sales Coordination 
Coordinate daily with the sales team to ensure timely lead allocation and follow-up. 
Monitor lead ageing, response times, and conversion metrics. 
Track lead status across the funnel and identify bottlenecks. 
Conduct regular pipeline reviews with the sales team. 
Ensure marketing-generated leads are effectively converted into revenue opportunities. 

Budget Planning & Reporting 
Prepare monthly and quarterly marketing budget plans. 
Allocate budgets across channels based on performance and business priorities. 
Monitor marketing spend and ensure efficient utilisation. 
Prepare dashboards tracking: 
Leads Generated 
Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) 
Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) 
Cost per Lead (CPL) 
Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) 
Conversion Rates 
Marketing ROI 
Channel-wise performance 
Present actionable insights and recommendations to leadership. 

Analytics & Optimisation 
Analyse campaign performance using GA4, CRM dashboards, and advertising platforms. 
Identify trends, customer behaviour, and optimisation opportunities. 
Build attribution reports and improve marketing efficiency. 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve the customer acquisition journey. 
Required Skills 
4- 6 years of experience in Performance Marketing and CRM. 
Strong expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads. 
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as Moengage. 
Experience with marketing automation tools. 
Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4), Excel, and reporting dashboards. 
Understanding of lead management processes and sales funnels. 
Experience managing multi-channel marketing budgets. 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Performance Marketing Manager US Market 

Role Overview

Prism is looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own website revenue and conversion growth for the US market. This role will lead full-funnel performance marketing across paid channels with clear ownership of revenue, ROAS, CAC, and conversion metrics for the website business.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue & Growth Ownership
Own website revenue, bookings, and conversion rate for the US market.
Drive YoY growth through performance marketing, funnel optimization, and experimentation.
Set and manage weekly/monthly targets for revenue, ROAS, CAC, and CVR.

Performance Marketing (Channel Ownership)

Own and scale paid channels including Google Search, PMAX, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), YouTube, Display, and other performance channels.
Drive full-funnel performance across prospecting, retargeting, and retention.
Manage budgets, bid strategies, audience segmentation, and creative testing across platforms.

Strong understanding of attribution, conversion tracking, and web analytics.
Ability to translate data into clear actions and growth levers.
Ownership mindset with strong bias for action.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, target-driven environments.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY 
MSM CampusOS is a full-service digital marketing agency exclusively serving the education sector schools, colleges, universities, EdTech platforms, and coaching institutes. We help institutions grow their brand, drive enrolments, and build a strong digital presence through integrated marketing, technology, and creative solutions.
ABOUT THE ROLE 
We are looking for an experienced and data-driven Performance Marketing Manager who can independently create, execute, optimise, and scale paid campaigns across multiple digital platforms. This role demands someone who not only understands the mechanics of paid advertising but also deeply understands the education sector — its audiences, seasonality, enrolment cycles, and what drives a student or parent to convert.
PLATFORMS YOU WILL WORK ON 
Platform 
Primary Use Case (Education) 
Campaign Formats 
Google Ads
Search intent — admissions, courses, exams
Search, Display, PMAX, Shopping
Meta (Facebook & Instagram)
Awareness & lead gen for institutions, EdTech
Lead Ads, Reels, Carousel, Stories
YouTube
Video campaigns — brand films, course promos
In-Stream, Bumper, Discovery
LinkedIn
Higher ed, professional courses, B2B outreach
Sponsored Content, InMail, Lead Gen
Quora
Intent-based targeting — course/career queries
Promoted Answers, Display
Programmatic / DV360
Precision retargeting & reach campaigns
Display, Video, Native
App Campaigns (UAC)
Mobile app installs for EdTech platforms
Google UAC, Meta App Ads
WhatsApp (Meta)
Re-engagement & lead nurturing
Click-to-WhatsApp Ads
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
Campaign Strategy & Planning 
Develop comprehensive paid media strategies for education clients covering full-funnel objectives — awareness, consideration, lead generation, and enrolment conversion.
Plan campaign architecture across platforms — Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, Quora, Programmatic, and emerging channels — based on client goals, budgets, and target audience profiles.
Map campaign plans to education-sector seasonality — admission seasons, entrance exam cycles, course enrolment windows, and awareness periods.
Define audience segmentation strategies targeting students, parents, working professionals, and institutional decision-makers as required.
Recommend budget allocation across platforms based on CPL targets, historical performance data, and campaign objectives.
Campaign Execution & Management 
Create, set up, and launch paid campaigns end-to-end across all assigned platforms with zero dependence on external teams.
Build and manage campaign structures including ad groups, targeting parameters, bidding strategies, ad copies, landing page mapping, and tracking setup.
Set up and verify conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, and other relevant tracking tools.
Manage monthly ad spends ranging from small budgets for independent schools to large media plans for EdTech and multi-campus institutions.
Ensure all campaigns go live on schedule, within budget, and in line with the approved media plan.
Optimisation & Performance Management 
Continuously monitor and optimise live campaigns for CPL, CPA, ROAS, CTR, Quality Score, and other platform-specific KPIs.
Conduct regular A/B testing of ad copies, creatives, landing pages, audiences, and bidding strategies to improve campaign performance.
Analyse audience performance, placement data, and device breakdowns to reallocate budget towards the highest-performing segments.
Identify and resolve underperformance issues proactively — before they impact client SLAs or lead targets.
Stay current with platform algorithm changes, new ad formats, and beta features — and test their applicability to education campaigns.
Reporting & Client Communication 
Prepare and present clear, insightful campaign performance reports for clients on a weekly and monthly basis.
Translate raw campaign data into actionable insights and recommendations — not just numbers, but the story behind them.
Maintain live dashboards using Google Looker Studio, Data Studio, or equivalent tools for real-time client visibility.
Participate in client review calls to discuss performance, present optimisation plans, and address queries confidently.
Provide accurate budget utilisation reports and forecasts to clients and internal stakeholders.
Collaboration & Internal Coordination 
Work closely with the graphic design team to brief and review ad creatives — ensuring formats, messaging, and CTAs are optimised for each platform.
Coordinate with the SEO and content teams to ensure consistency of messaging across paid and organic channels.
Partner with the client servicing team to understand campaign briefs, manage expectations, and communicate delivery timelines.
Collaborate with the tech/IT team to ensure proper pixel implementation, CRM integrations, and lead flow from ad platforms to client systems.
AI & New-Age Technology 
Leverage AI-powered features within Google Ads and Meta Ads (Performance Max, Smart Bidding, Advantage+) to drive automated, data-backed campaign optimisation at scale.
Use generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copy.ai, and similar) to accelerate ad copy, creative briefs, and content ideation, improving campaign turnaround time.
Evaluate and pilot new-age martech and AI platforms — predictive analytics, AI-based audience modelling, and marketing automation tools — and recommend adoption to improve efficiency and results.
Guide and upskill the team on integrating AI and automation tools into everyday campaign workflows, from creative testing to reporting.
Apply AI-driven analytics and anomaly-detection tools to proactively flag performance issues and surface optimisation opportunities beyond manual analysis.
SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS 
Must-Have 
6–9 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with a minimum of 5 years specifically in the education sector — EdTech, schools, colleges, universities, or coaching institutes.
Proven expertise in managing and scaling paid campaigns on Google Ads (Search, Display, PMAX, YouTube) and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram).
Strong command of LinkedIn Ads, Quora Ads, and YouTube Advertising for education audiences.
Demonstrated ability to manage large monthly ad spends (50 Lakh+) across multiple clients simultaneously.
Proficiency in conversion tracking setup — Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, and UTM parameters.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive insights from data and translate them into optimisation actions.
Hands-on experience with reporting tools — Google Looker Studio, Data Studio, or similar dashboards.
Deep understanding of the education sector audience — student intent, parent behaviour, admission funnels, and seasonal demand patterns.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for client-facing reporting and presentations.
Good-to-Have 
Experience with programmatic advertising platforms (DV360, The Trade Desk, or similar).
Knowledge of app install campaign management (Google UAC, Meta App Ads) for EdTech platforms.
Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, LeadSquared).
Exposure to WhatsApp advertising (Click-to-WhatsApp campaigns via Meta).
Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications are a strong plus.
Basic understanding of SEO and its interplay with paid search campaigns.
Experience using AI-based tools for ad copy generation, audience insights, or creative testing.
PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES 
Deeply data-driven with a sharp eye for performance trends and anomalies.
Self-motivated and proactive — does not wait to be told when a campaign needs attention.
Strong ownership mindset — treats client budgets and results as if they were their own.
Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple campaigns across multiple clients simultaneously.
Clear communicator who can explain complex campaign data in simple, client-friendly language.
Curious and up-to-date — always learning about new platform features, formats, and industry trends.
Genuinely passionate about the education sector and its impact on learners and institutions.

title: Performance Marketing Manager - Gaming Growth (RMX)
description:
HEAD GAMING GROWTH & USER ACQUISITION 

Location: Noida | Work From Office 
Experience: 4–8+ Years 
Industry: Gaming / Mobile Apps / Performance Marketing 
Employment: Full-Time 

About the Role 

We are looking for a hardcore Gaming Growth & User Acquisition Expert who has real-world experience in scaling gaming/mobile applications and driving mass downloads across India. 

This is NOT a generic Digital Marketing or Social Media Marketing role. 

We need someone who has actually worked on Gaming Apps and understands how to take an app from low-scale acquisition to lakhs/millions of quality users while maintaining healthy CPI, CAC, Retention, LTV and ROAS. 

Key Responsibilities 

Build and execute Pan-India Gaming App User Acquisition Strategy 
Scale app downloads across Tier 1, Tier 2 & Tier 3 cities 
Manage and optimise Meta, Google UAC/App Campaigns, YouTube, Instagram & other UA channels 
Develop aggressive paid acquisition and growth strategies 
Drive continuous creative testing, A/B testing and campaign optimisation 
Build Gaming Influencer, Creator, YouTuber & Regional Influencer partnerships 
Develop referral, viral and community-led acquisition strategies 
Drive ASO, organic downloads and app-store conversion 
Analyse CPI, CPA, CAC, CTR, CVR, D1/D7/D30 Retention, LTV, ARPU & ROAS 
Work with product/team to improve activation, retention and monetisation 
Identify high-performing geographies, audiences, creatives and channels 
Build strategies for Hindi + Regional Indian markets 
Manage significant monthly marketing budgets and scale campaigns profitably 
Own the complete funnel: 

Ad Install Registration First Game Active User Retention Monetisation LTV 

MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE 

Proven experience in Gaming App Marketing / User Acquisition 
Hands-on experience scaling mobile/gaming applications 
Strong Meta & Google App Campaign expertise 
Experience managing substantial performance marketing budgets 
Strong understanding of Gaming UA, Retention, LTV & ROAS 
Experience with AppsFlyer / Adjust / Branch / Singular or similar MMPs 
Experience in Influencer & Creator-led Gaming Growth 
Strong understanding of Indian gaming users 
Data-driven and highly performance-oriented mindset 

BIG ADVANTAGE 

Candidates who have: 

Scaled a gaming app to 1M+ downloads/users 
Managed 10 Lakhs–1 Crore+ monthly marketing budgets 
Worked with Real Money Gaming / Fantasy / Casual / Social Gaming Apps 
Built successful referral/viral acquisition engines 
Experience with regional-language gaming campaigns 
Strong existing network of Indian Gaming Creators/Influencers 

What We Will Measure You On 

Downloads | CPI | CAC | D1/D7/D30 Retention | DAU | MAU | LTV | ROAS | Revenue/User | Organic Growth 

Downloads alone are NOT success. We want quality users who retain and monetise. 

IMPORTANT 

Please DO NOT apply if your experience is primarily in: 

Education Marketing 
Generic Lead Generation 
Social Media Management 
SEO-only 
Branding 
Content Marketing 
Traditional Marketing 

We are specifically looking for a hands-on Gaming App Growth Expert with proven numbers. 

Compensation 

Competitive Salary UPTO 10 LPA + Performance Incentives 

Compensation will be based on experience, previous scale handled and proven results. 

Apply Now 

If you have actually scaled gaming apps and know how to acquire millions of users across India, we want to speak with you. 

Join us and build the next large-scale gaming growth engine in India.

title: Seo Executive
description:
Position/ Skillset : SEO
Designation : Executive
Timings- 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
Overview 
We are seeking a result driven SEO Specialist to enhance our online presence and drive organic growth. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing effective search engine optimization strategies, improving website visibility, and increasing qualified traffic. This
role requires a strong understanding of both on-page and off page SEO, technical optimization, and data analysis, along with the ability to collaborate across teams to achieve business goals.

Key Responsibilities 
Keyword Research: Conduct in-depth research to identify high-performing keywords and search trends using tools like SEMrush and Ahrefs.
OnPage Optimization: Optimize website content, including meta tags (titles and descriptions), headings, URLs, and internal linking to improve rankings.
OffPage SEO & Link Building: Develop and execute strategies to acquire high-quality backlinks from reputable websites.
Technical SEO: Perform regular website audits to identify and fix issues like broken links, slow page speed, and crawl errors.
Performance Tracking: Monitor and report on organic traffic, rankings, and conversion rates using Google Analytics and Google Search Console.
Content Collaboration: Guide content teams on creating SEO-friendly articles and landing pages based on search intent.
Competitor Analysis: Research and analyze competitors' SEO efforts and rankings to identify opportunities for growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with content, design, and dev teams to prioritize and implement SEO fixes.
AI Search Optimization (AEO/GEO): Structure content so it gets cited/extracted in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, and Perplexity -- now as important as traditional ranking.

Qualifications 
Education: A Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
Experience: Typically 1 -3 years of proven experience in SEO or digital marketing.
SEO Tools: Proficiency in tools like Google Analytics, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, and Screaming Frog is required.
Technical Knowledge: Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and Content Management Systems (CMS) like WordPress.
Analytical Skills: Ability to interpret complex data and derive actionable insights for strategy improvement.
Certifications: Professional certifications from platforms like HubSpot Academy or Google are often seen as a plus.
Familiarity with AI-search visibility tracking (AI Overview / answer-engine citation monitoring) is a plus.

title: Hiring For Creative Designer
description:
Job Description: Creative Designer 
Job Title: Creative Designer
Industry: Real Estate
Department: Marketing & Branding
Experience: 2-6 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary 
We are looking for a highly creative and innovative Creative Designer to join our real estate marketing team. The candidate will be responsible for designing impactful marketing creatives, branding materials, digital advertisements, property brochures, social media campaigns, motion graphics, and promotional videos for real estate projects.
The ideal candidate should have strong graphic design skills, video editing expertise, knowledge of AI-powered creative tools, and the ability to create engaging visual content that strengthens brand identity and promotes real estate projects.

Key Responsibilities 
Design creative marketing materials for residential and commercial real estate projects.
Create social media posts, digital ads, brochures, flyers, banners, hoardings, standees, and project launch creatives.
Develop branding materials and maintain visual consistency across all marketing platforms.
Create motion graphics, animated advertisements, promotional videos, and engaging video content.
Edit and produce real estate marketing videos, project presentations, and promotional reels.
Use AI tools and video AI platforms to generate creative concepts, visuals, animations, and marketing content.
Enhance property images, architectural renders, and project visuals for marketing purposes.
Collaborate with the marketing, sales, and digital marketing teams to execute campaigns.
Manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality creative assets within deadlines.
Stay updated with the latest graphic design trends, AI technologies, and real estate marketing strategies.
Required Software & Technical Skills
Corel DRAW : Designing print materials, brochures, hoardings, flex banners, and other marketing collaterals.
Adobe Photoshop : Image editing, photo manipulation, retouching, and creative compositions.
Adobe Illustrator : Vector graphics, logos, branding, icons, and marketing illustrations.
Adobe Premiere Pro : Professional video editing, promotional videos, property walkthrough edits, and social media reels.
Motion Graphics : Creating animated creatives, text animations, transitions, and promotional content.
AI Creative Tools : Using AI tools for image generation, creative concepts, image enhancement, and content creation.
Video AI Tools : Generating and enhancing AI-based videos, animations, and promotional visuals.
Knowledge of After Effects, Canva, or other relevant creative tools will be an added advantage.
Required Qualifications 
Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Multimedia, Animation, Visual Communication, or a related field.
26 years of experience in graphic design and creative production, preferably in real estate.
Strong understanding of typography, color combinations, composition, and visual storytelling.
Experience in digital marketing creatives, print design, video editing, and motion graphics.
Ability to use AI-powered tools to improve creative quality and production efficiency.
Strong portfolio showcasing graphic design, video editing, motion graphics, and AI-generated content.
Good communication, time-management, and teamwork skills.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Quality, creativity, and consistency of design output.
Timely completion of creative assignments and campaigns.
Quality of video editing, motion graphics, and AI-generated content.
Adherence to brand guidelines.
Ability to manage multiple creative projects and implement feedback effectively.

title: Liquidity Risk Analyst/ Business Analyst
description:
Role & responsibilities 

Review all LIQ Risk reports from functional as well as detail validation perspective and recommending automated solutions to minimize operational risk and time.
Review requirements from business users on data validations, reconciliations and data elements for all Liquidity reports.
Supporting Liquidity Risk Requirements Lead in planning and tracking progress of Requirements work stream.
Supporting wider Finance data related initiatives, including resolution of upstream data initiatives, investigation and prioritization of data issues, liaising with IT / Design teams to support delivery of data sourcing changes.
Working with upstream IT to resolve Global Data Quality issues and create a Requirements Operating Model
Provide worldwide sites with effective communication of analytics on requirements.
Work closely with diverse Business and IT teams, to ensure outstanding requirement issues / sourcing are being discussed and solutions rolled out.
Facilitate issue resolution to ensure that the schedule of each work stream remains on track and that any issues are resolved through appropriate, agreed solutions.
Perform Requirement Gap analysis and raise requirements for upcoming projects to relevant teams.
Role holder will be responsible to present requirements in various forums and follow requirements governance process.
Facilitate issue resolution to ensure that the schedule of each work stream remains on track and that any issues are resolved through appropriate, agreed solutions.
The role holder will work with a large Global Finance team that delivers complex transformational and important regulatory change on Liquidity Reporting Metrics
The role will require supporting teams/activities across multiple global regions.
There are no line management responsibilities for this role.
Role holder will be aiding other change delivery functions like Design, testing etc. to deliver targeted model.
Work with dynamic plans in a fast-moving environment, continually assessing priorities and progress and adjusting course where necessary, being sure to maintain alignment with other programme work streams.
The role holder will also continually reassess the operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology.
This will be achieved by ensuring all actions take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring.
Also, by addressing any areas of concern in conjunction with line management and/or the appropriate department.

description:

Data Preparation and Analysis: Collect, clean, organise, and analyse data in coordination with the Team Lead to support business operations and decision-making.

Dashboard Development: Create and maintain dashboards and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs), business performance, and operational progress.

Data Management: Organise and maintain the companys data room, files, and documentation to ensure information is accurate, secure, and easily accessible.

Basic knowledge or exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure.

Familiarity with Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, or Amazon QuickSight for creating dashboards and visual reports.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and data accuracy.

title: Product Owner
description:
We are looking for a Business Analyst who can work in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, partnering with business and technology teams to deliver impactful solutions across agrochemical operations. If you enjoy translating business needs into scalable product solutions, this role could be a great fit.

Job Responsibilities 
As a Business Analyst, you will:
Lead requirement gathering and user story development in collaboration with Product Managers, Developers, Designers, and QA teams
Drive the end-to-end process of defining, analyzing, and prioritizing business requirements while ensuring alignment with business objectives
Engage with internal and external stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document requirements, ensuring clarity and feasibility
Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
Guide development teams in designing and delivering solutions aligned with agrochemical business processes
Conduct in-depth analysis and propose data-driven solutions to enhance product offerings and user experience
Define and document user stories, including behavior-driven development (BDD) scenarios and acceptance criteria
Perform gap analysis and provide strategic recommendations to improve product capabilities and business processes
Manage and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring smooth execution of product roadmaps
Ensure quality control through peer reviews, deliverable sign-offs, and adherence to best practices
Lead functional, exploratory, and user acceptance testing (UAT), ensuring solutions meet business and customer expectations
Provide support during product releases and ensure seamless transition of changes to end users

Qualifications & Experience 
8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Product Owner within a product or technology-driven environment.
Proven domain expertise in the Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Biotech, or specialized Agrochemical sectors. 
Strong understanding of Life Sciences regulatory frameworks (e.g., GxP, FDA guidelines, HIPAA, or 21 CFR Part 11) and experience delivering validated systems.
Proven ability to take ownership of product delivery, driving execution from concept to completion.
Strong experience working in Agile environments (Scrum or similar frameworks) with cross-functional teams.
Experience in user experience (UX), user story mapping, and requirement documentation.
Ability to synthesize complex scientific or technical information and translate it into actionable business insights.
Hands-on experience in continuous delivery and integration environments.
Skills 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to interact with both technical and non-technical audiences
Proficiency in tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and MS Office Suite
Familiarity with data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, Power BI)
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

title: Program Manager
description:
Crossing Hurdles (Samvedh Grow Private Limited) is one of the world's largest suppliers of AI training talent. We build and run expert contributor teams for global AI labs and data companies, with 50,000+ candidates on our network and 1,000+ roles delivered across coding, STEM, research, linguistics, annotation and professional services.
We are hiring a Delivery & Program Associate into the Founder's Office. This is a 3-month paid internship with a full-time offer at the end, based on performance.

Roles and responsibilities 
Manage day-to-day delivery on live AI projects: allocate work across the internal contributor pod, track throughput and quality, and publish end-of-day performance numbers.
Review client project specifications and evaluation rubrics, and convert them into clear working instructions for contributors.
Act as the first line of response for contributor queries on task logic, platform access, policy and payments, with a defined response-time standard.
Build and maintain performance dashboards and trackers in Google Sheets and Excel that drive payout calculation, quality review and weekly client reporting.
Support client engagement: attend review calls, record action items, draft status updates and follow up to closure.
Assist with contributor onboarding and offboarding, documentation and compliance checks.

Desired candidate profile 
Graduate of the 2025 or 2026 batch, any discipline. Analytical backgrounds such as engineering, economics, mathematics or statistics are an advantage.
Excellent written English. The majority of this role is written communication with clients and contributors.
Working proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets. Exposure to SQL, Python or any BI tool is a plus.
Strong ownership and follow-through, with the ability to run multiple threads without supervision.
Interest in artificial intelligence, model training and evaluation. No prior AI industry experience required.

Perks and benefits 
Performance-linked monthly variable on top of the fixed stipend.
Direct exposure to international AI clients and to the founder's office.
Full-time conversion at revised compensation for interns who clear the bar.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
About the Role 
We're looking for an experienced Delivery Manager to lead delivery across a portfolio of technology teams and strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for driving predictable delivery, operational excellence, and governance across multiple teams while partnering with senior leaders to ensure successful business outcomes. You'll play a key role in developing delivery capability and continuously improving how we plan, deliver, and scale technology solutions.

What You'll Be Doing 
You'll help shape and lead delivery across multiple teams, ensuring that technology initiatives are delivered effectively while balancing priorities, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
Own delivery performance across a portfolio of teams and strategic initiatives, driving alignment to quarterly and annual commitments.
Establish and evolve delivery governance, planning standards, forecasting processes, and delivery best practices.
Proactively manage portfolio risks, issues, and dependencies, ensuring effective mitigation and informed decision-making.
Partner with senior stakeholders to provide clear delivery insights, lead governance reviews, and support strategic prioritisation.
Coach and develop Delivery Leads and Scrum Masters while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For 
You'll bring strong delivery leadership experience, a collaborative approach, and the ability to influence outcomes across complex technology environments.
Experience leading delivery across multiple agile teams, programmes, or value streams within Product and Engineering-led organisations.
People leadership capability, including coaching and developing Delivery Leads, Scrum Masters, or similar delivery professionals.
Strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and modern delivery practices, with a focus on continuous improvement and predictable delivery.
Proven ability to manage complex dependencies, risks, and stakeholder relationships while navigating competing priorities.
Excellent communication, facilitation, and influencing skills, with the confidence to engage senior stakeholders and drive decision-making.
Experience delivering projects or programmes within the consumer retail domain. 
Familiarity with delivery analytics and forecasting tools such as Plandek, Jira Align, or similar platforms.
Experience establishing delivery governance frameworks and operating models.
Relevant Agile or delivery certifications, such as Scrum, AgilePM, PMP, or equivalent.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Who We’re Looking For
The Sr. Associate (Performance Marketing) will be responsible for all top-of-the-funnel initiatives aimed at lead generation through digital mediums. The ideal candidate should be highly skilled in managing and optimizing campaigns on Google Ads and Meta platforms (Facebook and Instagram). As the Performance Marketing Lead for our residential and housing society business, this position is responsible for increasing inbound lead acquisitions through effective
and efficient digital campaigns and driving brand awareness. Strong bias to action with deep 
performance marketing experience in B2C space will be critical to success in this role. We are 
looking for you to develop, implement, track and optimize our digital marketing campaigns 
across google and meta channels. 

You’ll be taking the lead, so we’d love if you have the following skills/traits:3+ years of digital marketing experience preferably in B2C product or financial/investment services industry Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze raw data, draw conclusions and develop actionable recommendations, data-driven insights to optimize results Proven digital and performance marketing skills - experience with paid channels such as
Google, Facebook, A/B testing, Analytics, Marketing Automation etc. Strong verbal and written communication skills Google Ads and Facebook certifications are a plus Entrepreneurial mindset and high ownership with bias towards execution combining planning with action to achieve set goals Humble, open to feedback and collaborative

What You’ll Do 
In typical startup fashion, you’ll be wearing many different hats and learning a lot along the way. 
Here are some things that we’d want you to help lead and execute: 
1. Be accountable for all PPC campaigns (search, display, YouTube & P-Max, Meta ads) Hands-on experience with Google Adwords (search, Shopping, Perf Max & YT) and Meta marketing Develop, implement, and manage paid search and paid social campaigns to generate high-quality leads Set up, manage, and optimize Meta ads (Facebook and Instagram) including campaign objectives, audience targeting, and ad creatives Conduct keyword research, ad copy creation, and A/B testing for Google Ads (Search, Display, Video, Shopping)

Expertise in Meta (Facebook and Instagram) advertising, including: 

Facebook Ads Manager 

Instagram Ads 
Audience Insights and Custom Audiences 

Retargeting and Lookalike Audiences 

Dynamic Ads 
Video Ads 

Strong understanding of all Google Ads formats, including: 

Search Ads 

Display Ads 
Video Ads (YouTube) 
Shopping Ads 
App Campaigns 

Experience with conversion tracking, pixel setup, and event tracking 

2. Reviewing end-to-end PPC strategy and execution on Google and Meta Strategizing, creating, and managing campaigns across various digital channels Optimizing campaigns based on data-driven insights and quantitative analysis to ensure high ROI Establishing relevant KPIs and targets, and use dashboards for performance tracking and optimization purposes

Driving improvements in ROI and cost per acquisition (CPA) across all channels Extensive experience in running tests & experiments, bidding strategies and attribution tools

3. Keep track of and optimize the entire funnel (from impressions to conversions) for all Ads Leveraging A/B tests, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and other optimization techniques to improve Ad effectiveness

4.Budget planning and implementation schedules to achieve revenue goals Manage budget allocations, bid strategies, and optimize for ROI Utilizing marketing budgets and allocating resources to achieve business goals in the most efficient manner

5. Data collection and analysis

Identify trends and insights to optimize spend and maximize ROI, Identifying 
performance issues using analytics platforms to ensure effective campaigns 

Measure and provide internal reports on the performance of all digital marketing 
campaigns by assessing against goals (ROI and KPIs) 

Establish data collection mechanisms + processes, allowing quick feedback loops for 
various teams - lead qualification, pre-sales and field sales team 

Measure and improve website traffic and web conversion 
Monitor competitor activity and keep an eye out for trends 

6. A little bit of everything

Design and develop different messaging strategies for key stakeholders 

Identify and evaluate new digital technologies and web analytics tools 

Work closely with the wider marketing team to optimize audience and communication 
strategies 

Collaborate with the content and design teams to create compelling ad creatives and 
landing page

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Senior Manager - Performance Marketing 
Location: Gurugram

About the role 
Were looking for a hands-on performance marketing leader to own paid growth for a high-potential consumer business. Youll be responsible for turning digital media into a meaningful growth engine -driving acquisition, activation and engagement at scale while improving CAC and business outcomes.
This is a role for someone who can think strategy, operate platforms hands-on, and own the number -with the opportunity to build and scale the performance function as the business grows.
What youll own 
The paid-media growth number . Own paids contribution to the categorys core conversions acquisitions ,scale while holding CAC. 
Growth strategy across web & app . Build and own the acquisition, retention, engagement, and retargeting strategy across Google, Meta, and any upcoming channels for both web and app.
End-to-end paid media across platforms . Google (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, Display), Meta (Advantage+, catalog/carousel), 3P / app / programmatic and social full ownership of strategy, structure, bidding, and budget pacing.
A dual-engine acquisition model . Run both engines on paid - in-market new-user acquisition and pre-identified base activation.
Optimise for quality: Use first-party audiences, downstream conversion/value signals and platform AI to optimise campaigns towards high-value customers and core business outcomes.
Full-funnel paid campaigns . Build and execute integrated funnel strategies that move users from consideration to conversion, with mid-funnel engagement ultimately driving higher core activations.; track engaged cohorts across 30/60/90-day windows to prove nurture-to-conversion, not last-click.
Make creative a growth lever : Build a strong testing engine across hooks, formats, propositions and audiences; identify winners and scale them.
Attribution & measurement. Ensure attribution setup and tracking across every campaign; own CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, cohort quality, and incrementality (holdouts / geo-tests) -present paid growth with quality proof, not attributed numbers.
Experiment relentlessly: Identify new platforms, formats, audiences and growth opportunities and turn successful experiments into scalable playbooks.
Agency & platform partnership . Lead the external paid-media agency pod, vendors, and publishers, and the Google / Meta partnerships; set the operating model and hold it to outcome-based standards. Own budget planning, reporting, and strategy changes basis performance.
Consumer-led experimentation : Partner with category teams to turn consumer insights into scalable growth experiments -looking beyond performance data to understand why consumers behave the way they do.
Who you are 
5-8 years in performance marketing, with a strong core in paid media (Google & Meta) and full-funnel campaign management. high-consideration-category experience strongly preferred.
Hands-on campaign experience across Google Search, Display, Meta/Facebook, third-party app networks, app campaigns, and social channels.
Proven ownership of a growth number - acquisitions at a target CAC/ROAS -not just campaign delivery. 
Performance-media depth: value-based bidding, first-party audience strategy, server-side tracking (CAPI / enhanced conversions), and optimising to downstream value events - not lead volume.
Measurement rigour: fluency in CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, cohort analysis, attribution, and incrementality testing. You can defend a number to a CFO.
Martech & analytics literacy: strong grasp of web analytics (e.g. Google Analytics), app analytics / MMPs (e.g. AppsFlyer / Branch / Adjust), and the various attribution models 
Creative-for-performance instinct: you treat creative as a performance variable
Agency & stakeholder leadership: you can run a paid-media agency pod, align cross-functional partners (product, brand, category, and engineering)
Consumer instinct. You understand the Indian consumer - trust barriers in high-consideration categories, the role of India affluence signals, and new-age surfaces (quick-commerce, WhatsApp, CTV) as acquisition channels.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Role & responsibilities 
Job Description: Senior Graphic Designer- Digital & Brand Communications. 
About Ridge Digital 
Ridge Digital is an integrated digital marketing and MarTech agency working with leading brands across the Education and FMCG sectors. We partner with organisations to build and execute end-to-end digital marketing strategies, spanning brand awareness, audience engagement, lead generation and customer acquisition.
With a strong presence across India through our network of eight offices, we combine strategic thinking, creative excellence, technology and performance marketing to deliver measurable business outcomes.
Our portfolio includes leading educational institutions such as IITs, IIMs, MDI, XLRI, Bennett University, Manipal and Plaksha, along with established consumer brands such as Dabur, Parachute, Citizen and Brita.
At Ridge Digital, creativity is closely integrated with strategy and performance. We believe in creating compelling brand experiences and impactful communication that not only look distinctive but also deliver results.
___________________________________________________________________________ 
Experience:  5+ Years
Location:  Gurgaon, India
Compensation:  As per industry standards, commensurate with experience and skill set
About the Role 
We are looking for a highly creative, detail-oriented and hands-on Graphic Designer with 5+ years of professional experience  in a digital agency, startup or corporate environment.
The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of digital-first design, brand communication and integrated marketing campaigns. Experience working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) / FMCG brands  will be an added advantage.
The candidate should be capable of independently conceptualising and executing creative campaigns across multiple digital platforms, maintaining brand consistency and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality visual communication.
Key Responsibilities 
1. Creative Conceptualisation & Campaign Execution 
Take end-to-end ownership of design campaigns, from understanding creative briefs and conceptualisation to final execution and delivery.
Develop creative assets across websites, landing pages, social media, display advertising, digital campaigns and presentations.
Translate marketing objectives and communication strategies into compelling visual concepts.
Create engaging visual content that drives audience engagement and supports campaign performance.
2. Brand Identity & Design Management 
Maintain, strengthen and scale brand consistency across all communication platforms.
Develop and adhere to brand guidelines, visual identity systems and design standards.
Ensure consistency in typography, colour palettes, layouts and overall visual language.
Adapt creative communication to suit different brands, audiences and marketing objectives.
3. Digital & Multi-Platform Design 
Design responsive website banners, landing page layouts, social media creatives, carousels and display advertisements.
Create UI/UX wireframes and visual layouts for websites and digital platforms.
Develop motion graphics, short-form video snippets and other multimedia assets.
Design professional presentations, pitch decks, proposals and corporate communication material.
4. Collaboration & Team Management 
Work closely with marketing, content, performance marketing, product and social media teams.
Collaborate with copywriters and campaign managers to develop integrated creative solutions.
Mentor junior designers and interns, provide creative direction and review day-to-day design deliverables.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring quality and adherence to timelines.
Key Digital & Technical Requirements 
1. Software Proficiency 
Advanced working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly:
Adobe Photoshop
Adobe Illustrator
Adobe InDesign
Working knowledge of CorelDRAW.
Proficiency in Figma for UI layouts, wireframing and collaborative design workflows.
Familiarity with motion graphics and video editing tools will be an advantage.
2. Multi-Platform Design Capabilities 
Strong portfolio demonstrating experience in digital-first creative design.
Ability to create designs for websites, landing pages, social media, display ads and digital presentations.
Experience in designing social media carousels, infographics, campaign key visuals and multimedia content.
Understanding of responsive design principles and platform-specific creative requirements.
3. Technical & Production Knowledge 
Strong understanding of digital file formats, image optimisation and export specifications.
Knowledge of web colour profiles, including RGB and HEX, and print colour systems.
Understanding of typography, visual hierarchy, grid systems, layouts and composition.
Ability to deliver production-ready creative assets in the required formats and specifications.
Desired Skills & Attributes 
Strong visual storytelling and conceptual thinking abilities.
Excellent understanding of contemporary design trends and digital communication.
Ability to interpret creative briefs and translate them into effective visual solutions.
Comfortable handling feedback, revisions and multiple creative iterations.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to design quality.
Ability to work independently, take ownership and manage tight deadlines.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred candidate profile 
Preferred Experience 
5+ years of hands-on graphic design experience in an agency, startup or corporate environment.
Experience handling multiple brands and integrated marketing campaigns.
Exposure to CPG/FMCG brands and consumer-focused marketing communication will be a strong advantage.
Experience working in a fast-paced digital marketing or advertising agency environment is preferred.
Differentiators 
FMCG/CPG exposure: Someone who has worked on consumer brands and understands product communication, packaging-led visuals and brand storytelling.
Performance marketing design: Ability to create multiple creative variations for Google and Meta campaigns, not just aesthetically attractive designs.
Independent ownership: Someone who can take a brief from the marketing team, conceptualise, execute and deliver without requiring constant supervision.

Application 
Candidates should share their updated CV along with a portfolio showcasing their best work across digital campaigns, branding, social media and other relevant creative projects.

title: AI Data Scientist
description:
AI Data Scientist 
Pay: 20 to 30 lakh per year
Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
Type: Full-time
Hours: 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST
Entity: XpertDox India Private Limited (XIPL)
Department: AI
On-site or remote: On-site, Monday through Friday
Reports to: AI Team Lead

About XpertDox 
XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), women's health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers. 

Position Summary 
You will work on neural network models that read clinical documentation and predict medical codes. Your first job is diagnosis: finding out why these models get specific cases wrong, and testing fixes until one holds up. Once a fix is proven, you write it into production code that runs inside the automated coding pipeline. This is an individual contributor role with no team management. It suits someone who wants to understand model errors and fix them. It does not suit someone who wants to run experiments without shipping, or who works only in notebooks.

Key Responsibilities 
In this role you will:
Own diagnosis of model errors on clinical text: find where predictions go wrong and trace each pattern to its root cause.
Design experiments that test one specific fix at a time, and decide from the results whether the fix moves forward.
Train, fine-tune, and evaluate neural network models for multilabel classification on clinical documentation.
Improve precision on imbalanced classes, where a wrong code has a real cost.
Write production Python that moves proven fixes into the automated coding pipeline.
Explain the tradeoffs of a proposed change to the AI Team Lead before it touches a production model.
Document every experiment: what you tried, what happened, and what you decided.

Required Qualifications 
At least 1 year of hands-on machine learning work outside coursework.
Hands-on experience fine-tuning pretrained language models for text classification.
Project work training deep learning models in Python.
Experience with multilabel classification, including handling class imbalance.
Production Python: code that runs inside a larger system, beyond notebook experiments.
Strong debugging and root-cause skills: you can work out why a model or pipeline is behaving unexpectedly.
Willing to act on partial evidence instead of waiting for exhaustive experiments.
Explains tradeoffs clearly before making a change.
Methodical and careful, because this work affects real claims.

Preferred Qualifications 
Making model predictions reliable enough for automated decisions.
Adapting language models to specialized vocabulary.
Taking a model from research prototype to production deployment.

Location and Schedule 
This role is on-site at the XIPL office in Noida, Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST. It is not remote and not hybrid. Candidates outside Noida must relocate to Noida before their start date. No travel is required.

Compensation 
Base salary of 20 to 30 lakh per year, commensurate with experience.
Relocation assistance, reimbursed against receipts, up to a cap.

Benefits 
Health insurance, provident fund, and leave per XIPL policy.
Company cab service for all Noida employees.

To Apply 
Apply at https://careers.xpertdox.com/ 

XIPL is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Site Reliability Engineer / Azure Devops
description:
Job Description: Azure DevOps & Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) 
Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
Experience: 6 to 10 Years
Work Mode: Work From Office (WFO)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Notice - Immediate Joiner only 

Job Summary 

We are looking for an experienced Azure DevOps & Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure, automate deployment processes, and ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of applications running on Microsoft Azure. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Azure cloud services, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Kubernetes, monitoring, and production support.

Key Responsibilities 

Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
Manage and optimize Azure cloud infrastructure, including Virtual Machines, AKS, Azure Storage, Networking, and other Azure services.
Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Terraform, ARM Templates, or Bicep.
Implement and manage containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
Monitor system performance, availability, and reliability using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Prometheus, and Grafana.
Implement Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, including SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, and error budgets.
Identify and troubleshoot infrastructure, application, and deployment-related issues.
Lead incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and preventive action implementation.
Optimize cloud infrastructure for performance, scalability, security, and cost efficiency.
Implement automation using PowerShell, Python, or Bash scripting.
Manage Azure networking, security configurations, access controls, and disaster recovery.
Collaborate with development, QA, and operations teams to improve deployment frequency and system reliability.
Ensure production environment stability through proactive monitoring and automated recovery mechanisms.

Required Technical Skills 

Cloud Platform: Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
DevOps Tools: Azure DevOps, Azure Pipelines, Repos, Boards, and Artifacts.
CI/CD: Pipeline creation, automation, release management, and deployment strategies.
Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, ARM Templates, or Bicep.
Containerization: Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
Monitoring & Observability: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK Stack.
Scripting: PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
Version Control: Git, GitHub, or Azure Repos.
Operating Systems: Linux and Windows administration.
Networking: Azure Virtual Networks, Load Balancers, DNS, VPN, NSG, and Application Gateway.
SRE Practices: Incident management, RCA, capacity planning, performance optimization, SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs.
Security: Azure IAM, RBAC, Key Vault, secrets management, and security best practices.

Mandatory Requirements 

6 to 10 years of overall experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with Azure Cloud and Azure DevOps.
Practical experience in designing and managing CI/CD pipelines.
Good understanding of SRE principles and production environment management.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Infrastructure as Code.
Strong troubleshooting, automation, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage critical production incidents and ensure service availability.

Preferred Qualifications 

Microsoft Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-400, or AZ-305.
Experience with high-availability architecture and disaster recovery.
Knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
Experience with cloud cost optimization and security compliance.
Exposure to GitOps tools such as ArgoCD or Flux.

Key Competencies 

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Ability to work independently and handle production-critical responsibilities.
Strong ownership and accountability towards system reliability and uptime.

NOTE - WE ARE ONLY LOOKING FOR IMMEDIATE JOINERS FROM NOIDA LOCATION 

Contact - 

Call / What's App Resume - 9718978697 
Email - siddharth.mathur@moptra.com 

Manager - Global Talent Acquisition 
MOPTRA INFOTECH PVT LTD

title: Associate Program Manager
description:
Job Description Senior Associate – Program Manager
Experience: Minimum 3 Years
Work Location: Work from Office (WFO)
Preferred Qualification/Background: CMA / CFA candidates with experience in professional categories will be preferred.

Role Overview
We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Senior Associate – Program Manager to manage and drive day-to-day category operations. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of YouTube, its ecosystem, content trends, and category dynamics, along with the ability to identify growth opportunities and drive operational excellence.
Key Responsibilities
Manage and oversee day-to-day category operations, ensuring smooth and efficient execution.
Develop a strong understanding of YouTube, its ecosystem, content trends, audience behaviour, and category dynamics.
Monitor category performance, analyse key metrics, identify growth opportunities, and recommend improvement strategies.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure timely execution of business objectives.
Work closely with content, marketing, operations, and other relevant teams to drive category growth and performance.
Identify and implement innovative ideas and initiatives to enhance category growth, audience engagement, and overall performance.
Drive operational efficiency by streamlining processes and ensuring effective execution of category-level plans.
Take end-to-end ownership of assigned projects and ensure timely delivery of defined objectives.
Candidate Requirements
Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience.
Strong understanding of category management, business operations, and stakeholder coordination.
Ability to analyse performance metrics and identify business growth opportunities.
Strong communication, coordination, and project management skills.
CMA/CFA-qualified or experienced candidates, particularly those who have worked in professional categories, will be preferred.
Ability to work from the office.

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
Role & responsibilities: 

Position: Scrum Master

Experience: 8-12 Years

Location: Offshore / Hybrid

Role Overview 
We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support Agile delivery initiatives for the client .The ideal candidate will be responsible for facilitating Agile ceremonies, removing impediments, driving team performance, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement across cross-functional teams delivering digital, customer, and operational solutions within the travel and hospitality domain.
Key Responsibilities 
Serve as Scrum Master for one or more Agile teams, ensuring adherence to Scrum principles and Agile best practices.
Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions.
Partner closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, and Development teams to ensure successful delivery of business objectives.
Identify and remove impediments impacting team productivity and sprint commitments.
Track and report sprint metrics, team velocity, burn-down charts, and release progress.
Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives and Agile coaching.
Coordinate dependencies across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Support release planning, PI planning, and roadmap execution where applicable.
Ensure transparency in project status, risks, and issues through regular stakeholder communication.
Promote Agile maturity and coach team members on Scrum values and principles.
Collaborate with QA, DevOps, and Product teams to ensure high-quality product delivery.
Required Skills 
Strong experience as a Scrum Master in Agile environments.
In-depth knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, and Agile frameworks.
Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and managing distributed teams.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Experience with project and Agile management tools such as:
Jira
Confluence
Azure DevOps
Miro
Strong understanding of SDLC and software delivery lifecycle.
Ability to identify risks, manage dependencies, and drive resolution.
Preferred Skills 
Experience in Travel, Hospitality, Cruise, Airlines, or Transportation domains.
Exposure to customer-facing digital platforms such as:
Online Booking
Reservation Systems
Loyalty Programs
Mobile Applications
E-commerce Platforms
Experience working in SAFe Agile environments.
Knowledge of cloud technologies and DevOps practices.
Experience managing multiple Agile teams.
Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PSM, SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), or equivalent Agile certification preferred.
SAFe certification is an added advantage.
Key Competencies 
Agile Coaching
Servant Leadership
Conflict Resolution
Stakeholder Management
Facilitation & Collaboration
Continuous Improvement
Risk & Dependency Management
Team Enablement
Nice-to-Have Domain Experience 
Candidates with experience supporting:
Cruise Line Operations
Hospitality & Guest Experience Platforms
Reservation and Booking Systems
Loyalty & Rewards Programs
Travel Commerce Applications
Customer Self-Service Portals
