title: Technical Project Manager (Japanese Speaking)
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
• Serve as the single point of contact between the Onsite PM and the offshore team: cascade priorities, decisions and CCBJI feedback; escalate offshore risks, issues and blockers to the Onsite PM
• Run daily offshore stand-ups and a regular sync with the Onsite PM across time zones (ISTJST)
• Plan, allocate and track offshore work across waves; manage offshore capacity, backlog and sprint progress in Jira
• Maintain the offshore plan, milestone tracker, RAID entries, action logs and access tracker, and feed them into the Onsite PM's program plan
• Prepare offshore weekly status reports and provide offshore inputs to fortnightly reviews and SteerCo packs (owned by the Onsite PM)
• Track offshore resource onboarding, access provisioning and environment readiness (Week 0 entry gate)
• Monitor offshore delivery quality against gate criteria; coordinate defect triage, reconciliation and KT readiness
• Log offshore CRs and support the Onsite PM's impact assessment; keep meeting minutes, sign-off records and KT completion records for offshore deliverables
• Work with translators to publish offshore reports in English and Japanese
• Manage offshore team onboarding, ramp-up/ramp-down, backfills and performance

MUST-HAVE SKILLS 
• Proven management of offshore delivery teams on SAP / data-platform migration programs
• Fixed-bid and Agile/wave-based delivery with Atlassian Jira/Confluence
• Strong communication with onsite and client stakeholders across time zones
• RAID management, status reporting; advanced MS Excel and PowerPoint

GOOD TO HAVE 
• Experience with Japanese clients; Japanese language basics
• SAP BW/HANA to Azure/Fabric migration exposure
• PMP / PRINCE2 / CSM certification
• Power BI for delivery dashboards

title: Hiring For Client account manager/Delivery Manager
description:
We are seeking a high-performing Business Development & Account Manager with a proven track record in the recruitment industry, specifically focusing on contract staffing and IT/non-IT temporary contingent labor. In this dual role, you will be responsible for hunting new enterprise clients to secure contract staffing mandates while simultaneously nurturing and growing existing accounts. You will act as the primary bridge between our clients and our internal delivery/sourcing teams to ensure fast turnaround times and high-quality placements. Key ResponsibilitiesBusiness Development & Sales (60%) 
Identify Opportunities : Prospect, cold call, and pitch contract staffing solutions to HR leaders, Procurement, and Hiring Managers.
Secure Mandates : Win new master service agreements (MSAs) and staffing contracts with mid-market and enterprise clients.
Market Analysis : Map target industries, analyze competitor pricing, and identify high-demand skill gaps in the contingent labor market.
Proposal Creation : Standardize, draft, and present commercial proposals, RFPs, and pricing models (markups, margins, and pay rates).
Account Management & Client Retention (40%) 
Relationship Management : Serve as the main point of contact for active clients, ensuring high satisfaction and repeat business.
Requirement Gathering : Extract detailed job descriptions, technical stack requirements, and cultural fit nuances from clients.
Delivery Collaboration : Partner closely with internal recruitment teams to prioritize open contract positions and screen matching resumes.
Contract Extensions : Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of contractors, including performance checks, extensions, and off-boarding.
Role Requirements 
Experience : Minimum 35 years of experience in agency recruitment, specifically selling and managing contract staffing / temporary staffing solutions.
Industry Knowledge : Deep understanding of contract compliance, payroll models, labor laws, and contingent workforce management.
Sales Metric Focus : Proven history of meeting or exceeding monthly/quarterly gross margin and headcount deployment targets.
Communication Skills : Exceptional negotiation skills with the ability to converse fluidly with C-level executives, MSPs, and VMS partners.
Tools : Proficiency with popular CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

title: Project Manager
description:
Tycho Technologies is looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead and manage software development projects from planning to delivery. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating with development, QA, design, and other cross-functional teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and as per client requirements.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of software development processes, project planning, stakeholder management, and Agile methodologies.

Key Responsibilities 

Plan, manage, and deliver software development projects within agreed timelines, scope, and budget.
Gather project requirements and coordinate with clients, business stakeholders, and internal teams.
Prepare project plans, timelines, milestones, resource allocation plans, and delivery schedules.
Work closely with developers, QA engineers, UI/UX designers, and business analysts to ensure smooth project execution.
Track project progress, identify risks and dependencies, and take corrective actions to avoid delays.
Conduct regular project status meetings and communicate updates to clients and senior management.
Manage client expectations, handle change requests, and ensure timely resolution of project-related issues.
Monitor software development activities across the SDLC, from requirement gathering and development to testing, deployment, and post-release support.
Ensure deliverables meet defined quality standards and client expectations.
Maintain project documentation, status reports, risk logs, and meeting minutes.
Use project management tools such as Jira, Trello, Asana, or Microsoft Project to track tasks and milestones.
Support Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, wherever applicable.
Identify opportunities to improve project delivery processes, team productivity, and customer satisfaction.

Required Skills and Qualifications 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
6-8 years of overall professional experience, with substantial experience managing IT/software projects.
Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum and/or Waterfall project management methodologies.
Experience managing project timelines, resources, budgets, risks, and deliverables.
Strong client communication, stakeholder management, and team coordination skills.
Familiarity with software development concepts, APIs, databases, integrations, and testing processes.
Experience using project tracking and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Trello, or similar platforms.
Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver projects in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications 

PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, or other relevant project management certification.
Experience working with distributed or cross-functional technical teams.
Experience managing multiple client projects or software product development initiatives.
Understanding of software release management, deployment processes, and post-production support.

What We Are Looking For 
A proactive and accountable Project Manager who can bridge the gap between clients and technical teams, drive project execution, manage delivery risks, and ensure successful software delivery while maintaining strong client relationships.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Performance Marketing Manager Residential Solar 
Role Overview 
We are looking for a data-driven and results-oriented Performance Marketing Manager to drive qualified lead generation and customer acquisition for our Residential Solar business. The role will focus on scaling digital demand across paid channels, optimizing cost per lead (CPL), improving conversion rates, and maximizing return on ad spend (ROAS).
This position requires strong experience in performance marketing, funnel optimization, and local lead generation for high-value products.

Key Responsibilities 
1. Paid Campaign Management 
Plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across:
Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube)
Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
LinkedIn (if applicable for premium segment)
Drive high-intent lead acquisition for rooftop solar installations.
Manage location-based targeting campaigns across multiple cities and states.

2. Lead Generation & Funnel Optimization 
Own end-to-end lead generation funnel from click to installation.
Optimize landing pages for higher conversion rates.
Improve lead quality to ensure high appointment-to-installation conversion.
Track and reduce CPL and CAC while maintaining lead quality.

3. Performance Measurement & Reporting 
Monitor and report on:
CPL (Cost per Lead)
CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)
ROAS
Conversion rates (Lead Site Visit Installation)
Build dashboards and weekly/monthly performance reports.
Forecast budgets and scale profitable campaigns.

4. Experimentation & Growth 
Run A/B and multivariate testing across:
Ad creatives
Copy
Target audiences
Landing pages
Identify new scalable acquisition channels.
Test new ad formats and emerging marketing technologies.

5. Marketing-Tech & Tracking 
Ensure accurate tracking via:
Google Analytics / GA4
Conversion APIs
CRM integrations
Collaborate with sales teams to track offline conversions and improve attribution.
Optimize marketing automation and lead routing systems.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration 
Work closely with:
Sales teams (to improve lead quality and conversion)
Product/Technical teams (to refine customer value proposition)
Creative teams (to develop high-performing solar ad creatives) 

Requirements 
8+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience.
Strong experience in lead generation for high-value or home-improvement products (solar, real estate, home loans, insurance, etc. preferred).
Deep expertise in Google Ads (Search & Performance Max) and Meta Ads.
Proven track record of managing large monthly budgets.
Experience optimizing CPL and improving funnel conversions.
Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel proficiency.
Experience with CRM systems and offline conversion tracking.
Ability to work in a fast-scaling, performance-driven environment.

title: Senior 3D Graphic Designer & Creative
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly skilled and creative Senior 3D Graphic Designer & Creative Lead with 8+ years of experience in 3D design, graphic design, video editing, and visual storytelling. The ideal candidate will have a strong command of industry-leading design tools, a proven track record of delivering high-quality creative output across multiple disciplines, and the ability to lead and inspire a creative team.
This role demands a portfolio-driven professional who can independently manage projects from concept through execution, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and maintain brand consistency across digital and print media.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

3D Design & Visualization 
Create high-quality 3D models, textures, lighting setups, and photorealistic renders using 3ds Max, V-Ray, and Autodesk Maya
Develop architectural and product visualization including exhibition stall and interior design renders
Produce 3D walkthroughs, animations, and explainer visuals for client presentations
Optimize 3D assets for use in various media formats including print, digital, and immersive displays
Graphic Design & Branding 
Design comprehensive brand identities including logos, brand guides, stationery, and promotional collateral
Create print-ready artwork for catalogues, brochures, stickers, banners, and marketing materials
Develop website UI/UX layouts and ensure visual coherence with brand guidelines
Manage and create social media creatives for 50+ accounts across platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn), encompassing static creatives, carousel posts, video creatives, reel assets/shots, single-page and dual-page flyers, and catalogues/brochures
Handle end-to-end Amazon, Flipkart, and Big Basket e-commerce listings including brand pages, product banners, and A+ content
Collaborate closely with the Marketing team during product photography and videography shoots to advise on required angles, compositions, lighting, and visual requirements, ensuring the availability of suitable raw content for design and promotional activities
Video Editing & Motion Graphics 
Edit, color-grade, and deliver high-quality video content using Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects
Create motion graphics, animated infographics, product reveals, and explainer animations
Produce reels, short-form content, and brand promotional films for social media campaigns
SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

3D Modeling & Texturing 

Lighting & Rendering (V-Ray) 

3ds Max & Autodesk Maya 

Adobe After Effects 

Adobe Premiere Pro 

Photoshop & Illustrator 

InDesign & CorelDRAW 

AutoCAD (Basic) 

Social Media Design 

E-Commerce Listing Design 

Exhibition Stall Design 

Interior Visualization 

Brand Identity & Packaging 

Motion Graphics 

UI/UX Layout Design 

Print Production 

Video Color Grading 

Team Leadership (10+) 

KeyShot (Product Rendering) 

Preferred / Emerging Skills (Added for 2025 Standards) 
Proficiency in Blender (open-source 3D industry growing rapidly)
Basic knowledge of Unreal Engine / real-time rendering for architectural visualization
AI-assisted design tools: Adobe Firefly, Mi journey, or Stable Diffusion for concept ideation
Understanding of AR/VR asset preparation and 3D asset optimization for metaverse/immersive experiences
Familiarity with Sigma or Adobe XD for web/app design collaboration
Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for web asset handoff to developers
Experience with Google Workspace, project management tools (Asana, Trello, or Notion)
Knowledge of SEO best practices for e-commerce listing images and alt-text
QUALIFICATIONS & EDUCATION

Graduate/Diploma in Multimedia & Animation (Arena Animation or equivalent institute)
Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, Design, Animation, or any relevant stream
8+ years of hands-on experience in graphic design, 3D design, and video editing
Award or recognition in 3D Modeling/Design (e.g., APTECH Creative Hunt or equivalent) — preferred
Strong portfolio on Behance, Art Station, or personal website showcasing 3D renders, branding, and motion work
EXPERIENCE PROFILE

Candidates should ideally have worked with or demonstrated expertise in the following types of environments:
MNCs, creative advertising agencies, or architectural/real estate design studios
Product-based companies or e-commerce brands requiring large-scale digital creatives
Multi-category projects spanning events, exhibitions, interior design, and digital marketing
Previous Roles Valued At: 
– 3D Modeling & Texturing Artist
– 3D Graphic Designer (Mid / Senior level)
– Senior Creative Designer / Creative Lead
– Visual Design Manager
WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive salary commensurate with experience
Creative, collaborative, and growth-oriented work environment
Opportunity to work on diverse, high-impact projects across real estate, FMCG, fashion, and lifestyle brands
Access to the latest design tools, software licenses, and training resources
Flexible hybrid work arrangement
Exposure to international brand campaigns and e-commerce platforms
PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENT

Candidates must submit a portfolio link (Behance / Art Station / personal site) along with their application. The portfolio should include at minimum:
3–5 completed 3D renders or architectural/product visualizations
2–3 branding or social media campaign samples
1–2 video editing or motion graphics reels
Any e-commerce or exhibition stall design samples are a strong plus

Location: Bangalore 
Experience: 5-7 Years

• As part of project scrum team member design and implement the most optimal cloud-based solutions for the company
• Ensure application performance, uptime, and scale, maintaining high standards for code quality and thoughtful design
• Modifying and improving existing systems. 
• Educating teams on the implementation of new cloud technologies and initiatives.
• Ensuring efficient functioning of data storage and processing functions in accordance with company security policies and best practices in cloud security.
• Identifying, analyzing, and resolving infrastructure vulnerabilities and application deployment issues.
• Define and document best practices and strategies regarding application deployment and infrastructure maintenance.
• Regularly reviewing existing systems and making recommendations for improvements.

Qualifications 
• Degree in computer science or a similar field.
• Eight or more years of experience in architecting, designing, developing, and implementing cloud solutions in Azure or AWS 
• Understanding of core cloud concepts like Infra as code, IaaS, PaaS and SaaS.
• Strong proficiency in Python and experience with REST API development.
• Design and implement scalable, secure, and efficient cloud-based solutions using Azure services.
• Develop and maintain RESTful APIs to support various applications.
• Technologies: Python, Terraform, Azure app services, Functions, App Insights, ADF in AZURE
• Similar Technology stack for AWS like ECS, Lambda, S3, Glue jobs etc
• Developing and maintaining continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines Jenkins Groovy scripts.
• Developing containerized solutions and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, App Service or ECS)
• Experience of server less architecture, cloud computing, cloud native application and scalability etc
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
• Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
• Implement robust security measures and ensure compliance with industry standards.
• Monitor and troubleshoot application performance and resolve any issues.
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to the continuous improvement of the development process.
• Development experience with configuration management tools (Terraform, Ansible, Arm Templates).
• Relevant certification of Azure/AWS preferred.
• Troubleshooting and analytical skills.
• Knowledge of AI & ML technologies, as well as ML model management is a plus.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Job Responsibilities: 
Lead the meetings with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for GIS -related projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform decision-making, utilizing GIS tools and techniques to visualize and interpret data.
Act as a liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders, facilitating communication and ensuring that project deliverables meet business needs and requirements.
Assist in the design and development of GIS solutions by translating business requirements into functional specifications and using cases for technical teams.
Conduct regular meetings and workshops with stakeholders to review project progress, gather feedback, and adjust project scope or requirements as necessary.
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including project plans, business requirement documents (BRDs), user stories, and reports on project status and outcomes for stakeholders.
Mentor the junior business analyst and business analyst 

Qualifications & Experience: 
B.Tech / B.E
5-8 Years

Required skills 

Technical Skills: 
Advanced skills in gathering and eliciting complex business requirements and securing sign-off from stakeholders.
Proficiency in preparing detailed Software Requirements Specifications (SRS), Functional Requirements Specifications (FRS), and Business Requirements Documents (BRD) for various projects.
Strong experience in facilitating User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and guiding users through the testing process.
Ability to create comprehensive and persuasive responses to Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and Requests for Information (RFIs).
Proficient in conducting technical evaluations of tenders and RFPs, preparing pre-bid queries, and producing technical documentation.

Soft Skills: 
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, enabling clear presentation of complex ideas and documentation to diverse audiences.
Strong interpersonal skills for effective intra-department communication and collaboration with cross-functional teams, including legal, sales, and finance.
Demonstrated ability to manage teams, lead discussions, and coordinate efforts to achieve project goals.
High attention to detail in documentation and communication to ensure clarity and accuracy in all deliverables.

Preferred Skills: 
Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall methodologies, enabling effective project oversight and delivery.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to assess requirements, identify gaps, and recommend solutions.
Understanding of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and related technologies is highly beneficial. 
Proven track record of engaging with clients through demos and presentations, enhancing client relationships and satisfaction

8+ years of experience in Windows Server & Cloud Infrastructure roles. 

Strong expertise in AD, DNS, DHCP, Hyper-V, Azure, Entra, and O365. 

Proven experience with storage systems, backup platforms, and data center management. 

Strong troubleshooting, monitoring, and documentation skills.

5 Days working culture 
20 Paid Leaves & 14 public holidays 
Friendly Work Environment

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description: Senior Performance Marketing Executive E-commerce & Quick Commerce 
Location: Mumbai

About the Role 
We are looking for a data-driven and commercially oriented Senior Performance Marketing Executive to manage and optimize advertising performance across e-commerce marketplaces, Quick Commerce platforms, and D2C channels.
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in Amazon Ads, marketplace performance marketing, and at least one Quick Commerce platform such as Blinkit, Zepto, or Swiggy Instamart. The role requires strong analytical skills, proficiency in Excel, and the ability to connect advertising investments with inventory availability, product visibility, conversion, sales, and profitability.
Key Responsibilities 
1. E-commerce & Marketplace Advertising 
Plan, execute, and optimize advertising campaigns on Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.
Monitor SKU-level performance, including ad spend, sales, ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, conversion rates, and product profitability.
Identify high-performing and underperforming SKUs and implement appropriate budget allocation strategies.
Optimize bids, keywords, campaign structures, and advertising budgets to achieve sales and profitability targets.
Monitor product listings, pricing, Buy Box performance, ratings, reviews, and conversion-related issues.
2. Quick Commerce Performance Marketing 
Manage and optimize advertising campaigns across platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, and Swiggy Instamart.
Analyze platform-wise, city-wise, and SKU-wise performance to identify growth opportunities.
Monitor product availability and ensure advertising spends are aligned with inventory levels and store-level availability.
Identify underperforming campaigns and reallocate budgets based on ROAS, availability, and business priorities.
Coordinate with platform account managers to improve campaign performance, product visibility, and sales.
3. Performance Analysis & Reporting 
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
Develop and maintain performance dashboards and reports covering sales, advertising spend, ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, inventory, and targets.
Track monthly budgets, sales forecasts, planned versus actual performance, and campaign efficiency.
Use advanced Excel or Google Sheets functions, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, and IFERROR.
Present actionable insights and recommendations to management.
4. Budget Planning & Business Growth 
Develop monthly advertising plans aligned with sales targets, promotional events, and seasonal campaigns.
Allocate budgets across marketplaces, Quick Commerce platforms, and individual SKUs based on performance and business priorities.
Forecast sales and advertising returns using historical data and realistic performance assumptions.
Identify opportunities to improve marketing efficiency, reduce wasted spends, and maximize return on investment.
Align advertising strategies with stock availability, pricing, margins, and overall business objectives.
5. D2C & Digital Marketing Support 
Monitor D2C website performance, including traffic, conversion rate, customer acquisition cost (CAC), average order value (AOV), and ROAS.
Coordinate with agencies and internal teams for Meta Ads and Google Ads performance.
Analyze campaign performance across the customer funnel and recommend actions to improve conversions and customer acquisition.
Identify opportunities to improve traffic quality, customer acquisition efficiency, and website conversion.
6. Cross-functional Coordination 
Work closely with E-commerce, Quick Commerce, Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, and Creative teams.
Coordinate inventory planning and replenishment requirements to ensure advertising campaigns are supported by adequate stock.
Flag potential stock-outs, pricing issues, listing problems, and other factors affecting campaign performance.
Collaborate with external agencies and marketplace account managers to achieve business objectives.
Required Skills & Qualifications 
25 years of relevant experience in performance marketing, e-commerce advertising, or marketplace growth.
Hands-on experience managing Amazon Ads or marketplace advertising campaigns.
Practical experience with at least one Quick Commerce platform: Blinkit, Zepto, or Swiggy Instamart.
Strong knowledge of ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CAC, AOV, and conversion rate (CVR).
Excellent analytical skills with strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
Ability to analyze SKU-level data and connect advertising performance with inventory availability, pricing, and sales.
Experience in budget planning, forecasting, performance tracking, and dashboard creation.
Working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads.
Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
Preferred Qualifications 
Experience in beauty, FMCG, personal care, or consumer brands.
Exposure to Flipkart Ads and multiple Quick Commerce platforms.
Experience coordinating purchase orders, inventory planning, and replenishment.
Familiarity with Power BI, Looker, or other reporting and visualization tools.
Experience managing external marketing agencies and platform account managers.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
Marketplace and Quick Commerce sales growth.
Advertising efficiency and return on ad spend (ROAS).
ACOS, TACOS, and customer acquisition cost.
SKU-level campaign performance and conversion rates.
Advertising budget utilization and forecast accuracy.
Product availability and inventory-aligned advertising spends.
Achievement of monthly sales and advertising performance targets.

We are looking for an experienced Sr. Manager / Manager - Digital Marketing who will act as the central point of coordination between internal stakeholders and multiple outsourced digital marketing agencies. Act as the primary point of contact for all outsourced digital marketing agencies
Coordinate campaigns, timelines, deliverables, and budgets across agencies
Ensure agencies are aligned with business goals, brand guidelines, and marketing strategy
Review agency reports, validate performance metrics, and provide feedback

Prepare consolidated performance reports for management
Use data insights to improve marketing effectiveness and decision-making

Coordinate with sales, product, and design teams for campaign alignment
Ensure lead flow, quality, and conversion processes are optimized

Required Skills & Qualifications 
Must-Have Skills 
Strong knowledge of Performance Marketing / Paid Ads (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, etc.)
Experience managing and coordinating external digital marketing agencies 
Solid understanding of SEO, social media marketing, content marketing, and email marketing
Strong analytical skills and data-driven mindset
Technical & Tools Knowledge 
Google Analytics / GA4
Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager
CRM and lead tracking systems (preferred)
Excel / Google Sheets for reporting and analysis

title: Performance Marketing  Executive
description:
Job Title: Performance marketing Executive
Location: Civil Lines , Jaipur 

Company Description 
Trumpet Media is a results-driven digital marketing and web development agency with a strong presence in Jaipur and Bangalore. We specialize in crafting high-impact websites and executing comprehensive 360 marketing strategies tailored to the unique needs of D2C brands. With a proven track record of driving growth for influential clients like Uber, Swiggy and big designer labels, our team is dedicated to enhancing brand visibility, optimizing customer journeys, and boosting sales through data-driven creativity and innovation.

Role Description 
The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating and executing performance marketing strategy to handle assigned D2C brands. You will lead our marketing campaigns, evaluate our marketing performance metrics, and collaborate with internal teams. You will have a strong marketing background with excellent communication skills and attention to detail.

Responsibilities 

Analytical & Data 
Data analysis Ability to interpret campaign data, spot patterns, and draw actionable insights.
ROI tracking & attribution modeling – Understanding where conversions come from and which channels drive the most value.
Excel/Google Sheets proficiency – For data manipulation, reporting, and forecasting.
Channel Expertise 
Google Ads – Mastery in keyword targeting, bidding strategies, ad copywriting, and Quality Score optimization.
Meta– Knowing how to build audiences, structure campaigns, test creatives, and scale ad sets
Email & CRM marketing – Understanding how to drive retention through automated campaigns.

Performance Strategy 
Full-funnel strategy – Knowing how to design campaigns for awareness, consideration, and conversion stages.
Media planning & budgeting – Allocating budgets across platforms to meet CPA, ROAS, and other KPIs.
Audience segmentation – Creating precise target groups using behavior, demographics, and intent.
Technical & Tool Skills 
Ad platforms – Deep knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager
Competition tools – Meta Ads library, Google Ads library etc
Tag management – Experience with GTM (Google Tag Manager), pixel setup, and event tracking.
Creative Collaboration 
Briefing creative teams – Writing clear performance-based briefs for video, static, and UGC content.
Understanding ad psychology – Knowing what kind of messaging, visuals, and hooks work for direct response.
Feedback loops – Communicating insights back to the creative team for ongoing optimization.

Communication & Reporting 
Client/stakeholder communication – Translating numbers into understandable takeaways.
Dashboard creation – Building reports in Sheets,Looker, or similar tools to showcase performance.
Crisis handling – Knowing what to do when campaigns underperform (pivoting strategies quickly).
Required Skills & Qualifications 
Agency experience preferred
Ability to multi-task
Strong verbal, written, and organizational skills
What We Offer: 
Competitive salary + performance-based incentives.
Opportunity to work with a fast-growing agency and make a real impact.
Flexible work environment with opportunities for career growth.

title: Seo Executive
description:
About the Role 

LPT is looking for an SEO Executive with 2-5 years of hands-on experience in search engine optimization. The selected candidate will work on LPTs websites and help improve organic visibility, rankings, traffic, and content performance across multiple education-focused web properties.

The role requires strong knowledge of on-page SEO, technical SEO, guest blogging, keyword research, content optimization, and the emerging area of GEO, which focuses on improving visibility across AI search platforms and generative search experiences.

Key Responsibilities 
Work on SEO for LPTs websites to improve organic traffic, keyword rankings, and search visibility.
Conduct keyword research for blogs, web pages, category pages, and more.
Optimize website pages for meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal linking, schema, and content structure.
Perform on-page SEO audits and implement improvements across existing and new pages.
Coordinate with content writers to create SEO-friendly blogs and website content.
Handle guest blogging activities, including prospecting websites, outreach, content coordination, and link placement tracking.
Track keyword rankings, traffic trends, backlinks, and competitor SEO activities.
Identify new SEO opportunities for LPTs websites, blogs, and city/category/service pages.
Prepare regular SEO reports and share insights on growth, issues, and next steps.
Stay updated with Google algorithm updates, SEO trends, AI search changes, and best practices.

Required Skills 
2-5 years of practical SEO experience.
Good understanding of on-page SEO, technical SEO, off-page SEO, and content SEO.
Experience with guest posting, blogger outreach, and backlink-building activities.
Basic understanding of HTML, website structure, CMS platforms, and SEO-friendly page formatting.
Working knowledge of Google Search Console, Google Analytics, keyword research tools, and SEO audit tools.
Ability to analyze rankings, traffic, indexing issues, and page-level SEO performance.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Ability to work with content, design, and development teams.
Interest in AI search, GEO, and the changing search landscape.

Who Should Apply? 
This role is suitable for candidates who have hands-on SEO experience and want to work on high-growth education websites. The ideal candidate should be proactive, detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable working in a fast-paced onsite environment.

description:
React Native Developer iOS & Android 

Alcogi Software Pvt Ltd is looking for a React Native Developer to join our Kochi development hub. Work on exciting mobile applications for an established UK-based software company, alongside an experienced team of web, Windows, Android and QA professionals.

The role:

Familiarity with REST APIs, version control & mobile app testing.

Competitive salary based on experience.
Collaborate with experienced developers across the UK, Europe and India.
Opportunities for learning, growth and career progression.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer 
Location: India – Remote
Experience: 5+ years
Employment Type: Full time and Remote
Immediate

Role Overview 
We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with strong hands-on experience in MLOps, production ML systems, PySpark, and Databricks.
The role is focused more on deploying, operationalizing, monitoring, and maintaining ML/DL models in production than on pure research or model development.

Key Responsibilities 
Design, deploy, and operationalize Machine Learning and Deep Learning models in production.
Build and maintain end-to-end MLOps workflows, covering model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, versioning, and retraining.
Develop scalable data and ML pipelines using PySpark and Databricks.
Productionize Deep Learning models and support scalable model inference.
Work with multimodal data, combining Computer Vision, textual data, metadata, and other signals to build ML solutions.
Implement model monitoring, performance tracking, drift detection, experiment tracking, and lifecycle management.
Work with cloud-based ML infrastructure and deployment platforms.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Data Engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver production-ready ML solutions.
Ensure ML systems are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and suitable for production environments.

Mandatory Skills 
5+ years of experience in Machine Learning / ML Engineering.
Strong hands-on MLOps and production ML deployment experience.
PySpark – mandatory.
Databricks – mandatory.
Experience deploying Deep Learning models into production.
Strong understanding of the end-to-end MLOps lifecycle.
Experience working with Computer Vision + textual data + metadata or other multimodal data.
Experience with at least one cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Strong Python programming skills.

Good to Have 
Strong understanding of Deep Learning architectures.
Experience building Deep Learning models using PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Experience with Generative AI / RAG.
Understanding and practical experience with embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
Experience with MLflow or similar ML lifecycle/experiment tracking tools.
Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, model serving, or ML monitoring platforms.

What We're Looking For 
The ideal candidate is someone who can take an ML/DL solution beyond experimentation and make it production-ready — including deployment, monitoring, scaling, versioning, and ongoing lifecycle management.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities: 
To design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable multi-cloud infrastructure to support our engineering and operational workloads.

Key Responsibilities
- Infrastructure Design & Delivery: Design, deploy, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance cloud environments across AWS, Azure, OCI, and GCP. Build resilient architectures for highly available production workloads.
- Infrastructure as Code & Automation: Standardize and automate infrastructure provisioning using tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
- Cross-Cloud Security: Implement consistent security controls, including IAM policies, encryption, and network security configurations, in adherence to organizational standards.
- Operational Excellence: Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues while optimizing performance, availability, and cost across all cloud platforms.
Requirements
- Hands-on experience with at least two of the following: Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, or GCP.
- Proven experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Terraform).
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
- Strong understanding of Linux and Windows system administration.
- Knowledge of networking concepts, including VPNs, hybrid connectivity, routing, and firewall policies.
- Solid understanding of cloud security best practices, including identity management and network hardening.

Preferred candidate profile: 
Experienced Cloud Engineer with a minimum of two years of hands-on experience in design, implementation and maintain secure, scalable multi-cloud infrastructure.

Hands-on with tape-out gating, signoff criteria and the foundry/OSAT interface (masks, packaging, test).
Proven effort estimation, budget tracking and risk management on fixed-price or T&M turnkey engagements.
Confident, customer-facing communicator who can hold senior technical and business conversations.
Proficiency with Jira, MS Project or equivalent planning tools.
Good to Have 
PMP / PgMP certification
Experience with advanced nodes or multi-die / chiplet programs
Exposure to post-silicon validation and production ramp
Preferred candidate profile 

Perks and benefits

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Role & responsibilities 

1. Data Discovery: Identify the SAP tables and fields used for existing Data Quality(DQ) rules & reports and locate the corresponding data in Databricks
Data Validation: Validate data across all the layers(bronze, silver,etc) in Databricks for completeness, structure and availability of required fields
DQ Rule Migration & BUILD: Select and build a set of existing DQ rules in Databricks as part of the PoC
PoC Testing & Reconciliation: Execute the rules in Databricks and compare results with the existing DQ results, investigating and resolving differences
End-to-End Rule Migration: Following the PoC, migrate / BUILD the agreed As-Is DQ rules to data bricks, including SQL logic, data mappings, rule outputs and required transformations
Data & Rule Validation: Perform end-to-end validation of source data, DQ rules, results and defects in Databricks to ensure the migrated process produces expected outcomes
DQ Reporting: Support the development of DQ outputs, KPIs and dashboard reporting from Databricks, including validation of report results
Documentation & BAU Handover: Document data mappings, DQ rules, validation results and migration processes

SQL & Pyspark/Python knowledge
Experience in Data Quality / Data Validation.
Experience working with SAP data, preferably master data
Good understanding of SAP tables
Experience with Databricks platform
Experience in data reconciliation and comparison between different data sources.
Ability to translate DQ requirements/rules into technical SQL or Python logic
Experience in DQ rule testing, defect analysis and troubleshooting

title: Data Scientist Machine Learning & Applied Analytics.
description:
Role & responsibilities 

Translate product and customer problems into well-defined analytics and ML use cases. 
Perform data exploration, feature engineering, statistical analysis and experimentation. 
Develop, train, validate and optimize machine learning and predictive models. 
Define appropriate model performance metrics, benchmarks and acceptance criteria. 
Convert prototypes and experiments into scalable, production-ready capabilities. 
Work with Product, Architecture and Engineering teams to integrate models and analytics into SaaS products and platforms. 
Model Evaluation & Productization 
Evaluate models and analytical solutions developed by internal teams, technology partners and specialist solution providers. 
Assess model assumptions, data requirements, accuracy, robustness, explainability and limitations. 
Benchmark alternative models/approaches and provide evidence-based recommendations. 
Establish practices for model versioning, validation, monitoring, drift detection and continuous improvement. 
Ensure that externally sourced models can be effectively integrated, governed and evolved within the product. 

Preferred candidate profile 

5-8 years of relevant experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Analytics or related roles. 
Experience building ML/analytics capabilities that have been deployed into production products or platforms. 
Experience working with automotive, mobility, connected vehicle, battery/EV, IoT or industrial datasets is desirable but not mandatory. 
Experience collaborating with technology partners, research organizations or academic institutions is an advantage. 
Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related quantitative discipline preferred.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Senior Data Analyst 
InPrime Finserv | Bangalore | Full-time | Hybrid 3 days/week in office
3+ years experience | Reports to AVP, Data Science & Analytics

About the role 
You will be the analyst the business, product and credit teams come to when they need a number they can act on.
We are launching a new consumer app, and you will be the analyst on it from before day one — defining what we measure, making sure it gets instrumented, and telling us honestly how the launch is going. Alongside that you will own the business and portfolio reporting layer for our existing lending book.
Reporting is part of this job — you will own the dashboards the business runs on. But you are not a request queue. You will own analyses end to end — question, data, method, conclusion, recommendation — and be expected to explain and stand behind your conclusions with senior leadership and the founders.
You will report to the AVP, Data Science & Analytics and sit on a team of four data scientists and analysts. No layers in between: the person setting the analytics agenda is the person you work with directly.

What you'll own 
Business analytics: the lead-to-disbursement funnel with stage-wise drop-offs and turnaround times, branch and RM productivity, disbursement mix, yield, portfolio composition and operational bottlenecks.
Product analytics for a new consumer app: we are building a consumer app and you will own its analytics from the ground up. Define the event taxonomy and the metrics that matter before launch, work with engineering to get the instrumentation right the first time rather than retrofitting it, build the acquisition-to-activation funnel from day one, and measure what actually happens after release — adoption, drop-off, retention, and whether each subsequent change moved anything. Very few analysts get to design a product's measurement layer from scratch; this is that job.
Experimentation & impact measurement: determine whether product, process and policy changes actually worked, using appropriate cohorts, holdouts, matched comparisons or statistical tests. Define success metrics before launch, not after.
Analytical data models: design fact/dimension tables, funnel and journey models, loan-level daily panels and analytical marts. You own the analytical design — grain, keys, dimensions and metric logic — and partner with data engineering on upstream data and productionisation.
Self-serve reporting: build durable, documented dashboards in QuickSight and Superset backed by certified datasets and consistent metric definitions.
Portfolio and risk reporting: the credit team's recurring view of the book — vintage and cohort curves, DPD migration, bounce and collection efficiency, approval rates and segment-level trends. You will own the reporting layer for this and partner with the data scientists on the deeper risk modelling. You do not need prior credit risk experience; you do need to be willing to learn the domain properly, because every metric here has a regulatory definition behind it.
Data quality: notice when a number looks wrong, trace it to source and get the underlying issue fixed rather than patching individual queries.

Data agent semantic layer 
We have built an internal LLM-based data agent so the business can self-serve ad-hoc questions. You will own the analytical layer it reasons over — certified datasets, valid join paths, metric definitions and business terminology — test it against real questions, investigate wrong answers and improve the underlying semantics.
You do not need prior LLM experience. We would rather hire strong analytical judgement and teach the LLM side.

Your first six months 
The scope above is broad by design, and we have a view on sequence:
1. Own the consumer app's measurement layer through launch — event taxonomy, instrumentation review with engineering, the funnel and retention views leadership will watch daily, and an honest post-launch read.
2. Own the business and funnel reporting layer for the lending book — lead-to-disbursement funnel, drop-offs and TATs, branch and RM productivity, disbursement mix.
3. Build the measurement discipline. Every meaningful product or process change gets a defined success metric before launch and an honest read after.
4. Take on the portfolio and risk reporting layer, and the data agent's semantic layer — certified datasets, consistent definitions, and a shrinking ad-hoc queue.
Deeper risk and credit policy analytics build from there, alongside the data scientists. We will revisit this with you in the first month rather than hand it down.

What you need 
3+ years in analytics — fintech, lending, consumer internet, marketplace or e-commerce. Lending experience is a plus, not a requirement.
Advanced SQL: window functions, complex CTEs, temporal logic, cohorts and longitudinal/panel data.
Funnel and cohort analytics done properly: you have found where users drop, quantified it, and had something change as a result.
Event instrumentation: you have defined an event taxonomy and worked with engineers to get it implemented — or can convincingly show how you would. Analysts who have only consumed someone else's events will find the app work hard.
Experimentation: you can design an A/B test or quasi-experiment, define the success metric up front, and read the result honestly — including when it says the change did nothing.
Dimensional modelling: grain, fact/dimension tables, surrogate keys, slowly changing dimensions and additivity.
Python for analysis: pandas, numpy and basic statsmodels/sklearn.
Strong experience with a BI tool. We use QuickSight and Superset; Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Metabase etc. transfer fine.
Statistical judgement: cohort maturity, confidence intervals, mix effects, and why before/after movement alone does not establish impact.
Rigour about definitions and clarity in writing. You should be irritated by two dashboards showing different numbers for the same metric and fix it at the definition, not in the query. And you should be able to take a loosely defined business question, turn it into a testable one, and write up the answer in a page.

Nice to have 
Product analytics tooling — Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, Firebase
Having analysed a consumer app through its first year
Lending funnel, collections or bureau data experience
AWS analytics stack — Athena, Glue, S3, Bedrock
dbt or similar transformation frameworks
Semantic/metric-layer experience
Credit risk exposure — DPD, vintage, roll rates, scorecards, ECL / Ind AS 109

How we work 
Small team, high autonomy, low process overhead. Based in Bangalore, 3 days per week from office. You will work directly with credit, product, engineering, compliance and the founders, and day to day with the data scientists on the team.
Your analysis will change what gets shipped — which means we would rather you take an extra day and be right than ship fast and be wrong.

title: Senior Financial Data Analyst
description:
Skills and Competencies 
0-1 years experience in credit/financial data analysis and interpretation with knowledge of capital markets; experience in structured finance will be an added advantage
Skilled in identifying key credit risk factors and applying relevant credit methodologies to support analysis and decision-making.
Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
Detail-oriented and well-organized, with a proven ability to excel in team-driven environments.
Basic understanding of AI concepts (Generative AI tools and Agentic AI systems), with curiosity and enthusiasm for learning how AI tools can be used to improve processes and drive efficiency leveraging these technologies for research, analysis, or workflow optimization. Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use.
Experience with data science and analytics tools like Python, Power BI, and Alteryx is advantageous along with proficiency in handling large datasets, ensuring data integrity, and applying best practices in data analysis
Education 
Masters’ degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics from or qualified CA
CFA/FRM certification is preferred.
Responsibilities 
Independently manage routine deliverables such as portfolio review preparation, credit opinions, and outreach materials, while contributing to process improvement initiatives.
Apply Moody’s ratings methodologies to create adjusted data, key indicators, ratios, charts, and graphs that enhance ratings and research accuracy.
Perform data intake, scrubbing, and validation to ensure accuracy and readiness for research and ratings processes.
Analyze financial reports, official statements, and related documents to assess issuer performance and creditworthiness. Partner with analysts and accounting specialists to apply relevant accounting concepts and capture accurate data for ratings.
Provide direction and resolve queries for junior team members to ensure quality and efficiency in deliverables.

title: Senior DATA Scientist- Remote
description:
Role & responsibilities 

REMOTE JOB ROLE 

IMMEDIATE INTERVIEWS 

Job Summary: 
Client is seeking a visionary and highly experienced Senior Data Scientist to lead our most critical analytical initiatives. In this strategic role, you will be a thought leader, responsible for architecting innovative data science solutions that solve complex healthcare challenges and drive the company's long-term vision. You will mentor a talented team, set technical direction, and translate ambiguous business problems into tangible, high-impact machine learning systems. This position is ideal for a seasoned expert who is passionate about using data to revolutionize the healthcare industry.

Key Responsibilities: 
Lead the end-to-end design, development, and deployment of advanced machine learning models and AI-driven products that deliver significant business value.
Act as the technical lead on complex data science projects, defining the roadmap, setting priorities, and ensuring the scientific rigor of the team's work.
Architect and implement scalable, production-ready data science pipelines and MLOps frameworks in collaboration with engineering teams.
Serve as a primary consultant to executive leadership and business stakeholders, translating complex data insights into strategic recommendations.
Mentor and develop other data scientists and engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous technical growth.
Pioneer the adoption of new technologies, methodologies, and best practices in data science and machine learning across the organization.
Stay at the forefront of AI/ML and healthcare technology trends to identify new opportunities for innovation and competitive advantage.
Document methodologies, processes, and results to ensure transparency and reproducibility.
Adhere to data privacy and security standards, including HIPAA regulations, in all data handling activities.

Required Knowledge: 
Expert-level understanding of a broad range of machine learning techniques, including deep learning (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, Transformers), NLP, reinforcement learning, and causal inference. 
Deep knowledge of MLOps best practices, including model lifecycle management, CI/CD for machine learning, model monitoring, and governance. 
Comprehensive understanding of cloud architecture and services (GCP, AWS, or Azure) for building scalable AI/ML solutions. 
Expertise in healthcare data domains, including clinical data (EHR/EMR), claims, pharmacy, and familiarity with standards like HL7/FHIR, ICD, and CPT. 
Strong theoretical foundation in statistics, mathematics, and computer science. 

Required Skills: 
Mastery of Python and its data science ecosystem (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, MLflow). 
Exceptional SQL and data modeling skills, with the ability to work with complex, multi-source data environments. 
Proven experience in designing and building solutions on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud's Vertex AI, AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning). 
Proficiency with big data technologies such as BigQuery. 
Superior ability to communicate and present complex technical concepts and results to executive-level audiences. 

Preferred candidate profile 

Perks and benefits

title: Senior Data Scientist (AWS Bedrock, Agentic AI,  LLMs , Databricks )
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Scientist Agentic AI 

Experience: 6 to 8 Years
Location: 100% Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary 
We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist Agentic AI with strong expertise in Python, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs and Multi-Agent AI systems.
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in designing, developing and deploying production-grade Agentic AI applications, RAG pipelines and intelligent automation solutions. The candidate should be proficient in LangGraph, LangChain, MCP, Databricks and AWS Bedrock, with a strong understanding of traditional Machine Learning, model development and MLOps.

Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop and deploy production-grade Agentic AI and multi-agent applications using LangGraph, LangChain or similar frameworks.
Build autonomous AI workflows with tool calling, agent orchestration, memory management, state management and human-in-the-loop capabilities.
Develop and implement MCP servers and clients to integrate AI agents with external tools, APIs and enterprise applications.
Design and optimise RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, reranking and document processing.
Work with AWS Bedrock Agents, Knowledge Bases and Guardrails to build secure and scalable GenAI solutions.
Develop and manage data and AI workflows using Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, MLflow and Unity Catalog.
Implement Databricks Vector Search, Model Serving, Apps and Workflows for production AI applications.
Perform LLM evaluation, prompt engineering, hallucination detection, observability and performance optimisation.
Work on LLM fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA and PEFT.
Develop traditional Machine Learning and Deep Learning models, including classification, regression, forecasting and NLP solutions.
Implement end-to-end MLOps pipelines covering model training, validation, deployment, monitoring and retraining.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

Required Skills & Experience 
6 to 8 years of overall experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, AI or related domains.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
Strong programming experience in Python and SQL.
Hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain and Multi-Agent AI architectures.
Practical experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol).
Strong knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases and LLM evaluation.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, MLflow and Unity Catalog.
Experience with AWS Bedrock, including Agents, Knowledge Bases and Guardrails.
Understanding of LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT and LLM fine-tuning.
Strong foundation in traditional Machine Learning, statistical modelling and model evaluation.
Experience with MLOps, CI/CD, model deployment and production monitoring.

Good to Have 
Experience in manufacturing, automotive, industrial or supply chain domains.
Exposure to Computer Vision, NLP and Deep Learning.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, FastAPI and REST APIs.
Knowledge of AI governance, security, responsible AI and enterprise-scale deployments.

Mandatory Technical Skills 
Python | LangGraph | MCP | Databricks | AWS Bedrock

Important: Candidates must have hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade Agentic AI solutions, not just theoretical knowledge or certification exposure.

This role involves collaborating with development and operations teams to implement DevOps practices, automate processes, manage Kubernetes environments, and maintain infrastructure that supports our applications and services.

Senior Systems Engineer 
Rapidly growing startup in the health sector and great founding team to work with. We are building the best healthcare startup in the ecosystem to provide affordable medicine by optimizing supply chain and logistics that are based on highly personalized experience. We are funded by best-in-class VCs.

Roles & Responsibilities 
Design, create, own, and maintain systems and service deployments in cloud and container architecture (AWS, Kubernetes)
Continuously improve CI/CD & infrastructure for better reliability, observability, performance & scalability
Contributing to important architectural and operational decisions like deployment techniques, monitoring, automation, forming best practices policies, etc.
Work closely with engineering leaders and architects from multiple teams
Leading incident response and postmortems
Develop Infrastructure-as-code artifacts for re-use across the environments
Ensure availability, performance, security, and scalability of production systems

Engineering graduate with 2 - 5 years of experience as a DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer

title: Senior DevOps Engineer  CI/CD & Infrastructure as Code
description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience in CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools, along with hands-on experience managing cloud environments on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
You will be responsible for designing and maintaining automated deployment pipelines, managing scalable infrastructure, improving deployment reliability, and implementing DevSecOps best practices.
Key Responsibilities
CI/CD & Automation 
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
Automate build, testing, security scanning, and deployment processes.
Implement deployment strategies such as Blue-Green, Canary, and Rolling deployments.
Manage artifact repositories and container registries.
Improve pipeline performance and deployment reliability.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) 
Provision and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform.
Develop reusable and modular Terraform configurations.
Manage Terraform state, remote backends, and multi-environment infrastructure.
Automate infrastructure configuration using Ansible or similar tools.
Implement infrastructure validation, drift detection, and policy-as-code.
Cloud & Containerization 
Manage cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Build and manage Docker containers and Kubernetes clusters.
Work with Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS, or GKE.
Manage application deployments using Helm or Kustomize.
Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or CloudWatch.
Security & Operations 
Implement DevSecOps practices and security checks in CI/CD pipelines.
Manage secrets using Vault or cloud-based secrets management services.
Monitor infrastructure performance and troubleshoot production issues.
Participate in incident management and root cause analysis.
Optimize cloud infrastructure costs and resource utilization.
Required Skills
5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, SRE, or Platform Engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps).
Expert-level experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
Strong experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Knowledge of Ansible or other configuration management tools.
Scripting experience in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
Good understanding of Linux administration, networking, DNS, load balancing, and security.
Strong knowledge of Git and version control practices.
Good to Have
Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
Knowledge of Helm, Kustomize, and service mesh technologies.
Experience with DevSecOps, security scanning, and policy-as-code.
Relevant certifications such as AWS DevOps Professional, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Terraform Associate, or CKA.
Knowledge of SRE practices and DORA metrics.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.
Strong automation mindset and willingness to improve existing processes.
Ability to mentor junior team members and maintain technical documentation.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Role Overview 

The role reports into the UK and involves regular collaboration with UK-based stakeholders and teams across OCU Digital.

The Senior DevOps Engineer is responsible for the design, governance and continuous improvement of DevOps and application reliability across OCU Digital, ensuring digital platforms are built, secured, deployed and operated efficiently, consistently and resiliently across all environments.

Working across OCU One, Data and Dynamics, the role sets and governs standards for CI/CD, build and release security, deployment automation, runtime configuration, observability and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), bridging Engineering, Cloud & Infrastructure, Security and Architecture.

Key Responsibilities 

1. DevOps Tooling, Boards & Governance 
Own and govern the DevOps tooling landscape, with explicit accountability for Azure DevOps configuration and administration.
Define and govern Azure DevOps Boards work item types, process templates and lifecycle models (e.g. Requirements, Change Requests, Work Requests, Bugs and Tasks).
Own state models, mandatory fields, validation rules and workflow controls to ensure consistency, auditability and traceability.
Ensure consistent usage of DevOps Boards across Digital platforms to support change control, compliance and reporting requirements.
Maintain end-to-end traceability from demand intake through delivery, deployment and release.

2. DevOps & CI/CD Standards and Governance 
Define, own and continuously evolve CI/CD standards, templates and reusable pipeline patterns.
Govern how build, test, security scanning, deployment and rollback stages are implemented across platforms.
Enforce secure build and release practices aligned with security and architecture standards.
Own the operation of CI/CD pipelines, ensuring reliability, performance and rapid recovery from failure.
Provide clear guidance and decision-making on CI/CD tooling, patterns and usage.

3. Deployment, Environment & Release Management 
Define standardised deployment and release models, including automated releases and rollback mechanisms.
Manage environment strategies across development, test, QA and production environments.
Govern access control and environment permissions in collaboration with Cloud & Infrastructure and Security.
Ensure release processes are auditable, predictable and aligned to risk and change controls.
Support platform teams during complex or high-risk releases.

4. Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) & Performance Systems 
Design and govern the application-layer SRE monitoring and performance management system.
Define and manage service reliability standards including SLIs, SLOs and error budgets.
Build and standardise monitoring and observability dashboards covering availability, latency, errors and saturation.
Lead reliability activities such as fault injection, resilience testing and reliability drills.
Proactively identify reliability risks and drive preventative engineering improvements.

5. Observability, Incident Management & Operational Excellence 
Own the observability strategy, ensuring consistent use of metrics, logs and traces across platforms.
Resolve major platform and application incidents, acting as incident commander when required.
Ensure runbooks, handover packages and operational documentation are prepared and maintained.
Lead post-incident reviews and ensure corrective actions are delivered and tracked.
Improve operational maturity through standardised documentation, runbooks and operational tooling.

Key Skills & Experience 

Essential Skills 
Extensive hands-on experience in DevOps and SRE practices in complex, multi-platform environments.
Strong expertise in CI/CD tooling including Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.
Proven experience defining CI/CD standards, templates and secure build pipelines.
Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, Kubernetes and application runtime configuration.
Strong background in SRE concepts including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and reliability governance.
Experience designing monitoring, observability and performance management systems.
Proven ability to lead and resolve high-severity platform incidents.
Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional working.
Experience producing high-quality technical documentation and runbooks.

Desirable Skills 
Experience operating DevOps and SRE across custom applications, data platforms and SaaS environments.
Familiarity with ISO27001, SOC2 or similar enterprise governance frameworks.
Experience implementing DevSecOps controls and secure supply-chain practices.
Experience running resilience testing, chaos engineering or fault injection exercises.
Knowledge of Azure Fabric, Databricks or modern data platforms.
Experience supporting business-critical or safety-sensitive systems.
Track record of building and scaling DevOps capabilities in growing organisations.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
he second resource should be a senior engineer with deep practical experience in:
Terraform and reusable module development
GitHub and GitHub Actions
CI/CD for Azure infrastructure deployments
Reusable GitHub Actions workflows
Terraform testing and validation
GitHub repository and branching strategy
GitHub release strategy
Versioning and lifecycle management of GitHub Actions and reusable workflows
Automated Azure infrastructure deployments
Secure GitHub-to-Azure authentication and authorization
Appropriate handling of secrets, identities, and credentials
Designing controlled deployment patterns that allow developers to consume approved infrastructure automation without allowing them to introduce or execute their own Terraform modules or configuration outside the established framework 
A major part of what we want to design is a model where developers have appropriate flexibility within sandbox environments, but infrastructure outside of sandbox is deployed through controlled GitHub Actions using standardized Terraform code and approved modules . We want this resource to help us design the GitHub security, release, versioning, and deployment model necessary to enforce that approach.
Engagement expectations 
Both resources should be senior, hands-on engineers , not resources who primarily provide architectural guidance without doing the implementation. We expect them to participate directly in the design and development of the platform.
Our team will help define and prioritize sprint items, and we intend to have daily standups with the resources to maintain alignment and quickly address blockers and design decisions.
Just as importantly, we want knowledge transfer to be continuous throughout the engagement . We want our engineers working with these resources, participating in design decisions and code reviews, and understanding the rationale behind the Terraform, Azure, and GitHub patterns being established.
At the end of the engagement, the objective is to have a standardized Azure Landing Zone framework, reusable Terraform, a secure and repeatable GitHub Actions deployment model, and an internal team that fully understands and can own, support, and extend what has been built. Role & responsibilities

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Sr. Product Manager 
Hyderabad/Bangalore (Hybrid)
Experience level: 7+yrs
Proven enterprise SaaS, CX, or decisioning platform PM experience must have; Tier 1-2 educational background preferred 

What You'll Do 
As Product Manager for CX Apps , you will own the strategy and execution for Teradata's real-time decisioning and campaign management capabilities, leading the transition of VCX and CIM from standalone enterprise applications into the decisioning and execution layer of a unified agentic CX platform. You will work directly with engineering, field, architecture, and customers to close the adoption and reference gap against competition and deliver agentic experiences that prove the platform's value at scale.
You Will:
Lead product strategy and roadmap for VCX and CIM , driving their evolution from legacy standalone apps into the Campaign Strategy and Real-Time Decisioning agents at the core of Teradata's agentic CX platform.
Define agent architectures built on MCP and Vantage , with explicit go/no-go gates tied to conversion lift, setup time reduction, and real-time adoption growth across enterprise accounts.
Own competitive positioning , building the proof point program, arming field and COE teams.
Act as the connective tissue between engineering, field, and architecture , translating customer requirements into prioritized roadmap decisions while holding the integration contract with the data foundation layer.
Present product vision and investment asks to senior leadership , framing architectural tradeoffs, adoption risks, and platform sequencing in materials that inform decisions, not just report status.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate 
7+ years of product management experience with enterprise SaaS, CX, or decisioning platforms.
Hands-on experience with or strong understanding of real-time decisioning, campaign management, or customer engagement platforms (e.g., Pega CDH, Hightouch, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe).
Familiarity with agentic AI architectures , MCP-based tooling, and orchestration frameworks.
Demonstrated ability to engage technical customers , field teams, and architects to drive adoption and build references.
Strong executive communication skills , able to frame strategy, tradeoffs, and investment asks in crisp written and verbal form.

What You'll Bring 
A clear point of view on how agentic AI reshapes enterprise CX, from episodic campaign management to always-on, decision-centric customer engagement.
Comfort operating across legacy sustaining, active engineering transition, and field enablement simultaneously.
Proven ability to translate customer pain into prioritized roadmap decisions and ship with urgency.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About the Role: 
As a Senior Product Manager, you will play a pivotal role in shaping best in class journeys that are best for our customers in India's complex logistics ecosystem. That can be hard, but we refuse to settle, given we are a customer-obsessed company. We are committed to figuring out what matters to our customers and then doing everything in our power to deliver it. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager passionate about solving customer problems and has demonstrated success working backwards from ambiguous customer needs, translating them into disruptive, successful products that delight customers. In this role, you will be defining strategy/product vision through feature definition, prioritization, positioning, naming, go-to-market/adoption and P&L. You will put to use best-of-breed technologies and design thinking to accomplish this at a scale that has never been done before in the logistics industry.

Key responsibilities: 
Own the entire product life cycle for products at Freight Tiger from inception to strategic planning, delivery to live launch, post-launch tracking and ongoing product management, enhancement, and development.
Work closely with internal stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Customer Support and Sales to deeply understand and address product needs. 
Work with customers and the leadership team to understand the customers needs and define solutions in line with the business strategy.
Proactively identify and resolve strategic issues that may impair the teams ability to meet strategic, financial and technical goals.
Define and track metrics that measure the success of your product/features, including adoption and growth.
Manage regular communications with customers to understand their needs closely. 

Key Competencies for the Role: 
Conceptualize new business initiatives by working with business stakeholders and creating business impact through effective planning, business analysis and operational data metrics, and driving execution with operations and technology teams.
Create product specification documents and conduct product specification reviews with key stakeholders.
Analyze product metrics regularly and use the learning for product innovations and improvements.

Preferred qualifications: 
B. Tech /B.E. in any stream, and preferably MBA from a Tier-1 institute (but not essential).
At least 7+ years of overall experience, preferably in a B2B start-up.
Passion for technology and tracking developments in the tech/logistics industry.
Self-driven, comfortable with a fast-paced, always-on, highly ambiguous environment.
Strong influence and cross-functional collaboration skills; able to craft clarity and drive focus in complex and dynamic contexts.
High problem solving and customer-centric mindset.
Strong passion for data-driven decision making, i.e. extremely high focus on analytics.
You are technically tuned and business savvy to interact with all levels and disciplines within an organization, from engineers to senior leadership.
Able to communicate both the business and technical rationale behind product decisions.
Product user experience understanding and understanding of mobile is a plus.
Proven ability to mentor other Product Managers and lead teams.
Strong communication skills, skilled at cross-functional and cross-organizational communication.
Must be able to work independently and enjoy working in a fast-paced start-up environment.
