title: Senior Product Manager
description:
SEITO 
Product Manager 
5 to 10 years • Full time, in person • Bengaluru • Notice period within 30 days 
ABOUT SEITO 
Seito is building the AI OS for education. Universities run admissions, learning, exams, partner channels, support and finance on our 
stack, so a student's journey from the first ad click to the degree runs through software we build. We are a small team, every PM owns a 
product outright, and we ship every week. 
THE ROLE 
We're hiring a product manager who builds. You'll own one or more products on the Seito stack and take ideas from a rough concept to 
something running in production with our university partners. Most of the time you'll make the first working version yourself, test it with 
users, and then work with engineering to make it production-grade. This role suits someone who is more comfortable in a code editor than 
in a slide deck. 
WHAT YOU'LL DO 
Take ideas to production. Own the full path from problem definition to a live release: scoping, prototyping, building with engineering, 
launching and measuring. 
Prototype it yourself. Build working versions with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) before we commit engineering 
time. 
Ship AI features. Design conversational agents, workflow automation and LLM-powered tools for admissions and student support, 
including prompts, evaluations and fallbacks. 
Work closely with engineering. Write specs engineers can build from, review technical designs, and make trade-offs on architecture, 
scope and timelines. 
Stay close to users. Spend time every week with students, university staff and partners, and turn what you learn into product 
decisions. 
Own the numbers. Track adoption, conversion and retention for your products, and decide what to build next based on them. 
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 
A degree in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline. 
5 to 10 years of experience, with a significant part of it as a product manager who owned products end to end. 
A hands-on track record: you have built and shipped products yourself, not only managed their delivery. 
Active use of AI-assisted development ("vibe coding") to build real things, and the ability to demo it in the interview. 
Your own GitHub repositories with projects you built. We'll ask you to walk us through one. 
At least one product you took from concept to production. You should be able to explain what you built, the decisions you made, and 
the results. 
GOOD TO HAVE 
Experience in ed-tech: admissions, learning platforms, student journeys or university operations. 
An MBA alongside a computer science background. 
Startup experience in a small team. 
WHAT YOU GET 
Real ownership of products used by universities and students. 
A team that ships weekly, so your work goes live quickly. 
The AI tools you need from day one. 
Competitive salary. 
HOW TO APPLY 
Send your resume, your GitHub profile, and a link or short note about something you built recently.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
As a Lead Data Engineer , you will lead, design, implement, and maintain data processing pipelines and workflows using Databricks on the Azure platform. Your expertise in PySpark, SQL, Databricks, test-driven development, and Docker will be essential to the success of our data engineering initiatives.
Roles and responsibilities: 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and design scalable and efficient data processing solutions.
Develop and maintain data pipelines using PySpark and SQL on the Databricks platform.
Optimise and tune data processing jobs for performance and reliability.
Implement automated testing and monitoring processes to ensure data quality and reliability.
Work closely with data scientists, data analysts, and other stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide effective solutions.
Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues, including performance bottlenecks and data quality problems.
Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices in data engineering and Databricks.
Key Requirements: 
8+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, with a focus on Databricks and cloud-based data platforms, with a minimum of 4 years of experience in writing unit/end-to-end tests for data pipelines and ETL processes on Databricks.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer 

About ExaThought 
ExaThought is a technology consulting and digital transformation company delivering innovative solutions across cloud, data engineering, software development, and enterprise technology domains. We partner with global organizations to build scalable, secure, and high- performing technology platforms. At ExaThought, we foster a culture of continuous learning, technical excellence, collaboration, and innovation, enabling our teams to solve complex business challenges through cutting-edge technologies. 

Position Overview 
We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to design, implement, automate, and manage cloud-native infrastructure and deployment platforms. The ideal candidate will play a key role in building highly available, scalable, and secure environments while collaborating 
closely with development, architecture, and operations teams. 

Key Responsibilities 
Design, implement, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS. 
Build and maintain containerized platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, EKS, and ECS. 
Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform and CloudFormation. 
Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments. 
Monitor infrastructure and applications using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and related tools. 
Implement logging, monitoring, alerting, and incident management processes. 
Collaborate with development teams to streamline application deployment and release management. 
Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, networking, and deployment-related issues. 
Implement security best practices, access controls, and compliance standards. 
Drive infrastructure scalability, reliability, and cost optimization initiatives. 
Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures. 
Stay current with emerging DevOps technologies and cloud best practices. 

Required Skills & Experience 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering. 
Strong experience with AWS cloud services. 
Hands-on expertise in Kubernetes, EKS, ECS, and Docker. 
Strong experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices. 
Experience with CloudFormation and configuration management tools such as Ansible or Packer. 
Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, or similar languages. 
Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines. 
Knowledge of Linux administration and system troubleshooting. 
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms. 
Knowledge of SQL/PostgreSQL or other relational databases. 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities. 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

Preferred Qualifications 
AWS certifications. 
Experience with multi-account cloud environments. 
Exposure to security automation and DevSecOps practices. 
Experience working in enterprise-scale cloud environments. 

Employment Type - Full-Time Permanent 
Location - Bangalore (Hybrid)

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Who We Are: 
Gameberry Labs, a thriving mobile games studio established in 2017 and 
headquartered in Bangalore, has aimed for an extraordinary vision to become the premier game development company on a global scale. As a bootstrapped and profitable startup, Gameberry Labs has taken the mobile gaming scene by storm. Since our inception in 2017, our games 'Ludo STAR' and 'Parchisi STAR' have captivated players around the globe, resulting in an impressive 300M+ downloads. 

Our Belief: 
Our profound belief in the transformative ability of mobile games lies in their power to reshape modern connections, entertainment, and learning experiences. We see them as personal buddies that boost our brains, melt away stress, and keep spirits high - anytime, anywhere. 

Our Mission: 
We want to make millions of people happy with games that they would love to grow old with. We are driven by passion for creating exceptional gaming experiences that people will cherish for years to come. With our fearless team of dreamers and innovators we are constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the world of mobile gaming. 

Highlight Reel: 
We've rocked an impressive 300M+ game downloads. 
We have made $275M+ in lifetime revenue from our games. 
Both 'Parchisi STAR' and 'Ludo STAR' have hit 120M+ downloads individually. 
We were in the list of Top 10 India HQ Games Publishers in 2021. 
We have handled more than 1M+ concurrent users playing our game in 2020. 

Cool Tidbits: 
Our games attract a monthly player base equivalent to the population of Australia, with over 20M players engaging each month! 
Players spend an astronomical 297.6 Mars Round Trips worth of time on our games daily!!! 

Roles & Responsibilities 
We are looking for a strong Senior Product Manager to help scale Clubs from $28M to $100M in ARR. 
Clubs is a live, social product built inside Ludo Star and our other games. It brings people together through live voice, gifting, progression and competition. It is already at ~$28M ARR and growing protably. 
As we expand into new titles, Clubs is becoming the monetization engine across our games. This is a high ownership role where you take a core pillar and push it to the next level. 

As a Senior Product Manager on the Clubs team, you will: 
Get up to speed on the social product fast. Clubs has a lot of moving parts, and we want someone who climbs the learning curve quickly and starts making calls early. 
Own a quarterly pillar end to end. It could be a target metric, a new feature area, or launching Clubs inside a new game. You run it and you are accountable for the 
outcome. 
Analyze user data, player behavior, and market trends to identify problems and opportunities for feature enhancements, and new feature development. 
Possess deep product expertise, rst principles thinking and understanding core user motivations to shape the solutions. 
Balance monetization, engagement, and long term retention with good judgement. 
Live in the data. Spot trends, pull out insights, and turn them into clear next steps. 
Excellent communication skills with proven ability to convey complex messages clearly and with conviction to different stakeholders. 
Work closely with design, engineering, and analytics to influence decision making and ship right features. 
Keep an eye on players, competitors, and where the market is heading so you catch gaps and openings early. 

Requirements 
5 to 8 years in Product Management on a B2C consumer product. 
Comfortable with rst principles thinking and structured problem solving 
Very strong with data. You can dig into it, nd the signal, and decide what to do next. 
Good at working across teams and keeping stakeholders aligned. 
Able to own a large area on your own and drive it to a clear result. 

Bonus: 
Experience in social, gaming, or entertainment products. 

Your Adventure at Gameberry Labs: 
At Gameberry Labs, we're all about riding the wave of new trends, tech and building the best possible player experience that shapes the gaming universe. We strive to be at the forefront of casual game entertainment. When you join us, you're stepping into a place where your ideas count and your impact matters. We offer an autonomous studio setup that fosters fast decision-making, empowering you to make a signicant impact and accelerate your professional growth. 

Why Choose Us: 
Freedom to be you. 
Get in on a seriously competitive salary. 
Hungry? Enjoy free daily lunches. 
We've got your back with company-paid health insurance. 
Team fun? It's our thing! 
Opportunity knocks with limitless growth potential. 
We're making a global splash. 
Your playground: a studio that owns the P&L of its creations. 
Inspiring, down-to-earth teams are our secret sauce. 
Dive into challenges, learning, and growth at warp speed. 
We want to take India to the list of "Top 10 Gaming Studios" in the World. 

Ready to embark on this thrilling quest? Join us and let's create gaming history, one pixel at a time

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Job Title: Manager/Senior Manager - Digital Marketing (Male preffered) 
Location: Sarjapur road, Bangalore 
Interview Mode: face-face Interview Only 

Role Overview: 
We are looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing Technical Lead who sits at the meeting point of marketing and technology. You will run and optimize campaigns on Meta, Google, and other platforms, drive SEO and AI-search research, and build practical AI tools, including fine-tuned LLMs, for marketing and sales. You will also be a key hands-on contributor to Nambiar's in-house digital transformation.
This is a doing role: you'll build, test, and ship, not just plan.
Key Responsibilities: 
Performance Marketing
Plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across Meta (Facebook, Instagram), Google (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max, Demand Gen), LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
Manage campaign budgets with accountability for CPL, cost per site visit, and lead quality.
Set up and maintain tracking: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, and offline conversion uploads from CRM.
Run structured A/B tests on creatives, audiences, landing pages, and bidding strategies.
Coordinate with agencies and property portals on execution and lead quality.
SEO, AI Search & Research: 
Execute SEO across technical audits, on-page optimization, schema markup, site speed, local SEO (Google Business Profiles for each project), and content.
Research and implement AI-search optimization (GEO/AEO) so Nambiar appears in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
Conduct keyword, competitor, and buyer-intent research and turn findings into actionable recommendations.
AI & LLM Development: 
Build and deploy AI tools for marketing and sales, such as lead-qualification chatbots, WhatsApp assistants, and content-generation workflows.
Hands-on fine-tuning of LLMs (LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning) on Nambiar's project data, FAQs, and brand voice, plus RAG pipelines and prompt engineering.
Evaluate model output for accuracy and brand safety, and follow data privacy requirements (DPDP Act).
In-house Digital Transformation: Implement and integrate match tools: 
CRM (Salesforce / Lead Squared / Sell. Do or similar), marketing automation, WhatsApp Business API, and analytics dashboards.
Automate manual marketing and sales processes and help digitize customer journeys (virtual tours, online booking, customer portals).
Work closely with Sales, CRM, and IT teams to deliver digital projects.
Technical Leadership: 
Act as the go-to technical expert in the marketing team and guide junior executives and agency partners.
Prepare clear performance reports and dashboards for leadership.
Key Performance Indicators: 
Cost per qualified lead, lead-to-site-visit conversion, campaign ROAS, organic traffic and AI-search visibility, tracking accuracy, and successful delivery of AI and automation projects.
Required Qualifications & Skills: 
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, or a related field.
58 years of hands-on digital marketing experience, with strong expertise in Meta and Google Ads.
Solid technical SEO skills and familiarity with AI-search optimization.
Practical experience with LLMs: fine-tuning, RAG, prompt engineering, and APIs (Open AI, Anthropic, Google, or open-source models via Hugging Face).
Working knowledge of Python and SQL.
Strong command of GA4, GTM, Looker Studio or Power BI, and conversion tracking setups.
Experience implementing or integrating CRM and marketing automation tools. • Strong problem-solving skills and clear communication.
Preferred: 
Experience in real estate or other high-ticket, long-cycle purchase categories.
Basic web development skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, WordPress or similar).
Certifications such as Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, or AI/ML courses.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER
Company: Impacto Digifin Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Experience: 2+ Years
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: Work from Office
1. Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled and result-oriented Digital Marketing Manager with comprehensive knowledge of digital marketing strategies, tools, technologies, and platforms to promote our IT products and technology solutions.
The candidate must have hands-on experience in planning, executing, monitoring, and optimizing end-to-end digital marketing activities to increase brand visibility, website traffic, product awareness, qualified leads, customer acquisition, and business growth.
The ideal candidate should understand traditional search engines, AI-powered search platforms, emerging digital marketing trends, and data-driven marketing strategies. The candidate must be capable of independently managing digital marketing activities and coordinating with management, sales, development, and design teams.
2. Roles and Responsibilities
A. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor analysis, and content gap analysis.
Implement on-page, off-page, technical, and local SEO where relevant.
Optimize website content, landing pages, meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal links.
Manage technical SEO, website indexing, crawling, redirects, canonical tags, XML sitemaps, and robots.txt.
Improve website speed, mobile usability, Core Web Vitals, and organic search performance.
Develop ethical link-building and digital PR strategies.
Monitor rankings, organic traffic, impressions, clicks, and conversions.
B. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
Optimize content for direct answers, featured snippets, People Also Ask results, and conversational search.
Develop FAQ pages, how-to content, comparison pages, and question-based content.
Apply relevant structured data and schema markup.
Improve content clarity, relevance, factual accuracy, and answer accessibility.
C. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI Search
Improve the discoverability of company products across AI-powered search and answer platforms.
Optimize content for discovery and potential citations in ChatGPT search, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity.
Strengthen brand authority, product information consistency, topical relevance, and credible online mentions.
Develop original, authoritative content supported by product documentation, use cases, and case studies.
Track AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and referrals wherever measurable.
D. Search Engine Marketing (SEM) and Paid Advertising
Plan, launch, manage, and optimize Google Ads and other relevant paid advertising campaigns.
Manage search, display, remarketing, video, and lead-generation campaigns.
Conduct keyword bidding, audience targeting, ad copywriting, budget allocation, and A/B testing.
Manage LinkedIn Ads and other relevant paid social campaigns.
Monitor CPC, CPM, CPL, conversion rates, CAC, ROAS, and campaign ROI.
E. Social Media Marketing
Manage company social media profiles on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
Develop platform-specific content calendars and publishing strategies.
Create posts, carousels, reels, videos, polls, product announcements, and thought-leadership content.
Manage audience engagement, brand awareness, community building, and social media campaigns.
Analyze reach, engagement, follower growth, referral traffic, and conversions.
F. Content Marketing and Copywriting
Create SEO-friendly blogs, articles, website content, product pages, landing pages, case studies, and whitepapers.
Develop product descriptions, email campaigns, newsletters, social media copy, and advertising creatives.
Prepare content for awareness, consideration, lead generation, and conversion stages.
Use AI-assisted content tools responsibly, with human review and fact-checking.
Maintain brand voice, content quality, originality, and consistency.
G. B2B Marketing and Lead Generation
Develop digital marketing strategies for IT products, SaaS solutions, software platforms, and technology services.
Identify target industries, customer segments, decision-makers, and buyer personas.
Generate qualified leads through SEO, paid campaigns, LinkedIn, email marketing, webinars, and landing pages.
Create lead magnets, product demo campaigns, downloadable resources, and conversion funnels.
Work with the sales team to improve lead quality, nurturing, and lead-to-customer conversion.
Track marketing-qualified leads, sales-qualified leads, pipeline contribution, and acquisition costs.
H. Website Management and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
Manage website content through the relevant CMS.
Coordinate with developers for landing pages, technical fixes, tracking implementation, and website improvements.
Improve website navigation, user experience, calls to action, and lead forms.
Conduct A/B tests and conversion funnel analysis.
Monitor website traffic, bounce and engagement metrics, user journeys, and form submissions.
I. Analytics, Reporting, and Tracking
Use Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, and Looker Studio.
Implement UTM parameters, event tracking, conversion tracking, and campaign measurement.
Create dashboards and periodic reports covering traffic, leads, spend, conversions, and ROI.
Analyze performance data and recommend improvements based on measurable outcomes.
J. Email Marketing and Marketing Automation
Plan newsletters, promotional emails, product updates, and lead-nurturing campaigns.
Segment audiences and personalize communication.
Use email marketing and marketing automation platforms.
Set up relevant automated workflows, follow-ups, and campaign sequences.
Monitor deliverability, engagement, conversions, and unsubscribe rates.
Follow consent, privacy, and applicable anti-spam requirements.
K. Online Reputation Management and Digital PR
Monitor company, product, and brand mentions online.
Maintain accurate company information across relevant business directories and industry platforms.
Develop legitimate backlink opportunities, guest articles, partnerships, and industry publications.
Support customer testimonials, reviews, case studies, and reputation-building initiatives.
L. Video Marketing and YouTube SEO
Plan and promote product demonstrations, explainer videos, tutorials, and promotional videos.
Optimize video titles, descriptions, thumbnails, tags where relevant, and transcripts.
Develop YouTube and short-form video strategies.
Measure video views, watch time, engagement, and referral conversions.
M. Influencer, Affiliate, and Partnership Marketing
Identify relevant industry influencers, technology communities, publishers, and business partners.
Evaluate affiliate and referral marketing opportunities where appropriate.
Coordinate campaigns, partnerships, and co-marketing activities.
Measure campaign performance and business impact.
N. Mobile Marketing and Emerging Channels
Understand mobile-first marketing, responsive landing pages, app marketing, and push notifications where applicable.
Explore relevant channels such as WhatsApp Business, webinars, online communities, and conversational marketing.
Evaluate emerging platforms and technologies based on the target audience and business objectives.
O. Market Research and Competitor Analysis
Research industry trends, competitors, customer needs, search behavior, and market opportunities.
Analyze competitor keywords, content strategies, advertising campaigns, positioning, and online presence.
Identify opportunities to differentiate the company's products.
Prepare actionable recommendations for marketing growth.
P. AI Tools and Digital Marketing Technology
Use AI tools for research, keyword clustering, content planning, campaign ideation, reporting, and workflow efficiency.
Understand AI-assisted search, content discovery, and changes in customer search behavior.
Evaluate suitable AI tools, marketing platforms, and automation workflows.
Verify AI-generated information and ensure content accuracy and originality.
Q. Brand Strategy and Product Marketing
Understand product positioning, value propositions, unique selling points, and target audiences.
Develop consistent brand messaging across the website, campaigns, social media, and other channels.
Support product launches, feature announcements, product demos, and promotional campaigns.
Align marketing initiatives with sales objectives and business growth targets.
3. Required Skills and Tools
Candidates should have practical knowledge of relevant tools, including:
SEO: Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog or equivalent.
Paid Ads: Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager where relevant.
Analytics: Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, Excel and Google Sheets.
Content and AI: ChatGPT, Gemini, content optimization tools, keyword research tools.
Website: WordPress or another CMS, HTML basics, schema markup, and website performance fundamentals.
Email and CRM: HubSpot, Zoho, Mailchimp or equivalent platforms.
Creative: Canva and basic image/video editing tools.
Social Media: Platform analytics, scheduling, publishing, and campaign management tools.
Candidates are not expected to use every commercial tool listed, but should understand the relevant functions and be able to learn equivalent platforms.
4. Required Qualifications and Experience
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
Minimum 2+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience.
Experience in an IT, SaaS, technology product, or B2B organization is preferred.
Strong working knowledge of SEO, AEO, GEO, paid advertising, social media, content marketing, analytics, and lead generation.
Ability to plan, execute, measure, and optimize campaigns independently.
Excellent communication, copywriting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Growth in relevant organic and overall website traffic.
Qualified leads and marketing-qualified leads generated.
Lead conversion rates and cost per qualified lead.
Paid campaign ROI and return on advertising spend.
Improvement in relevant search visibility and website conversions.
AI search visibility and citations, where measurable.
Content engagement, backlinks, and brand mentions.
Social media engagement and relevant audience growth.
Email campaign performance and marketing-generated sales pipeline.
KPIs should be finalized according to the company's starting position, available budget, target market, and business objectives.
6. Candidate Expectations
The candidate must be a hands-on digital marketer who understands the complete marketing funnel, from brand awareness and customer discovery to lead generation, conversion, and performance reporting.
The candidate should demonstrate practical knowledge through previous campaigns, website improvements, content samples, analytical reports, or measurable business outcomes.
Application Requirement: Candidates should share an updated resume highlighting digital marketing tools used, campaigns managed, industries handled, and measurable results achieved.

title: Manager - Digital Marketing
description:
Position: Senior Manager Digital Marketing 
Function: Sales & Marketing 
Experience: 5-8 Years 
Location: Nambiar D25 Marketing Office, Sarjapura Road, Dommasandra, Bangalore KA 562125. 

Summary: 
We are looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing Technical Lead who sits at the meeting point of marketing and technology. 
You will run and optimize campaigns on Meta, Google, and other platforms, drive SEO and AI-search research, and build practical AI tools, including fine-tuned LLMs, for marketing and sales. 
You will also be a key hands-on contributor to Nambiar's in-house digital transformation. 
This is a doing role: you'll build, test, and ship, not just plan. 

Key Responsibilities: 
Performance Marketing 
Plan, execute, and optimise paid campaigns across Meta (Facebook, Instagram), Google (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max, Demand Gen), LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms. 
Manage campaign budgets with accountability for CPL, cost per site visit, and lead quality. 
Set up and maintain tracking: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, and offline conversion uploads from CRM. 
Run structured A/B tests on creatives, audiences, landing pages, and bidding strategies. 
Coordinate with agencies and property portals on execution and lead quality. 

SEO, AI Search & Research: 
Execute SEO across technical audits, on-page optimisation, schema markup, site speed, local SEO (Google Business Profiles for each project), and content. 
Research and implement AI-search optimisation (GEO/AEO) so Nambiar appears in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. 
Conduct keyword, competitor, and buyer-intent research and turn findings into actionable recommendations. 

AI & LLM Development : 
Build and deploy AI tools for marketing and sales, such as lead-qualification chatbots, WhatsApp assistants, and content-generation workflows. 
Hands-on fine-tuning of LLMs (LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning) on Nambiar's project data, FAQs, and brand voice, plus RAG pipelines and prompt engineering. 
Evaluate model output for accuracy and brand safety, and follow data privacy requirements (DPDP Act). 

In-house Digital Transformation: 
Implement and integrate martech tools: CRM (Salesforce / LeadSquared / Sell.Do or similar), marketing automation, WhatsApp Business API, and analytics dashboards. 
Automate manual marketing and sales processes and help digitise customer journeys (virtual tours, online booking, customer portals). 
Work closely with Sales, CRM, and IT teams to deliver digital projects. 

Technical Leadership: 
Act as the go-to technical expert in the marketing team and guide junior executives and agency partners. 
Prepare clear performance reports and dashboards for leadership.

Key Performance Indicators: 
Cost per qualified lead, lead-to-site-visit conversion, campaign ROAS, organic traffic and AI- search visibility, tracking accuracy, and successful delivery of AI and automation projects. 

Required Skills: 
Bachelors degree in engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, or a related field. 
5-8 years of hands-on digital marketing experience, with strong expertise in Meta and Google Ads. 
Solid technical SEO skills and familiarity with AI-search optimisation.
Practical experience with LLMs: fine-tuning, RAG, prompt engineering, and APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or open-source models via Hugging Face). 
Working knowledge of Python and SQL. 
Strong command of GA4, GTM, Looker Studio or Power BI, and conversion tracking setups. 
Experience implementing or integrating CRM and marketing automation tools. 
Strong problem-solving skills and clear communication. 

Qualifications: 
BTech in computer field or MBA with experience in Digital Marketing. Industry experience can be Digital agency, Retail or Real estate but should have experience of dealing with large scale campaign of 40 lakh plus which he/she should ran on their own across various Digital Touch points like social media, google, meta, LinkedIn, quick commerce, Quora, Reddit, Pinterest etc. 

Preferred: 
Experience in real estate or other high-ticket, long-cycle purchase categories. 
Basic web development skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, WordPress or similar). 
Certifications such as Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, or AI/ML courses. 

What We Offer 
Competitive salary commensurate with experience. 
Opportunitiesfor professional development and career advancement.
A collaborative and supportive work environment.

title: Expert/ Senior Business Analyst
description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Payment Business/System Analyst to join our team full-time in India /US / Canada.
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role: 
A Senior Payment Business/System Analyst is one of the key roles within the Program. The aim of which is consolidation of multiple payment gateways into one target gateway platform. Strong USA Payments domain expertise and hands-on experience with TSYS card acquiring platforms is mandatory for the candidate in this role . 
The candidate will work closely with Business Stakeholders, Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Development, Migration and QA Teams. 
Hands-on experience with payment platform migrations, the SAFe environment, and working at the Program level is highly preferable.

Domain-specific knowledge required: 
Deep and wide knowledge of the USA Payment landscape 
Payment processor background 
Strong knowledge of the TSYS Acquiring platforms (such as Saratoga, Sierra, Summit); TSYS BETs and TSYS PPM 
Knowledge of TSYS EIS 1080 (Authorization) and EIS 1081 (Settlement & Clearing). 
Understanding of the card scheme rules, transactions (such as tipping, surcharges, split billing, DCC / FX at POS); Terminal vendor protocols Verifone, Ingenico etc 
Understanding of card authorization, clearing, settlement, chargebacks, and reconciliation
Experience with tokenization and digital wallets such as Apple Pay and Google Pay
Experience working with Visa/Mastercard mandates and compliance changes
Experience with payment fraud, risk, or regulatory initiatives
Strong experience with data mapping and migration of complex platforms 
SQL knowledge for data validation and analysis

Responsibilities: 
Elicit, analyze, and document business, functional, non-functional and transition requirements through business and technical stakeholder discussions, workshops and reverse engineering
Create and maintain BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, and data process flows
Create documentation enabling the technical teams: Solution Architecture, Development, Data and Migration teams
Work closely with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Developers, Data and Migration Engineers, QA, and business teams throughout the SDLC
Provide functional expertise across the US Payment landscape, focusing on the gateway technical processing rather than card products and e2e payments for the customer's 
Provide expertise with TSYS/card processing platforms and understand processor integrations and downstream systems
Analyze change requests, perform impact analysis, and identify and manage dependencies across streams
Manage requirements at the Program level
Conduct data analysis, data mapping, and scenario planning for the migration 
Support migration and UAT planning, test case reviews, defect triage, and production releases
Collaborate with QA teams to ensure requirements are completely covered through functional and integration testing
Define and document non-functional requirements in collaboration with the Solution Architects and the QA team
Work with APIs, data flows, interfaces, and system integrations to translate business requirements into technical specifications
Actively plan and drive SAFe ceremonies including backlog refinement, PI and sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demos, and retrospectives
Maintain requirements traceability from business requirements through development, testing, and migration completion 
Support investigation and resolution of production issues and business queries
Work with payment networks and industry standards, including Visa, Mastercard, and relevant regulatory/compliance requirements

Requirements: 
7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst / Business Systems Analyst
Deep expertise in the USA Payments domain, including regulatory compliance (such as ACH, PCI, etc.)
Hands-on experience with TSYS card acquiring platforms
Technical background: SQL, API, system integrations, data flows, data analysis and mapping
Basic understanding of architecture principles
Experience with requirements elicitation and documentation, creation of BRD, FRD, user stories, acceptance criteria, process and data flows at the appropriate technical level
Experience with UAT, integration testing, defect management, and release support
Strong proven experience leveraging AI throughout the SDLC and BA/SA workflows, quickly adapting to the wide variety of AI tools 
Experience working in Agile/Scrum/SAFe environments
Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills
Experience with Jira and Confluence, Azure DevOps
Ability to maintain at least six (6) hours of daily working-hour overlap with North American business hours (approximately 09:0017:00 across the US Eastern to Pacific time zones)

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES 
1. Partner with business stakeholders to understand objectives, gather requirements, define KPIs, 
document business rules, and translate business needs into effective reporting and analytical 
solutions. 
2. Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, scorecards, semantic models, 
datasets, and measures using Power BI, DAX, Power Query, and related tools. 
3. Create meaningful visualizations and data stories that highlight trends, exceptions, root causes, 
opportunities, and recommended business actions. 
4. Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and analysis. 
Perform data profiling, cleansing, transformation, ETL validation, and quality checks across 
multiple data sources. 
5. Conduct structured research using public web sources, industry publications, market intelligence 
platforms, and approved third-party paid data sources. Validate source credibility, data 
accuracy, and relevance before using the information for business analysis. 
6. Investigate data discrepancies, identify root causes, maintain KPI and data definitions, and 
coordinate corrective actions with technical and business teams. 
7. Identify repetitive or error-prone processes and use Python, Power Query, Power Automate, 
VBA, or other suitable tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, and turnaround time. 
8. Support the migration of Excel-based reports and manual processes to governed Power BI 
solutions while improving report usability, performance, consistency, and adoption. 
9. Lead requirement discussions, user acceptance testing, solution walkthroughs, and stakeholder 
presentations. Communicate complex technical and analytical topics clearly to non-technical 
audiences. 
10. Prepare and maintain requirements documents, technical specifications, data dictionaries, test 
cases, user manuals, and process documentation. Mentor junior analysts and promote 
consistent analytical practices. 
11. Evaluate practical applications of AI and generative AI to improve analysis, reporting, 
documentation, automation, and business workflows. 
Required Qualifications 
1. Bachelors or Master’s degree in business administration, Data Analytics, Computer Science, 
Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Finance, or a related field. 
2. Minimum 5 years of experience in business analysis, business intelligence, data analytics, 
reporting, or a related discipline. 
3. Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including dashboard development, DAX, Power 
Query, data modeling, semantic models, and Power BI Service. 
4. Strong SQL skills, including joins, subqueries, aggregations, reconciliation, and data validation. 
5. Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, Power Pivot, PivotTables, complex formulas, and 
data analysis. 
6. Practical knowledge of dimensional modeling, star schemas, data warehousing, ETL processes, 
data cleansing, and data-quality validation. 
7. Experience researching and validating business, market, competitor, customer, or industry data 
from public and licensed third-party sources. 
8. Strong analytical, problem-solving, root-cause-analysis, communication, presentation, and 
stakeholder-management skills. 
9. Ability to independently manage projects from requirements gathering through 
implementation, documentation, and user adoption. 
10. Ability to work independently and in a team environment

Job Title: Digital Marketing Executive Location: Bengaluru 
Job Type: Full-time ( ONSITE ) 
Job Summary 
We are seeking an innovative and results-driven digital marketing professional with a strong creative flair to join our team. In this role, you will develop and execute integrated digital marketing
campaigns, with a special focus on creating engaging social media content. The ideal candidate will combine analytical skills with creative storytelling to drive brand awareness, engagement, and lead generation across digital channels.

DETAIL JOB DESCRIPTION 
Key Responsibilities
Digital Marketing Campaigns:
Develop, implement, and manage multi-channel digital marketing campaigns (SEO, PPC, email, etc.) that align with business objectives.
Monitor campaign performance using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, SEMrush) and optimize strategies based on insights.

Social Media Strategy & Execution:
Plan and execute comprehensive social media strategies across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and emerging channels.
Engage with online communities to boost brand presence and foster customer relationships.
Creative Content Development:
Conceptualize and produce high-quality social media creatives including graphics, short videos, and interactive contentthat adhere to brand guidelines.
Collaborate with graphic designers, copywriters, and content creators to develop innovative campaign visuals and messaging.
Campaign Management & Optimization:
Oversee paid social media advertising campaigns, managing budgets and adjusting strategies for optimal ROI.
Conduct A/B testing and use performance data to refine creatives and improve engagement and conversion rates.
Trend Analysis & Innovation:
Stay current with digital marketing trends, social media platform updates, and best practices to keep the brand at the forefront of industry innovation.
Research competitors and industry benchmarks to continually improve creative strategies and campaign effectiveness.
Campaign Strategy & Execution:
Develop, implement, and manage integrated digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels including SEO, PPC, social media, email marketing, and content marketing.
Coordinate with creative and content teams to produce engaging digital assets that align with campaign goals and brand guidelines.
Performance Analysis:
Monitor, analyze, and report on campaign performance using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, SEMrush, etc.).
Generate insights and actionable recommendations to optimize current and future campaigns.
SEO & SEM Management:
Oversee website SEO and content strategy, ensuring best practices for organic growth.
Manage paid advertising campaigns on platforms such as Google Ads, Facebook Ads, and LinkedIn Ads, ensuring cost-effective ROI.

Digital Marketing Campaigns:
Develop, implement, and manage multi-channel digital marketing campaigns (SEO, PPC, email, etc.) that align with business objectives.
Monitor campaign performance using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, SEMrush) and optimize strategies based on insights.
Qualifications
Education:
Bachelors degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
Experience:
Minimum of 2years experience in digital marketing, with a proven track record in campaign development and execution.
Experience in managing multi-channel digital campaigns and working with performance analytics tools.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in digital marketing tools such as Google Analytics, Facebook Business Manager, and social media scheduling platforms (e.g., Hootsuite, Sprout Social).
Strong graphic design skills and familiarity with creative software (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva) for developing social media content.
Basic video editing skills and an understanding of multimedia content production are a plus.
Proficient in digital marketing tools such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Business Manager, and email marketing platforms.
SEO, SEM, PPC, and social media marketing strategies.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong analytical and creative problem-solving abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
A collaborative team player with a proactive approach to achieving goals.
Compensation & Benefits
Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Senior Graphic Designer ( Packaging & Brand Design)
description:
About the Role 
Manipal Digital is looking for a creatively driven and detail-oriented Senior Graphic Designer with a strong foundation in graphic design and hands-on experience in packaging design.
The ideal candidate should possess a formal education in Graphic Design or Visual Communication from a reputed design institute, coupled with 46 years of industry experience, preferably across FMCG, F&B or consumer brands.
The candidate will be responsible for conceptualising, designing and executing packaging solutions, along with developing brand communication assets and adapting creative concepts across multiple formats. A strong understanding of packaging structures, artwork development, print production and pre-press requirements is essential.

Key Responsibilities 
Conceptualise and develop creative packaging designs in alignment with brand guidelines, briefs and marketing objectives.
Create and execute primary, secondary and tertiary packaging designs across different product categories.
Develop packaging artworks, layouts, adaptations and design extensions across multiple SKUs and variants.
Demonstrate strong understanding of typography, colour theory, composition, hierarchy and visual storytelling.
Work on brand identity, key visuals, marketing collaterals and other graphic design requirements as needed.
Prepare print-ready artworks, ensuring technical accuracy, artwork specifications and production feasibility.
Coordinate with internal teams, clients and production vendors to ensure smooth execution from concept to final output.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining creative quality and adhering to timelines.
Ensure consistency and accuracy across all design adaptations and packaging deliverables.

Required Skills & Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Communication Design or Visual Communication from a reputed design institute.
46 years of relevant professional experience in graphic design, with packaging design experience being a mandatory requirement .
Strong portfolio demonstrating hands-on packaging design projects, preferably in FMCG, F&B or consumer goods.
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop. Working knowledge of Adobe InDesign is preferred.
Sound understanding of packaging artwork development, dielines, keyline layouts (KLD), print processes etc
Ability to translate creative briefs into visually compelling and commercially viable design solutions.
Strong attention to detail, creative problem-solving abilities and an eye for aesthetics.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a fast-paced creative environment.

Good to Have 
Experience working with large FMCG brands or multi-SKU packaging portfolios.
Knowledge of 3D packaging visualisation and mock-up development.
Understanding of different packaging substrates, printing techniques.
Experience working in a creative agency or an in-house studio/brand design team.

Ideal Candidate Profile 
We are looking for someone who combines strong design fundamentals with practical packaging expertise. The candidate should be creatively curious, technically sound and capable of taking ownership of projects from initial ideation through artwork execution and final production.
Portfolio submission is mandatory. 
Candidates must showcase relevant packaging design projects as part of their application.

title: Senior UI UX and Graphic Designer
description:
Position:   Sr UI/UX Designer
Location:  Bengaluru
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Description: 
About the Role We're looking for a Senior Designer who brings strong visual craft, sound judgment and the ability to keep several projects on track at once. You'll own design work from concept through final delivery across digital, print and brand projects. You'll work closely with marketing, product and leadership teams in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly. This role suits someone who does great work under deadline pressure and can guide both the work and the people around them.
What You'll Do• Lead design projects from concept to final production across web, social, email, presentations, print collateral and brand assets.• Manage several projects at once, prioritize well and deliver high-quality work on tight timelines.• Turn business goals and creative briefs into clear, compelling visual solutions.• Keep brand standards consistent across all channels and help evolve them over time.• Work with internal marketers, developers and stakeholders to shape ideas and act on feedback.• Present concepts and explain the reasoning behind your design decisions to internal teams and leadership.• Prepare production-ready files and manage vendor and printer handoffs when needed.• Keep up with design trends, tools and best practices, and bring new ideas to the team.
What You Bring • 5+ years of professional graphic or visual design experience, in an agency, in-house or both.• Expert-level skills in Adobe Creative Cloud, especially Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign. Experience with After Effects, Premiere Pro or Adobe XD is a plus.• A strong portfolio showing range, conceptual thinking and polished execution.• A proven ability to juggle competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced setting.• A strong command of typography, layout, color theory and visual hierarchy.• Excellent communication skills, and comfort presenting work and taking in feedback.• Self-motivation and organization, with sharp attention to detail.• A bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Nice to Have• Experience with Figma or other UI/UX tools.• Motion graphics or video editing skills.• Experience with digital advertising and social media creative.• A basic understanding of HTML/CSS or web design principles.• Experience with brand development or rebranding projects.
What We Offer • Competitive salary• Health, dental and vision insurance• 401(k) with company match• Paid time off and holidays• Professional development and training opportunities• A collaborative, creative team environment

With operations across six countries and delivery centers in India, V2Soft partners with Fortune 500 companies to deliver innovative technology solutions and business value. www.v2soft.com

title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
Job Overview: 
We are looking for a highly motivated fresher to join our team as an Associate Software Engineer ALM. In this role, you will be responsible for configuring, optimize and supporting Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) tools used in software/product development processes. This is an excellent opportunity for fresh graduates to gain hands-on experience in ALM tools, software development methodologies, automation, and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities: 
ALM Tool Implementation & Support: Learn and Configure, customize, and maintain ALM platforms such as IBM Engineering Lifecycle Management (IBM ELM), PTC CodeBeamer, Polarion, or similar tools.
Process Framework Setup: Establish structured frameworks within ALM solutions for Requirements Management, Change Management, Defect Tracking, Risk Management, Test Management, and Version Control, ensuring alignment with industry standards and organizational processes.
User Training & Support: Conduct training sessions for customers and internal teams on ALM tool usage, best practices, and compliance requirements. Provide day-to-day technical support for ALM solutions.
Demonstrations & Proof of Concepts (PoC): Execute live demonstrations and PoCs for various customers, showcasing the capabilities and benefits of ALM solutions.
Software Design & Modeling: Create models using design and modeling tools such as Enterprise Architect, Rational Software Architect, MagicDraw, Rhapsody, etc.
Automation & Scripting: Gain hands-on experience in automation and scripting using Shell, Batch, or Python to optimize workflows..
Installation, Migration & Upgrades: Perform installation, migration, and upgradation of ALM solutions as per customer requirements.
Process Compliance & Standards: Assist project teams in ensuring compliance with industry standards (ASPICE, ISO 26262, CMMI) using ALM solutions.
Documentation & SOP Creation: Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and technical documentation for ALM tool usage, configurations, and troubleshooting.

Primary Skills: 
Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
Proficiency in Requirements Management, Change Management, and Risk Management.
Experience with ALM tracking tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, IBM ELM, PTC CodeBeamer, Polarion, etc.
Hands-on experience with programming languages like C, C++, or Java.
Familiarity with Agile, V-Model, and DevOps methodologies.
Proficiency in scripting languages (Shell, Batch) for automation.
Good knowledge of Windows and Linux (RHEL) operating systems.
Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive troubleshooting approach.
Excellent communication, customer interaction, and presentation skills.
Secondary Skills: 
Proficiency in version control systems such as Git for code repository management.
Understanding of DevOps concepts and CI/CD pipelines.
Knowledge of software modeling and design tools like Enterprise Architect, Magic Draw, Rational Software Architect, or Rhapsody.
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to enhance ALM adoption and optimization.
Continual learning mindset to stay updated with emerging ALM technologies and best practices.
Other Requirements: 
Willingness to work on customer projects in different regions if required.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Analyst-II to join our Data & AI Team. In this role, you will partner closely with our Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to analyze, scale, and improve our data products for our clients.
Have you ever collected your own dataset simply out of curiosity? Do you enjoy asking why” and “how” to get to the core of a dataset? Have you ever helped an executive make a high-impact decision? If so, we’d love to meet you. 
Key Responsibilities 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with Product Owners and Customer Managers to align deliverables with product requirements and development standards.
Data Analysis & Growth: Leverage SQL to analyze complex business challenges, test hypotheses, and uncover novel opportunities for growth.
Data Engineering & Snowflake: Build, refine, and maintain datasets, tables/views, and transformation workflows in Snowflake using SQL and Python.
Modeling & Testing: Develop and unit test analytical data models and curated datasets.
Code Quality: Implement reusable, well-structured code aligned with established architecture patterns, naming conventions, and development standards.
End-to-End Delivery: Own the full lifecycle of assigned data products, supporting analytics, dashboarding, and AI/ML use cases.
Data Quality & Documentation: Ensure accuracy and completeness through validation, data quality checks, discrepancy investigations, and root-cause analysis while maintaining clear documentation for downstream teams.
Autonomy & Communication: Work independently with minimal supervision, translating complex technical insights into clear, actionable value for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.1
What We Are Looking For 
Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree with 3–6 years of relevant experience in Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, or a related field.
Core Technical Skills: 
Hands-on experience with Snowflake for data engineering and analytics.
Proficiency in Python and SQL .
Preferred Tools: Experience with Looker for data visualization and dashboard creation.
AI Integration: Familiarity with developing data products for AI use cases or integrating AI into business reporting tools is a strong plus.
Soft Skills: Strong analytical mindset, exceptional problem-solving abilities, high attention to detail, and a collaborative approach in a fast-paced environment.
Why Join Us? 
Comprehensive benefits and programs supporting holistic employee health.
Growth-oriented organization with clear career pathing and development opportunities.
A deep commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) to ensure a welcoming environment for all team members.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Senior Data Scientist
GenAI Application Development
CBRE Technology & Digital

September 2026

Role Overview
CBRE is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to lead the design and delivery of generative AI applications that transform how our business operates and how our clients experience our services. This is a senior individual-contributor role with real technical ownership: you will architect solutions, not just advise on them.
You will work at the frontier of applied AI, building production-grade GenAI systems that solve concrete business problems across advisory, asset management, research, and operations. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and domain experts to move ideas from whiteboard to working software -- and you will set the technical bar for how CBRE thinks about and deploys large language models.
Key Responsibilities
GenAI Application Development
Lead end-to-end development of GenAI applications including document intelligence, conversational agents, automated reasoning pipelines, and decision-support tools.
Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, selecting the right chunking strategies, embedding models, vector stores, and retrieval methods for each use case.
Build multi-agent orchestration systems that decompose complex tasks, route between specialized agents, and maintain coherent state across long-running workflows.
Evaluate and select the right foundation models (proprietary and open-source) for each application, balancing capability, cost, latency, and data-residency requirements.
Apply prompt engineering rigorously, using structured outputs, chain-of-thought reasoning, tool use, and few-shot examples to shape model behavior reliably.
Model Development and Fine-Tuning
Fine-tune and adapt foundation models using techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning, and RLHF where off-the-shelf models fall short.
Design and execute systematic model evaluation frameworks: define metrics, build evaluation datasets, run human preference studies, and track regressions across model versions.
Apply classical ML and statistical methods alongside LLMs where appropriate, including time-series forecasting, clustering, classification, and anomaly detection for structured real estate and financial data.
Stay current with the research literature and rapidly evaluate new techniques -- papers published one week should be prototyped the next.
MLOps and Production Engineering
Own the full lifecycle of models you build: from experimentation through staging, production deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
Instrument GenAI applications with appropriate observability -- trace latency, token usage, retrieval quality, and output correctness in production.
Build and maintain experiment tracking, model registries, and evaluation pipelines using tools such as MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent.
Work with platform engineers to deploy models and inference services on cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), ensuring reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Implement guardrails, content filters, and safety checks that make GenAI applications suitable for enterprise deployment.
Data and Research
Interrogate large, heterogeneous datasets -- structured property data, unstructured documents, market research, financial records -- and extract signal that drives model quality.
Design data pipelines that prepare training, evaluation, and retrieval corpora at scale.
Apply domain knowledge of commercial real estate or financial services to guide feature engineering, evaluation criteria, and solution design.
Publish internal research notes and conduct knowledge-sharing sessions that elevate the broader team's technical understanding.
Stakeholder Collaboration
Translate complex model behavior and trade-offs into language that non-technical stakeholders -- executives, advisors, analysts -- can act on.
Work directly with business lines to identify high-value AI opportunities, scope solutions realistically, and set honest expectations about what models can and cannot do.
Mentor junior data scientists and share expertise across the AI community of practice.
Write clear technical documentation covering system design, model cards, evaluation results, and operational runbooks.
Required Qualifications

Area

What We Are Looking For

GenAI & LLMs

Deep hands-on experience building production GenAI applications using OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, or equivalent. Proficient in orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or DSPy).

RAG Systems

Proven ability to design and tune RAG pipelines: chunking, embedding, vector store selection (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Chroma), hybrid search, and re-ranking. Understands the failure modes of naive RAG and knows how to fix them.

Prompt Engineering

Systematic approach to prompt design: structured outputs, tool use, chain-of-thought, few-shot selection, and prompt regression testing.

Model Fine-Tuning

Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods (LoRA, QLoRA), dataset curation for instruction tuning, and evaluation-driven iteration.

Model Evaluation

Ability to design rigorous evaluation frameworks: offline metrics, human preference studies, red-teaming, and A/B testing in production.

Classical ML

Strong foundation in supervised and unsupervised learning, statistical modeling, and time-series analysis. Knows when not to use an LLM.

Python

Expert-level Python. Comfortable with PyTorch or JAX for model work, plus standard data stack: pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and SQL.

MLOps

Experience managing the full ML lifecycle in production: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, and cost management.

Cloud & Infrastructure

Practical experience deploying ML workloads on AWS, Azure, or GCP. Comfortable with containers, managed inference endpoints, and GPU provisioning.

Communication

Able to present findings, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior business stakeholders without hiding behind technical jargon. Writes clearly and concisely.
Preferred Qualifications
Graduate degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent research and industry experience.
6 or more years of industry experience in data science or applied ML, with at least 2 years focused on LLM or GenAI application development.
Experience in commercial real estate, capital markets, investment management, or financial services.
Published research or public contributions (papers, open-source, technical blog posts) in AI, ML, or NLP.
Familiarity with knowledge graphs, structured reasoning, or neuro-symbolic approaches for grounding model outputs in verified facts.
Experience with multi-modal models (vision-language models, document understanding) for processing financial documents, floor plans, or property imagery.
Exposure to responsible AI practices: bias auditing, fairness metrics, model explainability, and regulatory considerations for AI in financial services.
What You Will Work On
CBRE's GenAI applications span a wide range of domains. Below are examples of the types of systems this role will contribute to -- not an exhaustive list, since the roadmap evolves as we learn.

Application Area

Description

Document Intelligence

Automated extraction, classification, and synthesis of lease abstracts, appraisal reports, due diligence packages, and research publications.

Conversational Research

AI research assistants that let advisors and analysts query CBRE's proprietary data, market reports, and benchmarks in natural language.

Workflow Automation

GenAI-powered pipelines that automate repetitive analytical tasks -- market comps, portfolio summaries, client briefing drafts -- with human-in-the-loop review at critical decision points.

Decision Support

Models that surface relevant insights at key moments in the advisory and transaction process, helping brokers and advisors act faster with better information.

Structured Data Reasoning

Systems that combine LLMs with structured financial and property data to answer complex questions that neither approach could handle alone.
What Success Looks Like
In your first 90 days, you will have shipped a meaningful improvement to an existing GenAI system -- better retrieval quality, reduced hallucination rate, lower latency, or a new capability -- with the metrics to prove it. Within six months, you will have designed and launched at least one new GenAI application from the ground up and built a clear point of view on where CBRE's AI capabilities need to go next. Your work will be in production, not in a notebook.

CBRE Group, Inc. is the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with services, insights, and data that span every dimension of the industry. We create solutions for clients of every size, in every sector, and across more than 100 countries. CBRE is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead/Senior Data Engineer is responsible for overseeing the design, development, and management of data infrastructure and pipelines within an organization. This role involves a mix of technical leadership, project management, and collaboration with other teams to ensure the efficient collection, storage, processing, and analysis of large datasets. The Lead Data Engineer typically manages a team of data engineers, architects, and analysts, ensuring that data workflows are scalable, reliable, and meet the businesss requirements.

Responsibilities 
Lead the design, development, and maintenance of data pipelines and ETL processes architect and implement scalable data solutions using Databricks and AWS.
Optimize data storage and retrieval systems using Rockset, Clickhouse, and CrateDB.
Develop and maintain data APIs using FastAPI.
Orchestrate and automate data workflows using Airflow.
Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to support their data needs.
Ensure data quality, security, and compliance across all data systems.
Mentor junior data engineers and promote best practices in data engineering.
Evaluate and implement new data technologies to improve the data infrastructure.
Participate in cross-functional projects and provide technical leadership.
Manage and optimize data storage solutions using AWS S3, implementing best practices for data lakes and data warehouses.
Implement and manage Databricks Unity Catalog for centralized data governance and access control across the organization.

Qualifications 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
5+ years of experience in data engineering, with at least 2 years in a leading project
Strong proficiency in Python, PySpark, and SQL
Extensive experience with Databricks and AWS cloud services
Hands-on experience with Airflow for workflow orchestration
Familiarity with FastAPI for building high-performance APIs
Experience with columnar databases like Rockset, Clickhouse, and CrateDB
Solid understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and ETL processes
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams
Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance best practices
Proficiency in designing and implementing data lake architectures using AWS S3
Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog or similar data governance and metadata management tools

Nice To Have 
Experience with real-time data processing and streaming technologies
Familiarity with machine learning workflows and MLOps
Certifications in Databricks, AWS
Experience implementing data mesh or data fabric architectures
Knowledge of data lineage and metadata management best practices

Tech Stack 
Databricks, Python, PySpark, SQL, Airflow, FastAPI, AWS (S3, IAM, ECR, Lambda), Rockset, CLickhouse, CrateDB

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Job Overview: 
We are looking for a high-performance Senior Product Manager to step into a single, senior, full-ownership seat running our AI Operating System (Teach OS) end-to-end. Based out of our Hyderabad (HITEC City) office on a 5-day work week layout, this is a strategic, independent product leader role rather than an execution-under-direction position. Your ultimate mandate is to leverage AI model judgments, LLM agents, and advanced product analytics to drive massive behavior change and scale learning quality across 35+ campuses.

Key Responsibilities: 
Strategy & Discovery: Own the comprehensive product strategy, roadmap narrative, and execution sequence independently. Conduct rigorous user discovery, user interviews, and JTBD mapping.
AI-Native Delivery: Architect and ship an AI-native product experience where model judgment (QA scoring, coaching action prompts) is the core interface. Design the model evaluations and safety guardrails.
Measurement & Metrics: Define strict, data-driven product success metrics with binary, dated targets and explicit kill criteria. Handle full analytics configurations and experimentation tracking.
Behavior Change: Analyze cohorts, conversion funnels, and retention adoption patterns to transform an administrative utility tool into a platform that users actively engage with.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner directly with Engineering, Design, Data, and business P&L owners to manage deployments with tight rollout hygiene and clear written decision documentation.

Required Skills & Qualifications: 
3-4 years of dedicated professional experience in a Product Management role with a proven track record of absolute end-to-end ownership (0->1 or 1->n phases).
Elite technical data fluency utilizing product analytics tools (SQL, Sheets, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or equivalent systems).
Strong causal reasoning and diagnostic capabilitiesproven ability to trace messy data back to clear root causes.
AI Product Judgment: Practical experience designing AI-first or LLM/agent-integrated workflows and evaluating model output reliability.
Excellent written communication capabilities and structured narrative-building skills.
Nice to Have: Background in EdTech platforms, performance/gamification products, or behavior-change applications.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Role: Senior AWS DevOps Engineer 
Experience: 5+ years 
Location: Hyderabad 
Fission Labs, headquartered in Sunnyvale, with offices in Dallas & Hyderabad, Fission Labs is a leading software development company, specializing in crafting flexible, agile, and scalable solutions that propel businesses forward. With a comprehensive range of services, including product development, cloud engineering, big data analytics, QA, DevOps consulting, and AI/ML solutions, we empower clients to achieve sustainable digital transformation that aligns seamlessly with their business goals.

What are we looking for! 
A skilled AWS DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience to manage CI/CD pipelines, environments, and cloud deployments. The ideal candidate will be responsible for automating deployment processes, managing environments, handling AWS secret management, and supporting DevOps operations using Jenkins, ANT, and GitLab.

Responsibilities 
Proficiency in AWS Cloud services such as EC2, ECS, ECR, Lambda, Route 53, API Gateway, CloudFront, Cognito, and IAM.
Experience with CloudFormation for infrastructure as code (IaC) and automation.
Strong understanding of S3, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and Observability practices for monitoring, logging, and compliance.
Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, and Ansible.
Experience in setting up Load Balancers, WAF, and Route 53 for high availability and security.
Hands-on experience with DynamoDB and Secrets Manager for data and credential management.
Knowledge of AWS SES for application-based email services.
Expertise in implementing CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodeBuild and integrating automated testing and deployments.
Good understanding of security best practices, IAM policies, and access control across AWS services.
Ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and automate deployments efficiently.
Support DevOps operations using Jenkins, ANT, and GitLab.

Qualifications 
5+ years of experience in Infrastructure Mgmt / DevOps roles.
Hands-on experience with operations (DevSecOps) principles and best practices.
Exposure to LLM models and frameworks such as OpenAI and Gemini.
Familiarity with Vector databases, Prompt Engineering, and FastAPI for building AI-powered applications.
Good knowledge in Python for automation, scripting, and backend service development.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

You would enjoy 
Opportunity to work on impactful technical challenges with global reach.
Vast opportunities for self-development, including online university access and knowledge sharing opportunities.
Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons to foster innovation and learning.
Generous benefits packages including health insurance, retirement benefits, flexible work hours, and more.
Supportive work environment with forums to explore passions beyond work.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities 

- Design and build Jenkins pipelines for environment refreshes, quarterly OS and middleware patching, Kubernetes/EKS/ArgoCD upgrades and site-resiliency failover exercises
- Automate Kubernetes cluster lifecycle on-prem and on AWS EKS, including deprecated-API pre-flight checks, node draining, readiness gates and wave promotion from sandbox to production
- Run GitOps delivery with ArgoCD, using sync waves to promote changes from one environment to the next
- Automate rotation of certificates, keys and passwords with cert-manager, External Secrets Operator and AWS Secrets Manager, without disrupting applications
- Run automated dependency and vulnerability updates (Renovate, Trivy) so every change goes through a reviewed pull request
- Manage Dynatrace dashboards and alerting as code with Terraform, using plan-on-PR, apply-on-merge and drift detection
- Build automated health checks and readiness dashboards for business-critical processing windows
- Build self-service automation triggered from ServiceNow requests, with access controls and automatic expiry
- Develop AI-assisted on-call tooling that triages incidents across monitoring, ticketing and logs, and runs approved runbook fixes under strict guardrails and human approval
- Plan rollback, pre/post validation and change management for every automation that touches production
- Write runbooks and documentation, and mentor engineers on using and extending the automation
- Work with application teams, database engineers, release management and security on dependencies and handoffs
- Take part in the on-call rotation
Preferred candidate profile 

- Strong experience building and maintaining Jenkins pipelines (declarative and scripted, Groovy, shared libraries, parameterised and scheduled jobs)
- Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience, both on-prem and on AWS EKS, including cluster upgrades and production operations
- GitOps experience with ArgoCD
- Ansible for configuration management, patching and orchestration
- Terraform, including remote state and CI-driven plan/apply workflows
- Solid AWS knowledge, especially EKS, IAM, Secrets Manager and S3
- Strong scripting in Python and Bash, including integrating with REST APIs
- Observability experience, preferably Dynatrace (dashboards, alerting, DQL)
- Git and GitHub pull-request workflows
- A track record of delivering automation into production safely, with rollback plans, validation and change management
- The ability to work independently, own outcomes end to end, and explain technical trade-offs to engineers and stakeholders

Nice to have:
- cert-manager, External Secrets Operator, Stakater Reloader
- Renovate, Trivy, pluto/kubent, kured, Kubespray
- Kafka / Confluent Cloud administration (Confluent CLI, API key management, consumer lag monitoring)
- Oracle WebLogic and OHS administration, including PSU patching
- F5 and/or AVI load balancer automation
- ServiceNow (catalog items, request-driven automation, REST API) and Jira automation
- Building AI agents or assistants for operations (e.g. Claude Code, MCP integrations) with safe credential and approval models
- Familiarity with ITGC/SOX controls for access management
