title: Senior Salesforce DevOPS Engineer
description:
AutoRABIT Profile 
AutoRABIT is the leader in DevSecOps for SaaS platforms such as Salesforce. Its unique metadata-aware capability makes Release Management, Version Control, and Backup & Recovery complete, reliable, and effective. AutoRABITs highly scalable framework covers the entire DevSecOps cycle, which makes it the favourite platform for companies, especially large ones who require enterprise strength and robustness in their deployment environment. AutoRABIT increases the productivity and confidence of developers which makes it a critical tool for development teams, especially large ones with complex applications. AutoRABIT has institutional funding and is well positioned for growth. Headquartered in the CA, USA and with customers worldwide, AutoRABIT is a place for bringing your creativity to the most demanding SaaS marketplace. 

Job Role : 

Role of DevOPS Engineer in ES department covers initiating or reviewing customer DevOPS 
implementation, provide process flow recommendation, run salesforce deployments for managed services 
projects, suggest best practices for customer, assist engineering team in latest technological developments 
(UAT) to aid in AR tool enhancement. 
Roles & Responsibilities 
Implement and support Salesforce DevOps, CI/CD, code quality, security, and backup solutions for enterprise Salesforce customers. Experience with AutoRABIT ARM, CodeScan, Guard, and Vault will be an added advantage. 
Work with customers to understand their Salesforce development lifecycle, release management process, version control strategy, security, and compliance requirements. 
Configure and maintain Salesforce CI/CD pipelines using AutoRABIT ARM or equivalent DevOps platforms such as Copado, Flosum, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar tools 
Configure and maintain Static Code Analysis solutions such as CodeScan, SonarQube, PMD, Salesforce Code Analyzer, Checkmarx, or equivalent tools to improve code quality and security. • 
Support implementation of Salesforce governance, security, and compliance controls using AutoRABIT Guard or similar governance and security solutions. 
Assist customers in implementing secure development practices and resolving deployment, code quality, security, and release management challenges. 
Configure and manage Git repositories, branching strategies, merge processes, release pipelines, deployment automation, and environment synchronization. 
Participate in customer workshops, implementation activities, solution validation, UAT, troubleshooting, and production support. 
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support teams to troubleshoot customer issues and provide implementation feedback. 
Assist in configuring backup and recovery solutions using AutoRABIT Vault or equivalent Salesforce backup platforms such as OwnBackup or similar backup and recovery solutions. 
Support Salesforce Industries (Vlocity) deployments where applicable, including OmniScripts, Integration Procedures, DataRaptors, FlexCards, EPC assets, and DataPacks. 
Troubleshoot deployment failures, merge conflicts, version control issues, static code analysis findings, and CI/CD pipeline failures across Salesforce environments. 
Prepare implementation documentation, deployment guides, knowledge articles, and customer handover documentation. 
Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls. 
Experience and Desired Skills: 
3–5 years of experience working on Salesforce DevOps, CI/CD, Release Management, or Salesforce 
Administration/Development with DevOps exposure. 
Hands-on experience with at least one Salesforce DevOps platform such as: 
1. AutoRABIT ARM (Preferred) 
2. Copado 
3. Flosum 
4. Azure DevOps 
5. GitHub Actions 
6. GitLab CI/CD 
7. Jenkins 
or equivalent CI/CD solutions. 

Experience working with Git-based version control systems including GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or Azure Repos. 
Experience configuring or using Static Code Analysis tools such as: 
1. AutoRABIT CodeScan (Preferred) 
2. SonarQube 
3. Salesforce Code Analyzer 
4. PMD 
5. Checkmarx or equivalent application security tools. 
Experience working with Salesforce backup and recovery solutions such as:
1. AutoRABIT Vault (Preferred) 
2. OwnBackup or similar backup and recovery platforms 
Good understanding of Salesforce metadata deployments, CI/CD concepts, branching strategies, merge conflict resolution, release management, and deployment automation.
Basic understanding of DevSecOps principles, Secure SDLC, vulnerability remediation, and Salesforce security best practices. 
Experience supporting enterprise Salesforce implementations across multiple environments and release streams. 
Good troubleshooting and analytical skills for deployment failures, version control issues, pipeline failures, and code quality findings. 
Exposure to Salesforce Industries (Vlocity), Vlocity Build Tool (VBT), or DataPack deployments is a plus. 
Knowledge or experience with nCino implementations, release management, or deployment processes will be considered an added advantage. 
Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with customers and internal stakeholders. 
Preferred Qualifications 
Hands-on experience with AutoRABIT ARM, CodeScan, Guard, and Vault. 
Salesforce Administrator, Platform Developer, or DevOps-related certifications. 
Experience implementing DevOps processes for enterprise Salesforce organizations. 
Exposure to Salesforce Industries (Vlocity) implementations. 
Knowledge of nCino platform architecture, metadata, and deployment best practices is a plus. 
Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, and enterprise software delivery practices 
Salesforce Admin certification. 
Nice to Have 
Experience with Test Automation frameworks 
Exposure to Static Code Analysis tools 
Salesforce Certifications (Admin / Platform Developer / DevOps-related certifications) 
Education 
Bachelor's degree or equivalent 
Location: 
Hyderabad, Hybrid - 3 Days from Office 
Work Timings: 
US working hours (EST/ PST Time zone – Late evening hours/Night Shifts) 
Experience: 
5+ Years Experience 
Travel Required:  No 
Compensation:  25 - 28 LPA 
Website: www.autorabit.com

description:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Terraform, GitOps, and DevSecOps. The candidate will be responsible for building, managing, securing, monitoring, and optimizing scalable cloud infrastructure and containerized applications.

Key responsibilities 
- Design and manage scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure.
- Manage Kubernetes clusters and containerized microservices.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated build, testing, security, and deployment.
- Implement GitOps using Argo CD or similar tools.
- Manage infrastructure using Terraform / Infrastructure as Code.
- Implement DevSecOps practices, security controls, access management, and vulnerability scanning.
- Implement security best practices for data protection, encryption, access control, audit logging, secrets management, and vulnerability management.
- Configure monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability.
- Troubleshoot production issues across cloud, Kubernetes, networking, and applications.
- Implement autoscaling, high availability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
- Collaborate with development, security, and infrastructure teams to improve reliability and deployment processes.

Required skills & qualifications 
- Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with AWS.
- Kubernetes & Docker: Production experience with containerized applications.
- CI/CD: Code Pipeline, CodeBuild, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent.
- GitOps: Argo CD or similar.
- IaC: Terraform.
- Data Layer: ElastiCache Redis,Route 53 Aurora PostgreSQL, MongoDB Atlas, and S3 media storage.
- Messaging: MSK and ZooKeeper nodes.
- DevSecOps: Cloud security, IAM/RBAC, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and security automation.
- Cloud & Networking: CDN, WAF, DNS, API Gateway, Internet Gateway, load balancer, public/private subnets, and NAT Gateways.
- Monitoring & Operations: Grafana, Prometheus, New Relic, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and alerting integrations.
- OS & Scripting: Linux and Bash/Shell scripting.
- Version Control: Git.
- Production Kubernetes experience
- Kubernetes autoscaling and performance optimization.
- Cloud cost optimization.
- High-availability and disaster-recovery architecture.
- Experience supporting compliance and security audits.
- Microservices, REST, gRPC, and WebSocket knowledge.
- Load testing and infrastructure capacity planning.

Qualifications 
- 5+ years of hands-on DevOps / Cloud experience.

title: Senior Manager - Capital Projects/ Senior Project Manager
description:
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE 
The Senior Manager, Capital Projects and Facilities lead the planning, design, procurement, execution, and handover of all capital construction and renovation projects across the Academy - from initial brief through to commissioning and operation. The role carries end-to-end accountability for project scope, budget, schedule, quality, and regulatory approvals. 

This includes responsibility for ensuring:
Capital projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality and safety standards, from initial brief through to handover and operation.
All capital works comply with Government, local authority, and municipality regulations, and with AKDN Green Buildings Guidelines and AKS standards.
Contractors, consultants, and vendors engaged on capital works perform to contract, on budget, and on schedule.
All buildings and facilities are safe, well maintained, and performing adequately.

The role also holds oversight responsibility for the Academy's facilities and soft services functions, which are managed day-to-day through the Facilities and Maintenance Manager and Assistant Admin Manager.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
1. Capital Projects 
Own the oversight and management of all phases of any capital construction project within Academy land - initial project brief development, design (concept, schematic, detailed), procurement, construction, commissioning, handover, and operation.
Develop the complete scope of work for each capital project, including technical specifications, drawings, and deliverables, in coordination with consultants and design teams.
Prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQ) for capital works, ensuring accurate measurement, specification, and pricing of materials and labour.
Prepare tender documents and packages for capital projects, including technical specifications, drawings, BOQ, conditions of contract, and evaluation criteria.
Manage the tendering process end-to-end - issuing tenders, responding to bidder queries, conducting technical and commercial evaluations, and recommending contractor award.
Lead contractor management for the full project duration: onboarding, contract administration, site supervision, progress monitoring, quality control, variation and claims management, and final account close-out.
Coordinate with local authorities to obtain construction and operational permissions and approvals.
Prepare project budgets, timelines, and scopes of work in coordination with the Head of Finance and Procurement.
Oversee the work of contractors, consultants, and vendors engaged on capital works; monitor contracts for compliance, quality, and cost control.
Form and lead taskforces for the rapid upgrading of facilities where required.
Ensure capital projects comply with Government, local authority, and municipality regulations, the AKDN Green Buildings Guidelines, and AKS standards.
Prepare and present project status, risk, and budget reports to the Head of Academy and Regional Head of Facilities.
Report on a regular basis to the Regional Head of Facilities on capital project pipeline, progress, budget performance, and key risks.
Prepare and monitor a multi-year repair and capital works plan based on evaluations and inspections of the facilities.

2. Facilities & Maintenance (Oversight) 
Oversee the Facilities and Maintenance Manager, ensuring planned preventative maintenance, timely repairs, and a yearly maintenance program are in place for all facilities and systems (electrical, mechanical, sanitary).
Oversee the Assistant Admin Manager, ensuring catering, security, housekeeping, landscaping, pest control, and laundry services are fit for purpose and meet an appropriately high standard.
Prepare annual, medium, and long-term facilities planning budgets, in coordination with the Academy Head of Finance, and track costs against approved budgets.
Ensure daily facilities operations comply with Government, local authority, and municipality policy, regulations, best practices, and AKS standards.
Supervise facilities personnel, including recommendations for recruitment, performance evaluation, training, and problem resolution.
Review monthly operational and financial reports from the Facilities and Maintenance Manager and Assistant Admin Manager and consolidate these into reporting to the Head of Academy and Regional Head of Facilities
Conduct or commission annual facilities condition audits and ensure recommendations feed into the capital projects pipeline.
Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
3. General Responsibilities 
The Senior Manager, Capital Projects and Facilities will form part of the Academy Extended Senior Leadership Team.
Develop, and work in accordance with, all necessary Standard Operating Procedures for capital projects and facilities management.
Be aware of local law and municipality requirements, ensuring that the Academy is fully compliant at all times.
Perform the role of primary coordinator between the capital projects and facilities teams, Academy Management, and third-party service providers.
Provide leadership of the capital projects team and oversight of the facilities teams.
Identify key risks and corresponding mitigation measures across all capital projects and facilities to minimize operational downtime and protect the value and life span of Academy assets.
Prepare funding requests for submission on a monthly basis.
Review, prepare, and approve invoices from third-party service providers and certify for payment.
Ensure all project and operational documentation is properly stored and filed, complying with the Document Management System (DMS).
Provide technical input in any third-party contract discussions.
Ensure that the interests of the Academy are protected at all times.
Demonstrate and champion the highest ethical, professional, and technical standards in all dealings with faculty, admin staff, student residences and dorm parents, suppliers, service providers, and the entire team.
Perform other responsibilities related to capital projects and facilities management as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS 
Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Structural Engineering. Or Diploma in Project Management or Facilities Management, or a Degree with 10 years' experience in Project management.
Member of a relevant professional body (optional).

EXPERIENCE 
Minimum 15 years' experience initiating and managing capital construction projects as an end user, including design, procurement, and contractor management.
Clear understanding of local legislation and processes for gaining necessary approvals and permits for minor and major capital projects.
Experience in multi-location Project management, preferably in educational facilities, gained alongside or in support of project delivery work.
Clear experience forming taskforces to deal with rapid upgrading of facilities.
Working understanding of legislation for the operation of buildings and facilities (sanitary, fire, environmental, electrical, health, safety, and welfare).

KNOWLEDGE AND COMPETENCIES 
Strong project planning and delivery skills across the full capital project lifecycle - brief, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, handover.
Strong domain knowledge of construction methods, building materials, and mechanical/electrical/structural systems.
Skill in liaising with government bodies and local authorities to obtain necessary approvals and permits for capital projects.
Knowledge of accounting and budgeting practices, and ability to track project costs against approved budgets.
Working knowledge of Project management systems and software.
Ability to anticipate and resolve problems and advise management well in advance of decisions to be undertaken.
Strong oral and written communication skills in English.
Strong strategic focus and innovative, quick to adapt to change.
Skilled in team building, people management, and conflict resolution; skill in organizing resources and establishing priorities.
Credible, trustworthy, and high on integrity and ethical values.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with diverse people, including contractors, consultants, third-party service providers, institutions, and the community at large.
Ability to develop and maintain recordkeeping and documentation systems for projects and facilities.
Ability to supervise, train, and mentor employees, including organizing, prioritizing, and scheduling work assignments.
Knowledge of emergency and disaster recovery planning.
Self-confidence, with the ability to write and present reports well.

title: Senior Product Manager (Only Tier 1 college)
description:
Senior Product Manager 
Location : Hyderabad / Nagpur | Experience: 48 Years

About Aro.AI 
ARO.AI is being built by KC Overseas Education, a company that has run international education operations across 30+ countries for over 28 years. We are now building the AI layer on top of all that experience. 
We are building an AI-powered CRM for study abroad consultants, universities and higher education institutions. Most of this industry still runs admissions and counselling on spreadsheets and CRMs that were never built for this workflow. We are changing that.
We are at an early stage and looking for a Founding Product Manager who wants to build, not just manage.

What you will do 
This is a 01 product ownership role. You will work directly with the Founder and own the product end to end:
Talk to universities, counsellors and users to identify real problems worth solving.
Define product strategy, roadmap and priorities.
Own the complete PDLC from discovery wireframe PRD build launch adoption. 
Work closely with 20+ engineers and designers to ship products fast.
Create wireframes and user flows when needed and stay hands-on till execution.
Decide what to build, what not to build and why.
Use product data, customer feedback and business impact to improve the product.
Identify where AI/agents can genuinely improve the international admissions journey.

What we are expecting 
4–8 years of Product Management experience with strong B2B SaaS exposure.
MBA from a Tier-1 institute preferred. IIT/NIT/BITS or similar engineering background is a plus. 
Experience in an early-stage startup where you have built or significantly shaped products.
Proven ownership of products/features from problem discovery to production.
Strong product thinking, customer understanding and execution.
Comfortable with wireframing, PRDs, APIs, integrations and working with engineering teams.
AI/GenAI exposure is a plus, but strong SaaS product experience matters more.

If you want a defined PM role, this is not it. If you want to build the product from the ground up, this is the role.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Hi,

Infor are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join our high-performing product development team. You will play a critical role in the architecture, design, and development of our next-generation enterprise applications. This is a hands-on technical leadership role that requires deep software engineering expertise, a passion for innovation, and a commitment to building scalable, cloud-first solutions. As a Principal Engineer, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams across architecture. C++,  .Net, Angular, Ext JS  and DevOps, driving the technical strategy and mentoring engineers to build robust, maintainable, and performant software. 

A Typical Day in the Life Includes: 

Design and develop scalable, secure, and reliable enterprise software using modern frameworks and cloud-native principles. 
Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across multiple teams and products. 
Champion engineering excellence through code reviews, mentorship, and thought leadership. 
Work closely with Development / Product Manager to align technical solutions with business requirements and customer needs. 
Evaluate new tools, technologies, and practices, and drive continuous innovation and improvement. 
Act as a subject matter expert on key technologies, and participate in incident response and postmortem reviews. 

Basic Qualifications: 

Experience as a Senior or Principal software development. 
Experience in cloud-native application development (preferably AWS). 
Strong proficiency in modern programming languages such as .Net, C ++, Angular, ExtJS. Sound knowledge in C++ and .Net
Experience in microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). 
Experience with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins and DevOps practices
Proficient Database skills like Oracle 
Testing experience. 
Experience with modern development process (SOLID programming, merge requests, code review). 

Preferred Qualifications: 
Experience in enterprise software for industries such as manufacturing, healthcare, or distribution. 
Database skills, both relational (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server)  
Experience of Jenkins , Git Hub, Kubernetes and Docker containerization
Familiarity of data science tools and algorithms (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Prophet) for future development
Experience with Agile methodology
Experience in AI tool usage for development such as Claude or Kiro or Amazon Q

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Job Description Business Intelligence - Analytics
JOB TITLE: Sr Data Analyst BI Analytics
DEPARTMENT: Business Intelligence & Analytics
LOCATION: Mumbai

JOB PURPOSE: 
Analyst BI Analytics will be responsible for conducting statistical analysis and highlighting areas of concerns in terms of Contact Centre statistical parameters; and providing regular analytics support to the team and external stakeholders.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES: 

I. To conduct statistical analysis and highlight areas of concern in terms of Contact Centre statistical parameters: 
Analyzes available data and reports, by using statistical tools (if required), to gain better understanding of issues/concerns impacting business.
Highlights areas of concern in terms of contact center statistical parameters by translating raw data into business insights and strategies.
Participates in activities such as modelling framework, defining data requirements, creating predictive variables, and coordinating model implementation with other business partners
Develops business insights out of analysis and puts together management presentations in PowerPoint with minimal guidance.

II. To provide analytics support to stakeholders 
Interfaces with stakeholders to better interpret their business needs and translates them into application and operational requirements. 
Interfaces with stakeholders to validate business requirements/requests for analysis and presents intermediate and final analytical results. 
Interfaces with MIS and Automation team members to translate analytical results into requirements for new and/or existing applications/tools and works to ensure high quality and stable implementations.

III. To manage and perform daily Business Intelligence (BI) activities: 
Documents analytical methodologies used in the execution of analytical request projects.
Prepare documentation for developed models and provide analysis support for business strategies. 
Performs end-to-end analytics and reporting solutions that include data analysis, cleansing, ETL, modelling, development, testing, and implementation.
Develops analytical approaches to meet business requirements. This involves translating requests into database queries, analysing data, mining data and transforming results into actionable reports, data visualizations, and interactive user interfaces.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & COMPETENCIES REQUIRED 
Functional Skills and Competencies: 
Understands and knows the industry/organization and business drivers that impact the organization.
Understands basic project management techniques and knows how to implement these techniques.
Displays strong research orientation and is familiar with various research methodologies and fundamentals such as Data Collection Methods, Measurement and Scaling Techniques, Sampling Fundamentals, Analysis of Variance and Covariance, Multivariate Analysis Technique, etc.
Ability to adapt quickly and effectively to changing plans and priorities of the department.

Technical Skills and Competencies: 
(Mandatory) Has experience and knowledge of coding in SQL (MS SQL Server / MySQL)
(Mandatory) Has experience and knowledge of coding in SQL (MS SQL Server / MySQL)
Understands and knows machine learning algorithms.
Performs end-to-end analytics that include data analysis, cleansing, ETL with Python, modelling, development, testing, and implementation
Knows how to do large scale data mining (multi-million row data sets), reporting and knowledge discovery. 
Demonstrates strong Excel capabilities, with pivot tables, data tables, excel functions and scenario modelling.
Knows how to work with VBA in EXCEL.

Customer Focus (Core) 
Ability to consistently place high value on customers and all issues related to customer.
Ability to anticipate customer needs, explore all options and develop appropriate reporting solutions, policies and procedures.
Ability to keep customers requirements and feedback at the base of all analytics related activities.
Required to maintain high confidentiality with sensitive information and data and display integrity.

Analytical Thinking: 
Ability to analyze available data and reports to gain a better understanding of issues/concerns impacting business.
Ability to analyze and interpret stakeholder requests and identify their operational requirements accurately.
Ability to look beyond the obvious solutions and ways of working and create better reports or more efficient ways of reporting.

Influencing & Interpersonal Skills: 
Ability to build and sustain relationships with (internal and external) stakeholders and influence them on decisions impacting the performance of your team.
Ability to influence stakeholders decisions based on ones own presentation of data either verbally or through dashboards during meetings.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED: 
Education: 
(Minimum) Graduation
Preferred) Post Graduation in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, etc.

Experience: 
Minimum of 3+years experience of which at least 1 years should be in a data analytics related role.

description:
Role Overview 
We are looking for a data-driven Senior Data Analyst to support Workforce Management (WFM) and productivity improvement initiatives across facility management operations. The role will focus on analysing workforce data, developing dashboards, identifying efficiency opportunities, and providing actionable insights to improve operational performance and resource utilisation.

Key Responsibilities 
Analyse workforce, manpower deployment, attendance, productivity, and operational performance data.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
Identify trends, productivity gaps, manpower optimisation opportunities, and cost efficiencies.
Work closely with operations and business stakeholders to define KPIs and support data-driven decisions.
Automate recurring reports and improve data accuracy, consistency, and reporting efficiency.
Support WFM and productivity improvement projects through data analysis, performance tracking, and actionable recommendations.

Desired Skills & Experience 
5 years of experience in data analytics, MIS, business intelligence, or workforce productivity analytics.
Strong proficiency in Advanced Excel and Power BI; working knowledge of SQL is preferred.
Experience in workforce analytics, manpower planning, productivity analysis, or operations analytics.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to translate complex data into clear insights and business recommendations.

Preferred Background 
Experience in facility management, manpower-intensive operations, workforce management, or service-based organisations will be an advantage.

We are seeking a seasoned Senior DevOps Engineer with 3-5 years of relevant experience to join our team in Mumbai. This is a full-time, on-site role operating on rotational shifts (Monday to Saturday layout). You will be responsible for handling the implementation, enterprise integrations, and Day-2 operations of multi-cloud application platforms. The ideal candidate will work closely with enterprise customers to solve application transformation goals, driving automation, scalability, and DevSecOps best practices.

Key Responsibilities: 
Cluster Deployment: Plan, architecture-review, and deploy production-level containerization configurations and Kubernetes / VMware Tanzu clusters.
Pipeline Orchestration: Build, integrate, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins) across multiple customer staging and deployment environments.
Configuration Management: Automate infrastructure-as-code deployments and manage environment sync states using tools like Ansible or Chef.
Container Security & Registries: Securely configure container registry solutions (Harbor, JFrog, Quay) while enforcing Kubernetes networking and security architecture standards.
Monitoring & Observability: Implement robust application tracking and cluster logging setups utilizing DataDog or open-source infrastructure tools (Prometheus, ELK stack).
Stakeholder Engagement: Actively interface with enterprise customers to advise on structural cloud-native migrations and clear operational technical blockers.

Required Skills & Qualifications: 
3-5 years of dedicated, hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, site reliability engineering, or DevOps roles.
Engineering Graduate (B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, or related fields preferred).
Proven proficiency with orchestration toolsets (Kubernetes), automation setups (Ansible), and version control systems (Git).
Excellent technical analysis, troubleshooting capacity, and customer communication abilities.
Preferred Credentials: Active professional certifications including Red Hat, CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), or VMware tracks are a significant advantage.

title: Product Manager - Chronic Therapy
description:
USV, a top-15 pharmaceutical company in India, excels in the diabetes and cardio sectors. We have a presence in over 65 countries with our dynamic team of over 7,000 across generations. Our commitment to brand building is evident in our popular products like Glycomet GP, Ecosprin AV, Jalra, Tazloc, Glynase, MVI and more. 

Join USV and be part of our journey as we continue to innovate, transform lives, and shape the future of healthcare.

Designation:   Product Manager / Senior Product Manager

Department/Function:  Domestic Marketing

Location:  HO @ Govandi, Mumbai

Working Days:  5 Days WFO with 1st, 3rd & 5th Saturdays

Key Responsibilities: 

Strategic Planning and Budgeting: 
Develop and maintain a rich reserve of market intelligence and competitor knowledge for formulation of marketing strategies:
Study market trends and analyse agency reports     
Collate feedback from sales teams and generate insights     
Meet KoLs in order to keep abreast of market changes and competitor strategies     
Conduct own research to analyse value chain     
Attend and network at industry seminars/conferences
Provide market data to help in estimation of annual market share forecasts
Participate in annual budgeting exercise by providing activity/item-wise estimates of annual spends.

Brand Planning and Execution: 
 Prepare an annual brand plan for your  brand/s. Create STP for brand/s as per market realities and own expertise     
Plan in-clinic and out-clinic activities for brand/s across short and long term     
Ideate marketing deliverables (Brand communication, advertisements, promotions, brand reminders, etc.) and ensure they are designed and executed as per plan    
Prepare calendar and content for CMEs, awareness programs, courses, conferences, etc.    
Communicate the brand plan and execution strategy to the sales force. Provide training where needed    
Design and implement incentive plan and motivational drives for sales force    
Continuously monitor brand activity and on-ground execution to ensure and report adherence to brand plan (calendar and budget)    
Present execution updates to Marketing heads at monthly review. Highlight variation from budget/ plan and discuss recourses    
Provide on-going customer and market insights to RDPM during the development process
Recommend product pricing based on market research and competitor analysis

Sales Support : 
Campaign execution and timely feedback by  coordinating with regional/distr. Heads.    
Provide support in case of objections/queries (check against crm point)     
Ensure field force motivation and effectiveness. Leverage all available platforms (sms, app, email, call, etc.) and data sources (tracker, SFA reports, etc.)

Manage execution of cycle meetings: 
Ensure materials are available and participation is coordinated     
Prepare and deliver select training modules at the cycle meetings    
Conduct strategic briefing meeting for sales force     
Demonstrate new inputs and collate feedback. Analyse feedback to re-work inputs as needed

Customer Relationship Management: 
Handle customer queries and complaints (routed via sales). Work with CQA to resolve issues (basis expertise)     
Maintain relationships with select KoLs in order to receive feedback and share updates    
Support the end to end delivery of:
Educational programs
Chemist, Pharmacist and Paramedics programs

Vendor Management: 
Identify and recommend new vendors and support vendor registration process to ensure contracting    
Follow up for delivery of content/material. Ensure adherence to timelines and requirements    
Approve disbursal of payments by raising indents and processing bills

  Business (people & budgets) planning, continuity and improvement 
Ensure personal adherence to work norms and the marketing manual.    
Nominate self for trainings. Ensure attendance    
Provide timely and relevant inputs for the preparation of departmental opex budget    
Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process efficiency    
Organize and participate in Knowledge Sharing sessions with the team to share insights and learnings

Job Specifications: 
Minimum qualification required - Science Graduate
Mandatory qualification - Management Graduate (MBA Only)
Minimum years of experience - 3+ years as Product Manager in Product Management Team (We are open for all segments)
Industry - Only Pharmaceuticals

title: Opening For Product Manager & Senior Product Manager
description:
JOB DISCRPITION OF PRODUCT MANAGER 
ROLE PROFILE, PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES 
• Responsible for providing sales teams with appropriate and necessary technical
expertise to enable them to detail / promote / sell the product. This involves printed and electronic promotional material, product training, and relevant clinical papers.
• Responsible for reviewing product data to ensure that the field force is kept up to date
on new developments regarding the companies or competitors products.
• Responsible for brand management and brand plan:
Analyse internal and external data;
Do primary and secondary research;
Set Brand Objectives;
Formulate Brand Strategies - Positioning, Segmentation and Targeting, Brand
extension strategy;
Brand Mix, Action Plans;
• Act as first point contact for all product related enquiries and work collaboratively with colleagues in Medical, Clinical Research (if any), and Quality and Regulatory to address any issues that might be received from field.
• Close liaison with the field force to assess the response to and suitability of current
promotional material and to ensure that the printed promotional material is being used
optimally.
• Design market research projects to assess customer attitudes to the
current product range and new product introductions. Either conduct this research with
in-house staff or manage an outside agency i.e., initial identification of suitable partner,
definition of responsibilities, communication plan, divisions of responsibility, milestones, contract with company, review transcripts and reports, and recommend action plans from the research.
• Prepare annual marketing plans and activities including brand strategy for pillar brands and for controlling promotion, promotional inputs and sales aids in accordance with the annual marketing plan.
• Responsible for preparing product forecasts, which are in tune with strategic plans, and constantly monitoring inventory availability in coordination with distribution and sales groups to ensure supply timelines for achieving forecasts.
• Driving implementation along with effective feedback mechanism; effectively
demonstrate in meetings/ field work the right way to communicate the campaign to the
customers.
• Constant contact with the Field force and line managers, monitoring and sharing
success stories, good feedback formats with suitable deadlines, course corrections if any.
• Monitors brand wise budget vis--vis actual expenditure.
• Develops systems across brand teams which facilitate better MIS and synergy of
operations.
• Develops market entry strategy for previously untapped geographies based on market intelligence, and validate the same with Marketing Head.
• Follow-up with procurement group and also with suppliers for timely delivery of
marketing inputs and ensure distribution group dispatches well in time so that execution of marketing plans are in line with budget.
• To Increase Market Share and profitability through Brand Building & Strategic Planning of the assigned brand portfolio for meeting the Organization goals.

Note : We want minimum 2 Yrs of experience in PMT Role then only apply for this role not from Sales Background

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Digital Marketing Manager International Real Estate 

*Company:* Graviti Properties LLC 
*Location:* Mumbai, India 
*Experience:* 2- 5 Years 
*Level:* Mid-Level Management 
*Industry:* International Real Estate | Dubai | Thailand | UK | USA 

## About Graviti Properties LLC 

Graviti Properties LLC is an international real estate consulting firm specialising in investment opportunities across Dubai, Thailand, and other global property markets. We work with leading developers and cater to investors, HNIs, NRIs, and end users seeking international real estate opportunities. 

We are looking for a dynamic, performance-oriented *Digital Marketing Manager* who can drive qualified international property leads, manage ROI-focused campaigns, and develop innovative, AI-driven digital marketing strategies across multiple geographies. 

The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience managing international campaigns, preferably in real estate, financial services, luxury sales, or other high-value, high-consideration industries. 

## Key Responsibilities 

### 1. Performance Marketing & Lead Generation 

* Plan, execute, and optimise paid digital campaigns for international property markets, including Dubai, Thailand, the UK, and the USA. 
* Manage end-to-end lead generation through Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads, and other relevant digital advertising platforms. 
* Develop targeted campaigns for investors, HNIs, NRIs, business owners, and high-net-worth property buyers. 
* Generate high-quality, sales-ready leads with a strong focus on lead quality, conversion potential, and cost efficiency. 
* Experiment with innovative audience targeting, retargeting, lookalike audiences, funnel optimisation, and lead-nurturing strategies. 
* Collaborate closely with the sales and pre-sales teams to improve lead quality and increase lead-to-appointment and appointment-to-sales conversion rates. 

### 2. ROI & Campaign Budget Management 

* Take ownership of campaign budgets, marketing spends, CPL, CPA, ROAS, and overall campaign profitability. 
* Develop market-wise and campaign-wise performance dashboards to track expenditure, lead quality, sales pipeline, and revenue attribution. 
* Monitor campaign performance daily and optimise budgets based on measurable business outcomes. 
* Identify underperforming campaigns, diagnose issues, and implement corrective measures promptly. 
* Establish clear performance benchmarks for every geography, campaign, channel, and target audience. 
* Ensure marketing investments are aligned with sales targets and deliver measurable returns. 

### 3. Meta Advertising & Communication Ecosystem 

* Demonstrate extensive hands-on expertise in Meta Business Suite, Ads Manager, campaign structures, audience segmentation, conversion tracking, and retargeting. 
* Manage Meta lead forms, landing-page campaigns, WhatsApp lead journeys, and relevant messaging integrations. 
* Optimise campaign creatives, copy, calls to action, placements, and audience strategies through structured A/B testing. 
* Understand Meta Pixel, Conversions API, tracking events, attribution, and lead-quality optimisation. 
* Keep pace with evolving Meta advertising policies, algorithm changes, campaign automation, and platform best practices. 

### 4. SEO & Organic Growth 

* Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve website visibility, organic traffic, and qualified inbound enquiries. 
* Conduct keyword research for international property investment, Dubai real estate, Thailand properties, and other relevant markets. 
* Manage on-page SEO, technical SEO coordination, content optimisation, backlink strategy, and website performance. 
* Work with content and creative teams to develop SEO-friendly landing pages, blogs, investment guides, and market-specific content. 
* Monitor organic performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools. 
* Identify opportunities to reduce dependence on paid advertising by building sustainable organic lead-generation channels. 

### 5. AI-Driven & Innovative Digital Marketing 

* Leverage AI-powered tools for audience research, campaign planning, creative development, copywriting, keyword analysis, reporting, and optimisation. 
* Explore AI-driven marketing automation, lead scoring, predictive analysis, personalisation, and lead-nurturing workflows. 
* Identify emerging advertising platforms and alternative acquisition channels to reach international property investors. 
* Evaluate and implement innovative digital marketing solutions that improve efficiency, campaign performance, and conversion rates. 
* Use data and AI tools to identify trends, uncover new audience segments, and improve campaign decision-making. 

### 6. Alternative Advertising Channels & Taboola 

* Explore and manage alternative paid acquisition channels beyond Meta and Google, based on campaign objectives and target audiences. 
* Evaluate platforms such as Taboola, native advertising networks, YouTube, display advertising, and relevant international digital media channels. 
* Test new traffic sources for reaching HNIs, investors, NRIs, and international property buyers. 
* Assess channel suitability, audience intent, lead quality, and conversion economics before scaling budgets. 
* Develop a diversified acquisition strategy to reduce overdependence on any single advertising platform. 

*Preferred:* Hands-on experience with Taboola or other native advertising platforms. 

### 7. Campaign Planning & Creative Strategy 

* Develop integrated digital campaign plans aligned with project launches, property exhibitions, investor events, and sales priorities. 
* Brief graphic designers, video editors, content creators, and external agencies on campaign requirements. 
* Develop market-specific campaign messaging, ad creatives, video concepts, landing pages, and conversion-focused content. 
* Introduce innovative campaign concepts to differentiate Graviti in competitive international property markets. 
* Coordinate with the brand and events teams to ensure consistency across digital campaigns, exhibitions, roadshows, and offline sales initiatives. 

### 8. Analytics, Reporting & Troubleshooting 

* Monitor campaign performance and identify issues affecting lead volume, CPL, conversion rates, or ROI. 
* Troubleshoot ad disapprovals, tracking failures, landing-page issues, audience fatigue, rising acquisition costs, and campaign delivery problems. 
* Ensure accurate tracking of leads from advertising platforms through CRM and sales outcomes wherever technically feasible. 
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports covering spend, leads, CPL, qualified leads, appointments, bookings, and revenue attribution. 
* Recommend actionable improvements based on campaign data rather than assumptions. 
* Take ownership of campaign performance and resolve operational challenges proactively. 

## Required Skills & Experience 

* 47 years of experience in digital marketing and performance marketing, with substantial hands-on campaign management experience. 
* Proven experience in international lead generation, preferably across Dubai, the UK, the USA, Thailand, or other overseas markets. 
* Strong expertise in Meta Ads Manager, Facebook and Instagram advertising, Google Ads, and campaign optimisation. 
* Practical knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, conversion tracking, and performance reporting. 
* Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, improve lead quality, optimise CPL, and measure campaign ROI. 
* Experience in international sales-oriented industries such as real estate, luxury products, financial services, investment advisory, or other high-ticket sectors. 
* Working knowledge of Taboola, native advertising, marketing automation, and AI-powered marketing tools. 
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, planning, and problem-solving abilities. 
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple campaigns simultaneously, and collaborate effectively with sales and creative teams. 

## Preferred Candidate Profile 

* Candidates who have managed international lead-generation campaigns and understand the differences between domestic and overseas audiences. 
* Professionals with exposure to Dubai real estate, international property investment, luxury sales, or investor-focused marketing. 
* Candidates who can demonstrate actual campaign performance through case studies, dashboards, budget ownership, and measurable results. 
* Individuals who combine analytical thinking with creative execution and innovative campaign ideas. 
* A hands-on professional who can independently plan, launch, monitor, optimise, and troubleshoot campaigns rather than relying entirely on external agencies. 

## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

Performance will be evaluated against measurable business outcomes, including: 

1. Qualified lead generation across Dubai, Thailand, the UK, and the USA. 
2. Cost per lead (CPL) and cost per qualified lead. 
3. Marketing spend efficiency and campaign ROI. 
4. Lead-to-appointment and appointment-to-sales conversion rates. 
5. Organic traffic growth and SEO-driven enquiries. 
6. Campaign performance by geography, project, channel, and audience. 
7. Tracking accuracy and lead attribution. 
8. Testing and successful adoption of new digital acquisition channels. 
9. Timely campaign execution and resolution of performance issues. 
10. Contribution to the sales pipeline and attributable revenue. 

Apply Today! 
Email: hr@gravitiproperties.com 
WhatsApp / Call: +91 7304750986

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
About JUSTO: Established in August 2019, JUSTO is a dynamic real estate solutions company committed to driving innovation and growth. With a dedicated team of professionals, we empower developers to bring their vision to life. Our tailored strategies are designed to maximize value for both developers and end-users. Operating across multiple cities, including Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Pune, Bhubaneswar, Kolhapur, Aurangabad, and Nashik, we have built a strong presence in the real estate market. Guided by our core principles of providing expert advice, creating innovative solutions, and nurturing long-term partnerships, we combine cutting-edge technology with personalized service to establish ourselves as a trusted brand in real estate solutions.

Job Role:  Manager - Digital Marketing
Job Title:  Mid Level to Senior Level
Department: Marketing

Profile Summary: We are looking for a performance-driven Assistant Manager – Digital Marketing with strong expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram). The role focuses on planning, executing, and optimizing paid campaigns to drive high-quality leads, conversions, and measurable ROI.

The ideal candidate should be data-oriented, execution-focused, and capable of handling multiple campaigns across industries, especially in performance-heavy environments.

Key Responsibilities: 

Performance Marketing (Google Ads & Meta Ads): 

Plan, execute, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube) and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram).
Ensure campaigns are aligned with business goals such as lead generation, conversions, and ROI maximization.
Manage campaign budgets efficiently and monitor spend vs performance.

Campaign Strategy & Execution: 

Develop structured campaign strategies including audience targeting, funnel creation, ad creatives, and landing page alignment.
Create and test multiple ad variations (copies, creatives, formats) to improve performance.
Implement retargeting and remarketing strategies to improve conversion rates.

Performance Tracking & Optimization: 

Monitor campaign performance on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
Analyze key metrics like CPL, CPA, CTR, Conversion Rate, ROAS, and optimize accordingly.
Conduct A/B testing and continuously refine campaigns for better outcomes.

Analytics & Reporting: 

Use tools like Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, and Google Ads Dashboard to track and analyze performance.
Prepare detailed reports, dashboards, and insights for internal teams and clients.
Translate data into actionable insights and optimization strategies.

Content & Creative Coordination: 

Work closely with the creative team to develop high-performing ad copies and creatives.
Ensure messaging consistency across all paid campaigns.

Client & Stakeholder Management: 

Collaborate with internal teams (creative, sales, strategy) to align campaigns with business objectives.
Present campaign performance, insights, and strategies to stakeholders or clients when required.

Platform & Trend Updates: 

Stay updated with the latest trends, tools, and algorithm changes in Google Ads and Meta Ads ecosystems.
Implement new features, formats, and strategies to maintain competitive performance.

Preferred candidate profile: 

Experience in lead generation campaigns (especially real estate, education, healthcare, etc.)
Understanding of landing page optimization and funnel strategy
Basic knowledge of tracking tools like Google Tag Manager, Pixels, and Events

Educational, Experience & Professional Qualifications 

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business Management, Mass Communication, or related field.
Minimum 5+ year of hands-on experience in Google Ads and Meta Ads.
Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics and conversion tracking.
Experience with tools like Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly.
Ability to manage multiple campaigns in a fast-paced environment

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Role Purpose 
The Assistant Manager Content & Digital Marketing is responsible for developing compelling, high-quality content that strengthens the luxury brand, engages travelers across digital platforms, and supports commercial campaigns. The role will work closely with merchandising, retail operations, brand partners, and creative agencies to deliver integrated content that enhances customer engagement, drives traffic, and supports sales across airport retail channels.

Key Responsibilities 
1. Content Strategy & Development 
Develop engaging content for digital platforms, including websites, blogs, email campaigns, social media, digital screens, and promotional materials.
Create content calendars aligned with business priorities, seasonal campaigns, new store launches, and travel peaks.
Ensure all content reflects the brands tone, positioning, and luxury retail standards.
Research travel, retail, luxury, beauty, fashion, gourmet food, liquor, and gifting trends to create relevant content.
2. Digital Campaign Support 
Create campaign copy for paid digital advertising, Google Ads, Meta campaigns, and CRM communications.
Support product launches, promotions, festivals, and airport events with compelling storytelling.
Coordinate campaign execution with internal stakeholders and external agencies.
3. Social Media Management 
Plan, write, and publish content across social media platforms.
Develop engaging captions, short-form videos, stories, and campaign concepts.
Monitor engagement and recommend improvements based on analytics and customer insights.
4. Website & SEO Content 
Write and update website content, landing pages, and product descriptions.
Optimize content using SEO best practices to improve organic visibility.
Ensure website content is current, accurate, and aligned with promotional campaigns.
5. Brand Partner Collaboration 
Coordinate with luxury and premium brand partners to create co-branded campaigns.
Adapt global brand content for local airport retail audiences.
Ensure compliance with brand guidelines and regulatory requirements.
6. Airport & In-store Communication 
Develop content for digital screens, in-store signage, promotional displays, and customer communications.
Support omnichannel campaigns linking digital engagement with in-store experiences.
7. Email Marketing & CRM 
Draft emailers, newsletters, WhatsApp campaigns, and SMS communications.
Create personalized content for customer segments and loyalty programmes.
Support customer retention initiatives through engaging communication.
8. Analytics & Performance 
Track the performance of content across digital channels.
Monitor engagement, website traffic, email metrics, and campaign performance.
Recommend content improvements based on data and customer behaviour.
9. Agency & Stakeholder Management 
Coordinate with creative agencies, designers, photographers, videographers, and digital partners.
Liaise with merchandising, operations, and retail teams to ensure timely content delivery.
Maintain a content repository and ensure adherence to brand standards.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
Content delivery as per marketing calendar
Website traffic and content engagement
Social media engagement and follower growth
Email open and click-through rates
SEO performance and organic traffic growth
Campaign content delivered on time
Content quality and brand compliance
Digital campaign support effectiveness
Customer engagement metrics
Stakeholder satisfaction
Qualifications 
Bachelors degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism, English, Advertising, Digital Media, or a related field.
Certification in Digital Marketing, Content Marketing, SEO, or Google Analytics is preferred.

Experience 
47 years of experience in content writing, digital marketing, or brand communications.
Experience in luxury retail, fashion, beauty, hospitality, aviation, travel retail, FMCG, or e-commerce is preferred.
Portfolio demonstrating strong long-form and short-form content writing across digital channels.

Technical Skills 
Excellent English writing, editing, and proofreading skills
SEO content writing
Social media content creation
CMS platforms (WordPress or similar)
Google Analytics (GA4)
Basic knowledge of Canva or Adobe Creative Suite
Email marketing platforms
Microsoft Office and PowerPoint

Success Profile 
The ideal candidate is a creative storyteller with a passion for luxury brands, travel, and retail. They can transform business objectives into engaging content that resonates with domestic and international travellers, supports premium brand positioning, and contributes to measurable digital engagement and commercial success in the Luxury environment.

Call or Whatsapp:
Poonam - 7660045222

Email:
poonam.pariya@unisoninternational.net

We are seeking a talented and experienced Digital Marketing Manager to take charge of our online presence. Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Analyze and report on the performance of digital marketing efforts, making data-driven recommendations for improvements.
Stay updated with industry trends in the cybersecurity, networking, ethical hacking, and data science sectors.

At least 5 to 8 years of industry experience in digital marketing, SEO, SEM, SMO, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Meta Ads

Results-driven and goal-oriented, with the ability to fulfill daily lead targets.
Strong technical skills with SEO and Ads tools

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
OneAlphaMed Private Limited
Healthcare Communications & Medical Education
JOB DESCRIPTION
Graphic Designer
Role Snapshot
OneAlphaMed (OAM), a healthcare communications and medical education company, is looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to develop engaging, accurate, and brand-consistent visual assets across digital and print formats.
The ideal candidate has a strong eye for layout, typography, colour, and composition, and can translate creative briefs into polished designs. The role involves working closely with the content, medical, account, and creative teams to deliver high-quality work on time.
Title: Graphic Designer
Location: Mumbai (on-site)
Experience: Relevant experience in graphic design; experience in pharma or healthcare communications is preferred
Reports to: Creative Lead / Managing Partner
Type: Full-time
Key Responsibilities
Digital Design

Create digital assets for campaigns and communication, including social media creatives, emailers, web banners, presentations, landing-page graphics, and other digital collateral.
Design visual content for healthcare and pharmaceutical brands while following the brief, brand guidelines, and approved content.
Adapt artwork into different sizes and formats for various digital platforms, maintaining consistency and quality.
Support the creation of visual assets for microsites, e-detailers, apps, and other digital experiences, as required.
Print & Event Collateral

Design brochures, flyers, posters, standees, invitations, conference backdrops, booth panels, and other print materials.
Prepare print-ready artwork with correct dimensions, resolution, colour settings, bleed, and other pre-press specifications.
Coordinate with printers and vendors on proofs, artwork corrections, material requirements, and finishing, when needed.
Creative Execution & Collaboration

Interpret creative briefs and develop clear, visually engaging design concepts.
Maintain visual consistency and adhere to brand guidelines across all deliverables.
Work closely with content, medical, account, and event teams to ensure designs are accurate, on-brief, and delivered on schedule.
Make revisions based on feedback and manage multiple assignments and deadlines effectively.
Organise design files, templates, and creative assets for easy access and reuse.
Support the wider creative team with layout refinements, image editing, retouching, and production artwork.
Required Experience & Skills

Formal education in graphic design, commercial art, applied art, or a related discipline is preferred.
A portfolio demonstrating strong digital and print design skills.
Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
Strong understanding of typography, layout, colour theory, composition, and visual hierarchy.
Knowledge of print production, pre-press requirements, and digital file specifications.
Ability to interpret briefs, incorporate feedback, and deliver accurate, high-quality work within deadlines.
Good communication, organisation, and teamwork skills.
Experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare communications is preferred, including familiarity with referenced content and medical/regulatory review workflows.
Good to Have

Basic knowledge of motion graphics or video-editing tools such as After Effects.
Experience creating infographics, illustrations, presentations, or UI-related visual assets.
Familiarity with healthcare professional (HCP)-facing materials, patient education content, and medical education projects.
Ability to manage multiple brands and projects in a fast-paced agency environment.
Who You Are
You are creative, organised, detail-oriented, and committed to producing polished work. You enjoy collaborating with a team, responding constructively to feedback, and turning ideas into clear and effective visual communication.
How to Apply
Please share your CV along with a portfolio showcasing relevant digital and print design work.
OneAlphaMed Private Limited | Healthcare Communications & Medical Education

title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor | Permanent Work From Home Role
description:
We are hiring a full-time Graphic Designer & Video Editor for a long-term permanent work-from-home role, focused on photo editing, social media creatives, reels, videos, website graphics, and digital marketing assets. 

Role & responsibilities 
1. Utilize advanced photo editing techniques to cut out subjects, change or blur backgrounds, and merge multiple subjects together 

2. Perform photo corrections, including lens correction, perspective cropping, retouching, color correction, enhancing, and resizing 

3. Create engaging graphic content for social media, website blogs, and landing pages 

4. Produce creative videos and reels for social media, aligning with our marketing strategy 

5. Maintain and update the creative library in accordance with the social media calendar 

6. Collaborate with the marketing team to conceptualize and implement design solutions that meet marketing strategies 

7. Assist in the creation of digital assets for a variety of platforms, including website banners, promotional emails, and advertising campaigns 

8. Participate in brainstorming sessions to share new design perspectives and ideas 

9. Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends and techniques 

Preferred candidate profile 

1-5 years of hands-on experience in graphic design, photo editing, and video editing.
Strong working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, or similar professional design and editing tools.
Excellent Photoshop skills, especially in image cut-outs, background replacement, photo merging, retouching, color correction, and image enhancement.
Experience creating social media posts, reels, website banners, email creatives, blog graphics, and digital advertising assets.
Good understanding of visual composition, typography, color, spacing, and current social media design trends.
Ability to edit short-form videos and reels with clean transitions, text overlays, music, and engaging pacing.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain consistency across different creatives and platforms.
Comfortable working with briefs, feedback, and multiple revisions while meeting deadlines.
Able to understand marketing objectives and convert them into effective visual concepts.
Self-motivated and disciplined, with the ability to work independently in a permanent work-from-home environment.
Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with the marketing team.
A strong portfolio demonstrating graphic design, photo manipulation, and video editing work is required.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
SENIOR DATA SCIENTIST PORTFOLIO ANALYTICS, Global SMB 

Position Summary 

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Data Scientist to develop and deploy advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions that drive customer growth, retention, and portfolio optimisation at scale. This role offers the opportunity to solve complex business problems, influence strategic decisions, and build intelligence products used across global SMB markets. 

Operating within the Customer Data & Portfolio Analytics organization, this role partners with business and technology teams across markets to deliver scalable analytical products and predictive models. The individual will lead end-to-end model development, deployment, and optimization across customer lifecycle use cases including attrition prevention, cross-sell and upsell optimization, Next Best Action recommendations, Customer Retention tools, dormancy prediction, customer segmentation, customer lifetime value optimization, and conversational intelligence. 

This is a highly visible role that combines data science, AI innovation, and business partnership to deliver measurable commercial impact and influence strategic decision-making. 

Key Responsibilities 

Model Development & Deployment 

Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of machine learning models including problem definition, exploratory data analysis (EDA), feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and optimization. 

Develop predictive models for attrition, cross-sell propensity, dormancy prediction, Next Best Action recommendations, portfolio compression, customer segmentation, and customer value optimization. 

Independently design, train, tune, evaluate, deploy, and maintain machine learning models in production environments. 

Design scalable analytical solutions and data pipelines that support model development and deployment. 

Drive model performance monitoring, retraining, and continuous improvement using production data and business outcomes. 

Ensure models are explainable, scalable, and aligned with enterprise data governance standards. 

AI & Customer Intelligence 

Design and deploy AI-powered solutions leveraging GenAI, LLMs, NLP, and related AI technologies. 

Develop call listening and conversational intelligence solutions to identify customer sentiment, churn risk indicators, emerging customer needs, and growth opportunities. 

Build AI-assisted workflows that improve customer engagement, portfolio management, and decision-making. 

Evaluate emerging AI technologies and establish scalable best practices across analytics use cases. 

Analytics & Business Impact 

Translate complex business challenges into scalable analytics and machine learning solutions. 

Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities that improve customer retention, engagement, product adoption, and revenue growth. 

Develop analytical products and decision-support tools that enable proactive portfolio management. 

Perform exploratory data analysis and hypothesis testing to uncover insights and support model development. 

Communicate actionable insights, recommendations, and model outcomes to business and senior leadership teams. 

Measure, track, and quantify business impact from analytical initiatives. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

Partner closely with Portfolio Management & Customer Success, Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance & BI teams. 

Partner with Data Engineering and BI teams to identify, source, validate, engineer, and operationalize data assets and model features. 

Collaborate with Portfolio Analytics leadership and business leaders to prioritize use cases, drive model adoption, and ensure alignment with strategic objectives. 

Work with Data Engineering and MLOps teams to productionize and scale analytical solutions. 

Drive alignment across global stakeholders to ensure successful implementation and adoption. 

Experience 

4-5 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or related fields. 

Proven experience developing, deploying, and maintaining production-grade machine learning models. 

Experience in customer analytics, portfolio management, commercial analytics, CRM analytics, marketing analytics, or customer lifecycle management. 

Experience building predictive analytics solutions such as attrition/churn models, propensity models, customer segmentation, recommendation systems, forecasting solutions, customer lifetime value models, or Next Best Action frameworks. 

Experience or exposure to AI/GenAI solutions using LLMs, NLP, or related technologies to solve business problems. 

Experience working with large-scale customer, transaction, sales, or operational datasets. 

Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, uplift analysis, or impact measurement is desirable. 

Proven demonstration of analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in data-rich environments. 

Financial Services, Payments, FinTech, Banking, or related industry experience preferred. 

Technical & Domain Expertise 

Strong proficiency in Python and SQL. 

Strong understanding of machine learning, statistical modelling, feature engineering, and model validation. 

Experience applying predictive analytics techniques to customer, commercial, or portfolio management use cases. 

Experience with modern data science platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS SageMaker, or similar environments. 

Familiarity with MLOps practices including version control, model monitoring, and deployment processes. 

Exposure to AI/GenAI technologies, LLMs, NLP, or related frameworks. 

Ability to translate business problems into analytical approaches and actionable recommendations. 

Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills. 

Why Join Us 

Own and deliver high-impact machine learning and AI solutions used by global business teams. 

Influence customer growth, retention, portfolio optimization, and strategic decision-making across international markets. 

Partner directly with business leaders, technology teams, and analytics leaders to solve complex commercial challenges. 

Work with modern cloud, AI, and data science platforms including Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, GenAI, and LLM technologies. 

Help shape the future of AI-powered customer intelligence and portfolio analytics capabilities.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Job Description 
Role: Senior Project Manager 
Location: Kharadi, Pune 

Life Unlimited. At Smith+Nephew, we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living.
Initiate projects & mobilize project teams.
Create detailed project plans and assign project resources.
Manage day-to-day execution of projects. Manage delivery of agreed work products ensuring delivery to time, scope, cost & quality.
Execute risk and issue management processes, analyse the overall project performance and initiate mitigating actions where required.
Execute project close-down. Create final report (including lessons learned). Manage transition plan into Operations.
Effectively maintain the project scope through use of the agreed Change Control processes.
Accountable for sprint & scrum planning and delivery ensuring the agile development team operates smoothly without any problems.
Allow teams to self-organise and make changes quickly, in accordance with agile tools and techniques.
Helping the team to reach consensus for what can be achieved during a specific period of time. Establish, measure & maintain sprint velocity using Use Cases, Stories and Story Points.
Remove obstacles that impede progress.

What will you be doing? 
(15%) Change implementation planning and management - Ensures that there is a business perspective on how any new technical capabilities will be integrated into the business, including planning around key business cycles, selecting appropriate customers for migration, etc. Initiates the business implementation plan, including all the activities that the business needs to do to prepare for new technical components and technologies. Ensures sites deliver site implementation plans that align with the overall plan. Tracks and reports against these activities to ensure progress. Defines and manages the activities to ensure achievement of the projected business benefits after delivery. Outlines key business engagement messages that need to be communicated throughout the programme/project.
(15%) Contract management - Oversees and measures the fulfilment of contractual obligations. Uses key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor and challenge performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Develops strategies to address under-performance and compliance failures, including application of contract terms. Identifies where changes are required, evaluates the impact, and advises stakeholders about the implications and consequences for the business and/or the procurement element of programmes/projects. Negotiates variations and seeks appropriate authorisation. Actively supports and engages with experts and stakeholders to ensure continuous improvements are identified through review and benchmarking processes. Develops and implements change management protocols.
(50%) Project management - Takes full responsibility for the definition, documentation and successful completion of complex projects (typically with significant business, political, or high-profile impact, and high-risk dependencies). Adopts and adapts project management methods and tools, selecting appropriately from plan-driven/predictive approaches or more adaptive (iterative and agile) approaches. Ensures that effective project control, change control, risk management and testing processes are maintained. Monitors and controls resources, revenue and capital costs against the project budget and manages expectations of all project stakeholders.
(20%) Relationship management - Identifies the communications and relationship needs of stakeholder groups. Translates communications/stakeholder engagement strategies into specific activities and deliverables. Facilitates open communication and discussion between stakeholders, acting as a single point of contact by developing, maintaining and working to stakeholder engagement strategies and plans. Provides informed feedback to assess and promote understanding. Facilitates business decision-making processes. Captures and disseminates technical and business information.

What will you need to be successful? 
Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Operations or Information Technology.
Licenses/Certifications: PMI PMP, PMI ACP, Scrum Master preferred.
Experience: 8 years of senior IT project management experience within a global environment.

You Unlimited. 
We believe in crafting the greatest good for society. Our strongest investments are in our people and the patients we serve.
Inclusion + Belonging: - Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating, and Thriving. Learn more about our Employee Inclusion Groups on our website (https://www.smith-nephew.com/).
Other reasons why you will love it here! 
Your Future: Major medical coverage + policy exclusions and insurance non-medical limit. Educational Assistance.
Work/Life Balance: Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Privilege Leave, Floater Leave.
Your Wellbeing: Parents/Parents-in-Law’s Insurance (Employer Contribution of 8,000/- annually), Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave.
Flexibility : Hybrid Work Model (For most professional roles)
Training: Hands-On, Team-Customized, Mentorship
Extra Perks: Free Cab Transport Facility for all employees; One-Time Meal provided to all employees as per shift. Night shift allowances.
