title: Product Owner/Product Manager
description:
Product Owner Platform & Roadmap 

Position Title 

Product Owner – Platform & Roadmap

Reports To 

Associate VP of Product

Location 

Pune, India (Hinjawadi)

Employment 

Full-Time

Experience 

12–15 years total; 8+ years in product management; B2B SaaS experience mandatory

Delivery Model 

Scrum

Company Overview 
Culinary Digital, part of Fulcrum Worldwide, is a B2B SaaS company building the Operating System for Institutional Foodservice. Our platform serves 2.5M+ meals daily across seven verticals, including healthcare, senior living, K–12, higher education, corrections, and food service management companies.
Our products — CulinarySuite, CD MealPlanner, and CD Signage — connect procurement, inventory, recipes, production, compliance, and diner experience in one integrated system. We operate in regulated environments (HIPAA, HL7, USDA/NSLP, audit-ready corrections records) and are actively building AI and intelligence capabilities on an enterprise-scale platform.

Position Overview 
The Product Owner – Platform & Roadmap owns delivery of the committed product roadmap and the platform foundation that powers all Culinary Digital products. The role is accountable for outcomes, not activity: roadmap scope delivered, platform stability strengthened, and commitments met on schedule.
The role spans two layers:
Roadmap delivery — new modules and capabilities on the CulinarySuite roadmap, including AI-driven insights, operational modules (e.g., commissary and catering workflows), and enterprise client programme commitments.
Platform foundation — architecture-level improvements, data integrity, concurrency and infrastructure reliability, observability, and AI/data enablement.
This is a senior, technically strong PO role. You will make informed trade-offs with Engineering and Architecture, then explain those decisions in business terms to leadership, Client Delivery, and Sales.

Key Responsibilities 
Committed Roadmap Delivery 
Own the Platform & Roadmap backlog end to end — prioritised, groomed, and sprint-ready at all times
Drive delivery against agreed roadmap scope sprint over sprint, measured as items delivered vs. items committed into sprint
Conduct structured discovery before development; write user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria (Gherkin preferred)
Translate roadmap and client programme commitments into sequenced, deliverable increments
Platform Technical Delivery & Stability 
Partner with Engineering and Architecture to own the platform roadmap — scalability, reliability, and performance
Define requirements for architecture-level work, data integrity improvements, and concurrency/race-condition fixes that close defect classes at the root
Own data platform requirements — data models, data quality standards, pipeline reliability, and cloud DB/BI access for clients
Define requirements for AI and analytics capabilities, including governance and benchmarking
Drive observability, CI/CD, and environment readiness for compliance, load testing, and scaling
Lead root-cause analysis for critical incidents in owned areas; distinguish requirement gaps from engineering failures
Delivery Predictability 
Deliver committed sprint scope on schedule; flag risk at least one sprint ahead, never at sprint close
Sequence concurrent platform priorities with explicit trade-offs
Own Definition of Done enforcement for both feature releases and platform capability delivery
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Visibility 
Maintain a live dependency and risk tracker across Engineering, Product, QA, UX, and Client Delivery
Run a recurring sync cadence with teams affected by platform sequencing decisions
Communicate platform investment rationale to non-technical stakeholders in terms of business value
Support Client Delivery and Sales with release readiness artifacts — demo flows, release summaries, and CS briefs
Process & Documentation 
Document major decisions in real time — scope changes, architecture trade-offs, and reprioritisation rationale
Close the loop on deprioritised or rejected requests with documented reasoning
Present delivery outcomes and platform progress clearly in leadership forums

Qualifications 
Required 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
12–15 years of total experience, with a minimum of 8 years in product management (Product Owner / Product Manager roles)
Mandatory: hands-on product experience in a B2B SaaS company
Hands-on ownership of platform, infrastructure, or technical backlogs alongside customer-facing features
Strong understanding of web application architecture, APIs, databases, and integrations — enough to make informed trade-offs with Engineering
Proven delivery against committed sprint scope, with a track record of surfacing risk early
Proficiency with Jira or equivalent agile tooling
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to explain technical decisions to non-technical audiences
Based in Pune or willing to relocate
Preferred 
Exposure to data platforms — data pipelines, data quality, BI/reporting, or cloud database access
Experience defining requirements for AI/ML features, including benchmarking and governance
Familiarity with observability, CI/CD, and performance/load testing concepts
SAFe or LeSS exposure
Enterprise SaaS experience in regulated domains (healthcare/HIPAA, public sector, education)
Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent certification

What Success Looks Like 
Committed roadmap delivery rises sprint over sprint against an agreed target
Platform work measurably strengthens stability — root-cause fixes close defect classes rather than patching symptoms
Sprints have few surprises; risks are visible at least one sprint ahead
Leadership and dependent teams have a current, trusted view of platform dependencies and sequencing
Key decisions are documented as they happen, making the track's choices defensible and repeatable
Platform investments are articulated in business value, not just technical outcomes

Why Join Us 
Work on an enterprise-scale SaaS platform serving 2.5M+ meals daily across the US
Direct exposure to AI, data, and platform modernisation initiatives
Flat structure with direct access to product leadership
High-ownership culture with clear accountability and visible impact
Close collaboration with US-based client and leadership teams

title: Senior Business Analyst -Pricing
description:
About Medline India: 

Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development Centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500+ strong and growing team of technology, finance and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work by the Great Place to Work Institute (India) for the duration June 2025 June 2026. We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered & engaged team. We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges. 

About Medline Industries, LP: 

Established in 1966, Medline Industries LP is a renowned global healthcare organization boasting 56 years of consecutive sales growth, exceeding $21 billion in annual sales. With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care. At present, Medline Industries, LP holds the esteemed position as the #1 market leader, delivering an extensive portfolio of over 550,000 medical products and clinical solutions. Our clientele includes hospitals, extended care facilities, surgery centers, physician offices, home care agencies, providers, and retailers. We're proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Large Employers and Best Employers for Women. Additionally, the Chicago Tribune has consistently named us a Top Workplace for the past 12 years.

Role: Senior Business Analyst - Pricing 

Job Description: 
Develop and maintain analytical reports , dashboards, and performance metrics that provide actionable insights to support Customer Service (CS) operations and business decision-making across the EMEA region
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends , operational challenges, pricing opportunities, and areas for service improvement, translating findings into clear business recommendations.
Apply strong commercial acumen and technical expertise to evaluate customer, product, and operational performance, enabling data-driven decision-making.
Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to provide analytical support, performance insights, and recommendations that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
Ensure data accuracy , consistency, and integrity across reporting systems, dashboards, and analytical outputs while maintaining high-quality standards.
Leverage data modelling, reporting best practices, and analytical techniques to uncover meaningful insights and improve business performance.
Demonstrate critical thinking and problem-solving skills to investigate root causes, identify opportunities, and recommend sustainable solutions to operational challenges.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives by proactively identifying opportunities to enhance reporting, analytics frameworks, business processes, and automation capabilities.
Exhibit a high level of curiosity, attention to detail, and ownership while delivering accurate, insightful, and business-focused analytical outcomes.
Communicate complex analytical findings in a clear and concise manner , enabling stakeholders to make informed strategic and operational decisions.

Key Responsibilities: 
Develop and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, and KPIs to monitor pricing effectiveness and drive business performance. 
Analyze data to identify anomalies, revenue leakage, margin improvement opportunities, and profitability trends across customers, products, and markets. 
PRICING STRATEGY | DEAL PRICING | COMMERCIAL STRATEGY | REVENUE & MONETIZATION | PRICING ANALYTICS, Pricing Strategy & Optimization. 
Partner with Customer Success and business leadership teams to provide actionable insights and support strategic decision-making. 
Translate complex datasets into clear, concise business insights and recommendations that influence commercial outcomes. 
Design, enhance, and support dashboard solutions and reporting tools that enable data-driven decision-making. 
Drive process improvement and automation initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, and scalability. 
Apply strong data modelling, analytics, and reporting best practices to solve complex business challenges. 
Manage and validate pricing and business data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting platforms and databases. 
Deliver ad hoc analytical support and recommendations to commercial and leadership stakeholders.

Required Skills & Experience: 
Must have : 
6-10 years of experience in developing reporting solutions and utilizing advanced Business Intelligence tools for data analysis and reporting. 
Advanced proficiency in Tableau for creating, maintaining, and enhancing interactive dashboards and visualizations . 
Strong expertise in Microsoft Excel , including data formatting, formulas, lookups, and pivot tables . 
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict weekly and monthly reporting deadlines . 
Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy, report validation, and quality assurance . 
Ability to analyze complex datasets to identify trends, issues, gaps, and inconsistencies . 
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify, investigate, and resolve data discrepancies quickly and effectively . 
Demonstrated initiative with a passion for process improvement, automation, and operational efficiency . 
Ability to independently lead projects from concept to implementation , delivering measurable business value. 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present data-driven insights and recommendations to senior leadership and stakeholders . 
Strong analytical thinking, critical reasoning, and decision-making capabilities .
Good to have: 
Basic knowledge of VBA and Excel automation techniques . 
Ability to anticipate business challenges and proactively recommend solutions. 
Familiarity with data visualization and reporting tools beyond Tableau. 
Experience in business process improvement, operational excellence, or analytical initiatives . 
Understanding of database management systems, SQL concepts, and data structures . 
Exposure to process automation tools and workflow optimization methodologies . 
Experience working in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment with cross-functional stakeholders. 
Knowledge of continuous improvement practices and data-driven problem-solving approaches.
Working Hours: 
10.30 am to 7.30 pm – daylight saving. 
11.30 am to 8.30 pm – non daylight saving.

title: Senior Project Manager - Passive cabling & Data center
description:
Role & responsibilities :
1. Will be required to lead a team of experienced PMs/APMs /Senior Engineers/Tech in Pune region
2. Manage/Supervise/Monitor 5-10 projects at a given time in Maharashtra region with support from Help-desks/Service Coordinators 
3. Projects will include Data Centers/Large Campuses - Green field/ Brown Fields
4. Ensure daily/weekly progress updates/MIS reports to internal & external stakeholders
5. Monitor and manage OEM/Consultants' site audits and customer UAT processes
6. Will be physically meeting global customers/consultants/PMCs at sites across India and forge relationships on a long term basis
7. 10-12 days travel monthly on an average across India and more depending on the customer exigencies/deadlines
8. Will be required to build lasting relationships with Key OEMs tech leadership teams in India and overseas
9. Should be aware of HSE processes , Green Building norms and sustainability programs
10. Will have very sound knowledge of planning ahead, crisis management, Plan B and anticipate needs proactively before those become critical

1. Education : Full-time Engineering in Civil /Electrical/Industrial/MBA

3. Certification : Industry certifications/BICSI/AVIXA/PMI preferred
4. Software : Knowledge of AutoCAD/MS Project/Primavera desired along with sound Excel skills
5. Team Management : Proven track record of leading large tech teams and handling global MNC customer projects with 3-month - 12-month project life cycle

description:
Take ownership of significant corporate interior projects.
Work closely with management in a growing organisation.
Contribute to building stronger project delivery systems and processes. Role & responsibilities 
At Intezine, we deliver corporate interior projects where planning, coordination, execution and client experience are equally important. Key responsibilities 
Lead end-to-end execution of corporate interior projects, from mobilisation to final handover.
Plan project schedules, monitor progress and drive timely completion.
Coordinate with clients, architects, consultants, contractors, vendors and internal design and procurement teams.
Manage site teams, subcontractors, material planning and day-to-day execution challenges.
Monitor project costs, BOQs, billing, variations and resource utilisation.
Ensure quality, safety and compliance with project specifications.
Proactively identify risks, resolve bottlenecks and maintain clear project reporting.

712 years of experience, preferably in corporate or commercial interior fit-outs.
Strong understanding of civil, finishing, electrical, HVAC, firefighting and other MEP coordination.
Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and drive projects against tight deadlines.
Strong leadership, communication, planning and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in MS Project / Primavera / Excel for planning and tracking.
Someone who takes ownership, anticipates challenges and focuses on solutions rather than excuses. 

Perks and benefits 
Take ownership of significant corporate interior projects.
Work closely with management in a growing organisation.
Contribute to building stronger project delivery systems and processe

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role  
We are seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Manager to lead the digital marketing strategy and execution for VoXgent. This role will be responsible for building brand awareness, generating qualified enterprise leads, driving website traffic, managing digital campaigns, and supporting revenue growth through data-driven marketing initiatives. The ideal candidate has experience marketing B2B SaaS or Al products and is passionate about creating impactful campaigns across digital channels.

About VoXgent  
VoXgent is an enterprise Al platform that enables organizations to transform customer engagement through intelligent voice and chat agents. Built for enterprises, VoXgent integrates seamlessly with leading CRM, ERP, and business applications to automate customer support, sales, employee assistance, and business workflows using Generative Al.

Key Responsibilities  
Digital Marketing Strategy  
Develop and execute the digital marketing strategy aligned with business growth objectives. 
Build quarterly and annual marketing plans focused on pipeline generation. 
Define campaign goals, budgets, KPIs, and ROI targets. 
Demand Generation  
Plan and execute integrated demand generation campaigns across multiple -channels. 
Generate Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) for the sales team. 
Optimize lead nurturing workflows and marketing automation campaigns. 
Collaborate with Sales to improve lead conversion rates. 
Content Marketing  
Create and manage high-quality content including blogs, case studies, whitepapers, eBooks, landing pages, newsletters, and customer success stories. 
Develop messaging around Al, Conversational Al, Contact Center Automation,  Customer Experience, and Enterprise Automation. 
Coordinate product launches and feature announcements.
Website & SEO  
Manage and optimize the VoXgent website for user experience and conversions. 
Improve organic search rankings through SEO best practices. 
Monitor website performance and conversion metrics. 
Work with designers and developers to optimize landing pages.
Performance Marketing  
Manage Google Ads, Linkedin Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube campaigns, and retargeting initiatives. 
Optimize campaigns to maximize ROI, CPL, and conversion rates. 
Conduct A/B testing for ads, landing pages, and CTAs.
Social Media Marketing  
Develop and execute social media strategies across LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and other relevant platforms. 
Build thought leadership content around Al and enterprise automation. 
Grow followers, engagement, and brand visibility. 
Email Marketing & Marketing Automation  
Design email campaigns for lead nurturing, customer engagement, and product updates. 
Segment audiences and optimize email performance. 
Manage marketing automation workflows.
Events & Webinars  
Plan and promote webinars, product demos, virtual events, Lunch & Learn sessions, and industry conferences. 
Coordinate event marketing campaigns before, during, and after events. 
Measure event-generated pipeline and ROI. 
Analytics & Reporting  
Track campaign performance using Google Analytics, CRM dashboards, and marketing automation tools. 
Report on website traffic, lead generation, campaign ROI, CAC, CPL, and marketing attribution. 
Provide actionable recommendations based on data insights. 
Cross-functional Collaboration  
Partner with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to align messaging and campaigns. 
Support sales enablement through collateral, presentations, and competitive positioning. 
Work closely with external agencies and creative partners when required.
Required Qualifications  
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. 
5+ years of experience in digital marketing for B2B SaaS, Al, cloud, or enterprise technology products. 
Proven track record in lead generation and demand generation. 
Experience managing enterprise digital campaigns with measurable business outcomes. 
Strong understanding of SEO, SEM, email marketing, and marketing automation. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
Strong analytical and project management abilities.
Preferred Skills  
Experience marketing Al, Generative Al, Conversational Al, SaaS, or enterprise software products. 
Hands-on experience with Google Analytics, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Search Console, and Tag Manager. 
Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, or similar marketing automation platforms. 
Familiarity with CRM systems such as Salesforce. 
Basic knowledge of HTML, CMS platforms, and landing page optimization. 
Experience using Al tools for content creation, campaign optimization, and marketing analytics.
Key Competencies  
Strategic thinking 
Demand generation expertise 
Content storytelling 
Performance marketing 
Data-driven decision-making 
SEO and SEM proficiency 
Marketing automation 
Brand building 
Campaign management 
Collaboration and stakeholder management 
Creativity and innovation
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)  
Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) generated 
Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) influenced 
Pipeline generated from marketing campaigns 
Marketing-sourced revenue 
Website traffic growth 
Organic keyword rankings 
Landing page conversion rate 
Cost per Lead (CPL) 
Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) 
Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) 
Email open, click-through, and conversion rates 
Webinar registrations and attendance 
Social media engagement and follower growth 
Content downloads and lead conversions 
Marketing campaign ROI

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Digital Marketing Strategy: Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns to promote real estate projects, residential properties, redevelopment projects, and property launches.
Social Media Management: Manage company social media accounts, including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube. Plan and publish regular posts, reels, stories, and project updates.
Lead Generation: Generate qualified leads for ongoing real estate projects through digital platforms and ensure campaigns support sales targets.
Paid Advertising: Plan, execute, and monitor paid campaigns on Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads to generate property enquiries and site visits.
Content Creation & Coordination: Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, photographers, and agencies to develop creative posts, project videos, brochures, banners, and promotional content.
Website Management: Coordinate website updates, project landing pages, property details, enquiry forms, and SEO activities to improve online visibility.
Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Implement SEO strategies, keyword research, and local SEO activities to improve search rankings and website traffic.
Lead Tracking & Reporting: Monitor digital leads, cost per lead (CPL), campaign performance, conversions, and site visit enquiries. Prepare regular performance reports for management.

description:
Company: AiDamsole Agile Services Pvt. Ltd.
Location: Hinjewadi Phase 2, Pune
Work Mode: On-site
Experience: 13 Years
Salary: 25,000–30,000 per month
Industry Experience: Digital Marketing Agency Experience Mandatory

Job Summary 
We are looking for a performance-driven Digital Marketing Executive with strong hands-on experience in both Meta Ads and Google Ads. The ideal candidate must have prior experience working in a digital marketing agency and managing paid advertising campaigns for multiple clients.
Candidates with only theoretical knowledge, certification, or experience in just one advertising platform will not be suitable for this role.

Key Responsibilities 

Plan, execute, and manage paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads.
Manage campaigns for multiple clients across different industries.
Perform audience research, keyword research, campaign setup, budget allocation, and ad optimization.
Monitor campaign performance, including CPL, CPA, CTR, CPC, ROAS, and conversion rates.
Analyze campaign data and implement strategies to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs.
Create and test different ad creatives, copy, audiences, and campaign strategies.
Prepare performance reports and communicate campaign results to internal teams and clients when required.
Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action to achieve client targets.

Mandatory Skills 

Strong practical knowledge of Meta Ads Manager.
Hands-on experience with Google Ads, including Search and Display campaigns; Performance Max is an advantage.
Experience managing lead-generation and/or conversion campaigns.
Ability to analyze campaign metrics and optimize campaigns based on performance data.
Basic understanding of conversion tracking, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager.
Good English communication skills.
Previous experience in a digital marketing agency managing multiple client accounts.

Mandatory Requirements 

Minimum 1 year of relevant hands-on experience.
Practical expertise in both Meta Ads and Google Ads .
Digital marketing agency experience is compulsory.
Candidates must be able to explain campaigns they have personally managed, including budgets, results, optimization strategies, and lead-generation performance.
Candidates must be comfortable working from our Hinjewadi Phase 2, Pune office.

Preferred Candidates: Professionals who can independently manage paid campaigns, analyze performance, and deliver measurable results across multiple client accounts.

Job Location: Hinjewadi Phase 2, Pune
Job Type: Full-time | On-site

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Company: Insight Education Consultancy
Location: Baner, Pune, Maharashtra
Job Type: Full-Time | Work from Office
Experience: 5 Years
Salary: 35,000–45,000 per month (depending on experience and expertise)
About Insight Education Consultancy
Insight Education Consultancy is an education consultancy based in Baner, Pune, specializing in medical admissions guidance for NEET UG (MBBS) and NEET PG aspirants. We help students and parents navigate the medical admission process by providing guidance on college selection, counselling procedures, admission strategies, and related services.
We are looking for a results-driven Digital Marketing Expert who can strengthen our online presence, generate high-quality student enquiries, improve brand visibility, and drive business growth through digital marketing.
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in performance marketing, lead generation, social media management, and digital advertising, preferably in the education or consultancy industry.
Key Responsibilities
1. Performance Marketing & Paid Advertising
Plan, execute, and manage paid advertising campaigns on Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram).
Generate high-quality leads from students and parents seeking NEET UG MBBS and NEET PG admission guidance.
Manage advertising budgets efficiently to achieve the best possible cost per lead (CPL) and return on advertising spend (ROAS).
Develop and test different advertising creatives, landing pages, audience segments, and campaign strategies.
Monitor campaign performance and optimize campaigns to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and overall marketing ROI.
Implement remarketing campaigns to re-engage prospective students and parents.
2. Social Media Management
Manage and grow the company's presence on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other relevant social media platforms.
Develop a monthly social media content calendar aligned with admission cycles and marketing objectives.
Plan engaging content, including educational posts, reels, stories, admission updates, and student guidance videos.
Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, and content creators to produce high-quality marketing materials.
Monitor engagement, reach, follower growth, and audience behaviour.
Identify relevant trends and opportunities to increase organic reach and brand awareness.
3. Lead Generation & Conversion Optimization
Develop effective digital marketing strategies to generate qualified enquiries from NEET UG and NEET PG aspirants.
Understand the student admission journey and create targeted campaigns for different courses and admission requirements.
Collaborate with the counselling and telecalling teams to improve lead quality and lead-to-admission conversion rates.
Track leads from initial enquiry through counselling and admission wherever the necessary CRM and tracking systems are available.
Analyse lead quality and work with the sales team to identify opportunities for improvement.
Implement lead tracking, conversion tracking, and remarketing strategies.
4. SEO & Website Management
Improve the company's website visibility on Google through search engine optimization (SEO).
Conduct keyword research related to MBBS admissions, NEET UG counselling, NEET PG admissions, medical colleges, and admission consultancy services.
Optimize website pages, landing pages, blogs, and other content for relevant search queries.
Identify opportunities to improve organic traffic, website enquiries, and search rankings.
Monitor website performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and other relevant tools.
Coordinate with website developers to improve website speed, user experience, landing pages, and conversion rates.
5. Content Marketing & Brand Building
Develop digital marketing campaigns around important admission events, counselling rounds, deadlines, and college admission updates.
Work with the content and design teams to create informative and engaging content for students and parents.
Help establish Insight Education Consultancy as a trusted brand in medical admission counselling.
Develop campaign concepts, promotional strategies, and digital communication plans.
Ensure all marketing communications are accurate, professional, and consistent with the company's brand identity.
6. Analytics, Reporting & Strategy
Prepare weekly and monthly digital marketing performance reports.
Track key performance indicators (KPIs), including:
Advertising expenditure
Number of leads generated
Cost per lead (CPL)
Qualified leads
Cost per qualified lead
Website traffic and organic rankings
Social media reach and engagement
Counselling conversions and admissions attributed to marketing campaigns
Analyse campaign data and recommend strategies to improve performance.
Maintain proper tracking and reporting of marketing campaigns across platforms.
Identify new digital marketing opportunities and competitor strategies.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Educational Qualification: 
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or a related field.
Relevant certifications in Google Ads, Meta Ads, or digital marketing will be an advantage.
Technical Skills: 
Hands-on experience with Google Ads.
Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager.
Knowledge of SEO and keyword research.
Experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
Understanding of landing page optimization and conversion tracking.
Knowledge of social media marketing and content planning.
Familiarity with CRM systems and lead management processes.
Basic understanding of Canva or other creative tools is an advantage.
Knowledge of Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and remarketing is preferred.
Professional Skills: 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and coordination skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple campaigns.
A results-oriented approach with a focus on lead quality and business growth.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, particularly during peak admission and counselling seasons.
Preferred Candidate Profile
We are particularly interested in candidates who:
Have previously worked with education consultancies, coaching institutes, edtech companies, or admission counselling businesses.
Have experience generating leads for high-value services.
Understand the Indian education market and student acquisition strategies.
Can demonstrate previous campaign results through actual performance data.
Understand the difference between generating a large number of leads and generating leads that convert into paying customers.
Can independently plan, execute, analyse, and optimize digital marketing campaigns.
Important: Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical experience in running digital advertising campaigns. Candidates with only theoretical knowledge or social media posting experience, without performance marketing expertise, may not be suitable for this position.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The candidate will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes rather than simply the number of posts published or campaigns launched.
Performance AreaKey Performance IndicatorPaid AdvertisingCost per lead and cost per qualified leadLead GenerationNumber of relevant student and parent enquiriesLead QualityPercentage of leads meeting the company's qualification criteriaLead ConversionContribution to counselling bookings and admissionsGoogle AdsCampaign efficiency and conversion performanceMeta AdsLead generation efficiency and campaign ROISEOGrowth in relevant organic traffic and search visibilitySocial MediaReach, engagement, and relevant audience growthReportingAccuracy and timeliness of weekly and monthly reports
Targets should be finalized after reviewing the company's existing marketing performance, advertising budget, lead-to-admission conversion rate, and seasonal demand.
Salary & Benefits
Salary: 35,000–45,000 per month, depending on experience and demonstrated results.
Performance-based incentives may be offered for achieving agreed marketing targets.
Opportunity to take ownership of digital marketing strategy and contribute directly to business growth.
Full-time, work-from-office position at Baner, Pune.
Candidates with a strong track record in performance marketing and lead generation may be considered for a higher salary based on their capabilities.

You'll design, build, and own features across both the Javamicroservices platform and the .Net-based MarTech/content integration layer, as priorities require 
You'll build front-end components (Angular or React) for both areas of the stack

Our Software Engineers personify the notion of constant improvement as they work with their team to build software that delivers on our mission to improve student outcomes

Experience with Database and Caching technologies such as MySQL/SQL Server, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, and Redis

Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable business insights.
Interpret business requirements and translate them into effective analytical solutions.
Gather and document requirements from stakeholders and business users.
Design, develop, and implement interactive dashboards and reports.
Create meaningful data visualizations to support business decision-making.
Collaborate with US-based clients and stakeholders on a day-to-day basis.

Present analytical findings, insights, and recommendations to business and technical teams.
Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure deliverables align with business objectives.

5+ years of relevant experience in the following areas:
Data Analysis
Data Interpretation
Data Visualization
Requirements Gathering
Dashboard Development and Implementation

Prior experience working and coordinating with US-based clients or stakeholders.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Python
Tableau
Experience in the Finance or Wealth Management domain

Technical assessment covering SQL, data analysis, data visualization, and dashboard development.

Assessment of stakeholder interaction, communication skills, and overall suitability for the client-facing role.

title: Data Analyst Trainee
description:
Job Summary: 
We are seeking a Data Analyst specializing in email marketing to analyze campaign performance, generate insights, and provide recommendations that optimize our email marketing strategies. You will be responsible for analyzing customer data, segmenting audiences, and helping design email campaigns that drive customer engagement and achieve business goals.

Key Responsibilities: 
Analyze and evaluate the performance of email marketing campaigns, including open rates, click-through rates, conversion rates, bounce rates, and unsubscribe rates.
Develop detailed reports and dashboards on email campaign performance to track KPIs and identify trends.
Segment email audiences based on demographic, behavioral, and transactional data to improve campaign targeting and personalization.
Work closely with marketing and creative teams to recommend data-driven strategies for optimizing email content, frequency, and design.
Conduct A/B testing on email subject lines, content, designs, and calls to action to identify the most effective elements.
Monitor and analyze customer engagement across various email campaigns to understand what drives action.
Use tools like Google Analytics, email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, HubSpot, etc.), and data visualization tools to track, analyze, and report performance.

title: Data Scientist
description:
The Apollo Hospitals Family 
Set-up in 1983 by Dr. Prathap C. Reddy, renowned as the architect of modern healthcare in India. As the nations first corporate hospital, Apollo Hospitals is acclaimed for pioneering the private healthcare revolution in the country.
Apollo Hospitals has emerged as Asia’s foremost integrated healthcare services provider and has a robust presence across the healthcare ecosystem, including Hospitals, Pharmacies, Primary Care & Diagnostic Clinics and several retail health models. The cornerstones of Apollo’s legacy are its unstinting focus on clinical excellence, affordable costs, modern technology and forward-looking research & academics.

Role Description 
The Data Scientist designs, implements and manages enterprise AI and data science frameworks at Apollo, enabling advanced analytics, machine learning models and predictive insights across non-clinical domains such as finance, marketing and operations. The role drives AI-infused business outcomes articulated in the AOP FY27, including retention AI, medical tourism engine, SGE optimisation, revenue integrity, propensity-to-pay and contact centre copilot.

Detailed Job Responsibility & Accountabilities 
Design, build and deploy machine learning models for finance, marketing and operational use cases.
Partner with business functions to identify AI opportunities aligned to the AOP FY27 plan and translate them into model specifications.
Lead retention AI models analysing EMR data to identify drop-out risk for chronic disease patients.
Build propensity-to-pay models, lead-funnel optimisation models and high-value lost-lead detection.
Collaborate with data engineers to curate training datasets and productionise feature pipelines.
Drive model performance engineering — accuracy, precision, recall, calibration, fairness and drift monitoring.
Productionise models using MLOps practices — CI/CD for models, registry, monitoring and rollback.
Ensure data integrity, privacy (DPDP) and regulatory compliance in every model lifecycle.
Publish model documentation, model cards and explainability artifacts.
Contribute to GenAI and agentic AI use cases as they emerge in the platform roadmap.
Measure and report business impact of deployed models.

Desired Skills & Competencies 
Must have 5+ years in applied data science and machine learning.
Must have strong Python skills and proficiency with ML libraries (scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch/TensorFlow).
Must have experience with feature engineering, model evaluation and MLOps.
Must have exposure to Azure ML, Databricks ML, MLflow or equivalent platforms.
Must have strong SQL and data wrangling skills.
Must have working knowledge of statistical inference, A/B testing and causal analysis.
Preferred exposure to GenAI, LLMs, RAG, vector databases and agentic frameworks.
Preferred healthcare, marketing analytics or finance domain exposure.

Job Performance Parameters 
Model delivery and adoption (25%)
Model performance — accuracy, precision, recall (25%)
Production readiness — MLOps maturity (20%)
Stability and monitoring (15%)
Data integrity and compliance (15%)
Business impact of deployed models

Managerial and Behavioral Competencies 
Analytical and experimental rigour
Effective Communication with business users
Team Spirit
Long term effective decision making
Continuous learning on evolving AI landscape

title: Senior GCP DevOps Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities :

Own production GKE architecture and lifecycle: clusters, node pools, autoscaling, storage, networking, add-ons, Kubernetes version upgrades, and worker-node patching. 
- Design and execute low- or zero-downtime GKE upgrades and node migrations using surge/blue-green strategies, PodDisruptionBudgets, probes, graceful termination, safe drain/cordon practices, rollback plans, and verified capacity headroom. 
- Optimize infrastructure through machine-family selection and migrations , node sizing and topology, requests/limits, bin packing, Cluster Autoscaler/HPA/KEDA tuning, quota/reservation planning, and cost analysis. 
- Design high-availability and disaster-recovery patterns across zones and regions, including regional/multi-zone GKE, multi-region failover options, backup/restore strategy, recovery testing, and RTO/RPO planning. 
- Partner with application teams to make workloads disruption-tolerant through replica design, readiness/startup behavior, preStop and termination handling, StatefulSet/storage considerations, dependency management, and safe rolling deployment patterns. 
- Lead DevOps and vulnerability remediation across container images, OS packages, application libraries, and platform components using secure base images, checks, registry scanning, patching, IAM/RBAC, secrets, certificates, and TLS controls. 
- Own observability and incident response using Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, ELK/Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, and Kubernetes metrics; build actionable alerts, reduce noise, lead RCA, and drive post-incident fixes. 
- Operate production Kafka platforms, including broker resiliency, rolling restarts, producer/consumer behavior, quotas/rate limits, consumer lag, JMX monitoring, storage capacity, KEDA scaling, and failure-recovery testing. 
- Support stateful platform services such as MongoDB, Solr, Redis, and Elasticsearch, including backup lifecycle, restore validation, replication, capacity planning, and version/upgrade compatibility. 
- Build and improve GitLab CI/CD pipelines, Docker images, Kubernetes manifests, Python/Bash automation, Terraform-based infrastructure, and Helm/Kustomize packaging so changes are repeatable, reviewed, and auditable. 
- Troubleshoot Linux, GKE, networking, DNS, load balancing/Ingress, certificates, VPN/private connectivity, service accounts, storage, and application-to-platform integration issues across environments.
- Own infrastructure-impacting production changes from risk assessment and runbook preparation through validation and stakeholder communication; translate client/business requirements into practical platform solutions and explain trade-offs clearly. 
- Mentor junior engineers, review infrastructure and automation changes, strengthen engineering standards and documentation, and provide technical direction across the DevOps team.

Preferred candidate profile 
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
- 6+ years of DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure experience with hands-on ownership of production systems. 
- Deep Google Cloud and production GKE experience. This is a GCP/GKE-focused role; EKS/AKS experience without strong GKE depth is not sufficient.
- Advanced Kubernetes administration: node pools, scheduling, autoscaling, PDBs, probes, pod lifecycle, Deployments/StatefulSets, storage/PVCs, RBAC, networking, cordon/drain behavior, upgrades, and API deprecations. 
- Proven experience executing GKE upgrades, node/machine-family migrations, patching, and maintenance with minimal application disruption. 
- Strong GCP infrastructure knowledge across Compute Engine, VPC, load balancing, IAM/service accounts, DNS, certificates, Artifact Registry, quotas/reservations, and monitoring/logging. 
- Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, routing, firewalls, and load balancing. 
- Hands-on Python/Bash automation, Git, GitLab CI/CD, Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes deployment/configuration practices. - Hands-on Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, and ELK experience for production monitoring and troubleshooting. 
- Production Kafka experience and a strong understanding of distributed-system reliability, backpressure, consumer lag, capacity, and recovery behavior.

Strong stakeholder management across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Design
Track record using prioritization frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, or similar)
Proficiency with product analytics tools and PM platforms (Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar)
Healthcare or B2B SaaS experience is a plus

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description: Marketing Manager / Performance Marketing Specialist Company: Lemonpeak Marketing Services Pvt. Ltd.
Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu
Work Mode: Work from Office – No Work from Home
Shift: US Night Shift
Weekly Off: Rotational / Business-Driven – No Fixed Weekly Off
Experience: 3–6 years (preferred)
Employment Type: Full-time
About Lemonpeak Lemonpeak is a digital marketing and technology company focused on performance-driven customer acquisition, lead generation, and technology solutions for international markets. We are looking for a data-driven marketing professional with strong experience in US B2C marketing, paid advertising, campaign optimization, and team management.
Role Overview The Marketing Manager / Performance Marketing Specialist will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns targeting the US B2C market. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads), strong analytical skills, and the ability to lead a team toward achieving campaign performance targets.
This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, hands-on campaign management, data analysis, and people management.
Key Responsibilities1. Performance Marketing & Campaign Management Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads).

Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, audience targeting, keywords, search terms, and ad performance.

Drive measurable results across lead generation, inbound calls, customer acquisition, and other campaign objectives.

Monitor key performance indicators, including cost per lead, cost per call, conversion rate, campaign spend, lead quality, and return on ad spend.

Identify opportunities to scale successful campaigns while maintaining target acquisition costs.

Ensure campaigns comply with advertising policies, brand guidelines, and platform requirements.

2. Data Analysis & Reporting Analyze campaign data to identify trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

Build and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports and dashboards.

Use Microsoft Excel extensively for data analysis, reporting, pivot tables, lookup functions, data reconciliation, and performance tracking.

Work with analytical tools, dashboards, and spreadsheets to support data-driven decision-making.

Present actionable insights and recommendations to management based on campaign performance.

Track budget utilization, forecast campaign performance, and investigate fluctuations in key metrics.

3. Team Management & Leadership Lead, mentor, and manage a team of marketing executives and campaign specialists.

Set daily, weekly, and monthly targets and monitor individual and team performance.

Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and improve team productivity.

Allocate tasks, manage workloads, and ensure timely execution of marketing activities.

Establish reporting processes, performance standards, and accountability within the team.

Coordinate with sales and operations teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and overall campaign outcomes.

4. Campaign Optimization & Process Improvement Conduct keyword research, search-term analysis, competitor analysis, and campaign audits.

Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective actions.

Develop and test ad copy, landing pages, bidding strategies, and campaign structures.

Monitor conversion tracking and work with relevant teams to resolve tracking discrepancies.

Continuously improve campaign efficiency through structured experimentation and performance analysis.

Required Qualifications & Skills 3–6 years of experience in digital marketing or performance marketing, preferably in a B2C environment.

Hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads) campaigns.

Proven experience marketing products or services to customers in the US market .

Prior experience managing, mentoring, or supervising a marketing team.

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookup functions, conditional formulas, data cleaning, and reporting.

Experience with data visualization or analytics tools such as Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio, Power BI, or equivalent.

Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to interpret campaign data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

Strong communication, leadership, and decision-making skills.

Ability to work independently in a target-driven environment and manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.

Willingness to work night shifts from the Chennai office and work on a rotational weekly-off schedule.

Preferred Qualifications Experience in US B2C lead generation, inbound call campaigns, or call-driven acquisition.

Experience managing high-budget paid advertising campaigns.

Familiarity with call tracking, CRM platforms, conversion tracking, and attribution tools.

Experience with Meta Ads or other paid acquisition channels.

Understanding of landing-page optimization, conversion funnels, and lead-quality analysis.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated based on:
Campaign spend and budget utilization.

Cost per lead / cost per call and customer acquisition cost.

Lead quality and conversion performance.

Campaign efficiency and return on advertising spend, where applicable.

Team productivity and achievement of assigned targets.

Accuracy and timeliness of reports.

Campaign scaling, optimization improvements, and compliance.

Consistency in execution and team development.

Work Schedule & Conditions The position is based at the Lemonpeak office in Chennai.

This is a US night-shift role; candidates must be comfortable working during US business hours.

Work from home and hybrid arrangements are not available.

Weekly offs will be rotational or determined by business requirements; fixed Saturday/Sunday offs cannot be guaranteed.

Candidates should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-oriented environment.

Who Should Apply? We are looking for a hands-on marketing leader who understands advertising platforms, can analyze numbers in depth, and knows how to get results through a team. Candidates who combine strong campaign execution with analytical thinking, ownership, and people-management skills will be a strong fit.
To apply: Submit your updated resume highlighting your Google Ads and Bing Ads experience, US B2C campaign exposure, team size managed, campaign budgets handled, and measurable performance achievements.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
*About the Role* 

Wisdom Properties is looking for a Digital Marketing Executive who can independently create landing pages and manage digital advertising campaigns for our residential plot and real estate projects. 

The candidate should be able to generate quality enquiries, connect leads to our CRM, and work with the sales team to improve site visits and bookings. 

*Key Responsibilities* 

- Create and maintain attractive, mobile-friendly landing pages using WordPress, Elementor, or similar platforms. 
- Add enquiry forms, WhatsApp buttons, click-to-call buttons, and clear calls to action. 
- Plan, launch, and optimise paid advertising campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, and Google. 
- Manage campaign budgets, audience targeting, retargeting, and creative testing. 
- Prepare advertising copy, social media posts, basic graphics, and short promotional videos using Canva and video-editing tools. 
- Set up and verify Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking. 
- Connect landing-page leads with Sell.do CRM and troubleshoot lead-capture issues. 
- Coordinate with sales executives and telecallers to assess lead quality and campaign results. 
- Track advertising spend, cost per lead, qualified enquiries, site visits, and bookings. 
- Maintain social media pages and prepare weekly performance reports. 
- Ensure advertising content reflects approved project details accurately. 

*Required Qualifications and Skills* 

- Any graduate with relevant practical experience. 
- Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns. 
- Proven ability to build landing pages independently. 
- Working knowledge of WordPress, Elementor, forms, hosting, and domain configuration. 
- Knowledge of conversion tracking, CRM integration, and campaign reporting. 
- Ability to write clear promotional content in English and Tamil. 
- Basic graphic design and video-editing skills. 
- Ability to manage multiple project campaigns and meet deadlines. 

*Preferred Qualifications* 

- Experience in real estate marketing or sales lead generation. 
- Experience working with Sell.do or a similar CRM. 
- Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS, SEO, and landing-page speed optimisation. 
- Relevant Google Ads or Meta certifications.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Company details 
Website - https://www.theadaffair.com/ 

Founder - https://www.linkedin.com/in/muktham/ 

About the Role 
The Ad Affair is looking for a Senior Graphic Designer to lead the creative output for our portfolio of D2C and B2B brands. You will own the visual direction for your brands, set the creative standard for static ads, social content and brand systems, and work alongside performance marketers and brand managers to produce work that looks sharp and moves numbers. This is a hands-on senior role: you will still design daily, but you will also shape concepts, guide junior designers and be accountable for the quality that goes out the door.

Role & Responsibilities 
Own the visual direction for assigned brands and translate positioning into a consistent design language.
Lead the design of static ad creatives, social posts, stories and carousels across multiple client brands.
Build and maintain brand identity systems, logos, style guides and marketing collateral.
Turn marketing briefs, customer insight and campaign angles into strong creative concepts, not just executions.
Design landing page graphics, banners, email creatives and presentation decks.
Drive creative testing: develop performance led variations, review what is working with the media team and feed learnings back into the next round.
Review and give feedback on the work of junior designers, and raise the bar on layout, typography and finish.
Set up and maintain file structures, templates, source assets and version control so the team can move fast.
Partner with copywriters, video editors and the performance team to deliver integrated campaigns end to end.
Manage timelines across multiple brands and keep delivery predictable during high volume periods.
Use Ai tools to design, create videos and build efficient workflows to delivery high volume of designs and videos

Preferred Candidate Profile 
3 to 6 years of hands-on graphic design experience, preferably in an agency or D2C environment.
Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma, Canva.
A strong portfolio showing ad creatives, social content and brand identity work, with a clear point of view.
Excellent sense of layout, typography, colour and visual hierarchy, plus the judgement to know when a design is done.
Proven experience designing for paid social performance and understanding what makes a creative convert.
Ability to handle multiple brands at pace without dropping quality or consistency.
Comfortable mentoring juniors, reviewing work and communicating feedback clearly.
Quick and confident with AI design tools (such as Claude, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly and Canva AI) to speed up ideation and production.
Able to present and defend creative decisions in front of internal teams and clients.
Bonus: motion graphics, video editing, or experience building creative systems and templates at scale.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Job Title: Data Analyst (Senior Executive) 
Location: Gurgaon 
Department: Data ENOC 
Reports To: Data Lead 
Job Summary: 
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical MIS/Data Analyst to join our team. The ideal 
candidate will be responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to provide 
actionable insights and support strategic decision-making. This role involves managing and 
optimizing MIS systems, generating accurate reports, and ensuring the integrity of organizational 
data. 
Key Responsibilities: 
1. Data Management and Analysis: 
Collect, organize, and analyze data from various sources to generate meaningful insights. 
Identify trends, patterns, and correlations in datasets to support business decisions. 
Develop dashboards, visualizations, and reports to communicate findings effectively. 
2. MIS Development and Maintenance: 
Design, implement, and maintain Management Information Systems (MIS) for efficient 
data collection and reporting. 
Collaborate with Infra, Operations and other departments to enhance system functionality 
and user experience. 
Troubleshoot system issues and ensure data accuracy and security. 
3. Reporting and Performance Monitoring: 
Generate daily, weekly, and monthly reports on key performance indicators (KPIs). 
Monitor operational performance metrics and provide actionable recommendations for 
improvement. 
¢ Automate repetitive reporting tasks to improve efficiency. 
4. Stakeholder Collaboration: 
¢ Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and deliver 
customized reports. 
¢ Support senior management by providing data-driven insights and presentations. 
¢ Train and support end-users in leveraging MIS tools and reports. 
5. Compliance and Data Integrity: 
¢ Ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory data standards. 
¢ Conduct regular audits to maintain data accuracy and integrity. 
¢ Implement best practices for data governance and security. 
Qualification: 
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Business 
Administration, or a related field. A Masters degree is a plus. 
Experience: 
5+ years of experience in MIS, data analysis, or a related role. 
Proven experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and databases 
(e.g., SQL, MySQL). 
Hands-on experience with reporting tools and software (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets, 
Powerpoint). 
Skills: 
¢ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
¢ Proficiency in programming languages like Python, R, or SQL is an advantage. 
¢ Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel (e.g., pivot tables, 
VLOOKUP, macros). 
¢ Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
¢ Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 
Certifications: 
¢ Relevant certifications in data analytics, business intelligence, or MIS are preferred (e.g., 
Tableau Certification, Google Data Analytics Certificate). 

Please share your updated resume at mandakini@nikosconsulting.com if you are interested in this opportunity. 

Best Regards
Mandakini

title: Senior AI Data Scientist / Gen AI
description:
Job Title: Senior AI Data Scientist / Gen AI 
Experience: 8+ Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Industry: IT Services / Healthcare Technology / Data Analytics

Job Summary: 
We are looking for an experienced Senior AI Data Scientist / AI Analytics Lead to develop and scale an enterprise-grade Conversational Analytics Platform for a leading healthcare and Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) business.
The role involves building GenAI-powered analytics solutions, developing RAG pipelines, designing semantic layers, and enabling natural language interaction with enterprise data hosted on Snowflake.

Key Responsibilities: 

Deep experience across two or more of GCP, Azure, AWS, OpenAI, or Anthropic Claude.
Design and develop Generative AI and Conversational Analytics solutions using LLMs.
Build and optimize RAG pipelines, NLP models, chatbots, and AI-powered assistants.
Develop semantic layers and business data models for enterprise analytics.
Work with Snowflake, Python, SQL, vector databases, and embedding technologies.
Implement prompt engineering, agentic AI workflows, and LLM orchestration.
Develop and optimize ML models for predictive analytics, forecasting, and anomaly detection.
Establish LLMOps/MLOps practices, model evaluation, monitoring, and deployment frameworks.
Collaborate with architects, data engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.
Ensure conversational accuracy, scalability, governance, and responsible AI implementation.

Required Technical Skills: 
8+ years of experience in Data Science, AI/ML, or AI Engineering.
3+ years of hands-on experience in Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
Strong expertise in Python, SQL, and Snowflake.
Experience with NLP, Transformers, Embeddings, Vector Search, and RAG.
Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of Semantic Layer, Data Modelling, and Conversational AI.
Experience with OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
Exposure to cloud platforms, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.

Preferred Skills: 
Experience in Healthcare Analytics, Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM), or Pharmacy Claims.
Knowledge of Azure AI Services, Databricks, dbt, and Power BI/Tableau.
Experience in Agentic AI, Multi-Agent Frameworks, and enterprise AI product development.
Understanding of healthcare data governance and compliance.

Ideal Candidate: 
A technically strong AI professional with proven experience in taking GenAI solutions from Proof of Concept (POC) to enterprise-scale production deployment, along with strong analytical and stakeholder management capabilities.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the role 
We are hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and evolve the deployment of our AI-powered application modernization platform (NEXUS) into client production environments. This role is a unique hybrid of Platform Engineering and Technical Advisory. You will not only design the underlying multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) but also partner directly with client IT groups to establish SysOps frameworks. You will leverage our AI-driven automation tools to provision infrastructure, integrate AIOps for anomaly detection and remediation, and ensure clients receive seamless product updates via our Helm-based delivery pipeline.
This is a senior individual contributor role that requires a "product mindset"you are designing for scale, security, and long-term operational sustainability in client environments.
What you will do 
Client Collaboration & SysOps Partnership 
Serve as the primary technical partner to client IT groups, guiding them on best practices for operating bespoke NEXUS implementations.
Work with client-aligned delivery teams to manage the lifecycle of the platform, ensuring timely and reliable product updates via Helm charts.
Collaborate with client stakeholders to tailor infrastructure and operational workflows, ensuring NEXUS integrates seamlessly with their existing enterprise monitoring and ticketing systems.
AI-Driven Automation & AIOps Integration 
Build & Leverage AI for Provisioning: Architect and implement AI-assisted workflows to automate the provisioning and configuration of infrastructure across multi-cloud environments.
AIOps Implementation: Integrate and adopt 3Pillar’s AIOps platform into client ecosystems to enable proactive, automated anomaly detection and incident remediation.
Knowledge Base Evolution: Maintain and refine the AIOps knowledge base, training agents to perform accurate root-cause analysis (RCA) and automate recurring issue resolution.1
Platform & Multi-Cloud Development 
Evolve our Helm-based platform layer and Terraform module libraries to support standardized, secure deployment patterns across AWS, Azure, and GCP.12
Design for "Delegation": Move our automation from simple execution to self-adapting workflows that handle ambiguity and get smarter over time.3
Ensure all infrastructure-as-code and automated remediation scripts meet rigorous enterprise security and compliance standards, including PII access logging and least-privilege IAM.
Our technology stack 
You should be comfortable working with most of the following (or able to ramp quickly):
Area 
Technologies 
IaC 
Terraform (>= 1.5), remote state (S3 + DynamoDB), module versioning via Git tags
Cloud 
AWS (primary for client deployments): EKS, VPC, NLB, EFS, ECR, Route 53, KMS, IAM/IRSA • Azure: AKS, Key Vault, ACR, VNet • GCP: GKE, Artifact Registry
Kubernetes 
Production cluster operations, storage classes, ingress, HPA, troubleshooting CrashLoop / init failures
Packaging 
Helm (umbrella charts, atomic releases), feature-flag-driven deployments
Platform services 
HashiCorp Vault, Keycloak, OAuth2 Proxy, cert-manager, Zalando Postgres Operator, Neo4j, Redis Operator, Strimzi Kafka, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki, Apache Airflow, MinIO
Application platform 
Python/FastAPI backend, React frontend, MCP server, background workers, retrieval/RAG services; container images on a private registry (e.g. GHCR)
CI/CD & GitOps 
GitHub Actions, Flux (internal environments), image signing (Cosign)
Observability & ops 
kubectl, helm, structured logging (Loki), metrics/alerts, operational runbooks
Security 
TLS (Let's Encrypt DNS-01), secrets via Vault/VSO, SSO/OIDC, VPN / CIDR-based ingress controls
Required experience 
Client-Facing Advisory & Enablement: Proven experience in a technical advisory or client-facing engineering role. You are comfortable partnering with client IT teams, guiding them through technical adoption, and translating complex platform requirements into operational success.
DevOps & Infrastructure Expertise: 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering. You possess production-grade Terraform experience—architecting modular, multi-cloud IaC frameworks that enable consistent, repeatable deployments across different environments.
AIOps & Observability: Hands-on experience integrating or managing AIOps platforms or automated observability stacks. You understand the lifecycle of incident response, anomaly detection, and automated remediation.
AI-Driven Automation: Demonstrated experience building automation workflows. You don’t just write scripts; you build systems that reduce manual operational toil and empower users through self-service provisioning and automated configuration.
Platform Engineering at Scale: Deep expertise in Kubernetes and Helm. You have a track record of deploying and operating complex, multi-service platforms and managing their lifecycle (chart development, values layering, atomic releases).
Foundational Cloud Operations: Proven AWS expertise (EKS, networking, IAM/IRSA) with a strong aptitude for multi-cloud environments (Azure/GCP).
Identity & Security: Solid experience with secrets management (HashiCorp Vault or similar) and identity/SSO integration (Keycloak/OIDC).
Communication & Mentorship: Excellent written and verbal communication. You are able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and mentor teams on best practices.
Strongly preferred / nice to have 
Consultative Experience: Prior work as a Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager, or Implementation Engineer in a SaaS or Managed Services environment.
AI/LLM Infrastructure: Experience managing infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, including GPU node pools, vector databases (e.g., Neo4j), or RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
GitOps & Lifecycle: Hands-on experience with GitOps methodologies (Flux, Argo CD) for managing continuous deployment at scale.
Enterprise Compliance: Experience operating within regulated or enterprise environments (PII logging, audit trails, network isolation, SOC2/compliance-heavy workflows).
Kafka & Distributed Systems: Experience with event streaming platforms (e.g., Strimzi/Kafka) or specialized operators for stateful services.
What success looks like in your first 6–12 months 
Successful enablement of client IT teams to independently manage and operate the NEXUS platform.
Quantifiable reduction in manual operational toil for clients through the successful adoption of AIOps-driven anomaly detection and automated remediation.
Seamless, low-friction delivery of platform updates via automated Helm-based pipelines.
Deployment of robust, AI-provisioned infrastructure stacks that adapt to client-specific demands while maintaining security and compliance.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
About the role 
We are looking for a highly detail-oriented, execution-focused, and analytically strong Project Manager to join our online market research operations team. This role is central to the successful delivery of quantitative research studies across global markets, predominantly the US, UK, and international B2B/B2C ecosystems.
The ideal candidate should possess strong end-to-end ownership capabilities across project execution, client servicing, scripting coordination, sample management, data quality validation, and reporting workflows. This is not a coordination-only role we are looking for someone who understands the operational, logical, and analytical nuances of online research and can proactively drive projects with speed, accountability, and precision.
The role demands high agility, strong multi-tasking ability, operational maturity, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment handling multiple concurrent studies with strict timelines.

Role- Senior Project Manager (Online Market Research Operations) 
Location- Gurugram (Work from Office) 

Key Responsibilities 
End-to End Project Ownership 
Independently manage the complete lifecycle of quantitative online research projects from kickoff to final delivery.
Ensure projects are launched, monitored, validated, and delivered within timelines while adhering to client requirements and internal quality standards.
Maintain complete ownership of project execution including timelines, feasibility alignment, scripting coordination, field management, quotas, data checks, tabulation planning, and reporting coordination.
Drive proactive communication internally and externally throughout all project phases.
Client Servicing & Stakeholder Management 
Serve as the primary operational point of contact for clients during active project execution.
Interpret client objectives, research intent, questionnaire requirements, and reporting expectations accurately.
Ensure timely acknowledgement and resolution of client requests, revisions, and escalations.
Build confidence with clients through responsiveness, attention to detail, consultative thinking, and execution reliability.
Questionnaire Review & Research Logic Understanding 
Review questionnaires thoroughly for logic consistency, research flow, respondent experience, and data quality implications before scripting.
Possess strong understanding of:
Complex skip logic
Piping and randomization
Rotations and masking
Quota structures
Validation conditions
Multi-level logic dependencies
Mobile optimization
Grid optimization
Conjoint and MaxDiff structures
Brand lists and segmentation frameworks
Identify gaps, contradictions, or potential respondent biases proactively before launch.
Scripting Coordination & Survey Validation 
Work closely with Survey Programming teams and possess operational exposure to platforms such as Decipher and related survey ecosystems.
Coordinate testing and validation for:
Survey logic
Quota controls
Redirects
URL parameters
API variables
Security checks
Device compatibility
Open-end validations
Conduct multiple rounds of pre-launch QA across logic, aesthetics, respondent flow, language handling, and overall user experience before exposing links to clients or sample partners.
Ensure all client comments and revisions are implemented accurately and validated thoroughly.
Sample & Vendor Management 
Coordinate with internal panel assets and external sample/vendor partners for feasibility, pricing, quota distribution, and field monitoring.
Monitor incidence rates, conversion trends, dropout points, and supply quality during fieldwork.
Optimize sample allocation and vendor mix to balance quality, timelines, and project profitability.
Handle vendor communication professionally while maintaining accountability on deliverables and quality expectations.
Data Quality & Validation 
Take ownership of overall data integrity and respondent quality throughout project execution.
Identify and remove:
Speeders
Straight-liners
Duplicate respondents
AI/fraudulent responses
Gibberish or poor-quality open ends
Contextually inconsistent responses
Apply contextual and logical validations beyond automated checks to ensure reliable and research-ready datasets.
Work closely with Data Processing teams on data cleaning logic, variable mapping, coding structures, weighting requirements, and final outputs.
Operational Excellence & Automation Mindset 
Be highly proficient in Excel and operational data handling including:
VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
Pivot tables
Advanced formulas
Data cleaning
Validation techniques
Large dataset handling
Leverage automation tools, AI-assisted workflows, and operational efficiencies to improve turnaround time and reduce manual dependency.
Maintain strong process discipline, documentation standards, and execution accuracy while handling multiple live studies simultaneously.
Budget & Commercial Awareness 
Track project costs, sample spends, vendor allocation, and operational profitability throughout execution.
Coordinate closely with internal stakeholders to ensure projects remain commercially viable while maintaining quality standards.

Required Skills & Qualifications 
Experience 
47 years of experience in online quantitative market research project management.
Prior experience handling international research studies across US, UK, APAC, or Middle East markets preferred.
Experience in agency-side or full-service research environments strongly preferred.
Technical & Research Understanding 
Strong operational understanding of:
Online survey methodologies
Questionnaire structures
Survey logic and routing
Quota management
Conjoint and MaxDiff studies
Tabulation planning
Data validation workflows
Online panel ecosystems and sampling methodologies
Exposure to:
Decipher
Sawtooth
SPSS/tabulation workflows
Automation and AI-assisted operational tools is highly preferred.
Core Competencies 
Exceptional attention to detail
Strong ownership mindset
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Fast learner with high adaptability
Strong analytical and logical thinking skills
Calm under pressure with strong prioritization ability
High responsiveness and communication discipline
Strong operational accountability

AI Search, Digital Growth & Performance Marketing Manager
Institution: ITS, Mohan Nagar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh
Department: Marketing & Admissions
Designation: Manager AI Search, Digital Growth & Performance Marketing
Reporting To: Director / Head of Marketing & Admissions / Management
Location: Mohan Nagar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh
Employment Type: Full-Time
1. Job Purpose
To lead the institution’s digital growth strategy, performance marketing, AI-driven search visibility, and online lead generation initiatives. The role will focus on strengthening the digital presence of ITS Mohan Nagar across search engines, AI-powered search platforms, social media, and other digital channels to drive qualified student enquiries, improve admission conversions, and enhance the institution’s brand visibility.
The incumbent will be responsible for integrating traditional digital marketing with emerging AI search technologies, data analytics, automation, and conversion optimisation to achieve measurable growth in admissions.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. AI Search & Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) 
Develop and implement strategies to improve the visibility of ITS across AI-powered search platforms, including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and other emerging answer engines.
Implement Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), and traditional Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) strategies.
Optimise institutional websites, course pages, FAQs, blogs, and other digital assets to improve discoverability across search engines and AI-driven platforms.
Strengthen the institution’s online authority through high-quality content, structured data, credible backlinks, relevant citations, and accurate institutional information.
Monitor brand mentions, search visibility, competitor positioning, and AI-generated recommendations relevant to higher education.
Collaborate with content and web development teams to ensure accurate, engaging, and search-friendly content.
B. Digital Growth & Performance Marketing 
Plan, execute, and optimise paid digital campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube, and other relevant advertising platforms.
Develop performance marketing strategies to generate qualified leads for undergraduate, postgraduate, and other academic programmes.
Manage campaign budgets, audience segmentation, keyword targeting, retargeting, and conversion tracking.
Monitor key metrics, including Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Admission, Click-Through Rate (CTR), conversion rate, Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and overall campaign ROI.
Conduct A/B testing of advertisements, landing pages, creative formats, calls to action, and audience segments.
Identify new digital acquisition channels and growth opportunities to increase admission enquiries while optimising marketing expenditure.
Develop data-driven strategies to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs.
