Manage the SEO strategy for the institutional website and individual programme pages.
Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword research, competitor analysis, and content gap assessments.
Improve website speed, mobile responsiveness, user experience, landing-page performance, and conversion pathways.
Plan and optimise dedicated landing pages for admission campaigns, events, webinars, and programme promotions.
Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, website engagement, and lead-generation performance using analytics tools.
Coordinate with web developers and content teams to implement technical improvements and SEO recommendations.
D. Social Media & Digital Brand Management 
Develop and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
Strengthen the institution’s digital reputation through engaging content, student success stories, faculty achievements, campus activities, and academic initiatives.
Coordinate with creative, video production, and content teams to develop high-performing digital assets.
Monitor social media engagement, brand sentiment, online reviews, and audience feedback.
Ensure consistency in brand messaging, visual identity, and communication across digital platforms.
Develop strategies to increase organic reach, engagement, website traffic, and qualified admissions enquiries.
E. Lead Management, CRM & Admissions Conversion 
Integrate digital campaigns with the institution’s CRM, admission management systems, and lead-tracking processes.
Establish lead attribution and tracking mechanisms to identify the source, quality, and conversion status of enquiries.
Collaborate with the Admissions Team to improve lead response time, follow-up efficiency, counselling appointments, and application conversions.
Implement remarketing, email marketing, WhatsApp communication workflows, and marketing automation wherever appropriate.
Analyse the complete lead funnel, from initial enquiry to application, admission, and enrolment.
Recommend strategies to improve lead nurturing, reduce lead leakage, and increase the overall admission conversion ratio.
Ensure proper consent, data protection, and responsible use of student and prospective applicant information.

Identify and deploy suitable AI tools for campaign planning, content ideation, keyword analysis, reporting, audience insights, and marketing automation.
Use analytics and attribution tools to evaluate campaign performance and support data-driven decision-making.
Develop automated dashboards for monitoring campaign expenditure, lead generation, lead quality, conversion rates, and admission performance.
Apply AI-assisted personalisation and predictive insights to improve audience targeting and campaign effectiveness.
Ensure human review of AI-generated content for factual accuracy, institutional guidelines, originality, and brand consistency.
Keep abreast of changes in search algorithms, AI search technologies, digital advertising platforms, and marketing best practices.

Develop annual, quarterly, and monthly digital marketing plans aligned with institutional admission targets.
Prepare campaign budgets, media plans, forecasts, and performance projections.
Submit regular reports to management on campaign performance, lead generation, marketing expenditure, and admissions outcomes.
Conduct competitor benchmarking and identify opportunities to strengthen the institution’s digital positioning.
Coordinate with internal departments, external agencies, vendors, and technology partners.
Ensure timely execution of campaigns and adherence to approved budgets and institutional policies.

Performance will be evaluated against mutually agreed targets, including:
Growth in qualified admission enquiries through digital channels.
Improvement in lead-to-application and application-to-admission conversion rates.
Reduction in Cost Per Qualified Lead and Cost Per Admission.
Improvement in organic search visibility and website traffic.
Growth in visibility across AI-driven search and answer platforms, assessed through appropriate visibility and referral indicators.
Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) and overall digital marketing ROI.
Website conversion rate and landing-page performance.
Improvement in lead response, nurturing, and CRM tracking efficiency.
Achievement of approved campaign budgets and admission targets.
Timeliness, accuracy, and quality of management reports.
Specific numerical targets will be finalised by management based on programme-wise admission requirements, approved budgets, historical performance, and the academic calendar. 
4. Educational Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, Mass Communication, Computer Applications, or a related discipline.
MBA/PGDM in Marketing or a relevant postgraduate qualification will be preferred.
Relevant certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, SEO, Meta Ads, marketing automation, or performance marketing will be an advantage.
5. Experience
Minimum 5–8 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, SEO, online lead generation, or digital growth.
At least 2–3 years of experience in managing digital campaigns, budgets, and performance metrics independently.
Experience in the education sector, particularly higher education and student admissions, will be preferred.
Demonstrated experience in lead generation, paid media optimisation, conversion tracking, analytics, and CRM integration.
Practical knowledge of AI search optimisation, GEO/AEO, and AI-assisted marketing tools will be an added advantage.
6. Technical Skills Required
Paid Media: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, YouTube Ads and other relevant advertising platforms.
Analytics: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Search Console and Looker Studio.
SEO & AI Search: Keyword research, technical SEO, schema markup, content optimisation, GEO/AEO and search visibility monitoring.
CRM & Automation: CRM platforms, lead management, email marketing, WhatsApp workflows and marketing automation.
Conversion Optimisation: Landing-page optimisation, A/B testing, attribution modelling and funnel analysis.
AI Tools: Practical use of generative AI tools for marketing research, content planning, analysis, and workflow automation.
Reporting: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets, dashboards, budget tracking, and performance reporting.
7. Core Competencies
Strategic thinking and growth-oriented execution.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Data-driven decision-making and budget management.
Understanding of student acquisition and admission conversion funnels.
Creativity combined with commercial and performance orientation.
Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deliver results within deadlines.
Adaptability to evolving AI search technologies and digital marketing trends.
8. Working Relationships
The incumbent will work closely with:
Institutional Management and Marketing Leadership.
Admissions and Counselling Teams.
Website Development and IT Teams.
Content, Creative, and Social Media Teams.
External Digital Marketing Agencies and Technology Vendors.
Academic Departments, as required for programme-specific campaigns.
9. General Responsibilities
Maintain confidentiality of institutional information, campaign data, prospective student records, and marketing budgets.
Ensure that all marketing communications are accurate, ethical, compliant with applicable advertising requirements, and consistent with institutional policies.
Protect the institution’s brand reputation across digital platforms.
Undertake any other marketing and digital growth responsibilities assigned by the competent authority in the interest of the institution.
10. Expected Outcome
The successful candidate will establish a measurable, integrated digital growth framework for ITS Mohan Nagar, combining AI search visibility, performance marketing, SEO, analytics, and admissions funnel optimisation to strengthen institutional brand awareness, improve lead quality, increase admission conversions, and maximise the return on digital marketing investments.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Digital Marketing Executive to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have 2 years of experience in executing digital marketing campaigns across various channels, including social media, search engine optimization (SEO), search engine marketing (SEM), email marketing, and content marketing. You will play a key role in helping us reach a wider audience and achieve our marketing goals.
Responsibilities:
 * Social Media Marketing:
   * Plan and execute social media campaigns across major platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, etc.) to promote courses and resources.
   * Create engaging social media content (text, images, videos) that resonates with our target audience (students, educators, parents).
   * Monitor and analyze social media performance, track key metrics (reach, engagement, conversions) to measure the success of our campaigns.
   * Manage social media advertising campaigns (e.g., Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads) to drive targeted traffic to our website.
   * Engage with followers and respond to comments and messages in a timely and professional manner.
 * Search Engine Optimization (SEO):
   * Conduct keyword research to identify relevant keywords that students are searching for when looking for educational resources.
   * Perform on-page SEO activities to optimize our website and course content for search engines.
   * Track and report on SEO performance (e.g., website traffic, organic rankings) to identify areas for improvement. 
Search Engine Marketing (SEM):
   * Manage pay-per-click (PPC) advertising campaigns on search engines like Google Ads to promote our courses and resources to a wider audience.
   * Optimize PPC campaigns for maximum return on investment (ROI), including bidding, targeting, and ad copy.
   * Track and analyze campaign performance to identify areas for improvement and ensure we are getting the most out of our advertising budget.
 * Content Marketing:
   * Develop and execute content marketing strategies to attract students on website. This may include creating blog posts, articles, infographics, and videos on educational topics relevant to our target audience.
   * Collaborate with content writers, educators, and subject matter experts to create high-quality and informative content.
   * Distribute content across relevant channels, including our website, social media, and email marketing campaigns.
 * Email Marketing:
   * Create and send engaging email campaigns (e.g., newsletters, promotional emails) to promote courses, resources, and special offers.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description Digital Marketing Manager
Organization: Asia-Pacific Institute of Management (AIM)
Location: Jasola, New Delhi
Department: Marketing & Admissions
Position: Digital Marketing Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site
Experience Required: 4–7 Years (preferably in Education / EdTech / Lead Generation)
About AIM
Asia-Pacific Institute of Management (AIM) is a leading management education institution in New Delhi with a legacy of nearly three decades. The institute offers industry-oriented management programs, including PGDM, MBA in Healthcare Management, and undergraduate programs.
We are looking for a highly analytical, technically proficient, and results-driven Digital Marketing Manager to oversee our digital marketing operations, manage external agencies, and ensure measurable growth in student applications and admissions.
Key Responsibilities
1. Performance Marketing & Agency Management
Act as the primary point of contact for all digital marketing and performance marketing agencies.
Oversee campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube, and other relevant digital platforms.
Monitor campaign budgets, lead generation, lead quality, cost per lead (CPL), cost per application (CPA), and overall return on marketing investment.
Independently review campaign structures, audience targeting, bidding strategies, keyword performance, and conversion tracking.
Conduct regular performance reviews with agencies and ensure timely execution of agreed deliverables.
Identify underperforming campaigns and recommend corrective actions.
Ensure that agencies continuously optimize campaigns rather than simply manage advertising budgets.
2. Digital Marketing Tools & Technical Expertise
The candidate should possess strong working knowledge of:
Paid Advertising 
Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, Remarketing)
Meta Ads Manager (Facebook & Instagram)
LinkedIn Ads and other relevant advertising platforms
Analytics & Tracking 
Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
Google Tag Manager (GTM)
Google Search Console
Looker Studio
Meta Pixel and Conversions API
UTM tracking, conversion events, attribution, and remarketing audiences
SEO & Website Optimization 
On-page, off-page, and technical SEO fundamentals
Keyword research using tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Keyword Planner
Landing page optimization, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO)
Website performance monitoring and user journey analysis
CRM & Marketing Automation 
LeadSquared or similar CRM platforms
Lead source attribution and campaign-to-CRM integration
WhatsApp, email, and SMS marketing automation
Lead nurturing workflows and remarketing campaigns
3. Lead Generation & Admissions Funnel Management
Take ownership of digital lead generation performance across AIM's academic programs.
Track the complete admissions funnel: Impressions Clicks Leads Qualified Leads Applications Admissions.
Work closely with the admissions team to evaluate lead quality and conversion performance.
Identify lead leakage, attribution errors, duplicate leads, and ineffective lead sources.
Ensure accurate lead capture, campaign tagging, and CRM integration.
Recommend strategies to improve lead-to-application and application-to-admission conversion rates.
Monitor program-wise performance and allocate marketing resources accordingly.
4. Reporting, Analytics & Budget Monitoring
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly digital marketing performance reports.
Develop dashboards to monitor campaign performance, expenditure, and admissions conversions.
Track and analyze key metrics, including:

Cost per Lead (CPL)
Cost per Qualified Lead (CPQL)
Cost per Application (CPA)
Cost per Admission / Acquisition (CAC)
Click-Through Rate (CTR)
Conversion Rate (CVR)
Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), where measurable
Verify agency-reported data against advertising platforms, analytics tools, and CRM records.
Monitor budget utilization and ensure campaigns remain within approved spending limits.
Present actionable recommendations to management based on performance data.
5. SEO, Content & Digital Brand Visibility
Oversee SEO agencies and ensure improvements in organic search visibility and relevant keyword rankings.
Coordinate with content and creative teams to ensure campaign messaging aligns with AIM's positioning.
Review advertising copies, creatives, landing pages, and promotional content for accuracy and effectiveness.
Monitor website traffic, organic leads, and search performance.
Ensure consistent messaging across all digital channels.
6. Campaign Planning & Execution
Work with management and agencies to develop program-wise digital marketing strategies.
Coordinate campaign launches for admissions cycles, webinars, events, and institutional initiatives.
Ensure timely delivery of creatives, landing pages, campaign assets, and tracking integrations.
Research competitors, market trends, student search behavior, and emerging digital marketing opportunities.
Support new initiatives involving marketing automation, AI-driven campaign optimization, and digital outreach.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
4–7 years of relevant digital marketing experience, preferably involving performance marketing and lead generation.
Strong hands-on understanding of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, GTM, and digital analytics.
Demonstrated experience managing or supervising significant advertising budgets.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets and marketing dashboards.
Experience working with marketing agencies and independently evaluating their performance.
Understanding of CRM systems, marketing automation, and lead management processes.
Strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications 
Experience in higher education, business schools, education marketing, or EdTech.
Google Ads and Google Analytics certifications.
Experience with LeadSquared CRM.
Familiarity with AI-powered marketing tools, automation, and advanced reporting.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be evaluated based on:
Quality and volume of leads generated across academic programs.
Improvement in lead-to-application and application-to-admission conversion rates.
Optimization of CPL, CPA, and cost per admission.
Accuracy of campaign tracking, reporting, and CRM attribution.
Agency accountability, execution quality, and timely delivery of campaigns.
Improvement in organic search visibility and website conversion rates.
Effective utilization of digital marketing budgets.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for someone who understands digital marketing beyond dashboards and reports.
The ideal candidate should be capable of logging into Google Ads or Meta Ads Manager, independently understanding campaign performance, identifying problems, questioning agency strategies, and recommending improvements.
This is not merely an agency coordination role. The candidate must have strong technical knowledge, commercial awareness, and the ability to translate digital marketing expenditure into measurable student applications and admissions.
The role requires someone who can take ownership, work independently, and ensure AIM's digital marketing agencies deliver results aligned with the institute's admissions objectives.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
About the Role
We're hiring a Performance Marketing Executive to own paid acquisition on Google and Meta for our e-commerce business. You'll spend roughly 70% of your time on paid campaigns and 30% on SEO, using organic insights to make every ad rupee work harder. You'll have real budget ownership and clear targets, and your work will directly move revenue.

What You'll Do

Paid Advertising (Google & Meta)
Plan, launch, and optimize Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Facebook, and Instagram campaigns.
Track daily performance and improve ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, and lead quality.
Manage Google Merchant Center feeds and resolve errors and disapprovals quickly.
Build retargeting campaigns across both platforms to boost conversions.
Run A/B tests on creatives, headlines, audiences, product titles, and landing pages.
Set up and maintain conversion tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads, and Meta Pixel.
Allocate budgets based on campaign profitability and performance trends.

SEO
Run regular on-page and technical audits covering meta tags, site speed, crawlability, indexation, sitemaps, and schema markup.
Build organic visibility through link building and outreach.
Use organic data, such as high-intent keywords and top-performing pages, to improve ad keywords, copy, and landing pages.
Work with content and design teams to produce SEO-ready pages and ad creatives.

Reporting
Deliver weekly and monthly reports with clear insights and next steps across paid and organic channels.
What Success Looks Like in Year One
Measurably improve blended ROAS and lower acquisition cost.
Keep Merchant Center feeds healthy, with minimal disapprovals.
Grow organic traffic and rankings for priority keywords.

What You Bring
3-5 years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads, with results you can show.
Practical experience with Shopping, Performance Max, and Merchant Center.
Working knowledge of on-page and technical SEO, plus basic link building.
Proficiency with Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, GA4, GTM, Search Console, and SEMrush or Ahrefs.
Strong analytical skills, including spreadsheets, pivot tables, and dashboards.
Clear communication and the ability to work with design, content, and development teams.
Self-starter who can manage multiple campaigns in a fast-paced setting.

Nice to Have
Experience with Shopify, WooCommerce, or similar e-commerce platforms.
Exposure to digital PR or guest posting.

Location: Faridabad, Haryana (on-site) 
Employment Type : Full-time

Svarn is embarking on an ambitious phase of growth towards 2030, making strong and impactful visual communication critical to building the brand and supporting its business objectives.

We are looking for a Senior Graphic Designer who can translate ideas and business objectives into compelling visual communication across digital, social, print, presentations, exhibitions and other brand touchpoints.

The role requires strong conceptual and visual thinking, a keen eye for detail and a deep understanding of design, typography, layouts, imagery and brand aesthetics. The ability to take an idea from concept to final artwork while maintaining a high standard of creative execution is essential.

Creative Collaboration : Work closely with copywriters, marketing teams and other stakeholders to develop integrated creative solutions, contribute to brainstorming and bring concepts to life through strong visual storytelling.

Production & Delivery : Take ownership of projects from concept and design through final artwork and production, ensuring accuracy, attention to detail, quality and timely delivery across multiple projects.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on AI solution quality, innovation, and operational effectiveness.

Demonstrates strong ownership while driving AI engineering excellence.

title: Embedded UI Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Embedded UI Software Engineer 
Experience: 4-9 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida

Job Description 
We are looking for an experienced Embedded UI Software Engineer to design and develop graphical user interfaces for embedded products. The candidate should have strong expertise in Embedded C/C++ , LVGL , TouchGFX , or similar embedded GUI frameworks, along with hands-on experience in ARM-based embedded systems.

Key Responsibilities 
Design and develop embedded graphical user interfaces using LVGL, TouchGFX, Embedded Wizard, Qt for MCU , or similar frameworks.
Develop UI applications for LCD/TFT touch displays on embedded platforms.
Integrate UI software with embedded platform services and device drivers.
Work on ARM Cortex-M based microcontrollers (STM32, NXP, ESP32, etc.).
Develop and debug embedded firmware using C/C++.
Support display, touch, communication, and peripheral interfaces.
Collaborate with hardware, firmware, validation, and product teams.
Participate in software testing, debugging, and product releases.

Mandatory Skills 
4-6 years of Embedded Software Development experience.
Strong programming skills in Embedded C/C++ .
Experience with LVGL (mandatory preferred).
Hands-on experience with TouchGFX, GUIX, emWin, Embedded Wizard, Qt/QML, or similar Embedded GUI frameworks .
Experience with ARM Cortex-M platforms (STM32/NXP) .
Experience in RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, QNX, VxWorks, or Embedded Linux).
Knowledge of Display Technologies, LCD/TFT Touchscreens, HMI Development .
Experience with UART, SPI, I2C, CAN communication protocols.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Company Overview 
Shiprocket is Indias leading technology-driven logistics and commerce platform, powering shipping, 
fulfilment and growth for hundreds of thousands of sellers. We build the platforms that millions of 
shipments depend on every day, in a fast-moving, AI-native product culture that values ownership and 
measurable outcomes. 
About the Role 
We’re hiring Senior Product Managers to own core platforms end to end: the systems where revenue, 
margin and seller experience are decided, not feature backlogs. You’ll take a product from problem to 
launch to a number you can defend, and you’ll build with AI as a matter of course. 
What You’ll Own 
A platform or business line with a revenue, GMV or cost outcome attached, and the roadmap to move 
it. 
01 launches taken through to scale: discovery, PRD, build, GTM with sales and ops, and the metrics 
after. 
AI where it earns its place in the product: automation, agents, document intelligence, conversational 
flows, with evals and fallbacks, not demos. 
Your own data: SQL, funnel and cohort analysis, experiments. You bring the answer, not the question. 
Alignment across engineering, design, data, business and ops, including saying no with reasons. 
What We’re Looking For 
4–7 years in product, at companies whose revenue comes from their own product. 
Owned a platform or system, not just a feature area, and can show the number it moved. 
One 01 product launched and scaled. 
Shipped AI into production and can walk through what it does, how it’s evaluated, and where it fails. 
Clear writer and communicator; comfortable in ambiguity and with senior stakeholders.

title: Assistant Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 

Brand Visibility and Engagement : Drive the organization's brand visibility across digital channels, enhancing engagement with the target audience through strategic social media management.
Customer Acquisition and Lead Generation : Execute digital marketing campaigns to efficiently acquire customers and generate leads, leveraging performance marketing expertise to optimize ROI and conversion rates.
Competitive Edge: Gain a competitive edge in the B2B logistics industry by employing a Digital Marketing Manager with a focus on performance marketing, ensuring a data-driven approach to outperform competitors.
Content Excellence: Elevate content creation standards to communicate the organization value proposition effectively, utilizing both social media and performance marketing channels for optimal reach and impact.
Analytics-Driven Decision Making: Utilize analytics and performance metrics to make informed decisions, implementing course corrections to enhance marketing strategies and overall brand performance.
Integrated Marketing Approach: Foster an integrated marketing approach by combining social media management and performance marketing, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and a cohesive brand presence.
Adaptation to Industry Trends: Stay ahead in the dynamic landscape of B2B logistics by employing a Digital Marketing Manager who not only understands social media trends but also adapts performance marketing strategies to evolving industry dynamics.
Efficient Resource Utilization: Optimize marketing resources by having a specialist who can manage both organic and paid aspects of digital marketing, ensuring cost-effectiveness and maximizing the impact of marketing budgets.
AI Integration: Leverage the knowledge of AI tools to enhance marketing efficiency, automate processes, and implement cutting-edge technologies for personalized and data-driven marketing strategies.
Measurable Impact: Enable the organization to measure the impact of its digital marketing efforts through quantifiable metrics, ensuring a clear understanding of the return on investment and continuous improvement. 
Insourcing to Reduce Cost: multiple odd-jobs currently being outsourced to Agencies at a higher cost.
Lead Management : Improving the quality of Digital Leads and contribution to the business with improved RoAS. 

Preferred candidate profile 

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communication, or a related field.
Proven 5 to 7 Year experience in Content Creation, Design, Digital Marketing, Social Media Management & Performance Marketing preferably in B2B Marketing.
Social Media Management: In-depth knowledge of major social media platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook) with the ability to develop and execute effective strategies for brand presence, engagement, Social Listening and lead generation.
Performance Marketing: Expertise in performance marketing channels, including paid advertising (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, etc.), with a focus on optimizing ROI, conversion rates, and cost-effectiveness.
SEO and SEM: Proficient understanding of Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and Search Engine Marketing (SEM) strategies to improve online visibility, drive organic traffic, and enhance search engine rankings.
Content Marketing: Strong understanding of content marketing principles, including content creation, distribution, and promotion to build brand authority and engage the target audience.
Data Analytics: Proficiency in utilizing analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics) to measure and analyze the performance of digital marketing campaigns, extracting actionable insights for continuous improvement.
AI Tools Integration: Familiarity with AI tools and their integration into digital marketing strategies for personalization, automation, and enhanced decision-making.
Email Marketing: Expertise in email marketing, including segmentation, A/B testing, and campaign optimization to drive engagement and nurture leads.
Community Engagement: Experience in building and nurturing online communities, forums, and relationships with influencers to expand brand reach and foster a positive brand image.
Agency Collaboration: Ability to effectively collaborate with external agencies for advertising, content creation, and other marketing initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. 
Integrated Marketing: Understanding of integrated marketing approaches, ensuring a cohesive brand presence across various channels and alignment with overall marketing and business objectives. 
Brand Management: Expertise in maintaining brand consistency and reputation, understanding the nuances of brand management within the context of the logistics and B2B sectors.
Mobile Marketing: Awareness of mobile marketing strategies, considering the increasing prevalence of mobile devices in accessing digital content. 
Multimedia Content Creation: Capability to oversee the creation of multimedia content, including graphics, videos, and other visual elements, to enhance the overall impact of digital marketing campaigns. 
Legal and Ethical Compliance: Knowledge of legal and ethical considerations in digital marketing practices, ensuring compliance with regulations and maintaining ethical standards.
Continuous Learning: Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated on emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in the field of digital marketing.

title: Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist
description:
We are looking for a versatile Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist to drive our online presence, execute lead generation campaigns, manage social media platforms, and connect directly with prospective clients. In this multi-faceted role, you will bridge digital marketing with direct customer engagementcreating compelling digital content and following up with digitally acquired leads to convert them into satisfied clients 

Role & responsibilities 
1. Lead Generation & Campaign Support
Assist in creating and monitoring online ad campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, Google Ads, and LinkedIn to generate inbound health insurance inquiries.
Organize, filter, and track inbound digital leads using CRM tools.
2. Social Media & Content Management
Manage 1Apollo Capitals official social media profiles (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp Business).
Draft engaging posts, short infographics, and promotional messaging tailored to build brand credibility and educate audiences on health insurance benefits.
3. Client Outreach & Conversion
Initiate prompt telephonic and WhatsApp contact with prospective clients who express interest through digital campaigns.
Understand client requirements, explain policy options with clarity, and guide them through the onboarding/purchase journey.
Required Skills & Experience
Experience: 1 to 3 years in digital marketing, social media management, inside sales, or growth marketing (candidates with a blend of digital marketing exposure and client communication skills will be prioritized).
Education: Graduate degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or related fields.
Technical Skills: Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, basic graphic design tools (Canva), and social media platforms.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi . Strong interpersonal skills for client interactions.
Mindset: Highly creative, target-conscious, comfortable working with data, and eager to learn about financial/insurance products.

Preferred candidate profile 
Fixed Salary: 25,000 per month (paid on time).
Performance Incentives: Uncapped monthly bonuses based on successful client acquisitions and campaign performance.
Career Growth: Hands-on exposure to building a financial brand's digital presence from the ground up, with direct mentorship from industry leaders.
Professional Work Environment: Supportive, modern office setup in Gurugram.

title: Senior Devops Engineer - Azure
description:
About Trintech : 
Trintech is an award-winning AI driven Fintech SaaS and we are looking for a Software Architect to own the technical architecture of the Platform Team at Trintechs AI Platform. The Platform Team builds the foundational capabilities that all AI agents depend on security and IAM infrastructure, multi-tenant architecture, cross-agent workflow orchestration, governance framework, billing and metering engine, and the agent marketplace. You report to the Director of Engineering and are the senior technical IC for the Platform Team. Your design decisions define the security posture, tenancy boundaries, API contracts, and event-driven backbone of the entire platform. The right person reasons from first principles on security architecture, system design, and multi-tenant SaaS patterns. Cloud-native production experience required; Azure preferred. This is a hands-on delivery role, not an advisory one . 

Job Description Summary 

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Sr. Azure Engineer (DevOps & Database) / Cloud to lead the design, build, and management of our Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure, with a specific focus on Windows-based application hosting, SQL Server database engineering, and DevOps delivery pipelines.

In this role, you will be the owning the cloud environment- a dedicated, per-customer hosted deployment built on Windows Server, WildFly, and SQL Server and will work closely with Engineering, Product and Cloud team to deliver a reliable, secure, and production-grade hosting platform.

As a senior engineer in this team, you will take ownership of the Azure environment, collaborating with the engineering and infrastructure teams to align on stack design, and providing hands-on engineering leadership across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, database setup and management, security hardening, and release operations.

You will also play a key role in supporting the transition of Oracle-based customers to SQL Server as part of the cloud onboarding process, as required. 

Our product is currently undergoing a migration from an on-premises environment to Azure Cloud. This is a pure DevOps role focused on Azure infrastructure, CI/CD, automation, and application/database administration , rather than platform engineering.
Key Technical Requirements: 
Azure Infrastructure: Hands-on experience provisioning and managing Windows Server VMs, networking, storage, load balancers, dedicated client environments, monitoring logs, and Application Insights.
CI/CD: Experience building and maintaining DevOps pipelines for automated builds, deployments, and testing.
Scripting: Strong hands-on PowerShell scripting skills for pipeline automation.
Database: SQL Server installation, configuration, fine-tuning, and TDE configuration. Exposure to Oracle and Oracle-to-SQL Server migration is preferred.
Application Servers: Experience with WildFly and JBoss on Windows, including configuration, customization, and log monitoring.
Security: Ability to identify and fix security vulnerabilities in code reported by scanning tools.

title: Growth Product Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 

About the role 
We're hiring a Growth Product Manager to own how people discover, sign up for, and get value on the web product. You'll run the experimentation engine across our website, signup and onboarding flows, turning traffic into activated, retained, paying users. This is a zero-to-one role: you'll build our growth function from the ground up, including the funnel, tracking, experimentation practice and first growth bets.
You'll lead a cross-functional pod of engineers, a designer and an analyst, and partner closely with Marketing, SEO, Lifecycle and Data. You'll report to Director of Product. 

What you'll do 
Own the web funnel end to end:  visitor signup activation conversion to paid, across marketing pages, pricing, signup, onboarding and in-product upgrade moments.
Build growth from zero to one:  stand up the first funnel dashboards and experimentation process, then find, validate and launch new growth loops and acquisition channels where none exist yet.
Run a high-velocity experimentation program:  form hypotheses from data and user research, size opportunities, design A/B and multivariate tests, and ship experiments per quarter with sound statistical rigor.
Set the growth roadmap:  prioritize bets by expected impact, confidence and effort, and balance quick wins with larger structural changes (e.g. new onboarding, pricing-page redesign, product-led trials).
Define and instrument metrics:  own the funnel metrics and dashboards, run the tagging plan in Google Tag Manager (tags, triggers, data layer, conversion events), partner with Data on attribution and experiment analysis, feed accurate conversions back to Google Ads, and make sure every launch is measurable.
Improve activation:  find the "aha" moment, shorten time-to-value, and design onboarding, empty states, templates and nudges that get new users there.
Drive acquisition on web:  work with SEO and Performance Marketing on landing pages, programmatic SEO, page speed, Core Web Vitals and conversion-rate optimization. Partner on Google Ads to align campaigns, keywords and landing pages, improve Quality Score, and lower cost per acquisition.
Shape go-to-market (GTM):  run market research, competitor analysis and customer interviews; size and prioritize segments; define the ideal customer profile; and work with Marketing and Sales on positioning, messaging, pricing and launch plans for new products and features.
Use AI to grow faster:  apply AI to personalize onboarding and landing pages, generate and test copy and creative variants, speed up research and analysis, and spot new growth opportunities in user data.
Lead the pod:  write clear specs, run rituals, and keep engineering, design and analytics moving fast together.
Share what you learn:  publish experiment readouts, keep a learnings library, and influence the broader product org with evidence.

What success looks like 
Timeframe
Outcome
First 30 days
You know the funnel cold: baseline conversion at each step, the biggest drop-offs, and the state of tracking. You've met key partners and shipped your first small test.
First 90 days
You own a prioritized growth roadmap and a steady experiment cadence. At least one test has moved a core metric (e.g. visitor-to-signup or signup-to-activation rate).
First 6 months
You've delivered a measurable lift in [primary metric, e.g. new paid conversions] of [X%], built a trusted experimentation process, and are shaping the next year's growth strategy.

What you bring 
3-5 years of product management experience, with at least 2 Year in growth, conversion or monetization roles on a web product.
A track record of moving funnel metrics through experimentation, with specific results you can walk us through.
Zero-to-one experience: you've launched a new product, feature, funnel or growth channel from scratch (at a startup or a new team), found early traction, and scaled what worked.
Strong grasp of A/B testing: hypothesis design, sample sizing, statistical significance, novelty effects and when not to test.
Hands-on analytics skills: comfortable writing SQL and working in tools like Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4 or Looker without waiting on an analyst.
Solid understanding of how the web works: page performance, SEO basics and front-end constraints.
Go-to-market experience: running market and customer research, sizing segments, defining an ideal customer profile, shaping positioning and messaging, and planning launches with Marketing and Sales.
Hands-on Google Tag Manager experience: setting up tags, triggers, variables and a data layer, debugging in Preview mode, and keeping GA4 and Google Ads conversions accurate.
Fluency with AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) in your daily workflow, and a practical sense of where AI can improve growth: personalization, content at scale, research synthesis, analytics and experimentation speed.
Working knowledge of Google Ads: campaign structure, conversion tracking and enhanced conversions, landing-page experience and Quality Score, and how spend and CPA tie back to funnel metrics.
Clear, concise writing and the ability to turn messy data into a decision others will act on.
Comfort leading without authority and moving fast amid ambiguity.
Nice to have 
Experience with product-led growth: free trials, freemium, self-serve upgrades and paywalls.
Pricing and packaging experiments.
Programmatic SEO or large-scale landing-page systems.
A background in engineering, data science or design.
Experience in [B2B SaaS / consumer / marketplace] products

title: Technical Lead Product Manager
description:
This is a deeply technical PM role, but technical chops alone arent enough. You’ll need to translate complex capabilities into compelling customer experiences that drive adoption and demonstrate value in-app. 
Define strategy for authentication, tenant discovery, and secure access across HRSD and mobile experiences. 
Establish scalable patterns for tenant identification and routing (e.g., access codes, identifiers, discovery flows). 
Lead cross-functional initiatives across tenancy, identity, mobile, and product teams. 
Partner with engineering to shape platform architecture supporting secure, reliable, and scalable systems. 
Drive alignment across teams on standards, integrations, and shared platform capabilities. 
Communicate strategy, trade-offs, and progress to senior leadership and stakeholders. 
Own the product narrative and GTM readiness. Translate complex HRSD capabilities into compelling customer stories, partner with enablement, sales, and customer success to ensure features land well, and drive adoption through clear rollout strategy and segmentation. 
You don’t just build AI products—you use AI to work smarter every day. 
About You: Basic Qualifications 
10+ years of Product Management experience in enterprise SaaS. 
Strong understanding of platform concepts such as APIs, integrations, and system design trade-offs. 
Demonstrated technical knowledge of API design, system integrations, and third-party platform connectivity; able to assess integration complexity and guide solution design decisions. 
Experience leading product strategy for platform, infrastructure, or enterprise software. 
Proven ability to drive alignment across multiple teams and influence decisions at scale. 
Understanding of concepts related to authentication, identity, or platform integrations. 
Product-led growth mindset. You’ve thought about how features drive adoption, engagement, and expansion, not just how they work technically. You understand the intersection of technology and usage. 
Proven ability to lead through influence and operate across teams without formal authority. 
Surface risks early, propose solutions, and follow through. 
Communicate effectively across levels: engineers, partners, and senior leaders. 
Preferred Qualifications 
Experience with authentication systems, identity platforms, or tenant management. 
Familiarity with Auth0 or other identity management systems (e.g., Okta, Azure AD) is a plus. 
Experience using analytics tools (e.g., Looker, Pendo) and advanced data analysis to drive product insights and decision-making. 
Experience delivering mobile or cross-product platform integrations at scale. 
Experience defining and driving adoption of cross-product standards and reusable platform capabilities. 
Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, Computer Science, Data Science, or related field) or equivalent practical experience.

title: Oracle Retail Account Manager/Sr. Project Manager
description:
Success Numbers is looking for an experienced Oracle Retail Project Manager to lead end-to-end Oracle Retail implementation and transformation projects. The ideal candidate should have strong project management capabilities, experience in Oracle Retail applications, and a proven track record of delivering large-scale retail technology programs.
The Project Manager will be responsible for project planning, execution, governance, resource management, stakeholder communication, risk mitigation, and successful delivery within the agreed scope, budget, timeline, and quality standards.

Role & responsibilities 
Manage and grow strategic retail accounts across the region.
Lead end-to-end Oracle Retail implementation, upgrade, migration, and rollout projects.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and resource allocation.
Manage all project phases, including requirement analysis, solution design, configuration, development, SIT, UAT, data migration, go-live, and hypercare.
Ensure timely delivery of project milestones within the agreed scope and budget.

Stakeholder & Customer Management 
Act as the primary point of contact for customer stakeholders and internal delivery teams.
Conduct regular project governance meetings, status reviews, and steering committee presentations.
Manage customer expectations, project escalations, and critical business decisions.
Build strong relationships with business leadership, IT teams, implementation partners, and vendors.

Resource & Team Management 
Manage cross-functional teams consisting of functional consultants, technical consultants, solution architects, integration specialists, and QA resources.
Monitor team performance, resource utilization, productivity, and delivery quality.
Identify resource gaps and coordinate staffing requirements.
Ensure effective collaboration between onsite and offshore delivery teams.

Risk, Issue & Change Management 
Maintain and regularly review RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies).
Identify project risks proactively and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.
Manage project scope changes, impact assessments, and formal change requests.
Escalate critical issues to customer leadership and internal management as required.

Testing, Data Migration & Go-Live 
Coordinate SIT, UAT, regression testing, and end-to-end integration testing.
Monitor defect resolution and ensure testing exit criteria are achieved.
Oversee data migration planning, mock migrations, reconciliation, and business validation.
Lead cutover planning, go-live readiness assessments, production deployment, and hypercare support.
Ensure smooth transition to application support and maintenance teams.

Project Governance & Financial Management 
Prepare weekly and monthly project status reports, executive dashboards, and milestone trackers.
Monitor project budgets, effort utilization, delivery costs, and commercial commitments.
Ensure compliance with project governance, quality standards, and contractual obligations.
Track project deliverables, customer approvals, and milestone sign-offs.

Required Skills & Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
1015 years of overall IT experience, including at least 5 years managing enterprise implementation projects.
Proven experience managing at least two end-to-end Oracle Retail implementation or transformation projects.
Good understanding of Oracle Retail applications, particularly Xstore, MFCS, SIOCS, ORCE, and OMS.
Strong knowledge of retail business processes, including merchandising, procurement, inventory, warehouse operations, POS, and omnichannel retail.
Experience managing complex integrations and multi-application implementation programs.
Strong project planning, governance, risk management, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid project delivery methodologies.
Proficiency in MS Project, Jira, Excel, PowerPoint, and project reporting tools.
Excellent communication, leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and geographically distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications 
PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification.
Experience with Oracle Retail Cloud SaaS implementations.
Experience working with retail customers in GCC/Middle East markets.
Exposure to Oracle Fusion Finance, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), and Oracle WMS Cloud.
Experience managing large-scale POS implementations and multi-country store rollouts.
Knowledge of retail payment integrations, loyalty programs, and omnichannel processes.

Key Expectations 
Strong ownership and accountability for project delivery.
Ability to independently manage customer-facing projects.
Proactive identification and resolution of risks and delivery challenges.
Strong focus on timelines, quality, cost optimization, and customer satisfaction.
Ability to present project status and critical issues confidently to senior leadership.
Willingness to travel for customer workshops, project milestones, and go-live activities when required.

Perks and benefits 
Perks and benefits 36-60 Lacs per annum

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 
Paid media: Google and Meta 
Plan, launch and optimise campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube, Display, App) and Meta Ads (lead forms, conversion, app install, reach). 
Build full-funnel structures (TOF MOF BOF retargeting) for franchise lead generation, store traffic and app installs. 
Own budget pacing and allocation across 2060 lakh per month. Scale what works and cut what doesn't, based on cost per qualified lead and CAC, not just CPL or CTR. 
Run structured creative and audience tests and document the learnings. 

Creative and video ads 
Write ad video scripts (UGC, testimonial, explainer, whiteboard and reel formats) with a strong hook, a clear message and one CTA. 
Brief creators, influencers and the design / video team, review cuts, and get ad-ready videos produced on time. 
Read creative performance (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPL by creative) and turn the learnings into the next round of scripts. 

Tracking and analytics 
Set up, audit and fix conversion tracking: Google Tag Manager, GA4 events, Google Ads conversions, Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI), and offline conversion imports from the CRM. 
Make sure leads flow correctly from ad platforms to the CRM, and close the loop on lead quality back to the platforms. 
Build and maintain performance dashboards (GA4, Looker Studio, platform reports) and share weekly and monthly reports with insights and next actions. 

Organic search: SEO, AEO and GEO 
Lead SEO strategy for the brand site and location pages: keyword clusters, on-page, technical health, local SEO and Google Business Profile. 
Drive visibility in AI answer engines (AEO / GEO), including Google AI Overviews and ChatGPT style assistants, through structured content, schema and authoritative sources. Team leadership 
Manage, coach and review a team of performance marketing executives. Set clear KPIs, review accounts weekly and build team capability. 
Coordinate with sales, franchise, design and agency partners for creatives, landing pages and lead follow-up. 

Must-have skills and experience 
3-6 years in digital / performance marketing, with hands-on campaign management (not only agency coordination). 
At least 1 year of team leading experience. 
Complete working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads: campaign types, bidding strategies, audiences, creative formats and account structure. 
Has managed 20-60 lakh per month in ad spend and can show results against it: CPL, cost per qualified lead, CAC, ROAS. 
Lead generation experience: has run lead-gen campaigns end to end, including lead forms, landing pages, CRM integration and lead-quality optimisation. 
Tracking expertise: can independently set up and debug GTM, GA4, Google Ads conversions, Meta Pixel / CAPI and offline conversion import. 
Strong with GA4 and all Google / Meta dashboards and tools: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Events Manager, Business Manager, GA4, Search Console, Google Business Profile, Looker Studio. 
Good understanding of SEO, AEO and GEO: how to rank on Google search and how content appears in AI Overviews and AI assistants. 
Team management: has led at least 2-3 marketers, including setting KPIs, reviewing work and training. 
Strong analytical skills in Excel / Google Sheets. Thinks in funnels, unit economics and ROI. 
Ad scripting and video production: can write and evaluate video ad scripts, knows what makes a hook work, and can brief and manage creators or editors to deliver performance videos.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Job Title: Digital Marketing Manager
Experience: 3-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: On-Site
Location: Noida
Industry: IT Services & Consulting

About the Role 
We are looking for a results-driven Digital Marketing Manager with 35 years of experience to plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies for the organization.
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SEO, social media marketing, paid advertising, content marketing, lead generation, analytics, and campaign management . The candidate will be responsible for improving online visibility, generating quality leads, and supporting overall business growth through digital channels.

Key Responsibilities 
Digital Marketing Strategy 
Develop and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies aligned with business goals. 
Plan and manage campaigns across multiple digital channels. 
Identify new opportunities to improve brand visibility, engagement, and lead generation. 
Monitor industry trends, competitors, and emerging digital marketing practices. 
SEO & Website Marketing 
Develop and implement SEO strategies to improve organic rankings and website traffic. 
Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and on-page/off-page SEO activities. 
Coordinate website content, landing pages, and SEO improvements. 
Monitor website performance and identify areas for improvement. 
Paid Advertising & Lead Generation 
Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads and Meta Ads . 
Manage campaign budgets and monitor CPL, conversions, ROI, and other key metrics. 
Develop strategies for lead generation and conversion. 
Continuously test and optimize ad creatives, audiences, landing pages, and campaigns. 
Social Media Marketing 
Develop and execute social media strategies across relevant platforms. 
Plan and manage the social media content calendar. 
Coordinate with content/design teams for creatives, posts, videos, and campaigns. 
Monitor engagement, reach, followers, and overall social media performance. 
Content Marketing 
Plan content strategies based on business objectives and target audiences. 
Coordinate blogs, website content, social media content, email campaigns, and other marketing materials. 
Work closely with content writers and designers to ensure quality and consistency. 
Identify content opportunities that can improve traffic and lead generation. 
Analytics & Reporting 
Track and analyze digital marketing performance using tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards . 
Prepare regular reports on traffic, leads, conversions, campaign performance, and ROI. 
Use data and insights to improve ongoing campaigns and marketing strategies. 
Maintain marketing dashboards and performance trackers. 
Team & Agency Coordination 
Coordinate with internal teams such as sales, design, content, and development. 
Manage external agencies, freelancers, or marketing partners when required. 
Ensure campaigns and marketing activities are delivered within timelines. 

Required Skills 
3–5 years of hands-on experience in Digital Marketing . 
Strong understanding of SEO, SEM, Social Media Marketing, Paid Ads, Content Marketing, and Lead Generation . 
Experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads . 
Good knowledge of Google Analytics and Google Search Console . 
Strong analytical and data-driven approach. 
Good understanding of conversion funnels and campaign optimization. 
Excellent communication and coordination skills. 
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities. 
Strong understanding of digital marketing metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, and ROI . 
Ability to independently plan, execute, monitor, and optimize campaigns. 

Preferred Qualifications 
Bachelor's/Master's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field . 
Relevant certifications in Google Ads, Analytics, SEO, or Digital Marketing will be an advantage. 
Experience working with an IT/Technology or B2B organization is preferred. 

What We Offer 
Opportunity to lead and execute end-to-end digital marketing initiatives. 
Exposure to multiple digital marketing channels and technologies. 
Opportunity to work in a growing IT organization. 
Collaborative and professional work environment. 
Learning and career growth opportunities.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Job Description Digital Marketing Executive
Company: Eins Technik Pvt. Ltd.
Location: Sector 62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh
Department: Marketing & Sales
Designation: Digital Marketing Executive
Job Summary
Eins Technik Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a result-oriented Digital Marketing Executive to manage the company’s digital presence, plan and execute online marketing campaigns, generate quality leads, convert prospects into customers, and drive online sales. The candidate will be responsible for managing social media platforms, running paid advertisements, tracking campaign performance, and coordinating with the sales team to achieve business targets.
Key Responsibilities
1. Social Media Management 
Manage and maintain the company’s social media accounts, including LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and other relevant platforms.
Plan and publish engaging posts, product updates, promotional content, videos, and creatives.
Develop a monthly social media content calendar to improve brand visibility and audience engagement.
Monitor comments, messages, inquiries, and responses received through social media platforms.
2. Digital Campaigns & Paid Advertising 
Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns through Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
Create targeted campaigns to generate business leads and promote company products.
Manage advertising budgets and improve campaign performance, lead quality, and return on investment.
Conduct audience research, keyword research, competitor analysis, and A/B testing.
3. Lead Generation & Conversion 
Generate qualified leads through digital marketing campaigns, website inquiries, social media, and other online channels.
Follow up on leads and inquiries received through advertisements, social media, and digital platforms.
Coordinate with the sales team to ensure timely follow-ups and conversion of leads into customers.
Maintain a database of leads, track lead status, and prepare regular reports on lead generation and conversion.
Analyze reasons for lead drop-offs and implement strategies to improve conversion rates.
4. Online Sales & Business Development 
Develop digital strategies to increase online inquiries, product sales, and business opportunities.
Identify new online channels and platforms to reach potential customers.
Support the sales team with digital promotional activities, product campaigns, and customer engagement initiatives.
Track the complete digital sales funnel, from lead generation to final conversion.
5. Website & Performance Analytics 
Coordinate website updates, landing pages, product information, and inquiry forms.
Monitor website traffic, campaign performance, cost per lead (CPL), conversion rates, and return on ad spend (ROAS).
Use tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Meta Business Suite, and advertising dashboards.
Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports and recommend improvements based on data.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
2–5 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, paid advertising, lead generation, and online sales.
Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn, and social media management.
Strong understanding of lead generation, lead nurturing, sales funnels, and conversion optimization.
Knowledge of SEO, content marketing, website analytics, and campaign reporting.
Good communication, analytical, coordination, and follow-up skills.
Ability to manage advertising budgets and deliver measurable business results.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Number of qualified leads generated per month.
Cost per lead and overall campaign cost efficiency.
Lead-to-customer conversion rate.
Revenue and sales generated through digital channels.
Return on advertising spend (ROAS).
Social media reach, engagement, and follower growth.
Website traffic and inquiry generation.
Timely follow-up and reporting of digital leads.
Preferred Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be hands-on, commercially oriented, and focused on generating business rather than only posting content on social media. The candidate must be capable of independently managing digital campaigns, generating leads, following up with prospects, coordinating with sales, and contributing directly to revenue growth.
Work Location: Sector 62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh
Employment Type: Full-time
Reporting To: Marketing Head / Management

Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns for residential and commercial real estate projects.
Manage and optimize Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads campaigns.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Mainframe Developer
description:
As a Software Engineer within Optum Technology, you will be a key contributor to building, maintaining, and modernizing critical healthcare applications. In this role, you will work directly with robust mainframe processing systems while incorporating cutting-edge AI solutions and enterprise automations to enhance platform capability, reliability, and efficiency. You will collaborate with cross-functional technical teams to engineer scalable mainframe software, streamline development workflows using enterprise AI capabilities, and ensure our critical systems deliver seamless service for millions of members and care providers.

Primary Responsibilities: 
Design, develop, test, and deploy mainframe software applications utilizing COBOL, JCL, CICS, DB2, VSAM, File-AID, Abend-AID, and REXX to support core health business operations
Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools to streamline software engineering workflows, automate routine mainframe testing/maintenance, and drive continuous operational improvement
Evaluate emerging technology trends and AI integration opportunities to inform solution design, platform optimization, and mainframe modernization efforts
Analyze complex code, troubleshoot system issues, and optimize batch and online processing performance across core mainframe applications
Collaborate with database administrators, system architects, and business stakeholders throughout the full software development lifecycle (AIDLC)
Maintain high standards of code quality, performance, data security, and enterprise compliance across all engineering deliverables
Builder Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions using no-code, low-code, and advanced platforms, translating business needs into scalable applications that enhance products, workflows, and decision-making
Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

Qualifications - 
Required Qualifications: 
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
4+ years of professional software engineering experience in a mainframe environment, hands-on experience developing, testing, and debugging applications using COBOL, JCL, and CICS, experience working with DB2 databases and VSAM file structures and tools such as File-AID, Abend-AID, or REXX
Demonstrated experience designing, customizing, or deploying AI-driven tools, automated workflows, or intelligent automation capabilities within technology operations
Experience engaging across all phases of the full software development lifecycle (AI-DLC)

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

title: Senior / Lead Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Postion Senior / Lead Digital Marketing Manager

Required Experience: 812+ Years
Location: Ahmedabad / Hybrid / Remote
Job Type: Full-Time
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth

About the Role 
An experienced Senior / Lead Digital Marketing Manager to lead digital
marketing strategy, team execution, analytics, and growth initiatives across our company and global client projects.

This is a leadership role for someone who combines business strategy, performance marketing, SEO, AI-driven search, analytics, conversion optimization, marketing automation, and team management.

The ideal candidate should be capable of defining strategy while remaining technically strong enough to audit campaigns, challenge assumptions, review implementation, identify performance gaps, and guide specialists across SEO, PPC, content, analytics, social media,
and CRO.

Experience with eCommerce, technology, SaaS, B2B, or digital-service businesses will be highly valuable.

Key Responsibilities 
Digital Marketing Strategy & Leadership 

Own end-to-end digital marketing strategy across SEO, paid media, content, social, email, automation, CRO, and analytics.
Develop quarterly and annual digital marketing roadmaps.
Translate business objectives into measurable marketing KPIs.
Define channel strategy, budgets, priorities, testing plans, and performance targets.
Lead multiple client/project marketing initiatives simultaneously.
Conduct regular marketing audits and identify growth opportunities.
Present strategy, performance, risks, and recommendations to management and clients.

Performance Marketing 

Lead paid acquisition across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube, and other relevant channels.
Guide Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen, remarketing, and paid social strategies.
Optimize around business outcomes such as ROAS, CAC, CPA, CPL , revenue, and qualified leads.
Establish structured experimentation across creatives, audiences, offers, landing pages, and bidding strategies.
Review campaign structures, tracking, budgets, attribution, and overall account health.
Guide the team on effective use of AI-driven bidding and campaign automation.

SEO, AEO, GEO & AI Search 
Lead technical, on-page, off-page, local, and content SEO.
Develop strategies for:
SEO Search Engine Optimization
AEO Answer Engine Optimization
GEO Generative Engine Optimization

Understand changing search behavior across Google Search, AI-assisted search, conversational search, and LLM-based discovery.
Guide technical SEO including indexing, crawling, canonicalization, schema, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, redirects, and site architecture.
Improve topical authority, content quality, entity relevance, and structured data.
Track brand and content visibility across traditional and emerging AI-driven discovery channels.

Analytics, Tracking & Attribution 
Own marketing measurement and reporting strategy.
Strong understanding of GA4, GTM, Search Console and Looker Studio. 
Define conversion events, funnels, audiences, attribution requirements, and KPI frameworks.
Understand first-party data, server-side tracking, enhanced conversions, consent management, and privacy-aware measurement. 
Connect marketing performance with CRM, leads, sales, and revenue.
Identify tracking gaps and coordinate with development teams to resolve them.
Build or guide development of executive-level marketing dashboards.

CRO & Customer Journey Optimization 
Analyze complete acquisition-to-conversion customer journeys.
Identify friction across landing pages, category pages, PDPs, forms, cart, and checkout.
Establish A/B testing and experimentation roadmaps.
Work with UI/UX, development, content, and analytics teams.
Use behavioral analytics and quantitative data to develop test hypotheses.
Measure experiments against revenue and business outcomes . 

AI & Marketing Automation 
Lead practical adoption of Generative AI and AI-assisted marketing workflows.
Identify opportunities to automate research, reporting, analysis, content workflows, campaign operations, and repetitive marketing activities.
Develop reusable prompts, workflows, SOPs, and quality-control processes.
Evaluate new AI marketing tools based on measurable value rather than trends alone.
Establish appropriate human review for AI-generated output.
Encourage responsible and productive AI adoption across the marketing team.

CRM & Lifecycle Marketing 
Guide lead nurturing, lifecycle, remarketing, and retention programs.
Work with platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Adobe Experience Cloud, or similar tools. 
Improve segmentation, personalization, lead scoring, nurturing, and sales handoffs.
Connect CRM and first-party customer data with marketing campaigns wherever appropriate. 

eCommerce & Growth 
Develop strategies fo r Shopify, Adobe Commerce/Magento, Woo Commerce, and other commerce environments. 
Understand and improve key metrics including:
Conversion Rate
AOV
CAC
ROAS
LTV
Revenue per Visitor
Cart Abandonment
Repeat Purchase Rate
Work with merchandising, development, design, and analytics teams to improve the customer journey.

Team Leadership; Client Management 
Lead and mentor SEO, PPC, content, social, analytics, and digital marketing team members.
Establish SOPs, processes, reporting standards, and quality benchmarks.
Review team output and provide strategic and technical guidance.
Identify skill gaps and develop training/upskilling plans.
Manage workload and priorities across multiple projects.
Work closely with design, development, sales, product, data, and project- management teams.
Confidently communicate strategy and performance with international clients.

Required Skills & Qualifications 
812+ years of digital marketing experience with significant team/strategy leadership experience.
Strong expertise in SEO, paid acquisition, analytics, CRO, content, and growth marketing.
Advanced understanding of:
Google Ads
Meta Ads
GA4
GTM
Search Console
Looker Studio
Technical SEO
SEO / AEO / GEO
CRO & experimentation
CRM / marketing automation
Strong understanding of first-party data, attribution, conversion tracking, and privacy- aware measurement.
Practical experience using AI tools within digital marketing workflows.
Strong understanding of eCommerce funnels and customer journeys.
Ability to convert data into actionable business recommendations.
Strong client communication, presentation, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently audit an existing marketing program and create a prioritized improvement roadmap.

Preferred Skills 
International/US client experience.
Shopify and Adobe Commerce/Magento exposure.
Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, or Adobe Journey Optimizer.
HubSpot, Salesforce, Klaviyo, or similar CRM/automation platforms.
SQL/data-analysis knowledge.
Server-side tracking/API/integration knowledge.
Google Merchant Center and product-feed optimization.
B2B lead-generation experience.
Relevant Google, Meta, Adobe, HubSpot, or analytics certifications.

Technical Tool Stack 
Analytics: GA4, GTM, Search Console, Looker Studio, Excel/Google Sheets
Advertising: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Merchant Center
SEO: Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and related SEO tools

CRO: Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, VWO, Optimizely, Adobe Target or equivalent
CRM/Automation: HubSpot, Salesforce, Klaviyo, Mailchimp or Adobe Experience Cloud
AI: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and other relevant AI/automation tools
Commerce: Shopify, Adobe Commerce/Magento, WooCommerce

Key Performance Indicators 
Qualified traffic and lead growth
Revenue contribution
ROAS / CAC / CPA / CPL
Conversion-rate improvement
SEO and AI-search visibility
Lead quality
AOV and LTV
Marketing automation performance
Tracking/data accuracy
Experimentation impact
Client satisfaction and retention
Team productivity and quality

What We Are Looking For 
We are someone who is more than a campaign manager. 
The ideal profile combines: 

Marketing Strategist + Growth Leader + Performance Marketer + SEO Expert + Analytics Thinker + AI Adopter + Team Leader. The person should be able to define the strategy, understand the technology, challenge the data, guide the team, communicate with clients, and remain accountable for measurable business outcomes.

Current CTC
Expected CTC
Notice Period
Current Location
Portfolio / Case Studies
Campaign budgets managed
Team size managed

Examples of improvements in ROAS, leads, revenue, SEO, or conversion rates
AI/automation tools currently usedRole & responsibilities

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
Position: SDE-1 (Backend) 
Exp: 1 + Years
Working Mode:  WFO, 5 Days
Location:  Gurgaon

Job Overview: 
We are looking for a passionate Backend Developer with strong fundamentals in programming and experience building scalable backend systems using Node.js/NestJS . The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with databases, API design, and cloud environments, along with a strong inclination to learn and leverage AI-powered coding tools to improve productivity and code quality.

What Youll Do: 
Backend Development 
Develop and maintain backend services using NestJS + Node.js
Write clean, modular, and well-tested code following best practices
Implement RESTful APIs and microservices with attention to scalability
System Design & Architecture 
Collaborate in system design discussions and learn distributed system concepts
Support senior engineers in designing scalable, fault-tolerant architectures
Database Management 
Work with SQL/NoSQL databases for modeling, queries, and performance tuning
Ensure data consistency and basic optimizations in stored logic
Security & Quality 
Follow secure coding standards (OWASP, AUTH flows, validation)
Contribute to testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code reviews
AI-Enabled Engineering 
Use AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude, Copilot, etc.) for faster, higher-quality delivery
Learn to integrate AI-based workflows into backend systems
Observability & Reliability 
Implement logging and monitoring with APMs (NewRelic, Datadog, OpenObserve)
Participate in debugging and issue resolution in staging and production
Collaboration & Growth 
Work with Product, Data, and SDE-2/3 mentors to deliver features
Take ownership of small-to-medium modules and demonstrate continuous improvement.

Qualifications Required: 
13 years backend experience with Node.js/NestJS
Solid grounding in DSA, OOP, and microservice concepts
Hands-on with SQL & NoSQL databases
Understanding of API design, testing, and CI/CD
Awareness of secure coding and compliance basics
Exposure to cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure)
Willingness to use and learn AI coding tools

Preferred Qualifications: 
Experience in fintech, SaaS, or high-scale product systems
Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ) is a plus
Knowledge of monitoring tools and APMs
Strong communication and eagerness to learn system design from senior engineers
Embody our values: Ownership, Transparency, Courage, Customer Obsession, Celebration
