title: Sr Software Engineer - ASP.Net
description:
Job Description 
A highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer specializing in ASP.NET Core WebAPI with a strong background in RESTful API development, OData, cloud technologies, and scalable backend 
architecture. The role involves designing, developing, and optimizing backend services to support business needs. The candidate will be responsible for driving technical excellence, mentoring junior developers, and ensuring best coding practices. Passionate about building robust, efficient, and high-performance applications 
while collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve business goals. 

Deliverables / Key Responsibilities: 
The candidate should be proactive, accountable, and eager to take ownership of tasks while contributing to 
team and organizational growth. 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance ASP.NET Core WebAPI applications. 
Implement and optimize RESTful APIs and OData services for efficient data exchange. 
Collaborate with front-end, DevOps, and product teams to align business requirements with technical solutions. 
Develop database queries using Entity Framework Core and ensure optimized data handling. 
Drive API security best practices, including authentication, authorization, and data protection. 
Ensure high code quality by following SOLID principles, clean architecture, and design patterns. 
Troubleshoot and debug backend performance issues, optimizing system efficiency. 
Participate in code reviews, mentorship, and knowledge-sharing sessions for the development team. 
Work on containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud deployment (Azure) to enhance scalability. 
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation for smooth deployment. 
Stay updated with emerging technologies to continuously improve backend architecture and performance. 

Specific Job Requirements: 
8+ years of experience in backend development using ASP.NET Core WebAPI. 
Expert in C# and .NET Core/.NET 6+ with deep understanding of RESTful API architecture. 
Strong experience in OData services and OData protocol implementation. 
Hands-on experience with Entity Framework Core and relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.). 
Proficiency in Azure cloud services, including Azure Functions, App Services, and Azure SQL. 
Familiarity with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices architecture. 
Experience in unit testing and test-driven development (TDD). 
Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins). 
Proficiency with Git and version control workflows (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket). 
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills with attention to detail. 
Excellent communication and leadership skills to mentor junior developers and collaborate in an Agile environment.

title: DIgital Marketing Specialist - Client Facing
description:
Job Title: Digital Marketing Manager Client Facing 
Location: Remote; 
Working hours: US time zone. 
Company Overview: At Lean Summit Solutions, we’re a fast-growing, forward-thinking team passionate about creating impactful digital experiences. We believe in a balanced work-life blend, fostering creativity, collaboration, and fun while striving for excellence in everything we do. If you’re looking for a company that values innovation, encourages new ideas, and supports personal growth, this is the place for you.
Job Overview: We’re looking for a Digital Marketing Manager with strong expertise in SEO, SEM, Social Media Marketing, and Analytics. This role requires a creative and analytical professional who can lead our digital marketing strategy, drive growth, and optimize performance across all channels. You’ll work closely with our content, design, and product teams to ensure our marketing campaigns are engaging, results-driven, and aligned with company goals.
Who You Are: You are a versatile and adaptable marketing professional who thrives on understanding and responding to the unique needs of your clients. A strategic thinker with a growth mindset, you always look ahead, identifying opportunities to enhance our digital presence and drive long-term success. Your approachability makes you a trusted partner, and you love building lasting relationships with clients and colleagues alike.
Collaboration comes naturally to you—you can navigate across various departments within client organizations, ensuring seamless communication and alignment. With high emotional intelligence (EQ) and deep empathy for client needs, you’re able to anticipate concerns, offer thoughtful solutions, and build trust.
You’re a problem solver who remains patient under pressure, calmly guiding projects through challenges to successful outcomes. Your positivity and vision make you inspirational and motivating, not just for your team but for everyone you work with. You see the bigger picture, prioritize effectively, and empower those around you to reach their goals while creating a supportive and collaborative environment.
Key Responsibilities: 
Develop and Implement Strategy: Design and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies across SEO, SEM, and Social Media channels to achieve business goals.
SEO Optimization: Drive organic traffic by implementing on-page, off-page, and technical SEO best practices. Conduct keyword research, content optimization, and performance analysis.
Paid Campaigns (SEM): Manage and optimize PPC campaigns (Google Ads, Bing Ads, etc.), ensuring maximum ROI through effective budget allocation, targeting, and ad copy development.
Social Media Management: Lead social media strategy and execution across platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter, etc.) to engage audiences and grow brand awareness.
Performance Analytics: Monitor, track, and analyze campaign performance using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, or HubSpot. Translate data into actionable insights and provide regular reports to stakeholders.
Collaboration & Leadership: Work with internal teams to align marketing efforts with content, product development, and design. Mentor junior team members and stay up-to-date on the latest industry trends.
Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of digital marketing trends, tools, and best practices. Implement A/B testing and growth experiments to continuously improve marketing performance. Identify critical conversion points and drop off points and optimize user funnels.
Qualifications: 
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience)
3-5 years of experience in digital marketing, with a proven track record of managing SEO, SEM, and social media campaigns
Expertise in Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, SEO tools (e.g., SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz)
Strong understanding of web analytics, tracking, and reporting
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
Creative mindset with a data-driven approach to problem-solving
What Makes Us Awesome (Our Culture): 
Flexible Work Hours: We care about the quality of your work, not when you do it. Enjoy flexibility in your schedule.
Remote-Friendly: Whether you prefer working from home or joining us at the office, we support what works best for you.
Fun and Collaborative Environment: We believe that work should be fun! From virtual team hangouts to in-office game nights, we make sure to keep things light-hearted.
Professional Development: We invest in your growth. We offer opportunities for continuous learning, whether through workshops, certifications, or conferences.
Wellness Focus: Work-life balance is important to us. We offer wellness programs, mental health days, and promote a healthy work environment.
Open Communication: We embrace transparency and value every team member’s input. Your ideas matter and will shape the future of our company.
How to Apply: If you’re excited about growing with a company that values innovation, balance, and creativity, we’d love to hear from you! Send your resume and a cover letter to hr@leansummits.com. Role & responsibilities 

Preferred candidate profile 

Perks and benefits

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
About the Company: 
Real Connect Consulting is a real estate marketplace for buying and selling premium homes in Bangalore. We have built long-term relationships with buyers, sellers, investors, and developers throughout our journey for 10 years now. Providing exceptional customer service and unparalleled market insight known for our professionalism and integrity, we are committed to delivering seamless transactions and exceeding client expectations at every stage of the buying, selling, and leasing process.

Job Responsibilities: 
We are looking for a performance-driven Digital Marketing Specialist with thorough knowledge of Google Ads and Meta (Facebook & Instagram) paid campaigns, along with hands-on expertise in graphic design and video editing. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving traffic, leads, and conversions while creating visually compelling creatives and video content to support paid and organic campaigns.

Key Responsibilities 
Plan, execute, and optimize Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube) and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) paid campaigns
Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, A/B testing, and performance optimization
Design engaging ad creatives, banners, landing page visuals, and social media graphics
Create and edit marketing videos, reels, ad videos, and promotional content optimized for paid campaigns
Analyze campaign performance using Google Analytics, Ads Manager, and other reporting tools
Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and conversion tracking
Develop content strategies aligned with campaign objectives and brand guidelines
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure consistency in messaging and design
Stay updated with the latest digital advertising trends and platform policies

Required Skills 
Proven experience in managing Google Ads and Meta Ads paid campaigns
Strong understanding of campaign structures, audience targeting, and performance metrics
Graphic design and video editing skills are essential and acknowledged as part of the role
Proficiency in tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Canva, or similar
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication and time-management abilities

Eligibility 
Preferred Qualifications:- Graduation + Digital Marketing Course
Google Ads and Meta Ads certifications
Experience with conversion tracking (GA4, GTM)
Knowledge of motion graphics and A/B creative testing

Why Join Us? 
Competitive salary based on digital marketing experience
Performance-based incentives tied to campaign target achievements
Career growth in digital marketing, branding & operations
Collaborative, fast-paced, and creative work environment

Homes247.in, part of VSNAP Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd., is a technology company building products and solutions across Real Estate, SaaS and AI. We

Paid Advertising 
Plan, execute and manage Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.

SEO & AEO

¢ Continuously monitor SEO status and identify opportunities for rankings, traffic and search visibility improvements.

Someone who can execute, analyze and optimize, rather than simply coordinate campaigns. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working independently,

title: Performance Marketing Manager (Meta Ads + Creative)
description:
Remote, anywhere in India. Australian and international clients. 14 to 18 LPA. Senior role with AI-powered tooling. 

The role 
We want one person to own Meta ads results for our Australian and international clients, from first idea to booked appointment. You plan the campaign, make the ad creative, launch it fast, and keep improving it every week until the numbers are where they should be.
We are an established Australian digital agency. We work mostly with healthcare providers (allied health, psychology, clinics, telehealth), plus trades, retail and professional services.
This is a senior, hands-on role. You will report directly to the agency director, work with real budgets, and have access to AI-powered tooling that lets you analyse an account and make changes in minutes, not hours. We pay well for people who use that advantage.
Location: Remote, open to candidates anywhere in India.
Type: Full time.
Hours: Mon to Fri, 9 to 5 IST.

What you will own 
You will have real ownership and the freedom to decide how to get results. You will own:
Results clients can feel. Booked appointments, sales and qualified enquiries, not just a cheap cost per lead. If leads are not turning into bookings, you find out why and fix it with the client.
Fast launches. New accounts live within 5 business days of access and approvals. You chase what you need and never let a launch sit.
Every live account improving every week. No account goes more than 7 days without a review and a logged decision, even when the decision is to leave it alone.
A steady flow of fresh creative. You make your own static and short video ads, and you test new angles at least every fortnight on every account.
Lead quality and follow-up. You check where leads land, how fast clients respond and whether the right people are coming through, then adjust targeting, forms and offers.
Account health. Spend limits, payment issues, rejected ads, broken tracking and lead routing are caught by you before they stop delivery.
Clear reporting. Short, honest updates on what changed, what it did and what you will do next.
Client retention. Clients who stay because they can see the value. You will know which accounts are at risk before they tell us.

Who you are 
You must have: 
A proven track record. 4 or more years running Meta ads hands-on, across several accounts at once, with lead generation results you can show in real numbers: spend, leads, cost per lead, and bookings or sales.
Deep platform expertise. You know how to structure accounts for the current Meta algorithm: Advantage+ campaigns and audiences, consolidated structures, budget strategy, bidding, placements and learning phase. You can explain why you would choose one setup over another.
Analytical depth. You diagnose performance, not just report it. When cost per lead jumps or leads dry up, you find the cause, whether that is creative fatigue, audience saturation, tracking, the offer or the landing page, and you fix it. You are confident in spreadsheets and know attribution windows, incrementality and the limits of platform-reported numbers.
Tracking you can trust. Hands-on with Meta Pixel, Conversions API, custom conversions, event setup and GA4, so you know the numbers you are optimising are real.
A disciplined testing approach. You run structured tests with a clear hypothesis, isolate one variable, and know when a result is meaningful and when it is noise.
Strategic thinking beyond the ad. You look at the whole path to a customer, from offer and creative to landing page, lead form and follow-up, and you suggest improvements outside the ad account when they will move results.
Strong creative skills. You design scroll-stopping static ads and edit short videos yourself, in Canva, Figma, CapCut or similar, and with AI image and video tools. You know which hooks and formats work for which audiences.
Sharp copywriting in natural English for Australian and international audiences.
Ownership and speed. You act without being asked, turn work around in days, and tell people what you did and why.
Commercial thinking. You know whether a client is getting value for money, and you care about it.
AI fluency. You use AI tools every day for analysis, writing, creative and speed.
Clear, professional written communication. Everything you write could be forwarded to a client.

Strong bonus: 
Agency experience managing a diverse range of client accounts at the same time.
Healthcare or telehealth advertising experience, including Meta's health and wellness restrictions.
Strong working knowledge of Meta's advertising policies, including restricted categories, ad rejections and keeping accounts in good standing.
Experience with instant forms, lead routing and CRM integrations.

You will love this role if 
You get a kick out of turning a struggling account around.
You like owning the result, not just the setup.
You enjoy making the creative as much as running the numbers.
You want your work to show up as real customers for real businesses.
You are always looking for a smarter, faster way to do things, and AI tools are part of how you work.

What we offer 
Salary: 14 to 18 LPA, depending on experience.
Fully remote from anywhere in India, with a small, experienced team and direct access to the agency director.
AI-powered tooling for account analysis, reporting and changes, so your time goes on thinking and creative, not admin.
Real budgets and variety: healthcare, retail, trades and professional services, across Australia and internationally.
Room to grow: as you prove results, you take on more accounts and more say in strategy.

How to apply 
Apply through Naukri with your CV and answer the screening questions. They help us see how you think.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Manager Performance Marketing 
Company: Infinity Learn

Experience: 4-6 Years
Location: Bengaluru
We're looking for a performance-driven Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition and creative strategy across platforms, turning media spend into efficient, high-quality student growth. 
What You'll Work On 
Driving quality, cost-efficient student acquisition that feeds a robust, scalable onboarding flow.
Building campaigns and creative that reinforce the habit-forming, gamified learning experience across the student lifecycle.
AI-led thinking — bringing an AI-first mindset to media buying, creative generation, and audience targeting.
Key Responsibilities 
Plan, execute, and scale performance marketing campaigns across Meta, Google (Search/YouTube/PMax), DV360, and other programmatic/DMP platforms to drive quality student acquisition.
Own end-to-end campaign strategy — audience targeting, bidding strategy, budget allocation, and channel mix — to maximize ROAS and minimize blended CAC.
Define and evolve creative strategy — the hook, the story, and the CTA — partnering with creative/content teams to build ads that drive strong ad recall and stopping power.
Diagnose creative and campaign performance using a structured testing approach (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, VTR, ad recall lift) and iterate quickly.
Partner with Product to align campaign messaging and targeting with the onboarding journey and habit-forming features (streaks, rewards) to improve post-acquisition activation and retention.
Leverage AI-first marketing tools for creative generation, audience/lookalike modeling, and automated bid optimization.
Run and interpret multiple concurrent experiments (creative, channel, audience, bidding) and build frameworks to confidently identify what's actually driving performance.
Report campaign performance and unit economics to Business and Leadership; work cross-functionally with Product, Tech, and Sales to align spend with business goals.
What We're Looking For 
3–5 years in performance/growth marketing at a consumer-tech company, with hands-on experience running and optimizing campaigns on Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, DV360, and other DSP/DMP platforms.
Strong grasp of creative strategy — able to define the hook, the story, and the CTA, and to diagnose why a creative is or isn't working using recall, CTR, and engagement data.
Deep fluency in marketing and business metrics: ROAS, CAC, CTRs, & LTV:CAC
Experience managing sizeable media budgets and agency/vendor relationships.
Working knowledge of attribution, incrementality testing, or marketing mix modeling (MMM) is a plus.
Graduate/postgraduate from a Tier-1 institute (IIT, IIM, or equivalent).
Significant experience solving hard, scaled problems at consumer-tech companies.
A consumer-first, user-first advocacy mindset — you default to the student's point of view in every decision.
Ability to run multiple experiments in parallel and still build confident, repeatable frameworks to conclude results.
Strong cross-functional stakeholdership — proven ability to work closely with Business, Tech, and Sales/Marketing teams.

title: Performance Marketing Manager Ecommerce
description:
Senior Manager Performance Marketing (Quick Commerce & E-Commerce)
Company: WOW! Momo Sales Pvt. Limited
Location: Bangalore, India
Job Type: Full-time
Reports To: Head – E-Commerce & Emerging Channels
About the Company
WOW! Momo is India's largest momo brand and a leading player in the FMCG food industry. The company is looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing professional to manage campaign execution, pricing, catalogue management, and digital shelf visibility across Quick Commerce and E-Commerce channels.
Job Summary
The Senior Manager – Performance Marketing will own the day-to-day marketing engine across Quick Commerce and E-Commerce platforms including Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes, Amazon, and BigBasket.
The role will be responsible for campaign planning and execution, pricing and promotions, catalogue management, digital shelf visibility, performance analysis, and reporting. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role requiring daily coordination with E-Commerce KAMs, platform account teams, creative agencies, Supply Chain, and Finance teams.
Key Responsibilities
Campaign Planning & Execution
Prepare and maintain the monthly promotional calendar across platforms.
Coordinate campaign participation, timelines, and creative requirements with platform marketing teams and creative agencies.
Pricing & Promotions
Upload and validate promotional pricing across platforms.
Ensure live prices match approved price lists.
Coordinate discount funding approvals.
Validate promotion go-live and implementation.
Identify and resolve pricing discrepancies.
Remove expired promotions on schedule.
Catalogue Management
Manage new SKU listings, product descriptions, images, and specifications.
Maintain accurate MRP, weight, nutritional information, and other product details.
Maintain SKU master mapping.
Conduct regular catalogue hygiene audits.
Validate listing accuracy and correct mapping errors.
Digital Shelf & Visibility Monitoring
Track search ranking, banner visibility, and category placement by SKU and platform.
Monitor share of shelf and hero SKU visibility.
Benchmark competitor pricing and visibility on a weekly basis.
Performance Analysis & Reporting
Prepare campaign performance reports.
Track TACOS, ROAS, and campaign performance.
Monitor market share trends.
Maintain a weekly marketing dashboard for leadership review.
Cross-Functional Coordination
Work closely with E-Commerce KAMs to align promotions with stock availability.
Coordinate with Supply Chain to avoid promoting out-of-stock SKUs.
Coordinate with Finance for campaign spend settlement.
Partner with creative agencies and platform marketing teams to ensure timely execution.
Requirements
3–6 years of experience in Performance Marketing, preferably in E-Commerce, Quick Commerce, or FMCG.
Hands-on experience managing pricing, catalogue, and promotions on marketplace or Quick Commerce seller platforms.
Strong analytical skills with experience in TACOS, ROAS, and campaign performance data.
High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple platforms simultaneously.
Strong cross-functional coordination skills.
Proficiency in Excel.
Familiarity with seller and marketing dashboards of platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes, Amazon, and BigBasket.
Nice to Have
Experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads.
Familiarity with Google Analytics and Tableau.
Previous experience in Quick Commerce or D2C FMCG brands.
What We Offer
Competitive salary and benefits.
Ownership of a high-visibility, fast-growing function.
Opportunity to work across India's rapidly expanding Quick Commerce and E-Commerce ecosystem.
Collaborative and execution-focused work environment.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
About Affix Center 
Affix Center Softech Services Pvt. Ltd. is an IT and web development company based in Mumbai. We build websites, portals, and software solutions for enterprise and government clients, and we run digital marketing for our own brand and for our clients.
About the Role
We are seeking a creative, proactive, and detail-oriented Digital Marketing Executive to support and execute digital marketing strategies for multiple brands and clients.
The candidate should have practical experience in SEO, social media marketing, content coordination, campaign execution, and digital analytics.

Work mode: 

Work from Office (Lower Parel, Mumbai)
Key Responsibilities
Execute day-to-day digital marketing activities across multiple client accounts.
Implement On-Page, Off-Page, Technical, and Local SEO strategies.
Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and website SEO audits.
Optimize website content, metadata, internal linking, and landing pages.
Manage social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
Develop and maintain monthly social media content calendars.
Coordinate with graphic designers and content creators for posts, reels, banners, and advertising creatives.
Assist with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn advertising campaigns.
Monitor Google Search Console, GA4, and other analytics tools.
Support Google Business Profile optimization and local search visibility.
Implement basic AI SEO, AEO, and content optimization best practices.
Track website traffic, keyword rankings, engagement, and leads.
Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
Coordinate with internal teams and clients to ensure timely delivery of marketing activities.

Required Skills 
23 years of practical digital marketing experience.
Good understanding of SEO, SEM, SMM, and content marketing.
Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, GA4, Google Keyword Planner, and SEO tools such as Semrush or Ahrefs.
Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and Google Ads.
Basic understanding of WordPress or other content management systems.
Ability to coordinate creative production and manage content calendars.
Strong written communication, organizational, and multitasking skills.
Familiarity with Canva, AI content tools, and marketing automation is an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Communications, or a related field. Relevant digital marketing certifications are an added advantage.

What We're Looking For 
An enthusiastic digital marketing professional who can independently execute assigned activities, coordinate multiple projects, and contribute to organic growth, brand visibility, and lead generation.

title: Head Digital Marketing
description:
Job Title: Digital Marketing Head-Premium Real Estate 
Company: Verve Global Service
Industry: Real Estate Consulting & Marketing
Client Profile: Premium Real Estate Development, Karjat
Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra (Hybrid)

Job Summary 
Verve Global Service is hiring an experienced and result-oriented Digital Marketing Head on behalf of a premium real estate development company based in Karjat, near Mumbai, Maharashtra.

The company is developing a large-scale property spanning approximately 200 acres of land , envisioned as a premium destination offering significant opportunities in real estate marketing, property promotion, investor engagement, and channel partner development.

The selected candidate will lead the overall digital marketing function, build and manage a dedicated marketing team, and develop integrated strategies to strengthen the project's digital presence, generate qualified property enquiries, expand the real estate broker network, and support sales growth.

This role offers the opportunity to build a structured digital marketing operation from the ground up, combining strategic planning, hands-on campaign management, team leadership, performance marketing, and real estate lead generation.

The ideal candidate should understand how digital marketing translates into real estate business outcomes and be comfortable working directly with senior management.

Key Responsibilities 

1. Digital Marketing Strategy 

Develop and execute a comprehensive digital marketing strategy for a premium real estate development in Karjat.
Establish marketing objectives, campaign plans, budgets, KPIs, and performance benchmarks.
Build strategies to increase brand awareness, attract prospective buyers and investors, and generate qualified enquiries.
Develop a digital roadmap aligned with the company's real estate sales and business development objectives.

2. Team Management & Marketing Operations 

Build, manage, and supervise a dedicated team of social media and digital marketing professionals.
Allocate responsibilities, set performance targets, and monitor team productivity.
Oversee content calendars, creative production, campaign execution, publishing schedules, and reporting.
Establish efficient workflows for campaign approvals, lead management, and performance tracking.
Train and mentor team members while ensuring consistent quality and timely execution.
Build a scalable marketing function with clear responsibilities and measurable outcomes.

3. Real Estate Marketing & Lead Generation 

Plan and execute digital campaigns to promote the real estate development and its offerings.
Develop targeted campaigns for prospective property buyers, investors, high-net-worth individuals, and relevant audience segments.
Generate qualified property enquiries through digital channels.
Work closely with the sales team to improve lead quality, follow-up processes, and conversion rates.
Develop landing pages, enquiry forms, campaign creatives, and digital promotional materials.
Track enquiries from initial contact through follow-up, site visits, and sales conversion.

4. Broker & Channel Partner Acquisition 

Develop a structured digital strategy to identify and engage real estate brokers, property consultants, channel partners, and agencies.
Build and maintain a database of relevant real estate professionals and prospective channel partners.
Execute outreach campaigns through LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, and other appropriate channels.
Support broker onboarding, relationship management, project promotion, and channel partner engagement.
Coordinate with the sales team to facilitate broker meetings, project presentations, and property site visits.
Monitor broker engagement, active channel partners, referral enquiries, and resulting sales opportunities.

5. Performance Marketing & Campaign Management 

Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant platforms.
Develop audience targeting strategies for real estate buyers, investors, and channel partners.
Monitor cost per lead, lead quality, conversion rates, campaign expenditure, and return on advertising spend.
Conduct A/B testing of creatives, audiences, landing pages, and campaign messaging.
Optimize campaigns to improve enquiry quality and marketing efficiency.
Manage advertising budgets and ensure transparent reporting on campaign performance.

6. Brand Building & Digital Presence 

Lead social media strategy across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
Oversee website content, SEO, social media creatives, project videos, property walkthroughs, and promotional campaigns.
Develop a premium and consistent digital identity for the real estate development.
Coordinate with designers, video editors, content creators, and external vendors.
Identify relevant digital trends and creative opportunities to differentiate the project in the market.

7. Analytics, Reporting & Sales Alignment 

Establish dashboards and reporting systems to track marketing and sales-related performance.
Monitor traffic, enquiries, lead quality, broker engagement, site visits, and conversions.
Maintain accurate lead records and CRM processes in coordination with the sales team.
Present regular performance reports and actionable recommendations to senior management.
Identify underperforming campaigns and implement improvements based on data.
Ensure marketing activities contribute to measurable business and sales objectives.

Required Skills & Qualifications 

3-6 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, or real estate marketing.
Strong understanding of lead generation and digital campaign management.
Practical experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, CRM systems, and reporting tools.

title: Digital Marketing Head
description:
Company: JPrime Buildcon LLP 
Industry: Real Estate
Reporting To: Management / Director
Company Website : www.jprimebuildconllp.com
HR Manager: Prachi D 
HR Contact: 8104419399
Email: prachi.d@jprimebuildconllp.com
Interview Time: 02:00 PM to 05:00 PM

Interview Address: Jprime Buildcon llp, Office No. 601/602, One Platinum, Plot no 8, Sector 15 Belapur, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, 400614.

Role & responsibilities 

The Digital Marketing Head will be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing end-to-end digital marketing strategies to generate quality leads, enhance brand visibility, and support sales for real estate projects. The role requires strong expertise in Meta Ads, PR, and performance-driven digital marketing .

Key Responsibilities: 

1. Digital Marketing Strategy 
Develop and implement integrated digital marketing strategies for real estate projects.
Align marketing campaigns with sales targets and project launches.
Manage marketing budgets and ensure maximum ROI.

________________________________________

2. Performance Marketing (Meta & Paid Campaigns) 

Plan, execute, and optimize Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) campaigns.
Manage Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube) and other paid platforms.
Monitor CPL, CPA, CTR, and lead quality metrics.
Coordinate with sales for lead tracking and conversion optimization.
________________________________________ 

3. Lead Generation & CRM Coordination 
Drive quality lead generation through digital channels.
Ensure proper lead funnel management and CRM integration.
Analyze lead sources and improve conversion rates.
________________________________________
4. Public Relations (PR) & Brand Management 
Plan and execute PR activities for project launches and corporate branding.
Coordinate with PR agencies, media houses, and digital publications.
Manage brand reputation across digital platforms and portals.
________________________________________
5. SEO, SEM & Website Management 
Oversee SEO strategies to improve organic rankings and traffic.
Manage SEM campaigns for project-specific keywords.
Ensure website optimization, landing page performance, and lead forms.
________________________________________
6. Social Media & Content Marketing 
Plan and manage social media calendars for projects and corporate branding.
Oversee content creation (creatives, videos, reels, blogs).
Ensure consistent brand messaging across platforms.
________________________________________
7. Analytics, Reporting & Optimization 
Track campaign performance using Google Analytics, Meta Business Manager, and other tools.
Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
Provide actionable insights for continuous improvement.
________________________________________
8. Team & Agency Management 
Lead and mentor the digital marketing team.
Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, and freelancers.
Ensure timely execution of campaigns and deliverables.

Preferred candidate profile 

In-depth knowledge of Meta Ads & performance marketing.
Strong understanding of SEO, SEM, SMM, content & analytics.
Experience in PR and brand-building activities.
Knowledge of real estate portals (99acres, Magicbricks, Housing, etc.) is an advantage.
Excellent analytical, communication, and leadership skills

Preferred Qualifications 
Bachelors/Masters degree in Marketing, Digital Media, or related field.
5+ years of experience in digital marketing (real estate preferred).
Proven track record in lead generation and campaign optimization .

title: Social Media & Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Social Media & Digital Marketing Manager
Company: Dhariwal Securities Pvt. Ltd.
Department: Marketing & Business Development
Location: Borivali East, Mumbai, Maharashtra
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: Work from Office
Experience: 2 To 3 Years
Salary: As per Interview, depending on experience and skills
About the Company
Dhariwal Securities Pvt. Ltd. operates across financial services, including loans, insurance and mutual funds. The company aims to strengthen its digital presence, build customer trust and generate business opportunities through digital marketing.
Role Overview
We are looking for a creative, analytical and result-oriented Social Media & Digital Marketing Manager to develop and execute digital marketing strategies, build online brand presence, create engaging content, manage advertising campaigns and generate quality leads for the company's financial products and services.
Key Responsibilities
Social Media Management 
Manage Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
Develop monthly social media content calendars.
Create posts, reels, videos, carousels, banners and promotional creatives.
Maintain consistent brand identity, communication and posting schedules.
Improve brand awareness, audience engagement and organic reach.
Digital Marketing & Lead Generation 
Plan, execute and optimise paid campaigns using Meta Ads and Google Ads.
Generate qualified leads for home loans, loan balance transfers, insurance and mutual fund services.
Develop targeted digital campaigns to reach potential customers.
Monitor lead quality, cost per lead, conversion rates and campaign performance.
Coordinate with the Sales team to track leads and improve conversions.
Explore new digital channels and customer acquisition strategies.
Content Creation & Branding 
Create informative and promotional content related to financial products and services.
Develop customer-focused campaigns to build trust and credibility.
Use Canva, CapCut or other graphic design and video editing tools.
Research competitors, market trends and digital marketing opportunities.
Support brand-building initiatives across online channels.
Performance Tracking & Reporting 
Prepare weekly and monthly digital marketing performance reports.
Track reach, engagement, leads, advertising expenditure and cost per lead.
Analyse campaign results and recommend improvements.
Manage marketing budgets and optimise campaign returns.
New Business Development 
Develop digital marketing strategies for the upcoming trading platform business.
Support launches of new financial products, services and digital initiatives.
Identify opportunities to expand the company's online customer base.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication or a related field.
2 to 3 years of hands-on experience in social media management and digital marketing; fintech experience preferred.
Practical knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
Experience in lead generation and paid campaign optimisation.
Proficiency in Canva and basic video editing tools.
Knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics and social media insights.
Strong communication, creativity, analytical thinking and organisational skills.
Ability to manage campaigns independently and work towards measurable business goals.
A finance background is preferred.
Key Performance Indicators
Performance will be evaluated based on social media reach and engagement, quality and volume of leads, cost per qualified lead, brand visibility, content quality and contribution to customer acquisition.
Compensation & Benefits
Monthly in-hand salary will be decided based on the candidate's experience and skills.
This is an opportunity to build and manage the digital presence of a growing financial services company and gain exposure to multiple business verticals and new digital initiatives.
Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Performance Marketing Manager Meta, Google & YouTube Ads 

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can combine hands-on performance marketing with strategic thinking.
You will work directly with the CEO and take ownership of lead generation across Meta, Google Search and paid YouTube campaigns, with a clear focus on improving lead quality, qualified CPL, conversions and ROI.
The role will play an important part in scaling the business, expanding customer acquisition and contributing directly to business development and revenue growth.
You will also manage and coordinate internal team members, external agencies, freelancers and specialist partners, ensuring all marketing resources work toward common campaign and business goals.

Key Responsibilities 
Own and optimise Meta Ads, Google Ads and paid YouTube campaigns for qualified lead generation.
Manage campaign strategy, budgets, audiences, retargeting and creative testing across paid channels.
Design, track and optimise lead-generation funnels, including landing pages, lead forms, qualification, nurturing and conversion journeys.
Improve performance across the funnel from lead to qualified lead, consultation and business opportunity.
Analyse advertising and CRM data to improve lead quality, conversion rates, attribution and ROI.
Work closely with the CEO on growth priorities, customer acquisition and new market opportunities.
Manage internal resources, agencies, freelancers and specialists across campaign execution and creative.
Strengthen tracking, reporting and optimisation using GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, CAPI, CRM integrations, AI and automation.

Preferred Candidate Profile 
5-7 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, paid media or growth marketing.
Strong practical experience managing Meta Ads, Google Search and YouTube Ads.
Proven track record in high-ticket B2C lead generation; experience in financial services, real estate, immigration, education, consulting or premium services will be an advantage.
Strong understanding of campaign optimisation, funnels, audience targeting, retargeting, video advertising and conversion tracking.
Experience managing junior team members and coordinating with agencies or external partners.
Strong communication, commercial thinking and confidence working directly with senior leadership.
Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI, automation and emerging marketing technologies.
MBA/MMS/PGDM in Marketing or a relevant engineering background is strongly preferred, along with proven hands-on performance marketing results.

Why Join Acquest Advisors 
Work directly with the Founder & CEO and play a key role in the companys growth, customer acquisition and business expansion.
Take ownership of performance marketing across Meta, Google and YouTube, with visible impact on lead generation and revenue.
Work across international markets and high-value customer segments, using AI, CRM and automation to improve marketing performance.
Build toward a broader marketing and growth leadership role as the business scales.
Earn performance-linked incentives of 2.5 LPA, based on leads converting into business.
Compensation 
8-10 LPA fixed + 2.5 LPA performance-linked incentives
How Success Will Be Measured
Qualified Leads Qualified CPL Consultations Opportunities Business Conversions Marketing ROI
We are looking for someone who wants to own outcomes, not just campaigns.

Work Mode: This is an on-site internship based in the Western Suburbs of Mumbai. Candidates residing in the Western Suburbs will be preferred.

title: Senior Growth Marketer (AI, SaaS, B2B Software)
description:
Cogover is an Agentic Enterprise Platform that unifies CRM, Call Center, Workflow, and AI in one connected system. It helps businesses build applications tailored to their operations, automate workflows, and use AI agents to carry out tasks across business processes. With AI-assisted app creation and no-code configuration, Cogover brings customer data, communications, and processes together. We help teams in sectors such as stock brokerage, lending, debt collection, and real estate manage sales, service, and operations with less manual work and greater visibility. 

Job description 

Own the full-funnel demand engine: paid (LinkedIn, Google), organic, email/outbound enablement, and account-based campaigns targeting our ICP.
Build vertical-specific campaigns and messaging by segment.
Translate operational pain (fragmentation, no visibility, SLA breakdown, manual dependency, scaling chaos) into landing pages, ad copy, and content that speaks to COOs, Heads of CX, and CTOs, not generic SaaS fluff.
Run experiments end-to-end: hypothesis campaign measurement iteration. Own CAC, MQLSQL conversion, pipeline contribution, and CPL by channel.
Partner closely with Sales to align messaging with the lead-scoring model and feed a qualified, high-intent pipeline (not vanity leads).
Build the content and SEO foundation: case studies, vertical playbooks, comparison content, and thought leadership on enterprise operations execution.
Own marketing analytics and attribution, instrument the funnel, and report what's actually driving pipeline. 

Requirements 

3-6 years in B2B SaaS/enterprise tech growth marketing, ideally selling to Indian mid-market and enterprise.
Demonstrated ownership of a measurable pipeline number, not just campaign activity.
Hands-on with the modern stack: LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot/marketing automation, GA4, and one ABM tool.
Strong copy instincts; you can write pain-led, persona-specific messaging and kill generic feature lists.
Comfortable with long, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and aligning marketing to them. Cogover by Stringee • Growth Marketer B2B SaaS, India • Page 1
Analytical and experiment-driven; fluent in funnel metrics, attribution, and unit economics (CAC, payback, LTV).
Use AI tools as a force multiplier across content generation, ad/landing-page copy variants, audience research, campaign ops, and analysis- the output and velocity of an AI-native marketer, not 2020-era manual work.
Build AI-assisted systems, not one-off prompts: repeatable pipelines for content production, lead research/enrichment, and campaign reporting.
Demonstrated, hands-on use of LLMs and AI marketing tooling in a real role; you can show what you automated and the lift you got.
Experience in B2B SaaS - ideally to BFSI / financial services in India is a strong advantage. 

Remuneration package 

Salary: 1012 LPA . Pay reflects your ability and experience, and we will never pay less than what youre worth.

Performance bonuses : based on work performance, including annual and holiday bonuses.
Advancement opportunities : clear paths to Team Leader, Manager and beyond as Cogover scales in India.
Work environment : a young, dynamic and creative team that supports your development.
Professional training : continuous improvement of professional skills.
Learning opportunities : hands-on exposure to new technology, AI and innovation.
Employee engagement : hangouts, picnics, team trips and other activities. Working conditions

Working hours : full-time, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, with a 1-hour lunch break (1:30 PM 2:30 PM), from Monday to Friday.

title: Career Opportunity at Xanadu in Digital Marketing
description:
About Xanadu Realty: 
Xanadu Group is India's foremost institutional growth expert to the realty sector and is currently the fastest growing 
non-developer organization in the sector. Xanadu is the comprehensive institutional sales & marketing solution for 
real estate companies that focuses on product conception and design, product and brand development, market 
assessment, scaling up the best-in-class distribution, and CRM solutions, over and above conventional guidance 
and consultation for developers. We help developers focus on what they do best i.e., build best in class commercial 
and residential spaces, by lending our support and expertise with a dedicated team of marketing and sales strategists 
for each project, capable of creating a differentiated brand identity for the developer and the project at hand, rooted 
in scientific research and data, proven sales track record, and objective led market communication and distribution 
efforts. We help scale distribution and sales, by providing unmatched demand generation and market penetration 

Role: Digital Marketing 

Your day-to-day work/ Key Responsibilities 

Engaging with various stakeholders to understand project requirements and providing appropriate 
recommendations on execution 
Creating business plans and GTM strategies and implementing strategic & tactical initiatives towards 
revenue generation for projects as applicable 
End to End responsibility for managing lead generation campaigns for various launch / sustenance phases 
for different products 
Managing the lead lifecycle from generation to final closure 
Agency to Execution strategies for site 
(last mile) 

Working with digital agencies for a 360-degree implementation of plans 
Managing the P&L of projects for a defined time-period with complete ownership of all decisions made towards the same Using data to understand sales trends / market trends / customer behaviour and making relevant 
recommendations to top management based on this data 

We offer 

1-2 years of work experience in a Brand role with preferably an MNC; To ensure a broader 
spectrum of thought not just restricted to digital 
Avoid candidates who have worked in government roles / PSUs 
Avoid candidates who have prior real estate work experience 

We expect you to have 

Understanding of sales and marketing concepts & theory 
Added digital experience to help 
Ability to analyse data and derive trends / understanding from it 
Fluent knowledge of MS Office (Word, Power-point, Excel) 
Clearly able to differentiate right from wrong with a strong moral compass 
Capable of taking ownership of complex problems & structures 
Adaptive to different / rapidly changing circumstances 
Comfortable with operating within chaos / with limited information 
Able to work with a variety of people and manage their expectations with finesse 
Base Location: Mumbai.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist | Mon - Thurs | Work From Home
description:
Job Title: Digital Marketing Specialist

Reports to: Digital Marketing Manager (DMM)

Working Hours: 1:30 PM - 12:00 AM

Overview: The Digital Marketing Specialist (DMS) is a vital position in our marketing department. DMS needs to ensure attention to detail, quality of work and follow-through on all marketing client accounts. 
DMS is someone who: 
Possesses a blend of strategic vision, leadership skills, and technical expertise
Ability to develop and execute long-term digital marketing strategies that align with the client goals.
Ensures Meeting agendas are updated for the tasks assigned in time for client meetings.
Capable of identifying new opportunities and trends in digital marketing, and implementing innovative solutions.

Roles, Responsibilities & Duties: 

Marketing Related Responsibilities 

Social Media 
Creating and optimizing clients Social Media profiles and linking it to SemRush 
Scheduling Social Media posts, and checking the profiles for engagements
Review clients Facebook notifications for every client and remove any unwanted comments (if required).
Check Facebook messages for each client, if the client has not responded then the Specialist needs to seek permission from the Relationship Manager to send the client an email notifying them.
Pay Per Click (PPC) 
Create PPC campaigns for clients on the following platforms
Google Ads
Microsoft Ads
Meta Ads
LinkedIn Ad
Monitor clients Pay Per Click account.
Review paused campaigns in clients Google, Microsoft, LinkedIn, Meta ads account and reactivate if required (Monthly)
Update the PPC All Clients document with the campaign details
Check PPC monthly spend of clients to ensure the budgets are not overspending or underspending.
PPC Negative Keyword 
Download the search term reports from Google and Microsoft and upload it to the PPC document.
Upload the approved negative keyword report sent by the CSs to the clients Google and Microsoft Ads account.
Newsletter 
Creating Newsletters & E-blasts templates
Scheduling E-blasts & Newsletters templates
Upload Website Content (including Newsletters)
Upload contacts to the client's distribution platform
Send out Email Drips for clients (NEWSLETTER TASK)
YouTube 
Upload videos on clients YouTube Channel
YouTube SEO optimization data has been uploaded correctly
Website Content 
Uploading SEO Meta content for Websites (Website Content)
SEO GEO 
Running reports for SEO GEO pages and Google Analytics reports
Backlinking 
Review upcoming backlinks to be used by ensuring high domain authority and low spam score.
Search for the relevant backlinks for the respective client, submit and update the sheet.
Backlinking Disavow (Quarterly)
ORM 
Responding to reviews for ORM.
Create Apple & Bing Listings if needed
Onboard clients to ORM software and begin monitoring weekly.
Review Apple, Yelp, Bing and Google Business Profile listings to ensure data is updated correctly.
Review advice local to make sure the listing scores are good and do any mitigation activities, if needed. 
Downloading and uploading ORM reports (Monthly)
Email monthly reports to the meeting marketing clients
Lead Tracking 
Reviewing calls for Lead tracking and Measurement, and compiling reports
Check to ensure call tracking numbers are active on PPC, GMB, Social Media and Newsletters, etc.
Email the Lead tracking sheet to the client (Weekly)
ROI - Sending emails to clients (Monthly)
Updating the ROI sheet with data received from the client
Reviewing calls for Google Guarantee and compiling reports
Meeting Agendas 
Meeting agendas need to be updated for the tasks assigned in time for client meetings.
LinkedIn 
Connecting with the target audience for clients, sending invites and updating sheets for LinkedIn Outreach/Sales Navigator. 
Web Scraping 
Web scraping for:
Contact information such as phone numbers, emails, addresses, etc. for List building. 
Bloggers/influencers and building a list for Influencer Outreach
Website Reports 
Create the website reports (Google speed, Woorank, W3C and ADA) and send to the ARM/RM
Create SEMRush Site Audit report
Create Competitor Analysis report
Others 
Handle client communications that are specific to the tasks you were assigned 
Forward non-specific emails to relevant DMM/EVP as necessary
Stay up to date with the Digital Marketing Specialist department Operating Procedures Documents.
All other duties as assigned by DMM, EVP and/ or CPR Principals 

Department Related Responsibilities 
Communicate across departments to follow up on tasks as necessary
Prefer work experience in organization, task management, and timeline oriented roles.

Innovation Related Responsibilities 
Out of the box recommendations
Suggesting innovative ideas to enhance the department procedures
Initiative to learn about web, which includes development courses

Qualifications (Required): 
Google and/ or MS Office Suite proficiency.
Bachelor's Degree (Business/Marketing)
Fresher/6 months experience in the marketing field
Excellent verbal fluency and excellent written English language skills.

Qualifications (Preferred): 
Prefer a certificate in Marketing or related field i.e. Communications, etc.
Prefer work experience in journalistic/ writing field and/or English teaching, etc.

Oshin Infotech Services Private Limited is a growing healthcare technology and teleradiology services organization committed to delivering high-quality radiology reporting solutions to hospitals, diagnostic centers, and healthcare providers. We are seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to strengthen our brand presence, generate qualified leads, and support business growth in domestic and international markets.

Position Summary 
The Digital Marketing Specialist will be responsible for developing and executing digital marketing strategies to enhance brand visibility, generate leads, support business development initiatives, and identify new market opportunities. The role requires a combination of digital marketing expertise, analytical skills, content development capabilities, and business acumen.

Key Responsibilities 

Digital Marketing & Brand Building 
Develop and implement comprehensive digital marketing strategies aligned with business goals.
Manage and optimize the company's website, social media platforms, and online presence.
Create and execute SEO and SEM strategies to improve online visibility.
Plan and manage paid advertising campaigns across Google, LinkedIn, Meta, and other relevant platforms.
Develop engaging content, including blogs, articles, case studies, newsletters, and social media posts.
Monitor and enhance the company's online reputation and brand positioning.

Lead Generation & Business Growth 
Design and execute lead generation campaigns through digital channels.
Generate qualified B2B leads for sales and business development teams.
Manage lead nurturing activities and marketing funnels.
Track and improve lead conversion rates.
Identify and explore new business opportunities through market research and digital outreach.

International Market Development 
Research international markets and identify potential clients, partners, and business opportunities.
Build and maintain databases of prospective healthcare organisations and decision-makers.
Support business expansion initiatives through targeted marketing campaigns.
Collaborate with leadership to develop international marketing strategies.

Analytics & Reporting 
Monitor website traffic, campaign performance, and lead-generation metrics.
Prepare monthly performance reports and recommendations.
Analyze competitor activities, market trends, and customer behavior.
Utilize data-driven insights to optimize marketing strategies and ROI.

Stakeholder Collaboration 
Work closely with leadership, sales, operations, and clinical teams to align marketing efforts with business objectives.
Coordinate with external agencies, designers, and content creators as required.

Required Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.

36 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, or Business Development.
Experience in B2B marketing is preferred.
Healthcare, Health-Tech, or Teleradiology industry experience will be an added advantage.

Digital Marketing 
Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
Search Engine Marketing (SEM)
Google Ads
Social Media Marketing
Email Marketing
Content Marketing
Marketing Automation

Lead Generation & CRM 
B2B lead generation
LinkedIn outreach and networking
CRM tools 
Marketing funnel management

Analytics & Tools 
Google Analytics (GA4)
Google Search Console
LinkedIn Campaign Manager
Microsoft Office Suite
Canva and basic design tools

Soft Skills 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong presentation and networking abilities.
Analytical and data-driven mindset.
Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.

Preferred Certifications 
Google Ads Certification
Google Analytics Certification
HubSpot Inbound Marketing Certification
LinkedIn Marketing Certification

AI-driven operations: build agents that automate incident response, log analysis, deployments and infrastructure tasks, with human approval.

title: AWS Cloud / DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Description: 

AWS Cloud / DevOps Engineer 
Role Overview 
We are looking for an experienced AWS Cloud / DevOps Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in AWS infrastructure, AWS CDK, GitHub Actions, serverless services, containers, APIs, IAM, databases, and CI/CD deployments.
The candidate should be capable of designing, implementing, deploying, and maintaining production-grade AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code and automated deployment pipelines.

Key Responsibilities 
- Design, build, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure using AWS CDK and Infrastructure as Code.
- Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
- Automate application and infrastructure deployments across development, staging, and production environments.
- Work extensively with:
- AWS Lambda
- Amazon API Gateway
- Amazon ECS
- Amazon SQS
- Amazon SNS
- Amazon DynamoDB
- AWS IAM
- Amazon CloudWatch
- Amazon VPC
- Amazon S3
- Design and implement REST APIs using API Gateway and Lambda.
- Build event-driven architectures using SQS, SNS, and Lambda.
- Deploy and manage containerized applications using ECS.
- Design secure IAM roles, policies, permissions, and service-to-service access.
- Implement infrastructure completely through CDK, minimizing manual AWS console configuration.
- Develop reusable CDK constructs and maintain multiple AWS environments/accounts.
- Configure monitoring, logging, alerting, and troubleshooting using AWS services.
- Manage application configuration, secrets, networking, security, and deployment dependencies.
- Troubleshoot production infrastructure and deployment issues.
- Follow AWS best practices for security, scalability, availability, reliability, and cost optimization.
- Collaborate with developers to integrate application deployments with AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.

Required Technical Skills
AWS

Strong hands-on experience with:
- Lambda
- API Gateway
- ECS
- SQS
- SNS
- DynamoDB
- IAM
- S3
- CloudWatch
- VPC
- CloudFormation
- Event-driven architectures
- REST APIs

Infrastructure as Code 
- Strong experience with AWS CDK
- Ability to create and manage complete AWS infrastructure using code
- Experience with reusable CDK constructs
- Understanding of CloudFormation and infrastructure lifecycle management

CI/CD 
- Strong experience with GitHub Actions
- Automated build, test, and deployment pipelines
- Environment-specific deployments
- AWS authentication and secure deployment workflows
- Deployment rollback and release strategies

Development / Scripting 
- Experience with at least one language such as TypeScript, Python, or Java
- Understanding of REST APIs and JSON
- Shell scripting and automation experience
Security
- Strong understanding of AWS IAM
- IAM roles, policies, trust relationships, and least-privilege access
- Secure CI/CD authentication and AWS deployments
- Understanding of AWS networking and security best practices

Preferred Qualifications 
- 7+ years of experience working with AWS/cloud infrastructure.
- Strong production experience with AWS serverless and container-based architectures.
- Experience designing end-to-end AWS solutions.
- Experience managing multiple environments such as Dev, QA, UAT, and Production.
- Experience with AWS account/region management.
- Knowledge of observability, logging, monitoring, and incident troubleshooting.
- AWS certifications are a plus.

Ideal Candidate 
The ideal candidate should be able to take an application from source code infrastructure CI/CD pipeline AWS deployment monitoring production support and independently manage the complete lifecycle.
Strong practical experience with AWS CDK + GitHub Actions + Lambda + API Gateway + ECS + SQS/SNS + DynamoDB + IAM is essential.

title: Cloud Data Engineer | Snowflake, Spark, dbt, SQL & AWS
description:
Job Description 
Job Summary 
Synechron is seeking a highly skilled Cloud Data Engineer to design, develop, and optimize scalable, cloud-based data pipelines supporting advanced analytics and data warehousing initiatives. In this role, you will leverage AWS cloud services, orchestrate data workflows with Airflow, build modular data transformation models using DBT, and manage Snowflake data warehouses. Your expertise will enable reliable, high-performance data architectures aligned with enterprise objectives, facilitating data-driven decision-making and operational efficiency across large-scale systems.
Software Requirements 
Required: AWS services (S3, Lambda, Glue, EC2), Apache Airflow, DBT, Snowflake, SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Snowflake), Git, Jenkins, CI/CD automation tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps)
Preferred: Kubernetes, Terraform, DataOps tools, monitoring/alerting platforms (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk)
Experience level: 5+ years supporting enterprise cloud data pipelines, migration, and automation in large organizations
Overall Responsibilities 
Design and implement scalable data pipelines utilizing AWS cloud services for analytics, reporting, and data management
Develop and maintain workflows with Apache Airflow to automate data ingestion, transformation, and loading processes
Build modular, testable data transformation logic using DBT, ensuring data quality and consistency across systems
Manage and optimize Snowflake data warehouses for high-throughput analytical workloads
Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams to gather requirements, validate data models, and implement solutions
Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot issues, and optimize performance and reliability
Automate deployment, scaling, and maintenance activities with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
Support migration projects, data integration, and cloud transitioning efforts supporting enterprise architecture
Document architecture, data flow, and operational procedures for ongoing support and compliance
Technical Skills (By Category) 
Programming Languages:
Essential: SQL, Python, Shell scripting
Preferred: Java, Scala (for big data processing)
Data Management & Databases:
Snowflake, PostgreSQL, MySQL; schema design, data validation, and performance tuning
Cloud Technologies:
AWS (preferred), Azure (preferred), basic support for GCP supported
Frameworks & Libraries:
DBT, Apache Airflow, Spark, Presto, Kafka (preferred for streaming)
Development Tools & Methodologies:
Terraform, CloudFormation, Git, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines, Agile/Scrum, DataOps best practices
Security & Compliance:
Data encryption, IAM policies, audit logging, compliance with data standards (GDPR, HIPAA)
Experience Requirements 
5+ years supporting enterprise big data or cloud data infrastructure
Proven experience designing and operating scalable data pipelines on cloud platforms
Hands-on expertise with AWS, Snowflake, Airflow, and DBT for ETL and data management
Experience supporting data migration, automation, and performance tuning in large systems
Industry experience in finance, healthcare, retail, or enterprise analytics is preferred; relevant large-scale data support experience in other sectors also acceptable
Day-to-Day Activities 
Develop, support, and optimize cloud data pipelines for enterprise analytics platforms
Automate data workflows, deployment pipelines, and infrastructure provisioning
Troubleshoot pipeline failures, data quality issues, and operational bottlenecks
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and enterprise teams on data ingestion, transformation, and integration projects
Support migration, cloud adoption, and system upgrades in line with enterprise architecture strategies
Monitor and tune system performance, capacity, and security standards
Maintain documentation for architecture, data models, and operational procedures
Qualifications 
Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related fields
6+ years in enterprise cloud data environment support, automation, and pipeline management
Certifications such as AWS Data Analytics, Solutions Architect, or equivalent are advantageous
Strong coding, troubleshooting, and optimization skills
Excellent collaboration, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills
Experience working within large-scale data ecosystems supporting business analytics
Professional Competencies 
Critical thinking and analytical problem-solving for high-volume data pipelines
Leadership and team collaboration in cross-functional environments
Effective communication for stakeholder alignment and documentation
Adaptability to evolving cloud and data technologies
Ownership of system reliability, security, and operational excellence
Time management and planning skills to meet continuous delivery goals

title: IT- Project Manager
description:
Your work profile 
Understand the Project Delivery Framework (PDF) and how to apply both Waterfall and Agile project delivery methodologies within the framework.
Manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) for complex IT projects, ensuring adherence to scope, budget, and timelines.
Develop Project Charter, project plans, including detailed scope, budget, and schedule baselines.
Establish appropriate project governance and assurance, meticulously monitoring progress, managing risks, issues, and dependencies (internal and external), and ensuring readiness for change.
Provide clear, concise, and regular delivery reports, metrics, and measurements to stakeholders, including senior management and clients.
Proactively identify and mitigate project risks and impediments, addressing root causes and developing effective remediation plans.
Oversee project financials, tracking budget variances, and implementing corrective actions to ensure projects are delivered within budget.
Manage changes in project scope, costs, resources, and timing within established governance and change control processes.
Ensure quality project standards are met as prescribed by IT Services through the effective implementation and use of approved processes, methodologies, and deliverables.
Manage vendor relationships and third-party dependencies as required.
Act as a servant leader and coach for multiple Agile/Scrum teams, facilitating all Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint demos).
Guide and mentor team members on Agile principles, practices, and roles, ensuring a shared understanding and adherence to Agile methodologies.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners to define, refine, and prioritize user stories, epics, and product backlogs, ensuring alignment with strategic business goals and value delivery.
Proactively identify and remove obstacles or impediments that may hinder the team's progress, escalating when necessary.
Foster a culture of transparency, trust, open communication, and continuous improvement within the teams.
Encourage team self-organization and accountability for their decisions and commitments.
Champion the adoption of DevOps practices, test automation, and CI/CD pipelines to enhance delivery efficiency and quality.
Participate in and assist with larger Agile scaling frameworks (e.g., SAFe) activities, including PI planning events, as applicable.
Key skills required 
Overall, 8 to 12 years of professional experience in the IT industry, of which at least 6-8 years should have been in a Project Manager and Scrum Master role.
BE/BTech + MBA (Preferred)
Certifications like PMP/PMI-ACP/CSM/PSM/Prince2/SAFe is preferred.
Good understanding on SDLC phases and deliverables.
Understanding of Project management methodologies and models (Waterfall and Agile) 
Knowledge and experience of other agile, lean and DevOps approaches (e.g., XP, Kanban, TDD, continuous integration, continuous delivery, automation, etc.)
Hands on experience on any project management tool such as ADO, Monday.com Jira, MPP, Clarity, PowerBI etc.
Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) 
Ability to interact with all levels of the organization in a professional, diplomatic and tactful manner.
Attention to detail.
Negotiation skills
Critical Thinking 
MUST be flexible to travel

title: Program Manager
description:
Program Manager Job Description
Oct 28, 2026 • @DIONCE AI
About Dionce Technologies
Dionce Technologies (DIOnce "Do It Once") is a Bangalore-based agentic AI start-up. We build autonomous AI agents that plan, decide and act across customer experience, knowledge management and business operations, carrying enterprise workflows through from start to finish rather than handing them back to a human queue.
Our products include:
AvaniCX an agentic AI customer experience platform combining cloud telephony, conversational AI and agentic automation. Its AI agents (Receptionist, Sales, Qualification, Booking, Hiring, Customer Support and Telemarketing) take a call, understand it and finish the job, with an agentic control layer for LLM selection, guardrails and audit trails, plus post-call analytics.

We are a small, fast-moving team working with Technology leader, CX Transformation and operations leaders and growing businesses. Joining us means owning outcomes end to end, from the first customer conversation to a live deployment.
About the role
We are hiring a Program Manager with 4-8 years of experience to run the commercial and delivery engine of our AI products. You will drive pre-sales and sales enablement, open new business, and then own the delivery and coordination of the projects you help win.
This is a start-up role with real breadth: one week you are shaping a proposal and demo for a contact-centre prospect, the next you are running a go-live with engineering and the customer's operations team. You will be the connective tissue between founders, sales, engineering, data science and customers.

Role
Program Manager

Experience
4-8 years

Reports to
Founder 

Location
Remote

Employment type
Full-time

Key responsibilities
Pre-sales and sales enablement 
Lead discovery calls and solution workshops with prospects; map their customer-experience and operations workflows to AvaniCX and TrustWiz capabilities
Build and deliver product demos and proofs of concept with engineering, tailored to the prospect's use case
¢Own proposals, RFP/RFI responses, pricing inputs, effort estimates and statements of work
¢Create and maintain sales collateral: pitch decks, case studies, battle cards, ROI calculators and demo scripts
¢Train and enable sales partners and channel teams on product positioning and qualification
Business development 
¢Identify and qualify new opportunities across contact centres, CX teams and growing businesses; build and manage a pipeline
¢Develop partnerships with telephony providers, system integrators and resellers
¢Represent Dionce at industry events, webinars and customer forums
¢Feed market and competitor insights back into the product roadmap
Project delivery 
¢Own end-to-end delivery of customer implementations from kick-off to go-live and hypercare: scope, plan, budget, timeline and quality
¢Define delivery milestones, success criteria and acceptance plans with the customer
¢Manage risks, dependencies and change requests; escalate early and resolve
¢Run UAT, go-live and post-deployment reviews; track adoption and outcome metrics
Project coordination 
¢Coordinate day-to-day across engineering, data science, QA and customer teams; run stand-ups, status reviews and steering meetings
¢Maintain project plans, RAID logs and status reports for leadership and customers
¢Manage multiple concurrent projects and prioritise shared engineering capacity
¢Standardise delivery playbooks, templates and onboarding processes as the company scales
Required qualifications
¢4-8 years of experience in program or project management, pre-sales, solution consulting or delivery roles in a SaaS, AI or technology services company
¢Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or business; MBA is a plus
¢Proven pre-sales experience: discovery, demos, proposals, RFP responses and effort estimation for B2B software or AI solutions
¢Track record of business development: building pipeline, closing or materially contributing to new deals, and managing partner relationships
¢Delivered at least two end-to-end customer implementations, owning scope, schedule, budget and stakeholder management
¢Working understanding of AI products: conversational AI, LLMs, agentic automation, cloud telephony or contact-centre technology, and the ability to explain them to business buyers
¢Hands-on with project tools (Jira, Asana, MS Project or similar) and Agile/Scrum delivery
¢Excellent communication and presentation skills; comfortable with C-level customers and engineers alike
¢Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed
Preferred qualifications
¢Prior start-up experience in a role spanning sales, delivery and operations
¢Domain exposure to digital transformation, IT/BPM, customer support or CX transformation
¢Experience selling or delivering voice AI, chatbots, CCaaS or CRM-integrated solutions
¢PMP, PRINCE2, CSM or SAFe certification
¢Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and integration concepts such as APIs and webhooks
¢Experience with CRM and sales tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho)
Skills and competencies
Area
What good looks like

Pre-sales
Runs crisp discovery, tells a convincing product story, and scopes solutions engineering can actually deliver

Sales enablement
Produces collateral and training that lets others sell without you in the room

Business development
Builds pipeline methodically, qualifies hard, and keeps partners engaged

Delivery management
Keeps implementations on time and on scope; surfaces risk before it becomes a fire

Coordination
Keeps multiple teams and customers aligned with clear plans, minutes and follow-ups

AI literacy
Explains what our agents can and cannot do, and sets realistic customer expectations

Commercial judgement
Balances customer asks against margin, effort and roadmap

Ownership
Treats every deal and every delivery as yours from first call to renewal

What we offer
¢A front-row seat at an early-stage agentic AI company, with direct access to founders and customers
¢Broad ownership across sales and delivery, and a clear path to leading a function as we grow
¢Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives and ESOPs 
¢Learning budget for AI, sales and program-management certifications
¢Flexible / hybrid working and standard health benefits
How to apply
Send your CV and a short note describing one deal you helped win and one project you delivered end to end, what went well and what you would do differently, to hr@dionce.ai

Preferred candidate profile 
9+ yrs of experience into BPO/Shared services/GCC non IT project/program mgt with excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder mgt skills and with the above functional skills will be the preferred candidate, PMP Certification is a MUST
