title: Campaign Program Manager
description:
Key responsibilities 
Act as the India field marketing lead collaborating closely with all India GTM, Sales, Partner teams to gather insights, deliver campaigns and align plans to accelerate business growth. 
Develop a data-informed strategy on audience segmentation and opportunity, prioritization of marketing channels and tactics to conceptualize programs that will deliver impact across the account customer lifecycle 
Design and execution of key in-market direct and 3rd party events providing superlative customer experience in partnership with the local team and APAC (when and where applicable) 
Lead through influence to ensure delivery and execution at scale of campaigns and programs across India Field marketing and business teams that result in measurable growth in business goals and revenue. Set best practices in narratives, engagement and high-performance campaigns. 
Leverage all direct and indirect channels to land new business and drive up-sell, cross-sell and adoption marketing campaigns across customer buying groups and activate the ecosystem for new business acquisition. 
Develop and test new campaign scenarios to drive optimizations and efficiencies against investments. 
Prepare and input into forecasts, performance reports, monitoring key business metrics, quality and audience insights. 
Continually look at ongoing innovations and best practices to elevate the program, experience, and results. 

The ideal candidate should have: 
Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AIs potential impact on the function or industry. 
8+ years of marketing experience in a B2B enterprise technology environment directly supporting sales teams in field marketing, account-based marketing, or campaign management. Proven track record of delivering business impact across the account lifecycle. An understanding of the diverse business, cultural and media landscapes across India with proven experience in adapting marketing strategies for localisation. 
Experience in managing budgets and vendors to deliver effective marketing campaigns at scale. 
Experience managing multiple stakeholders across concurrent campaigns. 
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Ability to influence and align diverse, senior stakeholders across different time zones and cultural backgrounds. 
Be digitally savvy with a demonstrated understanding of the role of digital across integrated campaigns. 

Education: 
Graduate degree in marketing/business (or equivalent); advanced degree strongly preferred 
MBA beneficial but not required

title: Program Manager- Kids Gymnastic Center (North Whitefield, Bengaluru)
description:
Job Description - Program Manager 
Location- North Whitefield, Bengaluru 

What is the role? 
This is an exciting people person role for a young energetic go getter who loves to lead and take
responsibility. It covers all the key aspects of running any business such as Sales, Marketing, and
Operations. Its almost like running your own business. We are a very customer (both child and parent)
focused company and we look for people who are customer centric. As the Program Manager whilst you
have overall responsibilities for all functions in the center, your primary focus is parent and child
engagement and maintaining the quality of the classes with accurate documentation.
What would you do? 
Engage with parents and children both new and existing via phone call, emails and personal interaction.
Teach the best classes as per the curriculum
Maintain the class quality as per the little gym standards and curriculum
Conduct quality checks for the classes
Lead and participate in marketing and promotional activities to generate leads
Responsible for centre operation to ensure a safe, clean and child friendly environment
Planning and executing special events like Show Weeks, Birthday party, Pyjama party,
Field trips, Skill Thrill and other events
Maintain all documents and prepare reports as required
What do you need? 
0-2 years of experience in customer facing role
Interest in customer interactions
Proficiency in English, basic knowledge of MS Office
Fast learner and who loves to interact with people (very sociable)
Must be healthy and fit to be able to teach a class when required
Ability to build rapport and inspire others
Effective communication, with children as well as with parents
Organized, self-motivated multi-tasker with strong work ethic
High energy individuals who are happy and love to work with children
Why work with TLG? 
Strong sense of fulfilment
Keep fit as you work
Competitive compensation
Comprehensive ongoing career training
Fun, high energy work environment
Excellent opportunity for career growth & advancement
Work days & Timings - Tuesday to Sunday 10 am to 7 pm 
Salary - 3.5L 4L 
Regards , 
Nandini

title: Project Manager
description:
Position Overview 
We are looking for a results-driven Project Manager with mandatory expertise in WordPress / WooCommerce e-commerce implementations to lead technical delivery teams. This is a fully remote role supporting global clients, requiring exceptional communication skills and a deep understanding of web development workflows, plugin integrations, performance optimization, and e-commerce growth strategies.
Role Details 
Role: Project Manager E-Commerce Platforms
Experience Required: 7–12 years
Shift Timing: 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST (Night Shift)
Work Model: 100% Remote

Key Responsibilities 
E-Commerce Project Delivery 
Oversee full lifecycle development and delivery of custom e-commerce web applications built on WordPress / WooCommerce .
Define project roadmaps, backlog prioritization, sprint plans, and technical deliverable milestones.
Ensure seamless integrations with payment gateways, ERP/CRM systems, third-party logistics (3PL), and custom APIs.

Required Qualifications 
7–12 years of total IT project management experience.
Mandatory hands-on experience or deep technical understanding of WordPress / WooCommerce platform delivery. 
Demonstrated experience delivering cross-border e-commerce web applications, plugins, custom theme builds, and payment integrations.
Strong familiarity with web performance metrics, hosting setups, and security compliance (SSL, PCI-DSS).
Expertise in Jira/Trello/Asana for sprint tracking and back-log grooming.
Flexibility and willingness to work a dedicated night-shift schedule ( 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST ).

title: Project Manager
description:
Job Description Project Manager 
Position: Senior Manager
Experience: 10–25+ Years
Industry: Residential & Commercial Development / Construction
Department: Projects / Engineering
Location: Bengaluru
Reporting To: GM – Projects
Position Overview 
A Senior Civil Engineer with 15 to 25 years of professional experience is responsible for leading, managing, and delivering complex civil engineering projects across all phases—from planning and feasibility through design, construction, and closeout. This role provides high-level technical guidance, ensures regulatory compliance, mentors engineering teams, and collaborates with clients and stakeholders to achieve project objectives. The engineer is recognized as a subject-matter expert and contributes to strategic decision-making within the organization.
Key Responsibilities 
1. Project Planning & Execution 
Lead the planning and execution of all civil and structural works for residential, commercial, plotted, or mixed-use projects.
Prepare project execution plans, work schedules, and construction timelines.
Review and interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings for execution accuracy.
Ensure adherence to approved drawings, specifications, and project milestones.
2. Site Supervision & Construction Management 
Oversee day-to-day site operations and ensure proper construction practices are followed.
Coordinate with site engineers, contractors, subcontractors, and labour teams.
Monitor the quality of materials and workmanship; ensure compliance with IS codes and standards.
Resolve technical issues that arise during construction.
3. Quality Assurance & Safety Compliance 
Implement and enforce QA/QC processes at all project sites.
Conduct periodic inspections, non-conformance assessments, and corrective actions.
Ensure compliance with safety protocols, statutory norms, and company EHS policies.
Conduct toolbox talks, safety audits, and training for site staff.
4. Project Budgeting & Cost Control 
Assist in project estimation, BOQs, tendering, and contractor evaluations.
Monitor material consumption, labour utilization, and prevent wastage.
Certify contractor bills, verify measurements, and ensure cost control.
Forecast resource requirements and update management on deviations.
5. Coordination With Stakeholders 
Collaborate with architects, structural consultants, MEP teams, and PMC agencies.
Liaise with government authorities (BBMP, BDA, BWSSB, KPTCL, Pollution Control Board) for approvals and inspections.
Work closely with procurement, planning, and contract teams for project needs.
6. Documentation & Reporting 
Maintain daily/weekly/monthly site progress reports.
Prepare DPRs, WPRs, MPRs, snag lists, and handover documentation.
Track project progress, identify risks, and report delays to management.
Ensure complete documentation for RERA compliance and audits.
7. Team Leadership 
Mentor and guide junior engineers, supervisors, and site staff.
Allocate tasks, monitor performance, and ensure cross-team coordination.
Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering processes and standards.
Required Skills & Competencies 
B.E./B.Tech / M.Tech in Civil Engineering.
15–25+ years’ experience in real estate/construction sector with hands-on site execution.
Strong knowledge of structural systems, finishing works, and building services coordination.
Expertise in local building bylaws, NBC, IS codes, and regulatory requirements.
Proficiency in MS Project, AutoCAD, Primavera, Civil 3D, MicroStation, GIS, design and modelling tools and construction management tools.
Strong leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Experience 
Work experience with real estate developers (residential, commercial, villa, plotted development).
Exposure to high-rise buildings, luxury housing, Commercial Development and mixed-use development projects in Bangalore.
Strong understanding of soil conditions, concrete grades, waterproofing, and advanced construction methodologies.
Summary 
We are seeking a Senior Civil Engineer to lead the execution of large-scale real estate projects in Bangalore. The candidate must have extensive experience in high-rise/residential construction, strong leadership abilities, and deep technical knowledge in civil engineering and site management.

title: Technical Project Manager (Web & Mobile)
description:
We are seeking a hands-on Technical Project Manager with 4+ years of experience to lead and coordinate our software engineering teams. In this role, you will bridge business requirements and technical execution, directly managing Full Stack Developers (React/Node.js) and Flutter Mobile Developers to deliver web and mobile applications on time and within scope.
Key Responsibilities 
Sprint & Workflow Management: Lead Agile/Scrum ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, task estimation, and retrospectives using Jira or Trello.
Technical Oversight & Coordination: Facilitate technical alignment between Flutter mobile app releases and Node.js/React backend API integrations.
Delivery & Milestone Tracking: Track project progress, eliminate technical blockers, manage risk, and ensure high-quality software releases.
Stakeholder & Client Communication: Translate business goals into clear user stories, technical tickets, and scope documentation.
Quality & Deployment Assurance: Coordinate code releases across web platforms and app stores (Google Play Store & Apple App Store).
Key Requirements 
3 to 6 years of software project management experience within an IT services firm, product startup, or software agency.
Strong technical backgroundprior hands-on experience as a developer, QA lead, or technical analyst is highly preferred.
Solid grasp of modern web and mobile tech stacks (React, Node.js, Flutter, REST APIs).

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
NxtWave is a fast-growing Hyderabad-based EdTech company founded by IIT alumni. It helps students build industry-ready tech skills and land jobs at top companies, teaching in English and regional languages. Its programs include CCBP 4.0 Academy and NxtWave Institute of Advanced Technologies (NIAT). Backed by leading investors, NxtWave is building AI-first systems across learning, sales, and hiring.
About the Role 
Own NxtWave's AI calling, operations flows, and CRM end to end. You'll run the voice agents, streamline how teams work, and keep the CRM accurate and insight-ready, working with Sales, TA, Ops, and Tech teams.
Key Responsibilities 
AI Calling 
Own the AI Calling Product: Take full ownership of the AI calling platform we provide. Set up, configure, and manage voice agents across use cases and Indian languages.
AI Calling Prompting: Write, test, and refine voice agent prompts: persona, tone, call objectives, objection handling, guardrails, and multilingual flows. Version and A/B test prompts to lift connect and conversion.
Agent Performance: Review recordings and transcripts to find drop-offs and fix agent behaviour.
Vendor & Cost: Coordinate with voice AI vendors on issues, feature requests, SLAs, and billing. Track usage and reduce cost per call.
Operations 
Process Optimization: Map workflows, remove bottlenecks, and automate manual steps to cut TAT.
SOPs & SLAs: Define SOPs for new flows, track SLAs, and train teams to adopt them.
Quality & Compliance: Ensure calls and processes follow company guidelines, consent norms, and data privacy standards.
CRM Management 
CRM Ownership: Manage CRM setup: fields, stages, pipelines, lead routing, and automations.
Integrations: Connect the AI calling platform with CRM/ATS so call outcomes sync accurately.
Data Hygiene: Keep lead data clean: dedupe records, maintain status accuracy, and manage user access.
Reports & Insights: Build CRM dashboards, track KPIs (connect rate, conversion, drop-offs, cost per outcome), and share weekly insights with leadership.
Stakeholder Management: Act as the single point of contact for Sales, TA, and Ops on these systems; align priorities and manage expectations.
What We're Looking For 
24 years in product ops, CRM management, business operations, or a similar role
Hands-on experience with AI tools, LLMs, and voice agents
Proven experience writing and optimizing prompts for AI calling / voice agents
Hands-on CRM experience (e.g., LeadSquared, Salesforce, Zoho, HubSpot)
Strong process thinking with an eye for optimization
Data-savvy: Excel/Sheets required, SQL a plus
Strong stakeholder management and ability to handle multiple projects against tight deadlines
Clear communication, ownership mindset, and comfort in a fast-paced startup
Good to Have: Voice AI platforms (ElevenLabs, Hooman Labs, OSVI), APIs/webhooks, no-code/low-code tools (Replit, n8n)

title: Group Product Manager
description:
Job Description Group Product Manager (GPM) 
Industry: Pharmaceuticals
Department: Marketing
Designation: Group Product Manager
Location : Mumbai 
Job Summary 
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Group Product Manager to lead brand strategy, product management and marketing initiatives across the assigned therapeutic portfolio. The role involves developing strategic marketing plans, driving brand growth, supporting new product launches and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives.
Key Responsibilities 
Develop and implement strategic marketing plans for the assigned product portfolio to achieve sales, market share and profitability targets.
Lead brand planning, positioning, product differentiation and promotional strategy.
Analyse market trends, competitor activities, prescription trends and customer insights to identify business opportunities.
Develop marketing campaigns, promotional inputs, visual aids, product literature, digital initiatives and other marketing communication materials.
Work closely with the sales team to ensure effective implementation of brand strategies and promotional campaigns.
Conduct regular field visits and interact with doctors, key opinion leaders (KOLs) and healthcare professionals to understand market requirements.
Drive new product launches, lifecycle management and brand-building initiatives.
Prepare annual brand plans, marketing budgets, sales forecasts and business performance reviews.
Monitor product performance, sales trends, market share and return on marketing investments, and take corrective actions wherever required.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including sales, medical, regulatory, supply chain and business development, to ensure smooth execution of marketing plans.
Provide product and therapy-related training to the field force and support the development of effective selling strategies.
Guide and mentor Product Managers and other team members, where applicable.

Desired Candidate Profile 

MBA/PGDM in Marketing; a degree in Pharmacy or Life Sciences will be preferred.
Relevant experience in pharmaceutical marketing, brand management and product management, preferably at Group Product Manager level.
Strong understanding of pharmaceutical marketing, brand strategy, product launches and sales force effectiveness.
Experience in developing and executing marketing plans for assigned therapeutic segments.
Strong analytical, communication, presentation and leadership skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with sales and cross-functional teams and drive business growth.

Key Competencies 

Strategic brand planning and execution
Market research and competitor analysis
New product launch management
Sales and market share growth
Team leadership and stakeholder management
Budgeting, forecasting and performance analysis

title: Senior Product Owner (Digital Lending & LOS)
description:
Preferred candidate profile 
As a Senior Product Owner, you will own the Product Vision for our Loan Origination System (LOS). You will be responsible for the "Why" and the "When," ensuring that our lending platform stays ahead of market trends while maintaining extreme technical stability. You will mentor Business Analysts and collaborate directly with the C-suite (CTO/CRO) to align technical roadmaps with business growth targets. 

Role & responsibilities 

1. Strategic Roadmap & Prioritization 
Vision Ownership: Define the multi-year roadmap for the LOS, balancing new product launches (e.g., transitioning from Unsecured to Secured) with technical debt.
Backlog Grooming: Manage and prioritize a high-velocity product backlog to ensure the engineering team works on high-impact features.
Stakeholder Buy-in: Navigate conflicting requirements from Risk (who want more friction/checks) and Sales (who want one-click disbursements). 

2. Technical Orchestration & Architecture 
System Evolution: Lead the transition from monolithic LOS architectures to Microservices-based architectures.
Vendor Ecosystem: Evaluate and onboard third-party Fintech partners (Liveness checks, Account Aggregators, BRE engines) and manage the "Build vs. Buy" decision-making process. 
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the product journey is "Compliant by Design," incorporating RBI/Global regulatory mandates into the automated workflow. 

3. Segmented Competence Matrix 
A. Unsecured Lending Mastery (Lead Level) 
Focus: Hyper-Scalability & Data-Driven Growth 
BRE Orchestration: Expertise in configuring complex Business Rule Engines that can process 10,000+ applications daily without manual intervention.
Funnel Analytics: Using data to identify micro-conversions and implementing A/B testing on different credit policy rules.
Collection Integration: Designing the handshake between the LOS and the Collections/Recovery systems for early-warning signals. 

B. Secured Lending Mastery (Lead Level) 
Focus: Risk Mitigation & Ecosystem Integration 
LTV Optimization: Dynamically adjusting Loan-to-Value ratios based on real-time market data or collateral depreciation models.
Legal Tech Integration: Automating the "Title Search" and "Lien Marking" processes via integration with government property or education registries.
Complex Disbursement: Managing "Tranche-based" disbursements common in Education or Construction loans, linked to physical milestones. 

Technical Toolkit 
Project Management: Jira (Advanced Roadmaps), AWS DevOps.
Analytics: SQL, Google Analytics. 
Technical: Deep understanding of Cloud Infrastructure (AWS/Azure) and API Gateways. 
Architecture: LucidChart or Miro for high-level system design.
